{r:My parents moved here a year ago.} - Ota-onam bir yil oldin bu yerga ko'chib keldi.

text: {r:Evening}[ˈiːvnɪŋ] - kechqurun.
examples: {r:I cleaned the house yesterday evening.} - Men kecha kechqurun uyni tozaladim.
{r:Did she dance at the party last evening?} - U kecha kechqurun bazmda raqsga tushdimi?
{r:They didn't enjoy the evening.} - Ular kechqurun zavqlanmadi.
{r:My friends watched a movie last evening.} - Do'stlarim kecha kechqurun kino ko'rdi.

text: {r:Arrive}[əˈraɪv] – yetib kelmoq. Qadimda ayollar erlarini juda qattiq hurmat qilishgan. {p:Er ayv}onga {h:yetib kelganda} hali ichkariga kirmasidan oldin xotinlari erlarining qo'llariga suv quyib turishgan.
examples: {r:I arrived at the hotel yesterday.} - Men kecha mehmonxonaga keldim.
{r:Did she arrive late last night?} - U kecha kechqurun kech keladimi?
{r:They didn't arrive on time.} - Ular vaqtida kelmadi.
{r:Children arrived home early from school.} - Bolalar maktabdan uyga erta keldi.

text: {r:Start}[stɑːrt] - boshlash; boshlamoq. 'Start' nima ekanligini eslasangiz kerak. Yugurishni {h:boshlaydigan} chiziq bu {p:start} tugatadigan qismi esa finish.
examples: {r:I started my homework yesterday.} - Men kecha uy vazifamni boshladim.
{r:Did Anthony start the meeting on time?} - Antoni yig'ilishni vaqtida boshladimi?
{r:They didn't start the journey early.} - Ular safarni erta boshladi.
{r:My colleagues started a new project last week.} - Hamkasblarim o'tgan hafta yangi loyihani boshladi.

text: {r:Dance}[dæns] – raqs;raqsga tushmoq. Siz bu vaziyatda {p:TENNIS} o'yinida sportchining ajoyib {h:raqsini} tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:I danced at the party last night.} - Men kecha kechqurun bazmda raqsga tushdim.
{r:Did she dance with her friends?} - U do'stlari bilan raqsga tushdimi?
{r:They didn't dance much.} - Ular ko'p raqsga tushmadi.
{r:My parents danced together.} - Ota-onam birga raqsga tushdi.

text: {r:Clean}[kliːn] – toza. Tasavvur qiling erkak kishi bo'lsangiz ham farroshsiz. {p:KLIN}ikada {h:toza}likka javob berasiz.
examples: {r:Peter cleaned his room yesterday.} - Pitr kecha xonasini tozaladi.
{r:Did he clean the kitchen last evening?} - U kecha kechqurun oshxonani tozaladimi?
{r:They didn't clean the house.} - Ular uyni tozalamadi.
{r:They cleaned the garden last week.} - Ular o'tgan hafta bog'ni tozaladi.

text: {r:Tooth}[tuːθ] – tish. Tasavvur qiling {h:tishingizga} briket qo'ydirdingiz. Briket esa {p:TUS}tovuq shaklida.
examples: {r:I brushed my teeth last night.} - Men kecha kechqurun tishlarimni yuvdim.
{r:Did Laura forget to brush her teeth?} - Laura tishlarini yuvishni unutdimi?
{r:They didn't clean their teeth last night.} - Ular tishlarini tozalamadi o'tgan tun.
{r:My brothers always brush their teeth before bed.} - Ukalarim doim uxlashdan oldin tishlarini yuvadi.

text: {r:All}[ɔːl] - barcha, hamma.
examples: {r:Anvar ate all the food yesterday.} - Anvar kecha barcha ovqatni yedi.
{r:Did Laura finish all her work?} - Laura barcha ishini tugatdimi?
{r:They didn't enjoy all the activities.} - Ular barcha mashg'ulotlardan zavqlanmadi.
{r:These girls visited all the places.} - Bu qizlar barcha joylarga tashrif buyurdi.

text: {r:Lunch}[lʌntʃ] – tushlik. Ishingiz ko'pligi tufayli har kuni obedda {h:tushlik} qilmaysiz. Shuning uchun ham juda {p:lanch} bo'lasiz.
examples: {r:I had lunch at home yesterday.} - Men kecha uyda tushlik qildim.
{r:Did that girl enjoy her lunch?} - O'sha qiz tushlikdan zavqlandimi?
{r:They didn't have lunch together.} - Ular birga tushlik qilmadi.
{r:My wife prepared lunch for us.} - Xotinim biz uchun tushlik tayyorladi.

text: {r:Enjoy}[ɪnˈdʒɔɪ] - zavqlanmoq, maza qilmoq. Indyuklar patidan choy qilinishini bilarmidingiz? Kecha {p:IN}dyuklar {p:CHOY}idan ichdim va tan olaman choydan hech qachon bunchalik {h:zavqlanmaganman}.
examples: {r:I enjoyed the party last night.} - Men kecha kechqurun bazmdan zavqlandim.
{r:Did she enjoy the journey?} - U safardan zavqlandimi?
{r:They didn't enjoy the movie.} - Ular kinodan zavqlanmadi.
{r:My friends enjoyed the holiday.} - Do'stlarim ta'tildan zavqlandi.

text: {r:Study}[ˈstʌdi] – o'qimoq, o'rganmoq. Korxonamizda faqatgina {p:sta}nokni {p:Diy}or ishlata oladi, u Xitoyga borib {h:o'rganib} kelgan.
examples: {r:I studied English yesterday.} - Men kecha ingliz tilini o'qidim.
{r:Did she study for the test?} - U test uchun o'qidimi?
{r:They didn't study much.} - Ular ko'p o'qimadi.
{r:These guys studied together last evening.} - Bu yigitlar kecha kechqurun birga o'qidi.

text:
{r:Begin}[bɪˈɡɪn] – boshlamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - began, begun. 
Begzod o'ziga katta uy qurgandan so'ng qushlarga ham uycha qurib bermoqchi bo'ldi va bugundan {p:Beg}zod {p:in} qurishni {h:boshladi}.
examples: {r:I began my homework yesterday.} - Men kecha uy vazifamni boshladim.
{r:Did she begin the meeting on time?} - U yig'ilishni vaqtida boshladimi?
{r:They didn't begin the journey early.} - Ular safarni erta boshladi.
{r:This man began a new project last week.} - Bu kishi o'tgan hafta yangi loyihani boshladi.

text:
{r:Bring}[brɪŋ] – olib kelmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari -brought, brought.  
Oldin bokschilar turgan joyida boks tushavergan ringsiz. Keyinchalik {p:B}okschilarga {p:RING} {h:olib kelindi} va ularning natijalari yaxshilandi.
examples: {r:I brought my book yesterday.} - Men kecha kitobimni olib keldim.
{r:Did she bring her bag?} - U sumkasini olib keldimi?
{r:They didn't bring any food.} - Ular hech qanday ovqat olib kelmadi.
{r:That woman brought my keys.} - O'sha ayol kalitlarimni olib keldi.

text:
{r:Build}[bɪld] – qurmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - built, built. 
Toshkentda {p:BULUT} shaklidagi bino {h:qurilyapti}.
examples: {r:I built a small house last year.} - Men o'tgan yili kichik uy qurdim.
{r:Did Laura build the table herself?} - Laura stolni o'zi qurdimi?
{r:These men didn't build the garden.} - Bu kishilar bog'ni qurmadi.
{r:My parents built a new room.} - Ota-onam yangi xona qurdilar.

text:
{r:Catch}[kætʃ] – tutmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - caught, caught. 
Kecha uyda anchadan beri mebellarni yeb bitirayotgan kalamushni tutib oldim. Lekin {p:KECH} {h:tutdim}, yog'och jihozlarni hammasini kemirib tashlagandi.
examples: {r:I caught the ball yesterday.} - Men kecha to'pni ushladim.
{r:Did she catch the bus?} - U avtobusni ushladimi?
{r:Sobir caught some birds.} - Sobir ba'zi qushlarni tutib oldi.
{r:My parents caught some fish last week.} - Ota-onam o'tgan hafta ba'zi baliqlarni tutdi.

text:
{r:Fall}[fɔːl] - yiqilmoq, pasaymoq, tushmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - fell, fallen. 
Fol to'g'ri narsa emasligi rostda. Har safar {p:FOL} ochtirganimdan so'ng {h:yiqilib tushaman}.
examples: {r:I fell down yesterday.} - Men kecha yiqildim.
{r:When did you fall?} - Qachon yiqilding?
{r:They didn't fall during the journey.} - Ular safar paytida yiqilmadi.
{r:Why did you fall?} - Nega yiqilding?

text:
{r:Fly}[flaɪ] - uchmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - flew, flown. 
Men supermenman. Qobiliyatim shuki bir sizga qarab pu{p:FLAY} Rossiya yoki Amerikagacha {h:uchib} borib qolasiz.
examples: {r:I flew to Paris last month.} - Men o'tgan oy Parijga uchdim.
{r:Did she fly alone?} - U yolg'iz uchdimi?
{r:They didn't fly to the city.} - Ular shaharga uchmadi.
{r:I flew to Moscow with my wife.} - Moskvaga xotinim bilan uchdim.

text:
{r:Give}[ɡɪv] – bermoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - gave, given. 
Hammamiz oxirgi paytlarda ko'p eshitayotgan give konkurs yoki give away so'zlari manu shu so'zdan olingan.
examples: {r:I gave her a gift yesterday.} - Men kecha unga sovg'a berdim.
{r:Did she give you the book?} - U sizga kitobni beradimi?
{r:They didn't give any money.} - Ular hech qanday pul bermadi.
{r:My parents gave me some advice.} - Ota-onam menga ba'zi maslahatlar berdi.

text:
{r:Hear}[hɪr] – eshitmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - heard, heard. 
Sevgilisi bilan ajralishgan yigit ''{p:Hayr} endi, hayr endi'' nomli qo'shiqni {h:eshityapti}.
examples: {r:I heard the news yesterday.} - Men kecha yangiliklarni eshitdim.
{r:Did she hear the music?} - U musiqani eshitdimi?
{r:Guys didn't hear the signal.} - Yigitlar signalni eshitmadi.
{r:We heard the story last week.} - Biz o'tgan hafta hikoyani eshitdik.

text:
{r:Find}[faɪnd] – topmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - found, found. 
Fayzulla changlarni artmoqchi edi lekin lattani qayerdaligini eslay olmadi. {p:Fay}zulla {p:N}iderlandiya bayrog'ini {h:topib} oldi va tozalash uchun ishlatdi.
examples: {r:I found my keys yesterday.} - Men kecha kalitlarimni topdim.
{r:Did she find her bag?} - U sumkasini topdimi?
{r:They didn't find the book.} - Ular kitobni topmadi.
{r:My children found some old photos.} - Bolalarim ba'zi eski fotosuratlarni topdi.

text:
{r:Forget}[fərˈɡet] - unutmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - forgot, forgotten. 
Agar xotiningiz sizni egovlashini xohlamasangiz 8 - marta {p:BUKET} sovg'a qilishni {h:unutmang.} Yil bo'yi tinch yurasiz keyin.
examples: {r:I forgot my homework yesterday.} - Men kecha uy vazifamni unutdim.
{r:Did Laura forget her bag?} - Laura sumkasini unutdimi?
{r:They didn't forget the meeting.} - Ular yig'ilishni unutmadi.
{r:My children forgot to call me.} - Bolalarim menga qo'ng'iroq qilishni unutdi.

text:
{r:Leave}[liːv] - tashlab ketmoq; qoldirmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - left, left. 
Agar ishxonangizda halol ishlamay, qandaydir {p:liv}ak qilish yo'llarini qidirsangiz, ishdan {h:ketishingizga} to'g'ri kelib qolishi mumkin.
examples: {r:I left the house early yesterday.} - Men kecha uydan erta chiqdim.
{r:Did Laura leave her bag at home?} - Laura sumkasini uyda qoldirdimi?
{r:They didn't leave the party early.} - Ular bazmdan erta chiqmadi.
{r:My wife left for work at 7 a.m.} - Xotinim ishga soat 7da chiqdi.

text:
{r:Lose}[luːz] - yo'qotmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - lost, lost. 
Nima deb o'ylaysiz {p:LUIZ}a Rasulova nimasini {h:yo'qotsa} xalq e'tiborini yo'qotib qo'yadi? Menimcha sochini!
examples: {r:I lost my keys yesterday.} - Men kecha kalitlarimni yo'qotdim.
{r:Did he lose his bag?} - U sumkasini yo'qotdimi?
{r:They didn't lose the game.} - Ular o'yinni yo'qotmadi.
{r:My parents lost some money last week.} - Ota-onam o'tgan hafta ba'zi pullarini yo'qotdi.

text:
{r:Make}[meɪk] – qilmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - made, made. 
'Nima ish qilasan' deysizmi, pushti rangli {p:mayk}alar {h:tayyorlayman}.
examples: {r:I made lunch yesterday.} - Men kecha tushlik tayyorladim.
{r:Did she make the cake herself?} - U tortni o'zi tayyorladimi?
{r:They didn't make any mistakes.} - Ular hech qanday xato qilmadi.
{r:My father made a new table.} - Otam yangi stol yasadi.

text:
{r:Meet}[miːt] – uchratmoq, uchrashmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - met, met. 
Shaharga birinchi marta borganimda juda qiziq bo'ldi, {p:Mit}tini {h:uchratib} qoldim.
examples: {r:I met my friends yesterday.} - Men kecha do'stlarim bilan uchrashdim.
{r:Did she meet her teacher?} - U o'qituvchisi bilan uchrashdimi?
{r:They didn't meet at the park.} - Ular parkda uchrashmadi.
{r:My mother met some old friends last week.} - Onam o'tgan hafta ba'zi eski do'stlari bilan uchrashdi.

text:
{r:Pay}[peɪ] – to'lamoq;to'lov. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - paid, paid. 
Kartadan kartaga foizsiz {h:to'lov} qilmoqchimisiz, unda {p:Pey}midan foydalaning.
examples: {r:I paid for the meal yesterday.} - Men kecha ovqat uchun pul to'ladim.
{r:Did you pay the bill?} - Siz hisobni to'ladingizmi?
{r:They didn't pay for the tickets.} - Ular chiptalar uchun pul to'lamadi.
{r:My father paid for the hotel.} - Otam mehmonxona uchun pul to'ladi.

text: {r:Open}[ˈoʊpən] – ochiq. Open Byujet so'zini eshitgan bo'lsangiz kerak, ''ochiq byujet'' degani. Ochiq byujet orqali mahallalardagi muammolarni hal qilish uchun mablag' ajratiladi.
examples: {r:I opened the window yesterday.} - Men kecha derazani ochdim.
{r:Did they open the door?} - Ular eshikni ochdimi?
{r:They didn't open the box.} - Ular qutini ochmadi.
{r:My father opened a new shop last month.} - Otam o'tgan oy yangi do'kon ochdi.

text:
{r:Sell}[sel] – sotmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - sold, sold. 
Hozirgi kunda do'konlarda hatto {p:sel}ofan paket ham {h:sotilyapti.} Bu esa mening biroz jahlimni chiqardi.
examples: {r:I sold my old bike yesterday.} - Men kecha eski velosipedimni sotdim.
{r:Did she sell her car?} - U mashinasini sotdimi?
{r:They didn't sell the house.} - Ular uyni sotmadi.
{r:My friend sold some old furniture.} - Do'stim ba'zi eski mebellarni sotdi.

text:
{r:Tell}[tel] – aytmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - told, told. 
Ba'zi sirli gaplarni hamma oldida gapirib bo'lmaydi, ular {p:tel}efonda {h:aytiladi}.
examples: {r:I told her the story yesterday.} - Men kecha unga hikoyani aytdim.
{r:Did she tell you the news?} - U sizga yangiliklarni aytdimi?
{r:They didn't tell the truth.} - Ular haqiqatni aytmadi.
{r:Your parents told me some advice.} - Ota-onang menga ba'zi maslahatlar berdi.

text:
{r:Think}[θɪŋk] – o'ylamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - thought, thought. 
Doktor kovid uchun bemorlarga biroz {h:o'ylab} {p:tsink} yozib berdi. U yaxshi mineral.
examples: {r:I thought about the problem yesterday.} - Men kecha muammo haqida o'yladim.
{r:Did they think about the plan?} - Ular reja haqida o'yladimi?
{r:They didn't think it was easy.} - Ular buni oson deb o'ylamadi.
{r:Your father thought the journey was difficult.} - Otang safar qiyin deb o'yladi.

text:
{r:Win}[wɪn] – yutmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - won, won. 
{p:Vin}ni Puh tennis o'ynab do'sti Kristofer va yo'lbarsni {h:yutibdi}.
examples: {r:I won the game yesterday.} - Men kecha o'yinni yutdim.
{r:Did he win the competition?} - U musobaqani yutdimi?
{r:They didn't win the prize.} - Ular sovg'ani yutmadi.
{r:My parents won a trip last year.} - Ota-onam o'tgan yili sayohat yutib oldi.

text:
{r:See}[siː] – ko'rmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - saw, seen. 
Shaharda katta bo'lganim uchun bugun birinchi bor {p:si}girni {h:ko'rdim}.
examples: {r:I saw her yesterday.} - Men kecha uni ko'rdim.
{r:Did I see the movie yesterday?} - Kecha kino ko'rdimmi?
{r:We are seeing a movie right now.} - Biz hozirda kino ko'ryapmiz.
{r:Your father saw some old friends last week.} - Otang o'tgan hafta ba'zi eski do'stlarini ko'rdi.

text:
{r:Put}[pʊt] – qo'ymoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - put, put. 
Bolaligimda dadam meni xursand qilish uchun tug'ilgan kunimda lagerga {p:put}yovkani shunday oldimga {h:qo'yganlar} va juda xursand bo'lganman.
examples: {r:I put the book on the table yesterday.} - Men kecha kitobni stolga qo'ydim.
{r:Did she put her bag in the room?} - U sumkasini xonaga qo'ydimi?
{r:They didn't put the keys in the box.} - Ular kalitlarni qutiga qo'ymadi.
{r:Your mother put the food in the fridge.} - Onangiz ovqatni muzlatgichga qo'ydi.

text:
{r:Get}[ɡet] – olmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - got, gotten. 
Har kuni mazza qilib {p:get}a o'ynash uchun kompyuter {h:olishim} kerak(yoki futbol o'ynash uchun keta).
examples: {r:I got a new book yesterday.} - Men kecha yangi kitob oldim.
{r:Did you get the job?} - Sen ishni oldingmi?
{r:They didn't get the tickets.} - Ular chiptalarni olmadi.
{r:His parents got some gifts last week.} - Uning ota-onasi o'tgan hafta ba'zi sovg'alarni oldi.

text:
{r:Sit}[sɪt] – o'tirmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - sat, sat. 
''Muzlik davri'' multfilmidagi {p:Sid} muz ustida {h:o'tiribdi}.
examples: {r:I sat on the chair yesterday.} - Men kecha stulda o'tirdim.
{r:Did she sit next to you?} - U sizning yoningizda o'tirdimi?
{r:They didn't sit together.} - Ular birga o'tirmadi.
{r:Her father sat in the garden last evening.} - Uning otasi kecha kechqurun bog'da o'tirdi.

text:
{r:Break}[breɪk] – sindirmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - broke, broken. 
Yoshligimda o'yinchoq Avtomat sotib olganimda dadam {p:bir ekk}i bo'lakka {h:bo'lib} tashlagan. Chunki bunday narsalarni o'yinchog'ini ham ishlatmasligimni xohlagan.
examples: {r:I broke the cup yesterday.} - Men kecha piyolani sindirdim.
{r:Did she break the window?} - U derazani sindirdimi?
{r:They didn't break the rules.} - Ular qoidalarni buzmadi.
{r:Her parents broke some old plates last week.} - Uning ota-onasi o'tgan hafta ba'zi eski likopchalarni sindirdi.

text: {r:Cheap}[tʃiːp] – arzon. Chip va Deyl multfilmini eslaysizmi. Deyl har doim qimmat kiyimlar sotib oladi, {p:CHIP} esa {h:''arzonlarini''}.
examples: {r:I bought a cheap book yesterday.} - Men kecha arzon kitob sotib oldim.
{r:Did he find a cheap hotel?} - U arzon mehmonxonani topdimi?
{r:They didn't buy the cheap tickets.} - Ular arzon chiptalarni sotib olmadilar.
{r:His wife found a cheap restaurant.} - Uning xotini arzon restoranni topdi.

text: {r:Thing}[θɪŋ] – narsa. Alkash insonning farzandi 'uyimizda ko'p narsa bor, lekin ko'plari {p:sing}an {h:narsalar}' dedi.
examples: {r:I bought a cheap thing yesterday.} - Men kecha arzon narsa sotib oldim.
{r:Did you find a cheap thing?} - Sen arzon narsa topdingmi?
{r:Anvar sold cheap windows last year.} - Anvar o'tgaan yili arzon derazalar sotdi.
{r:I brought some cheap things.} - Men ba'zi arzon narsalar olib keldim.

text: {r:Age}[eɪdʒ] - yosh.
examples: {r:I didn't know his age.} - Men uning yoshini bilmasdim.
{r:Did she ask your age?} - U sizning yoshingizni so'radimi?
{r:They didn't tell me their age.} - Ular menga yoshlarini aytishmadi.
{r:My boss didn't forget my age.} - Boshliq yoshimni unutmagan ekan.

text: {r:Country}[ˈkʌntri] – davlat. Hozirgi paytda mahalla yoshlarning oliygohdagi kontrakt summasini to'lashda yordam beryapti. Yoshlar shunday qilib {p:KANTR}aktga kirib olib {h:davlat}dan olib davlatga beryapti.
examples: {r:I didn't go to that country.} - Men bu mamlakatga bormadim.
{r:Did she like our country?} - U mamlakatimizni yoqtirarmidi?
{r:They didn't live in that country.} - Ular bu mamlakatda yashamadilar.
{r:My brothers didn't travel to this country.} - Akalarim bu mamlakatga sayohat qilmadi.

text: {r:Friendship}[ˈfrendʃɪp] - do'stlik. Mnemonik namuna uchun 1 - darsdagi friend(do'st) so'ziga qarang.
examples: {r:I didn't understand their friendship.} - Men ularning do'stligini tushunmadim.
{r:Did she value friendship?} - U do'stlikni qadrlaydimi?
{r:They didn't build a strong friendship.} - Ular kuchli do'stlik qura olmadilar.
{r:My friendship with him has not ended.} - U bilan do'stligimiz hali tugamagan.

text: {r:Paper}[ˈpeɪpər] - qog'oz.
examples: {r:I didn't write on the paper.} - Men qog'ozga yozmadim.
{r:Did we read that blue paper?} - Biz anavi ko'k qog'ozni o'qidikmi?
{r:They didn't need the paper.} - Ular qog'ozga muhtoj emas edi.
{r:I think I bought very cheap paper.} - Mening o'ylashimcha juda arzon qog'oz oldim.

text: {r:Mountain}[ˈmaʊntən] – tog'. Sevgan qizim bilan ajralishdan oldin tog'ga dam olishga borgandik, u yerda sevgan qizim men bilan birga bo'la olmasligini aytgan. {h:Tog'}ga chiqqanimizda 'bu oxirgi sayohatimiz, endi {p:MANI UNITIN}' degan.
examples: {r:I didn't climb the mountain.} - Men tog'ga chiqmadim.
{r:Did they see the mountain?} - U tog'ni ko'rdimi?
{r:They didn't take a picture of the mountain.} - Ular tog'ning suratini olmadilar.
{r:My parents didn't talk about the mountain.} - Ota-onam tog' haqida gapirishmadi.

text: {r:Shirt}[ʃɜːrt] – ko'ylak. Tasavvur qiling ishxonada rasmiy kiyinib o'tiribsiz. Lekin hamma sizga qaraganda kulib qo'yadi. Nihoyat ko'rdingizki {p:SHIR}inlik {p:T}egibdi {h:ko'ylagingizga.} Tort bo'lsa kerak har xil rangdagi kremlar tegib dog'i kulgili bo'lib qolibdi.
examples: {r:I didn't buy the shirt.} - Men ko'ylakni sotib olmadim.
{r:Did you wash my shirt?} - Ko'ylagimni yuvdingmi?
{r:They didn't like the shirt.} - Ular ko'ylakni yoqtirmadilar.
{r:My parents didn't wear the shirt.} - Ota-onam ko'ylakni kiyishmadi.

text:
{r:Cut}[kʌt] – bo'lmoq, chopmoq, kesmoq, qirqmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - cut, cut. 
O'tlarni qishloqda nima bilan {h:chopishadi} – albatta {p:KAT}man bilan.
examples: {r:I didn't cut the paper.} - Men qog'ozni kesmadim.
{r:Did she cut her hair?} - U sochlarini qisqartirdimi?
{r:My sister didn't cut the cake.} - Singlim tortni kesmadi.
{r:My parents didn't cut the vegetables.} - Ota-onam sabzavotlarni to'g'ramadi.

text: {r:Important}[ɪmˈpɔːrtnt] – muhim. Bugun futbol bor, amakimnikida o'yinni ko'rmoqchiman. Real va Barsa o'ynaydi. Bu juda muhim o'yin. Amakimning televizorini antenasi yaxshimas. Keyinroq amakim xavotir olishimga hojat yo'q ekanligini, ularda hozir Rossiyadan keltirilgan {p:import}niy {p:ant}enna borligini aytdilar. Chunki amakimga futbol ko'rish, ayoliga esa seriallar ko'rish {h:muhim}.
examples: {r:I didn't think it was important.} - Men buni muhim deb o'ylamadim.
{r:Did she say it was important?} - U buni muhim dedimi?
{r:They didn't find the information important.} - Ular ma'lumotni muhim deb topmadilar.
{r:I brought you important things.} - Men senga muhim narsalar olib keldim.

text: {r:Headache}[ˈhedeɪk] - bosh og'rig'i. Head(bosh) va ache(og'riq) so'zlarining birlashuvidan tuzilgan.
examples: {r:Your wife had a headache yesterday.} - Xotiningizda kecha bosh og'rig'i bor edi.
{r:Did she complain about a headache?} - U bosh og'rig'idan shikoyat qildimi?
{r:They didn't take medicine for the headache.} - Ular bosh og'rig'i uchun dori ichmadilar.
{r:My father does not like headache.} - Otam bosh og'rig'ini yoqtirmaydi.

text: {r:Flight}[flaɪt] – uchish; reys. Chet elga {h:uchish} davomida men uchuvchilar xonasiga qiziqib kirdim va u yerdagi uchuvchilar {p:FIL} va {p:AYIQ} ekanligini ko'rib hayron bo'ldim.
examples: {r:I didn't miss the flight.} - Men reysni qo'ldan bermadim.
{r:This flight is very important to me.} - Bu reys men uchun juda muhim.
{r:They didn't enjoy the flight.} - Ular parvozdan zavqlanmadilar.
{r:Our flight is in the afternoon.} - Bizning parvozimiz peshin paytida.

text: {r:Plane}[pleɪn] - samolyot, uchoq. Agar samolyotda uchishga qo'rqsangiz {h:samolyot}ga chiqishdan oldin {p:PILLA YENG.} Shunda hech qo'rqmasdan uchaverasiz.
examples: {r:The plane arrived late yesterday.} – Bu samolyot kecha kech qoldi.
{r:Did you see the plane in the sky?} – Osmondagi samolyotni ko'rdigizmi?
{r:I flew in this yellow plane 2 years ago.} - Men bu sariq samolyotda ikki yil oldin uchganman.
{r:The plane to Tashkent was expensive.} – Toshkentga uchadigan samolyot qimmat edi.

text: {r:Sunny}[ˈsʌni] - quyoshli. Sun(quyosh) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It was sunny all day.} – Kun bo'yi quyoshli edi.
{r:Was it sunny in your country?} – Sizning davlatingizda quyoshli edimi?
{r:I drink much water in sunny weather.} - Men quyoshli ob-havoda ko'p suv ichaman.
{r:I think yesterday was sunny and warm.} – O'ylashimcha kecha havo quyoshli va iliq edi.

text: {r:Tiring}[ˈtaɪərɪŋ] - charchatuvchi, kuch talab etadigan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 1 - darsdagi tired ga qarang.
examples: {r:The journey was very tiring.} – Safar juda charchatuvchi edi(charchatdi).
{r:Why was your work so tiring?} – Nega ishingiz juda charchatuvchi edi?
{r:Dancing is very tiring.} - Raqs juda charchatadi.
{r:The flight wasn't tiring at all.} – Parvoz umuman charchatmadi.

text: {r:Leg}[leɡ] - oyoq. Oyoqning panja qismi foot panjadan yuqori qismi esa leg deyiladi. Mana bu Robotning tanasi temirdan {h:oyoqlari} esa {p:LEG}odan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He broke his leg last month.} – U o'tgan oy oyog'ini sindirib olgan edi.
{r:Why are your legs very long?} - Nega oyog'laringiz buncha uzun.
{r:My legs are not tired.} – Oyog'im charchamagan.
{r:He lost his leg in a war.} - U urushda oyog'ini yo'qotgan.

text: {r:Must}[mʌst] - kerak, lozim. Shoirlarning aytishicha eng zo'r she'rlarni yozish uchun ichib {p:mast} bo'lish {h:lozim} ekan.(Alkogolizmni tavsiya qilmaymiz. Bu shunchaki bir misol.)
examples: {r:You must finish your homework.} – Uy vazifangizni tugatishingiz kerak.
{r:You must find a good friend.} - Sen yaxshi do'st topishing kerak.
{r:She must listen to me.} - U meni eshitishi kerak.
{r:We must clean the room now.} - Biz hozir xonani tozalashimiz kerak.

text: {r:Hurry}[ˈhɜːri] – shoshmoq. Siz bu vaziyatda {p:Harri} Potterning {h:shoshib} tualetga ketyotganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:We must hurry to catch the plane.} – Samolyotga yetishish uchun shoshilishimiz kerak.
{r:Why are you in a hurry?} – Nega shoshilyapsiz?
{r:She didn't hurry and she was late.} – U shoshilmadi va kechikdi.
{r:Hurry! The bus is coming.} – Shoshiling! Avtobus kelmoqda.

text: {r:Need}[niːd] – kerak, zarur. Tasavvur qiling, biz futboldan jahon chempionati finaliga chiqdik, chempionlik uchun finalda {p:Nid}erlandiyani yutishimiz {h:kerak}
examples: {r:I need a new passport.} – Menga yangi passport kerak.
{r:Do you need help with your bag?} – Sumkangizni ko'tarishda yordam kerakmi?
{r:He didn't need an umbrella yesterday.} – Unga kecha soyabon kerak emas edi.
{r:We need to buy tables today.} – Biz bugun stollar sotib olishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Under}[ˈʌndər] – tagida, ostida. Mana bu t{p:andir} {h:tagida} nima borligini bilasizmi? Qiziqmaganingiz maqul chunki bu yerda mening xazinam bor.
examples: {r:The cat is under the table.} – Mushuk stol ostida.
{r:Did you look under the bed?} – Kravat ostiga qaradingizmi?
{r:The keys weren't under the hat.} – Kalitlar shlyapa ostida emas edi.
{r:Put your shoes under the shelf.} – Poyafzallaringizni javon ostiga qo'ying.

text: {r:Answer}[ˈænsər] – javob. Mana bu enaga bolakayga berilishi kerak bo'lgan sutni yarmini ichib qo'yarkan, kashasini yeb qo'yarkan. Bizningcha {p:EN}agani {p:SIR}lari hali ko'p. U bilan gaplashib olishimiz kerak, har bir qilmishi uchun {h:javob berishi} kerak.
examples: {r:She answered all questions.} – U barcha savollarga javob berdi.
{r:Did you answer his letter?} – Uning xatiga javob berdingizmi?
{r:They didn't answer the phone.} – Ular telefonga javob bermadilar.
{r:I need an answer now.} – Menga hozir javob kerak.

text: {r:Question}[ˈkwestʃən] – savol. Meni bir {h:savol} har doim qiziqtirar edi. Nega Ruslarda{p: KVAS CHIN}ni idishda ichiladi. Keyin bilishimcha chinni kvasdagi sovuqlikni yaxshi ushlab turar ekan.
examples: {r:This question is very difficult.} – Bu savol juda qiyin.
{r:Did you understand the question?} – Savolni tushundingizmi?
{r:He didn't ask any questions.} – U hech qanday savol so'ramadi.
{r:Answer my question, please.} – Iltimos, savolimga javob bering.

text: {r:Skirt}[skɜːrt] – yubka. Tasavvur qiling ochligingizdan singlingizni {h:yubkasini} {p:SKOVOROD}kada qovurib yeb yubordingiz. Skovorodka bu tova degani ya'ni qozonning kichkinasi.
examples: {r:I was wearing a skirt yesterday.} - Kecha yubka kiygan edim.
{r:I was selling skirts at 10 o'clock yesterday.} - Kecha soat 10 da yubka sotayotgan edim.
{r:They were putting the skirt under the table.} - Ular yubkani stol tagiga qo'yayotgan edi.
{r:My parents were looking at the skirt.} - Ota-onam yubkaga qarayotgan edi.

text: {r:Trousers}[ˈtraʊzərz] - shim. Tasavvur qiling sizning uyingizda kiyim javoni yo'q va {p:TILZORIZ}(televizoringiz) {h:shimingizni} osib qo'yadigan yagona joy.
examples: {r:I was ironing my trousers.} - Men shimimni dazmollayotgan edim.
{r:Was he wearing trousers?} - U shim kiyayotgan edimi?
{r:I was paying for cheap trousers in the afternoon.} - Men peshin payti arzon shimlar uchun to'lov qilayotgan edim.
{r:My mother was selling trousers on the street.} - Onam ko'chada shim sotayotgan edi.

text: {r:Bird}[bɜːrd] - qush. 2 yil oldin gravitatsiyasi(tortishish kuchi) bo'lmagan samolyotga mindim va samolyot {p:BORT}ida o'zimni {h:qushdek} his qildim. Tortishish kuchi bo'lmagani uchun bortning u yog'idan bu yog'iga parvoz qildim.
examples: {r:I was watching a bird in the garden.} - Men bog'dagi qushni ko'rayotgan edim.
{r:Was she feeding the bird?} - U qushni boqayotgan edimi?
{r:They weren't catching the bird.} - Ular qushni tutmayotgan edi.
{r:My parents were listening to the bird.} - Ota-onam qushning ovozini tinglayotgan edi.

text: {r:Each}[iːtʃ] – har. Inson organizmida har xil turdagi juda ham uzun ichaklar to'plami bor va {h:har bir} {p:ich}akning qalinligi har xil.
examples: {r:I was talking to each student.} - Men har bir o'quvchi bilan gaplashayotgan edim.
{r:They were reading each book because they were interesting.} - Ular har bir kitobni o'qiyotgan edi chunki kitoblar juda qiziq edi.
{r:My parents were greeting each guest.} - Ota-onam har bir mehmonga salom berayotgan edi.
[center][b]each other - bir-birini[/b][/center]
{r:They like each other.} - Ular bir-birini yoqtiradi.
{r:They always help each other.} - Ular har doim bir-biriga yordam berishadi.

text: {r:Few}[fjuː] - bir qancha, bir nechta. Tasavvur qiling bir necha baklashkadan itingizga uy qurdingiz, {h:bir nechta} {p:FYU}sti baklashkasidan.
examples: {r:I was reading a few books two weeks ago.} - Men ikki hafta oldin bir nechta kitoblar o'qiyotgan edim.
{r:My wife was buying a few cheap things.} - Mening xotinim bir nechta arzon narsa sotib olayotgan edim.
{r:Your dog was eating a few things.} - Sening iting bir nechta narsa yeyayotgan edi.
{r:My parents were planting a few flowers.} - Ota-onam bir nechta gul ekayotgan edi.

text: {r:Busy}[ˈbɪzi] – band. Skruch Makdakning uchuvchi jiyani Zig Zakni eslasangiz kerak. Hozir uchuvchilikni tashlab biznes qilyapti. {p:BIZ}nesmen {p:ZI}gzak hozir hot dog sotyapti, soqqani soqqaga urayotgan bu yigit hozir juda {h:band}.
examples: {r:I was busy cleaning the house.} - Men uyni tozalash bilan band edim.
{r:Was she busy making dinner?} - U kechki ovqat tayyorlash bilan band edimi?
{r:She was busy doing her homework.} - U uyga vazifalarni qilish bilan band edi.
{r:My parents were busy working in the garden.} - Ota-onam bog'da ishlash bilan band edi.

text: {r:Exact}[ɪɡˈzækt] – aniq, tochniy. Mana bu {p:EGIZ}ak {p:AKT}risalar bir-biriga {h:aniq} tochniy 100 % o'xshamasliklari bilan mashhur.
examples: {r:I was trying to find the exact time.} - Men aniq vaqtni topishga harakat qilayotgan edim.
{r:Was she looking for the exact place?} - U aniq joyni qidirayotgan edimi?
{r:They weren't giving the exact answer.} - Ular aniq javob bermayotgan edi.
{r:My parents were discussing the exact problem.} - Ota-onam aniq muammo haqida muhokama qilayotgan edi.

text:
{r:Drive}[draɪv] – haydamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - drove, driven. 
Direktorimiz motosikl haydashni yoqtiradi, {p:dir}ektor {p:ayv}onga qo'ygan motosiklini hozirgina {h:haydab} ketdi.
examples: {r:Farhod was driving to the city.} - Farhod shaharga qarab haydayotgan edi.
{r:Was Hilola driving the car?} - Hilola mashinani haydayotgan edimi?
{r:They weren't driving fast.} - Ular tez haydamayotgan edi.
{r:Our friends were driving to the mountains.} - Bizning do'stlarimiz tog'larga qarab haydayotgan edi.

text: {r:Car}[kɑːr] – mashina, avtomobil. Dunyodagi eng antiqa mashina qaysi ekanligini bilasizmi? Menimcha yaqinda Amerikada ishlab chiqarilgan {p:kar}am shaklidagi {h:mashina}.
examples: {r:He drives a new car.} - U yangi mashina haydaydi.
{r:They bought a family car.} - Ular oilaviy mashina sotib olishdi.
{r:Driving this car is very tiring.} - Bu mashinani haydash juda charchatadi.
{r:She washed her car on Sunday.} - U yakshanba kuni mashinasini yuvdi.

text: {r:Teacher}[ˈtiːtʃər] – o'qituvchi. Opamning oilasi juda ahil, eri ham juda hotirjam, juda {p:tinch eri.} Chunki maktabda {h:o'qituvchi}, xotirjamligini o'quvchilari ham qadrlaydi.
examples: {r:My teacher was answering the questions.} - Mening o'qituvchim savollarga javob berayotgan edi.
{r:Their teacher is very warm and beautiful.} - Ularning o'qituvchisi juda iliq va chiroyli.
{r:They weren't listening to the teacher.} - Ular o'qituvchini tinglamayotgan edi.
{r:My parents were meeting the teacher.} - Ota-onam o'qituvchi bilan uchrashayotgan edi.

text: {r:Beginning}[bɪˈɡɪnɪŋ] - boshlanish(i). Begin(boshlamoq) so'zining ot shakli. Mnemonik namuna uchun 10 - darsdagi begin ga qarang.
examples: {r:I was reading the beginning of the book.} - Men kitobning boshlanishini o'qiyotgan edim.
{r:Was she watching the beginning of the movie?} - U filmning boshini ko'rayotgan edimi?
{r:They weren't understanding the beginning of the lesson.} - Ular darsni boshidan tushunmayotgan edi.
{r:The beginning of the week is usually very tiring.} - Haftaning boshlanishi odatda juda charchatuvchi.

text: {r:Homework}[ˈhoʊmwɜːrk] - uy ishi, uyga vazifa. Home(uy) va work(ish) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I was doing my homework when you called.} – Siz qo'ng'iroq qilganingizda men uy vazifamni qilayotgan edim.
{r:Her homework is about expensive horses.} - Uning uyga vazifasi qimmat otlar haqida.
{r:The children weren't doing their homework.} – Bolalar uy vazifasini qilmayotgan edi.
{r:She was helping me with my homework.} – U menga uy vazifamda yordam berayotgan edi.

text: {r:Quiet}[ˈkwaɪət] – jimjit, tinch, beozor. {p:Kuvayt} futbol terma jamoasi eng {h:beozor, tinch} komandalardan biri. Har safar o'zbeklar bilan o'yinda osongina yutqazib berishadi.
examples: {r:Was the library very quiet?} – Kutubxona juda jim edimi?
{r:Why were you so quiet during the meeting?} – Nega yig'ilishda juda jim turdingiz?
{r:The baby wasn't quiet last night.} – Chaqaloq kecha jim emas edi.
{r:They were working in a quiet room.} – Ular jim xonada ishlayotgan edilar.

text: {r:Wait}[weɪt] – kutmoq. Martin Bred{p:veyt} Barselonada hujumchi sifatida o'ynadi. Uning gol urushini muxlislar 6 oy {h:kutishdi}.
examples: {r:Which bus were you waiting for?} - Qaysi avtobusni kutayotgan edingiz?
{r:Was he waiting long?} – U uzoq kutayotgan edimi?
{r:My wife was waiting for me.} - Xotinim meni kutayotgan edi.
{r:Why are you waiting for him/her?} - Nega uni kutyapsan?

text: {r:Floor}[flɔːr] – pol; qavat, etaj. Tasavvur qiling siz ishxonangizdagi tozalikka javob berasiz va har kuni 2 soat davomida {h:pol}ga {p:XLOR} sepib chiqasiz.
examples: {r:She was cleaning the floor.} – U polni tozalayotgan edi.
{r:Why were you sitting on the floor?} – Nega polga o'tirgan edingiz?
{r:The cat wasn't sleeping on the floor.} – Mushuk polda uxlamayotgan edi.
{r:They were dancing on the wooden floor.} – Ular yog'och polda raqs tushayotgan edilar.
{r:I live on the first floor.} - Men birinchi qavatda yashayman.

text: {r:Center}[ˈsentər] - markaz, sentr. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:A few women were standing in the center.} – Bir nechta ayol markazda turgan edi.
{r:Were you driving to the center?} – Markazga haydab borayotgan edingizmi?
{r:The shop wasn't in the center.} – Do'kon markazda emas edi.
{r:When did you go to the city center?} - Qachon shahar markaziga bordingiz?

text: {r:City}[ˈsɪti] - shahar. Hozirgi kunda inglizcha city(shahar) so'zini juda ko'p joylarda, brend nomlarida uchratish mumkin. Tashkent City, Samarqand City va Manchester City bunga misol bo'la oladi.
examples: {r:It was raining in the city.} – Shaharda yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi.
{r:Were you living in the city last year?} – O'tgan yili shaharda yashayotgan edingizmi?
{r:The roads weren't busy in the city.} – Shahar ko'chalari gavjum emas edi.
{r:People were walking quickly in the city.} – Shaharda odamlar tez yurishayotgan edi.

text: {r:Bus}[bʌs] – avtobus. Ko'chamizdan har safar mana shu avtobus o'tsa, hamma yoqni musiqa ovozi egallab olardi. Keyin bilsak bu {h:avtobusda} bir guruh {p:BAS}takorlar sayohat qilar ekan.
examples: {r:We were riding the bus.} – Biz avtobus haydayotgan edik.
{r:Was the bus late yesterday?} – Kecha avtobus kech qolgan edimi?
{r:The driver wasn't stopping the bus.} – Haydovchi avtobusni to'xtatmayotgan edi.
{r:This yellow bus is for children.} - Bu sariq avtobus bolalar uchun.

text: {r:Law}[lɔː] – qonun, huquqshunoslik. Tasavvur qiling endi Hindistonda {h:qonun} bo'yicha faqat {p:lov}iya yeyish mumkin.
examples: {r:He was studying law.} – U huquqshunoslikni o'qiyotgan edi.
{r:Were they discussing the new law?} – Ular yangi qonunni muhokama qilayotgan edilarmi?
{r:The teacher wasn't teaching the law.} – O'qituvchi qonunni o'rgatmayotgan edi.
{r:The students were interested in law.} – Talabalar qonunga qiziqqan edilar.

text: {r:News}[njuːz] - yangiliklar. New(yangi) yangi so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She was watching the news.} – U yangiliklarni ko'rayotgan edi.
{r:Were you listening to the news?} – Yangiliklarni tinglayotgan edingizmi?
{r:They were enjoying this news.} - Ular bu qonundan zavqlanishayotgan edi.
{r:She was shocked by the news.} – U yangiliklardan shokka tushgan edi.

text: {r:chair} - stul. Men antiqa narsalarning muxlisiman. Masalan mening {h:stul}im {p:CHAYON} shaklida.
examples: {r:The cat was sleeping on the chair.} – Mushuk stulda uxlayotgan edi.
{r:Did your father buy a new chair?} – Dadang yangi stul sotib oldimi?
{r:I cried because I lost my chair.} - Men yig'ladim chunki stulimni yo'qotib qo'ydim.
{r:They were carrying the heavy chair.} – Ular og‘ir stulni tashiyotgan edilar.

text: {r:Birth}[bɜːrθ] – tug’ilish. Bobomning aytishicha maktabda ishlatiladigan {p:bo’r s}otayotgan paytda buvim bilan tanishib qolishgan va keyinchalik turmush qurishgan ekan. Bu {p:BO’RS}iz biz ham {h:tug’ilmagan} bo’lar edik.
examples: {r:Birth is not an easy process.} - Tug'ilish oson jarayon emas.
{r:Has she received a birthday present?} - U tug'ilgan kun sovg'asini oldimi?
{r:They haven’t planned a birthday party.} - Ular tug'ilgan kuni ziyofatini rejalashtirishmadi.
{r:My parents have forgotten my birthday.} - Ota-onam tug'ilgan kunimni unutdi.

text: {r:Present}[ˈpreznt] - hozirgi, ayni; bor, mavjud
examples: {r:She is present at the meeting now.} - U hozir yig‘ilishda ishtirok etayapti.(bor)
{r:They are discussing the present situation.} - Ular hozirgi vaziyatni muhokama qilyaptilar.
{r:He is not present in the office today.} - U bugun ofisda yo‘q.
{r:We need to focus on the present moment.} - Biz hozirgi vaqtga e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak.

text:
{r:Choose}[tʃuːz] – tanlamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - chose, chosen. 
Bodring tanlashda iloji bo’lsa {p:Cho’z}oq bodring {h:tanlang}, ular shirinroq bo’ladi.
examples: {r:I have chosen a new book.} - Men yangi kitobni tanladim.
{r:I am choosing water not tea.} - Men suvni tanlayapman, choyni emas.
{r:They haven’t chosen a team yet.} - Ular hali jamoani tanlamadi.
{r:My parents chose a restaurant two days ago.} - Ota-onam ikki kun avval restoran tanlab qo'yishgan.

text: {r:Decide}[dɪˈsaɪd] – qaror qilmoq. Diyor qanday qilib mashhur bo'lish haqida bosh qotirardi. Nihoyat {p:Di}yor {p:sayt} yozishga {h:qaror qildi} va bu vebsayt uni mashhur qilishiga ishonardi.
examples: {r:I have decided to study English.} - Men ingliz tilini o'rganishga qaror qildim.
{r:Has she decided to go to the meeting?} - U uchrashuvga borishga qaror qildimi?
{r:Our teacher has not decided to help us yet.} - Bizning o'qituvchimiz hali bizga yordam berishga qaror qilmadi.
{r:My parents have decided to paint the house.} - Ota-onam uyni bo'yashga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Invite}[ɪnˈvaɪt] - taklif etmoq. Siz ehson qilgingiz kelib qoldi va bir guruh {p:INVALID}larni tushlikka {h:taklif qildingiz}.
examples: {r:I have invited my friends to the party.} - Men do'stlarimni ziyofatga taklif qildim.
{r:Has she invited her teacher?} - U o'qituvchisini taklif qildimi?
{r:They haven't invited many people.} - Ular ko'p odamlarni taklif qilmadi.
{r:My parents have invited the neighbors.} - Ota-onam qo'shnilarni taklif qildi.

text: {r:Paint}[peɪnt] – bo'yoq; bo'yamoq. {p:Paynt}ga borib telefoningizga pul soldingiz. Lekin uyga kelib tekshirsangiz pul tushmagan, qaytib borib pulni tushirishini talab qildingiz, o'rtada janjal kelib chiqdi. Siz esa qo'lingizdagi {h:bo'yoqni} {p:paynet} shohobchasiga sepib hamma yoqni bulg'ab tashladingiz.
examples: {r:I have painted the kitchen.} - Men oshxonani bo'yadim.
{r:Has she painted a picture?} - U rasm chizdimi?
{r:They haven't painted the walls yet.} - Ular hali devorlarni bo'yamadi.
{r:My parents have painted the door.} - Ota-onam eshikni bo'yadi.

text: {r:Road}[roʊd] – yo'l. Dadam menga bugun {p:RO}likni {p:UD}arini olib keldi. Lekin bizda tekis {h:yo'llar} yo'q.
examples: {r:I have walked on this road before.} - Men bu yo'lda oldin yurganman.
{r:Has he driven on this road?} - U bu yo'lda haydaganmi?
{r:They haven't repaired the road yet.} - Ular hali yo'lni ta'mirlamadi.
{r:My parents have crossed the road.} - Ota-onam yo'lni kesib o'tdi.

text: {r:Team}[tiːm] – Tasavvur qiling {p:tim}sohlar {h:jamoa} tuzib futbol o'ynayapti.
examples: {r:I have joined a new team.} - Men yangi jamoaga qo'shildim.
{r:Has she met the team?} - U jamoa bilan uchrashdimi?
{r:They haven't chosen a team captain yet.} - Ular hali jamoa sardorini tanlamadi.
{r:Teammates have supported each other.} - Jamoadoshlar bir-birini qo'llab-quvvatladi.

text: {r:Ball}[bɔːl] - to'p, kopto'k. Futbol so'zi inglizcha foot - oyoq va ball - to'p so'zlaridan olingan.
examples: {r:I have lost the ball.} - Men to'pni yo'qotdim.
{r:Has Sardor found the ball?} - Sardor to'pni topdimi?
{r:They haven't played with the ball yet.} - Ular hali to'p bilan o'ynamadi.
{r:My friend has bought a new ball.} - Do'stim yangi to'p sotib oldi.

text: {r:Kick}[kɪk] - tepmoq. Hindistonda hayvonlarga sig'inishadi. Masalan sigir insondan ko'ra ko'proq qadrlanadi. Hindistonga sayohat qilgan paytim {p:KIYIK}ni {h:tepgan}ligim uchun 2 yil qamoqda o'tirganman.
examples: {r:She has kicked me hard.} - U meni qattiq tepdi
{r:My father has never kicked me.} – Dadam meni hech qachon tepmagan.
{r:They haven't kicked the ball properly today.} – Ular bugun to'pni to'g'ri tepmadi.
{r:She's now kicked her first goal!} – U hozirgina birinchi golini urdi!

text: {r:Hit}[hɪt] – urmoq, zarar yetkazmoq. Hojatxonaning {p:hid}i shunchalik sassiq ekanki, kimdir {h:urgandek} bo'ldi.
examples: {r:The storm has hit the city hard.} – Bo'ron shaharga qattiq zarar yetkazgan.
{r:Why have you hit your wife?} - Nega xotiningizni urdingiz?
{r:The car hasn't hit anything.} – Mashina hech narsani urib yubormadi.
{r:When did you hit that guy?} – Qachon o'sha yigitni urding?

text: {r:Carry}[ˈkæri] – tashimoq, ko'tarib olmoq. Jim {p:Kerri} mana bu rasmda …ni {h:tashiyapti}.
examples: {r:I've carried these bags all day.} – Men kun bo'yi bu sumkalarni ko'tarib yurdim.
{r:Has he carried the tables upstairs?} – U stollarni yuqori qavatga ko'tarib chiqqanmi?
{r:She has carried all these things.} - U mana shu narsalarni hammasini o'zi tashidi.
{r:Their teacher has not carried those books to library.} - Ularning o'qituvchisi bu kitoblarni kutubxonaga tashimadi.

text: {r:Fast}[fæst] - tez. Agar sizga eng {h:tez} taksi kerak bo'lsa {p:Fast}en taksi aggreagatorini chaqirishingiz mumkin Yandeksni emas.
examples: {r:The train has arrived fast today.} – Poyezd bugun tez keldi.
{r:Have you eaten very fast?} – Siz juda tez ovqatlaningizmi?
{r:Our dog runs very fast.} - Bizning itimiz juda tez yuguradi.
{r:They've worked very fast.} – Ular juda tez ishlashdi.

text: {r:Kitchen}[ˈkɪtʃɪn] - oshxona. Dengiz qirolligida sakkizoyoq qirol ekan. Mana bu {p:KITCHA} esa uning {h:oshxonasini} boshqarar va taomlarga javob berar ekan.
examples: {r:My mother has cleaned the kitchen.} – Onam oshxonani tozaladi.
{r:Have you seen our new kitchen?} – Yangi oshxonamizni ko'rdingizmi?
{r:We haven't used the kitchen much.} – Biz oshxonani ko'p ishlatmaganmiz.
{r:He has cooked in this kitchen for years.} – U yillar davomida shu oshxonada ovqat pishirgan.

text: {r:Foot}[fʊt] – oyoq(feet - oyoqlar). {p:Fut}bol - bu {h:oyoq} bilan o'ynaladigan o'yin.
examples: {r:I've hit my foot.} – Oyog'imni urib oldim.
{r:Has the doctor examined your foot?} – Shifokor oyog'ingizni tekshrib ko'rdimi?
{r:I have brought new shoes for my feet.} - Oyoqlarimga yangi oyoq-kiyim olib keldim.
{r:They've walked twenty miles on foot.} – Ular yigirma chaqirim piyoda yurishgan.(on foot - piyoda)
{r:Eldor has strong feet.} - Eldorning kuchli oyoqlari bor.

text: {r:Meeting}[ˈmiːtɪŋ] - yig'ilish, majlis. Meet(uchrashmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:We've had three meetings today.} – Bugun uchta yig'ilish o'tkazdik.
{r:Why did not you come to our meeting yesterday?} - Nimaga kecha majlisga kelmadingiz?
{r:The boss hasn't made a meeting yet.} – Xo'jayin hali yig'ilish qilmadi.
{r:Today's meeting was long and tiring.} - Bugungi yig'ilish juda uzoq va charchatuvchi edi.

text: {r:Knowledge}[ˈnɒlɪdʒ] - bilim. Know(bilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He's gained much knowledge.} – U ko'p bilim olgan.
{r:You are helping me with your knowledge again.} - Sen biliming bilan menga yana yordam beryapsan.
{r:They haven't shared their important knowledge.} – Ular muhim bilimlarini ulashmadi.
{r:We've improved our knowledge.} – Biz bilimlarimizni yaxshiladik.

text:
{r:Sing}[sɪŋ] - kuylamoq, qo'shiq aytmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - sang, sung. 
Tinib-tinchimagan o'zbek qo'shiqchilari qizlar ismi mavzusini to'xtatib boshqa mavzularda ham qo'shiq aytishmoqda. Masalan mana bu qiz '{p:SING}an tarelka' nomli qo'shiq {h:kuyladi}.
examples: {r:Nargiza sings beautiful songs every day.} - Nargiza har kuni chiroyli qo'shiqlar aytadi.
{r:Have you ever sung in public?} – Siz hech omma oldida qo'shiq aytganmisiz?(in public - omma oldida)
{r:The children sang this song today.} – Bolalar bugun bu qo'shiqni kuylashdi.
{r:We've sung this song many times.} – Biz bu qo'shiqni ko'p marta aytganmiz.

text: {r:Asleep}[əˈsliːp] - uyquda, uxlayotgan. Sleep(uxlamoq) so'zidan yasalgan va uning sifat so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:The child fell asleep quickly.} - Bola tezda uxlab qoldi.
{r:He fell asleep during the movie.} - U film davomida uxlab qoldi.
{r:Anvar is asleep now.} - Anvar hozir uyquda.
{r:I was asleep yesterday at 23:00.} - Kecha soat 23:00 da men uyquda edim.

text: {r:Comfortable}[ˈkʌmftəbəl] - qulay, shinam. Komfort so'zi o'zbek tilida ham qulaylikni bildiradi.
examples: {r:He was so comfortable in the chair that he fell asleep.} - U stulda shunchalik qulay ediki, uxlab qoldi.
{r:She made the bed comfortable for her guests.} - U mehmonlari uchun to'shakni qulay qilib qo'ydi.
{r:I feel comfortable speaking in public now.} - Endi men omma oldida gapirishda o'zimni qulay his qilaman.
{r:The sofa is very comfortable.} - Divan juda qulay.

text: {r:Just}[dʒʌst] – faqat; hozirgina; shunchaki. Qo'shnimizning qizi "Tegsam ham faqat {p:JAST}in Biberga {h:tegaman}, bo'lmasa hech kim bilan turmush qurmayman" deyapti.
examples: {r:I need just you.} - Menga faqat sen keraksan.
{r:I just need you.} - Menga shunchaki sen keraksan.
{r:He just wants to know.} - U shunchaki bilishni xohlaydi
{r:I have just finished my homework.} - Men hozirgina uy vazifamni tugatdim.
{r:They have just started the race.} - Ular hozirgina poygani boshlashdi.
{r:My parents have just left the house.} - Ota-onam hozirgina uydan chiqib ketdi.

text: {r:Already}[ɔːlˈrɛdi] – allaqachon. Akam kecha sotib olgan rediskasini qidira boshladi. Men esa {p:ol}maxonga {p:redi}skalarni {h:allaqachon} berib yuborgandim.
examples: {r:I have already eaten breakfast.} - Men allaqachon nonushtani yeb bo'ldim.
{r:Has she already read the newspaper?} - U gazetani allaqachon o'qib bo'ldimi?
{r:These guys have already finished the meeting.} - Bu yigitlar allaqachon uchrashuvni tugatishdi.
{r:My wife and I have already boiled the eggs.} - Mening xotinim va men tuxumlarni allaqachon qaynatib bo'ldik.

text: {r:Yet}[jɛt] – hali. Tasavvur qiling futbolchisiz, yettinchi raqamda o'ynamoqchisiz. Lekin yettinchida o'ynashga arziysizmi, shu darajaga yetib keldingizmi? Menimcha {h:hali} {p:yet}ti darajasigacha kelganingiz yo'q. Mehnat qilishda davom eting.
examples: {r:Our team has not asked the question yet.} - Bizning jamoa hali savolni so'ramadi.
{r:Has she finished her coffee yet?} - U hali kofesini ichib bo'lmadimi?
{r:They haven't invited everybody yet.} - Ular hali hammani taklif qilmadi.
{r:Their teachers haven't decided yet.} - Ularning ustozlari hali qaror qilmadi.

text: {r:Place}[pleɪs] – joy. Leys chipslari kundan kunga mashhur bo'lmoqda. Hozirgi kunda {p:p}ishloqli {p:leys} kerak bo'lsa siz turgan {h:joy}ga dostavka qilib berishadi.
examples: {r:I have already found a place to sit.} - Men o'tiradigan joyni topib bo'ldim.
{r:How did you find a place to live?} - Qanday qilib yashashga joyni tez topding?
{r:They haven't chosen a place for the party yet.} - Ular hali ziyofat uchun joyni tanlamadi.
{r:We have just left that place.} - Biz hozirgina o'sha joyni tark etdik.

text: {r:Still}[stɪl] – hali ham. Siz har doim boradigan {p:stil}ist, yurtimizdagi {h:hali ham} mashinkadan foydalanmaydigan yagona sartarosh.
examples: {r:Are you still thirsty.} - Hali ham chanqaganmisiz?
{r:Has he still not finished his homework?} - U hali ham uy vazifasini tugatmaganmi?
{r:They are still waiting for the bus.} - Ular hali ham avtobusni kutishmoqda.
{r:Our teachers are still at the meeting.} - O'qituvchilarim hali ham uchrashuvda.

text: {r:Next}[nɛkst] – keyingi. Birinchi matiz sotib oldim, {h:keyingi} mashinam esa {p:neks}iya bo'ldi.
examples: {r:I have already planned the next race.} - Men allaqachon keyingi poygani rejalashtirib bo'ldim.
{r:Has she decided what to do next?} - U keyin nima qilishini qaror qildimi?
{r:They haven't chosen the next student yet.} - Ular hali keyingi talabani tanlamadi.
{r:Bobir and Aziza have just left for the next place.} - Bobir va Aziza hozirgina keyingi joyga ketdi.

text: {r:Everybody}[ˈɛvrɪbɒdi] - har kim, hamma.
examples: {r:I have already invited everybody.} - Men allaqachon hammani taklif qilib bo'ldim.
{r:Has she met everybody yet?} - U hali hamma bilan uchrashdimi?
{r:They haven't thanked everybody yet.} - Ular hali hammasiga minnatdorchilik bildirmadi.
{r:Everybody is afraid of my dog in our mahalla.} - Mahallamizda hamma itimdan qo'rqadi.

text: {r:Race}[reɪs] – poyga;irq. Men akam bilan {h:poyga} o'ynadim, kim ko'proq kartoshka tashishga. U 8 {p:reys} tashidi, men 7 {p:reys} va akam yutdi poygada.
examples: {r:I have just watched the race.} - Men hozirgina poygani ko'rdim.
{r:Have you already finished the race?} - Poygani allaqachon tugatib bo'ldingmi?
{r:We haven't started the race yet.} - Biz hali poygani boshlashmadik.
{r:My parents have just arrived at the race.} - Ota-onam hozirgina poygaga keldi.

text: {r:Perhaps}[pəˈhæps] - balki, ehtimol. Bolaligimda qo'shnimiz Misrga o'qishga ketib o'sha yerda qolib ketgandi. Odamlar uning nimaga kelmayotganliklarini muhokama qilishganida men uni {h:ehtimol} Asteriks va Obeliks {p:PIR}amidada {p:HIBS}da saqlayotgan bo'lsa kerak shuning uchun qaytmayotgandir deb o'ylardim
examples: {r:I have perhaps made a mistake.} - Men ehtimol xato qildim.
{r:Perhaps his trousers are cheap.} - Balki uning shimi arzon shimdir.
{r:They haven't perhaps decided yet.} - Ular balki hali qaror qilmadi.
{r:My boss has perhaps already left.} - Ehtimol boshlig'im allaqachon ketib bo'lgan.

text: {r:Them}[ðɛm] - ularni, ularga.
examples: {r:I have already talked to them.} - Men ularga allaqachon gapirdim.
{r:These people are good. Do you like them?} - Bu odamlar juda yaxshi. Sen ularni yoqtirasanmi?
{r:My friends haven't met them yet.} - Bizning jamoa hali ular bilan uchrashmadi.
{r:My parents have just called them.} - Ota-onam hozirgina ularga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

text: {r:Ask}[ɑːsk] – so'ramoq. Armiyada bir hazilkash askar bor ekan. Undan har doim {p:ask}iya aytishini {h:so'rasharkan}.
examples: {r:I've just asked a short question.} - Men hozirgina qisqa savol so'radim.
{r:Have you asked for help yet?} - Sen yordam so'radingmi?
{r:They haven't asked the teacher.} - Ular o'qituvchidan so'ramadi.
{r:We've already asked three times.} - Biz allaqachon uch marta so'radik.

text: {r:Coffee}[ˈkɒfi] - kofe. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:Sarvar has already drunk his coffee.} - Sarvar allqachon kofesini ichib bo'ldi.
{r:Have you made coffee yet?} - Hali kofe tayyorladizmi?
{r:This coffee is very different and expensive.} - Bu kofe juda farqli va qimmat.
{r:She's just bought fresh coffee.} - U hoirgina yangi kofe sotib oldi.

text: {r:Kind}[kaɪnd] - xil, tur. 2 - darsda 'kind' so'zining 'mehribon' deb tarjima qilinishini o'rgangan edik. Lekin bu so'zning ikkinchi ma'nosi ham bor. Yozilishi bir xil va ma'nolari har xil bo'lgan so'zlar omonimlar deyiladi.
examples: {r:She has already tried three different kinds of coffee today.} - U bugun allaqachon uch xil turdagi kofe ichib ko'rdi.
{r:Have you seen this kind of smartphone yet?} - Siz bu turdagi smartfonni hali ko'rganmisiz?
{r:When did you meet this kind of animal?} - Bu turdagi hayvonni qachon uchratdingiz?
{r:They haven't found this kind of mineral in Uzbekistan yet.} - Ular O'zbekistonda hali bu turdagi mineralni topmadi.

text: {r:Also}[ˈɔːlsəʊ] – ham. Qizil olmani ko'rib hammani ishtahasi ochilib ketdi. Jumladan meni ham. {p:Ol}ma {p:so'}lagimni {h:ham} oqizib yubordi.
examples: {r:She has also finished her work.} - U ham ishini tugatdi.
{r:Have you also visited Tashkent?} - Siz ham Toshkentga bordingizmi?
{r:They haven't also brought books.} - Ular ham kitoblarini olib kelmadi.
{r:We've also thought about this.} - Biz ham bu haqida o'yladik.

text: {r:Thirsty}[ˈθɜːsti] – chanqagan. Peshin payti {h:chanqab} uyga qaytdim. Agar chanqab ketib suv topolmasam bolamni so'rg'ichini tishlab o'tiraman. Chunki {p:SO'R}g'ichda {p:SUT} tomchilari bor va bir zumda mening {h:chanqog'imni} qondiradi.
examples: {r:I want to drink water or tea. I am very thirsty.} - Choy yoki suv ichishni xohlayman. Men juda chanqadim.
{r:You have drunken much water already. Why are you thirsty again?} - Sen allaqachon juda ko'p suv ichding. Nega yana chanqayapsan?
{r:They haven't given us water and we're thirsty.} - Ular bizga suv bermadi va biz chanqaganmiz.
{r:We've been thirsty for hours.} - Biz necha soatlardan beri chanqab yuribmiz.

text: {r:Newspaper}[ˈnjuːzpeɪpə] - gazeta. News(yangiliklar) va paper(qog'oz) so'zining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He has just read the newspaper.} - U hozirgina gazetani o'qidi.
{r:Have you bought today's newspaper yet?} - Bugungi gazetani hali sotib olmadingizmi?
{r:They haven't delivered our newspaper.} - Ular gazetamizni yetkazib bermadi.
{r:She's already finished the newspaper.} - U gazetani o'qib bo'ldi.

text: {r:Boil}[bɔɪl] – qaynamoq; qaynatmoq. Gazga choy qo'ygandim lekin mana bu televizorda Asilbekning {p:BOYL}ama qo'shig'ini qayta va qayta eshitaverib suv esimdan chiqib ketibdi. Suv {h:qaynayverib} qumg'onda tugab qolibdi.
examples: {r:The water has boiled.} - Suv qaynadi.
{r:Have you boiled the eggs yet?} - Tuxumlarni qaynatdingizmi?
{r:They haven't boiled enough water.} - Ular yetarli suv qaynatmadi.
{r:She has just boiled some milk.} - U hozirgina sut qaynatdi.

text: {r:Egg}[ɛɡ] – tuxum. Mana bu {p:eg}izaklar hali ham o'zlarini jo'jalardek {h:tuxumdan} paydo bo'lgan deb o'ylashadi.
examples: {r:I've boiled two eggs.} - Men ikkita tuxum qaynatdim.
{r:Has she eaten her egg yet?} - U tuxumini yeb bo'ldimi?
{r:They have thrown eggs to each other.} - Ular bir-biriga tuxumlar otishdi.
{r:We've already used all the eggs.} - Biz allaqachon barcha tuxumlarni ishlatib bo'ldik.

text: {r:Lawyer}[ˈlɔːjə] - huquqshunos, advokat. Law(qonun) so'zidan yasalgan. Advokatlarning bir irimi bor ekan. Mening qo'shnim kuchli {h:advokat} bo'lish uchun {p:LOY YER} edi
examples: {r:The lawyer has just arrived.} - Advokat hozirgina yetib keldi.
{r:My brother is an expensive lawyer.} - Mening akam qimmat advokat.
{r:They haven't hired a good lawyer.} - Ular yaxshi advokat yollamadi.
{r:She's already spoken to her lawyer.} - U allaqachon advokati bilan gaplashib bo'ldi.

text: {r:Writer}[ˈraɪtə] - yozuvchi. Write(yozmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He has become a famous writer.} - U mashhur yozuvchi bo'ldi.
{r:Have you read this writer's books?} - Bu yozuvchining kitoblarini o'qiganmisiz?
{r:They haven't invited the writer yet.} - Ular hali yozuvchini taklif qilmadi.
{r:We've already met many writers.} - Biz allaqachon ko'p yozuvchilar bilan uchrashdik.

text: {r:Ice}[aɪs] – muz. Aysberg nima ekanligini eslaysizmi? {p:Ays}berg – bu {h:muz} tog'i.
examples: {r:Have you ever touched ice?} - Siz qachonlardir muzga teginganmisiz?
{r:I have never seen ice in my town.} - Men shahrimda hech qachon muz ko'rmadim.
{r:She has already put ice in her drink.} - U ichimligiga muz qo'yib bo'ldi.
{r:They haven't bought ice yet.} - Ular hali muz sotib olmadi.

text: {r:Company}[ˈkʌmpəni] - kompaniya. Bir xil so'zlar.
examples: {r:Have you ever worked for a big company?} - Siz qachonlardir katta kompaniyada ishlaganmisiz?
{r:I have never visited their company.} - Men ularning kompaniyasiga hech qachon bormadim.
{r:She has just started her own company.} - U hozirgina o'z kompaniyasini boshladi.
{r:They haven't joined the company yet.} - Ular hali kompaniyaga qo'shilmadi.

text: {r:Ocean}[ˈəʊʃən] - okean, ummon. Inglizcha ocean va o'zbekcha okean bitta ildizga ega so'zlar. Lekin talaffuzida sezilarli farqlar bor. Shuning uchun mnemonik namuna taqdim etamiz. Tasavvur qiling {h:Ummon} guruhi bolalari va {p:Oshin}(yapon seriali) ummonda kemada sayohat qilishmoqda.
examples: {r:Has he ever seen the ocean?} - U qachonlardir okeanni ko'rganmi?
{r:I have never traveled to the ocean.} - Men hech qachon okeanda sayohat qilmadim.
{r:She has already taken pictures of the ocean.} - U okeanning suratlarini olib bo'ldi.
{r:They haven't visited the ocean yet.} - Ular hali okeanga bormadi.

text: {r:World}[wɜːld] - dunyo. Toshkentda hozir {p:WOLT} kompaniyasining kuryerlik xizmati yo'lga qo'yilgan. {p:WOLT} bilan nafaqat shahar bo'ylab balki butun {h:dunyoga} ovqat jo'natishingiz mumkin. Bu degani Afrikada ham Toshkentdan osh zakaz qilishingiz mumkin(namuna uchun yozildi, aslida unday emas).
examples: {r:Have you ever traveled around the world?} - Siz qachonlardir dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilganmisiz?
{r:The world is big and different.} - Dunyo katta va farqli.
{r:She has just returned from a world tour.} - U hozirgina dunyo bo'ylab sayohatdan qaytdi.
{r:This girl lives in her world.} - Bu qiz o'z dunyosida yashaydi.

text: {r:Once}[wʌns] – bir marta. Bu uyning o'z qoidalari bor. Masalan, {p:VAN}na {p:S}upurgi bilan haftadi {h:bir marta} supurilishi.
examples: {r:Have you ever met him once?} - Siz qachonlardir u bilan bir marta bo'lsa ham uchrashganmisiz?
{r:I have only been to that place once.} - Men bu joyda faqat bir marta bo'lganman.
{r:She has already told the story once.} - U hikoyani bir marta aytib bo'ldi.
{r:They haven't tried it even once.} - Ular buni bir marta ham sinab ko'rmadi.

text: {r:Ever}[ˈɛvə] - qachonlardir, agar not bilan qo'llanilsa hech qachon. Hozir men siz hech qachon bajarmaydigan ish haqida aytaman. Bu dunyodagi eng baland cho'qqi {p:EVER}estni zabt etish. Shu kungacha faqatgina 2 ta o'zbek bu ishni amalga oshirgan va {h:qachonlardir} siz 3 bo'lishingizga ishonmayman.
examples: {r:Has Dilshod ever seen a helicopter?} - Dilshod qachonlardir vertolyot ko'rganmi?
{r:I have never flown in the air.} - Men hech qachon havoda uchmaganman.
{r:If you ever visit Tashkent just call me.} - Agar qachonlardir Toshkentga kelsang shunchaki qo'ng'iroq qil.
{r:They haven't ever seen a helicopter.} - Ular hech qachon vertolyot ko'rmagan.

text: {r:Travel}[ˈtrævəl] - sayohat; sayohat qilmoq. Futbol bo'yicha trenerimning g'alati odati bor. Qayerga {h:sayohat}ga borsa ham {p:TRE}nerim {p:VIL}kasini o'zi bilan olib boradi.
examples: {r:Have you ever traveled alone?} - Siz qachonlardir yolg'iz sayohat qilganmisiz?
{r:I have never traveled by helicopter.} - Men hech qachon vertolyotda sayohat qilmaganman.
{r:I want to travel to new places.} - Men yangi joylarga sayohat qilishni xohlayman.
{r:They haven't planned their travel yet.} - Ular hali sayohatni rejalashtirmadi.

text: {r:Air}[ɛə] – havo. Uzbekistan {p:Air}ways – bu O'zbekistonning milliy {h:havo} yo'llari kompaniyasi.
examples: {r:Have you ever breathed fresh air in the mountains?} - Siz qachonlardir tog'larda toza havodan nafas olganmisiz?
{r:I have never flown in the air.} - Men hech qachon havoda uchmaganman.
{r:What color is air?} - Havoning rangi qanaqa?
{r:They haven't enjoyed the fresh air yet.} - Ular hali toza havodan zavqlanmadi.

text: {r:Us}[ʌs] – bizni / bizga. Bu so‘z “we” (biz) olmoshining to'ldiruvchi shakli bo‘lib, harakat bizga qaratilganini bildiradi.
examples: {r:They help us every day.} - Ular bizga har kuni yordam berishadi.
{r:They are dancing with us?} - Ular biz bilan raqs tushyapti.
{r:My father is working for us.} - Dadam biz uchun ishlayapti.
{r:She gave a few trousers to us.} - U bizga bir nechta shimlar berdi.
{r:He paid us some money.} - U bizga biroz pul berdi.

text: {r:Back}[bæk] – orqa. Sigaret chekib olmoqchi bo'lsangiz {p:bek}atni {h:orqasiga} o'ting.
examples: {r:What color is the back of your house?} - Uyingizni orqasi qaysi rangda?
{r:I have never sat in the back seat.} - Men hech qachon orqa o'rindiqqa o'tirmaganman.
{r:My friend, please, always sit in the back of plane.} - Do'stim iltimos har doim samolyotni orqa tarafiga o'tir.
{r:What is this black thing on your back.} - Orqangizdagi qora narsa nima?

text: {r:Helicopter}[ˈhɛlɪkɒptə] – vertolyot. Mana bu dunyodagi eng orqasi baquvvat superqahramon. Ba'zan vertolyotlarning vizillagan ovozi yoqmasa '{p:HALI KAPTAR} uchiraman qulab tushasan' deydi. Haqiqatdan osmonga bitta kaptar uchirsa {h:vertolyot}ning yo'nalishi o'zgarib ketadi.
examples: {r:Have you ever seen a helicopter?} - Siz qachonlardir vertolyot ko'rganmisiz?
{r:What color is that helicopter?} - O'sha vertolyotning rangi qanaqa?
{r:Flying in a helicopter is not easy in our country.} - Vertolyotda uchish bizning davlatda oson emas.
{r:I bought an expensive helicopter yesterday.} - Men kecha qimmat vertolyot sotib oldim.

text: {r:Town}[taʊn] - shaharcha. Shahardan kichikroq qishloq bo'lmagan aholi manzilgohi shunday nomlanadi.
examples: {r:Have you ever visited this town before?} - Siz bu shaharchaga qachonlardir borganmisiz?
{r:We've lived in this town for years.} - Biz yillar davomida bu shaharchada yashadik.
{r:This was a very beautiful town.} - Bu juda chiroyli shaharcha edi.
{r:My friendship with Hamza started in this town.} - Hamza bilan do'stligimiz shu shaharchada boshlangan.

text: {r:Differ}[ˈdɪfə] - farq qilmoq. Mnemonik namuna uchun 5 - darsdagi different ga qarang.
examples: {r:Have your opinions ever differed?} - Fikrlaringiz qachonlardir farq qilganmi?
{r:My shirt differs from your shirt.} - Mening ko'ylagim senikidan farq qiladi.
{r:The prices haven't differed much this year.} - Narxlar bu yili unchalik farq qilmadi.
{r:These two versions differ completely.} - Bu ikki versiya butunlay farq qiladi.

text: {r:Buyer}[ˈbaɪə] - sotib oluvchi, xaridor. Buy(sotib olmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The buyer was crying because of an expensive price.} - Xaridor qimmat narx sababli yig'layotgan edi.
{r:The buyer has just signed the contract.} - Xaridor hozirgina shartnoma imzoladi.
{r:We are selling our old home. The buyer is a tall guy.} - Biz eski uyimizni sotyapmiz. Xaridor uzun yigit.
{r:I had many buyers in the morning. As a result, I made much money.} - Ertalab xaridorlarim ko'p bo'ldi. Natijada ko'p pul topdim.

text: {r:Shorts}[ʃɔːts] - shortik. Tasavvur qiling youtube {p:shorts} da {h:shortik} reklama qilasiz.
examples: {r:Have you ever worn these shorts?} - Siz hech bu shortiklarni kiyganmisiz?
{r:I've bought new shorts for summer.} - Yozga yangi shortiklar sotib oldim.
{r:I am choosing cheap shorts for this summer.} - Men yoz uchun arzon shortiklarni tanlayapman.
{r:They've just washed all their shorts.} - Ular hozirgina barcha shortiklarini yuvishdi.

text: {r:Picture}[ˈpɪkʧə] - rasm. Menimcha bu so'zga telefon va komyuterlarda ko'p duch kelgan bo'lsangiz kerak. Chunki rasmlar saqlanadigan fayllar shunday nomlanadi odatda.
examples: {r:Have you ever painted a picture?} - Siz hech rasm chizganmisiz?
{r:She's just framed the picture.} - U hozirgina rasmga ramka qo'ydi.
{r:I took pictures of long legs.} - Men uzun oyoqlarni rasmga oldim.
{r:They've always liked this picture.} - Ularga bu rasm har doim yoqqan.

text: {r:Seller}[ˈsɛlə] - sotuvchi. Sell(sotmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Have you ever been a street seller?} - Siz hech ko'cha sotuvchisi bo'lganmisiz?
{r:The seller has already left.} - Sotuvchi allaqachon ketib bo'ldi.
{r:They haven't paid the seller yet.} - Ular hali sotuvchiga pul to'lamadi.
{r:She's always been a successful seller.} - U har doim muvaffaqiyatli sotuvchi bo'lgan.

text: {r:Husband}[ˈhʌzbənd] – er. Mana bu xonim 50 yil eri bilan yashagan vaqtiga achinadi. Xonim har doim eriga sayohatga borishni, konsertga tushishni, restoranga borishni taklif qilganida {p:eri} har doim ''{h:hozir band}man'' deb javob bergan. Er hech qachon ayoli ko'nglini olmagan.
examples: {r:Have you ever met her husband?} - Siz uning eri bilan qachonlardir uchrashganmisiz?
{r:My sister has just married her husband.} - Opam hozirgina eri bilan turmush qurdi.
{r:Dildora's husband broke his leg yesterday.} - Dildoraning eri kecha oyog'ini sindirib oldi.
{r:Your husband has put the keys under the table.} - Sening ering kalitlarni stol tagiga qo'ygan edi.

text: {r:Dirty}[ˈdɜːti] – kir. Diyor atigi 1000$ ga mashina sotib oldi. Qanday mashina ekan deb qiziqsam kir bo'lib ketgan eski tiko ekan. {p:DIYOR TI}koni ham shunday {h:''kirini''} olasanmi.
examples: {r:Your trousers are becoming dirty.} - Shimingiz kir bo'lib ketyapti.
{r:The kids have made everything dirty.} - Bolalar hamma narsani kir qilib yubordi.
{r:Everybody is dirty in this town. Because we don't have water here.} - Bu shaharchada hamma kir chunki suvimiz yo'q.
{r:We've never seen such a dirty room.} - Biz hech bunday kir xonani ko'rmaganmiz.

text: {r:seat} - o'rindiq. Sit(o'tirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan va deyarli bir xil talaffuz qilinadi.
examples: {r:Have you ever lost your theater seat?} - Siz hech teatrda o'rningizni yo'qotganmisiz?
{r:I've just found a comfortable seat.} - Men hozirgina qulay o'rin topdim.
{r:I have paid much money for this seat.} - Men bu o'rindiqqa ko'p pul to'laganman.
[center][b]take/have a seat - marhamat o'tiring[/b][/center]
{r:Take a seat here} – Bu yerga o‘tiring.
{r:Enter the room and have a seat.} - Xonaga kiring va o'tirib oling.

text: {r:Since}[sɪns] – ...dan beri. Matematikadagi {p:SINUS} va kosinusni o'rganganim{h:dan beri} odamlarni cho'ntagida qancha puli borligini bir sekundda aytib bera oladigan bo'lganman.
examples: {r:Have you been living here since 2020?} - 2020 yildan beri bu yerda yashaysizmi?
{r:I have been studying English since last year.} - Men o'tgan yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapman.
{r:She has been working here since January.} - U yanvardan beri bu yerda ishlaydi(yoki ishlayapti).
{r:They haven’t seen him since last week.} - Ular uni o'tgan haftadan beri ko'rishmadi.

text: {r:Life}[laɪf] – hayot. Dambo multfilmini eslang. Boshlanishda {p:LAY}lak {p:F}ilni ona filga tashlab ketadi va filchaning {h:hayoti} boshlanadi.
examples: {r:How long have you been learning about life?} - Siz hayot haqida qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganyapsiz?
{r:I have been thinking about life since I was a child.} - Men bolaligimdan beri hayot haqida o'ylayman.
{r:She has been writing about life for years.} - U yillar davomida hayot haqida yozib kelmoqda.
{r:They haven’t understood the meaning of life yet.} - Ular hali hayotning ma'nosini tushunib yetishmadi.

text: {r:Beard}[bɪəd] – soqol. Aytishlaricha agar tuyani bolasi ya’ni {p:BIY}a {p:YERD}a ertayu kech dam olib yotsa tez kattalashar va tez {h:soqol} o’stirib bir necha oylar ichida katta tuya bo’lib ketar ekan.
examples: {r:How long have you been growing your beard?} - Soqolingizni qancha vaqtdan beri o'stiryapsiz?
{r:I have been growing my beard since last month.} - Men o'tgan oydan beri soqolimni o'stiryapman.
{r:She has never liked beards.} - U hech qachon soqollarni yoqtirmagan.
{r:They haven’t seen Shuhrat with a long beard yet.} - Ular Shuhratni hali uzun soqoli bilan ko'rishmadi.

text: {r:Mine}[maɪn] – meniki. {p:Mayn}a qushi ba’zida yerda ko’ringan narsani cho’qilayveradi. Balki uning miyasida bu '{h:meniki}' degan hayol bo’lar.
examples: {r:Is that dog mine?} - Bu it menikimi?
{r:These yellow shoes are mine.} - Bu sariq poyabzal meniki.
{r:I have already paid for this bicycle. It is mine now.} - Men bu velosiped uchun allaqachon to'ladim. Bu hozir meniki.
{r:This chair is not mine. You can have a seat here.} - Bu stul meniki emas. Bu yerga o'tirishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:University}[ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːsəti] - universitet.
examples: {r:How long have you been studying at the university?} - Universitetda qancha vaqtdan beri o'qiyapsiz?
{r:I have been studying here since 2021.} - Men 2021 yildan beri bu yerda o'qiyapman.
{r:She has been teaching at the university for ten years.} - U universitetda o'n yildan beri dars beradi.
{r:We are building university here.} - Biz bu yerda universitet quryapmiz.

text: {r:Chocolate}[ˈtʃɒklət] - shokolad.
examples: {r:How long have you been eating chocolate?} - Siz qancha vaqtdan beri shokolad yeyapsiz?
{r:I have been eating chocolate since I was a child.} - Men bolaligimdan beri shokolad yeyman.
{r:She has never liked dark chocolate.} - U hech qachon qora shokoladni yoqtirmagan.
{r:They haven’t bought chocolate yet.} - Ular hali shokolad sotib olmadi.

text: {r:Produce}[prəˈdjuːs] – ishlab chiqarmoq. {p:Prodyus}ser kinoda bevosita kinoning ishlanishiga moliyaviy yordam ko’rsatuvchi inson. Ingliz tilidagi 'produce' so’zi ko’pincha mahsulot ishlab chiqarishni bildiradi ya'ni prodyusser bilan bir xil ildizga ega so'z!
examples: {r:How long have you been producing ice cream?} - Siz qancha vaqtdan beri muzqaymoq ishlab chiqaryapsiz?
{r:I have been producing chocolate for three years.} - Men uch yildan beri shokolad ishlab chiqaryapman.
{r:My parents produced chairs and tables.} - Ota-onam stol va stullar ishlab chiqarishgan.
{r:What are your friends producing?} - Sening do'stlaring nima ishlab chiqaryapti?

text: {r:Midnight}[ˈmɪdnaɪt] - yarim tun. Middle(o'rta, yarim) va night(tun) so'zlarining qo'shilishidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Did you read books until midnight?} - Sen yarim tungacha kitob o'qidingmi?
{r:I have been awake since midnight.} - Men yarim tundan beri uyg'oqman.
{r:He came home at midnight yesterday.} - U kecha yarim tunda uyga keldi.
{r:They haven’t finished the work by midnight yet.} - Ular hali yarim tungacha ishni tugatmadi.

text: {r:Ice-cream}[aɪs kriːm] - muzqaymoq. ice(muz) va cream(qaymoq) so'zlarining birlashuvidan tuzilgan.
examples: {r:How long have you been selling ice cream?} - Siz qancha vaqtdan beri muzqaymoq sotyapsiz?
{r:I have been selling ice cream for two years.} - Men ikki yildan beri muzqaymoq sotaman.
{r:She has never tried chocolate ice cream.} - U hech qachon shokoladli muzqaymoq tatib ko'rmagan.(try ning ikkinchi ma'nosi ta'tib ko'rmoq)
{r:They haven’t bought ice cream yet.} - Ular hali muzqaymoq sotib olmadi.

text: {r:Solve}[sɑːlv] – yechmoq, hal qilmoq. Olimlarning ta'kidlashicha aynan mana shu {p:so’lib} bo’lgan mahsulot inson kamqonlik muammosini {h:yecholarkan.} Bu narsa mayiz.
examples: {r:I solved this math problem.} – Men bu matematik masalani yecha oldim.
{r:How did you solve the difficulties?} – Qiyinchiliklarni qanday hal qildingiz?
{r:We solve this issue together.} – Bu muammoni birgalikda hal qilamiz.
{r:He is trying to solve a difficult question.} – U qiyin savolni yechishga harakat qilmoqda.

text: {r:Difficulty}[ˈdɪfɪkəlti] - qiyinchilik. Difficult(qiyin) so'zining ot shakli. Mnemonik namuna uchun 9 - darsdagi difficult ga qarang.
examples: {r:How long have you been facing this difficulty?} - Siz qancha vaqtdan beri bu qiyinchilikni boshdan kechiryapsiz?
{r:I have been facing this difficulty since last month.} - Men o'tgan oydan beri bu qiyinchilikni boshdan kechiryapman.
{r:She has never had such difficulty before.} - U ilgari hech qachon bunday qiyinchilikni ko'rmagan.
{r:We haven’t solved the difficulty yet.} - Biz hali qiyinchilikni hal qilmadik.

text: {r:Worker}[ˈwɜːkə] - ishchi. Work(ishlamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:How long have you been a factory worker?} - Siz necha yildan beri zavod ishchisisiz?
{r:I've been a construction worker since 2015.} - Men 2015-yildan beri qurilish ishchisiman.
{r:She has never been a good worker.} - U hech qachon yaxshi ishchi bo'lmagan.
{r:They've been workers at this company for years.} - Ular bir necha yillardan beri bu kompaniyada ishlashadi.

text: {r:From}[frɒm] - ...dan.
examples: {r:How long have you been working from home?} - Siz qachondan beri uydan turib ishlaysiz?
{r:We've been waiting from morning until night.} - Biz ertalabdan kechgacha kutib o'tirdik.
{r:I got this present from him.} - Men bu sovg'ani undan oldim.
{r:They've been friends from childhood.} - Ular bolalikdan do'st.

text: {r:Near}[nɪə] – yaqin. Bilasizmi odamning kayfiyati ham yuqumli narsada. Yaxshi kayfiyat ham yomoni ham yuqadi. Shuning uchun {p:NER}vniy odamga {h:yaqin}lashmang hech.
examples: {r:How long have you lived near the park?} - Siz qancha vaqtdan beri bog' yaqinida yashaysiz?
{r:I've been standing near the door for 10 minutes.} - Men 10 daqiqadan beri eshik yaqinida turibman.
{r:The bus hasn't stopped near our house.} - Avtobus uyimiz yaqinida to'xtamadi.
{r:How long has she been sitting near the window?} - U qanchadan beri deraza yaqinida o'tiribdi?

text: {r:Dark}[dɑːk] – qorong’i. Ilg’or texnologiyalar yigirma birinchi asrda juda rivojlanib bormoqda va buni deyarli hamma sohalarda ko'rish mumkin masalan {p:DARAK}chi gazetasi ‘’{h:qorong'ida}’’ ham o'qish mumkin bo'lgan, o'zidan yorug'lik taratadigan gazetalar chiqaryapti.
examples: {r:How long has it been dark outside?} - Tashqari qancha vaqtdan beri qorong'i?
{r:I like dark chocolate very much.} - Men juda ham qora shokoladni yaxshi ko'raman.
{r:We haven't walked in the dark before.} - Biz ilgari qorong'ida yurmaganmiz.
{r:They've been afraid of the dark since childhood.} - Ular bolalikdan qorong'idan qo'rqishgan.

text: {r:Later}[ˈleɪtə] – keyinroq. Leytenant jinoyatchini quvlayapti, lekin ular mashinaga o’tirib qochib ketishdi. Shunda leytenant traktorni ko’rib qoldida va unga o’tirib jinoyatchilar ortidan haydadi. {h:Keyinroq} jinoyatchilar tutilgach {p:LEYT}enant {p:TR}aktorni egasiga qaytarib berdi.
examples: {r:We must discuss this problem later.} - Biz bu muammoni keyinroq muhokama qilishimiz lozim.
{r:We must meet later today.} - Bugun biz keyinroq uchrashishimiz kerak.
{r:I saw you later that day.} - O'sha kuni keyinroq men seni ko'rdim.
{r:They built their house later that year.} - Keyinroq o'sha yili ular o'z uyini qurishdi.

text: {r:Lie}[laɪ] – aldamoq; yolg'on. Men har kuni laycha it bilan g'iybatlashib o'tiraman. Lekin {p:LAY}cha faqat {h:yolg'on gapiradi}.
examples: {r:When do your lies end?} - Yolg'onlaring qachon tugaydi.
{r:He's been lying about his age for years.} - U yillardan beri yoshi haqida yolg'on gapiradi.
{r:It was a lie.} - Bu yolg'on edi.
{r:They've been lying to each other since the beginning.} - Ular boshidan bir-birlariga yolg'on gapirishgan.

text: {r:Learn}[lɜːn] - o'rganmoq. Hozir quloq-burun tozalovchilar yaxshi pul topyapti. Shuning uchun {p:LORN}i kasbini {h:o'rganmoqchiman}.
examples: {r:How long have you been learning English?} - Siz qancha vaqtdan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapsiz?
{r:I've been learning to drive since January.} - Men yanvardan beri mashina haydashni o'rganyapman.
{r:She hasn't been learning the new words properly.} - U yangi so'zlarni to'g'ri o'rganmayapti.
{r:They've been learning about different cultures.} - Ular turli madaniyatlar haqida o'rganishyapti.

text: {r:Snow}[snəʊ] – qor; qor yog’moq. Agar kambag’al bo’lsangiz siz uchun qish kelishi va {h:qor} yog’ishi haqiqiy {p:SINOV}.
examples: {r:How long has it been snowing?} - Qancha vaqtdan beri qor yog'yapti?
{r:It's been snowing heavily since morning.} - Ertalabdan beri qattiq qor yog'ayapti.
{r:We haven't seen snow this year yet.} - Biz bu yili hali qorni ko'rmadik.
{r:Children have been playing in the snow all day.} - Bolalar kun bo'yi qorda o'ynashdi.

text: {r:Sorry}[ˈsɒri] - uzr, kechirim.
examples: {r:How long have you been saying sorry?} - Siz qancha vaqtdan beri uzr so'rayapsiz?
{r:Sorry! You are late for your flight. You must hurry}! - Kechirasiz parvozga kech qolyapsiz. Shoshilishingiz zarur.
{r:Sorry, my teacher, I have not done my homework.} - Ustozim kechiring men uyga vazifani bajarmadim.
{r:Why did you say sorry to her?} - Nega sen unga uzr deding?

text: {r:Word}[wɜːd] - so'z. Kompyuterda matnlar yozish uchun ishlatiladigan {p:WORD} dasturi aynan shu so'zdan olingan.
examples: {r:How long have you been memorizing these words?} - Siz qancha vaqtdan beri bu so'zlarni yod olyapsiz?
{r:I've been learning 20 words every day.} - Men kuniga 20 ta so'z o'rganyapman.
{r:She has not used these beautiful words.} - U mana bu chiroyli so'zlarni ishlatmayapti.
{r:These are not important words.} - Bu muhim so'zlar emas.

text: {r:Player}[ˈpleɪə] - o'yinchi. Play(o'ynamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:How long have you been a player?} - Qancha vaqtdan beri o'yinchisiz?
{r:I have been a player for five years.} - Men besh yildan beri o'yinchiman.
{r:She has been a player since 2018.} - U 2018 yildan beri o'yinchi.
{r:My children haven’t seen a football player yet.} - Bolalarim hali futbol o'yinchisini ko'rishmagan.

text: {r:Order}[ˈɔːdə] - order, buyruq; buyurtma(zakaz); buyurmoq. Hibsga olish uchun {p:order} atamasi aynan shu so'zdan paydo bo'lgan.
examples: {r:How long have you been waiting for the order?} - Buyurtmani qancha vaqtdan beri kutayapsiz?
{r:I have been waiting for the order for an hour.} - Men buyurtmani bir soatdan beri kutayapman.
{r:I have ordered you to clean the room.} - Men senga xonani tozalashni buyurganman.
{r:They haven’t received the order yet.} - Ular hali buyurtmani(zakazni) olmadi.

text:
{r:Hour}[aʊə] – soat. 
 Ota : Qanday qilib do'stingga seni nomingga kredit olishiga qo'yib berding.
 O’g’il: Chunki u meni {h:soat}lab {p:avr}adi
examples: {r:I worked for 16 hours yesterday.} - Men kecha 16 soat ishladim.
{r:I have been working for an hour.} - Men bir soatdan beri ishlayapman.
{r:My wife thinks I must sleep for 9 hours.} - Xotinim o'ylaydiki men 9 soat uxlashim zarur
{r:It takes 2 hours to open a bank account.} - Bank hisob raqami ochishga 2 soat ketadi.

text: {r:Compare}[kəmˈpeə] – solishtirmoq. Kompyuter oldida uzoq vaqt o’tirish ko’zni zararlaydi. Shuning uchun ko’pchilik oldiga kaktus qo’yvoladi. Men esa {p:komp}yuterga {p:piyr}og qo’yib qo’ydim. Endi natijalarni {h:solishtirib} sizlarga yetkazaman.
examples: {r:How long have you been comparing the prices?} - Narxlarni qancha vaqtdan beri solishtiryapsiz?
{r:I have been comparing the prices for 30 minutes.} - Men 30 daqiqadan beri narxlarni solishtiryapman.
{r:She has been comparing since yesterday.} - U kechadan beri solishtirayapti.
{r:They haven’t decided after comparing yet.} - Ular hali solishtirgandan keyin qaror qilmadi.

text: {r:Independent}[ˌɪndɪˈpendənt] - mustaqil.
examples: {r:How long have you been independent?} - Qancha vaqtdan beri mustaqilsiz?
{r:I have been independent for two years.} - Men ikki yildan beri mustaqilman.
{r:She has been independent since she started working.} - U ish boshlaganidan beri mustaqil.
{r:My children haven’t become independent yet.} - Bolalarim hali mustaqil bo'lmadi.

text: {r:Nobody}[ˈnəʊbɒdi] – Nosir badiiy kitobni o'qiyotib, uning muallifi kim ekanligi bilan qiziqdi. Lekin {p:NO}sir {p:BADIIY} kitobda {h:hech kim}ning nomini topmadi.
examples: {r:Nobody is talking about friendship.} - Hech kim do'stlik haqida gapirmayapti.
{r:Nobody is waiting for us there.} - Hech kim bizni u yerda kutmayapti.
{r:Nobody is winning in this situation. Everyone is losing here.} - Bu vaziyatda hech kim yutmayapti. Hamma bu yerda yutqazayapti.
{r:Nobody has seen you yet.} - Hech kim hali seni ko'rmadi.

text: {r:Hospital}[ˈhɒspɪtl] - gospital, kasalxona. Oxshash so'zlar.
examples: {r:How long have you been in the hospital?} - Kasalxonada qancha vaqtdan beri yotibsiz?
{r:I have been in the hospital for a week.} - Men bir haftadan beri kasalxonadaman.
{r:She has been working at the hospital since 2019.} - U 2019 yildan beri kasalxonada ishlaydi.
