Men: Ha siz uchun buni farqi yo’q. Siz bilan {h:bahslashishni} foydasi yo’q {p:AR}oq {p:GU}noh deb.
examples: {r:What did they argue about?} - Ular nima haqida bahslashishdi?
{r:Who likes to argue with others?} - Kim boshqalar bilan bahslashishni yaxshi ko'radi?
{r:How long did you argue?} - Siz qancha vaqt bahslashdingiz?
{r:It is bad to argue.} - Bahslashish yomon.

text:
{r:Grow}[ɡroʊ] - o'stirmoq, o'smoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - grew, grown. 
Men qish kunlarida eng yaxshi ko'rgan ishim {p:QIROV} {h:o'stirish} bilan shug'ullanaman.
examples: {r:What will you grow in the garden?} - Bog'da nima o'stirasiz?
{r:How fast do these plants grow?} - Bu o'simliklar qanchalik tez o'sadi?
{r:Who wants to grow a big tree?} - Katta daraxt o'stirishni kim xohlaydi?
{r:My children are growing fast.} - Bolalarim tez o'syapti.
{r:I grew potatoes.} - Men kartoshka o'stirdim.

text: {r:Brotherhood}[ˈbrʌðərhʊd] - birodarlik, aka-ukalik. Brother(aka, uka) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:What is brotherhood?} - Birodarlik nima?
{r:How important is brotherhood?} - Birodarlik qanchalik muhim?
{r:It is our obligation to develop the brotherhood of our nations.} - Xalqlarimiz birodarligini rivojlantirish bizning burchimiz.
{r:There is a strong brotherhood in this group.} - Bu guruhda kuchli birodarlik bor.
{r:We are pleased with this brotherhood.} - Biz bu birodarlikdan xursandmiz.

text: {r:Homesick}[ˈhoʊmsɪk] - uy sog'inchi. Home(uy) va sick(kasal) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:What makes you homesick?} - Sizni nima uy sog'inchiga soladi?
{r:Who feels homesick when they are away?} - Uzoqda bo'lganlarida kim uy sog'inchini his qiladi?
{r:How homesick are you?} - Siz qanchalik uy sog'inchidasiz?
{r:She is homesick for her home.} - U uyini sog'inyapti.

text: {r:Newcomer}[ˈnuːkʌmər] - yangi kelgan.
examples: {r:Who is the newcomer in the class?} - Sinfda yangi kelgan kim?
{r:What did the newcomer say?} - Yangi kelgan nima dedi?
{r:How do you help a newcomer?} - Siz yangi kelganlarga qanday yordam berasiz?
{r:He is a newcomer to this city.} - U bu shaharga yangi kelgan.
{r:I saw a newcomer with a yellow wallet on the corner.} - Men burchakda sariq hamyonli yangi kelganni ko'rdim.

text: {r:Source}[sɔːrs] – manba. Yod yetishmayotgan bolalar yodlangan tuz {p:so’rsin.} Bu yodning eng katta {h:manba}si.
examples: {r:What is the source of this mineral?} - Bu mineralning manbasi nima?
{r:Which source is more reliable, this or that?} - Qaysi manba ishonchliroq, bu yoki u?
{r:How reliable is this source?} - Bu manba qanchalik ishonchli?
{r:We found the source of the problem.} - Biz muammoning manbasini topdik.

text:
{r:Unlike}[ˈʌn.laɪk] – farqli o'laroq, o‘xshamaydigan. 
Bu so‘z ikki yoki undan ortiq narsaning bir-biridan farqli bo'lishini ifodalaydi va o'tgan darsdagi like(o'xshash) ning teskarisi.
examples: {r:Unlike his brother, he enjoys reading.} - Akasidan farqli o‘laroq, u kitob o‘qishni yaxshi ko‘radi.
{r:Unlike yesterday, today is sunny.} - Kechadan farqli ravishda, bugun quyoshli.
{r:She is calm, unlike her energetic friend.} - U jo'shqin do‘stidan farqli o'laroq juda xotirjam.
{r:Unlike most people, he doesn’t drink coffee.} - Ko‘pchilikdan farqli o‘laroq, u qahva ichmaydi.

text: {r:Weight}[weɪt] - vazn. Weigh so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Do you know how much the weight of this box is?} - Bu qutining vazni qancha ekanligini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know what the weight limit for this elevator is.} - Bu lift uchun vazn chegarasi qancha ekanligini bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me if the weight of the package is correct?} - Paketning vazni to'g'ri ekanligini ayta olasizmi?
{r:I don’t remember the weight of this pencil.} - Bu qalamning vaznini eslolmayman.

text: {r:Apologize}[əˈpɒlədʒaɪz] – kechirim so’ramoq. Mashhur ayfon telefonlarining batareykalari haqiqatdan ham kuchsiz. Shuning uchun {p:EPIL OJIZ} taraflarimizni {h:kechiring} hammasini to’g’rilaymiz demoqda ekan.
examples: {r:Do you know why he apologized?} - U nega kechirim so'raganini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know what he apologized for.} - U nima uchun kechirim so'raganini bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me if she apologized to you?} - U sizdan kechirim so'raganmi, ayta olasizmi?
{r:I apologize for being late.} - Kech qolganim uchun uzr so'rayman.

text: {r:Such}[sʌtʃ] – shunday, bunchalar, shunchalar, juda. Bolaligimda sochim o’sib ketsa har doim bir gapni aytishardi. '{p:Soch}ing {h:shunchalik} o’sibdiki hatto bantik taqsa bo’ladi'
examples: {r:Such a beautiful day!} - Bunchalar ajoyib kun!
{r:Is this such a difficult task?} - Bu shunday qiyin vazifami?
{r:She is such a kind and attentive person.} - U shunchalar mehribon va e'tiborli inson.
{r:I didn't expect such a late arrival.} - Shunday kech yetib kelishingni kutmagandim.

text: {r:Concern}[kənˈsɜːrn] – xavotir, g’am, tashvish; xavotirlanmoq; aloqador bo’lmoq, daxldor bo’lmoq. Hozir men cho’lning o’rtasida sayohatdaman. Yeyishga menda faqat baliq konservasi qolgan. Hozir mening eng katta {h:tashvishim} shu {p:konser}vani qanday qilib pichoqsiz ochishda.
examples: {r:Do you know what her main concern is?} - Uning asosiy tashvishi nima ekanligini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know why this issue is a big concern.} - Nima uchun bu masala bunchalik katta tashvish ekanligini bilmayman.
{r:I am concerned about Earth.} - Men Yer haqida tashvishdaman.
{r:I don’t remember where we discussed these concerns.} - Bu muammolarni qayerda muhokama qilganimizni eslay olmayman.

text: {r:Smoke}[smoʊk] - chekmoq; tutun.
examples: {r:Do you know where the smoke is coming from?} - Tutun qayerdan kelayotganini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know why there’s so much smoke in the kitchen.} - Oshxonada nima uchun buncha tutun borligini bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me if smoking is allowed here?} - Bu yerda chekishga ruxsat berilganmi, ayta olasizmi?
{r:She is lucky to have a non-smoking husband.} - U chekmaydigan eri borligi uchun omadli.

text: {r:If}[ɪf] – agar. {h:Agar} uyni tozalamasam, {p:IF}los bo’lib ketadi.
examples: {r:If you are a blogger, don't care about haters.} - Agar blogger bo'lsang negativchilar haqida o'ylama.
{r:If this ladder is not suitable we will find another one.} - Agar bu narvon to'g'ri kelmasa boshqa bittasini topamiz.
{r:If the weather is cloudy, take your umbrella.} - Agar ob-havo bulutli bo'lsa soyabonni olvol.
{r:If you don't wipe the floor, it gets very dirty.} - Agar polni artmasang u juda kir bo'lib ketadi.

text: {r:Elephant}[ˈelɪfənt] – fil. Elflarga kichkina bo’lib yurish yoqmaydi. {p:ELF}lar {p:INT}ilishadi {h:fil}dek basavlat bo’lishga.
examples: {r:Do you know where the elephant eats?} - Fil qayerda ovqatlanishini bilasizmi?
{r:Personally I don’t know how much an elephant weighs.} - Shaxsan men fil qancha vazn bosishini bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me if elephants are intelligent?} - Fillar aqllimi yo'qmi ayta olasizmi?
{r:Can you tell me whether elephants are intelligent?} - Fillar aqllimi, ayta olasizmi?
{r:Is it possible to steal the elephants from the zoo?} - Zooparkdan fillarni o'g'irlasa bo'ladimi?

text: {r:Lesson}[ˈlesn] - dars. Bugungi darsimiz ozgina uyatsiz bo'lib tuyulishi mumkin. {h:Darsimiz} {p:LASSIN}a haqida(ayollar kiyimi).
examples: {r:Do you know what the lesson is about?} - Dars nima haqida ekanligini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know why this lesson is so difficult.} - Nima uchun bu dars bunchalik qiyin ekanligini bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me if the lesson has started?} - Dars boshlanganmi, ayta olasizmi?
{r:Can you tell me whether the lesson has started?} - Dars boshlanganmi yo'qmi ayta olasizmi?
{r:I don’t remember where I put my lesson notes.} - Dars yozuvlarimni qayerga qo'yganimni eslay olmayman.

text: {r:Rainy}[ˈreɪni] - yomg'irli. Rain(yomg'ir) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Do you know if it will be rainy tomorrow?} - Ertaga yomg'irli bo'ladimi yo'qmi bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know why the weather is so rainy this week.} - Nima uchun bu hafta ob-havo bunchalik yomg'irli ekanligini bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me where the rainy season starts?} - Yomg'irli mavsum qayerdan boshlanishini ayta olasizmi?
{r:I don’t remember when the last rainy day was.} - Oxirgi yomg'irli kun qachon bo'lganini eslay olmayman.

text: {r:Reader}[ˈriːdər] - o'quvchi. Read(o'qimoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Do you know who the reader of this book is?} - Bu kitobning o'quvchisi kim ekanligini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know what the reader’s opinion is.} - O'quvchining fikri nima ekanligini bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me whether the reader understood the story?} - O'quvchi hikoyani tushunganmi yo'qmi ayta olasizmi?
{r:I don’t remember where the reader left the book.} - O'quvchi kitobni qayerga qoldirganini eslay olmayman.

text: {r:Feeling}[ˈfiːlɪŋ] - hissiyot. Feel(his qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Actually your feelings are understandable to everyone.} - Aslida sening hissiyotlaring hammaga tushunarli.
{r:I know my feelings and thoughts are not important to you.} - Bilaman mening o'ylarim va hissiyotlarim senga muhim emas.
{r:Do me a favour. Listen to my feelings.} - Menga bir yaxshilik qil. Hissiyotlarimni eshit.
{r:I can’t remember where I wrote down my feelings.} - Hissiyotlarimni qayerga yozganimni eslay olmayman.
{r:It's a common feeling to be homesick when you live far from your family.} - Oilangizdan uzoqda yashaganingizda uy sog'inishi odatiy holdir.

text: {r:Lively}[ˈlaɪvli] - jonli, energetik, tetik. Live(yashamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Do you know what the lively markets attract?} - Jonli bozorlar nimani jalb qilishini bilasizmi?
{r:I don't know why her lively personality attracts my attention.} - Nima uchun uning energetik xarakteri mening e'tiborimni jalb qiladi bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me whether they enjoyed the lively atmosphere at the cafe?} - Ular kafedagi jonli muhitdan zavqlandimi yo'qmi ayta olasizmi?
{r:I don't remember when a lively debate started among the students.} - Talabalar orasida jonli munozara qachon boshlanganini eslay olmayman.

text: {r:Monthly}[ˈmʌnθli] - oylik, har oyda bo'ladigan. Month(oy) so'zidan olingan.
examples: {r:How much is your monthly pension?} - Oylik pensiyangiz qancha?
{r:I don't know what they publish monthly about health.} - Ular sog'liq haqida har oy nima nashr etishlarini bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me how often the budget is checked on a monthly basis?} - Byudjet qanchalik tez-tez oylik asosda ko'rib chiqilishini ayta olasizmi?
{r:I don't remember if she pays the monthly rent on time.} - U oylik ijara haqini o'z vaqtida to'laydimi yo'qmi eslay olmayman.

text: {r:Occasion}[əˈkeɪʒn] – vaziyat, holat, fursat; tadbir. Soch soqolim karantin payt shunchalik o’sib ketdiki, ko’chaga chiqqan paytim odamlar hazillashishni boshlashdi “{p:OKA} nima bu {p:JUN}” deya. Shunday {h:vaziyat}ga tushib qoldim.
examples: {r:It was a special occasion.} - Bu maxsus tadbir edi.
{r:We celebrated this occasion.} - Biz bu holatni nishonladik.
{r:She dressed up for the occasion.} - U tadbir uchun chiroyli kiyindi.
{r:We met on several occasions.} - Biz bir necha vaziyatlarda uchrashib qolganmiz.

text: {r:Typical}[ˈtɪpɪkl] - tipik, tipichniy, odatiy.
examples: {r:Do you know what a typical breakfast here includes?} - Bu yerda odatiy nonushta nimani o'z ichiga olishini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know if the weather is typical for this time of year.} - Ob-havo yilning bu davri uchun odatiymi bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me how long the typical meeting lasts?} - Odatdagi yig'ilish qancha davom etishini ayta olasizmi?
{r:I am a typical Uzbek.} - Men odatiy(tipichniy) o'zbekman.

text: {r:Base}[beɪs] - baza, asos, tayanch.
examples: {r:Do you know where the military base is located?} - Harbiy baza qayerda joylashganini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know if his theory has a strong scientific base.} - Uning nazariyasi kuchli ilmiy asosga egami bilmayman.
{r:This factory was an economic base of the city.} - Bu zavod shaharning iqtisodiy tayanchi edi.
{r:I don’t remember why they decided to move the base to another location.} - Ular nima uchun bazani boshqa joyga ko'chirishga qaror qilganlarini eslay olmayman.

text: {r:Realize}[ˈriːəlaɪz] – tushunmoq, fahmlamoq; realizatsiya qilish ya'ni amalga oshirish. Yaqinda {p:REAL LAYS} chipslari bilan hamkorlik taklifini bekor qildi. Men o’sha zahotiyoq negaligini {h:tushundim.} Lays avval Messi bilan hamkorlik qilgan.
examples: {r:Do you know what she realized about the importance of hard work?} - U mehnatsevarlikning ahamiyati haqida nimani tushunganini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know if they finally realized their dream of traveling.} - Ular nihoyat sayohat qilish orzularini amalga oshirishganmi bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me why he didn't realize the mistake until it was too late?} - U nima uchun xatoni juda kech bo'lgunga qadar anglamaganini ayta olasizmi?
{r:I could not realize how significant this decision is.} - Bu qaror qanchalik muhim ekanligini fahmlay olmaganman.

text: {r:Contain}[kənˈteɪn] - ichida bo'lmoq, saqlamoq, o'z ichiga olmoq. U biror narsa boshqa biror narsaning ichida mavjudligini yoki uni o'z ichiga olishini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. 1) "This box contains books." — "Bu quti kitoblarni o'z ichiga oladi." 2) "The bottle contains water." — "Shishada suv bor." 3) "Does the cake contain nuts?" — "Tortda yong'oqlar bormi?" 4) "His speech contained several interesting ideas." — "Uning nutqida bir nechta qiziqarli g'oyalar bor edi."
examples: {r:Do you know what the box contains?} - Quti nimani o'z ichiga olishini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know if this food contains allergens.} - Bu ovqat allergenlarni o'z ichiga oladimi bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me if the bottle contains enough water for the trip?} - Shisha safar uchun yetarli suvni o'z ichiga oladimi yo'qmi ayta olasizmi?
{r:Our country contains 12 regions.} - Bizning davlat 12 ta regionni o'z ichiga oladi.

text: {r:Consist}[kənˈsɪst] - …dan iborat bo’lmoq, tashkil topmoq. Men o’ttiz yildan beri mana shu konteyner va sisternalarda sut, suv va boshqa suyuqliklar tashiyman. Mening bor boyligimni mana shu {p:KON}teyner va {p:SIST}ernalarim {h:tashkil qiladi}.
examples: {r:Do you know what the recipe consists of?} - Retsept nimadan iboratligini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know if the committee consists of five members.} - Qo'mita besh a'zodan iboratmi bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me who their team consists of?} - Ularning jamoasi kimlardan iboratligini ayta olasizmi?
{r:I don’t remember what a healthy diet consists of.} - Sog'lom ovqatlanish nimadan iboratligini eslay olmayman.

text: {r:Behave}[bɪˈheɪv] – o’zini tutmoq. Agar {p:BEHI V}arenyasini yesangiz {h:o’zingizni tutishingiz} keskin o’zgaradi, hamma narsaga tirjayaveradigan bo’lasiz.
examples: {r:Do you know how students are expected to behave?} - Talabalar qanday o'zini tutishlari kutilishini bilasizmi?
{r:I don’t know if he behaved kindly to the newcomers.} - U yangi kelganlarga nisbatan mehribonlik bilan harakat qilganmi yo'qmi bilmayman.
{r:Can you tell me how children learn how to behave?} - Bolalar qanday qilib o'zini tutishni o'rganishini ayta olasizmi?
{r:I don’t remember whether I behaved well when I was young.} - Yoshligimda o'zimni yaxshi tutganmanmi yoki yo'qmi eslayolmayman.

text: {r:Selfish}[ˈselfɪʃ] - xudbin. Men juda {h:xudbin} odamman. {p:SELFI ISH}im meni asosiy, ertayu-kech o'zimni o'zim rasmga olib o'tiraman.
examples: {r:Do you know why being selfish damages relationships?} - Nima uchun xudbinlik munosabatlarga zarar etkazishini bilasizmi?
{r:Why are you selfish?} - Sen nega xudbinsan?
{r:I don't have close friends. Because my friends are selfish.} - Yaqin do'stlarim yo'q chunki do'stlarimning hammasi xudbin.
{r:Seemingly my relatives are selfish.} - Ko'rinishidan mening qarindoshlarim xudbin.

text: {r:Repeatedly}[rɪˈpiːtɪdli] - qayta-qayta, takror. Repeat(takrorlamoq) so'zidan yasalgan ravish. Mnemonik namuna uchun 34 - darsdagi repeat ga qarang.
examples: {r:She said that she had repeatedly asked me for money.} - U mendan qayta-qayta pul so'raganini aytdi.
{r:The teacher told us that she repeatedly reminded us to study for the exam.} - O'qituvchi bizga imtihonga tayyorlanishimizni qayta-qayta eslatganini aytdi.
{r:Alisher said that he had repeatedly called her, but she hadn’t answered.} - Alisher unga qayta-qayta qo'ng'iroq qilganini, lekin u javob bermaganini aytdi.
{r:The child repeatedly said he was hungry.} - Bola qayta-qayta och qolganini aytdi.

text: {r:Fortunately}[ˈfɔːrtʃənətli] - yaxshiyamki. Fortunate(omadli) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Fortunately. I could get some rest before a busy day.} - Yaxshiyamki band kun oldidan biroz dam oldim.
{r:She said that fortunately she had found her lost keys in the car.} - U yaxshiyamki yo'qolgan kalitlarini mashinada topganini aytdi.
{r:Fortunately there are no dangerous guys in our town.} - Xayriyatki bu shaharchada xavfi yigitlar yo'q.
{r:Fortunately, I was trained to be strong since childhood.} - Yaxshiyamki men bolalikdan kuchli bo'lishga o'rgatilganman.

text: {r:Following}[ˈfɑːloʊɪŋ] - keyingi, quyidagi. Follow so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 35 - darsdagi follow ga qarang.
examples: {r:She said that the following day they would go to the beach.} - U ertasi kuni plyajga borishlarini aytdi.
{r:The teacher told us to complete the following tasks by tomorrow.} - O'qituvchi bizga quyidagi vazifalarni ertagacha bajarishimizni aytdi.
{r:He said that the following week his wife would start her new job.} - U keyingi hafta uning xotini ishini boshlashini aytdi.
{r:The teacher reported that the following students had been absent yesterday.} - O'qituvchi quyidagi o'quvchilar kecha darsda yo'q bo'lganini xabar qildi.

text: {r:Weekly}[ˈwiːkli] - haftalik, har hafta. Week(hafta) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:They told me that they had a weekly meeting every Monday.} - Ular menga har dushanba kuni haftalik yig'ilishlari borligini aytishdi.
{r:She said to us she wrote a weekly report for her boss.} - U xo'jayini uchun haftalik hisobot yozishini aytdi bizga.
{r:I usually buy a weekly newspaper.} - Men odatda haftalik gazeta sotib olaman.
{r:They told us that they cleaned the house weekly.} - Ular bizga uyni har hafta tozalashlarini aytishdi.

text: {r:Occasionally}[əˈkeɪʒnəli] – har zamonda, ahyon ahyonda, ba’zan. Men rassomman. Ijodga berilib ba’zan oylab uydan chiqmay ishlayman. Ko’chaga chiqqan paytim tanishlar “{p:OKA JUNLI} bo’p ketasiz shunaqa o’zi {h:har-har zamonda}” deyishadi.
examples: {r:She said that she occasionally visited her grandparents in the village.} - U vaqti-vaqti bilan qishloqdagi bobo va buvisinikiga borishini aytdi.
{r:He admitted he occasionally forgot to lock the door.} - U vaqti-vaqti bilan eshikni qulflab qo'yishni unutishini tan oldi.
{r:I used to meet my relatives occasionally.} - Men qarindoshlarimni har zamonda ko'rardim.
{r:My father used to ride a bicycle occasionally.} - Mening otam har zamonda velosiped minib turar edi.

text: {r:Piano}[piˈænoʊ] - pianino. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:He said he played the piano every evening.} - U har oqshom pianino chalishini aytdi.
{r:She told me the piano is her lifelong hobby.} - U menga pianino uning bir umrlik hobbisi ekanligini aytdi.
{r:It is not necessary to play the piano quickly.} - Pianoni tez chalish zarur emas.
{r:What color is your piano? Black or Brown?} - Pianinoyingizni rangi qanday? Qora yoki jigarrang?

text: {r:Stadium}[ˈsteɪdiəm] - stadion.
examples: {r:What is the meaning of this gesture that people showed in the stadium?} - Odamlar stadionda ko'rsatgan bu ishoraning ma'nosi nima?
{r:The news reported that the stadium had been full of eager fans.} - Yangiliklar stadion g'ayratli muxlislarga to'la bo'lganini xabar qildi.
{r:Bunyodkor is a small stadium in comparison with the Barcelona stadium.} - Bunyodkor Barselona stadioni bilan solishtirganda kichkina stadion.
{r:She said that the concert at the stadium had been amazing.} - U stadiondagi konsert ajoyib bo'lganini aytdi.
{r:The opening of the new stadium was a big occasion.} - Yangi stadionning ochilishi katta voqea bo'ldi.

text: {r:Reporter}[rɪˈpɔːrtər] - muxbir, reportyor. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:She said that the reporter had asked many questions during the interview.} - U muxbir intervyu davomida ko'plab savollar berganini aytdi.
{r:The reporter was ready to read news.} - Muxbir yangiliklarni o'qib berishga tayyor edi.
{r:Reporters are trained to speak fast.} - Muxbirlar tez gapirishga o'rgatiladi.
{r:This guy is a reporter from a foreign country.} - Bu yigit chet davlatdan bo'lgan muxbir.
{r:The reporter is wearing gloves because of the cold weather.} - Muxbir qo'lqoplarini kiymoqda sovuq havo tufayli

text: {r:Direct}[daɪˈrekt] - to'g'ri; yo'naltirmoq. Xullas men bilan bog'lanmoqchi bo'lsangiz {h:to'g'ri} Instagramda {p:DAYREKT}imga yozishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:He asked if I could give him direct instructions.} - U mendan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ko'rsatmalar bera olamanmi yo'qmi so'radi.
{r:She told me that the manager had spoken to her in a direct manner.} - U menga menejer unga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapirganini aytdi.
{r:He explained that the direct flight to Tashkent took 4 hours.} - U Toshkentga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri reys 4 soat davom etishini tushuntirdi.
{r:She said that she had given Jahongir a direct answer to his question.} - U Jahongirning savoliga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri javob berganini aytdi.

text: {r:Mark}[mɑːrk] – iz, dog’; belgi, baho. Tasavvur qiling har safar burger yeganingizda ketchupi tanangizning {p:MARK}aziga kindigingiz atrofiga tegib ketadi va ko’ylagingiz {h:dog’} bo’ladi.
examples: {r:He said that he saw a mark on the sunglasses.} - U ko'zoynak ustida iz ko'rganini aytdi.
{r:She told me that the teacher gave her a good mark.} - U menga o'qituvchi unga yaxshi baho berganini aytdi.
{r:He said that the cat left a mark on the chair.} - U mushuk stulda iz qoldirganini aytdi.
{r:Julia told us that she saw a mark on her skirt.} - Julia bizga yubkasida dog' ko'rganini aytdi.

text: {r:Speech}[spiːtʃ] - nutq. Kecha mashhur o'zbek qo'shiqchisi konsert davomida gugurt(SPICHka) haqida nutq so'zladi va bunday keraksiz mavzuni hech kim kutmagan edi.
examples: {r:She said that the speech was long.} - U nutq uzun ekanini aytdi.
{r:He told me that his speech was good.} - U menga uning nutqi yaxshi ekanini aytdi.
{r:Julia said to me she liked his speech.} - Julia uning nutqini yoqtirganini aytdi.
{r:They told me that the speech was about the new city.} - Ular menga nutq yangi shahar haqida ekanini aytdi.

text: {r:Suspicious}[səˈspɪʃəs] - shubhali. Tasavvur qiling musorkada 12 soat {p:SASIP ISHLIZ} va cho'milganingizda ham bu sassiq hid ketmaydi. Odamlar ko'ziga ham {h:shubhali} ko'rinasiz. Balki ular sizni BOMJ deb o'ylar.
examples: {r:He said the man looked suspicious.} - U odam shubhali ko'ringanini aytdi.
{r:The police grew suspicious when they heard sounds, realizing someone was still alive inside.} - Politsiya ovozlarni eshitib, kimdir ichkarida tirik ekanligini anglab, shubhalana boshladi.
{r:He said that he saw something suspicious.} - U shubhali narsa ko'rganini aytdi.
{r:She told me that the ladder was suspicious.} - U menga narvon shubhali ekanini aytdi.

text: {r:Delay}[dɪˈleɪ] – kechiktirmoq, ortga surmoq. Siz bu vaziyatda mashhur bloger DILI me uylanishni ortga surayotgani va ota onasi ''{p:DILI} biz ham nevara ko’rishni istaymiz nimaga hamma narsani {h:kechiktiraverasan.}'' deyishini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:They said that there was a delay.} - Ular kechikish borligini aytishdi.
{r:He told me that they would delay the game.} - U menga ular o'yinni kechiktirishini aytdi.
{r:She said that the bus had a delay.} - U avtobusda kechikish borligini aytdi.
{r:He told me that he would not delay his work.} - U menga ishini kechiktirmasligini aytdi.

text: {r:Recent}[ˈriːsnt] - yaqinda bo‘lgan, so‘nggi, oxirgi paytdagi. U yaqinda sodir bo‘lgan voqealar yoki holatlarni ifodalashda ishlatiladi. 1) "I read a recent article about climate change." — "Men iqlim o‘zgarishi haqida yaqinda chiqqan maqolani o‘qidim." 2) "Have you seen her recent photos?" — "Uning yaqinda tushgan suratlarini ko‘rdingmi?" 3) "The company’s recent success is impressive." — "Kompaniyaning so‘nggi yutug‘i qoyilmaqom." 4) "There have been several recent changes." — "So‘nggi paytlarda bir nechta o‘zgarishlar bo‘ldi."
examples: {r:She said that it was a recent event.} - U bu yaqinda bo'lgan voqea ekanini aytdi.
{r:He told me that he read a recent book.} - U menga yaqinda chiqqan kitobni o'qiganini aytdi.
{r:She said she saw Temur in recent days.} - U Temurni yaqinda ko'rganini aytdi.
{r:They told me that this was a recent change.} - Ular menga bu yaqinda bo'lgan o'zgarish ekanini aytdi.

text: {r:Connect}[kəˈnekt] – bog’lamoq, ulamoq. Bizning mahallamiz va qo’shni mahalla bir-biridan kanal bilan ajratilgan. Aholini ko’p yillik talabiga qaramay hokimiyatdan ko’prik qurib berishmayapti. Mahallamizdagi bir odam eski neksiya mashinalarini kanalga tashlabdi va tabiiy ko’prik hosil qilibdi. {p:KAN}alga {p:NEK}siyalarni tushirish orqali u ikkita mahallani bir-biriga {h:bog’ladi}.
examples: {r:She said that she would connect the wires.} - U simlarni ulab qo'yishini aytdi.
{r:He told me to connect the two parts.} - U menga ikki qismni bog'lashni aytdi.
{r:She said that the road connects two cities.} - U yo'l ikki shaharni bog'lashini aytdi.
{r:They told me that the team would connect soon.} - Ular menga jamoaning tez orada ulanishini aytdi.

text: {r:Fare}[fer] – yo’l kira. Tasavvur qiling siz qog’oz pul ishlatmaydigan fermersiz. Avtobuslarda {h:yo’l kira} haqini pulda to’lash o’rniga kartoshka yoki tuxum yoki shunga o’xshash {p:FER}merlik mahsulotlaringizdan biri bilan to’lab ketasiz.
examples: {r:She said that the bus fare was small.} - U avtobus yo'l haqqi kichik ekanini aytdi.
{r:He told me that the train fare was high.} - U menga poyezd yo'l haqqi baland ekanini aytdi.
{r:The bus does not take fares from needy people.} - Bu avtobus muhtoj odamlardan yo'l kira olmaydi.
{r:They told me that the fare was for the whole day.} - Ular menga yo'l haqqi butun kun uchun ekanini aytdi.

text: {r:Reserve}[rɪˈzɜːrv] - band qilmoq, buyurtirmoq.
examples: {r:He said that he would reserve a place.} - U joyni band qilishini aytdi.
{r:She told me that she wanted to reserve a table.} - U menga stol band qilishni xohlaganini aytdi.
{r:He said that we need to reserve tickets.} - U bizga chiptalarni band qilish kerakligini aytdi.
{r:She told me the room was reserved.} - U menga xona band qilinganini aytdi.

text: {r:Profit}[ˈprɑːfɪt] – daromad. Tasavvur qiling professorlikka dissertatsiya yoqlash uchun Italiya bayrog’i bilan qatnashishingiz kerak sizning universitetingizda. {p:PROF}essor {p:IT}aliyalik bo’lmasa ham. Shu bayroq sotayotganlar {h:foyda} qilyaptida universitetdagi shu qonundan.
examples: {r:They said that the company made a big profit.} - Ular kompaniya katta foyda qilganini aytishdi.
{r:He told me that the business made a profit.} - U menga biznesda foyda borligini aytdi.
{r:She said they want to make more profit.} - Ular ko'proq foyda qilishni xohlashini aytdi.
{r:They told me that the new work brought profit.} - Ular menga yangi ish foyda keltirganini aytdi.

text: {r:Confident}[ˈkɑːnfɪdənt] – o’ziga ishongan, uverenniy. Shirinliklar olamida konfet birinchi bo’lib kredit olmoqchi bo’libdi. “Meni hamma yaxshi ko’radi, menga kredit beradi aniq” deya {h:o’ziga ishonib} gapiribdi. Anorbank ilovasini yuklab olib kredit uchun registratsiyadan o’tibdi va keyin {p:KONF}etdan {p:IDENT}ifikatsiyadan o’tish so’ralibdi. O’ziga ishongan bo’lsada konfet bu bosqichdan pasporti yo’qligi tufayli o’ta olmabdi.
examples: {r:She said that she felt confident.} - U o'zini ishonchli his qilganini aytdi.
{r:He told me that he was confident about the plan.} - U menga reja bo'yicha o'ziga ishonayotganini aytdi.
{r:She said to me she would be more confident soon.} - U tez orada yanada o'ziga ko'proq ishonishini aytdi.
{r:They told me that the team was confident about winning.} - Ular menga jamoa g'alaba qozonishiga amin ekanini aytdi.

text: {r:Face}[feɪs] – yuz, qiyofa. Alisher {p:Fayz} {h:yuz}idan hech qachon kulgi arimaydigan kamdan kam insonlardan biri.
examples: {r:Kamron said that her face was beautiful.} - Kamron uning yuzi chiroyli ekanini aytdi.
{r:Sarah told me that his face was red.} - Sara menga uning yuzi qizil ekanini aytdi.
{r:He said that he saw a new face.} - U yangi yuz ko'rganini aytdi.
{r:She told me that she washed her face.} - U menga yuzini yuvganini aytdi.

text: {r:Ship}[ʃɪp] - kema. Tasavvur qiling sichqonlar sizning {p:SHIP}pagingizdan {h:kema} yasab ariqda suzib ketishyapti.
examples: {r:I want to see the ship.} - Men kemani ko'rishni xohlayman.
{r:Where is your paper ship?} - Qog'ozdan yasalgan kemang qani?
{r:We expect to see the ship arrive.} - Biz kemaning yetib kelishini kutamiz.
{r:Nobody wanted to see the ship damaged.} - Hech kim kemaning shikastlanishini xohlamadi.

text: {r:Temperature}[ˈtɛmprətʃər] - temperatura, harorat.
examples: {r:I need to know the temperature.} - Men haroratni bilishim kerak.
{r:She hoped to feel better with less temperature.} - U harorat kamayishi bilan yaxshiroq bo'lishiga umid qildi.
{r:We were surprised to see the temperature drop.} - Harorat pasayganini ko'rib hayron qoldik.
{r:Fortunately they learned to measure the temperature.} - Yaxshiyamki ular haroratni o'lchashni o'rganishdi.

text: {r:Mind}[maɪnd] – qarshilik qilmoq, qarshi bo'lmoq.
examples: {r:Do you mind opening the window?} - Derazani ochishga qarshimisiz?
{r:I don’t mind waiting.} - Kutishga qarshi emasman.
{r:He doesn't mind helping others.} - U boshqalarga yordam berishga qarshi emas.
{r:She wouldn't mind trying a new meal.} - U yangi ovqatni sinab ko'rishga qarshi emas edi.

text: {r:Suggest}[səˈdʒɛst] – tavsiya qilmoq, taklif qilmoq. Agar siz kal boshingizda {p:SOCH} o’stirmoqchi bo’lsangiz {p:CHEST}nokni kal joyingizga surkashni {h:tavsiya qilaman.} Achib ketmasa bo’ldi boshingiz.
examples: {r:I suggest going to the park.} - Parkga borishni taklif qilaman.
{r:She suggested learning a new skill.} - U yangi ko'nikmani o'rganishni tavsiya qildi.
{r:Can you suggest reading this book?} - Bu kitobni o'qishni tavsiya qila olasizmi?
{r:He suggested taking a break.} - U tanaffus olishni tavsiya qildi.

text: {r:Continue}[kənˈtɪnjuː] – davom ettirmoq. Do’stim Kanadaga ko’chib ketyapti, mashinasini ham olib ketyapti. 'Tyuning qilishni unitdingku' deganimda, ‘’{p:Kan}adada {p:tyuni}ngni {h:davom ettiramiz}’’ dedi.
examples: {r:Please continue working.} - Iltimos, ishlashda davom eting.
{r:The rain will continue falling.} - Yomg'ir yog'ishda davom etadi.
{r:She decided to continue her studies.} - U o'qishini davom ettirishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Refuse}[rɪˈfjuːz] – inkor qilmoq, voz kechmoq, bosh tortmoq. Tarixdan referat tayyorlashim kerak edi, bittasi tayyorlab beraman dedi. Narxini so’rasam {p:REF}erat {p:YUZ} dollar deydi, kerak emas bunday yordamdan {h:voz kechdim.}
examples: {r:The cleaner refused to work on weekends.} - Tozalovchi hafta oxirida ishlashdan bosh tortdi.

text: {r:Upset}[ʌpˈsɛt] – xafa bo’moq, tushkunlikka tushmoq. Bugun bir voqea meni biroz {h:xafa qildi.} Do’konchi qo’shnimiz apelsin olgan paytim {p:AP}elsin {p:SET}kasini yechib oldi “Qo’shni uyingiz uzoq emasku” deya. 12 ta apelsin donasini uyga qo’limda ko’tarib kelayotganimda qo’limdan sirg’anib loyga tushib ketdi va xafa bo’lganimdan ularni yerdan terib o’tirmadim.
examples: {r:Probably she was upset to hear the news.} - Ehtimol u yangilikni eshitib xafa bo'ldi.
{r:He seemed upset after the argument.} - Bahsdan keyin u xafa ko'rinardi.

{r:I felt upset after hearing the story.} - Hikoyani eshitganimdan keyin xafa bo'ldim.

text: {r:Surprised}[sərˈpraɪzd] - hayratlangan, lol qolgan. Surprise so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I was surprised to see him in pink sweater.} - Uni pushti sviterda ko'rib hayron qoldim.

text: {r:Concerning}[kənˈsɜːrnɪŋ] – haqida, taaluqli, bo’yicha. Men ham youtubeda intervyu oladigan kanal ochdim. Hozir Yulduz Usmonova bilan bo’lajak {p:KONSERTINING} raqqosalari {h:bo’yicha} gaplashamiz. Yulduz opaning aytishicha raqsda yurtimizning eng ofat raqqosalari.
examples: {r:We had a talk concerning the plan.} - Biz reja haqida gaplashdik.

text: {r:Behavior}[bɪˈheɪvjər] – xulq, o’zini tutish. {p:Behayo} insonlar {h:xulqi} meni juda g’azablantiradi.
examples: {r:His behavior at the meeting was good.} - Uning yig'ilishdagi xulq-atvori yaxshi edi.

{r:She was praised for her good behavior.} - U yaxshi xulq-atvori uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi.

text: {r:Report}[rɪˈpɔːrt] - hisobot, reportaj. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:Probably they managed to finish the report.} - Balki ular hisobotni tugatishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
{r:Maybe she decided to write a report.} - Balki u hisobot yozishga qaror qilgandir.

{r:The report will consist of various sections.} - Hisobot turli bo'limlardan iborat bo'ladi.

text: {r:Directly}[daɪˈrɛktli] - to'g'ridan-tog'ri. Direct so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:He chose to speak directly.} - U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gaplashishni tanladi.
{r:The road leads directly to the center.} - Yo'l markazga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri olib boradi.
{r:Sarah tried to look directly at him.} - Sara unga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarashga harakat qildi.
{r:The problem was directly related to the money.} - Muammo to'g'ridan-to'g'ri pulga bog'liq edi.

text: {r:Inform}[ɪnˈfɔːrm] - xabar berish, informatsiya berish. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:Please remember to inform me.} - Iltimos, menga xabar berishni unutmang.
{r:She decided to inform the team.} - U jamoaga xabar berishga qaror qildi.
{r:The teacher needed to inform the students.} - O'qituvchi o'quvchilarga xabar berishi kerak edi.

text: {r:Experience}[ɪkˈspɪəriəns] - tajriba.
examples: {r:She enjoys having much experience.} - U ko'p tajribaga ega bo'lishdan zavqlanadi.

text: {r:Discuss}[dɪˈskʌs] - muhokama qilmoq. Tasavvur qiling velosipedingizni {p:DISKAS}ini qo'shiningiz sindirib qo'ydi. Endi siz u bilan diska masalasini {h:muhokama qilishingiz} kerak.
examples: {r:We need to discuss your new trousers.} - Biz sening yangi shimingni muhokama qilishimiz kerak.

text:
{r:Hide}[haɪd] – yashirmoq; yashirinmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - hid, hidden. 
Tasavvur qiling, {p:Hayit}boy ismli bola berkinmachoq o’ynayapti va u {h:yashirinsa} hech kim topolmayapti.
examples: {r:He tried to hide the present behind his back.} – U sovg‘ani orqasiga yashirishga harakat qildi.

text:
{r:Swim}[swɪm] – suzmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - swam, swum. 
Mashhur suzuvchi Maykl Felpsning Olimpiada o’yinlaridagi mahoratli {h:suzib} bitta Olimpiada o’yinlarida 8 ta oltin medal yutganini ko’rib og’izdagi {p:SUVIM} oqib ketdi. 
 Amerikalik suzuvchi Maykl Felps haqiqatdan 2008 - yilda Pekindagi Olimpiada o'yinlarida 8 ta oltin medalni qo'lga kiritgan.

text: {r:Collect}[kəˈlekt] – to‘plamoq, yig'moq. Tasavvur qiling siz antiqa {p:KOLLEK}sionersiz. Siz otlar junini kolleksiya qilasiz ya'ni {h:yig'asiz}.
examples: {r:She collects wallets from different countries.} – U turli mamlakatlardan hamyonlar to‘playdi.

{r:The scientist safely collected perfect examples.} – Olim mukammal namunalarni xavfsiz yig'di.

text: {r:Disease}[dɪˈziːz] – kasallik. Dizel yoqilg’isi eng samarali yoqilg’i ekanligiga qaramasdan, u ko’p davlatlarda taqiqlanayapti. Chunki {p:diz}el {p:is}i inson va hayvonlardagi ko’plab {h:kasalliklarni} qo’zg’atadi.
examples: {r:Patients with this disease can't work here.} – Bu kasallikka chalingan bemorlar bu yerda ishlay olmaydi.

text: {r:Dish}[dɪʃ] – idish yoki taom. Tasodifni qarang 'dish' bu 'idish', o’zbekchadagi so’z bilan deyarli bir xil. Faqat boshlanishida I harfi yo’q va bu so’z ba’zan 'ovqat' ma’nosini anglatadi.
examples: {r:She washed the dishes after dinner.} – U kechki ovqatdan keyin idishlarni yuvdi.

{r:He cooked a delicious dish.} – U mazali taom tayyorladi.

I am [b]doing the dishes[/b] now. - Men hozir [b]idishlarni yuvayapman[/b].

text: {r:Amazing}[əˈmeɪ.zɪŋ] – ajoyib, hayratlanarli.
examples: {r:The view from the top of the mountain was amazing.} - Tog‘ tepasidan manzara ajoyib edi.

text: {r:advice} – maslahat; maslahat bermoq(advise). Ko’p pul topmoqchimisiz, bir {h:maslahatim} bor. Advokat bo’ling, {p:ADV}okatni {p:VAYS}aqisi bo’ling, ya’ni ko’p gapiring. Shunda ko’p klentlaringiz bo’ladi va ko’p pul topasiz.

text: {r:expect} – kutmoq. Fransiya O’zbekiston hududidan topilgan bir dona eksponatni qaytardi, biz esa {p:EKSP}onatlardan {p:EKT}asi qaytarilishini {h:kutgandik.}
examples: {r:I expect you to be on time.} - Men sizdan vaqtida kelishingizni kutaman.
{r:I expect you to pack following things and leave immediately.} - Men seni zudlik bilan quyidagi narsalarni yig'ishtirishingni va jo'nab qolishingni kutaman.

{r:Our team expects the results tomorrow.} - Bizning jamoamiz natijalarni ertaga kutadi.

text: {r:persuade} – ko’ndirmoq. Svitoforning yo’lovchilar uchun yashil chirog’i yongunicha 5 minut ketib qoladi. Bu paytda zerikib qolmaslik va vaqtni bekor o’tkazmaslik uchun men hozir shahar hokimiyatiga ariza yozdim. Men shahar hokimiyatini {p:PIR}og {p:SVIT}ofor tagiga qo’yib qo’yishlariga {h:ko’ndirmoqchiman.} Kutayotgan vaqtimiz shunda zoyi ketmaydi va ozgina qornimiz ham to'yadi.
examples: {r:He persuaded me to join the team.} - U meni jamoaga qo'shilishimga ko'ndirdi.
{r:Nargiza persuaded her friend to come.} - Nargiza o'z do'stini kelishga ko'ndirdi.

{r:They persuaded Anvar to stay longer.} - Ular Anvarni uzoqroq qolishga ko'ndirdi.

text: {r:let} – ruxsat bermoq. Yangi qurilayotgan uyga o’gil bir nechta eski lampochkalar olib kelibdi va otasidan gap eshitibdi. 'Faqat zamonaviy {p:led} lampochkalariga {h:ruxsat}' debdi ota.
examples: {r:She let me borrow her book.} - U menga kitobini olishga ruxsat berdi.

text: {r:luggage} - bagaj, yuk. Mana bu eng antiqa ryukzak chunki mol ichagidan qilingan. O'tgan yili{p: LAG}erga {p:ICH}akdan qilingan shu {h:ryukzakni} olib bordim va hamma hayratlandi.
examples: {r:I packed my luggage for the trip.} - Men safar uchun bagajimni yig'ishtirdim.

text: {r:beg} – yalinmoq, iltijo qilmoq. Tasavvur qiling BEGzod ismli do’stingiz Madagaskar multfilmidagi {p:BEG}emotga {h:yalinyapti} “Iltimos multfilmni davomini olinglar” deb.

text: {r:intention} – niyat. Intend(niyat qilmoq) ning ot shakli.
examples: {r:I intend to finish this project today.} - Men bu loyihani bugun tugatishni niyat qildim.

text: {r:force} – majburlamoq. {p:FORS}aj 7 filmi butun dunyo bo’ylab 1 milliard dollar yig’di va kino tarixida record qo’ydi va shuning uchun homiylar ijodiy jamoani kinoning davomini ishlashga {h:majburlayapti}.

text: {r:encourage} - ruhlantirmoq, qiziqtirmoq. Mana bu amaki Scott Joston va u universitetda o'qiyotgan {p:ENG QARI CH}ol. Uning tirishqoqligi va taslim bo'lmasligi meni haqiqatdan {h:ruhlantiradi}.
examples: {r:The teacher encouraged us to ask questions.} - O'qituvchi bizni savol berishga qiziqtiradi.

text: {r:enable} – imkoniyat bermoq. Bilasizmi nega Apple telefonlari ingichka. Chunki {p:IN}gichka {p:EPL} ko’proq funksionallik, dizayn va qulaylikka {h:imkon beradi}.(Apple bu Ayfon telefonining yana bir nomi)

text: {r:invent} – ixtiro qilmoq. Mana bu akamiz bir kun mashq qilsa ham mushaklarni keskin kattalashtirib yuboruvchi sport {p:INVENT}arini {h:ixtiro qilibdi}.
examples: {r:He invented a new machine.} - U yangi mashina ixtiro qildi.

{r:Who invented the telephone?} - Telefonni kim ixtiro qilgan?

text: {r:apply} - ariza bermoq, topshirib ko'rmoq; surtmoq. Orzularim bir jahon! Agar {p:EPLAY} olsam Garvard Universitetiga {h:ariza topshiraman}.
examples: {r:I will apply for the job tomorrow.} - Men ertaga ishga ariza topshiraman.

{r:She has not applied for medical help yet.} - U hali tibbiy yordam uchun ariza bermadi.

text: {r:success} – muvaffaqiyat. Hamma 7 raqamini omadli hisoblaydi. Lekin men uchun {p:SAKKIS} {h:muvaffaqiyat} keltiradi.
examples: {r:The project was a great success.} - Loyiha katta muvaffaqiyat bo'ldi.
{r:She achieved success through hard work.} - U qattiq mehnat orqali muvaffaqiyat qozondi.
{r:I usually don't believe in famous celebrities' success stories.} - Men odatda mashhur yulduzlarning muvaffaqiyat haqidagi hikoyalariga ishonmayman.
{r:Success depends on your hard work.} - Muvaffaqiyat sizning mehnatingizga bog'liq.

text: {r:outside} - tashqi tomon, tashqari. Maktabda o'qigan paytlarim {p:ABDUSAID} ismli o'rtog'im har kuni ertalab uyimning {h:tashqarisida} 30 minut meni chaqirardi va uning ovozidan uyg'onganimdan so'ng ovqatlanardim, kiyinardim. Xullas bola bechora 1 soat tashqarida meni kutib turardi.
examples: {r:Let’s go outside for some fresh air.} - Keling, yangi havo olish uchun tashqariga chiqaylik.

text: {r:arm} – qo’l. Men yillar davomida {p:arm}atura tashiganman, shuning uchun {h:qo’llarim} baquvvat.
examples: {r:He broke his arm in the accident.} - U baxtsiz hodisada qo'lini sindirib oldi.
{r:She held her baby in her arms.} - U chaqaloqni quchog'ida ushladi.
{r:The arm of the chair was broken.} - Stulning qo'li singan edi.

text: {r:recommendation} - tavsiya, rekomendatsiya. Recommend(tavsiya qilmoq) so'zidan olingan.
examples: {r:I need a recommendation letter for the job.} - Menga ish uchun tavsiya xati kerak.

examples: {r:The buyer expressed his satisfaction.} - Xaridor o'z qoniqishini bildirdi.
{r:She felt a sense of satisfaction after finishing the project.} - Loyihani tugatgandan so'ng u qoniqish his qildi.
{r:This job offers great satisfaction.} - Bu ish katta qoniqish beradi.
{r:Our nation is living with satisfaction.} - Bizning millat qoniqish bilan yashamoqda.

text: {r:follower} - kuzatuvchi, obunachi, podpischik; izdosh. Follow(ergashmoq) so'zidan olingan.
examples: {r:Nargiza has many followers on social media.} - Nargizaning ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda ko'p obunachilari bor.

text: {r:complaint} - shikoyat. Complain(shikoyat qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 37 - darsdagi complain ga qarang.

{r:The complaint was resolved quickly.} - Shikoyat tezda hal qilindi.

text: {r:growth} - o'sish, rivojlanish. Grow(o'smoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 37 - darsdagi grow ga qarang.
examples: {r:The company showed strong growth this year.} - Kompaniya bu yil kuchli o'sish ko'rsatdi.
{r:Personal growth is important for success.} - Shaxsiy o'sish muvaffaqiyat uchun muhimdir.

{r:Julia focused on her career growth.} - Julia o'z karyerasining o'sishiga e'tibor qaratdi.

text: {r:Inside}[ɪnˈsaɪd] - ichkarida.
examples: {r:They went inside the house.} - Ular uyning ichkarisiga kirdilar.
{r:Let's go inside, it's cold.} - Keling, ichkariga kiramiz, sovuq.
{r:He is playing inside.} - U ichkarida o'ynayapti.
{r:The cat went inside the box.} - Mushuk qutining ichiga kirdi.

text:
{r:Bleed}[bliːd] - qonamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - bled, bled.
examples: {r:His finger began to bleed.} - Uning barmog'i qonay boshladi.
{r:Be careful not to bleed.} - Qonamaslik uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.
{r:The doctor saw him bleed.} - Shifokor uning qonayotganini ko'rdi.
{r:The cut made his leg bleed.} - Kesilgan joy oyoqini qonatdi.

text: {r:Drug}[drʌɡ] - dori. Tasavvur qiling aptekalarda dori kamayib ketgan, odamlar esa {h:dori} talashib, {p:drak}a qilishyapti.
examples: {r:This drug will help you feel fine.} - Bu dori o'zingizni yaxshi his qilishingizga yordam beradi.
{r:He needs a new drug.} - Unga yangi dori kerak.
{r:The nurse gave her the drug.} - Hamshira unga dorini berdi.
{r:Is this drug for pain?} - Bu dori og'riq uchunmi?

text: {r:Develop}[dɪˈvɛləp] - rivojlantirmoq, rivojlanmoq. Bilasizmi siz aslida faqatgina {p:DUO OLIB} {h:rivojlanasiz}
examples: {r:They want to develop their knowledge.} - Ular o'z bilimlarini rivojlantirmoqchi.
{r:The city will develop quickly.} - Shahar tez rivojlanadi.
{r:She hopes to develop a new skill.} - U yangi ko'nikmani rivojlantirishga umid qiladi.
{r:We need to develop our ideas.} - Biz g'oyalarimizni rivojlantirishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Spill}[spɪl] - to'kib yubormoq. Butun dunyoga mashhur rejissyor Stiven {p:SPIL}bergning shonli faoliyati u boshqa bir mashhur rejissyorning ustiga kofe {h:to’kib yuborganidan} so’ng boshlangan ekan. Bundan so’ng ikkalavi tanishib qolgan va Stiven ustozidan ko’p narsa o’rgangan.
examples: {r:Don't spill the water on the desk.} - Stol ustiga suvni to'kib yubormang.
{r:He occasionally spills the coffee.} - U har zamonda qahvani to'kib qo'yadi.
{r:Be careful not to spill the milk.} - Sutni to'kib yubormaslik uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.
{r:She saw him spill the tea.} - U uning choyni to'kib yuborganini ko'rdi.

text: {r:Agree}[əˈɡriː] - rozi bo'lmoq, kelishmoq, kimningdir fikriga qo’shilmoq. Egrivoy va to’g’rivoy haqidagi ertakni eshitgansiz. Bolalikda {p:Egri}voy yomon bo’lmagan, u Tog’rivoyning yaqin do’sti bo’lgan. Lekin bir kun yetishmovchilik tufayli yomon bolalarning o’g’rilik qilish taklifiga {h:rozi bo’lgan} va o’shandan beri egri hayot kechiradi.
examples: {r:I agree with your plan.} - Men sizning rejangizga roziman.
{r:They did not agree to the offer.} - Ular taklifga rozi bo'lishmadi.
{r:Julia agreed to give me some cash tonight.} - Julia bugun tunda ozgina naqd pul berishga rozi bo'ldi.
{r:Do you agree with the new idea?} - Yangi g'oyaga qo'shilasizmi?

text: {r:Space}[speɪs] - bo'sh joy; kosmos.
examples: {r:There is enough space for everyone.} - Bu yerda hamma uchun yetarli joy bor.
{r:He looked at the stars in space.} - U koinotdagi yulduzlarga qaradi.
{r:We need more space for the table.} - Bizga stol uchun ko'proq joy kerak.
{r:The car needs space to park.} - Mashinani qo'yish uchun joy kerak.

text: {r:Desk}[dɛsk] - parta, yozuv stoli. Siz bu vaziyatda o’qimishli yigitning {p:DISK}otekada {h:parta}sida dars qilib o’tirganini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:My book is on the desk.} - Kitobim stol ustida.
{r:He sits at his desk to work.} - U ishlash uchun stoli oldida o'tiradi.
{r:She put her keys on the desk.} - U kalitlarini stol ustiga qo'ydi.
{r:There is a lamp on the desk.} - Stol ustida lampa bor.

text: {r:Ambulance}[ˈæmbjələns] - tez yordam mashinasi.
examples: {r:An ambulance arrived quickly.} - Tez yordam tezda yetib keldi.
{r:We called an ambulance for him.} - Biz unga tez yordam chaqirdik.
{r:The ambulance took her to the hospital.} - Tez yordam uni kasalxonaga olib ketdi.
{r:I heard the ambulance outside.} - Men tashqaridan tez yordam ovozini eshitdim.

text: {r:First}[fɜːrst] – birinchi. Shaharda avtobus qolmaganligi sababli {h:birinchi} marta {p:FUR}a{p: ST}adionga kirib keldi va futbolchilarni olib keldi.
examples: {r:He was the first to finish.} - U birinchi bo'lib tugatdi.
{r:This is my first time to go there.} - U yerga birinchi borishim.
{r:She finished first in the race.} - U poygada birinchi bo'lib tugatdi.
{r:The first lesson is easy.} - Birinchi dars oson.

text: {r:Trouble}[ˈtrʌbəl] - muammo, tashvish; muammo qilmoq, tashvishga qo’ymoq. Mening {p:TRA}ktorim {p:BOL}ti tushib qolibdi. U boltni hozir hech qayerdan topolmayman. Bitta shu boltni deb hozir ishim to’xtab qolgan. Bitta shu bolt {h:muammo} bo’lyapti hozir.
examples: {r:I rushed to help when my countrymen were in trouble.} - Vatandoshlarim tashvishda bo'lganida men yordamga shoshildim.
{r:He had some trouble with his car.} - Uning mashinasida biroz muammo bor edi.
{r:Don't cause any trouble.} - Hech qanday muammo tug'dirmang.
{r:I can see troubles in their relations.} - Ularning munosabatida muammolarni ko'ryapman.

text: {r:Map}[mæp] - xarita. map – xarita. Bu vaziyatda {p:Map}tun ismli qizni dunyo {h:xaritasi} tushirilgan futbolka kiyib olganini tasavvur qilamiz.
examples: {r:I need a map to find the way.} - Yo'lni topish uchun menga xarita kerak.
{r:He looked at the map carefully.} - U xaritaga diqqat bilan qaradi.
{r:Can you show me on the map?} - Menga xaritada ko'rsata olasizmi?
{r:This map shows the population and the flag of every country.} - Bu xarita har bir davlatning aholisi va bayrog'ini ko'rsatadi.

text: {r:Bill}[bɪl] - hisob, to'lov qog'ozi. Tasavvur qiling tanishingiz {p:BIL}ol har doim sizga qandaydir {h:to'lov qog'oz}lari olib keladi.
examples: {r:Can I have the bill, please?} - Hisobni bera olasizmi, iltimos?
{r:He paid the bill for dinner.} - U kechki ovqat uchun hisobni to'ladi.
{r:The bill was very high.} - Hisob juda yuqori edi.
{r:She forgot to pay the bill.} - U hisobni to'lashni unutdi.

text: {r:Able}[ˈeɪbəl] - imkoniyatga ega, qobiliyatiga ega(qila olmoq deb ham tarjima qilinadi). Men tushkunlikka tushganimda, dadam har doim ‘’{p:ey bil} sen imkon va qobiliyatlaringni va tushkunlikka tushma’’ der edilar.
examples: {r:I am able to help you.} - Men sizga yordam bera olaman.
{r:She was able to finish the work.} - U ishni tugata oldi.
{r:Will you be able to come?} - Kela olasizmi?
{r:He is not able to carry it.} - U buni tashiy olmaydi.

text: {r:Doubt}[daʊt] - shubha; shubha qilmoq. Siz o’z kuchingiz va qobiliyatingizga ishonasiz, sizning atrofingizdagi barcha sizga ishonadi. Faqat sizning qobiliyatingizga {p:DAUD} {h:shubha qiladi.}
examples: {r:I fully doubt your relatives.} - Men sening qarindoshlaringga butunlay shubha qilaman.
{r:He felt a little doubt.} - U biroz shubha his qildi.
{r:There is no doubt in my mind.} - Mening xayolimda hech qanday shubha yo'q.
{r:Julia began to doubt her husband's words.} - Julia uning so'zlariga shubha qila boshladi.

text: {r:Profitable}[ˈprɒfɪtəbəl] - foydali(ya'ni daromadli).
examples: {r:It was a very profitable business.} - Bu juda foydali biznes edi.
{r:The new idea was hardly profitable.} - Yangi g'oya deyarli foydali emas edi.
{r:He hopes for a profitable year.} - U daromadli yil bo'lishini umid qiladi.
{r:This work is profitable for us.} - Bu ish biz uchun foydali.

text: {r:Confidence}[ˈkɒnfɪdəns] - o'ziga ishonch. Confident(o'ziga ishongan) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She has much confidence in her team.} - Uning jamoasiga katta ishonchi bor.
{r:This writer writes with great confidence.} - Bu yozuvchi katta ishonch bilan yozadi.
{r:I have confidence in your work.} - Mening ishingizga ishonchim bor.
{r:The team gained confidence to play.} - Jamoa o'ynashga ishonch hosil qildi.
{r:My employer has no confidence and she always yells at workers.} - Mening ish beruvchimning o'ziga ishonchi yo'q va u har doim ishchilarga baqiradi.

text: {r:Direction}[daɪˈrɛkʃən] - yo'nalish.
examples: {r:Which direction should we go?} - Qaysi yo'nalishga borishimiz kerak?
{r:He pointed in the right direction.} - U to'g'ri yo'nalishni ko'rsatdi.
{r:The wind changed direction.} - Shamol yo'nalishini o'zgartirdi.
{r:Follow the direction on the map.} - Xaritadagi yo'nalishga amal qiling.

text: {r:Usual}[ˈjuːʒuəl] - odatiy. usual – odatiy, har doimgi. Afrikadagi mana bu qabila vilkalarni juda yoqtiradi. Har bir qabila azosi {p:YUZ}iga {p:VIL}ka yopishtirib yuradi {h:odatda}.
examples: {r:This is my usual way to go home.} - Bu mening uyga boradigan odatiy yo'lim.
{r:He came at his usual time.} - U odatiy vaqtida keldi.
{r:It's not usual to see him here.} - Uni bu yerda ko'rish odatiy emas.
{r:She took her usual seat.} - U odatiy joyiga o'tirdi.

text: {r:Speaker}[ˈspiːkər] - ma'ruzachi, so'zlovchi.
examples: {r:The speaker talked loudly.} - Ma'ruzachi baland ovozda gapirdi.
{r:She is a good speaker.} - U yaxshi ma'ruzachi.
{r:There are 40 million speakers of Uzbek.} - 40 million o'zbek tili so'zlashuvchilari bor.
{r:You are a good speaker of English.} - Siz yaxshi ingliz tili so'zlashuvchisiz.

text: {r:Second}[ˈsɛkənd] - ikkinchi; sekund, soniya.
examples: {r:Wait just a second.} - Bir soniya kuting.
{r:This is the second corner of the room.} - Bu xonaning ikkinchi burchagi.
{r:He won the second place.} - U ikkinchi o'rinni oldi.
{r:I need a second to think.} - O'ylashimga bir soniya kerak.

text: {r:Suspicion}[səˈspɪʃn] - shubha. Suspect(shubha qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:His behavior caused suspicion.} - Uning xulqi shubha uyg'otdi.
{r:I have a strong suspicion about this.} - Bu haqida kuchli shubham bor.
{r:There was no suspicion in her voice.} - Uning ovozida shubha yo'q edi.
{r:The police worked on the suspicion.} - Politsiya shubha ustida ishladi.
{r:The translator behaved with suspicion.} - Tarjimon shubhali o'zini tutdi.

text: {r:Strike}[straɪk] – urmoq; ish tashlash. Kontr {p:strayk} o’yini hamma o’g’il bolalar biladi. Ushbu o’yindagi strike so’zi 'urmoq', 'hujum qilmoq' ma'nolarini bildiradi.
examples: {r:The workers decided to go on strike.} - Ishchilar ish tashlashga qaror qilishdi.
{r:The clock will strike at six.} - Soat oltida uradi.
{r:Do not strike the table.} - Stolga urmang.
{r:He wanted to strike the ball hard.} - U to'pni qattiq urishni xohladi.

text: {r:Sea}[siː] - dengiz. Boshingizni sirka bosib ketgan bo'lsa {h:dengiz}ga borib cho'miling {h:si}rkalardan bir zumda halos bo'lasiz.
examples: {r:We went to the sea last summer.} - O'tgan yozda dengizga bordik.
{r:My wallet fell to the sea.} - Mening hamyonim dengizda tushib qoldi.
{r:They love to go on a trip to the sea.} - Ular dengizga sayohat qilishni yaxshi ko'radilar.
{r:Spending time at sea is never boring.} - Dengizda vaqt o'tqazish hech qachon zerikarli emas.

text: {r:Sailing}[ˈseɪlɪŋ] - yelkanli qayiqda suzish, yelkanli sport, yoki shunchaki suzib yurish. U odatda yelkanli kemalarda yoki qayiqlarda suvda harakatlanishni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:He often goes sailing in the summer.} - U yozda tez-tez yelkanli qayiqda suzishga boradi.
{r:Do you like sailing?} - Yelkanli qayiqda suzishni yoqtirasizmi?
{r:They went sailing on the big lake.} - Ular katta ko'lda yelkanli qayiqda suzishdi.
{r:Sailing is a good sport.} - Yelkanli qayiqda suzish yaxshi sport.

text: {r:Jogging}[ˈdʒɒɡɪŋ] - yugurish (sog'liq uchun, poyga yoki shoshgandagi yugurish emas).
examples: {r:She occasionally goes jogging.} - U har-har zamonda yugurishga boradi.
{r:Do you want to go jogging with me?} - Men bilan yugurishga borishni xohlaysizmi?
{r:He went jogging after work.} - U ishdan keyin yugurishga bordi.
{r:Jogging helps to keep you healthy.} - Yugurish sizni sog'lom saqlashga yordam beradi.

text: {r:Cruise}[kruːz] - Kruiz so‘zi dengiz yoki daryo orqali sayohat qilishni anglatadi. Bu atama ko‘pincha sayyohlik maqsadida tashkil etilgan kemadagi safarlarni ifodalaydi.
examples: {r:They want to go on a cruise on independence day.} - Ular mustaqillik kuni kruizga borishni xohlashadi.
{r:We will go on a long cruise next year.} - Kelgusi yili uzoq kruizga boramiz.
{r:A cruise at sea is nice.} - Dengizda kruiz qilish yaxshi.
{r:She went on a cruise with her family.} - U oilasi bilan kruizga bordi.

text: {r:Boat}[boʊt] - qayiq. Tasavvur qiling siz yangi {h:qayiq} sotib oldingiz va uning yon qismiga 'Ishlar zo'r {p:BO'VOTti}' deb yozdirdingiz.
examples: {r:He has a small boat.} - Uning kichik qayig'i bor.
{r:Let's go on the boat.} - Keling, qayiqqa chiqamiz.
{r:They went fishing by boat.} - Ular qayiqda baliq ovlashga borishdi.
{r:The boat was in the water.} - Qayiq suvda edi.

text: {r:Regular}[ˈrɛɡjələr] – muntazam. {p:Reg}istonda {p:Yul}duz {h:muntazam} konsert beradi va Samarqand ahlini xursand qiladi.
examples: {r:He has regular work.} - Uning muntazam ishi bor.
{r:She goes to the park on a regular basis.} - U parkga muntazam ravishda boradi.
{r:This is a regular customer.} - Bu doimiy mijoz.
{r:We need regular breaks.} - Bizga muntazam tanaffuslar kerak.

text: {r:Afford}[əˈfɔːrd] – qurbi yetmoq, nimadir uchun puli bo’lmoq. Afandi bir kuni ot sotib olgani bozorga boribdi.Ot sotib olish o’rniga latifa aytib kulgan odamga pul tarqateveribdi. Qolgan pulini hisoblab ko’rsa {p:AF}andi {p:O’RD}ak sotib olishga {h:qurbi yetar} ekan xolos.
examples: {r:I cannot afford a new car.} - Men yangi mashina sotib ola olmayman.
{r:Can you afford to go on a trip?} - Sayohatga borishga pulingiz yetadimi?
{r:They could not afford the high cost.} - Ular yuqori narxga qurbi yetmadi.
{r:She wants to buy a house, but she cannot afford it.} - U uy sotib olmoqchi, lekin unga puli yetmaydi.

text: {r:Confuse}[kənˈfjuːz] – chalkashtirmoq, adashtirmoq. Xotinimning oldiga borsam {p:KANF}et {p:YUZ}iga qo’yib olibdi. Men konfetni maskaga {h:adashtiribman.} U rosa irimchida konfetni yuziga qo’yib olsa shirin qiz bo’laman deb o’ylarkan.
examples: {r:The new rules may confuse people.} - Yangi qoidalar odamlarni chalkashtirishi mumkin.
{r:Do not confuse these two words.} - Bu ikki so'zni adashtirmang.
{r:His words started to confuse me.} - Uning so'zlari meni chalkashtira boshladi.
{r:It is easy to confuse them.} - Ularni chalkashtirish oson.

text: {r:Suggestion}[səˈdʒɛstʃən] - taklif. Suggest(taklif qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I have a suggestion for the party.} - Mening bazm uchun taklifim bor.
{r:Fortunately her suggestion was very good.} - Yaxshiyamki uning taklifi ajoyib edi.
{r:Do you have any suggestions?} - Qandaydir takliflaringiz bormi?
{r:We discussed his suggestion.} - Biz uning taklifini muhokama qildik.

text: {r:Continuously}[kənˈtɪnjuəsli] - davomiy, davomli. Continuous(davomli) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:It rained continuously all day.} - Butun kun davomida uzluksiz yomg'ir yog'di.
{r:He worked continuously for many hours.} - U ko'p soat davomida uzluksiz ishladi.
{r:The noise went on continuously.} - Shovqin davomiy bo'ldi.
{r:She watched the movie continuously.} - U filmni uzluksiz tomosha qildi.

text: {r:Refusal}[rɪˈfjuːzl] - bosh tortish, rad etish. Refuse(rad etmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:His refusal surprised us.} - Uning rad etishi bizni hayratda qoldirdi.
{r:We received a refusal from the bank.} - Biz bankdan rad javobini oldik.
{r:Her refusal was polite.} - Uning rad etishi xushmuomala edi.
{r:The team faced a refusal to help.} - Jamoaga yordam berishdan bosh tortishdi.

text: {r:Deny}[dɪˈnaɪ] – inkor qilmoq. Tasavvur qiling dinay sokini stakanga quydingiz u yerdan loyqa sok chiqib kelyapti. Siz kompaniyani befarqlikda aybladingiz. {p:DINAY} esa ayblovlarni ‘{h:inkor qildi}’.
examples: {r:He denied knowing about the problem.} - U muammo haqida bilishini inkor qildi.
{r:It was hard to persuade him, because he continued to deny everything.} - Uni ishontirish qiyin edi, chunki u hamma narsani inkor etishda davom etdi.
{r:They denied their mistake.} - Ular o'z aybini inkor qilishdi.
{r:Do not deny the truth.} - Haqiqatni inkor qilmang.

text: {r:Expectation}[ˌɛkspɛkˈteɪʃn] - kutilma, kutilayotgan natija. Expect(kutmoq) so'zidan olingan.
examples: {r:The results were above my expectation.} - Natijalar mening kutganimdan yuqori edi.
{r:We have high expectations for him.} - Biz undan yuqori natijalar kutamiz.
{r:Her expectation was to win.} - Uning kutgan natijasi g'alaba edi.
{r:It did not meet our expectation.} - Bu bizning kutganimizni oqlamadi.
{r:What is your expectation of potato yield?} - Kartoshkadan qancha hosil kutyapsiz?

text: {r:Persuasion}[pərˈsweɪʒn] - ko'ndirish. Persuade(ko'ndirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It took much persuasion to help him.} - Unga yordam berishga ko'ndirish uchun ko'p kuch kerak bo'ldi.
{r:She used soft persuasion.} - U muloyim ko'ndirishdan foydalandi.
{r:His words were full of persuasion.} - Uning so'zlari ko'ndirishga to'la edi.
{r:The art of persuasion is important.} - Ko'ndirish san'ati muhim.

text: {r:Tradition}[trəˈdɪʃn] - qadriyat, traditsiya.
examples: {r:We keep our family tradition.} - Biz oilaviy an'anamizni saqlaymiz.
{r:This is an old tradition.} - Bu eski an'ana.
{r:They follow the tradition.} - Ular an'anaga amal qilishadi.
{r:Every country has its own tradition.} - Har bir mamlakatning o'z an'anasi bor.

text: {r:Respectful}[rɪˈspɛktfəl] - hurmat qiluvchi, hurmatli. Respect(hurmat qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Be respectful to your elders.} - Kattalarga hurmatli bo'ling.
{r:He was very respectful.} - U juda hurmatli edi.
{r:She showed a respectful attitude.} - U hurmatli munosabatni ko'rsatdi.
{r:They are respectful of others.} - Ular boshqalarni hurmat qiladilar.

text: {r:Trust}[trʌst] – ishonmoq; ishonch. O’zbekistondagi eng {h:ishonchli} bank bu {p:TRAST}bank. Kreditlari 0% daligi bilan boshqa barcha banklardan ishonchli va foydali.
examples: {r:I trust you to do the work.} - Ishni qilishingizga ishonaman.
{r:She has my trust.} - Unda mening ishonchim bor(ya'ni men unga ishonaman).
{r:We built trust over time.} - Biz vaqt o'tishi bilan ishonch qurdik.
{r:It is hard to trust him.} - Unga ishonish qiyin.

text: {r:Third}[θɜːrd] - uchinchi. Akam bugun un sotvopti. Un bo’laklari katta katta. Keyin bilsam bu {h:uchinchi} {p:sort} un ekan.
examples: {r:This is my third try.} - Bu mening uchinchi urinishim.
{r:She got the third place.} - U uchinchi o'rinni oldi.
{r:The third chapter is long.} - Kitobning uchinchi bobi uzun.
{r:He is the third person to arrive.} - U kelgan uchinchi shaxs.

text: {r:Receive}[rɪˈsiːv] – qabul qilmoq. Bugun doktor ‘’Dorilarni {p:retsep} bo’yicha {h:qabul qiling}’’ dedi.
examples: {r:I took/received expensive petrol from my friend.} - Men do'stimdan qimmat benzin oldim.
{r:Finally she received an award for good work.} - Nihoyat u yaxshi ishi uchun mukofot oldi.
{r:The following messages have been received from Alex.} - Quyidagi xabarlar Aleksdan qabul qilingan.
{r:They received a suspicious gift from Alex.} - Ular Aleksdan shubhali sovg'a oldilar.

text: {r:Congratulate}[kənˈɡrætʃuleɪt] - tabriklamoq, qutlamoq.
examples: {r:I congratulated him on his success.} - Men uni muvaffaqiyati bilan tabrikladim.
{r:She congratulated her friend on the new job.} - U do'stini yangi ishi bilan tabrikladi.
{r:We congratulated the team on their win.} - Biz jamoani g'alaba bilan tabrikladik.
{r:Anvar will congratulate them.} - Anvar ularni tabriklaydi.

text: {r:Shut}[ʃʌt] – yopmoq. Sizning ko’plab ishlarni bajaruvchi mo’jizakor {p:SHAT}agingiz bor. Bitta otsangiz jo’mrakni {h:yopib} qo’yadi. Shatak ba'zi shevalarda oyoq kiyimni bildiradi.
examples: {r:Please shut the door.} - Iltimos, eshikni yoping.
{r:He shut the window because it was cold.} - U sovuq bo'lgani uchun derazani yopdi.
{r:The shop shuts at six.} - Do'kon oltida yopiladi.
{r:She shut her eyes to sleep.} - U uxlash uchun ko'zlarini yumdi.

text: {r:Stupid}[ˈstuːpɪd] – ahmoq, tentak. Studentlar orasida haqiqatdan ochlik bor. Studentning boshiga tushgan pit ham uning boshidan yetarli ozuqa moddalarni ololmaydi. {p:STU}dentning {p:PIT}i ham oxiri {h:tentak} bo’lib qoladi bu vaziyatda.
examples: {r:That was a stupid mistake.} - Bu ahmoqona xato edi.
{r:He felt stupid for forgetting.} - U unutgani uchun ahmoq his qildi.
{r:Don't make a stupid decision.} - Ahmoqona qaror qilmang.
{r:It is a stupid idea.} - Bu ahmoqona g'oya.

text: {r:Mistake}[mɪˈsteɪk] – xato. Ko’zoynagimni topolmay kecha bir {h:xato} qilib qo’ydim. {p:MISDEK} tovlangan metallni qimmat pulga sotib olibman, keyin tekshirsam bo’yalgan temir ekan.
examples: {r:I made a mistake in my work.} - Men ishimda xato qildim.
{r:She said sorry for her mistake.} - U xatosi uchun uzr so'radi.
{r:I hope he will realize his mistake and apologize.} - Umid qilamanki, u xatosini tushunadi va uzr so'raydi.
{r:He fixed the mistake.} - U xatoni tuzatdi.

text: {r:Recognize}[ˈrɛkəɡnaɪz] – tanimoq. Universitetdan haydab yuborilgan yigit bir necha yildan so’ng o’sha universitet rektorini qishlog’ida ko’rib {h:tanibdi} va jahl ustida {p:REKTORG}a {p:NAYZ}a bilan hujum qilibdi, xayriyatki odamlar uni to’xtatib qolibdi.
examples: {r:I didn't recognize him at first.} - Men uni dastlab tanimadim.
{r:She recognized the song.} - U qo'shiqni tanidi.
{r:They recognized her skill.} - Ular uning mahoratini tan oldilar.
{r:Can you recognize this place?} - Bu joyni taniy olasizmi?

text: {r:Message}[ˈmɛsɪdʒ] - xabar, sms. Har kuni kechki payt telfonimga {h:sms} keladi 'Bugun saunamizda {p:MASSAJ} olishni xohlaysizmi?' degan.
examples: {r:I sent him a message yesterday.} - Men unga kecha xabar yubordim.
{r:Did you get my message?} - Siz mening xabarimni oldingizmi?
{r:He left a message on my phone.} - U mening telefonimga xabar qoldirdi.
{r:He sent a message to inform us about the meeting time.} - U uchrashuv vaqti haqida bizga xabar berish uchun xabar yubordi.

text: {r:Pillow}[ˈpɪloʊ] – yostiq. Tasavvur qiling yostig’ni ichiga solish uchun paxta va boshqa materiallar qolmabdi. Siz esa oxiri bugun tayyorlangan {p:PALOV}ni {h:yostiq} ichiga solib yubordingiz.
examples: {r:She put her head on the pillow.} - U boshini yostiqqa qo'ydi.
{r:The pillow was soft.} - Yostiq yumshoq edi.
{r:My father bought a new pillow.} - Mening otam yangi yostiq sotib oldi.
{r:His pillow felt good.} - Uning yostig'i yaxshi edi.

text: {r:Appear}[əˈpɪər] – paydo bo’lmoq, ko'rinmoq. Yangiliklarda aytilishicha shu yil {p:EP}lning {p:PIR}amida shaklidagi telefonlari {h:paydo bo’ladi}.
examples: {r:The sun appeared in the sky.} - Quyosh osmonda paydo bo'ldi.
{r:Our teacher appeared on TV.} - Bizning o'qituvchimiz televizorda ko'rinish berdi.
{r:He appeared to be tired.} - U charchagan ko'rinardi.
{r:The problem appeared suddenly.} - Muammo to'satdan paydo bo'ldi.

text: {r:Accuse}[əˈkjuːz] – ayblamoq. {p:Ak}mal {p:yuz} dollarlik pulga o’zining rasmini bosibdi. Lekin bu pulni hech kim qabul qilmapti va uni {h:ayblashibdi.} Akmal esa bu pul o’zini xursand qilish uchunligini aytdi.
examples: {r:She accused her husband of lying.} - U erini yolg'on gapirganlikda aybladi.
{r:He was accused of stealing.} - U o'g'irlikda ayblangan.
{r:They accused the company.} - Ular kompaniyani aybladi.
{r:Don't accuse me without proof.} - Dalilsiz meni ayblama.

text: {r:Bother}[ˈbɒðər] – bezovta qilmoq, tashvishlantirmoq. Bir kuni afandi bozorga eshakda kelib sartaroshning oldiga kirib ketibdi va qaytib chiqsa eshagi yo’qmish. ‘Yaramas, ablahlar eshagimni topib bering. Bo’lmasa otam qilgan ishni qilaman’ deb juda qattiq baqiribdi va butub {p:BOZOR}ni {h:bezovta qilibdi.} Bu safar afandining eshagi topilmabdi.
examples: {r:Don't bother me now.} - Hozir meni bezovta qilmang.
{r:She didn't want to bother her husband.} - U erini bezovta qilishni xohlamadi.
{r:Does the noise bother you?} - Shovqin sizni bezovta qiladimi?
{r:I was bothered yesterday.} - Kecha meni bezovta qilishdi.

text: {r:Succeed}[səkˈsiːd] – muvaffaqiyat qozonmoq, erishmoq. Sid bolaligidan saksofon chalishni orzu qilgan. Lekin saksofon darslarida Sid bir necha yillar davomida past ball olib chalishni uzoq yillar o’rgana olmadi. Mehnat baribir o’z mevasini beradi, bir necha yillardan so’ng {p:SAKS}ofon {p:SID}ning haqiqiy muhabbatiga aylandi va hozir u {h:muvaffaqiyatli} va mohirona musiqalar ijro etmoqda.
examples: {r:She worked hard to succeed.} - U muvaffaqiyat qozonish uchun qattiq ishladi.
{r:He succeeded in his plan.} - U rejasida muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
{r:Our team succeeded in the game.} - Bizning jamoamiz o'yinda muvaffaqiyat qozondi.
{r:You must try to succeed in removing hunger in the country.} - Mamlakatda ochlikni yo'qotishda muvaffaqiyatga erishishga harakat qilishingiz kerak.

text: {r:Forgetful}[fərˈɡɛtfəl] - unutuvchan. Forget(unutmoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 10 - darsdagi forget ga qarang
examples: {r:Anvar is getting forgetful.} - Anvar unutuvchan bo'lib qolmoqda.
{r:My grandmother is forgetful.} - Mening buvim unutuvchan.
{r:Don't get forgetful about the meeting.} - Yig'ilish haqida unutuvchan bo'lma.
{r:She is a little forgetful.} - U biroz unutuvchan.

text: {r:Girlfriend}[ˈɡɜːrlfrɛnd] - qiz do'sti. Girl(qiz) va friend(do'st) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He went to the cinema with his girlfriend.} - U kinoga qiz do'sti bilan bordi.
{r:My brother has a new girlfriend.} - Mening akamning yangi qiz do'sti bor.
{r:Julia used to be his favorite girlfriend.} - Julia uning sevimli qiz do'sti.
{r:They went for a walk with their girlfriends.} - Ular qiz do'stlari bilan sayrga chiqishdi.

text: {r:Development}[dɪˈvɛləpmənt] - rivojlanish. Develop(rivojlanmoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:The development of our country is good.} - Bizning mamlakatimizning rivojlanishi yaxshi.
{r:She works on the development of new ideas.} - U yangi g'oyalarni rivojlantirish ustida ishlaydi.
{r:This new development will bring jobs.} - Bu yangi rivojlanish ish o'rinlarini olib keladi.
{r:The child's development was too fast.} - Bolaning rivojlanishi o'ta tez edi.

text: {r:Agreement}[əˈɡriːmənt] - kelishuv, rozilik. Agree so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:They got an agreement.} - Ular kelishuvga erishdilar.
{r:The agreement was good.} - Kelishuv yaxshi edi.
{r:My friend showed agreement.} - Mening do'stim rozi bo'ldi.
{r:We reached an agreement.} - Biz kelishuvga erishdik.

text: {r:Doubtful}[ˈdaʊtfəl] - shubhali, shubhaga ega(insonga nisbatan). Doubt(shubha qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I'm doubtful about his plan.} - Men uning rejasiga shubha bilan qarayman.
{r:The result still seems doubtful.} - Natija hali ham shubhali ko'rinyapti.
{r:She looked doubtful.} - U shubhali ko'rindi.
{r:It was a doubtful situation.} - Bu shubhali vaziyat edi.

text: {r:Local}[ˈloʊkl] - lokal, mahalliy.
examples: {r:We visited the local shop.} - Biz mahalliy do'konga tashrif buyurdik.
{r:She's a local person.} - U mahalliy inson.
{r:The translator knows the local language.} - Tarjimon mahalliy tilni biladi.
{r:Our family knows the local traditions.} - Bizning oilamiz mahalliy an'analarni biladi.

text: {r:Neighbor}[ˈneɪbər] – qo’shni. Hamma qo’shnilarimning {p:NAYI BOR}. Hattoki mana bu 1 yoshli chaqaloq {h:qo’shnimning} ham.
examples: {r:My neighbor is kind and attentive.} - Mening qo'shnim mehribon va e'tiborli.
{r:She invited her neighbor to the party.} - U qo'shnisini bazmga taklif qildi.
{r:The neighbor's dog barks loudly and that makes me angry.} - Qo'shnining iti baland ovozda akillaydi va bu mening jahlimni chiqaryapti.
{r:Our neighbor pays attention to the cleanliness of the mahalla.} - Bizning qo'shnimiz mahalla ozodaligiga e'tibor beradi.

text: {r:Boom}[buːm] – juda tez o’sish, rivojlanish; tez o’smoq, rivojlanmoq. Toshkent shahrida jamoat tualetlari yoppasiga qurilishi bilan {p:BUM}aga biznesi keskin {h:rivojlandi.}
examples: {r:The economy has had a boom this year.} - Iqtisodiyot bu yil katta rivojlanishga ega bo'ldi.
{r:The boom in housing was surprising.} - Uy-joy qurilishidagi tez o'sish hayratlanarli edi.
{r:We used to see a boom in sales every summer.} - Biz har yozda savdolarda tez o'sishni ko'rardik.
{r:The sudden boom in the market was good for business.} - Bozordagi to'satdan tez o'sish biznes uchun yaxshi edi.

text: {r:Sympathy}[ˈsɪmpəθi] - xayrixohlik, simpatiya.
examples: {r:She showed great sympathy for her friend.} - U do'stiga katta xayrixohlik ko'rsatdi.
{r:I must show sympathy to the family.} - Men oilaga xayrixohlik ko'rsatishim kerak.
{r:He had felt a lot of sympathy for the lost dog.} - U yo'qolgan itga katta xayrixohlik his qilgan edi.
{r:Your sympathy helps him feel better.} - Sizning simpatiyangiz unga o'zini yaxshi his qilishga yordam beradi.

text: {r:Fair}[fɛr] – adolatli, xolis. Siz bu o’rinda o’zingiz taniydigan har qanday Feruz yoki Feruzani adolatli va xolis inson sifatida tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:The game was fair to everyone.} - O'yin hamma uchun adolatli edi.
{r:She should be fair in her work.} - U o'z ishida adolatli bo'lishi kerak.
{r:It was not fair to blame him.} - Uni ayblash adolatli emas edi.
{r:We want a fair decision.} - Biz adolatli qaror istaymiz.

text: {r:General}[ˈdʒɛnərəl] - umumiy. Generalniy uborka iborasi o'zbek tilida ham keng qo'llaniladi. Aynan shu yerda general so'zi umumiy, asosiy ma'nosida kelyapti.
examples: {r:The general idea was good.} - Umumiy g'oya yaxshi edi.
{r:He had to give a general report.} - U umumiy hisobot berishi kerak edi.
{r:The general feeling was positive.} - Umumiy kayfiyat ijobiy edi.
{r:I would like to know the general opinion.} - Men umumiy fikrni bilishni xohlardim.

text: {r:Create}[kriˈeɪt] – yaratmoq. Nike kompaniyasi {p:KRI}shtianoga {p:ET}ik yaratibdi, bu etik bilan bemalol futbol oynasa bo’larkan.
examples: {r:Actually he is creating a new plan now.} - Aslida u hozir yangi reja yaratmoqda.
{r:We must create more jobs.} - Biz ko'proq ish o'rinlari yaratishimiz kerak.
{r:They would like to create a big family.} - Ular katta oila yaratishni xohlashadi.
{r:The artist used to create beautiful pictures.} - Rassom chiroyli rasmlar yaratardi.

text: {r:Example}[ɪɡˈzæmpl] - namuna, misol, ekzamplyar.
examples: {r:Can you give me an example?} - Menga bir misol keltira olasizmi?
{r:She has given a good example for others.} - U boshqalar uchun yaxshi namuna ko'rsatdi.
{r:You should follow her example.} - Siz uning namunasiga ergashishingiz kerak.
{r:This was an example of hard work.} - Bu qattiq mehnatning bir misoli edi.

text: {r:Hobby}[ˈhɒbi] - hobbi, sevimli mashg'ulot.
examples: {r:My hobby is reading books.} - Mening hobbim kitob o'qish.
{r:He used to have many hobbies.} - Uning ko'plab hobbilari bor edi.
{r:What is his hobby?} - Uning hobbisi nima?
{r:Her main hobby is painting.} - Uning asosiy hobbisi rasm chizishdir.

text: {r:Toy}[tɔɪ] – o’yinchiq. Tasavvur qiling farzandingiz yoki jiyaningiz faqat {p:TOY}choq {h:o’yinchoq}larini o’ynaydi. Boshqa o’yinchoqlarga qaramaydi.
examples: {r:The child was playing with a toy car.} - Bola o'yinchoq mashinacha bilan o'ynardi.
{r:I will do my best to make a toy from this wood.} - Mana shu yog'ochdan o'yinchoq yasash uchun qo'limdan kelguncha harakat qilaman.
{r:My little sister has many toys.} - Mening singlimning ko'plab o'yinchoqlari bor.
{r:He used to collect old toys.} - U eski o'yinchoqlar yig'ardi.

text: {r:Housework}[ˈhaʊswɜːrk] - uy ishlari. House(uy) va work(ish) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She has to do a lot of housework.} - U ko'p uy ishlarini qilishi kerak.
{r:I was doing housework all morning.} - Men butun ertalab uy ishlari qilayotgan edim.
{r:You should help with the housework.} - Siz uy ishlariga yordam berishingiz kerak.
{r:He used to hate doing housework.} - U uy ishlarini qilishni yomon ko'rardi.

text: {r:Especially}[ɪˈspɛʃəli] - ayniqsa.
examples: {r:I like fruits, especially apples.} - Men mevalarni, ayniqsa olmani yoqtiraman.
{r:She is especially good at English.} - U ayniqsa ingliz tilida yaxshi.
{r:The weather was nice, especially in the evening.} - Havo yaxshi edi, ayniqsa kechqurun.
{r:I especially hate making mistakes.} - Men ayniqsa xato qilishni yomon ko'raman.

text: {r:Engine}[ˈɛndʒɪn] – motor. Kitoblardagi barcha jinlar uchar gilamda uchishadi, mana bu {p:Anjon}lik jin esa {h:motor}ning ustida uchadi.
examples: {r:The car's engine has stopped working.} - Mashinaning motori ishlamay qoldi.
{r:The engineer must check the engine.} - Muhandis motorni tekshirishi kerak.
{r:I will do my best to fix the engine.} - Motorni tuzatish uchun qo'limdan kelguncha harakat qilaman.
{r:The old engine used to make a lot of noise.} - Eski motor juda ko'p shovqin chiqarardi.

text: {r:Strange}[streɪndʒ] – g’alati. Hayotimda men qilgan eng {h:g’alati} narsa nima bilasizmi? Menimcha ikki yil oldin ichib olib Bunyodkor {p:ST}adioniga {p:RENJ} roverda kirib borganim. Bu voqea terma jamoa o’yini oldidan yuz bergandi va hammaning hayratiga sabab bo’ldi.
examples: {r:He had a strange look on his face.} - Uning yuzida g'alati ifoda bor edi.
{r:It was strange that she did not call.} - Uning qo'ng'iroq qilmaganligi g'alati edi.
{r:The strange noise was getting louder.} - G'alati shovqin balandlashib borayotgan edi.
{r:I made some strange friends.} - Ba'zi g'alati odamlar bilan do'stlashdim.

text: {r:Worst}[wɜːrst] - eng yomon. Bir kuni boy ota 3 o'g'lini chaqirib 'Bugun uchchalang o'rtangda musobaqa qilamiz va {h:eng yomon} natija qayd etganing {p:VORIS}im bo'ladi' debdi. Uchchalasi poyga o'ynabdi va shunchalik sekin yugurishibdiki toshbaqa ham ulardan o'zib ketgan bo'lardi.
examples: {r:This is the worst day I have ever had.} - Bu men boshimdan kechirgan eng yomon kun.
{r:The worst part was the weather.} - Eng yomon tomoni ob-havo edi.
{r:He is the worst player on the team.} - U jamoadagi eng yomon o'yinchi.
{r:You must avoid the worst mistakes.} - Siz eng yomon xatolardan qochishingiz kerak.

text: {r:Regularly}[ˈrɛɡjələrli] - muntazam. Regular so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:She exercises regularly.} - U muntazam ravishda jismoniy mashqlar qiladi.
{r:He has been visiting his family regularly.} - U oilasiga muntazam tashrif buyurmoqda.
{r:You should study English regularly.} - Siz ingliz tilini muntazam o'rganishingiz kerak.
{r:They used to meet regularly for coffee.} - Ular kofe ichish uchun muntazam uchrashishardi.

text: {r:Confusion}[kənˈfjuːʒn] - chalkashlik, adashish. Confuse(chalkashtirmoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:There was much confusion about the plan.} - Reja bo'yicha ko'p chalkashlik bor edi.
{r:The strange news caused confusion.} - G'alati xabar chalkashlikka sabab bo'ldi.
{r:She was showing confusion in her eyes.} - Uning ko'zlarida chalkashlik bor edi.
{r:We must avoid any confusion.} - Biz har qanday chalkashlikdan qochishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Loser}[ˈluːzər] - mag'lub. Lose(mag'lub bo'lmoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Qiziqarli tomoni {p:LUZR} so'zi bizda ham oxirgi paytlarda ishlatilyapti.
examples: {r:He felt like a loser after the game.} - U o'yindan keyin mag'lub his qildi.
{r:No one likes to be a loser.} - Hech kim mag'lub bo'lishni yoqtirmaydi.
{r:The team was feeling like losers after the loss.} - Jamoa mag'lubiyatdan keyin o'zini mag'lub his qilayotgan edi.
{r:You should not call him a loser.} - Siz uni mag'lub deb chaqirmasligingiz kerak.

text: {r:Discussion}[dɪˈskʌʃn] - muhokama. Discuss(muhokama qilmoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli. Mnemonik namuna uchun 40 - darsdagi discuss ga qarang.
examples: {r:We had a long discussion about the work.} - Biz ishni uzoq muhokama qildik.
{r:The discussion should be fair.} - Muhokama adolatli bo'lishi kerak.
{r:They have been having a discussion all day.} - Ular butun kun muhokama qilishmoqda edi.
{r:Normally I have a long discussion with lawyers.} - Odatda advokatlar bilan juda uzoq muhokamalar qilaman.

text: {r:Income}[ˈɪnkʌm] - daromad. Ha ingliz tilida daromad income bo'ladi va o'zbek tilida 'eng kam' iborasiga o'xshash eshitiladi. Agar kam {h:daromad} ko'rsangiz demak {p:ENG KAM} income sizda ekan.
examples: {r:His income has increased this year.} - Uning daromadi bu yil oshdi.
{r:She gets a good income.} - U yaxshi daromad oladi.
{r:They had to work hard for their income.} - Ular topayotgan daromadlari uchun qattiq ishlashlari kerak edi.
{r:My parents are pleased with my income.} - Ota-onam daromadimdan xursand.
{r:Even with a good income, it's difficult to afford luxury items.} - Yaxshi daromad bilan ham, hashamatli narsalarni sotib olish qiyin.

text: {r:Caring}[ˈkɛərɪŋ] - g'amxor. Care(g'amxorlik qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She is a very caring person.} - U juda g'amxo'r odam.
{r:The nurse was caring for the child.} - Hamshira bolaga g'amxo'rlik qilayotgan edi.
{r:You should be caring to others.} - Siz boshqalarga g'amxo'r bo'lishingiz kerak.
{r:This single woman is very caring.} - Bu yolg'iz ayol juda g'amxo'r.

text: {r:Healthy}[ˈhɛlθi] - sog'lom. Health(sog'liq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She eats a healthy diet.} - U sog'lom ovqatlanadi.
{r:You must try to be healthy.} - Siz sog'lom bo'lishga harakat qilishingiz kerak.
{r:He has been living a healthy life.} - U sog'lom hayot kechirmoqda.
{r:We should all live a healthy life.} - Biz hammamiz sog'lom hayot kechirishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Blame}[bleɪm] – ayblamoq; ayb. Asalarilar {p:BILAYN} kompaniyasini sudga berdilar. Ular Bilaynni mualliflik huquqini o’g’irlashda va asalarilardan beso’roq kompaniyaga beeline(aslida bu so’z 'asalari chizig’i' ma’nosini bildiradi) deb nom berganliklarida {h:ayblashyapti}.
examples: {r:Don’t blame me for your mistake.} - O'z xatong uchun meni ayblama.
{r:She blamed the weather for the delay.} - U kechikish uchun ob-havoni aybladi.
{r:My brother took the blame for the accident.} - Mening akam baxtsiz hodisa uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
