{r:It’s not fair to blame him.} - Uni ayblash adolatsizlik.

text: {r:Consideration}[kənˌsɪdəˈreɪʃn] - ko'rib chiqish, e'tiborga olish. Consider(ko'rib chiqmoq, o'ylab ko'rmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Your opinion deserves consideration.} - Sizning fikringiz e'tiborga loyiq.
{r:Julia took his feelings into consideration.} - Julia uning his-tuyg'ularini e'tiborga oldi.
{r:The plan is under consideration.} - Reja ko'rib chiqilmoqda.
{r:Our teacher showed great consideration for others.} - Bizning o'qituvchimiz boshqalar uchun katta e'tibor ko'rsatdi.

text: {r:Intelligence}[ɪnˈtɛlɪdʒəns] - aql-idrok, intellekt.
examples: {r:She has a high level of intelligence.} - Uning aql-idroki yuqori darajada.
{r:The test measures your intelligence.} - Test sizning aql-idrokingizni o'lchaydi.
{r:John is known for his intelligence.} - John o'z aql-idroki bilan tanilgan.
{r:Artificial intelligence is changing our country.} - Sun'iy intellekt mamlakatimizni o'zgartirmoqda.

text: {r:Strongly}[ˈstrɒŋli] - kuchli. Strong(kuchli) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:I strongly disagree with you.} - Men sizning fikringizga qat'iy qo'shilmayman.
{r:She strongly believes in equality.} - U tenglikka kuchli ishonadi.
{r:His father strongly recommended the book.} - Uning otasi kitobni qat'iy tavsiya qildi.
{r:They strongly support the idea.} - Ular g'oyani kuchli qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

text: {r:Successful}[səkˈsɛsfəl] - muvaffaqiyatli. Success(muvaffaqiyat) so'zining sifat so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:She is a successful businesswoman.} - U muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkor ayol.
{r:The project was very successful.} - Loyiha juda muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.
{r:He feels successful in his career.} - U o'z karyerasida muvaffaqiyatli his qiladi.
{r:A successful result requires hard work.} - Muvaffaqiyatli natija qattiq mehnatni talab qiladi.

text:
{r:Promising}[ˈprɒmɪsɪŋ] - istiqbolli, kelajagi bor. 
Qo'shnim bolasini katta pora bilan universitetga kirgizib qo'ygan edi. O'shanda odamlarga '{p:PORAMIZNING} {h:istiqboli} bor. Sen pora bermasang boshqasi berib hamma joyni egallab olishadi' deb o'z harakatlarini oqlagan edi. Takasaltang o'g'li hech qanday ish qilmayapti hozir.
examples: {r:Perhaps, he is a promising young artist.} - Balki u istiqbolli yosh rassomdir.
{r:The results of the experiment are promising.} - Tajriba natijalari istiqbolli.
{r:Nargiza has a promising future ahead.} - Nargizaning oldinda istiqbolli kelajagi bor.
{r:Our team has a promising start.} - Bizning jamoamiz istiqbolli boshlanishga ega.

text: {r:Talent}[ˈtælənt] - qobiliyat, talant. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:She has a natural talent for singing.} - Uning qo'shiq aytishga tabiiy iste'dodi bor.
{r:He discovered his talent at a young age.} - U o'z iste'dodini yoshligida topdi.
{r:The school encourages students to develop their talents.} - Maktab o'quvchilarni o'z iste'dodlarini rivojlantirishga ruhlantiradi.
{r:My opponent's talent was recognized by many.} - Raqibimning iste'dodi ko'plar tomonidan tan olindi.

text: {r:Cough}[kɒf] - yo'tal; yo'talmoq. Agar {h:yo'tal}ingiz bo'lsa {p:KAF}olat tuzidan namakob qiling va tomog'ingizni chayqang. Ta'sirini tezda sezasiz chunki {p:KAF}olat bu {h:yo'tal}ingiz tuzalishi uchun kafolat.
examples: {r:She has a bad cough.} - Uning kuchli yo'tali bor.
{r:He started to cough during the meeting.} - U yig'ilish paytida yo'talishni boshladi.
{r:The medicine helped with her cough.} - Dori uning yo'taliga yordam berdi.
{r:A continuous cough can be a sign of illness.} - Doimiy yo'tal kasallik belgisi bo'lishi mumkin.

text: {r:Flu}[fluː] - gripp. Bu vaziyatda {p:FLU} so'zi bilan boshlanuvchi juda ko'plab {h:gripp}ga qarshi dori vositalaridan birini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin. Masalan flukonazol, fluoksetin, effekt flu, flutsinar, flutikazon.
examples: {r:He had the flu last week.} - U o'tgan hafta gripp bilan kasallandi.
{r:She stayed home because of the flu.} - U gripp tufayli uyda qoldi.
{r:The flu vaccine is recommended for everyone.} - Gripp vaktsinasi hamma uchun tavsiya etiladi.
{r:My grandfather felt weak after recovering from the flu.} - Mening bobom grippdan tuzalgandan keyin zaif his qildi.

text: {r:Dream}[driːm] - orzu; orzu qilmoq. Suvsiz joyda o'sadigan bo{p:DRING}ni yagona {h:orzusi} hech bo'lmasa ertalabki shudringdan chanqog'ini to'ydirish.
examples: {r:I dream that my toy manufacturing business booms.} - Men o'yinchoq ishlab chiqarish biznesim rivojlanib ketishini orzu qilaman.
{r:She dreams of becoming a doctor.} - U shifokor bo'lishni orzu qiladi.
{r:His dream came true after years of hard work.} - Uning orzusi yillik qattiq mehnatdan keyin ro'yobga chiqdi.
{r:Employing this worker was my dream.} - Bu ishchini ishga olish mening orzuyim edi.

text: {r:Baby}[ˈbeɪbi] - chaqaloq
examples: {r:The baby is sleeping.} - Chaqaloq uxlayapti.
{r:We need more babies to increase our population.} - Aholi sonini oshirish uchun bizga ko'proq chaqaloqlar kerak.
{r:They are expecting a baby next month.} - Ular kelasi oyda chaqaloq kutmoqda.
[center][b]have a baby - farzand ko'rmoq[/b][/center]
{r:She is going to have a baby soon.} – U tez orada chaqaloq tug‘adi.
{r:Did she have a baby?} – U farzand ko‘rdimi?
{r:They had a baby last year.} – Ular o‘tgan yili farzand ko‘rishdi.

text: {r:Nice}[naɪs] – yaxshi, ajoyib. Har kun {h:‘ajoyib’} kayfiyatda yurish uchun nima qilishim kerak ekan deb o’ylanib, oxirida bir qarorga keldim, {p:NAY S}otib olishim kerak va dilni xushnud etuvchi musiqalar chalishim kerak.
examples: {r:She is a very nice person.} - U juda yoqimli odam.
{r:It’s a nice day to go outside.} - Tashqariga chiqish uchun yaxshi kun.
{r:Sardor gave her a nice compliment.} - Sardor unga yoqimli kompliment aytdi.
{r:This cookie tastes nice.} - Bu pechenye ajoyib ekan.

text: {r:Actor}[ˈæktər] - aktyor
examples: {r:John is a famous actor but he has a terrible character.} - Jon mashhur aktyor lekin uning xarakteri rasvo.
{r:It is impossible to hire this actor now because he is expensive.} - Bu aktyorni yollash hozir imkonsiz chunki u qimmat.
{r:She dreams of becoming an actor.} - U aktyor bo'lishni orzu qiladi.
{r:The actor received an award for his role.} - Aktyor o'z roli uchun mukofot oldi.

text: {r:Actress}[ˈæktrəs] - aktrissa
examples: {r:She is a talented actress.} - U iste'dodli aktrisa.
{r:Julia is an actress now and her performance is improving over time.} - Nargiza hozir aktrisa va uning ijrosi vaqt o'tishi bilan yaxshilanyapti.
{r:Ideally we should hire this actress.} - Bu aktrisani yollasak zo'r bo'lardi.
{r:This actress can't concentrate.} - Bu aktrisa diqqatini jamlay olmaydi.

text: {r:Oil}[ɔɪl] – yog’; neft. Yog’lar qimmatlashib ketdi. {p:OIL}amning yaxshi yashashi, to’q yurishi uchun {h:yog’}ning yaxshi narxda bo’lishi muhim.
examples: {r:All countries are dependent on oil.} - Hamma davlatlar neftga qaram.
{r:She cooked the food in olive oil.} - U ovqatni zaytun yog'ida pishirdi.
{r:The country exports a lot of oil.} - Mamlakat ko'p miqdorda neft eksport qiladi.
{r:Decrease your oil consumption.} - Yog' iste'molini kamaytir.

text: {r:Spoon}[spuːn] – qoshiq. Tasavvur qiling bir necha yil qishloqda yashagandan so’ng shaharga ko’chib ketyapsiz. Ketmoningiz shaharda kerak bo’lmasligini bilib {p:SOPINI} pichoq bilan yo’nib yog’och {h:qoshiq}lar tayyorladingiz.
examples: {r:She stirred the soup with a spoon.} - U sho'rvani qoshiq bilan aralashtirdi.
{r:He ate his meal with a spoon.} - U o'z ovqatini qoshiq bilan yedi.
{r:The spoon was made of wood.} - Qoshiq yog'ochdan yasalgan edi.
{r:I use wooden spoon for honey.} - Yog'och qoshiqni asal uchun ishlataman.

text: {r:Punch}[pʌntʃ] – musht zarbasi; musht tushirish, mushtlamoq. Siz yaxshi urusha olish uchun mushtingizni qattiq qilmoqchisiz va shuning uchun shug’ullanishni boshladingiz. Hozircha meshok topolmaganingiz uchun qattiq {p:PANJ}araga {h:musht} bilan urib shug’ullanyapsiz.
examples: {r:I got sick after being punched by the barber.} - Sartaroshdan musht yeganimdan so'ng kasal bo'lib qoldim.
{r:The punch knocked him out.} - Zarba uni nokautga uchratdi.
{r:I promise I will punch you.} - Va'da beraman senga bir musht tushiraman.
{r:The boxer’s punch was powerful.} - Bokschining zarbasi kuchli edi.
{r:His nose started to bleed after the punch.} - Musht tushganidan keyin uning burni qonay boshladi.

text: {r:Support}[səˈpɔːrt] – qo'llab-quvvatlamoq. O’zbekistonda {p:SIPORT} {h:qo'llab-quvvatlanyotgani} Olimpiadadagi natijalarimizdan ko’rinib turibdi. Oxirgi Olimpiadada 8 ta oltin medal.
examples: {r:She is a truly caring nurse, always ready to support her patients.} - U haqiqatdan ham g'amxo'r hamshira, doimo bemorlarini qo'llab-quvvatlashga tayyor.
{r:He supports his family financially.} - U o'z oilasini moliyaviy qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
{r:Our team supports each other.} - Jamoamiz bir-birini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
{r:We support the new policy.} - Biz yangi siyosatni qo'llab-quvvatlaymiz.

text: {r:Tiger}[ˈtaɪɡər] - yo'lbars. Agar rus tilini bilsangiz ruslar yo'lbarsni 'tigr' deydi va bu inglizchadagi 'tiger' bilan deyarli bitta so'z.
examples: {r:The tiger is a powerful animal.} - Yo'lbars kuchli hayvon.
{r:She saw a tiger at the zoo.} - U hayvonot bog'ida yo'lbarsni ko'rdi.
{r:The tiger ate the meat yesterday.} - Yo'lbars kecha go'sht yedi.
{r:My friend drew a picture of a tiger.} - Mening do'stim yo'lbarsning suratini chizdi.

text: {r:Head}[hɛd] – bosh, kalla. Tasavvur qiling sizning ajoyib qobiliyatingiz bor. Siz odamlarni {h:bosh}ini {p:HID}idan taniy olasiz.
examples: {r:She has a headache.} - Uning boshi og'riyapti.
{r:The head is round.} - Bosh dumaloq.
{r:I was repeating these words in my head.} - Men shu so'zlarni kallamda takrorlayotgan edim.
{r:She nodded her head in agreement.} - U boshini rozi bo'lib irg'atti.

text: {r:Apology}[əˈpɒlədʒi] - uzr, kechirim. Apologize(uzr so'ramoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:John offered an apology for his mistake.} - Jon o'z xatosi uchun uzr so'radi.
{r:She accepted John's apology.} - U Jonning uzrini qabul qildi.
{r:The company issued a public apology.} - Kompaniya omma oldida uzr so'radi.
{r:A sincere apology can fix relationships.} - Samimiy uzr so'rash munosabatlarni tiklashga yordam beradi.

text: {r:Salary}[ˈsæləri] – oylik. Tasavvur qiling zapravkada ishlaysiz va sizning {h:oyligingiz}ni {p:SALAR}ka bilan to’lashmoqchi.
examples: {r:She earns a big salary.} - U yuqori maosh oladi.
{r:The salary is paid at the end of the month.} - Maosh oy oxirida to'lanadi.
{r:He negotiated a better salary.} - U yaxshiroq maosh uchun muzokaralar olib bordi.
{r:The salary increase made everyone happy.} - Maoshning oshishi hammani xursand qildi.

text: {r:Ability}[əˈbɪləti] – qobiliyat. Yaqinlashib kelayotgan bayramga {p:E}lektron {p:BILETTI} ko’rsatib Yulduz Usmonovaning konsertiga kirishingiz mumkin va xonandaning {h:qobiliyat}i va ovozidan bahramand bo’ling.
examples: {r:She has the ability to solve difficult problems.} - U murakkab muammolarni hal qilish qobiliyatiga ega.
{r:His ability to learn quickly is amazing.} - Uning tez o'rganish qobiliyati ajoyib.
{r:The job requires good communication abilities.} - Ish yaxshi muloqot qobiliyatlarini talab qiladi.
{r:Martin has an ability to make original cheese.} - Martinning original pishloq tayyorlash qobiliyati bor.
{r:This new software will enable you to work faster.} - Bu yangi dastur tezroq ishlashingizga imkon beradi.

text: {r:Throat}[θroʊt] – tomoq. Agar {h:tomog’}ingiz og’rib qolgan bo’lsa mana bu {p:SIR}li {p:O’T}dan tutatib yuboring bir zumda yaxshi bo’lib ketasiz.
examples: {r:She has a sore throat.} - Uning tomoqi og'riyapti.
{r:He cleared his throat before speaking.} - U gapirishdan oldin tomoqini tozaladi.
{r:I recommend honey for throat infection.} - Tomoq infeksiyasiga asalni tavsiya qilaman.
{r:A dry throat can be uncomfortable.} - Quruq tomoq noqulay bo'lishi mumkin.

text: {r:Son}[sʌn] – o’g’il. {h:O’g’lingiz} oldin tizzangizdek edi, hozir {p:SON}ingiz bilan barobar bo’lib qolibdi. Tez o’syapti.
examples: {r:His son is studying abroad.} - Uning o'g'li chet elda o'qiydi.
{r:She had a baby son last year.} - U o'tgan yili o'g'illi bo'ldi.
{r:Her son is taking a shower now.} - Uning o'g'li hozir yuvinyapti.
{r:They have two sons and a daughter.} - Ularning ikkita o'g'li va bir qizi bor.

text: {r:Daughter}[ˈdɔːtər] – qiz farzand. Tasavvur qiling {h:qizingiz} {p:dota} o’ynaydi, siz bunga qarshisiz. Lekin dota o'ynab pul yutuqlariga erishsa qo’llasangiz kerak uni faqat.
examples: {r:Her daughter is a talented musician.} - Uning qizi iste'dodli musiqachi.
{r:He spends a lot of time with his daughter.} - U o'z qizi bilan ko'p vaqt o'tkazadi.
{r:Her daughter insists on eating honey.} - Uning qizi asal yeyman deb turib oldi.
{r:They celebrated their daughter’s birthday.} - Ular o'z qizlarining tug'ilgan kunini nishonladilar.

text: {r:Its}[ɪts] – uning. Jonsiz predmetlar va hayvonlar uchun. {p:It s}o’lagi - bu {h:uning} ishtahasini bildiruvchi belgisidir.
examples: {r:The cat licked its paws.} - Mushuk o'z panjalarini yaladi.
{r:The company is famous for its products.} - Kompaniya o'z mahsulotlari bilan mashhur.
{r:The tree lost its leaves in autumn.} - Daraxt kuzda o'z barglarini yo'qotdi.
{r:The phone has its own charger.} - Telefonning o'z zaryadlovchisi bor.

text: {r:Tree}[triː] – daraxt. {h:Daraxtlar} inson {p:tri}kligining garovidir. Chunki ular inson yashashi uchun kerak bo’lgan kislorodning yagona manbasidir.
examples: {r:The tree in the garden is very old.} - Bog'dagi daraxt juda qadimiy.
{r:I miss our old tree.} - Men eski daraxtimizni sog'inaman.
{r:My mother is now growing apple trees.} - Onam hozir olma daraxtlari o'stiryapti.
{r:Trees are continuously being cut.} - Daraxtlar davomli kesilyapti.

text: {r:Leaf}[liːf] – barg. Zarang daraxtining {h:barglari} shunchalik kuchliki chakalakzorda undan tepaga ko’tarilish uchun {p:LIF}t yasasa bo’ladi.
examples: {r:The leaf fell from the tree.} - Barg daraxtdan to'kildi.
{r:Leaves were flowing on the river.} - Barglar daryoda oqib ketayotgan edi.
{r:The leaves turned yellow in autumn.} - Barglar kuzda sariq rangga kirdi.
{r:I have never seen a blue leaf.} - Men hech qachon ko'k bargni ko'rmaganman.

text: {r:Employment}[ɪmˈplɔɪmənt] - ishga kirish, ishli bo'lish, ish bilan ta'minlash. Employ(ish bermoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He is looking for employment.} - U ish qidirmoqda.
{r:The employment rate has increased.} - Ish bilan ta'minlash darajasi oshdi.
{r:She found employment in a new company.} - U yangi kompaniyada ish topdi.
{r:The government is working to improve employment.} - Hukumat ish bilan ta'minlashni yaxshilash uchun ishlayapti.

text: {r:Originally}[əˈrɪdʒɪnəli] - dastlab, asli. Origin(kelib chiqish) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The book was originally written in French.} - Kitob dastlab fransuz tilida yozilgan.
{r:She is originally from Spain.} - U asli Ispaniyalik.
{r:The idea was originally his.} - G'oya dastlab uniki edi.
{r:My girlfriend was originally considerate.} - Mening qiz do'stim aslida mulohazali edi.

text: {r:Belonging}[bɪˈlɒŋɪŋ] - shaxsiy narsalar, mol-mulk. Belong(tegishli bo'lmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The bag is her belonging.} - Sumka uning mol-mulkidir.
{r:He packed his belongings for the trip.} - U safar uchun o'z mol-mulkini yig'ishtirdi.
{r:How much do your belongings weigh?} - Narsalaringizni og'irligi qancha?
{r:Seemingly your belongings are suspicious.} - Ko'rinishidan buyumlaringiz shubhali.

text: {r:Response}[rɪˈspɒns] - javob. Respond(javob bermoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:She gave a quick response to this robbery.} - U bu o'g'irlikka tez javob berdi.
{r:The response to the event was positive.} - Hodisaga javob ijobiy bo'ldi.
{r:Anvar patiently waited for her response.} - Anvar sabr bilan uning javobini kutdi.
{r:The doctor’s response time was amazing.} - Doktorning javob vaqti ajoyib edi.

text: {r:Regarding}[rɪˈɡɑːrdɪŋ] - haqida, bo'yicha.
examples: {r:He spoke regarding the new policy.} - U yangi siyosat haqida gapirdi.
{r:The meeting can be regarding anything and anybody can participate.} - Majlis har narsa haqida bo'lishi mumkin va har kim qatnashishi mumkin.
{r:She asked a question regarding the project.} - U loyiha haqida savol berdi.
{r:The discussion was regarding the budget.} - Munozara byudjet haqida bo'ldi.

text: {r:Drawer}[drɔːr] - tortma.
examples: {r:She opened the drawer to find the keys.} - U kalitlarni topish uchun tortmani ochdi.
{r:The drawer was stuck.} - Tortma tiqilib qolgan edi.
{r:He keeps his socks in the top drawer.} - U paypoqlarini yuqori tortmada saqlaydi.
{r:The drawer was full of papers.} - Tortma qog'ozlar bilan to'lib-toshgan edi.

text: {r:Admire}[ədˈmaɪər] – yaxshi ko’rmoq, qoyil qolmoq. {p:Ed}ik laqabli itini {p:Mayr}am juda {h:yaxshi ko’radi} va har kuni suyak beradi.
examples: {r:I admire her courage.} - Men uning jasoratiga qoyil qolaman.
{r:He admires his teacher.} - U o'qituvchisiga qoyil qoladi.
{r:She admired the view from the window.} - U derazadan manzaraga qoyil qoldi.
{r:You are admired by many in my country.} - Sizni bizning davlatda yaxshi ko'rishadi.

text: {r:Trap}[træp] – qopqon; qopqonga tushmoq. Tasavvur qiling {p:TRAMP} sichqonlarga qo’yilgan {h:qopqon}ni bosib olibdi.
examples: {r:The mouse was caught in a trap.} - Sichqon tuzoqqa tushdi.
{r:Free cheese is only in a mousetrap.} - Tekin pishloq faqat qopqonda bo'ladi.
{r:Hopefully, a tiger will be caught in a trap.} - Umid qilamizki yo'lbars tuzoqqa tushadi.
{r:The trap was successful.} - Tuzoq muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.

text: {r:Kettle}[ˈkɛtl] - qumg'on, choynak. Mana bu antiqa {h:choynak.} U choy damlash uchun emas balki {p:KATL}et tayyorlash uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:Actually she boils water in the kettle.} - Aslida u suvni choynakda qaynatadi.
{r:The kettle whistled when the water was ready.} - Suv tayyor bo'lganda choynak chiyilladi.
{r:He bought a new electric kettle.} - U yangi elektr choynak sotib oldi.
{r:This lovely kettle is a present from my grandfather.} - Bu ajoyib qumg'on bobomdan sovg'a.

text:
{r:Mouse}[maʊs] – sichqon. Mice - sichqonlar. 
Dunyodagi eng mashhur {h:sichqon} kim ekanligini yaxshi bilasiza! Miki {p:MAUS}.
examples: {r:Actually Mickey is the most famous mouse and he knows to play chess.} - Aslida Miki eng mashhur sichqon va u shaxmat o'ynashni biladi.
{r:She uses a wireless mouse for her computer.} - U kompyuteri uchun simsiz sichqoncha ishlatadi.
{r:We believe that mice love cheese but they don't.} - Biz sichqonlar pishloqni yaxshi ko'radi deb ishonamiz lekin unday emas.
{r:He caught the mouse in a trap immediately.} - U sichqonni tezda tuzoqda tutdi.

text: {r:Edge}[ɛdʒ] - chekka, qirra. Ovqatga qo'shib yeyish uchun men ADJika olib kelaman, ketchupdan ko'ra yaxshiroq. Lekin ta'mi ozgina achchiq, yoqimli achchiq. Shuning uchun odatda {p:ADJ}ikani stol {h:chekkasiga} qo'yaman bolalar teginmasin deb.
examples: {r:She stood on the edge of the cliff.} - U qoyalarning chekkasida turardi.
{r:The knife has a sharp edge.} - Pichoqning qirrasi o'tkir.
{r:He lives on the edge of the city.} - U shaharning chekkasida yashaydi.
{r:The edge of the table was rough.} - Stolning chekkasi qo'pol edi.

text: {r:Of course}[əv kɔːrs] - albatta.
examples: {r:Of course, you can join us.} - Albatta, bizga qo'shilishingiz mumkin.
{r:She said, “Of course, I’ll help you.”.} - U aytdi: 'Albatta, sizga yordam beraman.'
{r:Of course, the answer is correct.} - Albatta, javob to'g'ri.
{r:He knew the answer, of course.} - U albatta javobni bilardi.

text: {r:Whose}[huːz] – kimning. Bolachalar hovuzda cho’milib huzurlanishyapti. {p:Hovuz} {h:kimniki?} Hovuz shishiraladigan bolalar hovuz borku, o’shani aytyapman. Rasmdagi amakini!
examples: {r:Whose book is this?} - Bu kimning kitobi?
{r:Whose car is parked outside?} - Tashqarida kimning mashinasi turibdi?
{r:Whose idea was this?} - Bu kimning g'oyasi edi?
{r:Whose turn is it to speak?} - Kimning gapirish navbati?

text: {r:Yours}[jɔːrz] - sizniki.
examples: {r:Is this pen yours?} - Bu ruchka siznikimi?
{r:The decision is yours.} - Qaror sizniki.
{r:The book is yours if you want it.} - Kitob sizniki, agar xohlasangiz.
{r:The responsibility is yours.} - Mas'uliyat sizniki.
{r:A friend of yours is pleased with your congratulation.} - Sizning do'stingiz tabrigingizdan xursand.

text: {r:Hers}[hɜːrz] - uniki(qiz bolaga nisbatan)
examples: {r:A bag of hers is heavy.} - Uning sumkasi og'ir.
{r:Is this phone hers?} - Bu telefon unikimi?
{r:The idea was hers.} - G'oya uniki edi.
{r:This fortune is hers.} - Bu boylik uniki.

text: {r:Ours}[aʊərz] - bizniki.
examples: {r:The house is ours.} - Uy bizniki.
{r:Is this problem ours?} - Bu muammo biznikimi?
{r:The victory is ours.} - G'alaba bizniki.
{r:Relatives of our are rich.} - Bizning qarindoshlarimiz boy.

text: {r:Theirs}[ðɛərz] - ularniki.
examples: {r:The lovely car is theirs.} - Bu ajoyib mashina ularniki.
{r:Is this table theirs?} - Bu stol ularnikimi?
{r:The success is theirs.} - Muvaffaqiyat ularniki.
{r:The desk and the chair are theirs.} - Parta va stul ularniki.

text: {r:Uncomfortable}[ʌnˈkʌmfərtəbl] - noqulay. Comfortable(qulay) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:The chair is uncomfortable.} - Stul noqulay.
{r:She felt uncomfortable when she was pregnant} - U homiladorlik payti noqulay his qildi.
{r:The situation made him uncomfortable.} - Vaziyat uni noqulay holatga keltirdi.
{r:These shoes are uncomfortable to wear.} - Bu poyabzal kiyish uchun noqulay.

text: {r:Candle}[ˈkændl] – sham. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:QANDIL}dagi lampalar uyni yetarlicha yorita olmayapti deb o’yladingiz va qandil ustiga {h:sham}larni ham qo’yishga qaror qildingiz.
examples: {r:She lit a candle in the dark.} - U qorong'ida sham yoqdi.
{r:The candle smelled like lavender.} - Sham lavanda hidini berardi.
{r:He blew out the candle.} - U shamni puflab o'chirdi.
{r:Candle is the national symbol of Scotland.} - Sham Shotlandiyaning milliy ramzi.

text: {r:Recipe}[ˈrɛsəpi] - retsept. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:She shared her favorite recipe.} - U o'zining sevimli retseptini ulashdi.
{r:The recipe requires fresh ingredients.} - Retsept yangi ingredientlarni talab qiladi.
{r:He followed the recipe carefully.} - U retseptni diqqat bilan bajardi.
{r:The recipe was easy to follow.} - Retseptni bajara olish oson edi.

text: {r:Event}[ɪˈvɛnt] – hodisa, tadbir. {p:I}lon {p:vent}ilyatorni aylanib turgan parragi orasidan o’tib ketdi va bu katta {h:hodisa} sifatida baholandi.
examples: {r:The event was a great success.} - Tadbir katta muvaffaqiyat bo'ldi.
{r:She organized the event perfectly.} - U tadbirni mukammal tashkil qildi.
{r:The event continuously attracted many people.} - Tadbir doimiy ravishda ko'p odamlarni jalb qildi.
{r:I translated the speaker's speech on yesterday's event.} - Kechagi tadbirda ma'ruzachining nutqini tarjima qildim.
{r:People are standing on long queues to watch this sports event.} - Odamlar bu sport tadbirini tomosha qilish uchun uzun navbatlarda turishibdi.

text: {r:Pure}[pjʊər] – toza, sof, asl. Agar yuragingizni {h:toza} qilmoqchi bo’lsangiz kartoshka {p:PYUR}i yeng. Haqiqatdan foyda beradi.
examples: {r:The water is pure and clean.} - Suv sof va toza.
{r:She has a pure heart.} - Uning sof qalbi bor.
{r:Her thoughts are pure.} - Uning o'y-fikrlari toza.
{r:The air in the mountains is pure.} - Tog'larda havo sof.

text: {r:Gold}[ɡoʊld] - oltin. Agar futbol bo'yicha Osiyo chempionatida barcha raqiblardan ko'proq {p:GOL} ursak yakunda {h:oltin} medal bizniki bo'ladi.
examples: {r:She wore a gold necklace.} - U oltin marjon taqdi.
{r:The ring is made of gold.} - Uzuk oltindan yasalgan.
{r:He invested in gold.} - U oltinga sarmoya kiritdi.
{r:The gold medal was his dream.} - Oltin medal uning orzusi edi.

text: {r:Stone}[stoʊn] - tosh. Mana bu rasmdagi 5000 yillik {h:tosh} u{p:STUN}.
examples: {r:The path was made of stone.} - Yo'l toshdan qilingan edi.
{r:Our marriage ceremony was held next to the big stone.} - Bizning nikoh marosimi katta tosh oldida o'tkazilgan.
{r:The stone was heavy.} - Tosh og'ir edi.
{r:He built a wall with stones.} - U toshlar bilan devor qurdi.

text: {r:Dive}[daɪv] - sho'ng'imoq. Mana bu yigit haqiqiy telba. U ekstrimallikni yoqtiradi va yaqinda okean bo'yida {p:TAYF}un sodir bo'lgan vaqti yigitcha qoyadan ummonga {h:sho'ng'idi} va o'z hayotini xatarga qo'ydi. Xayriyatki yakunda omon qoldi.
examples: {r:He loves to dive in the ocean.} - U okeanga sho'ng'ishni yoqtiradi.
{r:She dived into the pool.} - U hovuzga sho'ng'idi.
{r:The dive was perfect.} - Sho'ng'ish mukammal edi.
{r:They went diving last weekend.} - Ular o'tgan dam olish kunlarida sho'ng'ishga borishdi.

text: {r:Stick}[stɪk] - yopishmoq, yopishtirmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz asalari uyasidan STAKan tayyorladingiz, lekin muammo shundaki bu {p:STAK}an qo'lga {h:yopishib qolyapti}.
examples: {r:The sticker sticks firmly to the surface.} - Stiker yuzaga mahkam yopishadi.
{r:She stuck the note to the fridge with a magnet.} - U eslatmani magnit bilan muzlatgichga yopishtirdi.
{r:They stuck the broken pieces together with glue.} - Ular singan qismlarni elim bilan birlashtirishdi.
{r:The paper won’t stick without proper material.} - Qog‘oz kerakli materialsiz yopishmaydi.

text: {r:Translation}[trænzˈleɪʃn] - tarjima. Translate(tarjima qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The translation of yours was accurate.} - Tarjimangiz aniq edi.
{r:She works as a translation expert.} - U tarjima mutaxassisi sifatida ishlaydi.
{r:The book is a translation from French.} - Kitob frantsuz tilidan tarjima qilingan.
{r:He provided a translation of the document.} - U hujjatning tarjimasini taqdim etdi.

text: {r:Originate}[əˈrɪdʒɪneɪt] - paydo bo'lmoq, kelib chiqmoq. Origin(kelib chiqish so'zidan yasalgan)
examples: {r:The tradition originated in ancient times.} - An'ana qadim zamonlarda paydo bo'lgan.
{r:The idea originated from her.} - G'oya undan kelib chiqqan.
{r:The river originates in the mountains.} - Daryo tog'lardan boshlanadi.
{r:The problem originated from a misunderstanding.} - Muammo noto'g'ri tushunishdan kelib chiqqan.

text: {r:Basic}[ˈbeɪsɪk] so‘zi o‘zbek tilida 'asosiy', 'oddiy', 'muqaddimaviy', 'eng muhim' degan ma’nolarni anglatadi. Bu so‘z biror narsaning eng muhim yoki sodda shaklini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Masalan: 1) 'She has a basic knowledge of English.' — 'Uning ingliz tili bo‘yicha asosiy bilimlari bor.' 2) 'Food, water, and shelter are basic needs for survival.' — 'Oziq-ovqat, suv va boshpana tirik qolish uchun asosiy ehtiyojlardir.' 3) 'I just need a basic phone, nothing fancy.' — 'Menga faqat oddiy telefon kerak, maxsus narsalar shart emas.' Xulosa: 'Basic' — muhim, boshlang‘ich yoki sodda narsalarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:She learned the basic rules of the game.} - U o'yinning asosiy qoidalarini o'rgandi.
{r:The basic ingredients are flour and water.} - Asosiy ingredientlar un va suv.
{r:He explained the basic concepts.} - U asosiy tushunchalarni tushuntirdi.
{r:The basic idea is simple.} - Asosiy g'oya oddiy.

text: {r:Attractive}[əˈtræktɪv] - jozibali, o'ziga tortuvchi. Attract() so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Of course, the offer was very attractive.} - Albatta taklif juda jozibali edi.
{r:She is an attractive person.} - U jozibali odam.
{r:An attractive woman is responding to my messages.} - Jozibali ayol smslarimga javob beryapti.
{r:The price is attractive.} - Narx jozibali.

text: {r:Tax}[tæks] – soliq. Yashirib o’tirmayman Yandeks Taksini yoqtirmayman. Ushbu {p:TAKS}i agregati doim {h:soliqlar} to’lashdan bo’yin tovlaydi.
examples: {r:He paid his taxes on time.} - U o'z soliqlarini vaqtida to'ladi.
{r:The tax rate is rising.} - Soliq stavkasi oshyapti.
{r:She works in tax consulting.} - U soliq maslahati sohasida ishlaydi.
{r:Our country's government reduced the tax.} - Bizning mamlakatimiz hukumati soliqni kamaytirdi.

text: {r:Recently}[ˈriːsntli] - yaqinda. Recent so'zining ravish shakli. Mnemonik namuna uchun 39 - darsdagi recent ga qarang.
examples: {r:I met him recently.} - Men uni yaqinda uchratdim.
{r:The book was published recently.} - Kitob yaqinda nashr etilgan.
{r:Have you seen Julia recently?} - Siz Juliani yaqinda ko'rdingizmi?
{r:The weather has been cold recently.} - Havo yaqinda sovuq bo'ldi.

text: {r:Connection}[kəˈnɛkʃn] - aloqa. Connect(bog'lamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:There is a strong connection between them.} - Ularning o'rtasida kuchli aloqa bor.
{r:The internet connection is slow.} - Internet ulanishi sekin.
{r:She lost her connection to the past.} - U o'tmishi bilan aloqasini yo'qotdi.
{r:I am worried about my internet connection.} - Men internet aloqasidan xavotirdaman.

text: {r:Consistency}[kənˈsɪstənsi] - izchillik, davomiylik, barqarorlik. Consistent(barqaror, izchil) so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 110 - darsdagi consistent ga qarang.
examples: {r:Our team’s consistency led to success.} - Bizning jamoamiz izchilligi muvaffaqiyatga olib keldi.
{r:I respect her consistency in her work.} - Men uning ishdagi barqarorligini hurmat qilaman.
{r:The consistency is key to success.} - Izchillik muvaffaqiyat kaliti.
{r:His consistency in training showed its results.} - Uning mashg'ulotlardagi barqarorligi o'z samarasini berdi.

text: {r:Experienced}[ɪkˈspɪəriənst] - tajribali. Experience(tajriba) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She is a relatively experienced teacher.} - U nisbatan tajribali o'qituvchi.
{r:He is experienced in handling difficult situations.} - U qiyin vaziyatlarni hal qilishda tajribali.
{r:Our team needs experienced players.} - Jamoa tajribali o'yinchilarga muhtoj.
{r:Shuhrat is regarded as an experienced candidate.} - Shuhrat tajribali nomzod hisoblanadi.

text: {r:Invention}[ɪnˈvɛnʃn] - ixtiro. Invent(ixtiro qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The invention of the telephone changed the world.} - Telefon ixtirosi dunyoni o'zgartirdi.
{r:The scientist is working on a new invention.} - Olim yangi ixtiro ustida ishlamoqda.
{r:This invention belongs to me.} - Bu ixtiro menga tegishli.
{r:His invention solved a major problem.} - Uning ixtirosi katta muammoni hal qildi.

text: {r:Application}[ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃn] - ariza; qo'llash, amalda sinash. Apply(ariza bermoq; qo'llamoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:The application process is simple.} - Ariza berish jarayoni oddiy.
{r:She submitted her job application.} - U o'z ish arizasini topshirdi.
{r:The application of the theory was successful.} - Nazariyani qo'llash muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.
{r:I am working on different applications of this plant.} - Men bu o'simlikning turli qo'llanmalari ustida ishlayapman.

text: {r:Firstly}[ˈfɜːrstli] - birinchidan. First(birinchi) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Firstly, let’s introduce ourselves.} - Birinchidan keling o'zimizni tanishtiraylik.
{r:Firstly, we need to understand the problem.} - Birinchidan, muammoni tushunishimiz kerak.
{r:Firstly, we should distribute apples to buyers.} - Birinchidan, olmalarni xaridorlarga tarqatishimiz kerak.
{r:Firstly, we must make improvements in our results.} - Birinchidan, natijalarda yaxshilanishlar qilishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Survey}[ˈsɜːrveɪ] - so'rovnoma. Toshkent shahri bo'ylab hokimiyat so'rovnoma o'tkazdi. Savollarini eslayolmayman ammo qiziqarlisi {h:so'rovnoma} qog'ozlari {p:SIRLI} edi. Ya'ni pishloqdan qilingan ekan.
examples: {r:They conducted a survey to gather opinions.} - Ular fikrlarni to'plash uchun so'rovnoma o'tkazdi.
{r:The survey results were surprising.} - So'rovnoma natijalari hayratlanarli edi.
{r:She filled out the survey online.} - U so'rovnomani onlayn to'ldirdi.
{r:The survey is concerning brotherhood.} - So'rovnoma birodarlik haqida.
{r:The survey results formed the basis of our recommendation.} - So'rov natijalari bizning tavsiyamizga asos bo'ldi.

text: {r:Height}[haɪt] – bo’y. Yaqin kunlarda siz antiqa bir hodisani sezib qoldingiz. Har safar {p:HAYIT} bayrami bo’lgan payt {h:bo’yingiz} ozgina o’syapti.
examples: {r:The height of the building is impressive.} - Binoning balandligi hayratlanarli.
{r:She is hardly average in height.} - U bo'y jihatidan arang o'rtacha.
{r:The mountain’s height is over 3000 meters.} - Tog'ning balandligi 3000 metrdan oshadi.
{r:My brother measured the height of the tree.} - Mening akam daraxtning balandligini o'lchadi.

text: {r:Impress}[ɪmˈprɛs] – hayron qoldirmoq, taassurot qoldirmoq. Agar uy yoki imorat buzmoqchi bo’lsangiz mana bu zo’r bulldozer. Siz buzmoqchi bo’lgan {p:IM}oratni {p:PRESS}lab tashlaydi yerga 2 sekundda va siz {h:lol qolasiz}.
examples: {r:She impressed everyone with her speech.} - U o'z nutqi bilan hammada taassurot qoldirdi.
{r:I am impressed by the moon's beauty.} - Men oyning go'zalligidan lolman.
{r:He tried to impress his boss.} - U o'z xo'jayinini hayron qoldirishga harakat qildi.
{r:The design impressed the judges.} - Dizayn hakamlarni hayron qoldirdi.

text: {r:Colleague}[ˈkɒliːɡ] - hamkasb, kollega.
examples: {r:She discussed the project with her colleague.} - U loyihani o'z hamkasbi bilan muhokama qildi.
{r:His colleague helped him with the task.} - Uning hamkasbi unga vazifada yordam berdi.
{r:I have never complained about my colleagues because they are attentive and understanding.} - Hech qachon hamkasblarim ustidan shikoyat qilmaganman chunki ular e'tiborli va tushunadigan.
{r:Colleagues of mine are very selfish.} - Mening hamkasblarim juda xudbin.

text: {r:Frustrate}[ˈfrʌstreɪt] – xafa qilmoq, ranjitmoq. Furatsilin bilan tomog’imni chayqaganimdan so’ng tomog’im battar ishib ketdi. {p:FURATS}ilin {h:xafa qildi} meni lekin.
examples: {r:The delay frustrated everyone.} - Kechikish hammani asabiylashtirdi.
{r:She felt frustrated because her sweater was stolen.} - U ranjigandek his qildi chunki sviteri o'g'irlandi.
{r:The situation frustrated him.} - Vaziyat uni asabiylashtirdi.
{r:I feel homesick and frustrated.} - Men uyni sog'inib ranjidim.
{r:Lack of consistency can frustrate both employees and customers.} - Izchillikning yo'qligi ham xodimlarni, ham mijozlarni xafa qilishi mumkin.

text: {r:Owe}[oʊ] – qarz bo’lmoq. Tasavvur qiling sizning kasbdoshingiz ish joyida pulingiz bo’lmaganligi uchun 10 kundan beri ovqat uchun to’lab turibdi. Siz endi kasbdoshingizdan 10 {p:OV}qat {h:qarzsiz.} Siz esa bir qozon qilib shavla qilib keldingiz. ‘’Mana bu yerda 10 kosa shavla bor, qozoni bilan olib ket. Endi sendan qarzim yo’q’’ dedingiz.
examples: {r:I owe him an apology.} - Men undan uzr so'rashim kerak.
{r:A newcomer student owes me money.} - Yangi kelgan talaba menda pul qarz.
{r:I don't owe you anything.} - Men sendan qarzdor emasman.
{r:They owe the bank some money.} - Ular bankdan biroz pul qarz.

text: {r:Raise}[reɪz] – ko’tarmoq, oshirmoq. Maktabdagi qizchalar {p:rez}inka bilan sochlarini {h:ko’tarib} olishyapti.
examples: {r:She raised her hand to ask a question.} - U savol berish uchun qo'lini ko'tardi.
{r:The company raised its prices.} - Kompaniya narxlarni oshirdi.
{r:He raised his voice in anger.} - U g'azabdan ovozini ko'tardi.
{r:Employer raised my salary.} - Ish beruvchi oyligimni ko'tardi.

text: {r:Fix}[fɪks] – to’g’rilamoq, tuzatmoq. Agar uyingizda muzlatgich, ventilyator yoki televizor buzilib qolsa {p:FIKS}iki multfilmidagi Nolik va Simkani chaqiring, kelib {h:tuzatib} ketishadi.
examples: {r:He fixed the broken chair.} - U singan stulni tuzatdi.
{r:She fixed her hair before the meeting.} - U yig'ilishdan oldin sochlarini tuzatdi.
{r:The mechanic fixed the car.} - Mexanik mashinani tuzatdi.
{r:They are trying to fix the problem.} - Ular muammoni hal qilishga harakat qilmoqda.

text: {r:Bench}[bɛntʃ] – skameyka. Tasavvur qiling yangi 100 dollarlik chiqibdi. Kupyuradagi {p:BENJ}amin Franklin endi {h:skameykada} o’tirgan tasvirini ko’rishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:I received payment for installing benches.} - Men skameykalarni o'rnatganim uchun to'lovni qabul qildim.
{r:The bench was made of wood.} - Skameyka yog'ochdan yasalgan edi.
{r:We argued on the bench.} - Biz skameykada bahslashdik.
{r:The bench was painted green.} - Skameyka yashil rangga bo'yalgan edi.

text: {r:Determine}[dɪˈtɜːrmɪn] – aniqlamoq; belgilamoq. {p:Di}lshod {p:termin}alga plastik kartani tiqyapti. U plastikda qancha pul borligini {h:aniqlamoqchi}.
examples: {r:The police will determine the cause of the accident.} - Politsiya baxtsiz hodisaning sababini aniqlaydi.
{r:The test will determine his level.} - Test uning darajasini aniqlaydi.
{r:The scientist determined the cause of the problem.} - Olim muammoning sababini aniqladi.
{r:The committee will determine the winner.} - Qo'mita g'olibni aniqlaydi.

text: {r:Set}[sɛt] - belgilamoq, o‘rnatmoq, qo‘ymoq. U turli kontekstlarda ishlatiladi, lekin ko‘pincha maqsad, vaqt, qoidalar yoki narsalarni joyiga qo‘yish, belgilash ma’nosida qo‘llanadi.
examples: {r:They set a time for the meeting.} - Ular uchrashuv uchun vaqt belgilashdi.
{r:Please set the table for dinner.} - Iltimos, kechki ovqat uchun dasturxon yoz.
{r:The teacher set homework for tomorrow.} - O‘qituvchi ertaga uy vazifasini berdi.
{r:We need to set clear goals.} - Biz aniq maqsadlar qo'yishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Mess}[mɛs] - tartibsizlik. {p:MESS}i shunchalik kuchli dribling sohibi ediki u butun raqib jamoa o'yinini {h:tartibsiz} qilib buzib tashlardi.
examples: {r:The room was a mess.} - Xona tartibsiz edi.
{r:She cleaned up the mess.} - U tartibsizlikni tozaladi.
{r:My brother made a mess in the kitchen.} - Mening akam oshxonada tartibsizlik qildi.
{r:The children left a mess in the living room.} - Bolalar mehmonxonani tartibsiz qoldirishdi.

text: {r:Enemy}[ˈɛnəmi] - dushman. Man semiz bo'yi past qizman. Bo'yim kaltalashib ketibdi oxirgi bir yilda ana endi {p:ENIMMI} kamaytirishim kerak. Enli, semizligim meni {h:dushmanim}.
examples: {r:Sardor considered him an enemy.} - Sardor uni dushman deb hisoblardi.
{r:The two countries were enemies.} - Ikki mamlakat dushman edi.
{r:He used to be my opponent not an enemy.} - U mening raqibim edi dushmanim emas.
{r:The enemy was defeated.} - Dushman mag'lubiyatga uchradi.

text:
around/about - taxminan, atrofida. 
Garchi bu ikkala so'zning ham asosiy ma'nosi boshqa bo'lsada ular ba'zan 'taxminan', 'atrofida' ma'nolarida ham keladi.
examples: {r:The project will take about two weeks to complete.} - Loyiha taxminan ikki hafta davom etadi.
{r:She arrived around 3 PM.} - U taxminan soat 3 da keldi.
{r:There were about 50 people at the event.} - Tadbirda taxminan 50 kishi bor edi.
{r:The train leaves around noon.} - Poyezd taxminan tushda jo‘naydi.
{r:I make about 1000$ a month.} - Men oyiga taxminan 1000$ topaman.

text: {r:Mirror}[ˈmɪrər] – oyna. Tasavvur qiling {p:MIR}shab {p:OR}deniga ko’ra siz har kuni ertayu-kech {h:oynaga} qarab o’tirishga majbur etildingiz.
examples: {r:She has looked at herself in the mirror many times.} - U oynada o'ziga ko'p marotaba qaragan.
{r:He used to admire himself in the mirror.} - U oynada o'ziga qarab qoyil qolardi.
{r:You must not break the mirror.} - Siz oynani sindirmasligingiz kerak.
{r:They were watching themselves in the mirror.} - Ular oynada o'zlarini tomosha qilayotgan edilar.

text: {r:Reward}[rɪˈwɔːrd] - mukofot; mukofotlamoq, taqdirlamoq. Bugun meditsina bo'yicha o'zbek olimi Nobel mukofotini oldi. U revmatizmga eng sodda yechim topdi. Davolash uchun {p:REV}matizmni {p:O'RD}ak patini yesangiz bo'ldi ekan. Shu davo usulini topgani uchun uni {h:mukofotlashdi}.
examples: {r:He rewarded himself with a new toy.} - U o'zini yangi o'yinchoq bilan mukofotladi.
{r:The company should reward hard work.} - Kompaniya qattiq mehnatni mukofotlashi kerak.
{r:They have received a wonderful reward for their patience.} - Ular sabr-toqatlari uchun ajoyib mukofot oldilar.
{r:I would like to reward her for her caring spirit.} - Men uning g'amxo'r ruhi uchun uni mukofotlashni xohlardim.
{r:Completing the difficult task brought him great satisfaction and a sense of reward.} - Qiyin vazifani bajarish unga katta mamnuniyat va mukofot hissini berdi.

text: {r:Plate}[pleɪt] – tarelka. {p:PLIT}ochniy shokoladni issiqroq {h:tarelka}ga qo'ygan ekanman erib ketibdi.
examples: {r:The waiter brought plates to us.} - Ofitsiant bizga tarelkalar olib keldi.
{r:You must wash your plate after eating.} - Ovqatdan keyin tarelkangizni yuvishingiz kerak.
{r:They were eating from their plates together.} - Ular o'z tarelkalaridan birga ovqatlanayotgan edilar.
{r:He had to buy new plates for the guests.} - U mehmonlar uchun yangi tarelkalar sotib olishi kerak edi.

text: {r:Burn}[bɜːrn] – yonmoq, yoqmoq. Olov purkovchi ajdar haqida eshitgan bo’lsangiz kerak. Lekin fin afsonalarining biri olov purkovchi bo’ri haqida. {p:BO'RIN}i olov purkashi shaharning {h:yonib} ketishiga sabab bo’ladi.
examples: {r:He burned himself with hot water.} - U issiq suv bilan o'zini kuydirib oldi.
{r:The old engine used to burn a lot of fuel.} - Eski motor juda ko'p yoqilg'i yoqardi.
{r:You should not burn the paper here.} - Siz qog'ozni bu yerda yondirmasligingiz kerak.
{r:The sun has burned her skin.} - Quyosh uning terisini kuydirgan.

text: {r:Together}[təˈɡɛðər] – birgalikda. Rossiyada 3 yildan beri ishlayapman. Kastumim {p:tug}masiga {p:zir}a qadab qo’yganman, xotinim ham shunday qilgan. Rossiyadan O’zbekistonga qaytsam shu ikkita zirani qo’shib {h:birgalikda} osh qilamiz.
examples: {r:They used to work on projects together.} - Ular loyihalar ustida birga ishlashardi.
{r:We should all work together for success.} - Biz hammamiz muvaffaqiyat uchun birga ishlashimiz kerak.
{r:Our neighbors have been living together for years.} - Bizning qo'shnilarimiz yillar davomida birga yashamoqda.
{r:I would like us to go there together.} - Men u yerga birga borishimizni xohlardim.

text: {r:Secondly}[ˈsɛkəndli] - ikkinchidan. Second(ikkinchi) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Firstly, it is a good idea. Secondly, we should discuss the budget.} - Birinchidan, bu yaxshi g'oya. Ikkinchidan, biz byudjetni muhokama qilishimiz kerak.
{r:Secondly, the new plan must be approved.} - Ikkinchidan, yangi reja tasdiqlanishi kerak.
{r:He has always said, secondly, we must learn from our mistakes.} - U doimo, ikkinchidan, xatolarimizdan o'rganishimiz kerakligini aytgan.
{r:Secondly, I would like to show you a new invention.} - Ikkinchidan, men sizga yangi ixtironi ko'rsatmoqchiman.

text: {r:Express}[ɪkˈsprɛs] - bildirmoq, ifodalamoq. Men xotinimga Afrosiyob {p:EKSPRESS} poyezdida ketayotganimizda o'z tuyg'ularimni {h:ifodalaganman} va 3 oy o'tib turmush qurganmiz.
examples: {r:She expressed herself well in the meeting.} - U yig'ilishda o'zini yaxshi ifodaladi.
{r:Personally you must learn to express yourself clearly.} - Shaxsan siz o'zingizni aniq ifodalashni o'rganishingiz kerak.
{r:They were expressing their feelings to each other.} - Ular bir-birlariga o'z his-tuyg'ularini ifodalayotgan edilar.
{r:He has always wanted to express his thanks.} - U har doim o'z minnatdorchiligini bildirmoqchi bo'lgan.

text: {r:Ashamed}[əˈʃeɪmd] - uyalmoq. Men maktabda 2 ga o'qiganman. 4 ga 5 ni ham qo'sholmayman. Shunaqa {p:ESHEMIYALIGIMD}an {h:uyalaman}.
examples: {r:He felt ashamed of himself after the mistake.} - U xatodan keyin o'zidan uyaldi.
{r:She was ashamed of her relatives.} - U o'z qarindoshlaridan uyaldi.
{r:They have been feeling ashamed about their behavior.} - Ular o'z xulq-atvorlari uchun uyalishmoqda.
{r:You should not make them feel ashamed.} - Siz ularni uyaltirmasligingiz kerak.

text: {r:Towel}[ˈtaʊəl] – sochiq. Mening {p:DAVL}at ismli do’stim {h:sochiq} ishlab chiqarish biznesini yo’lga qo’ydi.
examples: {r:She dried herself with a clean towel.} - U o'zini toza sochiq bilan quritdi.
{r:He had to use a big towel to dry himself.} - U o'zini quritish uchun katta sochiq ishlatishi kerak edi.
{r:They used to share one towel with each other.} - Ular bitta sochiqni bir-biri bilan bo'lishardi.
{r:You should get yourself a soft towel.} - Siz o'zingizga yumshoq sochiq olishingiz kerak.

text: {r:Attack}[əˈtæk] – hujum;hujum qilmoq. Bobom soyuz davrida rais bo’lib ishlagan va paxta planini o’z vaqtida bajargan. Bir kuni uni ko’rolmaydigan qo’shni mahalla raisi bobomni obro’sizlantirish uchun {p:ETAK} saqlanadigan omborxonaga {h:hujum qildi} ya'ni yoqib yuborgan. Qishloq aholisi etaklari bo’lmagani uchun bir hafta paxta tera olmagan.
examples: {r:The army had to defend themselves from the attack.} - Armiya hujumdan o'zlarini himoya qilishi kerak edi.
{r:I attacked the bees by myself.} - Asalarilarga yolg'iz o'zim hujum qildim.
{r:The soldiers were attacking each other in the game.} - Askarlar o'yinda bir-birlariga hujum qilayotgan edilar.
{r:Attack the enemy when he is sleepy.} - Dushmaning uyqusiragan payt hujum qil.

text: {r:Store}[stɔːr] – ombor; do’kon; saqlamoq. Omborlarim, do’konlarimni ko’rmoqchi bo’lsangiz Instagram {p:STOR}islarimni tekshiring.
examples: {r:I bought a gift for myself at the store.} - Men do'kondan o'zim uchun sovg'a sotib oldim.
{r:The company has opened a new store for themselves.} - Kompaniya o'zlari uchun yangi do'kon ochgan.
{r:You should store the old books somewhere safe.} - Siz eski kitoblarni qayerdadir xavfsiz joyda saqlashingiz kerak.
{r:They used to walk to the store together.} - Ular do'konga birga borishardi.

text: {r:Mind}[maɪnd] - miya, aql. 42 - darsdagi mind(qarshilik qilmoq) ning omonimi. Tasavvur qiling {p:mayin d}oskaga {h:miyani} rasmini chizdingiz. Doska mayinligidan mel doskani ichiga kirib ketyapti.
examples: {r:He must train his mind himself.} - U o'z miyasini o'zi mashq qilishi kerak.
{r:She has a good mind for understanding complex problems.} - U murakkab muammolarni tushunishda yaxshi aqlga ega.
{r:They should keep their minds open to new ideas.} - Ular yangi g'oyalarga o'z fikrlarini ochiq tutishlari kerak.
[center][b]to change your mind[/b][/center]
{r:At first I wanted to stay at home, but I changed my mind and went to the party} – Avval uyda qolmoqchi edim, ammo fikrimni o‘zgartirib, kechaga bordim.
{r:I tried to change her mind about selling the house, but she was determined} – Uyini sotish haqida uning fikrini o‘zgartirishga harakat qildim, ammo u qat’iy edi.

text: {r:Voyage}[ˈvɔɪɪdʒ] - dengiz sayohati.
examples: {r:They enjoyed themselves on the long voyage.} - Ular uzoq dengiz sayohatida o'zlarini yaxshi his qilishdi.
{r:He had to prepare himself for the voyage.} - U dengiz sayohati uchun o'zini tayyorlashi kerak edi.
{r:The captain had made many voyages across the ocean.} - Kapitan okean bo'ylab ko'plab dengiz sayohatlarini qilgan.
{r:We would like to take a voyage next summer by ourselves.} - Biz kelasi yozda yolg'iz o'zimiz dengiz sayohatiga chiqishni xohlardik.

text: {r:River}[ˈrɪvər] – daryo. {p:RIV}oyatga ko’ra Rim shahri {h:daryo} bo’yida bo’ri tomonidan asrab olingan Rim va Romul tomonidan asos solingan.
examples: {r:The children were playing by the river themselves.} - Bolalar daryo bo'yida o'zlari o'ynashayotgan edi.
{r:I am a lucky guy today because I caught a big fish in the river by myself.} - Men bugun omadli yigitman chunki daryoda katta baliqni o'zim yolg'iz tutib oldim.
{r:He used to spend his free time by the river.} - U bo'sh vaqtini daryo bo'yida o'tkazardi.
{r:The river has been flowing for centuries.} - Daryo asrlar davomida oqib kelmoqda.

text: {r:Denial}[dɪˈnaɪəl] - inkor. Deny(inkor etmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He was in denial to himself about the problem.} - U muammo haqida o'ziga o'zi inkor holatida edi.
{r:Her denial of the accusation was strong.} - Uning ayblovni inkor etishi kuchli edi.
{r:We should not live in denial.} - Biz inkorda yashamasligimiz kerak.
{r:The judge had heard many denials like this.} - Sudya bunday ko'plab inkorlarni eshitgan.

text: {r:Congratulation}[kənˌɡrætʃuˈleɪʃn] - tabrik. Congratulate(tabriklamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:They congratulated themselves on their success.} - Ular muvaffaqiyatlari uchun o'zlarini tabrikladilar.
{r:I have received many congratulations for my work.} - Men ishim uchun ko'plab tabriklarni oldim.
{r:You should send a congratulation message.} - Siz tabrik xabarini yuborishingiz kerak.
{r:We must express our congratulations to the team.} - Biz jamoaga tabriklarimizni bildirishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Recognition}[ˌrɛkəɡˈnɪʃn] - tanish, tan olinish. Recognize(tanimoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He worked for his own recognition.} - U o'zini tanitish uchun ishladi.
{r:She has gained much recognition for her art.} - U o'z san'ati uchun ko'p tan olinishga erishgan.
{r:You should try to get recognition for your ideas.} - Siz o'z g'oyalaringiz uchun tan olinishga harakat qilishingiz kerak.
{r:The companies gave recognition to each other's efforts.} - Kompaniyalar bir-birlarining sa'y-harakatlariga tan berdi.

text: {r:Appearance}[əˈpɪərnəs] - tashqi ko'rinish.
examples: {r:She used to care a lot about her appearance.} - U o'z tashqi ko'rinishiga juda e'tibor berardi.
{r:His sudden appearance surprised everyone.} - Uning to'satdan paydo bo'lishi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
{r:You should improve your general appearance.} - Siz o'zingizning umumiy tashqi ko'rinishingizni yaxshilashingiz kerak.
{r:Haters used to laugh at his appearance.} - Negativchilar uning tashqi ko'rinishiga kulishardi.

text: {r:Accusation}[ˌækjuˈzeɪʃn] - ayblov. Accuse(ayblamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He had to defend himself against the accusation.} - U ayblovga qarshi o'zini himoya qilishi kerak edi.
{r:The false accusation made her feel ashamed.} - Yolg'on ayblov uni uyaltirdi.
{r:They were making accusations against each other.} - Ular bir-birlariga qarshi ayblovlar qo'yayotgan edilar.
{r:I would like to discuss the accusation with you.} - Men siz bilan ayblovni muhokama qilishni xohlardim.

text: {r:Generally}[ˈdʒɛnərəli] - umuman olganda. General(umumiy) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Generally, people take care of themselves.} - Umuman olganda, odamlar o'zlariga o'zlari qayg'urishadi.
{r:She has generally been a happy person.} - U umuman olganda baxtli inson bo'lgan.
{r:You should generally follow the rules.} - Siz umuman olganda qoidalarga amal qilishingiz kerak.
{r:They used to generally arrive on time.} - Ular umuman olganda vaqtida kelishardi.

text: {r:Match}[mætʃ] – gugurt; o'yin, match. Kecha stadionda milliy jamoamiz futbol {p:MATCH}ida yutqazib qo’ydi. Muxlislar norozi bo’lganidan qo’lidagi baklashkalarni stadionga uloqtirishdi. Menda qarasam baklashka yo’q ekan, cho’ntagimdagi {h:gugurt}ni otdim men.(Namuna uchun yozildi! Tartibsizlikni qo'llab-quvvatlamaymiz!)
examples: {r:He won the tennis match.} - U tennis o'yinida g'olib chiqdi.
{r:The match ended in a draw.} - O'yin durang bilan yakunlandi.
{r:She lit a candle with a match.} - U shamni gugurt bilan yoqdi.
{r:Our team’s match was intense.} - Bizning jamoamizning o'yini shiddatli bo'ldi.
{r:This is not my match. It is my friend's.} - Bu mening gugurtim emas. Bu mening do'stimniki.

text: {r:Building}[ˈbɪldɪŋ] - bino.
examples: {r:The height of Michael's building impressed everyone.} - Mayklning binosining balandligi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
{r:The confusion of the building's design was a problem.} - Binoning dizaynidagi chalkashlik muammo edi.
{r:Nargiza had to create a new plan for the building's appearance.} - Nargiza binoning tashqi ko'rinishi uchun yangi reja yaratishi kerak edi.
{r:The roof of the old building used to leak regularly.} - Eski binoning tomidan muntazam ravishda suv tomardi.
{r:They lived in that tall building when they had a baby.} - Ular farzandli bo'lganida ana shu uzun binoda yashaganlar.

text:
{r:Village}[ˈvɪlɪdʒ] – qishloq. 
- Aka tilla vilka olasizmi? 
- {p:VIL}kalani {p:LICH}kamga rasmini tashlang, {h:qishlog’imda} boylaga ko’rsataman.
examples: {r:The general opinion of the village's people was positive.} - Qishloq aholisining umumiy fikri ijobiy edi.
{r:Michael used to live in a small village by the river.} - Maykl kichik qishloqda daryo bo'yida yashardi.
{r:Anvar would like to move to a quiet village for his hobby.} - Anvar o'z hobbisi uchun tinch qishloqqa ko'chishni xohlardi.
{r:I went to my wife's village just once.} - Xotinimning qishlog'iga faqat bir marta borganman.

text: {r:Exchange}[ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ] – almashmoq;almashinuv. Kolleksionerlarning ham har xili bo’ladi, ularning ba’zilari ashaddiy shu ishning fanati bo’lib ba’zi qimmatbaho narsalar uchun butun boyligini ham berib yuborishga tayyor. Masalan, mana bu aka qadimgi {p:eks}ponat {p:chin}nini uyga {h:almashtiryapti}.
examples: {r:Julia's colleague had to exchange some documents.} - Julianing hamkasbi ba'zi hujjatlarni almashtirishi kerak edi.
{r:The students had been preparing themselves for the exchange program.} - Talabalar almashinuv dasturi uchun o'zlarini tayyorlayotgan edilar.
{r:She wanted to buy the red dress, but she changed her mind and exchanged it for a blue one.} – U qizil ko‘ylakni olmoqchi edi, lekin fikrini o‘zgartirib, uni ko‘kiga almashtirdi.
{r:They held an exchange of prisoners of war.} - Ular urush asirlari almashinuvini o'tkazishdi.

text: {r:Nephew}[ˈnɛfjuː] - o'g'il bola jiyan. Mening {h:jiyanim} soqqali joyda ishlaydi. U {p:NEF}t {p:YU}vish bilan shug'ullanadi.
examples: {r:Nargiza's nephew has received many rewards.} - Nargizaning jiyani ko'plab mukofotlar olgan.
{r:Michael was playing with his nephew's new toy.} - Maykl jiyanining yangi o'yinchoqlari bilan o'ynayotgan edi.
{r:My brother's nephew used to live in a small village.} - Mening akamning jiyani kichik qishloqda yashardi.
{r:You should visit your nephew more often. Understandable?} - Jiyaningni ko'proq ko'rib turishing kerak. Tushunarlimi?
{r:Generally speaking, my nephew is a good guy.} - Umuman olganda jiyanim yaxshi yigit.

text: {r:Top}[tɒp] – yuqori. Futbolchi {p:top}ni shunchalik qattiq tepdiki, {h:yuqori}ga ko’tarildi va qaytib tushmadi.
examples: {r:The top of the building was covered in snow.} - Binoning tepasi qor bilan qoplangan edi.
{r:Anvar has reached the top of his career.} - Anvar o'z faoliyatining eng yuqori cho'qqisiga chiqqan.
{r:The general's office was on the top floor of the building.} - Generalning ofisi binoning eng yuqori qavatida edi.
{r:He keeps his documents in the top drawer.} - U hujjatlarini yuqori tortmada saqlaydi.

text: {r:Page}[peɪdʒ] – sahifa, qog'oz. Tasavvur qiling siz maktabda yo boshqa muassasada {p:beyj}ik o’rniga A4 {h:qog’oz} taqib oldingiz.
examples: {r:The first rule was written on the second page of the book.} - Birinchi qoida kitobning ikkinchi sahifasiga yozilgan edi.
{r:Nargiza had to tear out a page from the old book.} - Nargiza eski kitobdan bir sahifani yirtib olishi kerak edi.
{r:Michael was creating a new design on the page.} - Maykl sahifada yangi dizayn yaratayotgan edi.
{r:The teacher's name was at the top of the page.} - O'qituvchining ismi sahifaning yuqori qismida edi.

text: {r:Best}[bɛst] - eng yaxshi. Men unchalik ham yaxshi yigit emasman. Ikkita sovrinim bor 'Eng yaxshi {p:BEZ}Delnik' va '{h:Eng yaxshi} {p:BEZ}' degan.
examples: {r:My sister's best friend has always been very supportive.} - Mening singlimning eng yaxshi do'sti har doim juda qo'llab-quvvatlovchi bo'lgan.
{r:Michael thinks his brother's toy car is the best.} - Maykl akasining o'yinchoq mashinasi eng yaxshi deb o'ylaydi.
{r:This is writer's best book.} - Bu yozuvchining eng yaxshi kitobi.
[center][b]do/try your best - qo'lidan kelguncha qilmoq, o'zining eng yaxshisini ko'rsatmoq.[/b][/center]
{r:I know the exam is difficult, but just do your best.} – Imtihon qiyinligini bilaman, ammo shunchaki qo‘lingdan kelganicha harakat qil.
{r:We did our best to finish the project on time.} – Loyihani vaqtida tugatish uchun qo‘limizdan kelganini qildik.
{r:We tried our best to help the lost tourist} – Yo‘qolgan sayyohga yordam berishga qo‘limizdan kelganicha harakat qildik.

text: {r:Part}[pɑːrt] – qism, bo’lak. Bolalikda partadoshim qo’llarini keng yozib butun bir partani egallab olardi. Keyinchalik unga faqatgina {p:PART}aning yarim {h:bo’lag}i uniki ekanligini tushuntirdim.
examples: {r:Zokir's part in the project was the best.} - Proyektdagi Zokirning qismi eng yaxshisi edi.
{r:That part was difficult to understand.} - O'sha qismni tushunish qiyin edi.
{r:We won the first part of the match.} - O'yinning birinchi qismini biz yutdik.
{r:This part of the machine was broken.} - Mashinaning bu qismi singan edi.

text: {r:Wall}[wɔːl] – devor. Qoshnimiz bilan har kuni {p:VOL}eybol o’ynaymiz. Faqatgina bizning to’rimiz yoq, to’r o’rniga uyimiz o’rtasidan o’tgan {h:devor}dan foydalanamiz.
examples: {r:The wall was painted blue.} - Devor ko'k rangga bo'yalgan edi.
{r:She hung a picture on the wall.} - U devorga rasm osdi.
{r:The wall was too high to climb.} - Devor o'tish uchun juda baland edi.
{r:They built a wall around the garden.} - Ular bog' atrofida devor qurdilar.

text: {r:Thin}[θɪn] – yupqa, ariq, nozik. Siz bu holatda {h:ariqlashib}, noziklashib ketayotgan {p:SIN}glingizni tasavvur qilsangiz bo’ladi.
examples: {r:Anvar has become very thin after his illness.} - Anvar kasalligidan keyin juda ozg'in bo'lib qolgan.
{r:The ice on the river was too thin to walk on.} - Daryodagi muz yurish uchun juda yupqa edi.
{r:Nargiza should wear a warmer coat; she is very thin.} - Nargiza issiqroq palto kiyishi kerak; u juda ozg'in.
{r:Her brother's cat used to be fat, but now it's thin.} - Uning akasining mushugi semiz edi, lekin hozir ozg'in.

text: {r:Topic}[ˈtɒpɪk] - mavzu, topik.
examples: {r:The discussion's topic was very general.} - Muhokamaning mavzusi juda umumiy edi.
{r:Michael was thinking about a strange topic for his paper.} - Maykl o'z maqolasi uchun g'alati mavzu haqida o'ylayotgan edi.
{r:At first, Ali wanted to write about sports, but he changed his mind and chose another topic.} – Dastlab Ali sport haqida yozmoqchi edi, lekin u fikrini o‘zgartirib, boshqa mavzuni tanladi.
{r:Julia would like to choose an interesting topic for her hobby.} - Julia o'z hobbisi uchun qiziqarli mavzu tanlashni xohlardi.

text:
{r:Tear}[tɪər] – yirtmoq; ko’z yoshi. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - tore, torn. 
'Rosomaxa' filmini ko’rgan bo’lsangiz bosh qaharamonning juda uzun tirnoqlari bor. Tasavvur qiling siz ham unga havas qilib shunday uzun tirnoq o’stirdingiz va hozir bu {p:TIR}noq bilan xohlagan predmetingizni {h:yirtib tashlayapsiz}.
examples: {r:Anvar's clothes had a big tear after the accident.} - Anvarning kiyimlari baxtsiz hodisadan keyin katta yirtiqqa ega edi.
{r:She was wiping a tear from her eye while watching the old movie.} - U eski filmni tomosha qilayotganda ko'zidan yoshini artayotgan edi.
{r:You must not tear this important document.} - Siz bu muhim hujjatni yirtmasligingiz kerak.
{r:Julia used to tear a page from every book she read.} - Julia o'qigan har bir kitobidan bir sahifani yirtardi.
{r:She was angry, tore the paper and began yelling at me.} - U jahldor edi, qog'ozni yirtib tashladi va menga baqirib ketdi.

text: {r:Mix}[mɪks] – aralashmoq; aralashtirmoq. Mevalarni ezib aralashtirib berishda qo’llaniluvchi mikser so’zi aynan shu so’zdan olingan. Lekin siz {p:miks}erda antiqa tajribalar o’tkazasiz. Masalan telefon, kitob, shokolad, tortni mikserga solasizda keyin {h:aralashtirasiz}.
examples: {r:The mix of old and new buildings created confusion.} - Eski va yangi binolarning aralashmasi chalkashlikni keltirib chiqardi.
{r:Michael has mixed up the ingredients for the cake.} - Maykl tort uchun ingredientlarni aralashtirib yuborgan.
{r:Nargiza was mixing the colors for her painting.} - Nargiza o'zining rasmi uchun ranglarni aralashtirayotgan edi.
{r:You should always mix the medicine well before using it.} - Siz dorini ishlatishdan oldin doimo yaxshilab aralashtirishingiz kerak.

text:
{r:Bend}[bɛnd] – egmoq, bukmoq, qayirmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - bent, bent. 
Tasavvur qiling sizga BENTli mashinasini tekinga berishdi. Nega tekinga berib yuborishdi deb yaxshilab tekshirsangiz {p:BENT}li {h:bukilib} qolgan ekan.
examples: {r:Anvar had to bend the metal to fix the engine.} - Anvar motorni tuzatish uchun metallni egishi kerak edi.
{r:The tree was bending in the strong wind last night.} - Daraxt kecha tunda kuchli shamolda egilayotgan edi.
{r:Julia has bent her toy car's wheel by accident.} - Julia o'yinchoq mashinasining g'ildiragini tasodifan egib qo'ygan.
{r:He was very strong and he even could bend the iron.} - U shunchalik kuchli ediki hattoki temirni ham qayira olardi.

text:
{r:Bet}[bɛt] – garov; garov o’ynamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - bet, bet. 
Do’stingiz '{h:garov} o’ynayman sen bilan mana bu to’g’ri' deb aytdi. Siz esa ‘Nimadan o’ynaymiz’ dedingiz. Do’stingiz esa hazil aralash ‘{p:BET}ga tuplashdan’ dedi
examples: {r:Michael has won a big bet on the football match.} - Maykl futbol o'yinida katta garov yutgan.
{r:Nargiza used to make small bets with her friends.} - Nargiza do'stlari bilan kichik garovlar o'ynardi.
{r:I would like to place a bet on our team's success.} - Men jamoamizning muvaffaqiyatiga garov tikishni xohlardim.
{r:Of course, you should not bet all your money.} - Siz albatta barcha pulingizni tikmasligingiz kerak.

text: {r:Creative}[kriˈeɪtɪv] - kreativ, ijodkor. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:Anvar is a very creative artist.} - Anvar juda ijodiy rassom.
{r:Julia's idea was truly creative and impressive.} - Julianing g'oyasi haqiqatan ham ijodiy va ta'sirli edi.
{r:They have created a very creative plan for the new building.} - Ular yangi bino uchun juda kreativ reja yaratganlar.
{r:Firstly, she is attractive, secondly she is relatively creative.} - Birinchidan u jozibador, ikkinchidan u nisbatan kreativroq.

text: {r:Neighborhood}[ˈneɪbərhʊd] - mahalla. Neighbor(qo'shni) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The children of the neighborhood were playing together.} - Mahallaning bolalari birga o'ynayotgan edilar.
{r:Nargiza's family has lived in this neighborhood for many years.} - Nargizaning oilasi bu mahallada ko'p yillar davomida yashagan.
{r:Michael should help keep his neighborhood clean.} - Maykl o'z mahallasini toza tutishga yordam berishi kerak.
{r:The new general of the district was visiting every neighborhood.} - Tumanning yangi generali har bir mahallani ziyorat qilayotgan edi.

text: {r:Talented}[ˈtæləntɪd] - talantli, qobiliyatli.
examples: {r:Anvar is a talented player in the team.} - Anvar jamoada iste'dodli o'yinchi.
{r:Julia has become a very talented artist.} - Julia juda iste'dodli rassom bo'lib qolgan.
{r:Michael's brother is very talented at creating things.} - Mayklning akasi narsalarni yaratishda juda iste'dodli.
{r:We must recognize the talented people in our community.} - Biz jamoamizdagi iste'dodli odamlarni tan olishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Supportive}[səˈpɔːrtɪv] - qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan, yordamini ayamaydigan. Support so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Nargiza's parents are very supportive of her decisions.} - Nargizaning ota-onasi uning qarorlarini juda qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan odamlar.
{r:Michael has always been a supportive colleague.} - Maykl har doim qo'llab-quvvatlovchi hamkasb bo'lgan.
{r:You should be supportive of your friends during their worst times.} - Siz do'stlaringizni eng yomon paytlarida qo'llab-quvvatlashingiz kerak.
{r:You must be supportive of needy people.} - Sen muhtoj odamlardan yordamini ayamaydigan inson bo'lishing kerak.

text: {r:Help}[hɛlp] – yordam; yordam qilmoq. O’zbekistonning issiq yozida har qanday {p:HILP}iraydigan narsa insonga orom va {h:yordam} beradi. Xoh u ventilyator bo’lsin, xoh parrak.
examples: {r:He asked for Michael's help to fix the engine.} - U motorni tuzatish uchun Mayklning yordamini so'radi.
{r:The old man had to ask for help with his heavy bags.} - Keksa odam og'ir sumkalarini ko'tarishda yordam so'rashi kerak edi.
{r:I will do my best to help you.} - Senga yordam berish uchun qo'limdan kelguncha harakat qilaman.
{r:Don't be ashamed to ask for help when you need it.} - Yordamga muhtoj bo'lganingizda yordam so'rashdan uyalmang.

text: {r:Frustrating}[ˈfrʌstreɪtɪn] - xafa qiluvchi, asabiylashtiruvchi. Frustrate so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The delay of the train was very frustrating for everyone.} - Poyezdning kechikishi hamma uchun juda asabiylashtiruvchi edi.
{r:Julia found the homework frustrating and difficult.} - Julia uy vazifasini asabiylashtiruvchi va qiyin deb topdi.
{r:It's frustrating when you have to wait for a long time.} - Uzoq kutishingiz kerak bo'lganda asabiylashasiz.
{r:The children's constant noise was frustrating for their parents.} - Bolalarning doimiy shovqini ota-onalari uchun asabiylashtiruvchi edi(asabiga tegardi).

text: {r:Admiration}[ˌædməˈreɪʃn] - yaxshi ko'rish, mehr, havas, qoyil qolish. Admire(yoqtirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 47 - darsdagi admire ga qarang.
examples: {r:Her determination earned her the admiration of the whole team.} - Uning qat'iyatliligi butun jamoaning mehrini qozondi.
{r:He looked at his teacher with great admiration.} - U o'z o'qituvchisiga katta havas bilan qaradi.
{r:The artist's work brought him much public admiration.} - Rassomning ishi unga ko'p ommaning havasini keltirdi.
{r:Their mutual admiration was clear to everyone.} - Ularning o'zaro mehrlari hammaga aniq edi.

text: {r:Golden}[ˈɡoʊldən] - oltindan qilingan. Gold(oltin) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She wore a beautiful golden necklace for the party.} - U ziyofat uchun chiroyli oltin marjon taqdi.
{r:The golden sunset was a sight of great beauty.} - Oltin quyosh botishi katta go'zallik manzarasi edi.
{r:He won a golden medal in the competition's final match.} - U musobaqa final o'yinida oltin medalni qo'lga kiritdi.
{r:The golden rule of life is to treat others with kindness.} - Hayotning oltin qoidasi - boshqalarga mehribonlik bilan munosabatda bo'lishdir.
{r:We are pleased with gold medals.} - Biz oltin medallardan xursandmiz.

text: {r:Illegal}[ɪˈliːɡl] - noqonuniy, nolegal. Legal so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:It’s illegal to park here.} - Bu yerda mashina qo'yish noqonuniy.
{r:The illegal activity was stopped.} - Noqonuniy faoliyat to'xtatildi.
{r:She was involved in illegal trade.} - U noqonuniy savdoga aralashgan edi.
{r:The illegal act was punished.} - Noqonuniy harakat jazolandi.

text: {r:Impression}[ɪmˈprɛʃn] - taassurot. Impress(taassurot qoldirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 49 - darsdagi impress ga qarang.
examples: {r:She made a good first impression on Michael's family.} - U Mayklning oilasida yaxshi birinchi taassurot qoldirdi.
{r:His speech left a strong impression on the audience.} - Uning nutqi tinglovchilarda kuchli taassurot qoldirdi.
{r:I got the impression that he was very busy with his work.} - Men u o'z ishlari bilan juda band degan taassurotni oldim.
{r:The impression of the old building was lasting in my mind.} - Eski binoning taassuroti mening ongimda uzoq vaqt saqlanib qoldi.

text: {r:Determination}[dɪˌtɜːrmɪˈneɪʃn] - qat'iyat. Determine so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Her strong determination led to the team's success.} - Uning kuchli qat'iyatliligi jamoaning muvaffaqiyatiga olib keldi.
{r:He showed great determination to finish the difficult task.} - U qiyin vazifani bajarishga katta qat'iyatlilik ko'rsatdi.
{r:The determination to win the competition was clear in his eyes.} - Musobaqada g'alaba qozonishga bo'lgan qat'iyatliligi uning ko'zlarida aniq edi.
{r:She faced all challenges with her usual strong determination.} - U barcha qiyinchiliklarni o'zining odatdagi kuchli qat'iyatliligi bilan qabul qildi.

text: {r:Messy}[ˈmɛsi] – tartibsiz, kir, iflos. Men Ronaldoning muxlisiman, Messini esa yoqtirmayman. Hattoki ingliz tilida tarjima qilganda ham {p:MESSI} {h:tartibsiz}, kir degan ma’noni bildiradi.(Messining muxlislari xafa bo'lmang! Bu shunchaki namuna uchun yozildi.)
examples: {r:His room was always messy, full of old toys and books.} - Uning xonasi har doim tartibsiz, eski o'yinchoqlar va kitoblar bilan to'la edi.
{r:Nargiza has a messy desk, but she always knows where everything is.} - Nargizaning tartibsiz stoli bor, lekin u har doim hamma narsa qayerda ekanligini biladi.
{r:The messy situation was hard to fix without help from a friend.} - Tartibsiz vaziyatni do'stdan yordamsiz tuzatish qiyin edi.
{r:The kitchen was looking very messy after their cooking activities.} - Oshxona ularning pishirish ishlaridan keyin juda tartibsiz ko'rinardi.

text: {r:Tool}[tuːl] – asbob, uskuna. {p:Tul}ki hayvonalar olamining eng ayyor vakili. Uning asosiy {h:asbobi} - ayyorlik
examples: {r:The barber uses a special tool to cut hair.} - Sartarosh soch kesish uchun maxsus asboblardan foydalanadi.
{r:The tool was very useful for all of the household's repairs.} - Asbob uy xo'jaligining barcha ta'mirlari uchun juda foydali edi.
{r:She bought a new tool for gardening, which was very efficient.} - U bog'bonchilik uchun juda samarali yangi asbob sotib oldi.
{r:The hammer was missing from the toolbox, which was a big problem.} - Bolg'a asboblar qutisida yo'q edi va bu katta muammo edi.

text: {r:Duck}[dʌk] – o’rdak. Eng mashhur {h:o’rdak} bu Donald {p:DAK}.
examples: {r:The duck swam quickly in the river.} - O'rdak daryoda tezda suzdi.
{r:She fed the ducks at the park every morning.} - U har kuni ertalab parkdagi o'rdaklarga ovqat berardi.
{r:The duck's loud sound surprised the children.} - O'rdakning baland tovushi bolalarni hayratda qoldirdi.
{r:My cat used to chase the ducks when they came into the garden.} - Mening mushugim bog'ga kelganida o'rdaklarni quvlab yurardi.

text: {r:Carrot}[ˈkærət] - sabzi. Meni itim rosa manman, {p:KER}ilgan {p:IT.} Osh bersam nozlanib 'menga keyingi safar {h:sabzi}siz osh tayyorla' deydi.
examples: {r:She cut a carrot for the soup.} - U sho'rva uchun sabzi to'g'radi.
{r:Probably they can lend me a few carrots.} - Balki ular menga bir nechta sabzi berib turar.
{r:He planted a carrot in his garden.} - U bog'iga sabzi ekdi.
{r:Anvar's favorite cake is carrot cake.} - Anvarning sevimli torti sabzili tortdir.

text: {r:Hammer}[ˈhæmər] - bolg'a. Agar lag'mon tayyorlasam hamirni qo'lda yumshatmayman. Bira to'la {p:HAMIR}ni {h:bolg'a}da urib yumshataman.
examples: {r:He used a hammer to hit a nail.} - U mixni urish uchun bolg'a ishlatdi.
{r:A hammer can be heavy.} - Bolg'a og'ir bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:Julia bought a new hammer for her house.} - Julia uyi uchun yangi bolg'a sotib oldi.
{r:A hammer was missing, so he could not fix the bench.} - Bolg'a yo'q edi, shuning uchun u skameykni tuzata olmadi.

text: {r:Private}[ˈpraɪvət] – shaxsiy. Men praynik tayyorlayman. {p:Pray}nikka {p:vit}aminlar solaman va yeyman. Bu mening {h:shaxsiy} prayniklarim.
examples: {r:She has a private office.} - Uning shaxsiy ofisi bor.
{r:It was a private meeting.} - Bu shaxsiy yig'ilish edi.
{r:He needs a private time for himself.} - U o'zi uchun shaxsiy vaqtga muhtoj.
{r:A private beach is good for relaxation.} - Shaxsiy plyaj dam olish uchun yaxshi.

text: {r:Autumn}[ˈɔːtəm] - kuz. {p:O'TIN} to'plab qo'yishim kerak {h:kuz}ga. Chunki katta to'y qilaman va osh bilan sho'rpa qilishimga ko'p o'tin kerak.
examples: {r:In autumn, leaves turn yellow.} - Kuzda barglar sarg'ayadi.
{r:She loves an autumn walk.} - U kuzgi sayrni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:An autumn day can be cool.} - Kuzgi kun salqin bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They saw beautiful scenery in autumn.} - Ular kuzda go'zal manzarani ko'rishdi.

text:
{r:Lay}[leɪ] – qo’ymoq, solmoq, joylamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - laid, laid. 
Chet elga ketayotganimda {p:lay}cha itimni ham o’zim bilan olib ketishni xohladim. Uni korobkaga {h:joyladim}, lekin aeroportda sezib qolishdi va u Toshkentda qoldi. Siz bunday ishni takrorlamang.
examples: {r:She laid a book on the table.} - U stolga kitob qo'ydi.
{r:He laid a strong foundation for the building.} - U bino uchun mustahkam poydevor qo'ydi.
{r:A hen has laid an egg every day.} - Tovuq har kuni tuxum qo'yadi.
{r:They were laying a new carpet in the room.} - Ular xonaga yangi gilam yotqizayotgan edilar.

text: {r:Kneel}[niːl] – tiz cho’kmoq, cho’kkalamoq. Mana bu {p:NIL}ufar ismli qizning bo’yi 3 metr. Odamlar uni ko’rsa {h:cho’kkalab qoladi.}
examples: {r:He knelt down to tie a shoe.} - U poyabzal bog'ichini bog'lash uchun tiz cho'kdi.
{r:She knelt for a prayer.} - U ibodat qilish uchun tiz cho'kdi.
{r:They knelt in front of a mirror to show respect.} - Ular hurmat ko'rsatish uchun oyna oldida tiz cho'kdilar.
{r:A knight used to kneel before the king.} - Ritsar qirol oldida tiz cho'kardi.

text: {r:Deal}[diːl] – kelishuv. Katta reklama ishi bo’yicha {p:Dil}i Mi bilan {h:kelishuvimiz} bor.
examples: {r:They made a good deal to share the profits from petrol sales.} - Ular benzin sotuvidan foydani bo'lishish uchun yaxshi kelishuv tuzdilar.
{r:Finally he got a great deal on the car, which was a pleasant surprise.} - Nihoyat u mashinani juda yaxshi narxda oldi, bu yoqimli syurpriz edi.
{r:The deal was finalized yesterday afternoon after long discussions.} - Kelishuv kecha tushdan keyin uzoq muhokamalardan so'ng yakunlandi.
{r:Our lawyer handled the deal professionally, ensuring a fair outcome.} - Bizning advokatimiz kelishuvni professional tarzda hal qildi, adolatli natijani ta'minladi.

text: {r:Blood}[blʌd] – qon. Kun isib ketdi. Shunday kunlardan birida do’stimning burni {h:qonab} ketdi va u hammaning oldida {p:‘’bilad’’} deb so’kinib yubordi.
examples: {r:He continuously donated blood at the hospital to help others.} - U boshqalarga yordam berish uchun kasalxonada doimiy qon topshirdi.
{r:The blood test was normal, which made everyone happy.} - Qon testi normal edi, bu esa barchani xursand qildi.
{r:She wiped the blood from the cut on her finger.} - U barmog'idagi kesilgan joydan qonni artdi.
{r:The doctor quickly stopped the blood flow from the wound.} - Doktor yaradan qon oqimini tezda to'xtatdi.

text: {r:Accommodation}[əˌkɒməˈdeɪʃn] - turar-joy, bino, inshoot, qo'rg'on. Kecha akamning uyiga borib keldim. Kenoyim idishlarni yuvmaydi shekilli chang bo'lib ketibdi. {p:AKAMI IDISHI} suvaraklarning {h:yashash joyiga} aylanibdi.
examples: {r:They found comfortable accommodation near the city center.} - Ular shahar markazi yaqinida qulay turar-joy topdilar.
{r:The accommodation was very comfortable, with all the necessary amenities.} - Turar-joy juda qulay edi, barcha kerakli qulayliklar bilan.
{r:My only concern is the accommodation price.} - Mening yagona tashvishim bu turar-joy narxi.
{r:This accommodation satisfies our demands.} - Bu turar-joy talablarimizni qondiradi.

text: {r:Affect}[əˈfɛkt] – ta’sir qilmoq(asosan negativ ta'sirlar uchun).
examples: {r:The weather can greatly affect your mood and energy.} - Ob-havo sizning kayfiyatingizga va energiyangizga juda ta'sir qilishi mumkin.
{r:His words deeply affected her, making her think for days.} - Uning so'zlari unga chuqur ta'sir qildi, uni kunlar davomida o'ylashga majbur qildi.
{r:Lack of sleep always affects productivity in the workplace.} - Uyqusizlik ish joyida unumdorlikka har doim ta'sir qiladi.
{r:The new law will affect many businesses, big and small.} - Yangi qonun ko'plab bizneslarga, ham kattasiga, ham kichigiga ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

text: {r:bucket}[ˈbʌkɪt] – paqir, chelak, satil. Mana bu {p:BAK}ka {p:IT}ni solib yuborsangiz u bak {h:chelakka} aylanib qoladi.
examples: {r:Anvar filled the bucket with water for the plants.} - Anvar o'simliklar uchun chelakni suv bilan to'ldirdi.
{r:Our dog loves to play with a small bucket in the garden.} - Bizning itimiz bog'da kichik chelak bilan o'ynashni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:The painter used a bucket to mix the colors.} - Rassom ranglarni aralashtirish uchun chelakdan foydalandi.
{r:Julia carried a bucket of fresh apples from the garden.} - Julia meva bog'idan bir chelak yangi olmalar olib keldi.

text: {r:envelope}[ˈɛnvələʊp] – konvert. Qishloqdagi do’stim Anvardan konvertda xat keldi. {h:Konvert} ustida {p:ANV}ar{p: LOP}atka ushlab turgan rasmi tushurilgan edi.
examples: {r:She stamped the envelope carefully before mailing it.} - U konvertni pochta orqali jo'natishdan oldin diqqat bilan muhrladi.
{r:My sister wrote the address on the envelope.} - Mening opam konvertga manzilni yozdi.
{r:The journalist opened the envelope containing sensitive information.} - Jurnalist maxfiy ma'lumotlarni o'z ichiga olgan konvertni ochdi.
{r:John needs an envelope for his important documents.} - Jon muhim hujjatlari uchun konvertga muhtoj.

text: {r:island}[ˈaɪlənd] – orol. Dubaydagi Palma shaklidagi sun’iy orollar haqida eshitgan bo’lsangiz kerak. Hozir ular Palma oroli yonidan {p:AYLAN}a shaklida boshqa bitta {h:orol} qurishyapti.
examples: {r:They spent their holiday on a small, secluded island.} - Ular dam olishlarini kichik, chekka orolda o'tkazdilar.
{r:Our country has many beautiful islands.} - Bizning mamlakatimiz ko'plab chiroyli orollarga ega.
{r:The scientists discovered a new species on the remote island.} - Olimlar olis orolda yangi tur topdilar.
{r:The cat seemed to think the sofa was its own private island.} - Mushuk divanni o'zining shaxsiy oroli deb o'ylayotganga o'xshardi.

text: {r:piece}[piːs] - bo'lak, qism. Pista chaqishni yaxshi ko'raman. Lekin xotinim 'hamma yerni iflos qilyapsiz' deb janjal qiladi. Shuning uchun pistaxo'rlikdan so'ng {p:PIS}taning {h:mayda} bo'laklarigacha yig'ishtirib qo'yaman.
examples: {r:She gave her friend a piece of her favorite chocolate.} - U do'stiga o'zining sevimli shokoladidan bir bo'lak berdi.
{r:My brother accidentally broke the vase into many small pieces.} - Mening akam tasodifan vazani ko'plab kichik bo'laklarga sindirib qo'ydi.
{r:I repeatedly asked for the piece of cake.} - Men qayta-qayta to'rt bo'lagini so'radim.
{r:An elephant ate the piece of bread.} - Fil non bo'lagini yedi.

text: {r:bowl}[bəʊl] – kosa, qadah. Kosalaringizni hovlida qoldirib ketdingiz. It mushuklar esa {h:kosa}laringizga {p:bovul} qilib ketishdi.
examples: {r:He ate a large bowl of moshhorda for breakfast.} - U nonushtaga katta kosada moshxo'rda yedi.
{r:Our grandmother always serves palov in a beautiful ceramic bowl.} - Bizning buvimiz doimo palovni chiroyli keramik kosada tortadi.
{r:The dog eagerly waited for its food in its new bowl.} - It yangi kosasida ovqatini intizorlik bilan kutardi.
{r:I apologize for breaking your bowl.} - Kosangizni sindirib qo'yganligim uchun uzr so'rayman.

text: {r:perfume}[ˈpɜːfjuːm] - atir. {p:PERF}ekt{p:YUM} mobayl aloqa operatorini eslaysizmi? Ucell va Beeline ning asosiy raqibatchisi bo'lgan bu kompaniya keyinchalik bu biznesdan chiqib ketdi va hozirgi kunda {h:atir} sotish bilan shug'ullanmoqda.
examples: {r:She received a bottle of expensive perfume as a gift.} - U sovg'a sifatida qimmat atir shishasini oldi.
{r:I suggest you buying French perfume.} - Men senga fransuz atirini sotib olishni tavsiya qilaman.
{r:The celebrity created her own brand of perfumes.} - Mashhur yulduz o'zining shaxsiy atir brendiga asos soldi.
{r:He bought his wife a special perfume for their anniversary.} - U xotiniga yubileylari uchun maxsus atir sotib oldi.

text: {r:furniture}[ˈfɜːnɪtʃər] - mebel. Mana bu {h:mebel}ni sotib olsangiz maza qilasiz. Ichiga {p:FANAR CHIR}oq o'rnatilgan. Svet o'chib qolgan payt avtomaticheskiy yonadi va xonangizni charog'on qilib yuradi.
examples: {r:They are buying new furniture for their house next month.} - Ular kelasi oy uylari uchun yangi mebel sotib olishmoqda.
{r:Our cat loves to scratch the old furniture.} - Bizning mushukimiz eski mebellarni tirnashni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:He measured the height of the door before buying the furniture.} - U mebel sotib olishdan oldin eshikning balandligini o'lchadi.
{r:This newspaper is about modern furniture. I will read it later.} - Bu gazeta zamonaviy mebellar haqida. Men uni keyinroq o'qiyman.

text: {r:soap}[səʊp] – sovun. Men har oy {p:SOVOP} bo’ladi deya musorkada ishlaydiganlarga va kambag’al odamlarga {h:sovun} tarqatib chiqaman. Chunki ular orasida gigiyenaga amal qilinmasligi kasalliklar keltirib chiqaradi.
examples: {r:She uses a special soap for her face.} - U yuzi uchun maxsus sovun ishlatadi.
{r:Michael hates using soap for hair.} - Maykl sovunni soch uchun ishlatishni yomon ko'radi.
