{r:A doctor recommended an antibacterial soap for the following reasons.} - Doktor quyidagi sabablar tufayli antibakterial sovunni tavsiya qildi.
{r:Anvar bought a new soap for the guest bathroom.} - Anvar mehmon hammomi uchun yangi sovun sotib oldi.

text:
{r:guide}[ɡaɪd] – yo’riqnoma; sayohat payti yo’l ko’rsatuvchi gid; yo'l-yo'riq bermoq. 
Sayohat payti shunchalik qusgingiz keldiki oxiri joy topolmay sayohat {h:yo’riqnomasiga} {p:QAYD} qildingiz.
examples: {r:Our guide told us that we must wear sunglasses because of sunny weather.} - Bizning gidimiz quyoshli havo tufayli ko'zoynak taqishimiz lozimligini aytdi.
{r:This travel guide has good tips for Rome.} - Bu sayohat yo'riqnomasi Rim uchun yaxshi maslahatlar beradi.
{r:A teacher can guide students with hard ideas.} - O'qituvchi qiyin g'oyalar bilan talabalarga yo'l ko'rsatishi mumkin.
{r:Nargiza asked a local guide to find the waterfall.} - Nargiza mahalliy giddan sharsharani topishni so'radi.

text: {r:expression}[ɪkˈsprɛʃn] - ifoda etish. Express(ifoda etmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Her expression of joy was clear.} - Uning quvonch ifodasi aniq edi.
{r:Michael has a serious expression when he works.} - Maykl ishlayotganda jiddiy ifodaga ega bo'ladi.
{r:An artist tries to show the true expression of a person.} - Rassom odamning haqiqiy ifodasini ko'rsatishga harakat qiladi.
{r:You can see expression of my thoughts in this book.} - Bu kitobda mening o'ylarim ifodasini ko'rishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:shampoo}[ʃæmˈpuː] - shampun
examples: {r:She changed her mind and bought two bottles of shampoo instead of one} – U fikrini o‘zgartirdi va bitta emas, ikkita shampun sotib oldi.
{r:My brother always forgets to buy shampoo.} - Mening akam doimo shampun sotib olishni unutadi.
{r:A hotel gives small shampoo bottles to guests.} - Mehmonxona mehmonlarga kichik shampun shishalari beradi.
{r:Our dog needs a special shampoo for its skin.} - Bizning itimizga terisi uchun maxsus shampun kerak.

text: {r:partner}[ˈpɑːtnər] - sherik, partnyor. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:She found a good business partner for her new plan.} - U o'zining yangi rejasi uchun yaxshi biznes sherik topdi.
{r:His wife is his best partner in life.} - Uning xotini hayotda eng yaxshi sherigi.
{r:I hate my business partner because he is a liar} - Men biznes sherigimdan nafratlanaman chunki u yolg'onchi.
{r:A buyer wanted a long-term partner for trade.} - Xaridor savdo uchun uzoq muddatli sherik qidirdi.

text: {r:disappear}[ˌdɪsəˈpɪər] - yo'qolib qolmoq, g'oyib bo'lmoq. Bu so'z appear(paydo bo'lmoq) ning oldiga dis- inkor predlogi qo'yish bilan yasaladi.
examples: {r:The magician made a rabbit disappear.} - Sehrgar quyonni g'oyib qildi.
{r:My cat often disappears under the bed.} - Mening mushugim ko'pincha kravat ostida g'oyib bo'ladi.
{r:Old traditions are starting to disappear.} - Eski an'analar yo'qolib bormoqda.
{r:The sun will soon disappear behind the mountains.} - Quyosh tez orada tog'lar ortida g'oyib bo'ladi.

text: {r:value}[ˈvæljuː] – qadrlamoq;qadr. Amakimga velik olib berdim. Ular esa juda xursand bo’ldilar va shunday dedi ‘’{p:VEL}ikni {p:YU}mshoq o’rindig’i bor ekan, maza qilib minayapman, {h:qadrlaganing} uchun rahmat’’
examples: {r:She values her family and friends a lot.} - U oilasini va do'stlarini juda qadrlaydi.
{r:The market value of the house increased.} - Uyning bozor qiymati oshdi.
{r:Michael understands the value of being honest.} - Maykl halol bo'lishning qadrini tushunadi.
{r:She did her best in the exam, and the teacher valued her effort} – U imtihonda qo‘lidan kelganini qildi va o‘qituvchi uning mehnatini qadrladi.

text: {r:difference}[ˈdɪfrəns] - farq. Differ(farqlanmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:There's a big difference in their ideas.} - Ularning g'oyalarida katta farq bor.
{r:She couldn't tell the difference between the two cars.} - U ikki mashina o'rtasidagi farqni ayta olmadi.
{r:What is the difference between profit and income?} - Foyda va daromadning o'rtasidagi farq nima?
{r:A scientist saw a small difference in the results.} - Olim natijalarda kichik farqni ko'rdi.

text: {r:pupil}[ˈpjuːpl] - o'quvchi.
examples: {r:A young pupil raised a hand to answer.} - Yosh o'quvchi javob berish uchun qo'l ko'tardi.
{r:Our teacher thinks every pupil can do well.} - Bizning o'qituvchimiz har bir o'quvchi yaxshi o'qiy oladi deb o'ylaydi.
{r:Anvar is a smart pupil at math.} - Anvar matematikadan aqlli o'quvchi.
{r:I used to be a selfish pupil in my childhood.} - Bolaligimda juda xudbin o'quvchi bo'lar edim.

text: {r:sleepless}[ˈsliːpləs] - uyqusiz. Sleep(uyqu) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She spent a sleepless night worrying about her exam.} - U imtihoni haqida tashvishlanib uyqusiz tun o'tkazdi.
{r:My sister had sleepless nights when she had a baby.} - Mening singlim farzandli bo'lganida uyqusiz tunlarni boshidan o'tkazdi.
{r:A lawyer had a sleepless night for the big trial.} - Advokat katta sud jarayoni uchun uyqusiz tun o'tkazdi.
{r:The construction noise caused a sleepless night.} - Qurilish shovqini uyqusiz tunga sabab bo'ldi.

text: {r:summer}[ˈsʌmər] – yoz. {p:Samar}qandga {h:yozda} borganman shunchalik issiq ediki, kuniga 10 litr suv ichganman.
examples: {r:They plan to travel in the mountains next summer.} - Ular kelasi yoz tog'larga sayohat qilishni rejalashtirmoqda.
{r:Our family spends summer holidays at the beach.} - Bizning oilamiz yozgi ta'tillarni plyajda o'tkazadi.
{r:A country has hot summers and cool winters.} - Mamlakatda issiq yozlar va salqin qishlar bo'ladi.
{r:Julia loves the long, sunny days of summer.} - Julia yozning uzun, quyoshli kunlarini yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:It is not necessary to wear gloves. It is a lovely summer now!} - Qo'lqoplar kiyish zarurat emas. Hozir sevimli yoz fasli!

text: {r:grape}[ɡreɪp] - uzum.
examples: {r:She ate a sweet grape from a bunch.} - U bir tup uzumdan shirin uzum donasini olib yedi.
{r:My uncle's farm grows lovely green grapes.} - Mening amakimning fermasida ajoyib yashil uzumlar o'sadi.
{r:Children love eating red grapes as a snack.} - Bolalar qizil uzumni tamaddi sifatida yeyishni yaxshi ko'radilar.
{r:A buyer checked the quality of each grape.} - Xaridor har bir uzumning sifatini tekshirdi.

text: {r:importance}[ɪmˈpɔːtəns] - ahamiyat, muhimlik. Important(muhim) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He spoke about the importance of finishing on time.} - U o'z vaqtida tugatishning ahamiyati haqida gapirdi.
{r:My mother taught me the importance of being attentive.} - Mening onam menga diqqatli bo'lishning ahamiyatini o'rgatgan.
{r:A scientist showed the importance of their findings.} - Olim o'z kashfiyotlarining ahamiyatini ko'rsatdi.
{r:Leaders discussed the importance of a new trade deal.} - Rahbarlar yangi savdo kelishuvining ahamiyatini muhokama qildilar.

text: {r:ceiling}[ˈsiːlɪŋ] – potolok, shift. Tasavvur qiling {h:potolok}ka {p:SILIN}dr shaklidaga Xitoy chiroqlarini o’rnatdingiz va uyingiz go’zallashib ketdi.
examples: {r:The ceiling in our house has nice designs.} - Uyimizning shiftida chiroyli naqshlar bor.
{r:A painter carefully painted the high ceiling.} - Rassom baland shiftni diqqat bilan bo'yadi.
{r:Julia installed a new light on her bedroom ceiling.} - Julia yotoqxonasining shiftiga yangi chiroq o'rnatdi.
{r:Look up at the ceiling; there's a small spiderweb.} - Shiftga qarang; kichik o'rgimchak to'ri bor.

text: {r:carpet}[ˈkɑːpɪt] – gilam. Tasavvur qiling {p:KAR}am {p:PIT}i xuddi ipak qurtidek ip yigirib {h:gilam} to’qiy olarkan.
examples: {r:She chose a soft carpet for the living room.} - U mehmonxona uchun yumshoq gilam tanladi.
{r:Our dog loves to sleep on the warm carpet.} - Bizning itimiz issiq gilamda uxlashni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:A buyer wanted a strong carpet for busy areas.} - Xaridor ko'p yuriladigan joylar uchun mustahkam gilam xohladi.
{r:The old carpet in the hallway needs to be changed.} - Koridordagi eski gilamni almashtirish kerak.
{r:Be careful not to spill your coffee on the new carpet.} - Yangi gilamga qahvangizni to'kib yubormaslikka ehtiyot bo'ling.

text: {r:bathroom}[ˈbɑːθruːm] – vanna, hammom. {p:BAS}takor {p:RUM}kaga aroq quyib rosa ichdi va keyin rosa musiqa ijro etdi. Lekin xotini kelayotganini eshitgan bastakor yugurib {h:hammom}ga kirib muzdek dush qabul qilib oldi va kayfi tarqab ketdi. Xotiningizdan qo’rqsangiz ichmang.
examples: {r:The hotel's bathroom was clean and big.} - Mehmonxona hammomi toza va katta edi.
{r:My sister always spends a lot of time in the bathroom.} - Mening opam hammomda doimo ko'p vaqt o'tkazadi.
{r:A plumber was called to fix a leak in the bathroom sink.} - Hammom rakovinasidan suv oqishini tuzatish uchun santexnik chaqirildi.
{r:Michael cleaned the bathroom before his guests arrived.} - Maykl mehmonlari kelishidan oldin hammomni tozaladi.

text: {r:flat}[flæt] – tekis, silliq, yassi. Siz tanigan da{p:VLAT} ismli inson Yer sayyorasi dumaloq emas {h:tekis} deb o’ylaydi.
examples: {r:10% of Earth population still believes that Earth is flat.} - Yer shari aholisining 10% hali ham yer yassi ekanligiga ishonishadi.
{r:The screen of my phone is flat.} - Telefonim ekrani silliq.
{r:A painter used a flat brush for the background.} - Rassom fon uchun yassi cho'tkadan foydalandi.
{r:The road was flat, making cycling easy.} - Yo'l tekis edi, bu velosipedda yurishni osonlashtirdi.

text: {r:straight}[streɪt] – to’g’ri, to’ppa-to’g’ri; dangal, rostgo’y. Futbolchilarimiz yaxshi o’ynamayapti. Ularning faqat kartadagi o’yinlari yaxshi chiqyapti. Shuning uchun ichki ishlari xodimlari to’g’ri {p:ST}adionga {p:REYD} uyushtirib futbolchilarni {h:to’g’ri} paxta dalalariga haydash kerak yozuvchi Tohir Malik aytganidek.
examples: {r:The path to the lake is straight through the forest.} - Ko'lga boradigan yo'l o'rmon orqali to'g'ri.
{r:Her sister has long, straight hair.} - Uning opasining uzun, to'g'ri sochlari bor.
{r:A judge asked the witness to answer straight.} - Sudya guvohdan to'g'ri javob berishni so'radi.
{r:I went straight to the school.} - Men to'g'ri maktabga bordim.

text: {r:turn}[tɜːn] – aylanmoq. Gollivud kinolarida ko’rgan bo’lsangiz kerak. Tornado payti qattiq shamol ta’sirida har xil narsalar, jismlar {p:TORN}ado bo’ylab {h:aylanadi}.
examples: {r:Of course, it's Julia's turn to choose the movie.} - Kinoni tanlash navbati albatta Juliada.
{r:The car made a sharp turn to the street.} - Mashina ko'chaga keskin burildi.
{r:The car's wheels are turning because of the engine.} - Mashinaning balonlari aylanyapti motori tufayli.
{r:Turn your head.} - Boshingni o'gir.

text: {r:helpful}[ˈhɛlpfʊl] - yordam beradigan, yordamchi, foydali. Help(yordam bermoq) so'ziddan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Our translator is a helpful guy.} - Tarjimonimiz juda odamga foydasi tegadigan yigit.
{r:This new software is very helpful for data.} - Bu yangi dastur ma'lumotlar uchun juda foydali.
{r:My uncle gave me helpful advice about my career.} - Mening amakim karyera tanlovlarim haqida foydali maslahat berdi.
{r:Anvar's guide gave helpful tips.} - Anvarning gidi foydali maslahatlar berdi.

text: {r:spring}[sprɪŋ] - bahor. Agar qishda qor yog'sa supurgini olib chiqib qorni {p:SPIRING} shunda issiq kunlar tezda boshlanib {h:bahor} keladi.
examples: {r:You can see the sun in spring.} - Quyoshni bahorda ko'rishing mumkin.
{r:Our country's weather in spring is nice.} - Bizning mamlakatimizda bahor ob-havosi yoqimli bo'ladi.
{r:Julia loves the fresh air of spring.} - Julia bahorning toza havosini yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:Children are excited for spring break.} - Bolalar bahorgi ta'tilni intiqlik bilan kutishmoqda.

text: {r:stomach}[ˈstʌmək] – oshqozon, qozon. Men dunyodagi eng ajoyib {p:STOMA}tolo{p:G}man. Agar qo’ydirayotgan tishingizni adashib yutib yuborsangiz men qo’limni tiqib {h:oshqozoningizdan} o’sha yasama tishni olib beraman.
examples: {r:He had a stomach pain after eating too much.} - U juda ko'p ovqatlangandan keyin qorin og'rig'i boshlandi.
{r:My dog has a big stomach.} - Mening itim katta oshqozonga ega.
{r:A doctor examined the patient's stomach.} - Doktor bemorning oshqozonini tekshirdi.
{r:It's important to listen to your stomach.} - Oshqozoningizga quloq solish muhim.

text: {r:elder}[ˈɛldər] – kattaroq, katta(yosh), kattalar. {p:Eldor} Shomurodov keyingi yil 30 yoshga to’ladi va terma jamoaning eng {h:katta} futbolchilaridan biriga aylanadi.
examples: {r:She respects her elder brother.} - U o'zining katta akasini hurmat qiladi.
{r:An elder of the village told stories.} - Qishloqning kattasi hikoyalar aytib berdi.
{r:My grandmother is the elder in our family.} - Mening buvim oilamizning kattasi.
{r:We should listen to our elders' wisdom.} - Biz kattalarimizning donoligiga quloq solishimiz kerak.
{r:He was always respectful towards his elders and teachers.} - U har doim o'zining kattalariga va o'qituvchilariga hurmatli edi.

text: {r:grey}[ɡreɪ] – kulrang. Tasavvur qiling siz ishlatayotgan {p:kley} {h:kulrang}da. Yopishtirish uchun ishlatilgan narsalarni hammasini kulrang qilib tashlayapti.
examples: {r:The sky turned grey before the storm.} - Bo'ron boshlanishidan oldin osmon kulrangga aylandi.
{r:His hair is starting to turn grey.} - Uning sochlari kulrangga aylana boshladi.
{r:My cat has a beautiful grey and white coat.} - Mening mushugimning chiroyli kulrang va oq mo'ynasi bor.
{r:A painter chose a grey color for the wall.} - Rassom devor uchun kulrang rangni tanladi.

text: {r:average}[ˈævərɪdʒ] - o'rtacha. Semizlikdan azob chekardim. Bir do'stimning tavsiyasi bilan {p:OBRICH} aylantirishni boshladim va {h:o'rtacha} bo'lib qoldim.
examples: {r:The average student scored high on the test.} - O'rtacha o'quvchi testda yuqori ball oldi.
{r:Our team's average performance got better.} - Bizning jamoamizning o'rtacha ko'rsatkichi yaxshilandi.
{r:A journalist reported on the average income.} - Jurnalist o'rtacha daromad haqida xabar berdi.
{r:The doctor said his blood pressure was average.} - Doktor uning qon bosimi o'rtacha ekanligini aytdi.

text: {r:neck}[nɛk] – bo’yin. Tasavvur qiling tarakanlar sizning {h:bo’yn}ingizda {p:NEK}siya minib yurishibdi.
examples: {r:She wore a necklace around her neck.} - U bo'yniga marjon taqdi.
{r:He had a pain on his neck.} - Uning bo'ynida og'riq bor.
{r:A giraffe has a very long neck.} - Jirafa juda uzun bo'yinli.
{r:The doctor checked his neck for swelling.} - Doktor uning bo'ynida shishish bor-yo'qligini tekshirdi.

text: {r:insurance}[ɪnˈʃʊərəns] - sug'urta, straxovka. 'Sug'urta haqida insho yozing' deyishdi maktabimizda. {p:INSHOYIZ} yaxshi chiqsa tekin {h:sug'urta} berishar ekan.
examples: {r:He bought car insurance for his new car.} - U o'zining yangi mashinasi uchun avtomobil sug'urtasini sotib oldi.
{r:Our country needs health insurance for all people.} - Bizning mamlakatimiz barcha odamlar uchun tibbiy sug'urtani talab qiladi.
{r:A lawyer explained the life insurance terms.} - Advokat hayot sug'urtasi shartlarini tushuntirdi.
{r:Nargiza is considering home insurance options.} - Nargiza uy sug'urtasi variantlarini ko'rib chiqmoqda.

text: {r:patience}[ˈpeɪʃns] - sabr. Patient(sabrli) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She showed great patience while teaching.} - U o'rgatayotganda katta sabr-toqat ko'rsatdi.
{r:My grandfather advised patience in hard times.} - Mening bobom qiyin paytlarda sabr-toqatli bo'lishni maslahat berardi.
{r:A doctor needs much patience with children.} - Doktorga bolalar bilan ishlash uchun juda katta sabr-toqat kerak.
{r:Learning a language needs a lot of patience.} - Til o'rganish juda ko'p sabr-toqatni talab qiladi.

text: {r:violent}[ˈvaɪələnt] – zo’ravon, zolim, notinch. Men ayollar lentasidan uy qurgandim qishloq joyda. {p:VAY}rona qilishdi {p:LENT}alarimni {h:zo’ravon} odamlar. Men bu lentali uyni qurish uchun 20 000 ta lenta ishlatgandim. Hammasi bekorga ketdi.
examples: {r:The news reported a violent storm.} - Yangiliklar kuchli bo'ron haqida xabar berdi.
{r:He warned his friend about violent video games.} - U do'stini zo'ravon video o'yinlardan ogohlantirdi.
{r:This city has many violent criminals.} - Bu shaharda ko'plab zo'ravon jinoyatchilar bor.
{r:The movie was criticized for its violent scenes.} - Film zo'ravon sahnalari uchun tanqid qilindi.

text: {r:justice}[ˈdʒʌstɪs] – adolat. Dunyoning ko’p davlatlarida isiriq narkotik moddalar ro’yxatiga kiritilgan. Amerikada shamollashdan tuzalish uchun isiriq ishlatgan Justin Biber qamalibdi. {p:JUST}in {p:IS}iriqni faqatgina tumovga qarshi vosita sifatida foydalangani aytib suddan {h:‘’adolat’’} so’rayapti.
examples: {r:The lawyer fought for justice for her client.} - Advokat o'z mijozining adolati uchun kurashdi.
{r:Our country's legal system aims for justice.} - Bizning mamlakatimizning huquqiy tizimi adolatni ta'minlashga qaratilgan.
{r:Michael believes true justice comes from peace.} - Maykl haqiqiy adolat tinchlikdan keladi deb hisoblaydi.
{r:A journalist reported on efforts to bring justice.} - Jurnalist adolatni ta'minlash bo'yicha harakatlar haqida xabar berdi.
{r:Justice is dependent on honest judges.} - Adolat halol sudyalarga bog'liq.

text: {r:colorful}[ˈkʌlərfəl] - rang-barang. Color(rang) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The garden was filled with colorful flowers.} - Bog' rang-barang gullar bilan to'la edi.
{r:She loves wearing colorful clothes.} - U rang-barang kiyimlarni kiyishni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:A painter used a very colorful palette.} - Rassom juda rang-barang palitradan foydalandi.
{r:Children enjoyed the colorful balloons.} - Bolalar rang-barang sharlarni yoqtirdilar.

text: {r:shark}[ʃɑːrk] – akula. Tasavvur qiling siz ulkan akvariumda suzib yurgan {h:akula}ga ovqat sifatida {p:SHARIK}larni beryapsiz.
examples: {r:A documentary showed a great white shark.} - Hujjatli film ulkan oq akulani ko'rsatdi.
{r:My uncle studies sharks.} - Mening amakim akulalarni o'rganadi.
{r:A scientist warned swimmers about a shark.} - Olim suzuvchilarni akula borligi haqida ogohlantirdi.
{r:The fishermen saw a big shark near their boat.} - Baliqchilar qayiqlari yaqinida katta akulani payqashdi.

text: {r:church}[tʃɜːrtʃ] - cherkov. O'zbekistonda eng katta xristianlik {h:cherkov}i {p:CHIRCH}iqda.
examples: {r:They go to church every Sunday.} - Ular har yakshanba cherkovga boradilar.
{r:Our grandmother often visits the old church to pray.} - Bizning buvimiz ko'pincha ibodat qilish uchun eski cherkovga tashrif buyuradi.
{r:A historical church has nice windows.} - Tarixiy cherkovda chiroyli oynalar bor.
{r:The painter portrayed the peaceful church.} - Rassom tinch cherkovni aks ettirdi.
{r:Smoking is not allowed inside the church.} - Cherkov ichida chekish taqiqlanadi.

text: {r:apartment}[əˈpɑːrtmənt] - kvartira, xonadon. Mana bu {p:APPARAT MET}allni kesadi va kesilgan bo'laklardan {h:kvartira} quradi.
examples: {r:She rented a small apartment in the city center.} - U shahar markazida kichik kvartira ijaraga oldi.
{r:My brother recently moved into a new apartment with his wife.} - Mening akam yaqinda xotini bilan yangi kvartiraga ko'chib o'tdi.
{r:The buyer was interested in a spacious apartment with a balcony.} - Xaridor balkonga ega keng kvartiraga qiziqardi.
{r:John is looking for an apartment closer to his workplace.} - Jon ish joyiga yaqinroq kvartira qidirmoqda.

text: {r:soldier}[ˈsoʊldʒər] - askar, soldat. Agar armiyaga borishdan qo'rqsang bitta dam {p:SOLDIR}ib yubor eshonga borib, {h:askar}lik xizmatingni keyin xotirjam o'tayverasan
examples: {r:The brave soldier was awarded a medal for his courage.} - Jasur askar jasorati uchun medal bilan taqdirlandi.
{r:My uncle served as a soldier in the army for many years.} - Mening amakim ko'p yillar davomida armiyada askar bo'lib xizmat qildi.
{r:The journalist interviewed a retired soldier about his experiences.} - Jurnalist nafaqadagi askar bilan uning tajribalari haqida intervyu o'tkazdi.
{r:Every soldier is trained to be strong.} - Har bir askar kuchli bo'lishga o'rgatiladi.
{r:The injured soldier started to bleed heavily.} - Yaralangan askar qattiq qonay boshladi.

text: {r:grocery}[ˈɡroʊsəri] - oziq-ovqat do'koni. Mana bu rasmdagi juda yoqimsiz {h:oziq-ovqat do'koni} ekan. Do'konda faqat {p:GILOS IRI}b ketgani bor, boshqa biror narsa yo'q.
examples: {r:She made a list before going to the grocery store.} - U oziq-ovqat do'koniga borishdan oldin ro'yxat tuzdi.
{r:My mother buys fresh food from our local grocery.} - Mening onam doimo mahalliy oziq-ovqat do'konimizdan yangi mahsulotlar sotib oladi.
{r:A grocery store has many international foods.} - Oziq-ovqat do'koni turli xil xalqaro mahsulotlarni taklif etadi.
{r:Anvar stopped at the grocery for milk and bread.} - Anvar sut va non olish uchun oziq-ovqat do'konida to'xtadi.

text: {r:dictionary}[ˈdɪkʃəneri] - lug'at, slovar.
examples: {r:A student used a dictionary to find new words.} - Talaba yangi so'zlarning ma'nosini topish uchun lug'atdan foydalandi.
{r:My teacher told us to keep a dictionary close.} - Mening o'qituvchim doimo lug'atni yaqin saqlashni maslahat berardi.
{r:He bought a medical dictionary for his studies.} - U o'qishlari uchun maxsus tibbiy lug'at sotib oldi.
{r:A dictionary is a useful tool for learning languages.} - Lug'at til o'rganuvchilar uchun foydali vosita.
{r:The star shone bright in the night sky.} - Yulduz tiniq tungi osmonda yorqin porladi.
{r:My grandmother always shows us the stars.} - Mening buvim doimo yulduzlarni ko'rsatadi.
{r:A young actor dreamed of being a movie star.} - Intiluvchan yosh aktyor mashhur kino yulduzi bo'lishni orzu qilardi.
{r:A scientist studied distant stars and galaxies.} - Olim olis yulduzlar va galaktikalarni o'rgandi.

text: {r:capital}[ˈkæpɪtl] - poytaxt. {p:Kapital}bank {h:poytaxt}imizning eng asosiy banki.
examples: {r:Tashkent is the capital city of Uzbekistan.} - Toshkent O'zbekistonning poytaxti.
{r:She visited Paris, the capital of France.} - U Fransiyaning poytaxti Parijga tashrif buyurdi.
{r:Our country's capital is a busy city.} - Bizning mamlakatimizning poytaxti gavjum shahar.
{r:A new law was passed in the capital.} - Yangi qonun poytaxtda qabul qilindi.

text: {r:count}[kaʊnt] - sanamoq, hisoblamoq. Juda ko'p telegram ak{p:KOUNT}im bor. Hech qachon sonini {h:sanab ko'rmaganman}.
examples: {r:Can you count the books on the table, Michael?} - Maykl, stolda nechta kitob borligini sanay olasizmi?
{r:My sister can count to 100 in three languages.} - Mening opam uch xil tilda 100 gacha sanay oladi.
{r:A scientist needs to count cells under a microscope.} - Olim mikroskop ostida hujayralar sonini sanashi kerak.
{r:The team counted the votes carefully.} - Jamoa ovozlarni diqqat bilan sanadi.

text: {r:presently}[ˈprɛzntli] - hozirda. Present(hozir) so'zining ravish shakli. Ya'ni present va presently ning farqi shundaki ravish sifatida presently asosan fe'llar (ya'ni ish-harakatni ifodalovchi so'zlar) bilan keladi.
examples: {r:She is presently working on a new paper.} - U hozirda yangi ilmiy maqola ustida ishlamoqda.
{r:A doctor is presently helping another patient.} - Doktor hozirda boshqa bemorga qarayapti.
{r:The company is presently changing its policy.} - Kompaniya hozirda o'z siyosatini o'zgartirmoqda.
{r:Michael will be arriving presently to help.} - Maykl tayyorgarliklarga yordam berish uchun tez orada yetib keladi.

text: {r:guidance}[ˈɡaɪdəns] – maslahat, ko’mak, yo’l-yo’riq ko’rsatish. Agar {p:GAYIDAN S}pravka olsangiz sizga kerakli hamma ma’lumot bor. Gayidan Spravka sizga hamma {h:yo’l-yo’riq}ni ko’rsatadi.
examples: {r:A teacher gives good guidance for exams.} - O'qituvchi imtihonlar uchun ajoyib yo'l-yo'riq beradi.
{r:My father's guidance always helped me.} - Mening otamning yo'l-yo'riqlari men uchun doimo kuch manbai bo'lgan.
{r:A new employee got full guidance during training.} - Yangi xodim o'qitish davrida to'liq yo'l-yo'riq oldi.
{r:The team used the coach's guidance to win.} - Jamoa chempionlikni yutish uchun murabbiyning yo'l-yo'riqlariga tayandi.

text: {r:valuable}[ˈvæljuəbl] - qiymatli, qadrli, qimmatli. Value(qiymat) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She got valuable advice from her mentor.} - U o'zining ustozidan qimmatli maslahat oldi.
{r:Our family has a very valuable antique clock and a belt.} - Bizning oilaviy yodgorligimiz juda qimmatli antiqa soat va kamar.
{r:Friendship is regarded as the most valuable thing in their culture.} - Do'stlik ularning madaniyatida eng qadrli narsa hisoblanadi.
{r:Time is a valuable thing; don't waste it.} - Vaqt isrof qilinmasligi kerak bo'lgan qimmatli manba.

text: {r:environment}[ɪnˈvaɪərnmənt] - atrof-muhit, tabiat; muhit.
examples: {r:We must protect our planet's environment.} - Biz sayyoramizning atrof-muhitini himoya qilish uchun birgalikda ishlashimiz kerak.
{r:A city environment is different from a country one.} - Shahar muhiti qishloq muhitidan juda farq qilishi mumkin.
{r:A scientist studied pollution's effect on the environment.} - Olim ifloslanishning atrof-muhitga ta'sirini o'rgandi.
{r:The school wants a good learning environment.} - Maktab o'quvchilari uchun ijobiy o'quv muhitini yaratishni maqsad qilgan.

text: {r:religion}[rɪˈlɪdʒən] - din.
examples: {r:He believes strongly in his religion.} - U o'zining diniga qattiq ishonadi.
{r:Our country allows freedom of religion.} - Bizning mamlakatimiz din erkinligini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
{r:A journalist wrote about different religions.} - Jurnalist dunyo bo'ylab dinning xilma-xilligi haqida maqola yozdi.
{r:Respecting religions helps peace.} - Turli dinlarga hurmat bilan qarash tinchlikka yordam beradi.

text: {r:degree}[dɪˈɡriː] - daraja; diplom. 'Diplom muhim, {h:diplom} muhim' deb aytishardi har doim. Mana men yuridik institutni bitirib {p:TEGIR}monda ishlayapman.
examples: {r:My nephew got his engineering degree last year.} - Jiyanim o'tgan yili muhandislik bo'yicha bakalavr darajasini oldi.
{r:His brother is getting a master's degree.} - Uning akasi magistrlik darajasini olmoqda.
{r:A doctor has a high degree of knowledge in heart care.} - Doktor kardiologiya bo'yicha yuqori darajadagi bilimga ega.
{r:The temperature dropped below zero degrees.} - Harorat nol darajadan pastga tushdi.

text: {r:commit}[kəˈmɪt] – sodir etmoq (jinoyat, xato kabi harakatni amalga oshirmoq). Sharq xalqlari it yeyishini eshitgan bo’lsangiz kerak. Butan nomli sharq davlatlaridan birida {p:KAM IT} yeyish jinoyat ‘{h:sodir etish}’ bilan barobar. U yerda itni ko’p ko’p yeyish kerak.
examples: {r:Generally the suspect might commit a crime again.} - Umuman olganda gumonlanuvchi yana jinoyat sodir etishi mumkin.
{r:He committed a serious error in his calculations.} - U hisob-kitoblarida jiddiy xatoga yo'l qo'ydi.
{r:The company promised not to commit fraud.} - Kompaniya firibgarlik qilmaslikka va'da berdi.
{r:They fear someone will commit violence.} - Ular kimdir zo'ravonlik sodir etishidan qo'rqishadi.

text: {r:crime}[kraɪm] – jinoyat. Mana bu narkobaron {h:jinoyat} olamiga {p:KRAYM}i yo yo’qmi deb jinoyat olamiga kirib ketgan.
examples: {r:The police are checking a serious crime.} - Politsiya jiddiy jinoyatni tekshirmoqda.
{r:Our country has strict laws against cyber crime.} - Bizning mamlakatimizda kiber jinoyatlarga qarshi qat'iy qonunlar bor.
{r:The police investigate every violent crime in the city.} - Politsiya shahardagi har bir zo'ravon jinoyatni tekshiradi.
{r:He felt ashamed after realizing his crime.} - U jinoyat qilganini tushungach uyaldi.

text: {r:visitor}[ˈvɪzɪtər] - tashrif buyuruvchi. Visit(tashrif buyurmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The museum had many visitors last month.} - Muzey o'tgan oy ko'p tashrif buyuruvchilarni qabul qildi.
{r:My grandmother loves having visitors at her house.} - Mening buvim har doim uyiga mehmonlar kelishini yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:A tour guide welcomed every visitor warmly.} - Turistik gid har bir tashrif buyuruvchini iliq kutib oldi.
{r:An unexpected visitor came to the door this morning.} - Bu ertalab eshik oldiga kutilmagan mehmon keldi.

text: {r:political}[pəˈlɪtɪkl] - siyosiy. Politics(siyosat) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:A journalist reported on political news.} - Jurnalist siyosiy yangiliklarni yoritdi.
{r:She is interested in political science.} - U siyosiy fanlarga qiziqadi.
{r:Our country is known for its stable political situation.} - Bizning mamlakatimiz barqaror siyosiy muhiti bilan mashhur.
{r:The new president gave a strong political speech.} - Yangi prezident kuchli siyosiy nutq so'zladi.

text: {r:belief}[bɪˈliːf] - ishonch; e'tiqod. Believe(ishonmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:My nephew has a strong belief in education.} - Jiyanim ta'limning kuchiga qattiq ishonadi.
{r:His personal belief guides his choices.} - Uning shaxsiy e'tiqodi uning qarorlarini yo'naltiradi.
{r:Generally we have a strong belief in development.} - Umuman olganda rivojlanishga kuchli ishonamiz.
{r:The team's belief helped them win.} - Jamoaning o'zlariga bo'lgan ishonchi ularga chempionlikni yutishga yordam berdi.

text: {r:toilet}[ˈtɔɪlɪt] - hojatxona, tualet. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:A public toilet was clean.} - Jamoat hojatxonasi toza edi.
{r:My wife always does her best to keep the toilet clean.} - Mening xotinim doimo hojatxonani iloji boricha toza saqlaydi.
{r:The hotel room had a separate toilet.} - Mehmonxona xonasida alohida hojatxona bor edi.
{r:A plumber was called to fix a running toilet.} - Oqib turgan hojatxonani tuzatish uchun santexnik chaqirildi.

text:
{r:sense}[sɛns] – sezgi, tuyg’u, his. 
Yigit qizga "{p:SENS}izlik {h:tuyg’usi} meni qiynaydi" deb xat yozibdi.
examples: {r:She has a great sense of humor.} - Uning juda yaxshi hazil hisi bor.
{r:A dog has a good sense of smell.} - Itning hid bilish tuyg'usi o'tkir.
{r:Michael lost his sense of direction in the fog.} - Maykl qalin tuman ichida yo'nalish olish sezgisini yo'qotdi.
{r:Dogs have a better sense of smell.} - Itlar yaxshi hid bilish hissiyotiga ega.

text: {r:ant}[ænt] - chumoli. Aslida {h:chumoli}larning ham {p:ANT}enasi bo'ladi dumida faqat biz ular juda kichkina bo'lganligi uchun sezmaymiz.
examples: {r:An ant was carrying a crumb.} - Bir chumoli non bo'lagini olib ketayotgan edi.
{r:Sometimes our kitchen has ants.} - Ba'zan oshxonamizda chumolilar bo'ladi.
{r:A scientist studied an ant colony.} - Bir olim chumoli koloniyasini o'rgandi.
{r:Look, a tiny ant is carrying a leaf.} - Qarang, chumoli kichkina bargni ko'tarib ketayapti.

text: {r:Skyscraper}[ˈskaɪˌskreɪpər] - osmono'par bino.
examples: {r:The new skyscraper is very tall.} - Yangi osmono‘par bino juda baland.
{r:The new apartment is located near a tall skyscraper.} - Yangi kvartira baland osmono'par bino yaqinida joylashgan.
{r:A skyscraper in our capital has 50 floors.} - Poytaxtimizdagi bir osmono‘par binoda 50 qavat bor.
{r:We visited the top of a tall skyscraper.} - Biz baland osmono‘par binoning tepasiga chiqdik.
{r:Building a skyscraper in Tashkent is possible.} - Toshkentda osmono'par bino qurishni imkoni bor.

text: {r:Experience}[ɪkˈspɪəriəns] - boshdan kechirmoq, his qilmoq, boshidan o'tkazmoq. Bu so‘z biror holat, hissiyot, voqea yoki vaziyatni shaxsan his qilish yoki undan o‘tishni bildiradi.
examples: {r:I want to experience life in a new country.} - Men yangi mamlakatda hayotni boshdan kechirishni xohlayman.
{r:She experienced a lot of stress at work.} - U ishda juda ko‘p stressni boshdan kechirdi.
{r:Michael has experienced true happiness together with her.} - Maykl u bilan birgalikda chinakam baxtni his qildi.
{r:They experienced some problems during their trip.} - Sayohatlari davomida ular ayrim muammolarni boshdan kechirdilar.

text:
{r:Hold}[hoʊld] - o‘tkazmoq, tashkil etmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - held, held. 
Bu so‘z biror tadbir, yig‘ilish yoki faoliyatni tashkil qilish yoki o‘tkazishni bildiradi.
examples: {r:They will hold a meeting tomorrow morning.} - Ular ertaga ertalab yig‘ilish o‘tkazishadi.
{r:The school holds a sports day every year.} - Maktab har yili sport kuni o‘tkazadi.
{r:Anvar held a party for his sister's birthday.} - Anvar singlisining tug‘ilgan kuniga ziyofat tashkil qildi.
{r:The city will hold an international conference.} - Shahar xalqaro konferensiya o‘tkazadi.

text: {r:Eagle}[ˈiːɡəl] - burgut. Futbol to'pini ishirish uchun igolka sotib olgan edim. Hovlida turgan payti {h:burgut} {p:IGOL}kani cho'qilab olib ketib qolibdi. Don deb o'ylagan menimcha.
examples: {r:An eagle is flying high in the sky.} - Burgut osmonda baland uchayapti.
{r:Eagles are very strong birds.} - Burgutlar juda kuchli qushlar.
{r:I saw an eagle near the mountain.} - Men tog‘ yonida bir burgutni ko‘rdim.
{r:The eagle caught a fish from the river.} - Burgut daryodan baliqni tutdi.

text:
{r:Book}[bʊk] - bron qilmoq, buyurtma qilmoq, band qilmoq. 
Bu yerdagi 'book' so'zi 'kitob' ma'nosini bildirmaydi. Chunki bu so'zning yana bir boshqa asosiy ma'nosi bor.
examples: {r:She booked a flight to Paris for summer.} - U yoz uchun Parijga reys bron qildi.
{r:They are booking a table at the restaurant.} - Ular restoranda stol band qilishmoqda.
{r:He had booked an appointment with a doctor.} - U shifokor bilan uchrashuv belgilagan edi.
{r:We booked tickets for the concert easily.} - Biz konsertga chiptalarni osonlik bilan band qildik.

text: {r:Surgeon}[ˈsɜːrdʒən] - jarroh. Xullas singlim senga sovchi kelibdi. Yigit onasini ovvora qilmasdan o’zi kelaveribdi. Kasbiga qiziqyapsanmi? {p:SO’VCHIN} {h:doktor} ekan. Ana sovchilikka ham qo’liga qo’lqop kiyib kelibdi.
examples: {r:The surgeon is very skilled.} - Jarroh juda mohir.
{r:Julia wants to become a surgeon.} - Julia jarroh bo‘lishni xohlaydi.
{r:An experienced surgeon performed the operation.} - Tajribali jarroh operatsiyani bajardi.
{r:This surgeon works in a big hospital and he is still single.} - Jarroh katta kasalxonada ishlaydi va hali ham yolg'iz.

text: {r:Plumber}[ˈplʌmər] - santexnik. Plombir muzqaymog'ini bilsangiz kerak. Keyingi safar uyga santexnik chaqirganda {p:PLOMBIR}dan ham olib bering. 'Aka atay sizdek {h:santexnik}lar uchun chiqarilgan morojniy bu' deb qo'shib ham qo'ying.
examples: {r:The plumber fixed the leaking pipe.} - Santexnik oqayotgan quvurni ta’mirladi.
{r:He called a plumber to repair his bathroom.} - U hammomini ta’mirlash uchun santexnikni chaqirdi.
{r:A plumber arrived late and he did not bring his ladder.} - Santexnik kech keldi va narvonini ham olib kelmabdi.
{r:She is a professional plumber woman.} - U professional santexnik ayol.

text: {r:Install}[ɪnˈstɔːl] - o'rnatmoq, qo'ymoq. Men hozir narxozda o'qiyman. Kecha bizning {p:INST OL}diga yangi quyosh panellari {h:o'rnatishdi.} Endi biz tokni quyoshdan olamiz.
examples: {r:He installed a new TV in his room.} - U xonasiga yangi televizor o‘rnatdi.
{r:She has installed the software on her computer.} - U kompyuteriga dasturni o‘rnatgan.
{r:The workers were installing the carpet.} - Ishchilar gilamni o‘rnatishayotgan edi.
{r:They will install a new window in the house.} - Ular uyga yangi deraza o‘rnatishadi.

text: {r:Pipe}[paɪp] – quvur. Tasavvur qiling {p:PAYP}oqlardan sizning kanalizatsiya {h:quvur}ingiz tayyorlanayapti(trubalardan emas).
examples: {r:The old pipe is leaking.} - Eski quvur oqayapti.
{r:Anvar fixed the broken pipe.} - Anvar singan quvurni ta’mirladi.
{r:Water flows through the pipe.} - Suv quvur orqali oqadi.
{r:She cleaned the clogged pipe.} - U tiqilib qolgan quvurni tozaladi.

text: {r:Shy}[ʃaɪ] – uyatchan, tortinchoq. Tasavvur qiling {p:SHAY}ton aslida juda {h:uyalchang} ekan.
examples: {r:She is very shy around new people.} - U yangi odamlar atrofida juda uyatchan.
{r:This young boy was too shy to speak.} - Yosh bola gapirishga juda uyatchan edi.
{r:He felt shy in front of the crowd.} - U olomon oldida uyatchan his qildi.
{r:Julia gave a shy smile.} - Julia uyatchan jilmaydi.

text: {r:Sore}[sɔːr] – og’riyotgan, yara. Tasavvur qiling {p:SO'R}g'ich so'rganingizdan so'ng tomog'ingiz {h:og'rib} qoldi.
examples: {r:He has a sore throat.} - Uning tomog'i og‘riyapti.
{r:Her feet were sore after the long walk.} - Uning oyoqlari uzoq yurishdan keyin og‘riyotgan edi.
{r:The sore on his arm is painful.} - Uning qo'lidagi yara og‘riqli.
{r:She applied medicine to the sore.} - U yaraga dori surtdi.

text: {r:Exam}[ɪɡˈzæm] - imtihon, ekzamen.
examples: {r:The exam was very difficult.} - Imtihon juda qiyin edi.
{r:She must pass her exam with high marks.} - U imtihondan yuqori ball bilan o'tishi zarur.
{r:Michael is preparing for a big exam.} - Maykl katta imtihonga tayyorlanayapti.
{r:The exam results will be announced soon.} - Imtihon natijalari tez orada e’lon qilinadi.

text: {r:Foreigner}[ˈfɒrənər] - chet ellik. Foreign(chet el) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:A foreigner asked for directions.} - Bir chet ellik yo‘l so‘radi.
{r:A foreigner is impressed by our hospitable nation.} - Chet ellik bizning mehmondo'st xalqimizdan katta taassurot oldi.
{r:This foreigner woman speaks English relatively well.} - Chet ellik ayol ingliz tilida nisbatan yaxshi gapirarkan.
{r:A foreigner is trying to find his countrymen.} - Chet ellik o'z vatandoshlarini qidiryapti.
{r:Most buyers of wallets are foreigners.} - Hamyonlarimning ko'p xaridorlari chet elliklar.

text: {r:Correctly}[kəˈrɛktli] - to'g'ri. Correct so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:She answered the question correctly.} - U savolga to‘g‘ri javob berdi.
{r:He has spelled the word correctly.} - U so‘zni to‘g‘ri yozgan.
{r:The teacher explained the lesson correctly.} - O‘qituvchi darsni to‘g‘ri tushuntirdi.
{r:They always follow the instructions correctly.} - Ular ko‘rsatmalarni har doim to‘g‘ri bajaradilar.

text: {r:Chaos}[ˈkeɪɒs] - tartibsizlik, xaos. O'zbek tilida rus tilidan ko'chgan 'xaos' so'zining inglizcha shakli. Talaffuzi biroz farq qiladi.
examples: {r:The room was in chaos after the party.} - Xona ziyofatdan keyin tartibsizlikda edi.
{r:The storm caused chaos in the city.} - Bo‘ron shaharda tartibsizlikka sabab bo‘ldi.
{r:She tried to organize the chaos.} - U tartibsizlikni tartibga solishga harakat qildi.
{r:We can see chaos on the corner.} - Burchakda tartibsizlikni ko'rishimiz mumkin.

text: {r:Impolite}[ɪmˈpəʊlaɪt] - odobsiz. Polite(odobli) ning teskarisi.
examples: {r:Hamza was very impolite to her.} - Hamza unga nisbatan juda odobsiz edi.
{r:The impolite comment upset Julia.} - Odobsiz izoh Juliani xafa qildi.
{r:She apologized for being impolite.} - U odobsizlik uchun uzr so‘radi.
{r:Anvar noticed impolite behavior.} - Anvar odobsiz xulq-atvorni ko'rdi.

text: {r:Impatient}[ɪmˈpeɪʃənt] - sabrsiz. Patient(sabrli) ning teskarisi.
examples: {r:She is very impatient when waiting.} - U kutayotganda juda sabrsiz.
{r:He became impatient waiting for the bus.} - U avtobusni kutayotganda sabrsizlandi.
{r:The impatient child cried loudly.} - Sabrsiz bola baland ovozda yig‘ladi.
{r:Michael tried to control his impatience.} - Maykl sabrsizligini boshqarishga harakat qildi.

text: {r:Straightforward}[ˌstreɪtˈfɔːrwərd] - oddiy; to'g'ri, dangal.
examples: {r:The instructions were straightforward.} - Ko‘rsatmalar oddiy edi.
{r:She always gives a straightforward answer.} - U har doim to‘g‘ri javob beradi.
{r:The task was straightforward for Anvar.} - Vazifa Anvar uchun oddiy edi.
{r:Davron liked her straightforward approach.} - Davron uning oddiy yondashuvini yoqtirdi.

text: {r:Irony}[ˈaɪrəni] – kesatiq, piching, kinoya. Mana bu shoirni taxallusi {p:AYRONIY} chunki bir kosa ayron ichib oladida keyin hammaga {h:piching} qilib tegishtirib she’r yozadi.
examples: {r:The irony of the situation was clear.} - Vaziyatning kinoyasi aniq edi.
{r:She understood the irony in his words.} - U uning so‘zlaridagi kinoyani tushundi.
{r:The irony made everyone laugh.} - Kinoya hammani kuldirdi.
{r:He has to explain the irony of the story.} - U hikoyadagi kinoyani tushuntirishi kerak.

text: {r:Scenery}[ˈsiːnəri] - manzara. Men aktyorlik qilaman va hozir Chorvoqqa ketyapmiz. Bu yerlarning manzarasi ajoyib ekan. {p:SSENARIY}da bu {h:manzara} ostida dam olib yotishimiz yo'q edi asli, lekin etirozim yo'q, maza qilyapman.
examples: {r:The scenery in the mountains is beautiful.} - Tog‘lardagi manzara juda go‘zal.
{r:She loves the scenery of the countryside.} - U qishloq manzarasini yoqtiradi.
{r:The scenery changed as we drove.} - Mashina haydab ketayotganimizda manzara o‘zgardi.
{r:The scenery reminded me of home.} - Manzara menga uyimni eslatdi.

text: {r:Baggage}[ˈbæɡɪdʒ] - yuk, bagaj.
examples: {r:The baggage was heavy.} - Yuk og‘ir edi.
{r:She lost her baggage at the airport.} - U aeroportda yukini yo‘qotdi.
{r:Somebody should help her find the baggage.} - Kimdir unga bagajni topishda yordam berishi kerak.
{r:He carried the baggage to the grey car.} - U yukni kulrang mashinaga olib bordi.

text: {r:Depression}[dɪˈprɛʃən] - depressiya.
examples: {r:The depression affected many people.} - Depressiya ko‘p odamlarga ta’sir qildi.
{r:She felt a sense of depression.} - U depressiyani his qildi.
{r:The depression continued for months.} - Depressiya oylar davom etdi.
{r:He talked about his depression.} - U o‘z depressiyasi haqida gapirdi.

text: {r:Unfortunately}[ʌnˈfɔːtʃənətli] - afsuski.
examples: {r:Unfortunately, the train was late.} - Afsuski, poyezd kechikdi.
{r:She missed the bus, unfortunately.} - Afsuski, u avtobusni o'tkazib yubordi.
{r:Unfortunately, the weather was bad.} - Afsuski, ob-havo yomon edi.
{r:He forgot his keys, unfortunately.} - Afsuski, u kalitini unutdi.

text: {r:Total}[ˈtoʊtəl] - umumiy, total, butunlay.
examples: {r:The total cost was high.} - Umumiy narx yuqori edi.
{r:She calculated the total.} - U umumiy miqdorni hisoblab chiqdi.
{r:The total number of students is 50.} - O‘quvchilarning umumiy soni 50 ta.
{r:He paid the total price.} - U umumiy narxni to‘ladi.
{r:Why was your total profit so low last year?} - Nimaga umumiy daromadingiz o'tgan yili past edi?

text: {r:Beer}[bɪər] – pivo. Agar kimdir tili {p:BIYR}on bo’lib ko’p gapirayotgan bo’lsa bilingki u {h:pivo} ichib olgan.
examples: {r:Was the beer cold?} - Pivo sovuq edimi?
{r:She ordered a glass of beer.} - U bir stakan pivo buyurtma qildi.
{r:The beer is made from grape in Germany.} - Pivo Germaniyada uzumdan tayyorlanadi.
{r:He drank the beer quickly.} - U pivoni tez ichdi.

text: {r:Prison}[ˈprɪzən] – qamoq. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:brezent}dan qilingan {h:qamoqxonada} yashaysiz.
examples: {r:The prison is very secure.} - Qamoqxona juda xavfsiz.
{r:She visited the prison last week.} - U o‘tgan hafta qamoqxonaga tashrif buyurgan.
{r:The prison has many guards.} - Qamoqxonada ko‘p qo‘riqchi bor.
{r:He is being sent to prison.} - U qamoqqa jo'natilyapti.

text: {r:Art}[ɑːrt] – san’at. Artist so’zi art so’zidan olingan. Bu o’rinda artist shousini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:The art in the museum is amazing.} - Muzeydagi san’at ajoyib.
{r:She loves modern art.} - U zamonaviy san’atni yoqtiradi.
{r:The art exhibition was crowded.} - San’at ko‘rgazmasi gavjum edi.
{r:He studied art in college.} - U kollejda san’atni o‘rgangan.

text: {r:Fridge}[frɪdʒ] - muzlatgich. Kartoshka {p:FRI} qovursam odatda shu zahoti {h:muzlatgichga} qo'yaman va sovutib maza qilib yeyman.
examples: {r:The fridge is full of food.} - Muzlatgich ovqatga to‘la.
{r:She opened the fridge to get milk and butter.} - U sut va sariyog' olish uchun muzlatgichni ochdi.
{r:The fridge stopped working.} - Muzlatgich ishlamay qoldi.
{r:He cleaned the fridge yesterday.} - U kecha muzlatgichni tozaladi.

text: {r:Happiness}[ˈhæpɪnəs] - baxt. Happy(baxtli) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The happiness on her face was clear.} - Uning yuzidagi baxt aniq-ravshan edi.
{r:She found happiness in her work.} - U o‘z ishidan baxt topdi.
{r:The happiness of the children was important.} - Bolalarning baxti muhim edi.
{r:Anvar wished her happiness.} - Anvar unga baxt tiladi.

text: {r:King}[kɪŋ] - qirol. {p:King} Kongni eslaysizmi? U junglining haqiqiy {h:qiroli}.
examples: {r:The king ruled for many years.} - Qirol ko‘p yillar hukmronlik qildi.
{r:Our king has so many obligations.} - Qirolimizning juda ko'p burchlari bor.
{r:The king was loved by his people.} - Qirol o‘z xalqi tomonidan sevilgan edi.
{r:Everybody can speak with the king here.} - Bu yerda har bir kishi qirol bilan gaplashishi mumkin.
{r:The king wanted to punish the man, but he changed his mind and forgave him.} – Qirol bu kishini jazolamoqchi edi, lekin fikrini o‘zgartirib, uni kechirdi.

text: {r:North}[nɔːrθ] - shimol. Tasavvur qiling sizning qorningizda noringiz bor. {p:NORIZ} kompasga o'xshaydi chunki doimo {h:shimol} tomonga og'ib turadi.
examples: {r:The north is colder than the south.} - Shimol janubdan sovuqroq.
{r:She lives in the north of the country.} - U mamlakatning shimolida yashaydi.
{r:The north wind was strong.} - Shimol shamoli kuchli edi.
{r:He traveled to the north last summer.} - U o‘tgan yoz shimolga sayohat qildi.

text: {r:South}[saʊθ] – janub. {p:Sous} qayerdan kelishini bilasizmi? Ko’pchilik bilmaydi. Sous {h:janub}dan Afrikadan keladi.
examples: {r:The south is warmer than the north.} - Janub shimoldan iliqroq.
{r:She moved to the south.} - U janubga ko‘chib o‘tdi.
{r:The south has beautiful sandy beaches.} - Janubda go‘zal qumli plyajlar bor.
{r:He visited the south last year.} - U o‘tgan yili janubga tashrif buyurgan.

text: {r:East}[iːst] – sharq. Yevropaning eng {h:sharqiy} nuqtasi {p:Ist}anbulda. Shahar madaniyati ham sharqqa yaqin.
examples: {r:The sun rises in the east.} - Quyosh sharqdan ko'tariladi.
{r:She traveled to the east.} - U sharqqa sayohat qildi.
{r:The east is known for its culture.} - Sharq o‘z madaniyati bilan mashhur.
{r:He lives in the east of the city.} - U shaharning sharqida yashaydi.

text: {r:West}[wɛst] – g’arb. {p:West}minister {h:g’arb} davlatlari ta’lim tizimida o’qitiladigan universitet.
examples: {r:The sun sets in the west.} - Quyosh g‘arbda botadi.
{r:She moved to the west.} - U g‘arbga ko‘chib o‘tdi.
{r:The west has many mountains.} - G‘arbda ko‘p tog‘lar bor.
{r:He visited the west last month.} - U o‘tgan oy g‘arbga tashrif buyurdi.

text: {r:Between}[bɪˈtwiːn] – o’rtasida, orasida. {p:Bit vin}o ichishni istab qolibdi va o’g’liga do’konga borishni buyuribdi. Do’konga borib kelish uchun endi u 500 soch {h:orasidan} o’tishi kerak ekan.
examples: {r:The book is between the two boxes.} - Kitob ikkita quti orasida.
{r:She sat between her friends.} - U do‘stlari orasiga o‘tirdi.
{r:The house is between the trees.} - Uy daraxtlar orasida.
{r:He stood between the two doors.} - U ikkita eshik orasida turardi.

text: {r:Cowboy}[ˈkaʊbɔɪ] - kovboy. Amerika kinolarida bu so'zni ko'p eshitgan bo'lsangiz kerak. Avval Amerika cho'ponlari shunday atalgan.
examples: {r:The cowboy rode a horse.} - Kovboy ot minib yurdi.
{r:The cowboy behaved suspiciously.} - Kovboy o'zini shubhali tutdi.
{r:The cowboy wore a hat.} - Kovboy shlyapa kiygan edi.
{r:My grandfather used to watch movies about cowboys.} - Bobom kovboylar haqida kinolar ko'rardi.

text: {r:Countless}[ˈkaʊntləs] - behisob, ko'p, son-sanoqsiz. Count(sanamoq; hisob) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:There are countless stars in the sky.} - Osmonda son-sanoqsiz yulduzlar bor.
{r:She has countless books on the shelf at home.} - Unda son-sanoqsiz kitoblar bor uyidagi javonida.
{r:The countless trees made the forest beautiful.} - Son-sanoqsiz daraxtlar o‘rmonni go‘zal qildi.
{r:He made countless mistakes.} - U behisob xatolar qildi.
{r:I have countless buckets and bowls in my attic.} - Cherdagimda son-sanoqsiz chelak va kosalarim bor.

text: {r:Probability}[ˌprɒbəˈbɪləti] - ehtimollik. Probable(ehtimol) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The probability of rain is high.} - Yomg‘ir yog‘ish ehtimoli yuqori.
{r:She calculated the probability.} - U ehtimollikni hisoblab chiqdi.
{r:The probability of success is low.} - Muvaffaqiyat ehtimoli past.
{r:He talked about the probability.} - U ehtimollik haqida gapirdi.

text: {r:Gamer}[ˈɡeɪmər] - geymir, komyuter o'yinlari o'ynovchilar.
examples: {r:The gamer played all night.} - Geymer butun kecha o‘ynadi.
{r:Firstly, this is an attractive game for gamers, secondly it is easy to play.} - Birinchidan bu geymerlar uchun jozibali o'yin, ikkinchidan uni o'ynash oson.
{r:The gamer won the competition.} - Geymer musobaqada g‘olib chiqdi.
{r:Who distributes this game to gamers?} - Kim bu o'yinlarni geymerlarga tarqatadi?

text: {r:Rope}[rəʊp] – arqon. Siz bu vaziyatda o’zingiz taniydigan {p:RO’UP} akani {h:arqon} tayyorlab sotishini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:The rope is very strong.} - Arqon juda mustahkam.
{r:The rope is long.} - Arqon uzun.
{r:The rope broke under the weight.} - Arqon og‘irlikdan uzildi.
{r:He climbed the rope quickly.} - U arqonga tez osilib ko'tarildi.

text: {r:Really}[ˈrɪəli] – haqiqatdan. Chempionlar ligasini yutishga haqiqatdan bitta jamoada imkoniyat ko’proq. {p:Real li}ga g’olibligiga {h:haqiqatdan} eng asosiy davogar.
examples: {r:She is really happy.} - U juda baxtli.
{r:Personally he really likes the movie.} - Shaxsan u filmni juda yoqtiradi.
{r:The food is really delicious.} - Ovqat juda mazali.
{r:I really need your help.} - Menga sizning yordamingiz juda kerak.

text: {r:Introduce}[ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs] – tanishtirmoq. Yangi avlod o’sib eski avlod qarib boryapti. 90 – yillar avlodi bo’lsangiz ishonchim komil farzandingiz biz eshitgan qo’shiqchilar Shohrux, Shahriyor va aktyorlar Farrux Soipov, Dilnoza Kubayevalarni tanimaydi. Aytganchi Radius 21 ni eslatish esimdan chiqibdi. Haqiqiy insongarchiligi bilan ajralib turgan {p:INT}izomli {p:RADIUS} 21 ni farzandingizga ham {h:tanishtiring}.
examples: {r:She introduced me to her friend.} - U meni do‘stiga tanishtirdi.
{r:He introduced himself to the class.} - U o‘zini sinfga tanishtirdi.
{r:The teacher introduced the new topic.} - O‘qituvchi yangi mavzuni tanishtirdi.
{r:When you introduce a topic, expect many questions and replies.} - Mavzuni tanishtirganingizda ko'plab savollar va javoblarni kuting.

text: {r:Pity}[ˈpɪti] – rahm; afsusli. Mening bobom sochdagi {p:PITTI}yam o'ldirmaydigan, {h:rahm qiladigan} inson.
examples: {r:It’s a pity that the weather is rainy.} - Afsuski havo yomg'irli.
{r:She felt pity for the poor man.} - U kambag‘al odamga rahmi keldi.
{r:The pity in her voice was clear.} - Uning ovozidagi rahm ravshan edi.
{r:He showed no pity.} - U hech qanday rahm ko‘rsatmadi.

text: {r:Lazy}[ˈleɪzi] – dangasa. Messi reklama qiladigan {p:LEYS} chipslari yaxshi emas ekan. Yesangiz odamni {h:dangasa} qilib qo'yar ekan.
examples: {r:The lazy boy didn’t do his homework.} - Yalqov bola uy vazifasini qilmadi.
{r:Nargiza called him lazy.} - Nargiza uni yalqov dedi.
{r:The lazy cat slept all day.} - Yalqov mushuk kun bo‘yi uxladi.
{r:He felt lazy after lunch.} - U tushlikdan keyin o'zini yalqov his qildi.

text: {r:Kingdom}[ˈkɪŋdəm] - qirollik. King(qirol) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The kingdom was very large.} - Qirollik juda katta edi.
{r:She read a book about the kingdom.} - U qirollik haqida kitob o‘qidi.
{r:The kingdom had many castles.} - Qirollikda ko‘p qal’alar bor edi.
{r:He visited the kingdom last year.} - U o‘tgan yili qirollikka tashrif buyurgan.

text: {r:Surgery}[ˈsɜːrdʒəri] – operatsiya, jarrohlik. Tasavvur qiling ichingizda nimadir lo’qillayapti. Tekshirtirishga qaror qildingiz va tanagizda qandaydir predmet oldingi {h:operatsiya}lardan birida qolib ketgani aniqlandi. Sizni operatsiya qilishdi va ichingizdan {p:SO’R}g’ichni {p:CHIRI}gan taxtachasi topildi. Endi siz o’zingizni sog’lom his qilyapsiz.
examples: {r:The surgery was successful.} - Jarrohlik muvaffaqiyatli bo‘ldi.
{r:She works in a surgery.} - U jarrohlik bo'limida ishlaydi.
{r:The surgery took three hours.} - Jarrohlik uch soat davom etdi.
{r:She does not need surgery.} - Unga jarrohlik shart emas.

text: {r:Religious}[rɪˈlɪdʒəs] - dindor, diniy. Religion(din) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The religious festival was very colorful.} - Diniy festival juda rang-barang edi.
{r:She is very religious.} - U juda dindor.
{r:The religious leader gave a speech.} - Diniy rahbar nutq so‘zladi.
{r:He visited a religious place.} - U diniy joyga tashrif buyurdi.

text: {r:Business}[ˈbɪznəs] - biznes.
examples: {r:The business is doing well.} - Biznes yaxshi ketmoqda.
{r:She started her own business.} - U o‘z biznesini boshladi.
[b]It's none of your business - ishing bo'lmasin, burningni tiqma.[/b]
{r:Her personal life is none of our business} – Uning shaxsiy hayotiga burnimizni tiqmasligimiz kerak.
{r:It’s none of your business how much money I make} – Mening qancha pul topishim bilan ishing bo'lmasin.

text: {r:Line}[laɪn] - chiziq, liniya; navbat.
examples: {r:This line is very long.} - Bu navbat juda uzun.
{r:She stood in that line for an hour.} - U o'sha navbatda bir soat turdi.
{r:This line on the paper is straight.} - Qog'ozdagi bu chiziq to'g'ri.
{r:He drew those lines on the board.} - U doskaga o'sha chiziqlarni chizdi.

text: {r:Issue}[ˈɪʃuː] – masala, muammo. Muammoyim shundaki ish topishim kerak. Bu yerda esa yagona ish beruvchi mening bolalikdan beri dushmanim. Ish Shuhratdaning korxonasida bor faqat. {h:Muammo} shundaki yagona {p:ish shu}.
examples: {r:What is the issue?} - Muammo nimada?
{r:Julia raised that important issue.} - Julia o'sha muhim masalani ko‘tardi.
{r:He didn't want to bother his parents with his personal issues.} - U o'z muammolari bilan ota-onasini bezovta qilishni xohlamadi.
{r:He solved that issue quickly.} - U o'sha masalani tez hal qildi.
{r:The company's refusal to discuss the issue led to a strike.} - Kompaniyaning masalani muhokama qilishdan bosh tortishi ish tashlashga olib keldi.

text: {r:Provide}[prəˈvaɪd] – ta'minlamoq, taqdim etmoq. O’zbekistonda prava va mashina bo’lishi juda muhim. {p:Prava} bo’lsa hech bo’lmasa taksichilik qilib bo’lsa ham oilani {h:ta’minlash} mumkin.
examples: {r:This company provides good service.} - Bu kompaniya yaxshi xizmat ko‘rsatadi.
{r:She provided all that information.} - U o'sha barcha ma’lumotlarni taqdim etdi.
{r:The school provides books for students; that is helpful.} - Maktab o‘quvchilarni kitoblar bilan ta’minlaydi va bu foydali.
{r:He provided help when Anvar needed it; that was kind.} - Anvarga yordam kerak bo‘lganida u yordam berdi; bu mehribonlik edi.

text: {r:Power}[ˈpaʊər] – qudrat, kuch; hokimiyat; energiya. O’zbek tilida ham ommalashib borayotgan {p:pour}bank so’zi aynan mana shu so’zdan olingan. Yoki shev POVARni qudratli insonga aylanganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:The power went out last night; that was a problem.} - Kecha elektr uzildi; bu muammo edi.
{r:She has a lot of power in this company.} - U bu kompaniyada ko‘p hokimiyatga ega.
{r:The power of this engine is impressive.} - Bu dvigatelning quvvati ajoyib.
{r:He used his power to help others; that is true leadership.} - U o‘z hokimiyatini boshqalarga yordam berish uchun ishlatdi; bu haqiqiy yetakchilik.
{r:They had no real power.} - Ularda haqiqiy kuch yo'q.

text: {r:Sickness}[ˈsɪknəs] - kasallik. Sick(kasal) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:This sickness spread quickly.} - Bu kasallik tez tarqaldi.
{r:She felt a sense of sickness; that was not good.} - U kasallikni his qildi; bu yaxshi emas edi.
{r:The sickness continued for days; this was hard.} - Kasallik bir necha kun davom etdi; bu qiyin edi.
{r:He recovered from that sickness well.} - U o'sha kasallikdan yaxshi tuzaldi.
{r:His stomach problem led to a feeling of sickness.} - Uning oshqozonidagi muammo kasallik hissiga olib keldi.

text: {r:Almost}[ˈɔːlməʊst] - deyarli.
examples: {r:She almost missed this bus.} - U deyarli bu avtobusni o'tkazib yubordi.
{r:The work is almost finished; that is good news.} - Ish deyarli tugadi; bu yaxshi yangilik.
{r:This country is almost independent.} - Bu davlat deyarli mustaqil.
{r:We are almost there; this journey was long.} - Biz deyarli yetib keldik; bu sayohat uzun bo'ldi.

text: {r:Member}[ˈmɛmbər] – a’zo. Bunyodkor stadioni me’mori kim bilasizmi? Humo arenasinichi? Biz odatda memorlarni yaxshi tanimaymiz. Lekin bunday katta proyektlarning me'morlari albatta {p:Me'mor}chilik Assotsiatsiyasi {h:a’zolari}.
examples: {r:Club members have to wear this kind of sunglasses daily.} - Klub a'zolari bu turdagi ochkilarni har kuni taqib yurishlari kerak.
{r:That member paid the fee already.} - O'sha a’zo to‘lovni allaqachon to‘ladi.
{r:This team has ten members.} - Bu jamoada o‘nta a’zo bor.
{r:He became a member last year; that was a good decision.} - U o‘tgan yili a’zo bo‘ldi; bu yaxshi qaror edi.

text: {r:Prisoner}[ˈprɪzənər] - mahbus. Prison(qamoq) so'zidan.
examples: {r:The prisoner escaped from that jail.} - Mahbus o'sha qamoqdan qochib ketdi.
{r:She visited this prisoner.} - U bu mahbus oldiga tashrif buyurdi.
{r:The prisoner was released; that was good news.} - Mahbus ozod qilindi; bu yaxshi yangilik edi.
{r:He felt like a prisoner in his own home; that was a bad feeling.} - U o‘z uyida mahbus kabi his qildi; bu yomon tuyg'u edi.

text: {r:Kid}[kɪd] – go’dak, bola. Bu so’z bilan {h:bolakay} {p:kit}ni tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:This kid played in the park for hours.} - Bu bola bog‘da soatlab o‘ynadi.
{r:She has two kids; those are her children.} - Unda ikkita bola bor; ular uning farzandlari.
{r:That kid laughed loudly at the joke.} - O'sha bola hazilga baland ovozda kuldi.
{r:He is just a kid; this is normal.} - U hali bola; bu normal holat u uchun.

text: {r:War}[wɔːr] – urush. Tasavvur qiling {p:vor}onkaning ustida bizning ko’zimiz ilg’amaydigan mayda mikrob va bakteriyalar katta {h:urushlar} qilyapti.
examples: {r:That war lasted for years.} - O'sha urush yillar davom etdi.
{r:She read a book about this war.} - U bu urush haqida kitob o‘qidi.
{r:The war affected many people; that was tragic.} - Urush ko‘p odamlarga ta’sir qildi; bu fojiali edi.
{r:He fought in that war very bravely.} - U o'sha urushda juda jasorat bilan jang qildi.

text: {r:Reason}[ˈriːzən] – sabab. {p:RI}xsitilla {p:ZIN}asi haqida soatlab gapiradi, {h:sabab}i u tilladan qilingan.
examples: {r:The reason for his absence is unknown; this is an issue.} - Uning yo‘qligining sababi noma’lum; bu bir muammo.
{r:She explained the reason; that was logical.} - U sababni tushuntirdi; bu mantiqiy edi.
{r:The reason is very clear; this is why we are here.} - Sabab juda aniq; shuning uchun biz bu yerdamiz.
{r:He gave a good reason for his decision.} - U o'z qarori uchun yaxshi sabab keltirdi.

text: {r:Moustache}[məˈstɑːʃ] - mo'ylov. Tasavvur qiling agar siz yolg'on gapirsangiz {h:mo'ylov}ingiz {p:MUZLASH}ga moyil ekan.
examples: {r:Anvar has a thick moustache; it's a nice one.} - Anvarda qalin mo‘ylov bor; u chiroyli.
{r:Julia doesn’t like men with moustaches, but she likes that one.} - Julia mo‘ylovli erkaklarni yoqtirmaydi, lekin o'sha bittasini yoqtiradi.
{r:This moustache makes him look older; that one is better.} - Bu mo‘ylov uni keksaroq ko‘rsatadi; o'sha birisi yaxshiroq.
{r:He shaved off his old moustache and grew a new one.} - U eski mo‘ylovini olib tashladi va yangisini o'stirdi.

text: {r:Pants}[pænts] – ishton, shim. Hozirgi kunda ko’plab kiyimlar plastikdan qilinyapti. Bu degani mana bu yelimdan tayyorlangan {p:PANTIS}ni eritib keyin {h:shim} tayyorlasa bo’ladi.
examples: {r:These pants are too big; I need a smaller one.} - Bu shimlar juda katta; menga kichikroq bittasi kerak.
{r:She bought a new pair of pants, a blue one.} - U yangi shim sotib oldi, ko'k rangli bittasini.
{r:The pants are in the closet; which ones do you want?} - Shimlar shkafda; qaysi birini xohlaysiz?
{r:He wore black pants to the party; those were formal ones.} - U bazmga qora shim kiygan edi; ular rasmiy edi.

text: {r:Species}[ˈspiːʃiːz] - tur, nav yoki xil. Bu atama biologiyada tirik organizmlarning turli guruhlarini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:This species is very rare.} - Bu tur juda kam tarqalgan.
{r:She studied many different species of birds; these ones are interesting.} - U turli qush turlarini o‘rgandi; mana bular qiziqarli.
{r:That species is in danger; we need to protect it.} - O'sha tur xavf ostida; biz uni himoya qilishimiz kerak.
{r:Michael discovered a new species, a very unusual one.} - Maykl yangi tur kashf qildi, juda g'ayrioddiy bittasini.

text: {r:Firm}[fɜːrm] – qattiq, mustahkam, mahkam. Bizning {p:FIRM}a binosi po’latdan quyilgani uchun O’zbekistondagi eng {h:mustahkam} ishxona.
examples: {r:Despite our persuasion, his refusal remained firm.} - Bizning ishontirishimizga qaramay, uning rad etishi qat'iy qoldi.
{r:Julia works for a big law firm; it's a famous one.} - Julia katta huquq firmasida ishlaydi; u mashhur bittasi.
{r:That firm has many employees.} - O'sha firmada ko‘p xodimlar bor.
{r:He started his own firm last year, a small one.} - U o'tgan yili o'z firmasini boshladi, kichik bittasini.

text: {r:Sight}[saɪt] - manzara, ko'rinish; ko'rish, zrenie. Aslida bu so'z see(ko'rmoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:The sight of those mountains was amazing.} - O'sha tog‘larning manzarasi ajoyib edi.
{r:She lost her sight in an accident; that was sad.} - U baxtsiz hodisa tufayli ko'rish qobiliyatidan ayrildi; bu qayg'uli edi.
{r:The sight of the ocean made her happy; it was a beautiful one.} - Okean manzarasi uni baxtli qildi; u go'zal bittasi edi.
{r:He has poor eyesight.} - Uning zreniyasi(ko'rish qobiliyati) yomon.

text: {r:Article}[ˈɑːrtɪkl] - maqola.
examples: {r:This article was about an experienced surgeon.} - Bu maqola tajribali jarroh haqida edi.
{r:She wrote an article for the newspaper, a long one.} - U gazeta uchun maqola yozdi, uzun bittasini.
{r:That article discussed climate change.} - O'sha maqola iqlim o‘zgarishi haqida edi.
{r:He read the article carefully; it was a good one.} - U maqolani diqqat bilan o‘qidi; u yaxshi bittasi edi.

text: {r:Calculate}[ˈkælkjuleɪt] - hisoblamoq. Aslida {p:KALKULYAT}or so'zi aynan shu so'zdan olingan.
examples: {r:A plumber calculated the total cost; that was a hard one.} - Santexnik umumiy narxni hisoblab chiqdi; bu qiyin edi.
{r:He calculated the distance to the city; it was a long one.} - U shahargacha bo'lgan masofani hisoblab chiqdi; u uzun edi.
{r:The teacher asked us to calculate the answer; this was a fun one.} - O‘qituvchi bizdan javobni hisoblashni so‘radi; bu qiziqarli edi.
{r:They calculated the time it would take; those were difficult ones.} - Ular ketadigan vaqtni hisobladilar; ular qiyin edi.

text: {r:Subject}[ˈsʌbdʒɪkt] – fan, subyekt;mavzu. Adabiyot {h:fan}ida ‘’Jek va loviya’’ haqida ertak o’qigandik. Hozir esa ‘’{p:Sab}zi va {p:Jek’’} ni o’rganyapmiz adabiyot fanida.
examples: {r:The subject of this lesson was history.} - Bu darsning mavzusi tarix edi.
{r:Julia is good at this subject; it's an easy one for her.} - Julia bu fandan yaxshi; bu uning uchun oson bittasi.
{r:That subject was very difficult; I didn't like that one.} - O'sha fan juda qiyin edi; men uni yoqtirmadim.
{r:What subject I should study is none of your business.} - Qaysi fanni o'qishim kerak bu sizning ishingiz emas.

text: {r:Shyness}[ˈʃaɪnəs] - uyatchanlik, uyalchanglik. Shy(uyatchan) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Her shyness made it hard to speak; this is a common issue.} - Uning uyatchanligi gapirishini qiyinlashtirdi; bu keng tarqalgan muammo.
{r:He did his best to overcome his shyness; that was powerful.} - U o‘zining uyatchanligini yengish uchun qo'lidan kelguncha harakat qildi; bu kuchli edi.
{r:The shyness was obvious in her voice; it was a clear one.} - Uning ovozidagi uyatchanlik sezilarli edi; u aniq-ravshan (bittasi) edi.
{r:She felt shyness in front of the crowd; that is normal for some.} - U olomon oldida uyatchan his qildi; bu ba'zilar uchun normal.

text: {r:Artist}[ˈɑːrtɪst] - rassom. Ha ingliz tilida artist bu rassom.
examples: {r:This artist painted a beautiful picture; it's a famous one.} - Bu rassom go‘zal rasm chizdi; u mashhur bittasi.
{r:She is a famous artist.} - U mashhur rassom.
{r:The artist’s work was displayed in the gallery; these ones are new.} - Rassomning asari galereyada namoyish etildi; bular yangilari.
{r:He admired the artist’s talent; that was a unique one.} - U rassomning iste’dodini qadrladi; bu noyob bittasi edi.

text: {r:Powerful}[ˈpaʊərfəl] - qudratli, kuchli. Power(kuch) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The powerful engine made this car fast.} - Kuchli dvigatel bu mashinani tez qildi.
{r:She gave a powerful speech; it was a memorable one.} - U kuchli nutq so‘zladi; u unutilmas (bittasi) edi.
{r:That powerful storm caused much damage.} - O'sha kuchli bo‘ron ko'p zarar keltirdi.
{r:He is a powerful leader; he is a respected one.} - U kuchli rahbar; u hurmatga sazovor bittasi.

text: {r:Tail}[teɪl] – dum. Tasavvur qiling Real Madridning sobiq futbolchisi Garet {p:BEYL}ga {h:dum} o’sib chiqibdi.
examples: {r:We humans are lucky not to have a tail.} - Biz insoniyat dumimiz yo'qligi uchun omadlimiz.
{r:She noticed the bird’s long tail; that was a beautiful one.} - U qushning uzun dumini payqadi; u go'zal bittasi edi.
{r:The tail of this plane was damaged.} - Bu samolyotning dumiga zarar yetdi.
{r:He painted the tail of the kite, a colorful one.} - U varrak dumini bo‘yadi, rangli bittasini.

text: {r:Nest}[nɛst] – in. Tasavvur qiling {p:NEST}le suvi baklashkasiga chumolilar {h:in} qurib olibdi.
examples: {r:The bird built a nest in that tree.} - Qush o'sha daraxtda uya qurdi.
{r:She found a nest with eggs; it was a small one.} - U tuxumli uyani topdi; u kichik bittasi edi.
{r:This bird nest was round.} - Qush ini dumaloq edi.
{r:He watched the birds in the nest; these ones were young.} - U uyadagi qushlarni kuzatdi; bular yosh edi.

text: {r:Relax}[rɪˈlæks] – tinchlanmoq, xotirjam bo’lmoq. Agar nimadandir qattiq asabiylashsangiz {h:xotirjam} bo’lishning eng oson yo’lini bilaman. Uning uchun kimdir sizga qimmatbaho {p:ROLEKS} soatini sovg’a qilishi kerak.
examples: {r:My nephew relaxed after a long day; that was a good one.} - Mening jiyanim uzun kundan keyin dam oldi; bu yaxshi edi.
{r:He relaxed on the beach, a sunny one.} - U plyajda dam oldi, quyoshli bittasida.
{r:The music helped her relax; this is a good one.} - Musiqa unga dam olishga yordam berdi; bu yaxshi.
{r:They relaxed in the garden; it was a peaceful one.} - Ular bog‘da dam olishdi; u tinch bittasi(dam olish) edi.

text: {r:Emphasize}[ˈɛmfəsaɪz] – urg’u bermoq, ta'kidlamoq. Sobiq Ittifoq tarafdori emasman lekin bir narsani yaxshi qilishgan ular. Yoppasiga {p:EM}lanish {p:SAYIZ} payti majburiy bo’lgan va davlat aholining umumiy salomatligiga kuchli {h:urg’u bergan}.
examples: {r:The teacher emphasized the importance of reading; this is a key one.} - O‘qituvchi o‘qishning ahamiyatini ta’kidladi; bu asosiy bittasi.
{r:She emphasized the main points, making them clear ones.} - U asosiy fikrlarni ta’kidladi, ularni aniq qilib.
{r:He emphasized the need for teamwork; that was an important one.} - U jamoada ishlash zarurligini ta’kidladi; bu muhim bittasi edi.
{r:They emphasized the rules; these are crucial ones.} - Ular qoidalarni ta’kidladilar; bular muhimlari.

text: {r:Unbelievable}[ˌʌnbɪˈliːvəbəl] - hayratlanarli, ishonish qiyin bo'lgan. Believe(ishonmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The story was unbelievable; it was a strange one.} - Hikoya ishonarsiz edi; u g'alati bittasi edi.
{r:She told an unbelievable joke; that was a funny one.} - U ishonarsiz hazil aytdi; u kulgili bittasi edi.
{r:The unbelievable news shocked everyone; this was a big one.} - Ishonarsiz yangilik hammani hayratda qoldirdi; bu katta bittasi edi.
{r:He has an unbelievable talent; it is a rare one.} - Unda hayratlanarli iste’dod bor; u noyob bittasi.

text: {r:Violence}[ˈvaɪələns] - zo'ravonlik. Violent(zo'ravon) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The violence stopped with the arrival of police forces.} - Zo'ravonliklar politsiya kuchlari yetib kelishi bilan to'xtadi.
{r:She spoke against violence; that was a powerful speech.} - U zo‘ravonlikka qarshi gapirdi; bu kuchli nutq edi.
{r:The violence caused fear; this is a serious issue.} - Zo‘ravonlik qo‘rquvga sabab bo‘ldi; bu jiddiy muammo.
{r:He was a victim of violence; it was a sad one.} - U zo‘ravonlik qurboni bo‘ldi; bu qayg'uli bittasi edi.

text: {r:Anyway}[ˈɛniweɪ] – nima bo’lganda ham, baribir. Men trenajor zaliga chiqib gavdani kattartirish uchun shug’ullana boshladim, sport ozuqalari sotib oldim. Lekin uyimda turgan whey protein yo’q bo’lib qolaverardi, keyin bilsam o’g’limning {p:EN}agasi {p:WHEY}ni o’g’irlab o’z eriga berayotgan ekan. WHEY juda qimmat va sifatli protein, hozir u yigit baquvvatlashib ketdi, menda esa o’zgarish bo’lmadi. ‘{h:Nima bo’lganda ham}’ hammaga ishonish kerak emas ekan.
examples: {r:Anyway, let’s move on to the next issue.} - Xullas, keyingi masalaga o'taylik.
{r:She said she would come anyway, despite the rain.} - U yomg'irga qaramay, baribir kelishini aytdi.
{r:Anyway, it doesn’t matter now; that was yesterday's problem.} - Xullas, hozir bu muhim emas; bu kechagi muammo edi.
{r:He decided to go anyway, even though it was late.} - U kech bo'lsa ham, baribir borishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:State}[steɪt] – vaziyat, holat. Bunyodkor stadioni qurilganidan so'ng uni eng zo'r stadionlardan biri deya uzoq vaqt ulug'lashdi. Lekin {p:STAD}ionning futbol o'ynash uchun {h:holati} yaxshi emas edi. Chimlar ko'chib ketaverar edi.
examples: {r:Generally the state of the building was poor.} - Umuman olganda binoning ahvoli yomon edi.
{r:How is your current state?} - Hozirgi holating qanday?
{r:The state of the economy is improving; this is good news.} - Iqtisodiyotning ahvoli yaxshilanmoqda; bu yaxshi yangilik.
{r:He explained the state of the project; that was an important one.} - U loyihaning ahvolini tushuntirdi; bu muhim bittasi edi.

text: {r:Mostly}[ˈməʊstli] - asosan. Mana bu rasmda Nyu Yorkning eng mostlarga(ko'prik) boy tumani tasvirlangan. Qatnov kattaligi uchun bu yerda {h:asosan} {p:MOSTLI} yo'llar.
examples: {r:The group is mostly students; they are young ones.} - Guruh asosan talabalardan iborat; ular yoshlar.
{r:She mostly works from home; that is a convenient one.} - U asosan uydan ishlaydi; bu qulay bittasi.
{r:This book is mostly about history, a very detailed one.} - Bu kitob asosan tarix haqida, juda batafsil bittasi(tarix).
{r:He mostly eats vegetables.} - U asosan sabzavotlar iste’mol qiladi.

text: {r:View}[vjuː] - manzara, ko’rinish; fikr, o'y. Tog’larda ajoyib manzaralardan bahra olamiz. Faqatgin ba’zan militsiyaning viyu {p:viyu} degan tovushi {h:manzara}dan olayotgan zavqimizni buzadi. Militsiya tog’larda hayvonlarni noqonuniy ovlovchi brokonerlarni qidiradi.
examples: {r:There's a really beautiful view from this window.} - Bu derazadan haqiqatda chiroyli manzara ko'rinadi.
{r:We don't have any view of the ocean.} - Bizga okean manzarasi ko'rinmaydi.
{r:This is the best view of the building.} - Bu binoning eng yaxshi ko'rinishi.
{r:I didn't take any photos of the view.} - Men manzara suratini olmadim.

text: {r:Hospitality}[ˌhɒspɪˈtæləti] - mehmondo'stlik. Hospitable(mehmondo'st) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:They will hopefully show some wonderful hospitality.} - Umid qilamizki ular ajoyib mehmondo'stlik ko'rsatishadi.
{r:We really didn't receive any hospitality at that hotel.} - U mehmonxonada haqiqatdan ham hech qanday mehmondo'stlik ko'rsatilmadi.
{r:Could I have some information about local hospitality customs?} - Mahalliy mehmondo'stlik odatlari haqida ma'lumot olsam bo'ladimi?
{r:There wasn't any traditional hospitality shown.} - An'anaviy mehmondo'stlik ko'rsatilmadi.

text: {r:Basis}[ˈbeɪsɪs] - asos, tayanchoq, negiz. U biror narsa qanday qilib tashkil etilganini yoki nima asosida amalga oshirilishini ifodalashda ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:I have some basis for my argument.} - Mening argumentim uchun asoslarim bor.
{r:There isn't any scientific basis for this claim.} - Bu da'vo uchun ilmiy asos yo'q.
{r:Would you like some examples to form a better basis?} - Yaxshiroq asos yaratish uchun misollar kerakmi?
{r:We didn't find any reasonable basis for their decision.} - Ularning qaroriga hech qanday asosli sabab topolmadik.

text: {r:Else}[ɛls] – yana, boshqa. ‘’Omad shou’’ ning homiylari ko’p, masalan Artel. {h:Yana} bir homiysi esa {p:else}f.
examples: {r:My girlfriend found an excellent little café somewhere else.} – Qiz do‘stim boshqa joyda ajoyib kichkina kafe topdi.
{r:I don't want anything else.} - Boshqa hech narsa istamayman.
{r:Would you like something else to drink?} - Ichish uchun boshqa narsa istaysizmi?
{r:There isn't anywhere else to sit.} - O'tiradigan boshqa joy yo'q.

text: {r:Keep}[kiːp] – saqlamoq. Yangi kuyov kipriklari uzun xotiniga aytibdi; Agar {p:KIP}rigingni {h:saqlasang} bir umr, chiroying ham men uchun hech qachon yo’qolmaydi.
examples: {r:I've kept some old letters.} - Men ba'zi eski xatlarni saqlab qo'yganman.
{r:Don't keep any secrets from me.} - Mendan hech qanday sir saqlama.
{r:Can I have some tips to keep my plants healthy?} - O'simliklarimni sog'lom saqlash uchun maslahat bera olasizmi?
{r:We didn't keep any of the leftovers.} - Qoldiqlarning hech birini saqlamadik.

text: {r:Greatly}[ˈɡreɪtli] - buyuk, ko'p, ulkan. Great(buyuk, ulkan) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Some people were greatly affected.} - Ba'zi odamlar juda ko'p zarar ko'rgan.
{r:It didn't help anyone greatly.} - Bu hech kimga katta yordam bermadi.
{r:Would you somewhat agree it greatly improved?} - Bu juda yaxshilanganiga qisman qo'shilasizmi?
{r:There wasn't anything greatly different.} - Juda farq qiladigan hech narsa yo'q edi.

text: {r:Against}[əˈɡeɪnst] – qarshi. {p:Egoist} odam kimligini bilasizmi? U hamma narsaga {h:qarshi}, hech narsani ma'qullamaydigan inson.
examples: {r:Of course, I have some arguments against this plan.} - Ushbu rejaga qarshi albatta ba'zi dalillarim bor.
{r:There aren't any rules against it.} - Bunga qarshi hech qanday qoida yo'q.
{r:She is against the idea of going to the cinema} - U kinoteatrga borish g'oyasiga qarshi.
{r:We didn't have any protection against the storm.} - Bo'ronga qarshi hech qanday himoyamiz yo'q edi.

text: {r:System}[ˈsɪstəm] - tizim, sistema.
examples: {r:The entire system depends on the appropriate financing.} - Butun tizim to'g'ri moliyalashga bog'liq.
{r:The ancient system of slavery made a person a slave to another.} - Qullikning qadimiy tizimi bir shaxsni boshqa shaxsga qul qildi.
{r:Would you like some help with the operating system?} - Operatsion tizim bilan yordam kerakmi?
{r:There wasn't any problem with the sound system.} - Ovoz tizimida hech qanday muammo bo'lmadi.

text: {r:Boy}[bɔɪ] – o’g’il bola. {p:Bo’y} {h:o'g'il bolalar} uchun juda muhim, odatda eng uzun bola jismoniy tarbiya darslarida birinchida turadi.
examples: {r:The boy is impolite, impatient and lazy.} - Bola tarbiyasiz, sabrsiz va dangasa.
{r:I don't see any boys in the classroom.} - Sinfda hech qanday o'g'il bola ko'rmayapman.
{r:These boys depend on me for their homework.} - Bu bolalar uy ishlarida menga tayanishadi.
{r:Boys in this kingdom occasionally drink beer.} - Bu qirollikda o'g'il bolalar har zamonda pivo ichib turishadi.

text: {r:Reasonable}[ˈriːzənəbəl] - mulohazali. Ayolim juda {h:mulohazali}, tushungan ayol. Turmush qurishni taklif qilganimda oltin yoki kumushga pulim bo’lmagan va men ayolimga {p:REZIN}ali {p:BIL}aguzuk bilan turmush qurishni taklif qilganman. Ayolimning tavsiyalari bilan turmush qurgandan so’ng boyib ketdik.
examples: {r:We found some reasonable prices.} - Biz bir nechta oqilona narxlarni topdik.
{r:There isn't any reasonable explanation.} - Hech qanday to'g'ri tushuntirish yo'q.
{r:Would you like some reasonable suggestions?} - Oqilona takliflar kerakmi?
{r:They didn't give any reasonable alternatives.} - Ular hech qanday oqilona alternativ bermadilar.

text: {r:Statement}[ˈsteɪtmənt] - bayonot, ifoda, gap. U rasmiy yoki aniq aytilgan fikr, e’lon yoki bayonni ifodalashda ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:The witness gave some important statements.} - Guvoh ba'zi muhim bayonotlar berdi.
{r:I didn't make any official statement.} - Men hech qanday rasmiy bayonot bermadim.
{r:The architect made a statement about the unusual ceiling design.} - Arxitektor g'ayrioddiy shift dizayni haqida fikrini aytdi.
{r:There wasn't any false statement in the report.} - Hisobotda hech qanday yolg'on bayonot yo'q edi.
{r:The irony in his statement was clear to everyone.} - Uning gapidagi kesatiq hamma uchun aniq edi.

text: {r:Point}[pɔɪnt] - ma'no, mantiq, foyda, maqsad, nuqta, jihat, punkt. Kontekstga qarab 'point' so'zi turli xil ma'nolarga ega bo'lishi mumkin.
examples: {r:She made some good points.} - U bir nechta yaxshi fikrlarni aytdi.
{r:There isn't any point in arguing.} - Bahslashishning hech qanday ma'nosi yo'q.
{r:Would you like some help understanding the main points?} - Asosiy fikrlarni tushunishda yordam kerakmi?
{r:We didn't see any point in continuing.} - Davom etishning hech qanday ma'nosini ko'rmadik.

text: {r:Minor}[ˈmaɪnər] - kichik; balog’atga yetmagan. May oyida quyoshdan keladigan infra qizil nurlar aktivlashadi va bu nurlar qon bosimi bor insonlarga salbiy ta’sir qilishi mumkin. Ba’zilar ularni MAY NURlari deb ham atashadi. Qon bosimi menda yo’q shuning uchun {p:MAY NUR}lari men uchun juda {h:kichik} muammo.
examples: {r:There were some minor issues.} - Bir qancha mayda muammolar bor edi.
{r:I don't have any minor coins.} - Menda hech qanday mayda tanga yo'q.
{r:Could you give me some examples of minor changes?} - Mayda o'zgarishlarga misol keltira olasizmi?
{r:There weren't any minor injuries in the accident.} - Baxtsiz hodisada hech qanday mayda jarohatlar bo'lmadi.

text: {r:Celebrate}[ˈsɛləbreɪt] – nishonlamoq. {p:SEL}ofan biznesi {p:IBRAT}ni boyildi. 10 yil oldin kichik bir firma sifatida ochilgan edik. Hozir esa katta zavodga aylandik. Bugun biz biznesimiz 10 yilligini ichib {h:nishonlayapmiz}.
examples: {r:Let's buy some food to celebrate.} - Nishonlash uchun ovqat sotib olaylik.
{r:We didn't have any reason to celebrate.} - Nishonlash uchun hech qanday sabab yo'q edi.
{r:We found an occasion to celebrate her birthday again.} - Biz uning tug'ilgan kunini yana nishonlash uchun fursat topdik.
{r:There wasn't any special celebration.} - Hech qanday maxsus tantana bo'lmadi.

text: {r:Performance}[pərˈfɔːrmans] - bajarish, ijro etish, chiqish qilish. Bu so‘z harakatni amalga oshirish yoki sahnada chiqish qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:The band played some new performances.} - Guruh bir nechta yangi ijrolarni namoyish etdi.
{r:They didn't perform any traditional songs.} - Ular hech qanday an'anaviy qo'shiq ijro etmadi.
{r:Can I have some information about tonight's performance?} - Bugungi kechki spektakl haqida ma'lumot olsam bo'ladimi?
{r:There wasn't any live performance at the event.} - Tadbirda jonli ijro bo'lmadi.

text: {r:Curious}[ˈkjʊəriəs] - qiziquvchan, qiziqqon. Quyoshda KUYGAN YUS mana bunaqa bo’ladi. {h:Qiziquvchanligingiz} tutib olovda {p:kuygan yuz}ni ham ko’rishni istasangiz kerak. Lekin ko’rsata olmayman.
examples: {r:Some curious children asked questions.} - Ba'zi qiziquvchan bolalar savollar berishdi.
{r:I'm not curious about petrol prices.} - Bu benzin narxlariga qiziqmayapman.
{r:Would you like some curious facts about this place?} - Bu joy haqida qiziqarli faktlar kerakmi?
{r:There weren't any curious visitors at the exhibition.} - Ko'rgazmada hech qanday qiziqqon tashrifchilar yo'q edi.

text: {r:Nature}[ˈneɪtʃər] - tabiat. 'Tabiiy' so'zining sinonimi sifatida ko'pincha o'zbek tilida ham 'natural' so'zi ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:We saw some beautiful nature.} - Biz go'zal tabiatni ko'rdik.
{r:There isn't any untouched nature left here.} - Bu yerda hech qanday teginilmagan tabiiylik qolmagan.
{r:Could I get some advice about nature photography?} - Tabiatni suratga olish bo'yicha biroz maslahat olsam bo'ladimi?
{r:They didn't show any respect for nature.} - Ular tabiatga hech qanday hurmat ko'rsatmadi.

text: {r:Dust}[dʌst] - chang. Tasavvur qiling Sizning {p:DOST}on ismli o'rtog'ingiz har doim {h:chang}ga botib yuradi.
examples: {r:There's some dust on the shelves.} - Javonlarda chang bor.
{r:I don't see any dust in this room.} - Bu xonada hech qanday chang ko'rmayapman.
