{r:I was told that dust is very light.} - Chang juda yengil bo'ladi deb aytishdi menga.
{r:There wasn't any dust on the clean surfaces.} - Toza yuzalarda hech qanday chang yo'q edi.

text: {r:Fury}[ˈfjʊəri] - qahr, g'azab. Kartoshkadan qilingan {p:PYURI}ga xotinim adashib tuz o'rniga shakar solib qo'yibdi va g'alati tamli shirin kartoshkali ovqat tayyor bo'ldi. Xotinimning bu o'xshamagan {p:PYURI}si mening {h:g'azabim}ni keltirdi.
examples: {r:He expressed some fury at the decision.} - U qarorga nisbatan g'azabini bildirdi.
{r:I didn't feel any fury about the situation.} - Vaziyat haqida hech qanday g'azab his qilmadim.
{r:Can I offer some advice about managing fury?} - G'azabni boshqarish haqida maslahat bera olamanmi?
{r:There wasn't any public fury over the incident.} - Voqea bo'yicha omma g'azabi yo'q edi.

text: {r:Recover}[rɪˈkʌvər] – tuzalmoq, sog’aymoq; tiklamoq. Tasavvur qiling institutdagi rektoringiz pora olaverganidan qo’li qichiydigan kasal orttirib olibdi. Lekin bir oydan so’ng {p:REK}tor {p:KAVR}akdan qo’liga malham tayyorlab {h:sog’ayib ketibdi}.
examples: {r:The patient made a recovery.} - Bemor bir oz tuzaldi.
{r:We didn't recover any lost data.} - Biz yo'qotilgan ma'lumotlarning hech qanday qismini tiklay olmadik.
{r:Would you like some help recovering your strength?} - Kuchingizni tiklashda biroz yordam kerakmi?
{r:There wasn't any chance to recover the costs.} - Xarajatlarni qoplash imkoniyati yo'q edi.

text: {r:During}[ˈdjʊərɪŋ] – mobaynida, vaqtida. Kecha Bahodir Jalolov boksga tushdi va raqibini yutdi. Ochilish marosimi {h:vaqtida} tarixda birinchi marta chalishdi {p:du}tor {p:ring}da. Shu yo‘l bilan u qadriyatlarimizga hurmat ko’rsatdi.
examples: {r:She slept during the movie; she had no energy.} - U film davomida uxlab qoldi; uning hech qanday energiyasi yo'q edi.
{r:He called me during the meeting; I didn't have any phone with me.} - U yig‘ilish davomida menga qo‘ng‘iroq qildi; menda hech qanday telefon yo'q edi.
{r:The store is closed during the holiday; there isn't any shopping today.} - Do‘kon ta’til davomida yopiq; bugun xarid qilib bo'lmaydi.
{r:We talked during the walk, and there was no usual silence.} - Biz sayr qilayotganimizda suhbatlashdik, odatdagi sukunatdan asar ham yo'q edi.

text: {r:Govern}[ˈɡʌvərn] - boshqarmoq, idora qilmoq, hukmronlik qilmoq. U davlat, tashkilot yoki harakatlar ustidan nazorat va boshqaruvni amalga oshirish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:The president governs the country; he has no easy job.} - Prezident mamlakatni boshqaradi; uning oson ishi yo'q.
{r:She wants to govern fairly; she doesn't have any bad intentions.} - U adolatli boshqarmoqchi; uning yomon niyatlari yo'q.
{r:The new law will govern the system; there isn't any question about that.} - Yangi qonun tizimni boshqaradi; bu haqda hech qanday savol yo'q.
{r:He governed 10 villages, but none paid taxes.} - U 10 ta qishloqni boshqargan lekin hech biri soliq to'lamagan.

text:
{r:Hold}[hoʊld] – ushlab turmoq, tutib turmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - held, held. 
Men: Yuvilgan kiyimlarni ushlab turing men yana kiyimlarni kir mashinadan olishim kerak. Akam: {h:Ushlab} turolmayman ular {p:ho’ld}a, shamollab qolaman.
examples: {r:She held the baby carefully; she had no fear.} - U bolani ehtiyotlik bilan ushladi; uning hech qanday qo'rquvi yo'q edi.
{r:He held the door open for me; I didn't need to ask.} - U menga eshikni ochiq ushlab turdi; so'rashga hojat yo'q edi.
{r:The box is too heavy to hold; I don't have any strength.} - Qutini ushlash uchun juda og‘ir; menda kuch yo'q.
{r:He held the spoon with his left hand.} - U qoshiqni chap qo'li bilan ushladi.

text: {r:Large}[lɑːrdʒ] – katta, keng. Tasavvur qiling siz yashaydigan joy tabiati shunchalik antiqaki agar o’zingizni {p:LANCH} his qilsangiz gavdangiz {h:katta} bo’lib ketadi.
examples: {r:The room is really large; there is no small space.} - Xona haqiqatdan katta; kichik joy yo'q.
{r:She bought a large bag; she didn't have any other choice.} - U katta sumka sotib oldi; uning boshqa tanlovi yo'q edi.
{r:The large tree provided shade; there wasn't any other place to rest.} - Katta daraxt soya bilan ta'minlardi; dam olish uchun boshqa joy yo'q edi.
{r:He has a large collection of books, and none is being read.} - Unda katta kitoblar to‘plami bor va hech biri o'qilmayapti.

text: {r:Include}[ɪnˈkluːd] - o'z ichiga olmoq, kiritilmoq. Ayfon tutish sizga juda qimmatga tushishi mumkin agar biz kelajakdagi remontlarni va {p:AYKLOD}ga tushib qolishini {h:hisobga kiritsak}.
examples: {r:The price does not include breakfast; there is no food in the morning.} - Narxga nonushta kiritilmagan; ertalab hech qanday ovqat yo'q.
{r:She included all the details; she didn't leave out any parts.} - U barcha tafsilotlarni kiritdi; u hech qanday qismlarni qoldirmadi.
{r:The list includes ten items; there aren't any more to add.} - Ro‘yxatga o‘nta narsa kiritilgan; qo'shish uchun boshqa yo'q.
{r:He was included in the team; no one was left out.} - U jamoa tarkibiga kiritildi; hech kim qoldirib ketilmadi.

text: {r:Separate}[ˈsɛpəreɪt] – alohida; ajratmoq, bo’lmoq. {p:SEPARAT}or sutdan qaymoqni {h:ajratib} beruvchi asbob va bu texnikani qishloq joylarda yaxshi bilishadi. Bu so’z aynan inglizchadagi separate so’zidan olingan.
examples: {r:The two rooms are separate; there is no shared space.} - Ikkita xona alohida; umumiy joy yo'q.
{r:She separated the papers into two piles; she didn't have any other choice.} - U qog‘ozlarni ikkiga ajratdi; uning boshqa tanlovi yo'q edi.
{r:The teacher asked us to separate into groups; no one refused.} - O‘qituvchi bizdan guruhlarga ajralishni so‘radi; hech kim rad etmadi.
{r:He lives in a separate house, so he doesn't have any neighbors close by.} - U alohida uyda yashaydi, shuning uchun uning yaqinida qo'shnilari yo'q.

text: {r:Relaxation}[ˌriːlækˈseɪʃən] - dam olish, orom olish. Relax(dam olmoq, tinchlanmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She enjoys relaxation after work; she has no stress then.} - U ishdan keyin dam olishni yoqtiradi; keyin uning stressi yo'qoladi.
{r:The vacation was full of relaxation; there wasn't any rush.} - Ta’til dam olish bilan o'tdi; shoshilish yo'q edi.
{r:He finds relaxation in reading; he doesn't have any other hobbies.} - U oromni o'qishdan topadi; uning boshqa sevimli mashg'ulotlari yo'q.
{r:The music helped her relaxation; she has no stress presently.} - Musiqa unga dam olishga yordam berdi; uning hozirda stressi yo'q.

text: {r:Waste}[weɪst] – isrof qilmoq, sarflamoq(isrof qilib). Shahar hokimi JAR stadionini rekonstruksiya qilish uchun 10 million dollar sarflash haqida qaror chiqardi. G’alati qaror, {p:VAY}rona {p:ST}adionga nega 10 million {h:sarflash} kerak. Bu yana pul yuvishning bir sxemasi emasmi?
examples: {r:Don’t waste water; we have no extra water.} - Suvni isrof qilmang; bizda ortiqcha suv yo'q.
{r:She wasted her time; she didn't gain anything from it.} - U vaqtini isrof qildi; u bundan hech narsaga erishmadi.
{r:The waste was collected in a bin; there wasn't any waste on the ground.} - Chiqindilar qutida to‘plandi; yerda hech qanday chiqindi yo'q edi.
{r:He wasted his chances during the game, and none were left until the end.} – U o‘yin davomida imkoniyatlarini behuda sarfladi, oxirida esa hech biri qolmadi.

text: {r:Situated}[ˈsɪtʃueɪtɪd] - joylashgan.
examples: {r:The hotel is situated near the beach; there is no far walk.} - Mehmonxona plyaj yaqinida joylashgan; uzoq yurish yo'q.
{r:She lives in a house situated on a hill; she doesn't have any close neighbors.} - U tepalikda joylashgan uyda yashaydi; uning yaqin qo'shnilari yo'q.
{r:The school is situated in the city center; there isn't any other school like it.} - Maktab shahar markazida joylashgan; unga o'xshash boshqa maktab yo'q.
{r:How many offices are on this floor? None are here right now.} - Bu qavatda nechta ofis bor? Hozir bu yerda hech qaysi yo'q.

text: {r:Enter}[ˈɛntər] – kirmoq. Kecha bizni darvozamizdan {p:EN}li {p:TR}aktor {h:kirmoqchi} bo’ldi, lekin darvozadan sig’madi.
examples: {r:He entered the competition; he had no fear of losing.} - U musobaqaga kirishdi; u yutqazishdan qo'rqmadi.
{r:The students entered the classroom; there wasn't any talking.} - O‘quvchilar sinfxonaga kirishdi; gaplashish yo'q edi.
{r:She entered the room quietly; no one heard her.} - U xonaga sekin kirib keldi; uni hech kim eshitmadi.
{r:They entered the building through the back door; nobody saw them.} - Ular binoga orqa eshikdan kirishdi; ularni hech kim ko'rmadi.

text: {r:Lonely}[ˈloʊnli] - yagona, yolg'iz. Bizning qishloqda hamma kartoshka, piyoz ekishdi. Faqatgina men loviya ekdim. Men hozir bu yerda {h:yagona} {p:LOVIYALI} dehqonman.
examples: {r:She felt lonely after moving; she had no friends there.} - U ko‘chgandan keyin o'zini yolg‘iz his qila boshladi; u yerda do'stlari yo'q edi.

{r:She started to feel homesick and lonely in the new city; she didn't have anyone to talk to.} - U yangi shaharda o'zini uyini sog'ingan va yolg'iz his qila boshladi; gaplashadigan hech kim yo'q edi.
{r:He wrote a letter to his lonely friend, but there was none back.} - U yolg‘iz do‘stiga xat yozdi, lekin hech qanday javob yo'q edi.
{r:The lonely child played by himself; he had no one to play with.} - Yolg‘iz bola o‘zi o'ynadi; u bilan o'ynashga hech kim yo'q edi.

text: {r:Memory}[ˈmɛməri] - xotira. Tarixchi sifatida yurtimizning barcha tarixiy arxitektura namunalarini aylanib chiqqanman. Odamlarning ismini yaxshi eslab qololmayman lekin {p:MEMORIY} obidalarimizga nisbatan {h:xotiram} juda yaxshi ishlaydi.
examples: {r:She has a good memory; she forgets no dates.} - Uning xotirasi yaxshi; u hech qanday sanalarni unutmaydi.
{r:The memory of that day is still clear; there isn't any blur.} - O‘sha kunning xotirasi hali ham aniq; xira joyi yo'q.
{r:He lost his memory after the accident; he remembered none of his past life.} - U baxtsiz hodisadan keyin xotirasini yo‘qotdi; o'tmish hayotidan hech narsani eslay olmadi.
{r:She has countless memories from her childhood; none are sad.} - Uning bolaligidan son-sanoqsiz xotiralari bor; ularning hech qaysisi qayg'uli emas.

text:
{r:Matter}[ˈmætər] – ahamiyat kasb etmoq, muhim bo'lmoq; masala. 
Chaqmoq Makvin haqidagi multfilmni bilsangiz kerak. Makvinning yaqin do’sti bu {p:Metr.} Bu obraz ham {h:ahamiyatli}, shuning uchun multfilmni ikkinchi qismi Metr haqida.
examples: {r:The matter was discussed at the meeting; there was no easy answer.} - Masala yig‘ilishda muhokama qilindi; oson yechim yo'q edi.
{r:She explained the matter clearly; there wasn't any confusion.} - U masalani aniq tushuntirdi; hech qanday chalkashlik yo'q edi.
{r:How many simple solutions does the matter have? None.} - Masalaning qancha oddiy yechimlari bor? Hech qancha yo'q.
{r:Do you think that money matters? It doesn't matter at all to me.} - Pul ahamiyat kasb etadi deb o'ylaysizmi? Men uchun hech qanday ahamiyatga ega emas.

text: {r:Introduction}[ˌɪntrəˈdʌkʃən] - tanishtiruv, kirish qismi. Introduce(tanishtirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The introduction to the book was interesting; it had no boring parts.} - Kitobning kirish qismi qiziqarli edi; uning zerikarli qismlari yo'q edi.
{r:She gave a brief introduction; she didn't use any extra words.} - U qisqacha kirish so‘zini aytdi; u ortiqcha so'zlarni ishlatmadi.
{r:American movies were my first introduction with America.} - Amerika kinolari bu mening Amerika bilan ilk tanishuvim edi.
{r:He wrote the introduction to the report; no one else did.} - U hisobotning kirish qismini yozdi; boshqa hech kim yozmadi.

text: {r:Story}[ˈstɔːri] - hikoya. Qiziq odatim bor. Hamma instagramda kundalik hayoti va muhim voqealarni storizga qo'ysa men kitobdan {h:hikoyalar} o'qib {p:STORI}simga qo'yaman.
examples: {r:The story was about a sleepy cleaner; it had no exciting moments.} - Hikoya uyquchan tozalovchi(farrosh) haqida edi; uning qiziqarli lahzalari yo'q edi.
{r:She told a funny story. However, it did not make anyone laugh.} - U kulgili hikoya aytdi lekin u hech kimni kuldira olmadi.
{r:How many parts did the story have? None were boring.} - Hikoyaning nechta qismi bor edi? Hech biri zerikarli emas edi.
{r:He read the story to the children; no one was bored.} - U bolalarga hikoyani o‘qib berdi; hech kim zerikmadi.

text: {r:However}[haʊˈɛvər] - ammo, lekin.
examples: {r:She wanted to go; however, she had no car.} - U borishni xohladi, ammo uning mashinasi yo'q edi.
{r:The plan was good; however, it didn't have any chance to work.} - Reja yaxshi edi, ammo o'xshab ketish imkoniyati yo'q edi.
{r:He tried hard; however, he had none of the expected success.} - U qattiq harakat qildi, ammo kutilgan muvaffaqiyatdan asar ham yo'q edi.
{r:The weather was bad; however, we had no problems and had fun.} - Ob-havo yomon edi, ammo bizda muammo yo'q edi va zavqlandik.

text: {r:Blanket}[ˈblæŋkɪt] – adyol, choyshab. Tasavvur qiling katta {p:BANKET} bo’lyapti. Banketga kirishning yagona talabi {h:adyol}ga o’ranib kelish.
examples: {r:The blanket kept her warm; she had no cold feeling.} - Choyshab uni iliq tutdi; u hech qanday sovuq his qilmadi.
{r:He bought a new blanket; he didn't have any old one.} - U yangi adyol sotib oldi; uning eski bittasi yo'q edi.
{r:The blanket was soft and comfortable; it didn't have any rough parts.} - Choyshab yumshoq va qulay edi; uning qo'pol qismlari yo'q edi.
{r:She wrapped herself in the blanket; she had no worries.} - U ko‘rpaga o‘ranib oldi; uning tashvishlari yo'q edi.

text: {r:Community}[kəˈmjuːnəti] - jamiyat, jamoa. 'Bojalar Komyuniti' ni eslasangiz kerak.
examples: {r:The community helped the family; they had no other help.} - Jamiyat oilaga yordam berdi; ularning boshqa yordami yo'q edi.
{r:She is active in the community; she doesn't have any free time.} - U jamiyatda faol; uning bo'sh vaqti yo'q.
{r:How many followers does that speaker have? None in this community.} - O'sha ma'ruzachining nechta izdoshlari bor? Bu jamoada hech qancha yo'q.
{r:He works for the community; he asks for no money.} - U jamiyat uchun ishlaydi; u pul so'ramaydi.

text: {r:Charge}[tʃɑːrdʒ] - haq olmoq, to'lov olmoq; haq, to'lov.
examples: {r:The hotel charges extra; there is no free parking.} - Mehmonxona qo‘shimcha haq oladi; bepul avtoturargoh yo'q.
{r:They charged me $50 for a service; I didn't have any idea why.} - Ular mendan xizmat uchun $50 to‘lov olishdi; men nima uchun ekanligini bilmasdim.
{r:Many restaurants charge a fee; there isn't any free reservation.} - Ko‘pgina restoranlar to‘lov oladi; bepul bronlash yo'q.
{r:The store doesn’t charge customers for gift wrapping; there is no charge for that.} - Do‘kon mijozlardan sovg‘a o‘rash uchun to‘lov olmaydi; buning uchun to'lov yo'q.

text: {r:Body}[ˈbɒdi] – tana. Tasavvur qiling {p:BOD}ringni ham {h:tanasi}, qo’li, oyog’i bor.
examples: {r:She takes care of her body; she has no bad habits.} - U o‘z tanasiga e'tibor qiladi; uning yomon odatlari yo'q.
{r:His body was found in the river; fortunately he was breathing.} - Uning tanasi daryoda topildi; xayriyatki u nafas olayotgan edi.
{r:The body of the car was damaged; it didn't have any smooth part.} - Mashinaning korpusiga zarar yetgan edi; silliq joyi yo'q edi.
{r:He exercises to keep his body healthy; he has no complaints.} - U tanasini sog‘lom saqlash uchun mashq qiladi; uning shikoyatlari yo'q.

text: {r:Membership}[ˈmɛmbərʃɪp] - a'zolik. Member(a'zo) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She applied for membership in the club, but nobody accepted her.} - U klubga a’zolik uchun ariza berdi, lekin hech kim uni qabul qilmadi.
{r:The membership fee is 50 dollars, and there is nothing cheaper.} - A’zolik to‘lovi 50 dollar va undan arzonroq hech narsa yo'q.
{r:He renewed his membership last week, so he has nothing to worry about.} - U o‘tgan hafta a’zoligini yangiladi, shuning uchun xavotir oladigan hech narsasi yo'q.
{r:The membership includes many benefits; it doesn't leave anybody unhappy.} - A’zolik ko‘p imtiyozlarni o‘z ichiga oladi; u hech kimni norozi qoldirmaydi.

text: {r:Government}[ˈɡʌvərnmənt] - hukumat. Govern(boshqarmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The government announced a new policy and nobody understood it.} - Hukumat yangi siyosatni e’lon qildi va hech kim uni tushunmadi.
{r:She works for the government; she doesn't do anything else.} - U hukumat uchun ishlaydi; u boshqa hech narsa qilmaydi.
{r:The government is responsible for education but nothing is perfect.} - Hukumat ta’lim uchun mas’ul lekin hech narsa mukammal emas.
{r:He criticized the government’s decision but nobody listened.} - U hukumatning qarorini tanqid qildi lekin hech kim eshitmadi.

text: {r:Livelihood}[ˈlaɪvlihʊd] - tirikchilik, daromad manbai, qiladigan ish.
examples: {r:Farming is his livelihood, so he doesn't need anything else.} - Fermerlik uning tirikchilik manbai, shuning uchun unga boshqa hech narsa kerak emas.
{r:She lost her livelihood when the factory closed; now she has nothing.} - Zavod yopilganda u tirikchilik manbaini yo‘qotdi; hozir uning hech narsasi yo'q.
{r:The new job provided a better livelihood; nobody worries about money now.} - Yangi ish yaxshiroq tirikchilik manbaini ta’minladi; endi hech kim pul haqida qayg'urmaydi.
{r:He depends on fishing for his livelihood; he doesn't know anything else.} - Uning tirikchiligi baliq ovlashga bog‘liq; u boshqa hech narsa bilmaydi.

text: {r:Entrance}[ˈɛntrəns] - kirish joyi, kirish. Enter(kirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The entrance to the building is on the left, but nobody is guarding it.} - Binoning kirish joyi chap tomonda, lekin uni hech kim qo'riqlamaydi.
{r:She waited at the entrance, but no one came.} - U kirish joyida kutdi, lekin hech kim kelmadi.
{r:The entrance fee is 10 dollars, so it's not cheap for anybody.} - Kirish to‘lovi 10 dollar, shuning uchun bu hech kim uchun arzon emas.
{r:He couldn't find the entrance to the park, so he didn't see anything inside.} - U bog‘ning kirish joyini topolmadi, shuning uchun ichkaridagi hech narsani ko'rmadi.

text: {r:Several}[ˈsɛvərəl] – bir nechta. Qo’shiqchi Sevinch bir nechta filmlarda ham suratga tushgan. Masalan, ‘’Million’’ kinosida {p:SEV}inchni {p:ROL}i xuddi hayotidagidek {h:bir nechta} qo’shiq chiqarib mashhur bo’lgan inson haqida.
examples: {r:She has several books, but she hasn't read any of them.} - Unda bir nechta kitob bor, lekin u ularning hech birini o'qimagan.
{r:He visited several countries last year, but he didn't learn anything new.} - U o‘tgan yili bir nechta mamlakatga tashrif buyurgan, lekin yangi hech narsa o'rganmadi.
{r:Several people attended the meeting, but nobody spoke.} - Yig‘ilishda bir nechta odam qatnashdi, lekin hech kim gapirmadi.
{r:They offered several options, but none were good.} - Ular bir nechta variantni taklif qilishdi, lekin hech qaysisi yaxshi emas edi.

text: {r:Crowd}[kraʊd] – olomon, xalq. Angliyada dunyodagi eng katta {p:KRAVAT}ni yasashibdi. Uning ichida 200 kishilik {h:olomon} uxlasa bo’lar ekan.
examples: {r:The crowd cheered loudly, but nobody understood their words.} - Olomon baland ovozda olqishladi, lekin hech kim ularning so'zlarini tushunmadi.
{r:She got lost in the crowd; she couldn't see anybody familiar.} - U olomon ichida yo‘qolib qoldi; u tanish hech kimni ko'ra olmadi.
{r:The crowd gathered in the square, but nothing happened.} - Olomon maydonda to‘plandi, lekin hech narsa sodir bo'lmadi.
{r:He pushed through the crowd, but nobody moved fast.} - U olomon orasidan itarib o‘tdi, lekin hech kim tez harakat qilmadi.
{r:Her shyness made it difficult to speak in a large crowd.} - Uning uyatchanligi katta olomon ichida gapirishni qiyinlashtirdi.

text: {r:Pretty}[ˈprɪti] – chiroyli, ko’rkam;biroz. Priti Zinta ‘’Vir va Zara’’ filmi orqali ko’plab yurtdoshlarimizga yaxshi tanish. Men uchun {p:Priti} eng {h:ko’rkam} hind aktrissasi.
examples: {r:These trousers are very pretty; it doesn't need anything else.} - Bu shim juda chiroyli; unga boshqa hech narsa kerak emas.
{r:She looks pretty in that hat and nobody can deny it.} - U shlyapa kiyganda juda chiroyli ko‘rinadi va hech kim buni inkor eta olmaydi.
{r:The garden is pretty in spring but nothing lasts forever.} - Bog‘ bahorda juda chiroyli lekin hech narsa abadiy emas.
{r:She is a pretty girl but a bit selfish.} - U juda go'zal qiz lekin biroz xudbin.

text: {r:Worth}[wɜːrθ] – munosib; ga teng(qanchadir qiymat). Tasavvur qiling, boy kishi kasal yotgan payti o’g’illarini chaqirib merosini bo'lyapti “Men 1 million dollarga {h:teng} uyimni {p:VORIS}im itimga qoldiraman, u merosimni katta qismini olishga munosib. U mening haqiqiy vorisim. Senlar otangni ko’rishga 3 yilda bir keldilaring. Itim esa menga mehr ko’rsatdi, doimo yonimda bo’ldi’’
examples: {r:The painting is worth a lot of money; nothing else is worth more.} - Rasm juda qimmat; boshqa hech narsa qimmatroq emas.
{r:She said the trip was worth it; she didn't regret anything.} - U sayohatga arziydi dedi; u hech narsadan afsuslanmadi.
{r:That book is worth reading; nobody should ignore it.} - O'sha kitob o‘qishga arziydi; hech kim unga e'tiborsizlik qilmasligi kerak.
{r:He is worth millions, but he doesn't show it to anybody.} - U millionlarga teng, lekin buni hech kimga ko'rsatmaydi.

text: {r:Situation}[ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən] - vaziyat, situatsiya.
examples: {r:The situation is under control; there is nothing to worry about.} - Vaziyat nazorat ostida; xavotirlanishga hech narsa yo'q.
{r:She explained the situation clearly, so nobody was confused.} - U vaziyatni aniq tushuntirdi, shuning uchun hech kim chalkashmadi.
{r:The situation is very serious; nobody knows what to do.} - Vaziyat juda jiddiy; hech kim nima qilishni bilmaydi.
{r:He handled the situation well; he didn't miss anything important.} - U vaziyatni yaxshi hal qildi; u muhim hech narsani o'tkazib yubormadi.

text: {r:History}[ˈhɪstəri] - tarix, istoriya.
examples: {r:She mostly loves studying history; there is nothing more interesting for her.} - U asosan tarixni o‘rganishni yoqtiradi; u uchun bundan qiziqarliroq hech narsa yo'q.
{r:The history of the city is fascinating; nobody knows all its secrets.} - Shaharning tarixi hayratlanarli; uning barcha sirlarini hech kim bilmaydi.
{r:Hameed occasionally reads history.} - Hamid ora-orada tarix o'qib turadi.
{r:The history lesson was interesting; nobody fell asleep.} - Tarix darsi qiziqarli bo'ldi; hech kim uxlab qolmadi.

text: {r:Memorable}[ˈmɛmərəbəl] - unutilmas, esda qolarli. Memory(xotira) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Actually the trip was very memorable; nobody will forget it.} - Aslida sayohat juda esda qolarli edi; uni hech kim unutmaydi.
{r:She gave a memorable speech; she didn't miss anything important.} - U esda qolarli nutq so‘zladi; u muhim hech narsani o'tkazib yubormadi.
{r:The memorable event was celebrated; nothing could stop the fun.} - Esda qolarli tadbir nishonlandi; hech narsa zavqni to'xtata olmadi.
{r:He has many memorable experiences; he doesn't forget anybody he meets.} - Unda ko‘p esda qolarli xotiralar bor; u o'zi bilan uchrashgan hech kimni unutmaydi.

text: {r:Require}[rɪˈkwaɪər] – talab qilmoq. Hindistonning rikshalarini bizga ham olib kelishdi. Lekin yo’llarni {p:rik}shalar {p:vayr}on qilib tashlashdi. Ularga juda yaxshi asfalt qilingan yo’llar {h:talab qilinar ekan}.
examples: {r:The job requires experience; it doesn't need anything else.} - Ish tajriba talab qiladi; unga boshqa hech narsa kerak emas.
{r:She requires more time to finish, but nobody can give it.} - U tugatish uchun ko‘proq vaqt talab qilyapti, lekin hech kim buni unga bera olmaydi.
{r:The situation requires immediate action; nobody can wait.} - Vaziyat zudlik bilan harakat qilishni talab qiladi; hech kim kuta olmaydi.
{r:He requires help with the project; he can't do it alone.} - U loyiha uchun yordam talab qiladi; u buni yolg'iz qila olmaydi.

text: {r:Social}[ˈsoʊʃəl] – ijtimoiy. Motivator ozg’in yigit ekan 2 soat quruq gap gapirdi. Keyin {p:so’}kindim {p:shl}anka hech narsa o’rgatmayapsan deb. U esa menday insonlar {h:ijtimoiy} xavf ekanligini aytdi.
examples: {r:The social event was a success; nothing went wrong.} - Ijtimoiy tadbir muvaffaqiyatli bo‘ldi; hech narsa noto'g'ri bo'lmadi.
{r:He studies social issues; he wants to learn everything.} - U ijtimoiy masalalarni o‘rganadi; u hamma narsani bilishni xohlaydi.
{r:The social media post went viral; nobody expected that.} - Ijtimoiy tarmoqdagi post virusli tarqaldi; hech kim buni kutmagan edi.
{r:She gained many new followers on social media platforms.} - U ijtimoiy media platformalarida ko'plab yangi obunachilarni qo'lga kiritdi.

text: {r:Level}[ˈlɛvəl] - daraja, sath, uroven. Ingliz tili darajasini ko'tarish uchun faqat o'qishning o'zi yetarli emas. To'g'ri ovqatlanish ham bo'lish kerak. Masalan ko'p {p:LAVL}agi yeyish kerak, qonni ko'paytiradi. Keyin ingliz tili {h:darajasi} ham ko'tariladi.
examples: {r:The water level is rising; nobody can stop it.} - Suv sathi ko‘tarilmoqda; uni hech kim to'xtata olmaydi.
{r:She reached a high level in her career; nothing could stop her.} - U karyerasida yuqori darajaga erishdi; hech narsa uni to'xtata olmadi.
{r:How could you improve your English level?} - Ingliz tili darajangizni qanday ko'tara oldingiz?
{r:He is at the beginner level; he doesn't know anybody here.} - U boshlang‘ich darajada; u bu yerda hech kimni bilmaydi.

text: {r:Allow}[əˈlaʊ] – ruxsat bermoq. Bizning uyimizda {p:e}chkiga {p:lov}iya, faqatgina loviya berishga {h:ruxsat} etiladi. Chunki u echkilarni juda tez semirtiradi.
examples: {r:The teacher allowed us to leave early; nobody objected.} - O‘qituvchi bizga erta ketishga ruxsat berdi; hech kim e'tiroz bildirmadi.
{r:She allowed her son to go to the party; she didn't say anything negative.} - U o‘g‘liga kechaga borishga ruxsat berdi; u hech qanday salbiy narsa demadi.
{r:The rules do not allow smoking; nobody can smoke here.} - Qoidalar chekishga ruxsat bermaydi; bu yerda hech kim cheka olmaydi.
{r:He allowed the dog to enter the house; there was nothing to stop him.} - U itga uyga kirishga ruxsat berdi; uni to'xtatadigan hech narsa yo'q edi.
{r:The sickness did not allow him to attend the social event.} - Kasallik unga ijtimoiy tadbirda qatnashishga yo'l bermadi.

text: {r:Add}[æd] – qo’shmoq. Mana shu oy o’qiydigan kitoblarim ro'yxatiga {p:AD}abiyot kitobini ham {h:qo’shib qo’ydim}.
examples: {r:She added sugar to her tea; she didn't add anything else.} - U choyiga shakar qo‘shdi; u boshqa hech narsa qo'shmadi.
{r:Julia chopped the carrot and added it to the soup.} - Julia sabzini to'g'radi va sho'rvaga qo'shdi.
{r:Add me to your Telegram channel.} - Meni telegram kanalingga qo'shib qo'y.
{r:They added more chairs to the room; nobody needed to stand.} - Ular xonaga ko‘proq stul qo‘shishdi; hech kim turishi shart emas edi.

text: {r:Rare}[reər] – noyob, kamyob. Tasavvur qiling {p:RE}diska {p:YER}ga ekdingiz va natijada rediska urug’idan {h:kamyob} va qimmatbaho metal oltin chiqdi. Xuddi Zumrad va Qimmat ertagida tarvuzdan oltin chiqqanidek.
examples: {r:Finding such an old coin is relatively rare.} - Bunday eski tangani topish nisbatan kam uchraydi.
{r:She has a rare talent; nobody else has it.} - Unda kam uchraydigan iste’dod bor; boshqa hech kimda yo'q.
{r:The rare book was sold for a high price; nothing else was so valuable.} - Kam uchraydigan kitob yuqori narxga sotildi; boshqa hech narsa bunchalik qimmatli emas edi.
{r:He found a rare coin; he didn't find anything similar then.} - U kam uchraydigan tanga topdi; bunga o'xshash hech narsa topmadi keyin.

text: {r:Case}[keɪs] - holat, vaziyat, ish; chemodan. Keserva kesish nimaligini bilasizmi? Agar homilador ayol tug'ruqni o'zi amalga oshirolmaydigan {h:holat} yuzaga kelsa {p:KES}erva kesish orqali farzand dunyoga keltiriladi.
examples: {r:The police are investigating the case; they didn't miss anything.} - Politsiya ishni tergov qilmoqda; ular hech narsani o'tkazib yubormadilar.
{r:She presented her case clearly; nobody had any doubts.} - U o‘z ishini aniq taqdim etdi; hech kimda shubha qolmadi.
{r:The case of robbery was quickly closed.} - O'g'irlik ishi tezda yopib yuborildi.
{r:He carried his books in a case; he didn't carry anything else.} - U kitoblarini chemodanda ko‘tarib yurardi; u boshqa hech narsa ko'tarmadi.

text:
{r:Spend}[spɛnd] – sarflamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - spent, spent. 
Yangi reklama ko’rib qoldim. ‘’{p:Sup}urgi {p:end}i tekin, pul {h:sarflashingizni} hojati yo’q’’ deyishyapti.
examples: {r:She spends a lot of time reading; she doesn't waste anything.} - U ko‘p vaqtini o‘qishga sarflaydi; u hech narsani isrof qilmaydi.
{r:He spent his money wisely; he didn't buy anything useless.} - U pulini oqilona sarfladi; u foydasiz hech narsa sotib olmadi.
{r:They spent the weekend at the beach; nobody worked.} - Ular dam olish kunlarini plyajda o‘tkazishdi; hech kim ishlamadi.
{r:How I spend my money is none of her business.} - Pulimni qanday ishlatishimga u burnini tiqmasin.

text: {r:Within}[wɪˈðɪn] – ichida. {p:Viz}a {p:In}diyaga olsam, Indiyaning {h:ichida} 90 kun bemalol yura olaman.
examples: {r:The answer is within the book; you won't find it anywhere else.} - Javob kitobning ichida; uni boshqa hech joydan topa olmaysiz.
{r:She completed the task within an hour; nobody helped her.} - U vazifani bir soat ichida bajardi; unga hech kim yordam bermadi.
{r:The store is within walking distance; you don't need anything to get there.} - Do‘kon piyoda borish masofasida; u yerga borish uchun sizga hech narsa kerak emas.
{r:He stayed within the rules; he didn't break anything.} - U qoidalar doirasida qoldi; u hech narsani buzmadi.

text: {r:Among}[əˈmʌŋ] – orasida. Bizning poliklinikamizda 1 yoshgacha bolalar {h:orasida} qoidaga ko’ra {p:em}lanish {p:o’ng} tarafdan, ya’ni o’ng qo’l va o’ng bo’ksa.
examples: {r:She found her keys among the books; there was something hidden there.} - U kalitlarini kitoblar orasidan topdi; u yerda biror narsa yashiringan edi.
{r:He was among the first to arrive; somebody was patiently waiting for him.} - U kelgan birinchi odamlar orasida edi; kimdir uni sabr bilan kutayotgan edi.
{r:The answer is among these options; you need to find something.} - Javob ushbu variantlar orasida; siz biror narsa topishingiz kerak.
{r:They discussed the issue among themselves; they didn't ask anybody.} - Ular masalani o‘zaro muhokama qilishdi; ular hech kimdan so'rashmadi.

text: {r:Exit}[ˈɛɡzɪt] – chiqmoq; chiqish, chiqish eshigi. {p:EGIZ}ak {p:IT}lar kirib qolibdi uyimizga. {h:Chiqish eshigi}ni ko’rsatib yuborsam o’zlari chiqib ketarmikan yoki urib quvalasamgina ketarmikan?
examples: {r:The exit is on the right, but there is nobody there.} - Chiqish joyi o‘ng tomonda, lekin u yerda hech kim yo'q.
{r:She hurried to the exit, wanting to go somewhere quiet.} - U chiqish joyiga shoshildi, qayergadir tinch joyga borishni xohlab.
{r:The fire exit was clearly marked; everybody knew where to go.} - Yong‘in chiqish joyi aniq belgilangan edi; hamma qayerga borishni bilar edi.
{r:He exited from the room.} - U xonadan chiqib ketdi.

text: {r:Teammate}[ˈtiːmmeɪt] - jamoadosh. Team(jamoa) va mate(do'st) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She thanked her teammate for the help; she couldn't do anything alone.} - U yordami uchun jamoadoshiga minnatdorchilik bildirdi; u hech narsani yolg'iz qila olmasdi.
{r:He is a good teammate; he always helps somebody.} - U yaxshi jamoadosh; u har doim kimlargadir yordam beradi.
{r:The teammates celebrated their victory; they went somewhere nice.} - Jamoadoshlar g‘alabani nishonladilar; ular biror yaxshi joyga borishdi.
{r:The truth is my teammates are impolite, impatient and lazy. }- Haqiqat shuki mening jamoadoshlarim tarbiyasiz, besabr va dangasa.
{r:The firefighter performed a brave rescue of his teammate.} - O't o'chiruvchi o'z jamoadoshini jasoratli qutqarishni amalga oshirdi.

text: {r:Separately}[ˈsɛpərətli] - alohida. Separate(alohida) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:They arrived separately, so nobody saw them together.} - Ular alohida-alohida kelishdi, shuning uchun hech kim ularni birga ko'rmadi.
{r:She packed the items separately; she didn't put anything together.} - U narsalarni alohida-alohida qadoqladi; u hech narsani birga qo'ymadi.
{r:The twins were dressed separately; they didn't want to look exactly the same.} - Egizaklar alohida-alohida kiyinib olishgan edi; ular bir xil ko'rinishni xohlamadilar.
{r:He paid for the tickets separately; he didn't want anybody to pay for him.} - U chiptalarni alohida to‘ladi; u uchun hech kim to'lashini xohlamadi.

text: {r:Drugstore}[ˈdrʌɡstɔːr] - apteka.
examples: {r:She bought medicine at the drugstore; she needed something for her cold.} - U dorixonadan dori sotib oldi; unga shamollash uchun biror narsa kerak edi.
{r:This grey drugstore is open 24 hours, so you can go there anytime.} - Bu kulrang dorixona 24 soat ochiq, shuning uchun u yerga istalgan vaqtda borishingiz mumkin.
{r:He works at the drugstore; he sees somebody new every day.} - U dorixonada ishlaydi; u har kuni qandaydir yangi odamni ko'radi.
{r:The drugstore is near the hospital; it's a good place to find anything you need.} - Dorixona kasalxona yaqinida; sizga kerak bo'lgan har qanday narsani topish uchun yaxshi joy.

text: {r:Moment}[ˈmoʊmənt] - moment, vaqt, payt, davr, lahza.
examples: {r:A plumber waited for a moment; he didn't want to do anything quickly.} - Santexnik bir zum kutdi; u hech narsani tez qilishni xohlamadi.
{r:He arrived at the right moment; somebody opened the door.} - U to‘g‘ri paytda keldi; kimdir eshikni ochdi.
{r:The moment was unforgettable; there was nothing like it.} - Bu lahza unutilmas edi; unga o'xshash hech narsa yo'q edi.
{r:They shared a special moment, just between themselves.} - Ular maxsus lahzani o‘zaro baham ko‘rishdi., faqat o'zaro.
{r:It was a truly memorable moment in the history of the country.} - Bu mamlakat tarixidagi chinakam esda qolarli davr edi.

text: {r:Search}[sɜːrtʃ] – qidirmoq; qidirish. Tasavvur qiling institutni bitirganingizdan so’ng barcha kursdosh do’stlaringiz bilan ko’rishib turasiz, lekin bir do’stingizni hech topolmaysiz. {p:Siroch} ismli do’stingizni {h:qidirasiz} va oqibatda u chet elga ko’chib ketgani haqida eshitdingiz.
examples: {r:She searched for her keys; unfortunately she couldn't find them anywhere.} - U kalitlarini qidirdi; afsuski u ularni hech qayerdan topa olmadi.
{r:He searched the room carefully; he didn't miss anything.} - U xonani diqqat bilan qidirdi; u hech narsani o'tkazib yubormadi.
{r:The search took a long time; nobody gave up.} - Qidiruv uzoq vaqt oldi; hech kim taslim bo'lmadi.
{r:They are searching for a new house; they want to find somewhere perfect.} - Ular yangi uy qidirmoqda; ular mukammal qayernidir topishni xohlaydilar.

text: {r:Rescue}[ˈrɛskjuː] – qutqarmoq. Toshkentdagi Efendi nomli turk restoranini kuya bosib ketibdi. Bu turklar kuyadan qanday qutulishni bilmas ekan. Men Efendiga kirib uksusga botirilgan latta bilan bitta artgan edim hamma kuya yo’q bo’lib ketdi. Men {p:RES}toranni {p:KUY}adan {h:qutqarib} qoldim.
examples: {r:The rescue team arrived quickly; somebody called them.} - Qutqaruv jamoasi tez yetib keldi; kimdir ularga qo'ng'iroq qildi.
{r:She rescued the cat from the tree; it was something brave to do.} - U mushukni daraxtdan qutqardi; bu jasur narsa edi.
{r:The rescue operation was successful; nobody was hurt.} - Qutqaruv operatsiyasi muvaffaqiyatli bo‘ldi; hech kim jarohat olmadi.
{r:He thanked the rescue workers; he didn't know anybody more helpful.} - U qutqaruv ishchilariga minnatdorchilik bildirdi; u undan ko'proq yordam beradigan hech kimni bilmas edi.

text: {r:Escape}[ɪˈskeɪp] – qochmoq; qochish. Qadim zamonda bir halol inson va uning itini noto’g’ri ayblov bilan qamab qo’yishgan ekan. Halol inson bir kuni qochishga muvaffaq bo’libdi, uning iti esa qolib ketibdi. It egasini qayerdan topishini, qayerga ketganini bilmas emish. Oxiri xo’jayinining hidini eslab yerni {p:ISKAB} u {h:qochgan} yo’lni aniqlab it ham qochib ketibdi.
examples: {r:She escaped from the burning building; she didn't lose anything.} - U yonayotgan binodan qochib ketdi; u hech narsani yo'qotmadi.
{r:He planned his escape carefully; he didn't tell anybody.} - U qochishini diqqat bilan rejalashtirdi; u hech kimga aytmadi.
{r:The escape was risky, but it was the only thing to do.} - Qochish xavfli edi, lekin bu qilish kerak bo'lgan yagona narsa edi.
{r:They made a narrow escape; they went somewhere safe.} - Ular zo'rg'a qochib ketishdi; ular biror xavfsiz joyga borishdi.

text: {r:Educate}[ˈɛdʒʊkeɪt] - ta'lim bermoq, tarbiyalamoq. Education so'zining fe'l shakli.
examples: {r:She does her best to educate her children well; she wants them to know everything.} - U bolalarini yaxshi tarbiyalamoqchi; u ularning hamma narsani bilishini xohlaydi.
{r:He was educated in a private school; he learned something new every day.} - U xususiy maktabda o‘qigan; u har kuni biror yangi narsa o'rgangan.
{r:You can't educate a liar to be honest.} - Sen yolg'onchini halol bo'lishga o'rgata olmaysan.
{r:They are working to educate the community; they want to teach something important.} - Ular jamiyatni tarbiyalash uchun ishlayapti; ular biror muhim narsani o'rgatmoqchilar.

text: {r:Secondary}[ˈsɛkəndəri] - ikkinchi darajali. Second(ikkinchi) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:This is a secondary issue. We must discuss something important.} - Bu ikkinchi darajali masala. Biz ahamiyatliroq nimadirni muhokama qilishimiz kerak.
{r:The secondary road was less busy; there was nowhere to hide.} - Ikkilamchi yo‘l kam gavjum edi; yashirinadigan joy yo'q edi.
{r:He has a secondary role in the play; but it's still something important.} - U spektaklda ikkinchi darajali rolda; lekin bu hali ham muhim narsa.
{r:The secondary issue was also important; nobody ignored it.} - Ikkilamchi masala ham muhim edi; hech kim uni e'tiborsiz qoldirmadi.

text: {r:Disability}[ˌdɪsəˈbɪləti] - nogironlik.
examples: {r:She works with people with disabilities; she does something good.} - U nogironlar bilan ishlaydi; u yaxshi narsa qiladi.
{r:The disability made it difficult for him to walk; he couldn't go anywhere fast.} - Nogironlik uning yurishini qiyinlashtirdi; u hech qayerga tez bora olmaydi.
{r:They discussed disability rights; nobody disagreed.} - Ular nogironlar huquqlarini muhokama qilishdi; hech kim norozi bo'lmadi.
{r:He overcame his disability; he showed something great to everybody.} - U nogironligini yengib chiqdi; u hammaga nimadir buyuk narsani(namuna) ko'rsatdi.

text: {r:Process}[ˈprɒsɛs] - protsess, jarayon.
examples: {r:The introduction of new technology is a slow process.} - Yangi texnologiyaning joriy etilishi sekin jarayondir.
{r:She explained the process clearly; everybody understood something new.} - U jarayonni aniq tushuntirdi; hamma biror yangi narsani tushundi.
{r:The process of making bread is interesting; it teaches you something.} - Non tayyorlash jarayoni qiziqarli; u sizga biror narsa o'rgatadi.
{r:He is in the process of writing a book; he doesn't do anything else now.} - U kitob yozish jarayonida; u hozir boshqa hech narsa qilmaydi.
{r:Deep breathing is a simple process for achieving relaxation.} - Chuqur nafas olish oromga erishishning oddiy jarayonidir.

text: {r:Including}[ɪnˈkluːdɪŋ] - jumladan, shu jumladan, ichiga olgan holda. Bu so‘z biror narsaning tarkibiga kiruvchi qismlar yoki misollarni keltirish uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:The price includes everything, including taxes; you don't need to pay anything extra.} - Narxga hamma narsa, shu jumladan soliqlar kiritilgan; sizga ortiqcha hech narsa to'lash kerak emas.
{r:She invited everyone, including her neighbors; nobody was left out.} - U hammani, shu jumladan qo‘shnilarini taklif qildi; hech kim tashqarida qolmadi.
{r:The package includes many items, including a book; it has something for everybody.} - Paketda ko‘p narsalar, shu jumladan kitob bor; unda hamma uchun biror narsa bor.
{r:He thanked everyone, including his teacher; he didn't forget anybody.} - U hammaga, shu jumladan o‘qituvchisiga minnatdorchilik bildirdi; u hech kimni unutmadi.

text: {r:Serve}[sɜːrv] - xizmat qilmoq, servis qilmoq.
examples: {r:She served the guests tea; she didn't forget anyone.} - U mehmonlarga choy berdi; u hech kimni unutmadi.
{r:He served in the army for five years; he went somewhere far away.} - U armiyada besh yil xizmat qildi; u uzoq biror joyga bordi.
{r:The restaurant serves delicious food; there's always something good to eat.} - Restoran mazali ovqatlar beradi; har doim biror mazali narsa bor.
{r:They served the community for many years; they did something for everybody.} - Ular jamiyatga ko‘p yillar xizmat qilishdi; ular hamma uchun biror narsa qilishdi.

text: {r:Human}[ˈhjuːmən] - inson.
examples: {r:No human should ever be treated as a slave.} - Hech qanday inson hech qachon qul sifatida ko'rilmasligi kerak.
{r:She studies human behavior; she learns something new every day.} - U inson xulq-atvorini o‘rganadi; u har kuni biror yangi narsa o'rganadi.
{r:The human race has made great progress; there's still somewhere to go.} - Insoniyat katta taraqqiyot qildi; hali ham rivojlanishi kerak.
{r:He believes in human rights; he doesn't want anything bad to happen to anybody.} - U inson huquqlariga ishonadi; u hech kimga yomon narsa bo'lishini xohlamaydi.
{r:The wheel was a revolutionary invention that changed human history.} - G'ildirak insoniyat tarixini o'zgartirgan inqilobiy ixtiro edi.

text: {r:Reach}[riːtʃ] – erishmoq, yetmoq. Akam qa{p:RICH} bilan butun mahalla hududini o’lchashga {h:erishgan} birinchi inson.
examples: {r:She reached the top of the mountain; it was something amazing.} - U tog‘ cho‘qqisiga yetib keldi; bu biror ajoyib narsa edi.
{r:He reached for the book on the shelf; he wanted something to read.} - U javondagi kitobga cho‘zildi; u o'qish uchun biror narsa xohladi.
{r:The train reached the station on time; nobody waited long.} - Poyezd stansiyaga vaqtida yetib keldi; hech kim uzoq kutmadi.
{r:They reached an agreement; it was a good result for everybody.} - Ular kelishuvga erishishdi; bu hamma uchun yaxshi natija edi.

text: {r:Control}[kənˈtroʊl] - kontrol, nazorat; nazorat qilmoq.
examples: {r:She lost control of the car; there was nothing she could do.} - U mashinani boshqarishni yo‘qotdi; u qila oladigan hech narsa yo'q edi.
{r:He has control over the situation; he doesn't need anybody's help.} - U vaziyatni nazorat qilib turibdi; unga hech kimning yordami kerak emas.
{r:They are trying to control the problem; they are doing something important.} - Ular muammoni nazorat qilishga harakat qilmoqda; ular muhim bir narsa qilmoqda.
{r:It is hard to control people waiting in the queue.} - Navbatda kutayotgan odamlarni nazorat qilish qiyin

text: {r:Remain}[rɪˈmeɪn] – qolmoq, qoldirmoq. {p:Remen}imni maktab hududida {h:qoldirib} kelibman. Shuning uchun shimimni qo’lim bilan ushlab keldim.
examples: {r:She remained calm during the storm; she didn't show anybody her fear.} - U bo‘ron paytida xotirjam qoldi; u hech kimga qo'rquvini ko'rsatmadi.
{r:He remained at home while others went out; he didn't want to go anywhere.} - Boshqalar chiqib ketganda u uyda qoldi; u hech qayerga borishni xohlamadi.
{r:The question remains unanswered; nobody has found a solution.} - Savol javobsiz qoldi; hech kim yechim topa olmadi.
{r:They remained friends for many years; nothing could break their bond.} - Ular ko‘p yillar do‘st bo‘lib qolishdi; hech narsa ularning aloqasini buzolmadi.
{r:The future of the project remains doubtful because of financial problems.} - Moliyaviy muammolar tufayli loyihaning kelajagi shubhali bo'lib qolmoqda.

text: {r:Field}[fiːld] – maydon, dala. Tasavvur qiling Afrikada {p:fil d}umini {h:dalaga} ekishadi va u haqiqatdan ham kattalashib daraxtga aylanadi.
examples: {r:The field was full of flowers; there was something beautiful everywhere.} - Dala gullarga to‘la edi; hamma joyda biror chiroyli narsa bor edi.
{r:She works in the field of medicine; she helps somebody every day.} - U tibbiyot sohasida ishlaydi; u har kuni kimlargadir yordam beradi.
{r:The children played in the field; they didn't want to go anywhere else.} - Bolalar dalada o‘ynashdi; ular boshqa hech qayerga borishni xohlamadilar.
{r:Consistency is key to success in any field.} - Har qanday sohada izchillik muvaffaqiyat garovidir.

text: {r:Emphasis} - urg'u, e'tibor. Emphasize(urg'u bermoq) so'zidan yasalgan
examples: {r:The teacher, Ms. Karimova, put emphasis on pronunciation, saying every student must practice daily.} - O‘qituvchi, Karimova xonim, talaffuzga alohida e’tibor berib, har bir talaba har kuni mashq qilishi shart dedi.
{r:She spoke with great emphasis, as if everything depended on her words.} - U katta e’tibor bilan gapirdi, go'yo hamma narsa uning so'zlariga bog'liq edi.
{r:The emphasis of the lesson was on grammar, so everybody should pay attention.} - Darsning urg'usi grammatikaga qaratilgan edi, shuning uchun hamma diqqat qaratishi kerak.
{r:He placed emphasis on the importance of reading, explaining that all books offer something new.} - U o‘qishning ahamiyatini ta’kidladi, barcha kitoblar yangi narsa taklif qilishini tushuntirdi.

text: {r:Charger} - zaryadchik.
examples: {r:Anvar forgot his phone charger at home, and now his phone is dead; he must find a charger everywhere.} - Anvar telefon zaryadlovchisini uyda unutdi va hozir telefoni o'chgan; u hamma joydan zaryadlovchi topishi shart.
{r:The charger is not working; it used to work fine before.} - Zaryadchik ishlamayapti; u avval yaxshi ishlar edi.
{r:Lola bought a new charger for her laptop, as her old one was always losing power.} - Lola noutbuki uchun yangi zaryadchik sotib oldi, chunki eskisi har doim quvvatni tez yo'qotar edi.
{r:All chargers are in the bag, but every single one is broken.} - Hamma zaryadchiklar sumkada, lekin har bir donasi buzilgan.

text: {r:Research} – izlanish. {p:RI}xsitilla {p:so’rg’ich}lar ustida {h:izlanish} olib boradi va bolalar uchun eng yoqimli so’rg’ich ishlab chiqarishga harakat qiladi.
examples: {r:Zahida is doing research on climate change; she should examine every piece of data.} - Zahida iqlim o‘zgarishi haqida tadqiqot olib bormoqda; u har bir ma'lumotni tekshirishi kerak.
{r:The research took several months, and all the scientists were working tirelessly.} - Tadqiqot bir necha oy davom etdi va barcha olimlar tinmay ishlayotgan edi.
{r:A surgeon presented his research at the conference, and everybody was listening attentively.} - Jarroh o‘z tadqiqotini konferentsiyada taqdim etdi va hamma diqqat bilan tinglayotgan edi.
{r:His greatest invention came after years of research and experiment.} - Uning eng buyuk ixtirosi ko'p yillik tadqiqot va tajribadan so'ng paydo bo'ldi.

text: {r:Flag} - bayroq, flag.
examples: {r:The lovely flag was flying high, and of course every citizen felt proud.} - Ajoyib bayroq baland hilpirab turardi va har bir fuqaro albatta g'ururlanardi.
{r:While the band was playing, Dilnoza waved the flag during the parade, and everybody cheered.} - Guruh chalayotgan paytda, Dilnoza paradda bayroq hilpiratdi va hamma qichqirdi.
{r:The flag represents the country; it is a symbol for all of us.} - Bayroq mamlakatni ifodalaydi; bu barchamiz uchun ramz.
{r:He saluted the flag, as he used to do every morning when he was in the army.} - U bayroqqa salom berdi(chest berdi), xuddi armiyada bo'lganida har kuni ertalab qilganidek.

text: {r:Except} – dan tashqari. Qishda armiyaga borgan paytimiz tomoq og’rig’i boshlansa chaynab yaxshi bo’p ketasilar deb {p:IK}kitadan {p:SEPT}olete berishgan men{h:dan tashqari} hammaga. Men baquvvat, immuniteti baland yigit bo’lganim uchun menga bitta berishdi.
examples: {r:Everyone came to the party except Jahongir; he was working all night.} - Jahongirni hisobga olmaganda, hamma kechaga keldi; u butun tun ishlayotgan edi.
{r:She likes all fruits except bananas; she says they make her sick.} - U banandan tashqari barcha mevalarni yoqtiradi; u banan uni kasal qiladi deydi.
{r:The store is open every day except Sunday; we used to go there every weekend.} - Do‘kon yakshanba kunidan tashqari har kuni ochiq; biz har dam olish kunlari u yerga borardik.
{r:He answered all the questions except one; everything else was perfect.} - U bitta savoldan tashqari barchasiga javob berdi; qolgan hamma narsa mukammal edi.

text: {r:Society} - jamiyat.
examples: {r:She studies the role of women in society, and she believes every woman has a voice.} - U jamiyatda ayollarning rolini o‘rganadi va u har bir ayolning ovozi borligiga ishonadi.
{r:How does society regard this new trend?} - Jamiyat bu yangi tendentsiyaga qanday qaraydi?
{r:He is a respected member of society; everyone listens to him.} - U jamiyatning hurmatga sazovor a’zosi; hamma uni tinglaydi.
{r:The society is changing rapidly; everything is different now.} - Jamiyat tez o‘zgarib bormoqda; hozir hamma narsa boshqacha.

text: {r:Additional} - qo'shimcha. Add(qo'shmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She provided additional information; she had to ensure everything was clear.} - U qo‘shimcha ma’lumot berdi; u hamma narsaning aniq bo'lishini ta'minlashi kerak edi.
{r:The teacher gave us additional homework; every student should complete it by Monday.} - O‘qituvchi bizga qo‘shimcha uy vazifasi berdi; har bir talaba uni dushanbaga qadar tugatishi kerak.
{r:He paid an additional fee, as everything cost more than expected.} - U qo‘shimcha to‘lov to‘ladi, chunki hamma narsa kutilganidan qimmatroq edi.
{r:The additional cost was unexpected, but all the guests still paid.} - Qo‘shimcha xarajat kutilmagan edi, lekin barcha mehmonlar baribir to'ladi.

text: {r:Mixture} – aralashma. Agar yerga noodatiy o’g’it sepmoqchi bo’lsangiz {p:MIKS}erda {p:CHIR}ik olma, banan va barglardan {h:aralashma} tayyorlang va yerni ozuqlantiring.
examples: {r:The mixture of colors was beautiful; every shade blended perfectly.} - Ranglar aralashmasi juda chiroyli edi; har bir rang mukammal aralashgan edi.
{r:Shahnoza made a mixture of fruits for the salad, using all the ripe ones she had.} - Shahnoza salat uchun mevalar aralashmasini tayyorladi, o'zida bor bo'lgan barcha pishgan mevalarni ishlatib.
{r:How can I make this mixture?} - Qanday qilib bu aralashmani tayyorlasam bo'ladi?
{r:Can you hold this mixture for some time?} - Mana bu aralashmani biroz vaqt ushlab turolasizmi?

text: {r:Former} – sobiq. Tasavvur qiling dadangiz {h:sobiq} {p:fermer}.
examples: {r:The former president, Mr. Aliyev, visited the school, and everybody cheered loudly.} - Sobiq prezident, janob Aliyev, maktabga tashrif buyurdi va hamma baland ovozda qichqirdi.
{r:She is a former student of this university; she used to study here every day.} - U bu universitetning sobiq talabasi; u har kuni bu yerda o'qigan.
{r:She is a former owner of a local drugstore.} - U mahalliy aptekani sobiq egasi.
{r:He introduced his former colleague, Rustam, and everybody was happy to see him.} - U o‘zining sobiq hamkasbi Rustamni tanishtirdi va hamma uni ko'rganidan xursand edi.

text: {r:Major} – muhim, katta. {p:Mey}vezr {p:jir}afani minmoqchi bo’libdi aslida ularni minish taqiqlangan bo’lsada. Zoopark xodimlari oxiri baribir ruxsat beribdi chunki Meyvezrning tashrifi {h:muhim} edi zoopark uchun. Floyd Meyveyzr Amerikalik mashhur bokschi.
examples: {r:Dust is a major problem here.} - Chang bu yerda katta muammo.
{r:The major problem was solved, and everyone felt relieved.} - Asosiy muammo hal qilindi va hamma yengillik his qildi.
{r:Umar played a major role in the project; everything he did was important.} - Umar loyihada asosiy rol o‘ynadi; u qilgan hamma narsa muhim edi.
{r:The major event attracted many people; you could see happy faces everywhere.} - Muhim tadbir ko‘p odamlarni jalb qildi; hamma joyda xursand yuzlarni ko'rish mumkin edi.

text:
{r:Examine} - ko'zdan kechirmoq, tekshirmoq. 
Rus tilidagi ekzamen so'zini eslash kifoya. Garchi ruschada bu so'z 'imtihon' ma'nosini anglatsada ma'no jihatdan kuchli yaqinlik bor.
examples: {r:The doctor, Dr. Saidov, examined the patient carefully, checking everything.} - Shifokor Saidov bemorni diqqat bilan hamma joyini tekshirdi.
{r:She examined the evidence carefully, as every detail mattered.} - U dalillarni diqqat bilan tekshirdi, chunki har bir detal muhim edi.
{r:He is examining the possibility of a new job; he should check all the requirements.} - U yangi ish imkoniyatini tekshirmoqda; u barcha talablarni tekshirishi kerak.
{r:The teacher examined the students’ work, and everybody was hoping for a good grade.} - O‘qituvchi o‘quvchilarning ishlarini tekshirdi va hamma yaxshi baho kutayotgan edi.

text: {r:Requirement} - talab. Require(talab qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The job has many requirements and every candidate must meet them.} - Ish ko‘p talablarni o‘z ichiga oladi va har bir nomzod ularga mos kelishi shart.
{r:She met all the requirements for the course, so everything was fine.} - U kurs uchun barcha talablarni bajardi, shuning uchun hamma narsa joyida edi.
{r:Following safety guidance is a strict requirement.} - Xavfsizlik bo'yicha ko'rsatmalarga rioya qilish qat'iy talabdir.
{r:He explained the requirements clearly, so everyone understood everything.} - U talablarni aniq tushuntirdi, shuning uchun hamma hamma narsani tushundi.

text: {r:Maintain} - parvarish qilmoq, saqlab turmoq, amal qilmoq. {p:MEN TENGI}lar sog'lom hayot tarziga {h:amal qilib} jismoniy mashqlar qilyapti. Men esa ichish, chekish bilan bandman. Nihoyat men ham 60 yoshimda obruch aylantirishni, ertalab 2 km sayr qilishni boshladim. Hamma narsa sekin-sekin, bosqichma-bosqich bo'laveradi.
examples: {r:She maintained her car regularly; she used to do it every month.} - U mashinasini muntazam ravishda parvarish qilardi; u har oyda buni qilardi.
{r:He maintains a healthy lifestyle; he must eat healthy food every day.} - U sog‘lom turmush tarzini saqlaydi; u har kuni sog'lom ovqatlanishi shart.
{r:The company maintains high standards; everything they do is top quality.} - Kompaniya yuqori standartlarni saqlaydi; ular qilgan hamma narsa eng yuqori sifatli.

{r:They maintained their friendship for years, even though they lived in opposite parts of the country.} - Ular yillar davomida do‘stliklarini saqlab qolishdi, garchi ular mamlakatning qarama-qarshi tarafida yashagan bo'lsalarda.

text: {r:Rate} so‘zi o‘zbek tilida "daraja", "ko‘rsatkich" yoki "tezlik" degan ma’nolarni anglatadi. Ko‘pincha iqtisodiy yoki statistik ma’lumotlarda ishlatiladi. Masalan: 1) "The unemployment rate is increasing." — "Ishsizlik darajasi oshmoqda." (ko‘rsatkich) 2) "He speaks at a fast rate." — "U tez sur’atda gapiradi." (tezlik) Xulosa: "Rate" so‘zi biror narsaning o‘zgarish tezligi yoki statistik ko‘rsatkich sifatida ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:The rate of growth is increasing; all businesses should prepare for it.} - O‘sish sur’ati o‘sib bormoqda; barcha korxonalar bunga tayyorlanishi kerak.
{r:She works at a high rate; she gets everything done quickly.} - U yuqori sur‘atda ishlaydi; u hamma narsani tezda bajaradi.

text:
{r:Lead} – yetaklamoq, yetakchilik qilmoq, boshqarmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - led, led. 
Leader(lider, yetakchi) aynan mana shu so'zdan olingan. Bu so'zni 'leader' ga bog'lash orqali yaxshi assotsatsiya hosil qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:She leads the team effectively, and everybody really respects her decisions.} - U jamoani samarali yetaklaydi va hamma uning qarorlarini haqiqatdan hurmat qiladi.
{r:He led the group to the top of the mountain; they were climbing all day.} - U guruhni tog‘ cho‘qqisiga olib bordi; ular butun kun davomida ko'tarilayotgan edi.
{r:The road leads to the city, where everything is bustling and lively.} - Yo‘l shaharga olib boradi, u yerda hamma narsa shovqinli va jonli.
{r:Lead, don't follow!} - Yetakchilik qil, kimgadir ergashma!
{r:Strong leaders are needed to govern and lead a nation effectively.} - Millatni samarali boshqarish va yetakchilik qilish uchun kuchli rahbarlar kerak.

text: {r:Pull} – tortmoq. Urush payti ishlatilgan {p:pul}emyot yerga kirib ketibdi. Siz esa uni o’ynab ko’rish uchun yerdan {h:tortib} sug’urib oldingiz.
examples: {r:She pulled the door open, and everybody rushed inside.} - U eshikni tortib ochdi va hamma ichkariga shoshildi.
{r:He pulled the box across the floor; he used to do it every time he moved.} - U qutini pol bo‘ylab tortdi; u har safar ko'chganda buni qilardi.
{r:The child pulled his mother’s hand, wanting to go somewhere.} - Bola onasining qo‘lini tortdi, qayergadir borishni xohlab.
{r:They pulled the car out of the mud; it was a difficult job for all of them.} - Ular mashinani loydan tortib chiqarishdi; bu ularning barchasi uchun qiyin ish edi.

text: {r:Return} – qaytmoq, qaytarmoq. Rixsitilla uyida katta to’y qilib berdi. Xorazmlik qo'shiqchining tori to'y payti qolib ketibdi. {p:Ri}xsitilla {p:torn}i {h:qaytarish} uchun 1100 km yo’l bosib Xorazmga boribdi.
examples: {r:She returned home late, because she was working all day.} - U uyga kech qaytdi, chunki u butun kun ishlayotgan edi.
{r:He returned the book to the library; he must return every book on time.} - U kitobni kutubxonaga qaytardi; u har bir kitobni o'z vaqtida qaytarishi shart.
{r:The return journey was faster, and everybody was happy about it.} - Qaytish safari tezroq edi va hamma bundan xursand edi.
{r:They returned to the same place, just as they used to do every year.} - Ular o‘sha joyga qaytishdi, xuddi har yili qilganlaridek.

text: {r:Price} – narx. Bu {p:pra}va {p:rays}niki. {h:Narxi} qanchaga tushganini bilasizmi? Tekin, rais bo’lganligi uchun tekinga qib berishdi. Agar shaharda yashab prayezdnoydan foydalansangiz aynan shu so'zni assotsatsiya ya'ni mnemonik namuna uchun qo'llasangiz ham bo'ladi.
examples: {r:The price of the car is high; not everybody can afford it.} - Mashina narxi yuqori; uni hamma ham sotib ololmaydi.
{r:She checked the price before buying, making sure everything was correct.} - U sotib olishdan oldin narxni tekshirdi, hamma narsaning to'g'ri ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilib.
{r:The price includes taxes, so you should see the final cost.} - Narxga soliqlar kiritilgan, shuning uchun siz yakuniy narxni ko'rishingiz kerak.
{r:He negotiated the price with the seller, as he used to do with all his purchases.} - U sotuvchi bilan narxni kelishib oldi, xuddi barcha xaridlarida qilganidek.

text: {r:According} - ...ga muvofiq, ga ko’ra. Uyga borib {p:akangni ko’rding}, ota-onangni ko’rding endi o’qishga qayt. Rektorni buyrug’i{h:ga ko’ra} o’qish tez orada boshlanadi.
examples: {r:According to the report, the project is on track, and everything is going well.} - Hisobotga ko‘ra, loyiha nazorat ostida va hamma narsa yaxshi ketmoqda.
{r:She acted according to the rules; every decision she made was correct.} - U qoidalarga muvofiq harakat qildi; u qabul qilgan har bir qaror to'g'ri edi.
{r:The decision was made according to the plan; all the steps were followed.} - Qaror rejaga muvofiq qabul qilindi; barcha bosqichlarga amal qilindi.
{r:He arrived according to the schedule, as he used to do every time.} - U jadvalga muvofiq yetib keldi, xuddi har safar qilganidek.

text:
{r:Join} – qo’shilmoq. 
Do’stim: Bugun futbol bor, O’zbekiston o’ynaydi, sen ham tushasanmi. 
Men: Bilet topish qiyin ekan. Agar {p:joyn}i naqd qilsang, senlarga {h:qo’shilib} futbol ko’raman.
examples: {r:My aunt, Malika, joined the club last week, and she loves every moment of it.} - Xolam Malika o‘tgan hafta klubga qo‘shildi va u bu yerdagi har bir lahzani yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:He joined the team for the project; he should help everybody now.} - U loyiha uchun jamoaga qo‘shildi; u endi hammaga yordam berishi kerak.
{r:They joined the two pieces together, making everything perfectly fit.} - Ular ikkita qismni bir-biriga ulashdi, hamma narsani mukammal tarzda moslashtirib.
{r:The river joins the sea here; you can see water everywhere.} - Daryo bu yerda dengizga quyiladi; hamma joyda suvni ko'rishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:Crowded}[ˈkraʊdɪd] – gavjum, to’la, zich, tiqilinch. Qishloqda qolgan uyimga 10 yil shaharda yashab qaytib keldim. Qarasam uy devorlari yorilib hamma yoqni chang bosib ketibdi. Eski {p:KROVAT IT}larga {h:to’lib} ketibdi. 8 ta it mening krovatimda yonma-yon tig’iz bo’lib yotib olibdi. Men ularni hammasini quvib yubordim.
examples: {r:Markets are crowded mostly on weekends.} - Bozorlar asosan dam olish kunlari gavjum bo'ladi.
{r:After the match, all of the streets around the stadium were crowded.} - O'yindan keyin stadion atrofidagi barcha ko'chalar gavjum edi.
{r:Were any of the cafes crowded this morning?} - Bugun ertalab kafelarning birortasi gavjum edimi?
{r:Even in a crowded city, he felt homesick for his quiet village.} - Gavjum shaharda ham u o'zining tinch qishlog'ini sog'indi.

text: {r:Role}[roʊl] – rol, o'rin.
examples: {r:Most roles in a big company require hard work.} - Katta kompaniyadagi aksariyat rollar qattiq mehnatni talab qiladi.
{r:What was her role in solving the problem?} - Muammoni hal qilishda uning roli qanday edi?
{r:Some of the roles in that movie were played by children.} - O'sha filmdagi rollarning ba'zilari bolalar tomonidan ijro etilgan.
{r:All of their roles in the project were clear from the beginning.} - Loyihada ularning barcha rollari boshidanoq aniq edi.

text: {r:Police}[pəˈliːs] – politsiya.
examples: {r:Most police officers wear blue uniforms and black sunglasses.} - Aksariyat politsiya xodimlari ko'k forma va qora ko'zoynak kiyadi.
{r:All of the police cars arrived at the scene quickly.} - Barcha politsiya mashinalari voqea joyiga tezda yetib keldi.
{r:Did any police officers talk to the people at the party?} - Kechada birorta politsiya odamlar bilan gaplashdimi?
{r:No police were needed at the quiet protest.} - Tinch norozilik namoyishida hech qanday politsiya kerak bo'lmadi.

text: {r:Awake}[əˈweɪk] – uyg'oq.
examples: {r:Most children are awake by six in the morning.} - Aksariyat bolalar ertalab soat oltiga qadar uyg'oq bo'ladi.
{r:Some of us were still awake when the sun came up.} - Bizning ba'zilarimiz quyosh chiqqanida hali ham uyg'oq edik.
{r:Was anyone awake when you came home late last night?} - Kecha kechqurun uyga kelganingizda kimdir uyg'oq edimi?
{r:After the news, all of my family was awake for a long time.} - Yangiliklardan so'ng, butun oilam uzoq vaqt uyg'oq edi.

text: {r:Education}[ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃn] – ta'lim, maorif. {p:ETIK}ni {p:KISHAN}lab qo’yishibdi yomon o’qigani uchun va yaxshi {h:ta’lim} olmaguncha qo’yib yubormas ekanlar.
examples: {r:Most education begins at a young age.} - Aksariyat ta'lim yoshlikda boshlanadi.
{r:Some of the education he got was from an old teacher.} - U olgan ta'limning ba'zilari eski o'qituvchidan edi.
{r:All of my education helped me understand the world better.} - Mening barcha ta'limim dunyoni yaxshiroq tushunishimga yordam berdi.
{r:Education can enable you to achieve great success in life.} - Ta'lim hayotda katta muvaffaqiyatlarga erishishingizga imkon berishi mumkin.

text: {r:Humanity}[hjuːˈmænəti] – insoniyat, bashariyat; insongarchilik, odamiylik.
examples: {r:Humanity wants a future of peace.} - Insoniyat tinch kelajakni xohlaydi.
{r:All of humanity faces common problems.} - Butun insoniyat umumiy muammolarga duch keladi.
{r:Did any great ideas for humanity come from this meeting?} - Bu yig'ilishdan insoniyat uchun birorta ajoyib g'oyalar paydo bo'ldimi?
{r:Where is your humanity?} - Insongarchiliging qani?

text: {r:Formerly}[ˈfɔːrmərli] – ilgari, avval. former(sobiq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Most buildings formerly had different uses.} - Aksariyat binolar ilgari turli maqsadlarda ishlatilgan.
{r:This place, formerly a church, now has some art inside.} - Bu joy, ilgari cherkov bo'lgan, endi ichida san'at asarlari bor.
{r:Were any of the people formerly known to him?} - Odamlarning birortasi ilgari unga tanish edimi?
{r:All of these old stories formerly seemed simple, but now they are deep.} - Bu eski hikoyalarning barchasi ilgari oddiy ko'ringan, lekin hozir chuqur tuyulayapti.

text: {r:Majority}[məˈdʒɒrəti] – ko'pchilik, aksariyat. Major(katta, asosiy) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The majority of people voted yes for the new plan.} - Odamlarning aksariyati yangi reja uchun ovoz berdi.
{r:Was a clear majority reached on that point?} - O'sha fikr bo'yicha aniq ko'pchilikka erishildimi?
{r:No majority was possible, so the decision was postponed.} - Ko'pchilikka erishilmadi, shuning uchun qaror qoldirildi.
{r:The majority of my friends are foreigners.} - Do'stlarimning ko'pchiligi chet elliklar.

text: {r:Minority}[maɪˈnɒrəti] – ozchilik, kamchilik.
examples: {r:The minority often feels unheard in big groups.} - Katta guruhlarda ozchilik ko'pincha eshitilmaydi.
{r:Some of the minority opinions were also important for the discussion.} - Ozchilik fikrlarining ba'zilari muhokama uchun ham muhim edi.
{r:It's only a tiny minority of people who are causing the problem.} - Faqatgina odamlarning kamchilik qismigina muammoga sabab bo'lyapti.
{r:The scientist says only a minority of birds cannot fly.} - Olimning aytishicha faqatgina qushlarning kamchilik qismi ucha olmas ekan.

text: {r:Season}[ˈsiːzn] – fasl, mavsum. Biz ishlatadigan 'sezon' so'zi aynan shu so'zdan olingan.
examples: {r:Generally most seasons bring different weather.} - Umuman olganda aksariyat fasllar turli xil ob-havoni olib keladi.
{r:Some of the seasons are very cold here, like winter.} - Bu yerda fasllarning ba'zilari juda sovuq, qish kabi.
{r:Does any season feel very long to you?} - Sizga birorta fasl juda uzun tuyuladimi?
{r:I think it is not the season for skirts.} - Menimcha hozir yubkaning mavsumi emas.

text: {r:Pick}[pɪk] – tanlamoq, terib olmoq. Bolalar imunitetini yaxshilash uchun {p:Pik}ovitni {h:tanlang}.
examples: {r:Most children pick their favorite toy to play with.} - Aksariyat bolalar o'ynash uchun sevimli o'yinchoqlarini tanlaydilar.
{r:Did your nephew pick any fruit from the garden today?} - Bugun jiyaningiz bog'dan birorta meva terdimi?
{r:Some of the players picked the wrong side in the game.} - O'yinchilarning ba'zilari o'yinda noto'g'ri tomonni tanladilar.
{r:All of the oranges were picked early this morning.} - Barcha apelsinlar bugun ertalab erta terib olindi.

text: {r:Couple}[ˈkʌpl] – juftlik, bir nechta. Egizak jiyanlarimga bir {h:juft} {p:kapl}ka sovg’a qildim.
examples: {r:Couples enjoy mostly quiet evenings at home.} - Aksariyat juftliklar uyda tinch oqshomlarni yoqtirishadi.
{r:Some of the couples at the wedding danced all night.} - To'ydagi juftliklarning ba'zilari butun tun raqsga tushishdi.
{r:Were any couples from your family at the party?} - Kechada oilangizdan birorta juftlik bormidi?
{r:All of the young couples looked happy and well.} - Barcha yosh juftliklar baxtli va yaxshi ko'rinardi.

text: {r:Half}[hɑːf] – yarim, yarmisi. Tasavvur qiling, oyligingizni faqat {h:yarmini} to’lashdi, sizni esa bundan {p:haf}salangiz pir bo’ldi.
examples: {r:Half an hour is usually enough time.} - Yarim soat odatda yetarli vaqt.
{r:Most of the work is half done now.} - Ishlarning aksariyati hozirda yarmi bajarilgan.
{r:Did you get half of the cake?} - Tortning birorta yarmini oldingizmi?
{r:All of the bread was eaten in less than half the time.} - Butun non belgilangan vaqtning yarmidan kamroq vaqt ichida yeb bo'lindi.

text: {r:Ease}[iːz] – osonlik, qulaylik. Biror narsani topolmay qiynalyapsizmi? Unda {p:IZ}quvar Sherlok Xolmsni yollang va u o’zining deduksiya qobiliyatidan foydalanib sizning narsangizni {h:osongina} hojatxonangizdan topib beradi.
examples: {r:Most problems can be solved with ease if you have patience.} - Agar sabr-toqatingiz bo'lsa, aksariyat muammolarni osonlik bilan hal qilish mumkin.
{r:Some of the new ideas brought an ease to the hard work.} - Yangi g'oyalarning ba'zilari og'ir mehnatga osonlik olib keldi.
{r:Was there any ease in the situation after the meeting?} - Yig'ilishdan keyin vaziyatda birorta osonlik bo'ldimi?
{r:All of his tasks were finished with surprising ease.} - Uning barcha vazifalari hayratlanarli darajada osonlik bilan yakunlandi.

text: {r:Image}[ˈɪmɪdʒ] – tasvir, rasm, obraz.
examples: {r:Most images on the internet are very clear.} - Internetdagi aksariyat rasmlar juda aniq.
{r:Some of the images in this old book are black and white.} - Bu eski kitobdagi rasmlarning ba'zilari oq-qora.
{r:Did you find any image of the building before it was changed?} - Bino o'zgarishidan oldingi birorta rasmini topdingizmi?
{r:Which image I should pick is none of your business.} - Qaysi rasmni tanlashim kerakligi bilan sizning ishingiz bo'lmasin.

text: {r:Cover}[ˈkʌvər] – qoplamoq, yopmoq, o'ramoq; muqova. {p:Kavr} ap ko’rsatuvida mana birinchi marta {h:o’ranib} olgan qiz ishtirokchi qatnashyapti.
examples: {r:Books mostly have a colorful cover.} - Aksariyat kitoblar rangli muqovaga ega.
{r:Some of the chairs were covered with green material.} - Bu stullarning ba'zilari yashil material bilan qoplangan.
{r:Does the subsidy cover any of my expenses?} - Bu subsidya mening birorta xarajatimni qoplaydimi?
{r:The ground is covered with snow.} - Yer qor bilan qoplangan.

text: {r:Peace}[piːs] – tinchlik, osoyishtalik. Bilasizmi mening fikrimcha dunyoda {h:tinchlik} bo’lishi uchun ko’proq {p:pis}ta ekish kerak. Shunda hamma pista chaqib o’tirardi, dangasa bo’lardi, urushishga ham xohishi qolmasdi.
examples: {r:Most people wish for peace in the world.} - Aksariyat odamlar dunyoda tinchlikni orzu qiladi.
{r:Humanity mostly needs peace.} - Insoniyatga eng ko'p tinchlik kerak.
{r:All of the peace activists were arrested.} - Hamma tinchlik faollari qamaldi.
{r:Population increased significantly during the times of peace.} - Tinchlik davrida aholi soni keskin o'sdi.

text: {r:Describe}[dɪˈskraɪb] – tasvirlamoq. Uyda eski diskni topib oldim. Kimniki ekan deb o’ylanib turdim. Ochgandim {p:disk}da {p:Ray}hon {h:tasvirlangan} ekan.
examples: {r:Most people can describe their home easily.} - Aksariyat odamlar o'z uylarini osonlik bilan tasvirlay oladilar.
{r:How did you describe any of the changes to him?} - Unga o'zgarishlarning birortasini qanday tasvirladingiz?
{r:Some of the witnesses could not describe the man clearly.} - Guvohlarning ba'zilari erkakni aniq tasvirlay olmadi.
{r:All of the paintings describe a simple village life.} - Barcha rasmlar oddiy qishloq hayotini tasvirlaydi.

text: {r:Certain}[ˈsɜːrtn] – aniq, muayyan. Ko’pchilik tomonidan tanqidlarga uchragan futbolchi {p:Ser}geyev {p:tin}imsiz gol uryapti shu kunlarda. Hozir unda {h:aniqlik} juda kuchli.
examples: {r:Most certain things are known to all.} - Aksariyat aniq narsalar hammaga ma'lum.
{r:Some of these points are certain, but others are not.} - Bu nuqtalarning ba'zilari aniq, lekin boshqalari emas.
{r:Is there any certain way to solve this problem?} - Bu muammoni hal qilishning birorta aniq yo'li bormi?
{r:All of the rules for the game are certain.} - O'yin qoidalarining barchasi aniq.

text: {r:Simple}[ˈsɪmpl] – oddiy, sodda. Uyda gaz o'chib qolsa, ovqat tayyorlashning eng {h:oddiy} usuli {p:SIM PL}ita ishlatish. Menimcha bunday plitalar ko’p xonadonlarda bor.
examples: {r:Most simple ideas are often the best.} - Aksariyat oddiy g'oyalar ko'pincha eng yaxshisidir.
{r:Some of the solutions are very simple and clear.} - Yechimlarning ba'zilari juda oddiy va aniq.
{r:Did you find any simple answer to that hard question?} - O'sha qiyin savolga birorta oddiy javob topdingizmi?
{r:All of his words were simple to understand.} - Uning barcha so'zlari tushunish uchun oddiy edi.
{r:The speaker gave major emphasis on simple solutions.} - So'zlovchi oddiy yechimlarga katta urg'u berdi.

text: {r:Doctor}[ˈdɒktər] – doktor, shifokor.
examples: {r:This doctor spends 2 hours in the shower every day.} - Bu doktor har kuni 2 soat vaqtini cho'milish bilan o'tkazyapti.
{r:Some of the doctors in this hospital are very old.} - Bu kasalxonadagi shifokorlarning ba'zilari juda keksa.
{r:Have you seen any doctor about your headache?} - Bosh og'rig'ingiz bo'yicha birorta shifokorga ko'rindingizmi?
{r:The doctor examined his throat for any signs of infection.} - Shifokor uning tomog'ida infektsiya belgilari bor-yo'qligini tekshirdi.

text: {r:Position}[pəˈzɪʃən] – joylashuv, o'rin, pozitsiya, lavozim.
examples: {r:She applied for a new position at work.} - U ishda yangi lavozimga ariza berdi.
{r:Each player had a clear position on the field.} - Har bir o'yinchining maydonda aniq pozitsiyasi bor edi.
{r:None of the positions in the company were easy to get.} - Kompaniyadagi lavozimlarning hech birini egallash oson emas edi.
{r:The small village is located between two mountains, a good position for defense.} - Kichik qishloq ikkita tog' orasida joylashgan, bu himoya uchun yaxshi pozitsiya.

text: {r:Special}[ˈspeʃəl] – maxsus, spetsialniy. {p:Sp}ektaklda {p:shl}anka ishlatishdi, {h:maxsus} shlanka. Rangi pushti ekan.
examples: {r:Today is a special day for her.} - Bugun uning uchun maxsus kun.
{r:What is your special obligation in the military?} - Armiyadagi maxsus vazifangiz nima?
{r:None of the gifts were truly special for her.} - Sovg'alarning hech biri u uchun chinakamiga maxsus emas edi.
{r:He felt special among all his friends.} - U barcha do'stlari orasida o'zini maxsus his qildi.

text: {r:Record}[ˈrekɔːd] – rekord; ovoz yozmoq(telefondagi zapis funksiyasi).
examples: {r:She broke the school record in running.} - U maktabning yugurish bo'yicha rekordini yangiladi.
{r:Each student tried to break the school record.} - Har bir talaba maktab rekordini yangilashga harakat qildi.
{r:None of the records from the old office are clear.} - Eski ofisdagi yozuvlarning hech biri aniq emas.
{r:Your recordings were spread among our friends.} - Sening zapislaring do'stlarimiz orasida tarqab ketdi.

text: {r:Prescribe}[prɪˈskraɪb] – retsept yozib bermoq, tayinlamoq. Men doktor bo’lsam ham bemorlarim orasida ba’zan aksiyalar va yutuqli o’yinlar o’tkazib turaman. Masalan hozirgi o’yinimiz bemorlardan kimda kim tayinlangan dorilarni qoldirmasdan vaqtida ichsa {p:PRIZ}imiz {p:KRAB} ya’ni dengiz hayvoni bor mana shunaqa. Maza qilib krab yeydi meni bemorlarim agar {h:yozilgan dorini} o’z vaqtida ichishsa.
examples: {r:The doctor prescribed medicine for her.} - Shifokor unga dori yozib berdi.
{r:Every doctor must prescribe carefully.} - Har bir shifokor ehtiyotkorlik bilan dori yozib berishi kerak.
{r:Each doctor in our hospital must prescribe carefully.} - Kasalxonamizning har bir shifokori ehtiyotkorlik bilan dori yozib berishi kerak.
{r:None of the medicines prescribed were costly.} - Belgilangan dorilarning hech biri qimmat emas edi.

text: {r:Costly}[ˈkɒstli] – qimmat. Agar svarshik yoki quruvchi bo’lsangiz ham yangi kostyum-shim sotib oling va mijozlaringizdan ko’proq to’lashini so’rang va ularga ‘men endi o’qimishli, malakali va {p:KAST}um{p:LI} ishchiman ya’ni {h:qimmatman}’ deng.
examples: {r:Having a baby now is a costly thing.} - Farzand ko'rish hozir qimmat narsa.
{r:Every costly mistake teaches a lesson.} - Har bir qimmatga tushgan xato saboq beradi.
{r:None of their new equipment is costly.} - Ularning yangi uskunalarining hech biri qimmat emas.
{r:Never buy costly things.Understandable?} - Hech qachon qimmat narsalarni sotib olma. Tushunarlimi?

text: {r:Affordable}[əˈfɔːdəbəl] - arzon, qurbi yetadigan. Afford(qurbi yetmoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Qurbi yetadigan darajada ma'nosini anglatadi.
examples: {r:Unfortunately the hotel is not affordable for most people.} - Afsuski mehmonxona ko'pchilik uchun arzon emas.
{r:Is every new house affordable now?} - Hozir har bir yangi uy arzonmi?
{r:None of the cars here are truly affordable.} - Bu yerdagi mashinalarning hech biri chinakamiga arzon emas.
{r:The best solutions are often those that are affordable among many options.} - Eng yaxshi yechimlar ko'pincha ko'plab variantlar orasida arzon bo'lganlaridir.

text: {r:Brick}[brɪk] – g’isht. Tishingizga yangi qo’ydirgan {p:BRIK}etingiz qiyshayib qoldimi? Unda {p:brik}etni {h:g’isht} bilan u yoq bu yog’idan urib tekislab qo’ying va taqib yuravering. Hech narsa qilmaydi.
examples: {r:The house is made of brick.} - Uy g'ishtdan qurilgan.
{r:Every brick needs to be strong.} - Har bir g'isht mustahkam bo'lishi kerak.
{r:Each brick of my house is made of gold.} - Uyimning har bir g'ishti oltindan qilingan.
{r:He held a brick between his two hands.} - U ikkita qo'li orasida g'ishtni ushlab turdi.
{r:The old wall was made of brick, but it could hardly stand.} - Eski devor g‘ishtdan qurilgan edi, lekin u zo‘rg‘a turardi.

text: {r:Effective}[ɪˈfektɪv] - efektiv, samarali.
examples: {r:The medicine was very effective.} - Dori juda samarali edi.
{r:Using effective tools can make housework much easier.} - Samarali vositalardan foydalanish uy ishlarini ancha osonlashtirishi mumkin.
{r:Pick one between these three effective methods.} - Bu samarali uch usuldan birini tanla.
{r:The new plan proved effective among all the tested options.} - Yangi reja sinovdan o'tgan barcha variantlar orasida samarali bo'ldi.

text: {r:Sincere}[sɪnˈsɪə] - samimiy. Tasavvur qiling {p:SINNIZI ERI} siz bilgan eng {h:samimiy} odam(Toshkent shevasida shunday gapiriladi).
examples: {r:She gave a sincere apology.} - U samimiy uzr so'radi.
{r:Every sincere word holds true meaning.} - Har bir samimiy so'z haqiqiy ma'noga ega.
{r:Each sincere wish of yours matters to me.} - Sening har bir samimiy tilaging men uchun muhim.
{r:His sincere smile made him popular among the new students.} - Uning samimiy tabassumi uni yangi talabalar orasida mashhur qildi.

text: {r:Guest}[ɡest] – mehmon. Futbolda ajoyib natija. O’zbekiston terma jamoasi {p:Ge}rmaniya {p:st}adionida {h:mehmon} jamoa sifatida o’ynab nemislarni 4:0 ga yutdi va hammani qoyil qoldirdi.
examples: {r:The guest arrived late.} - Mehmon kech kelgan edi.
{r:Each guest received a small gift at the party.} - Kechada har bir mehmon kichik sovg'a oldi.
{r:None of the guests knew the owner of the house.} - Mehmonlarning hech biri uy egasini tanimas edi.
{r:The host walked among the guests, talking to everyone.} - Mezbon mehmonlar orasida yurib, hamma bilan gaplashdi.

text: {r:Equipment}[ɪˈkwɪpmənt] – jihoz, uskuna.
examples: {r:The new equipment is very expensive.} - Yangi uskuna juda qimmat.
{r:Every new gym needs modern equipment.} - Har bir yangi sport zali zamonaviy uskunalar bilan jihozlanishi kerak.
{r:None of the equipment was working well this morning.} - Bugun ertalab uskunaning hech biri yaxshi ishlamayotgan edi.
{r:We need to equip each room with a new light.} - Har bir xonani yangi yorug'lik bilan jihozlashimiz kerak.

text: {r:Customer}[ˈkʌstəmə] - mijoz, klent. Xo'jayinim bilan tanishishimiz ajoyib bo'lgan. U payt kostyum sotardim bozorda. O'sha payt ular pushti rang kastim qidirib kepqoganla. Shu {p:KASTIM ER}imga sotganman yashil rangidan. Keyin doimiy {h:mijozim} bo'ldila. Shundan keyin tanishib to'yimiz bo'p ketdi.
examples: {r:The customer was very satisfied.} - Mijoz juda mamnun edi.
{r:Each customer was happy with the service today.} - Bugun har bir mijoz xizmatdan mamnun edi.
{r:The company cannot afford to ignore customer complaints.} - Kompaniya mijozlarning shikoyatlarini e'tiborsiz qoldirishga qurbi yetmaydi.
{r:The manager talked with the customers to get feedback.} - Menejer fikr-mulohazalar olish uchun mijozlar bilan gaplashdi.
{r:The sales team tried their best to persuade the customer to buy the product.} - Savdo guruhi mijozni mahsulotni sotib olishga ishontirishga harakat qildi.

text: {r:Opportunity}[ˌɒpəˈtjuːnɪti] – imkoniyat. Mashinani tyuning qildirishim kerak deb yotsam, instagramda tyuningchi akalardan 60 foiz skidka ketayotganini ko’rib qoldim. Dadam ham ‘’{p:oppor tyuni}ngga hozir bu yaxshi {h:imkoniyat}’’ deb aytdi.
examples: {r:She took the opportunity to learn something new.} - U yangi narsa o'rganish imkoniyatidan foydalandi.
{r:Every opportunity should be taken seriously.} - Har bir imkoniyatga jiddiy qarash kerak.
