{r:None of the opportunities came easily for him.} - U uchun imkoniyatlarning hech biri osonlik bilan kelmadi.
{r:We will inform you when a new opportunity arises.} - Yangi imkoniyat paydo bo'lganda sizga xabar beramiz.

text: {r:Candidate}[ˈkændɪdət] - nomzod, kandidat.
examples: {r:The company promised to inform all candidates about the results.} - Kompaniya barcha nomzodlarga natijalar haqida xabar berishga va'da berdi.
{r:Each candidate presented their ideas well.} - Har bir nomzod o'z g'oyalarini yaxshi taqdim etdi.
{r:We will choose new employee between the two candidates.} - Yangi xodimni 2 ta nomzod orasidan tanlaymiz.
{r:Seemingly the candidate was sleepy.} - Ko'rinishidan nomzod uyqusiragan edi.

text: {r:Solution}[səˈluːʃən] - yechim. Daraxtlarni nega kesyapsan deysizmi? Daryoni nargi tarafiga o'tishim uchun sol yasashim kerak. Daraxtlarni {p:SOL UCHUN} kesyapman. Bu narsa muammoyimni hal qiladi, bu mening {h:yechimim}.
examples: {r:She found a solution to the problem.} - U muammoning yechimini topdi.
{r:Every problem has a solution, if you look hard enough.} - Har bir muammoning yechimi bor, agar yetarlicha izlasangiz.
{r:None of the solutions were easy to find for them.} - Ular uchun yechimlarning hech birini topish oson emas edi.
{r:Finding the best solution was discussed among the team.} - Eng yaxshi yechimni topish jamoa orasida muhokama qilindi.

text: {r:Option}[ˈɒpʃən] - optsiya, variant.
examples: {r:She considered all the options.} - U barcha variantlarni ko'rib chiqdi.
{r:Each option has its pros and cons.} - Har bir variantning o'z afzallik va kamchiliklari bor.
{r:None of the options were perfect for the situation.} - Variantlarning hech biri vaziyat uchun mukammal emas edi.
{r:Choosing between two good options is always hard.} - Ikkita yaxshi variant orasidan tanlash doim qiyin.

text: {r:Description}[dɪˈskrɪpʃən] - tavsif, izoh, tasvir, tushuntirish. Describe(tasvirlamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The description of that drugstore was very detailed.} - O'sha aptekaning tavsifi juda batafsil edi.
{r:Every description needs to be accurate and clear.} - Har bir tavsif aniq va tushunarli bo'lishi kerak.
{r:None of the descriptions were easy to understand without a picture.} - Rasmsiz tavsiflarning hech birini tushunish oson emas edi.
{r:The police asked for a description of the man riding a bicycle.} - Politsiya velosiped mingan erkakning tavsifini so'radi.
{r:She gave a memorable description of her travel experience.} - U o'z sayohat tajribasi haqida unutilmas tavsif berdi.

text: {r:Land}[lænd] – yer. Qizlar lentasida yashayotgan sirka va bitlar {p:lent}ani o’z {h:yeri} qilib olibdi.
examples: {r:The foreigners are stealing our land.} - Chet elliklar yerimizni o'g'irlayapti.
{r:My father's land will be divided between us.} - Dadamning yeri bizning o'rtamizda bo'linadi.
{r:None of the land was good for growing food this season.} - Bu mavsumda yerlarning hech biri oziq-ovqat yetishtirish uchun yaroqli emas edi.
{r:The new farmer owns some land among the old fields.} - Yangi fermer eski dalalar orasida bir oz yerga ega.

text: {r:Simply}[ˈsɪmpli] - oddiy, oddiygina, prosto. Simple(oddiy) so'zining ravish shakli. O'zbek tilida ishlatiladigan ruscha so'z 'prosto' to'g'ridan to'g'ri tarjimasi bo'la oladi.
examples: {r:My former husband explained the problem simply.} - Mening sobiq erim muammoni oddiy tushuntirdi.
{r:He seemed simply tired after the long journey.} - U uzoq safardan keyin shunchaki charchagan ko'rinardi.
{r:None of them could simply forget what happened.} - Ularning hech biri sodir bo'lgan voqeani shunchaki unuta olmadi.
{r:Every complex idea can be explained simply.} - Har bir murakkab g'oyani oddiygina tushuntirish mumkin.

text: {r:Cooperate}[kəʊˈɒpəreɪt] – hamkorlik qilmoq, ko’maklashmoq. Gailar va radarchi tadbirkorlar o’rtada {h:hamkorlikni} kuchaytirib haydovchilarga yanada {p:KO’P REYD} tadbirlari qilmoqchi ekanlar.
examples: {r:She cooperated with her colleagues on the report.} - U hisobot bo'yicha hamkasblari bilan hamkorlik qildi.
{r:Each member must cooperate for the team's success.} - Jamoaning muvaffaqiyati uchun har bir a'zo hamkorlik qilishi kerak.
{r:None of them wanted to cooperate with the new rules.} - Ularning hech biri yangi qoidalar bilan hamkorlik qilishni xohlamadi.
{r:Her refusal to cooperate caused some confusion.} - Uning hamkorlik qilishdan bosh tortishi ba'zi tushunmovchiliklarga sabab bo'ldi.

text: {r:Evidence}[ˈevɪdəns] – isbot, dalil.
examples: {r:The evidence was really clear, whether he admitted it or not.} - Dalillar haqiqatdan aniq edi, u tan oldimi yo'qmi.
{r:She presented the evidence herself in court, hoping it would speak for itself.} - U dalillarni sudda o'zi taqdim etdi, ular o'zi uchun gapiradi deb umid qildi.
{r:The police found no evidence, which was the one thing they didn't expect.} - Politsiya hech qanday dalil topmadi, bu ular kutmagan yagona narsa edi.
{r:He studied the evidence carefully, as if preparing himself for a major test.} - U dalillarni diqqat bilan o'rgandi, go'yo o'zini katta sinovga tayyorlayotgandek.

text: {r:Century}[ˈsentʃəri] – asr. Plastik million yilda chiriydi, selofan 1000 yilda chiriydi, {p:sent}ifon {p:chir}iydi bir {h:asr}da.
examples: {r:The building is over a century old.} - Bino bir asrdan ko‘proq yoshga ega.
{r:She studied the history of the 19th century.} - U 19-asr tarixini o‘rgandi.
{r:The invention changed the course of the century.} - Ixtiro asr yo‘nalishini o‘zgartirdi.
{r:He wrote a book about the last century.} - U o‘tgan asr haqida kitob yozdi.

text: {r:Culture}[ˈkʌltʃə] - madaniyat, kultura.
examples: {r:The culture of the country is rich and wonderful.} - Mamlakat madaniyati boy va ajoyib.
{r:She enjoys learning about different cultures.} - U turli madaniyatlarni o‘rganishni yoqtiradi.
{r:The festival celebrated local culture.} - Festival mahalliy madaniyatni nishonladi.(o'zbekchada notabiiy eshitiladi ammo tushunarli)
{r:It's important to be respectful of different cultures.} - Turli madaniyatlarga hurmatli bo'lish muhim.

text: {r:Chance}[tʃɑːns] - imkoniyat, shans. 'Chance' va biz qo'llaydigan 'shans' so'zlarining kelib chiqishi bir.
examples: {r:She took a chance and applied for the job.} - U imkoniyatdan foydalanib ishga ariza berdi.
{r:He missed the chance to study abroad.} - U chet elda o‘qish imkoniyatini qo‘ldan boy berdi.
{r:You will have the chance to ask questions whenever you are ready.} - Qachonki tayyor bo'lsangiz savollar berish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lasiz.
[center][b]by chance - tasodifan[/b][/center]
{r:I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket} – Men eski do‘stimni supermarketda tasodifan uchratdim.
{r:I discovered the book by chance in a small shop} – Men kitobni kichik do‘konda tasodifan topdim.

text: {r:Listener}[ˈlɪsənə] - eshituvchi, tinglovchi. Listen(eshitmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She is a good listener.} - U yaxshi tinglovchi.
{r:The radio show has many listeners.} - Radio ko‘rsatuvining ko‘p tinglovchilari bor.
{r:He thanked the listeners for their support.} - U tinglovchilarga qo‘llab-quvvatlaganlari uchun minnatdorchilik bildirdi.
{r:The teacher encouraged the students to be active listeners.} - O‘qituvchi o‘quvchilarni faol tinglovchi bo‘lishga undadi.

text: {r:Hundred}[ˈhʌndrəd] - yuz, 100. Sizlarga savol {h:100} kg {p:HAND}on pista va 100 kg {p:RED}iskadan qaysi biri og'irroq?
examples: {r:She has read over a hundred books.} - U yuzdan ortiq kitob o‘qigan.
{r:The crowd numbered in the hundreds.} - Olomon soni yuzlab edi.
{r:He saved a hundred dollars.} - U yuz dollar yig‘di.
{r:They planted a hundred trees.} - Ular yuzta daraxt ekishdi.

text: {r:Available}[əˈveɪləbəl] – mavjud, bor, hozir foydalanish mumkin. "Available" so‘zi biror narsa hozircha mavjud yoki foydalanish uchun ochiq ekanligini bildiradi. Masalan: 1) "This product is available in all stores." — "Bu mahsulot barcha do‘konlarda mavjud." 2) "Is there a room available for tonight?" — "Bugun tunash uchun bo‘sh xona bormi?" 3) "I am available after 5 PM." — "Men soat 5 dan keyin bo‘shman." Xulosa: "Available" so‘zi odam, mahsulot yoki xizmat hozir mavjud va foydalanish mumkin ekanligini anglatadi.
examples: {r:The book is available in the library.} - Kitob kutubxonada mavjud.
{r:She is available for a meeting tomorrow.} - U ertaga yig‘ilish uchun bo‘sh.
{r:The tickets are still available.} - Chiptalar hali ham mavjud.
{r:He checked if the room was available.} - U xona bo‘sh ekanligini tekshirdi.

text: {r:Plant}[plɑːnt] – o’simlik; ekmoq; zavod. Yer planetasida milliondan ortiq o’simlik turi bor, lekin ular orasida eng antiqa o’simlik {p:plankt}on bo’lsa kerak, chunki u yarim {h:o’simlik}, yarim hayvondir.
examples: {r:She watered the plants in the garden.} - U bog‘dagi o‘simliklarni sug‘ordi.
{r:He works at a local plant.} - U mahalliy zavodda ishlaydi.
{r:The plant grew quickly.} - O‘simlik tez o‘sdi.
{r:They planted new flowers in the park.} - Ular bog‘da yangi gullar ekishdi.

text: {r:Likely}[ˈlaɪkli] – ehtimol, mumkin(adj). Instagram akkount sotib olmoqchiman. {h:Ehtimol} eng yoqimli Instagram bu layklari ko’p Instagram bo’lsa kerak, yani {p:laykli} Instagram kerak.
examples: {r:It is likely to rain today.} - Bugun yomg‘ir yog‘ishi mumkin.
{r:She is likely to win the competition.} - U musobaqada g‘alaba qozonishi mumkin.
{r:The likely outcome is positive.} - Ehtimoliy natija ijobiy.
{r:He is the most likely candidate.} - U eng ehtimoliy nomzod.

text: {r:Peaceful}[ˈpiːsfʊl] - tinch. Peace(tinchlik) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The village is very peaceful.} - Qishloq juda tinch.
{r:She enjoys the peaceful atmosphere.} - U tinch atmosferadan zavqlanadi.
{r:The protest was peaceful.} - Norozilik namoyishi tinch edi.
{r:He found a peaceful solution.} - U tinch yechim topdi.

text: {r:Term}[tɜːm] - termin, atama; muddat. Sovet davri bobom uchun qiyin o'tgan. Kolxoz raisi bo'lgan bobom paxta {p:TERIM}ini o'z {h:muddatida} bajarolmaganligi uchun qamab qo'yilgan.
examples: {r:The term of the contract is one year.} - Shartnoma muddati bir yil.
{r:She explained the term clearly.} - U atamani aniq tushuntirdi.
{r:The president served two terms.} - Prezident ikki muddat xizmat qildi.
{r:He used the term correctly.} - U atamani to‘g‘ri ishlatdi.

text: {r:Remaining}[rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ] - qolgan. Remain(qolmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The remaining food was saved.} - Qolgan ovqat saqlab qolindi.
{r:She finished the remaining work.} - U qolgan ishni tugatdi.
{r:The remaining time is short.} - Qolgan vaqt qisqa.
{r:He thanked the remaining guests.} - U qolgan mehmonlarga minnatdorchilik bildirdi.

text: {r:Condition}[kənˈdɪʃən] – holat, sharoit. {p:Kondi}tsioner {p:ishn}i yozda boshlab kuzda to’xtatadi. Yili bo’y ishlamaganligi uchun yaxshi {h:holatda} turadi.
examples: {r:The condition of the car is good.} - Mashinaning holati yaxshi.
{r:She agreed to the terms and conditions.} - U shartlar va sharoitlarga rozi bo‘ldi.
{r:Of course the patient’s condition improved.} - Bemorning ahvoli albatta yaxshilandi.
{r:His sickness was a temporary condition.} - Uning kasalligi vaqtinchalik holat edi.

text: {r:Rule}[ruːl] – qoida. {p:Rol}ga o’tirganda har doim {h:qoidalar}ga amal qil, rolni ko’rdingmi qoidalar esingga tushsin.
examples: {r:The rule is very clear.} - Qoida juda aniq.
{r:She broke the school rules and blamed herself for the mistake.} - U maktab qoidalarini buzdi va xato uchun o'zini aybladi.
{r:The new rule was introduced last week.} - Yangi qoida o'tgan hafta joriy qilindi.
{r:He explained the rules of the game, especially the ones that were difficult.} - U o'yin qoidalarini tushuntirdi, ayniqsa qiyinlarini.

text: {r:Choice}[tʃɔɪs] – tanlov. Hojiboy Tojiboyev aytganidek qora choy, ko’k choy degan gapni yomon ko’raman. Hozir {h:tanlov} qil, {p:choy s}ariq bo’lsinmi yoki qizil? Yaxshi sariq choy damlab kelaman.
examples: {r:A surgeon made the right choice, whether it was easy or hard.} - Jarroh to'g'ri tanlov qildi, osonmi yoki qiyinligidan qat'iy nazar.
{r:He had no choice but to agree, feeling defeated himself.} - U rozi bo'lishdan boshqa iloji yo'q edi, o'zini mag'lub bo'lgandek his qilib.
{r:The menu offers many choices, especially Asian ones.} - Menyuda ko'p tanlovlar mavjud, ayniqsa Osiyoniki.
{r:They discussed the available choices, considering whether each one was possible.} - Ular mavjud tanlovlarni muhokama qilishdi, har birining mumkinligini ko'rib chiqdilar.

text: {r:Current}[ˈkʌrənt] – hozirgi. {h:Hozirgi paytda} eng ovozi baland asbob nima? – {p:Karn}ay {p:t}ovushi eng balandi.
examples: {r:The current situation is stable.} - Hozirgi vaziyat barqaror.
{r:She studies current events, the ones concerning politics.} - U hozirgi voqealarni o'rganadi, siyosat haqidagilarini.
{r:The current president is very experienced in politics.} - Hozirgi prezident siyosat bo'yicha juda tajribali.
{r:He explained the current changes, mentioning the ones that would affect their future.} - U hozirgi o'zgarishlarni tushuntirdi, ularning kelajagiga ta'sir qiladiganlarini eslatib.

text: {r:Defend}[dɪˈfend] – himoya qilmoq. Ukam {p:DI}yor {p:FANT}asini hammadan {h:himoya} {h:qilib} yuradi 'ichib qo'ymasin boshqalar' deb.
examples: {r:She defended her opinion strongly, believing in herself.} - U o'z fikrini qat'iy himoya qildi, o'ziga ishonib.
{r:He defended the goal well, whether the team won or lost.} - U darvozani yaxshi himoya qildi, jamoa yutdimi yo'qmi.
{r:The lawyer defended the client, preparing himself for a tough case.} - Advokat mijozni himoya qildi, o'zini qiyin ishga tayyorlab.
{r:They defended their country, proving themselves true patriots.} - Ular o'z mamlakatini himoya qilishdi, o'zlarini haqiqiy vatanparvar ekanliklarini isbotlab.

text: {r:Security}[sɪˈkjʊərɪti] – xavfsizlik, sekyuriti.
examples: {r:The security at the airport is strict, whether you are a local or a tourist.} - Aeroportda xavfsizlik qat'iy, mahalliy fuqaromisiz yoki sayyohligingizdan qat'iy nazar.
{r:She works in security, dedicating herself to keeping others safe.} - U xavfsizlik sohasida ishlaydi, o'zini boshqalarni himoya qilishga bag'ishlaydi.
{r:Health insurance is an essential item for financial security.} - Sog'liq sug'urtasi moliyaviy xavfsizlik uchun muhim narsadir.
{r:He checked the security cameras, the ones that covered the main entrance.} - U xavfsizlik kameralarini tekshirdi, asosiy kirishni qoplaganlarini.

text: {r:Exception}[ɪkˈsepʃən] – istisno, mubolag'a.
examples: {r:Julia made an exception for him, whether it was fair to others or not.} - Julia unga istisno qildi, boshqalar uchun adolatli bo'ldimi yoki yo'qligidan qat'iy nazar.
{r:The rule applies to everyone without exception.} - Qoida istisnosiz hammaga nisbatan qo'llaniladi.
{r:All equipment is expensive here and mixer is no exception.} - Hamma jihozlar qimmat bu do'konda va mikser ham istisno emas.
{r:They discussed the exceptions, focusing on the ones that were most critical.} - Ular istisnolarni muhokama qilishdi, eng muhimlariga e'tibor qaratishdi.

text: {r:Fight}[faɪt] – urush, jang; urushmoq. {p:FAYT}un tepasi ochiq ot arava va u qadimgi Xitoyda paydo bo’lgan. Aytishlaricha qadimda imperatorlar jangning orqa qismida {p:FAYT}unda o’tirib {h:janglarni} nazorat qilishgan va buyruqlar berib turishgan ekan.
examples: {r:She fought for her rights, dedicating herself to the cause.} - U o'z huquqlari uchun kurashdi, o'zini bu ishga bag'ishlab.
{r:He fought against the disease, whether he felt strong or weak.} - U kasallikka qarshi kurashdi, o'zini kuchli yoki kuchsiz his qilishidan qat'iy nazar.
{r:The fight continued for hours, exhausting the fighters.} - Kurash soatlab davom etdi, kurashchilarni charchatib.
{r:Former soldiers fought for justice, becoming the ones who inspired many.} - Sobiq askarlar adolat uchun kurashishdi, ko'plarni ilhomlantirganlarga aylanishdi.

text: {r:Firmly}[ˈfɜːmli] - qattiq, qat'iy. Firm so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:Both sides firmly rejected the proposal.} - Ikkala tomon ham taklifni qat'iy rad etdi.
{r:Neither of the two friends firmly believed the story.} - Ikkala do'st ham bu hikoyaga qat'iy ishonmadi.
{r:I firmly believe you are able to learn English.} - Sen ingliz tilini o'rgana olishingga qattiq ishonaman.
{r:Both my father and mother firmly agreed with the plan.} - Mening otam ham, onam ham rejaga qat'iy rozi bo'lishdi.

text: {r:Eyesight}[ˈaɪsaɪt] - zreniya, ko'rish qobiliyati.
examples: {r:Neither of my grandmothers has perfect eyesight.} - Mening buvilarimning ikkalasi ham mukammal ko'rish qobiliyatiga ega emas.
{r:Both children have good eyesight.} - Ikkala bolaning ham ko'rish qobiliyati yaxshi.
{r:Either of these two lights can affect your eyesight.} - Bu ikkala chiroqdan biri ko'rish qobiliyatingizga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.
{r:Neither of the old men had strong eyesight.} - Ikkala qari odamning ham ko'rish qobiliyati kuchli emas edi.

text: {r:Productive}[prəˈdʌktɪv] - samarali, mahsuldor, produktiv.
examples: {r:Both meetings were productive, and we solved many problems.} - Ikkala uchrashuv ham samarali bo'ldi va biz ko'p muammolarni hal qildik.
{r:Neither of the workers was productive today.} - Ishchilarning ikkalasi ham bugun samarali emas edi.
{r:You can be productive either in the morning or evening.} - Siz ertalab yoki kechqurun samarali bo'lishingiz mumkin.
{r:Both teams were very productive during the game.} - Ikkala jamoa ham o'yin davomida juda samarali edi.

text: {r:Involve}[ɪnˈvɒlv] – o’z ichiga olmoq, jalb etmoq. Kecha ona tili darsida {p:IN}sho yozdik {p:VOLV}o mashinasi haqida. Insho mavzusi bu mashinaning barcha xarakteristikasini yoritishni {h:o’z ichiga olgan edi}.
examples: {r:Neither option involves a significant risk.} - Ikkala variant ham sezilarli xavfni o'z ichiga olmaydi.
{r:The lesson involves both reading and writing.} - Dars ham o‘qishni, ham yozishni o‘z ichiga oladi.
{r:The new job will involve both learning and working hard.} - Yangi ish ham o'rganishni, ham qattiq ishlashni o'z ichiga oladi.
{r:The task can involve either a lot of time or money.} - Bu vazifa ko'p vaqtni yoki pulni o'z ichiga olishi mumkin.

text: {r:Region}[ˈriːdʒən] - mintaqa, hudud, region
examples: {r:Both regions offer beautiful landscapes.} - Ikkala mintaqa ham chiroyli manzaralarni taqdim etadi.
{r:Neither region is safe for travel now.} - Ikkala mintaqa ham hozir sayohat uchun xavfsiz emas.
{r:You can choose either region for your holiday.} - Siz ta'tilingiz uchun ikkala mintaqadan birini tanlashingiz mumkin.
{r:Both regions have a cold winter.} - Ikkala mintaqada ham sovuq qish bor.

text: {r:Exceed}[ɪkˈsiːd] – oshmoq, oshirib yubormoq. Shaharning ichida mashina haydab bo’lmay qoldiku. Har qadamda svitofor. Kecha Oybek metrosidan burilsam 10 metr ichida {p:IK}kita {p:SIT}Ofor. {h:Oshirib yuborishyaptida} svetoforlar sonini. IKkita SITofor 10 metr ichida, shunaqasi ham bo’ladimi?
examples: {r:Neither of the new cars exceeded the budget.} - Yangi mashinalarning ikkalasi ham byudjetdan oshmadi.
{r:We found the small café by chance, and the taste exceeded our hopes.} – Biz kichkina kafeni tasodifan topdik va ta’mi umidimizdan ham ortiq bo‘ldi.
{r:Your speed must not exceed either 50 or 60 km/h in the city.} - Sizning tezligingiz shaharda 50 yoki 60 km/soatdan oshmasligi kerak.
{r:Neither of the children exceeded the time limit for the exam.} - Bolalarning ikkalasi ham imtihon uchun vaqt chegarasidan oshmadi.

text: {r:Certainly}[ˈsɜːtnli] - aniq, albatta. Certain(aniq) ning ravish shakli.
examples: {r:Both of them will certainly come to the party.} - Ularning ikkalasi ham albatta bazmga kelishadi.
{r:His determination was the best tool, and it certainly helped him succeed} – Uning qat’iyati eng yaxshi vosita edi va bu unga albatta muvaffaqiyatga erishishda yordam berdi.
{r:You can certainly choose either the red or the blue pen.} - Siz albatta qizil yoki ko'k ruchkani tanlashingiz mumkin.
{r:They both certainly know the answer.} - Ularning ikkalasi ham javobni albatta biladi.

text: {r:Additionally}[əˈdɪʃənəli] - qo'shimchasiga, bundan tashqari.
examples: {r:Additionally, both options are very good.} - Bundan tashqari, ikkala variant ham juda yaxshi.
{r:Additionally, neither of the boys was tall.} - Bundan tashqari, bolalarning ikkalasi ham baland bo'yli emas edi.
{r:You can additionally choose either coffee or tea.} - Siz qo'shimchasiga kofe yoki choyni tanlashingiz mumkin.
{r:Additionally, both my mother and father are tired.} - Bundan tashqari, mening onam ham, otam ham charchagan.

text: {r:Thousand}[ˈθaʊzənd] - ming. Mening yangi kitobim chiqayapti '{h:Mingta} {p:SAVZIN}i to'g'radim oshga' degan. Olib o'qinglar.
examples: {r:Both teams have thousands of fans.} - Ikkala jamoaning ham minglab muxlislari bor.
{r:Neither of the two countries has a thousand participants in this festival.} - Ikkala mamlakatning ham bu festivalda mingta qatnashchisi yo'q.
{r:Both books cost a thousand dollars.} - Ikkala kitob ham ming dollar turadi.
{r:You can choose either of these two for a thousand dollars.} - Siz bu ikkalasidan birini ming dollarga tanlashingiz mumkin.

text:
{r:Seek}[siːk] – qidirmoq; intilmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - sought, sought. 
Qishloqda tez-tez {p:SIG}irim yo’qolib qolardi, meni esa uzoq vaqt uni {h:qidirar} edim va oxiri uni sotib shaharga ketvordim.
examples: {r:Both candidates are actively seeking jobs.} - Ikkala nomzod ham faol ish qidiryapti.
{r:Neither of them sought to change the law.} - Ularning ikkalasi ham qonunni o'zgartirishga intilmadi.
{r:The government is seeking ways to reduce the cost of health care.} - Hukumat sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlarini kamaytirish uchun yo'llar qidirayapti.
{r:Both children sought to learn new things.} - Ikkala bola ham yangi narsalarni o'rganishga intildi.

text: {r:Wealth}[welθ] – boylik. Agar boy bo’lmoqchi bo’lsangiz {p:VELOS}iped sotib oling. Velosiped haydaganingizda qoningiz yurushib sog’ligingiz yaxshilanadi. Kislorod yaxshi aylanib miyangizga ajoyib idealar va {h:boylik} keladi.
examples: {r:Neither great wealth nor poverty guarantees happiness.} - Buyuk boylik ham, qashshoqlik ham baxtni kafolatlamaydi.
{r:Both families have great wealth.} - Ikkala oila ham katta boylikka ega.
{r:You can use either your time or your wealth to help people.} - Siz odamlarga yordam berish uchun vaqtingizni yoki boyligingizni ishlatishingiz mumkin.
{r:Neither wealth nor power can buy true friendship.} - Na boylik, na hokimiyat haqiqiy do'stlikni sotib ololmaydi.

text: {r:Somewhat}[ˈsʌmˌwɒt] – bir oz, bir qancha, ma’lum miqdorda. {p:SAM}arqand {p:VAT}asi hozir butun dunyo bozorini egallayapti. Chunki u chet el davlatlarida mahalliy vatalardan “{h:bir oz}” arzon.
examples: {r:Both of them were somewhat tired after the game.} - Ularning ikkalasi ham o'yindan keyin biroz charchagan edi.
{r:Neither of the answers was somewhat clear.} - Javoblarning ikkalasi ham biroz aniq emas edi.
{r:You can be somewhat happy with either result.} - Siz ikkala natijadan biri bilan biroz xursand bo'lishingiz mumkin.
{r:Both sisters were somewhat afraid of the dog.} - Ikkala opa-singil ham itdan biroz qo'rqishardi.

text: {r:Proposal}[prəˈpəʊzl] – taklif. Fonogramma aytishda PROfessor darajasiga yetgan Jahongir Poziljonov xalqqa taklifi bor ekan. Ya’ni {p:PRO}fessor {p:POZIL}jonov {h:taklifida} “Deputat bo’laman menga ovoz bering” deyapti.
examples: {r:Both proposals were reviewed by the committee once.} - Ikkala taklif ham qo'mita tomonidan bir marta ko'rib chiqildi.
{r:Neither of the new proposals was accepted.} - Yangi takliflarning ikkalasi ham qabul qilinmadi.
{r:You can agree to either proposal.} - Siz ikkala taklifdan biriga rozi bo'lishingiz mumkin.
{r:Both proposals are important for our future.} - Ikkala taklif ham kelajagimiz uchun muhim.

text: {r:Approach}[əˈprəʊtʃ] - yondashuv, taktika; yaqinlashmoq. Menimcha ozishim uchun eng yaxshi {h:yondashuv} bu har kuni {p:OBRICH} aylantirish.
examples: {r:Both approaches have their pros and cons.} - Ikkala yondashuvning ham o'z afzalliklari va kamchiliklari bor.
{r:Neither of the approaches was easy to understand.} - Yondashuvlarning ikkalasi ham tushunish oson emas edi.
{r:You can try either approach to answer the question.} - Savolga javob berish uchun ikkala yondashuvdan birini sinab ko'rishingiz mumkin.
{r:Both teachers use a modern approach to teaching.} - Ikkala o'qituvchi ham o'qitishda zamonaviy yondashuvdan foydalanadi.

text: {r:Device}[dɪˈvaɪs] – apparat, moslama. Tasavvur qiling sizda dunyodagi eng ajoyib {h:qurilma} bor. Sizning {p:DVI}jogingiz {p:AYS}ti quysangizgina ishlaydi, benzin shart emas.
examples: {r:Neither device is compatible with this software.} - Ikkala qurilma ham bu dasturiy ta'minot bilan mos kelmaydi.
{r:Both devices are new and work well.} - Ikkala qurilma ham yangi va yaxshi ishlaydi.
{r:You can use either device to listen to music.} - Siz musiqa tinglash uchun ikkala qurilmadan birini ishlatishingiz mumkin.
{r:Neither device was cheap, but both were useful.} - Ikkala qurilma ham arzon emas edi, lekin ikkalasi ham foydali edi.

text: {r:Task}[tɑːsk] - vazifa, topshiriq. Agar o'zimga berilgan {h:topshiriqlarni} bajarsam. Shunda haqiqatdan {p:TASK}in topaman barcha stresslardan.
examples: {r:Both tasks need to be completed by tomorrow.} - Ikkala vazifa ham ertagacha bajarilishi kerak.
{r:Neither task was easy for the child.} - Ikkala vazifa ham bola uchun oson emas edi.
{r:You can choose either task to start with.} - Siz boshlash uchun ikkala vazifadan birini tanlashingiz mumkin.
{r:Both tasks require a lot of time and effort.} - Ikkala vazifa ham ko'p vaqt va kuch talab qiladi.

text: {r:Campus}[ˈkæmpəs] – yotoqxona, obshag, obshjitie. Men hozir Amerikada tahsil olayapman. Universitetimizning yotoqxonasida yashab kelyapman. Bizning shtatimizda {h:yotoqxonalarda} {p:KAM}on va {p:PIS}tolet saqlash mumkin. Bu yerda ushbu qurollar o’zini-o’zi himoya qilish vositasi hisoblanadi.
examples: {r:Both campuses offer modern facilities.} - Ikkala kampus ham zamonaviy qulayliklarga ega.
{r:Neither campus has a big library.} - Ikkala kampusda ham katta kutubxona yo'q.
{r:You can live on either campus.} - Siz ikkala kampusdan birida yashashingiz mumkin.
{r:Both campuses are close to the city center.} - Ikkala kampus ham shahar markaziga yaqin.

text: {r:Performance}[pəˈfɔːməns] – bajarish, amalga oshirish, ijro.
examples: {r:Neither performance was perfect, but both were enjoyable.} - Ikkala ijro ham mukammal emas edi, lekin ikkalasi ham zavqli bo'ldi.
{r:Both actors gave a great performance.} - Ikkala aktyor ham ajoyib ijro etdi.
{r:You can watch either performance tonight.} - Siz bugun kechqurun ikkala ijrodan birini tomosha qilishingiz mumkin.
{r:Neither performance was long, but both were interesting.} - Ikkala ijro ham uzoq emas edi, lekin ikkalasi ham qiziqarli edi.

text: {r:Gate}[ɡeɪt] – darvoza. Agar boy bo’lmoqchi bo’lsangiz IT ni tanlang. Bill {p:GEYT}s ni boy qilgan bu soha sizning ham farovon hayotingiz uchun {h:darvoza}.
examples: {r:Either gate will lead you to the main road.} - Ikkala darvozadan biri asosiy yo'lga olib boradi.
{r:Both gates are open now.} - Ikkala darvoza ham hozir ochiq.
{r:Neither gate was closed last night.} - O'tgan kecha ikkala darvoza ham yopiq emas edi.
{r:You can use either gate to enter the garden.} - Bog'ga kirish uchun ikkala darvozadan birini ishlatishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:Divorce}[dɪˈvɔːrs] – ajrashmoq; ajrim. Tasavvur qiling {h:ajrim} haqidagi hujjatlarni bir oydan beri topolmayapsiz. Hamma joyni qidirib chiqdingiz va nihoyat {p:DIV}an {p:ORAS}idan chiqib qoldi.
examples: {r:They divorced after many years.} – Ular ko‘p yillardan so‘ng ajrashishdi.
{r:Divorce can be difficult for children.} – Ajrim bolalar uchun qiyin bo‘lishi mumkin.
{r:She filed for divorce last month.} – U o‘tgan oy ajrashish uchun ariza berdi.
{r:Some people stay friends after divorce.} – Ba’zi odamlar ajrashgandan keyin do‘st bo‘lib qolishadi.

text: {r:fun}[fʌn] – o’yin-kulgi, xursandchilik, mazza. Tasavvur qiling xuddi Teleport filmidagidek birdan O’zbekistondan Xitoyga tushib qoldingiz. Bu yerda esa {p:FAN}arlar festivali bo’lib o’tayotgan ekan va siz bu yerda {h:maza} qilib aylandingiz.
examples: {r:We had a lot of fun at the party.} - Biz bazmda juda ko'p zavqlandik.
{r:Did you have much fun during the trip?} - Siz safardan ko‘p zavq oldingizmi?
{r:There weren’t many fun activities for children.} - Bolalar uchun ko'p qiziqarli mashg'ulotlar yo'q edi.
{r:She always makes learning fun.} - U har doim qiziqarli qilib o'rganadi.

text: {r:fail}[feɪl] – muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoq. Bir kuni {p:FAYL} varag’i sotib oldim va bacha sinfdoshlarimni rasmlarini sola boshladim, lekin ikkita sinfdoshimni rasmini ham, o’zini ham topishda {h:muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradim}.
examples: {r:He failed the exam because he didn’t study much.} - U imtihondan o'ta olmadi, chunki u ko'p o'qimadi.
{r:Many students fail if they don’t work hard.} - Ko'p talabalar qattiq ishlamasa, o'ta olmaydi.
{r:There’s a lot of pressure not to fail.} - Muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramaslik uchun juda ko'p bosim bor.
{r:Our marriage failed and we divorced.} - Turmushimiz o'xshamadi va biz ajrashdik.

text: {r:idea}[aɪˈdɪə] - ideya, g'oya.
examples: {r:Do you have many ideas for the project?} - Loyiha uchun ko'p g'oyalaringiz bormi?
{r:Certainly. I have a lot of ideas.} - Albatta. Ko'p g'oyalarim bor.
{r:Your idea is likely to be a failure.} - Sening g'oyang muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lishi mumkin.
[center][b]have no idea - bilmaslik[/b][/center]
{r:I have no idea where my keys are} – Kalitlarim qayerda ekanini bilmayman.
{r:We have no idea what will happen tomorrow} – Ertaga nima bo‘lishini bilmaymiz.

text: {r:battle}[ˈbætl] - jang. Menimcha bunga mnemonik misol shart emas chunki hozirgi kunda internet foydalanuvchilari {p:batl} nima ekanligini yaxshi bilishadi. Lekin bu so'zning asl ma'nosi 'jang' degani. Tiktokchilar ham majoziy ma'noda {h:jang qilishadi} va buni {p:batl} deb atashadi.
examples: {r:There were many battles in history.} - Tarixda ko'p janglar bo'lgan.
{r:They didn’t have much time to prepare for the battle.} - Ularning jangga tayyorlanish uchun ko'p vaqti yo'q edi.
{r:A lot of soldiers fought in the battle.} - Jangda juda ko'p askarlar jang qilishdi.
{r:The battle was long and difficult.} - Jang uzoq va qiyin bo'ldi.

text: {r:celebration}[ˌselɪˈbreɪʃn] - nishonlash. Celebrate(nishonlamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:We didn’t have much money for the celebration.} - Bizda bayram uchun ko'p pul yo'q edi.
{r:Many people attended the celebration.} - Bayramga ko'p odamlar keldi.
{r:There was a lot of food at the celebration.} - Bayramda juda ko'p ovqat bor edi.
{r:The celebration lasted all night.} - Bayram tuni bo'yi davom etdi.

text: {r:viewer}[ˈvjuːər] - tomoshabin. View(ko'rmoq, tomosha qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The show didn’t have many viewers.} - Shouning ko'p tomoshabinlari yo'q edi.
{r:There’s a lot of competition for viewers.} - Tomoshabinlar uchun juda ko'p raqobat bor.
{r:How much feedback did you get from viewers?} - Tomoshabinlardan qancha fikr oldingiz?
{r:One viewer wanted to leave, but she changed her mind and stayed till the end.} – Bir tomoshabin ketmoqchi edi, lekin fikrini o‘zgartirib, oxirigacha qoldi.

text: {r:disaster}[dɪˈzɑːstər] – ofat, balo. Do’stingiz revmatizmdan aziyat chekadi va bir yilda ikki marta davolanadi. Bu {h:balo} uning {p:TIZZASID}A ya’ni revmatizm tizza bo’g’imlariga og’riq beradi.
examples: {r:The disaster caused a lot of damage.} - Ofat juda ko'p zarar keltirdi.
{r:There weren’t many survivors after the disaster.} - Falokatdan keyin ko'p omon qolganlar yo'q edi.
{r:They didn’t have much time to escape the disaster.} - Ularning falokatdan qochish uchun ko'p vaqti yo'q edi.
{r:Many people helped after the disaster.} - Falokatdan keyin ko'p odamlar yordam berdi.

text: {r:totally}[ˈtəʊtəli] - butunlay. Total(butunlay) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:I totally agree with you.} - Men butunlay fikringizga qo'shilaman.
{r:She didn’t have much time, so she totally forgot.} - Uning ko'p vaqti yo'q edi, shuning uchun u butunlay unutdi.
{r:Many people were totally surprised by the news.} - Ko'p odamlar yangilikdan butunlay hayratda qoldi.
{r:There’s a lot of work to do, and I’m totally exhausted.} - Juda ko'p qiladigan ish bor va men butunlay charchadim.

text: {r:sugar}[ˈʃʊɡər] – shakar. Aslida o’zbek tilidagi shakar va inglizcha sugar so’zlari umumiy ildizga ega. Shukur ismli inson va shakarni tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:Do you add much sugar to your tea?} - Choyingizga ko'p shakar qo'shdingizmi?
{r:There’s a lot of sugar in this cake.} - Bu tortda juda ko'p shakar bor.
{r:Many people try to avoid eating too much sugar.} - Ko'p odamlar ko'p shakar iste'mol qilishdan qochishadi.
{r:She didn’t add much sugar to the recipe.} - U retseptga ko'p shakar qo'shmadi.

text: {r:pain}[peɪn] – og’riq. Endi {p:PAYN}etda {h:og’riq}ni qoldiruvchi dori ham sotishadi. Paynet hayotning yorqin tarafida bo’ling.
examples: {r:He didn’t feel much pain after the surgery.} - Operatsiyadan keyin u ko'p og'riq sezmadi.
{r:He felt a sharp pain in his stomach after the meal.} - U ovqatdan keyin oshqozonida o'tkir og'riq his qildi.
{r:There’s a lot of pain in the world.} - Dunyoda juda ko'p og'riq bor.
{r:She couldn’t bear the pain any longer.} - U endi og'riqqa chiday olmadi.

text: {r:strength}[streŋθ] - kuch. Strong(kuchli) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:He didn’t have much strength left after the workout.} - Uning mashqdan keyin ko'p kuchi qolmadi.
{r:Many people admire her strength and courage.} - Ko'p odamlar uning kuchi va jasoratini qadrlaydi.
{r:There’s a lot of strength in teamwork.} - Jamoa ishida juda ko'p kuch bor.
{r:She gained a lot of strength from her family.} - U o'z oilasidan juda ko'p kuch oldi.

text: {r:secure}[sɪˈkjʊər] – tinch, xavfsiz, osoyishta. Bizning shahar juda {h:xavfsiz.} Hammasi mana shu {p:SEKYUR}iti xodimlari tufayli.
examples: {r:The house didn’t feel very secure.} - Uy unchalik xavfsiz his qilinmadi.
{r:Many people want to feel secure in their jobs.} - Ko'p odamlar o'z ishlarida xavfsiz his qilishni xohlaydi.
{r:There’s a lot of security in this neighborhood.} - Bu mahallada juda ko'p xavfsizlik mavjud.
{r:Additionally, she didn’t have much time to secure the documents.} - Qo'shimchasiga u hujjatlarni xavfsiz qilish uchun ko'p vaqt topa olmadi.

text: {r:curiosity}[ˌkjʊəriˈɒsəti] - qiziqish, qiziquvchanlik. Curious(qiziquvchan) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Children have a lot of curiosity about the world.} - Bolalar dunyo haqida juda ko'p qiziqishga ega.
{r:Did you feel much curiosity about the new project?} - Yangi loyiha haqida ko'p qiziqish his qildingizmi?
{r:Additionally we must determine their level of curiosity.} - Bundan tashqari, biz ularning qiziqish darajasini aniqlashimiz kerak.
{r:She didn’t have much curiosity about the topic.} - U mavzu haqida ko'p qiziqish bildirmadi.

text: {r:excited}[ɪkˈsaɪtɪd] - xursand, hayajonlangan, quvonchli.
examples: {r:There’s a lot of excitement about the upcoming event.} - Kelgusi tadbir bo'yicha juda ko'p hayajon bor.
{r:Many people were excited to meet the famous author.} - Ko'p odamlar mashhur muallif bilan uchrashishdan xursand edi.
{r:I don't feel excited much about this victory} - Bu g'alabadan juda ham xursand emasman.
{r:The children were a lot more excited than the adults.} - Bolalar kattalarga qaraganda ancha ko'p quvonchda edi.

text: {r:feedback}[ˈfiːdbæk] - fikr, mulohaza. Mashhur fast food tarmog'i {p:FID}ap {p:BAK}lashka shaklida hot doglar sotyapti va mijozlarning {h:fikrlariga} duch kelyapti.
examples: {r:Did you receive much feedback from the audience?} - Tomoshabinlardan ko'p fikr oldingizmi?
{r:Many students appreciated the teacher’s feedback.} - Ko'p talabalar o'qituvchining fikr-mulohazalarini qadrladi.
{r:There’s a lot of feedback to process after the meeting.} - Uchrashuvdan keyin juda ko'p fikr-mulohazalarni qayta ishlash kerak.
{r:We collect feedback to measure customer satisfaction.} - Biz mijozlar mamnuniyatini o'lchash uchun fikr-mulohazalarni yig'amiz.

text: {r:fighter}[ˈfaɪtər] - jangchi. Fight(jang qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:There weren’t many fighters left in the competition.} - Musobaqada ko'p jangchilar qolmadi.
{r:Perhaps he didn’t have much energy to continue as a fighter.} - Balki u jangchi sifatida davom etish uchun ko'p energiyaga ega emas edi.
{r:A lot of people admire the fighter’s determination.} - Ko'p odamlar jangchining qat'iyatini qadrlaydi.
{r:Many fighters train for years to become champions.} - Ko'p jangchilar chempion bo'lish uchun yillar davomida mashq qiladi.

text: {r:currently}[ˈkʌrəntli] - hozirda. Current(hozirgi) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:She doesn’t have much time currently because of work.} - U hozirda ish tufayli ko'p vaqtga ega emas.
{r:His country is currently not independent.} - Uning davlati hozirda mustaqil emas.
{r:There’s a lot of work to do currently.} - Hozirda juda ko'p ish bor.
{r:Maybe he’s currently not feeling well.} - Balki u hozir unchalik yaxshi his qilmayapti.
{r:Currently, I have no idea what is happening.} - Hozirda nima bo'layotganini bilmayapman.

text: {r:goal}[ɡəʊl] - maqsad; gol. Futboldagi gol so'zi aynan shu so'zdan olingan. Futbolda ikki jamoaning ham maqsadi gol urib g'alabaga erishish.
examples: {r:Achieving this goal will bring me enormous satisfaction.} - Bu maqsadga erishish menga ulkan mamnuniyat keltiradi.
{r:Many people struggle to stay focused on their goals.} - Ko'p odamlar o'z maqsadlariga e'tibor qaratishda qiynaladi.
{r:To achieve their common goal, all members must cooperate.} - Umumiy maqsadlariga erishish uchun barcha a'zolar hamkorlik qilishlari kerak.
[center][b]set a goal - maqsad qo'ymoq[/b][/center]
{r:I set a goal to read more books} – Men ko‘proq kitob o‘qish uchun maqsad qo‘ydim.
{r:They set a goal to learn English} – Ular ingliz tilini o‘rganish uchun maqsad qo‘yishdi.

text: {r:author}[ˈɔːθər] - avtor, muallif.
examples: {r:There’s a lot of respect for the author’s work.} - Muallifning ishiga juda ko'p hurmat bor.
{r:Did you read many books by this author?} - Bu muallifning ko'p kitoblarini o'qidingizmi?
{r:She didn’t have much time to meet the famous author.} - U mashhur muallif bilan uchrashish uchun ko'p vaqt topa olmadi.
{r:Many people admire the author’s creativity.} - Ko'p odamlar muallifning ijodkorligini qadrlaydi.

text: {r:fill}[fɪl] – to’ldirmoq, to'lmoq. Hayvonlarni albomga chizdim, birinchi fildan boshladim. Varaq {p:fil} bilan {h:to’lib qoldi}, ahir fil katta hayvonda.
examples: {r:He didn’t have much time to fill out the form.} - U formani to'ldirish uchun ko'p vaqt topa olmadi.
{r:Many students filled the room during the lecture.} - Ma'ruza paytida ko'p talabalar xonani to'ldirdi.
{r:There’s a lot of work to fill the gaps in the project.} - Loyihadagi bo'shliqlarni to'ldirish uchun juda ko'p ish bor.
{r:She filled the cup with a lot of water.} - U stakanni juda ko'p suv bilan to'ldirdi.

text:
"Challenge" so‘zi ot sifatida "qiyinchilik", "sinov", fe’l sifatida esa "qarshi chiqmoq", "sinab ko‘rmoq", "chorlamoq" degan ma’nolarni bildiradi. U biror narsa qiyin yoki kuch sinovchi ekanini yoki kimnidir biror ishga undashni ifodalaydi.

[b]Noun misollar:[/b] 
 1) "Climbing the mountain was a real challenge." — "Tog‘ga chiqish haqiqiy sinov bo‘ldi." 
 2) "She enjoys a good challenge." — "U yaxshi sinovlarni(chorlovlarni) yoqtiradi."

[b]Verb misollar:[/b] 
 3) "They challenged the final decision." — "Ular yakuniy qarorga qarshi chiqishdi." 
4 ) "I want to challenge myself to do better." — "O‘zimni yaxshiroq bo‘lishga undamoqchiman(chorlamoqchiman)."
{r:Represent}[ˌrɛprɪˈzɛnt] – vakil bo’lmoq. Men bozorga rediskachilarni {h:vakili} bo’lib bordim. Ularga {p:RE}diskani {p:PREZINT}atsiyasini qilib berdim, hammaga yoqdi va sotib oladigan bo’ldi.
examples: {r:She represents a few companies in the city.} - U shaharda bir nechta kompaniyalarga vakillik qiladi.
{r:There’s little representation of women in leadership roles.} - Rahbarlik lavozimlarida ayollarning vakilligi juda oz.
{r:I represent Uzbekistan in this sports event.} - Bu sport tadbirida men O'zbekistonni vakiliman.
{r:Many people represent our company in this meeting.} - Bu uchrashuvda juda ko'p odamlar kompaniyamizni vakili sifatida ishtirok etishadi.

text: {r:Focus}[ˈfoʊkəs] - diqqat, e'tibor, fokus; diqqat qilmoq, e'tibor qaratmoq. Bir xil so'zlar.
examples: {r:He has little focus when he’s tired.} - U charchaganda e’tiborini unchalik jamlay olmaydi.
{r:A few students focused on the difficult problem.} - Bir nechta talabalar qiyin muammoga e'tibor qaratdi.
{r:There’s a little focus on mental health in schools.} - Maktablarda ruhiy salomatlikka ozgina e'tibor qaratiladi.
{r:Many people struggle to focus in noisy environments.} - Ko'p odamlar shovqinli muhitda e'tiborini jamlashda qiynaladi.
{r:Please don't bother me when I need to focus.} - Diqqat qilishim kerak bo'lganda meni bezovta qilmang.

text: {r:Drop}[drɒp] – tushirmoq; tushish; tomchilamoq, tomchi. Men cho’lda ham {p:turup} ekib hosil oldim. Suv kam edi, {h:tomchilab} sug’orishni boshladim.
examples: {r:There’s little water left in the bottle, just a few drops.} - Shishada ozgina suv qoldi, bir nechta tomchi.
{r:Even a little drop of kindness matters.} - Mehribonlikning hatto ozgina tomchisi ham ahamiyat kasb etadi.
{r:House prices dropped gradually this year.} - Uy narxlari bu yil bosqichma-bosqich tushdi.
{r:I dropped my new phone.} - Men yangi telefonimni qo'limdan tushirib qo'ydim.

text: {r:Energy}[ˈɛnərdʒi] - energiya, kuch.
examples: {r:He has little energy after a long day at work.} - Uzoq ish kunidan keyin uning energiyasi deyarli qolmadi.
{r:A few people have the energy to exercise after work.} - Ishdan keyin mashq qilish uchun energiyasi bor odamlar oz.
{r:There’s a little energy left in the battery.} - Batareyada ozgina energiya qoldi.
{r:Many people depend on coffee for energy.} - Ko'p odamlar energiya uchun kofe ichishga tayanadi.
{r:The country's economy is heavily dependent on imported energy.} - Mamlakat iqtisodiyoti import qilinadigan energiyaga juda bog'liq.

text: {r:Love}[lʌv] - sevmoq; sevgi.
examples: {r:She has little love for spicy food.} - U achchiq taomlarni unchalik yoqtirmaydi.
{r:There’s a little love in every act of kindness.} - Har bir mehribonlikda ozgina muhabbat bor.
{r:Many people believe love is the most important thing.} - Ko'p odamlar sevgi eng muhim narsa deb hisoblaydi.
[center][b]fall in love - sevib qolmoq[/b][/center]
{r:I will never fall in love again.} – Men boshqa hech qachon sevib qolmayman.
{r:We fell in love last summer.} – Biz o‘tgan yoz bir-birimizni sevib qoldik.

text: {r:Courage}[ˈkʌrɪdʒ] – jasorat, dadillik. G’alati qonunlar chiqib ketdi davlatimizda. Masalan hozir tarvuzni {p:KARICH} qilib so’ysang bir umrlik qamoq jazosi berilyapti. Shuning uchun odamlar hatto uyining ichida ham {p:karich} qilib kesishga {h:jasorati} yetmayapti.
examples: {r:He showed little courage during the challenge.} - U qiyin vaziyatda unchalik jasorat ko'rsatmadi.
{r:I have no idea how she found the courage to speak.} - U qanday qilib gapirishga jasorat topganini men umuman bilmayman.
{r:There’s a little courage in everyone} - Har bir insonda ozgina jasorat bor.
{r:We must set goals and show courage to reach them.} – Biz maqsad qo‘yishimiz va ularga erishish uchun jasorat ko‘rsatishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Employer}[ɪmˈplɔɪər] - ish beruvchi. Employ(ishga olmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:There’s little trust between the employer and employees.} - Ish beruvchi va xodimlar o'rtasida unchalik ishonch yo'q.
{r:My employer is not caring. He even calls me at midnight.} - Ish beruvchim g'amxo'r emas. U ba'zan yarim tunda ham telefon qiladi.
{r:The employer showed a little kindness to the new staff.} - Ish beruvchi yangi xodimlarga ozgina mehribonlik ko'rsatdi.
{r:Many employers are looking for skilled workers.} - Ko'p ish beruvchilar malakali ishchilarni qidirmoqda.

text: {r:Push}[pʊʃ] – itarmoq. Urush payti bobom qo’lidan jarohatlanib hech narsa kotarolmaydi. O’shanda {p:push}kani yaqin do’nglikkacha {h:itarib} boradi.
examples: {r:He gave the door a little push, and it opened.} - U eshikni ozgina itarib yubordi va u ochildi.
{r:Only few people helped push my car.} - Faqatgina kamgina odam mashinani itarishda menga yordam berdi.
{r:I was pushed by my enemy.} - Dushmanim meni itarib yubordi.
{r:The crowd pushed each other when exiting from the stadium.} - Olomon stadiondan chiqish payti bir-birini itardi.

text: {r:Natural}[ˈnætʃərəl] - natural, tabiiy.
examples: {r:There’s little natural light in this room.} - Bu xonada tabiiy yorug'lik unchalik ko'p emas.
{r:A few natural remedies can help with headaches.} - Bosh og'rig'iga yordam beradigan bir nechta tabiiy davolar mavjud.
{r:She has little natural talent for singing.} - Uning qo‘shiq aytishga unchalik tabiiy qobiliyati yo‘q.
{r:Many people prefer natural products.} - Ko'p odamlar tabiiy mahsulotlarni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:Note}[noʊt] – qayd etmoq, eslatma yozmoq; qayd, eslatma. Biror narsani qayd etish kerak bo’lsa, albatta noutbukdan foydalanaman. Hozir {p:nout}bukda 1000 dan ortiq {h:qaydlar} bor.
examples: [center][b]take notes - eslatmalar yozmoq[/b][/center]
{r:Take notes during the lesson.} - Dars davomida eslatmalar yozib bor.
{r:He took a few notes during the lecture.} - U ma'ruza paytida bir nechta eslatmalar yozdi.
{r:There’s little time to review the notes before the exam.} - Imtihondan oldin eslatmalarni ko'rib chiqish uchun vaqt unchalik ko'p emas.
{r:She left a little note on the table.} - U stol ustida ozgina eslatma qoldirdi.
{r:Many students rely on their notes for repetition.} - Ko'p talabalar takrorlash uchun o'z eslatmalariga tayanadi.

text: {r:Share}[ʃeər] – bo’lishmoq. {p:Sheyr}it – ilova va fayllar {h:bo’lishish} mumkin bo’lgan ilova.
examples: {r:She shared a little food with her friend.} - U do'sti bilan ozgina ovqat ulashdi.
{r:A few people shared their opinions during the meeting.} - Uchrashuv paytida bir nechta odamlar o'z fikrlari bilan bo'lishdi.
{r:There’s little desire to share resources.} - Resurslarni ulashishga unchalik xohish yo'q.
{r:Many people enjoy sharing their experiences.} - Ko'p odamlar o'z tajribalarini ulashishni yoqtirishadi.

text: {r:Common}[ˈkɒmən] - umumiy; ommalashgan. Bolalar do'koniga kirsam juda ham qimmat va sifatli kamon turgan ekan. Boshqa bir o'rta yoshli kishi ham kirib qoldi va shu kamonga qiziqish bildirdi. Lekin ikkalamizni ham pulimiz sotib olish uchun yetmasdi va shunda o'rtada pul tashlashib bu kamonni sotib olishga qaror qildik. Hozir bu {p:KOMON} {h:umumiy}, ikkalamizniki ham. Bir oy men o'ynasam bir oy anavi kishi o'ynaydi.
examples: {r:English was a common language among international students.} - Inglizcha xalqaro talabalar o'rtasidagi umumiy til edi.
{r:A few common mistakes can be avoided with practice.} - Bir nechta keng tarqalgan xatolarni mashq bilan oldini olish mumkin.
{r:Many common English words originate from Latin.} - Ko'pgina keng tarqalgan inglizcha so'zlar lotin tilidan kelib chiqqan.
{r:Many people face common challenges in life.} - Ko'p odamlar hayotda umumiy qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishadi.

text: {r:Trait}[treɪt] – xususiyat, xossa. Toshtemir tog’aning traktori ajoyib {h:xususiyat}ga ega. U odamlar bilan gaplasha oladi. Faqat suhbatni “{p:TR}aktor {p:AYT}” degan gap bilan boshlash kerak. Shunda u tilga kirib ketadi.
examples: {r:He has little patience, which is a rare trait.} - Uning sabr-toqati unchalik ko'p emas, bu esa kam uchraydigan xususiyat.
{r:A few traits make her a great leader.} - Bir nechta xususiyatlar uni ajoyib rahbarga aylantiradi.
{r:There’s a little kindness in every trait of hers.} - Uning har bir xususiyatida ozgina mehribonlik bor.
{r:Many people admire her positive traits.} - Ko'p odamlar uning ijobiy xususiyatlarini qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Failure}[ˈfeɪljər] - muvaffaqiyatsizlik. Fail(muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:This project is likely to be a failure if we don't cooperate with professionals.} - Bu proyekt ehtimol muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrar agar biz professionallar bilan hamkorlik qilmasak.
{r:A few failures taught him valuable lessons.} - Bir nechta muvaffaqiyatsizliklar unga qimmatli saboqlar berdi.
{r:She showed a little disappointment after the failure.} - Muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan keyin u ozgina xafa bo'ldi.
{r:Unfortunately we fear failure.} - Afsuski biz muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan qo'rqamiz.

text: {r:Watch}[wɒtʃ] - soat. 3 - darsda 'watch' ning 'tomosha qilmoq, ko'rmoq' ma'nosi bilan tanishib chiqqan edik. Qarangki uning yana bir ko'p qo'llaniladigan omonimi bor ekan.
examples: {r:He bought a new watch with a leather strap.} - U charm tasmali yangi soat sotib oldi.
{r:She checked her watch to see the time.} - U vaqtni ko‘rish uchun soatiga qaradi.
{r:This brand produces luxury watches.} - Ushbu brend hashamatli soatlar ishlab chiqaradi.
{r:My grandfather's watch is an antique.} - Bobomning soati antikvardir.

text: {r:Evident}[ˈɛvɪdənt] – ayon, ma’lum, ochiq, oshkor, ravshan. Evidence(isbot, dalil) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:There’s little evidence to support the claim.} - Bu da'voni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan dalillar unchalik ko'p emas.
{r:A few evident mistakes were corrected immediately.} - Bir nechta aniq xatolar darhol tuzatildi.
{r:She showed evident frustration.} - U aniq xafa bo'ldi.
{r:Many people find the solution evident.} - Ko'p odamlar yechimni aniq deb bilishadi.

text: {r:Significant}[sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt] – muhim. Sigirlarning sutdorligini oshirish kerak. Biz hammaning fikrini soradik bu borada, endi {p:sigirni fik}rini ham so’raymiz. Uning fikrlari ham {h:muhim}.
examples: {r:There’s little significant progress in the project.} - Loyihada unchalik muhim taraqqiyot yo'q.
{r:A few significant changes were made to the plan.} - Rejaga bir nechta muhim o'zgartirishlar kiritildi.
{r:The building represents a significant aspect of 20th-century culture.} - Bino 20-asr madaniyatining muhim jihatini ifodalaydi.
{r:Many people appreciate significant achievements.} - Ko'p odamlar muhim yutuqlarni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Factor}[ˈfæktər] - omil, faktor.
examples: {r:What are main factors?} - Asosiy faktorlar nima?
{r:A few factors contributed to the success.} - Bir nechta omillar muvaffaqiyatga hissa qo'shdi.
{r:She considered a few factors before making the decision.} - U qaror qabul qilishdan oldin bir necha omilni hisobga oldi.
{r:Many people ignore important factors.} - Ko'p odamlar muhim omillarni e'tiborsiz qoldiradi.

text:
{r:Shoot}[ʃuːt] - otmoq(pistolet, kamonlarda); olmoq(rasm, video). 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - shot, shot. 
Men professional fotografman va asosan bitta narsani {h:rasmga olishni} yaxshi ko'raman. Bu ham bo'lsa ertalabki {p:SHUD}ring.
examples: {r:There’s certainly little time to shoot the scene.} - Sahnani suratga olish uchun albatta vaqt unchalik ko'p emas.
{r:He shot few pictures of mine.} - U mening rasmlarimni kam olibdi.
{r:Of course many people enjoy shooting as a hobby.} - Ko'p odamlar o'q otishni xobbi sifatida albatta yoqtirishadi.
{r:The hunter shot a man by chance in the forest} – Ovchi o‘rmonda bir odamni tasodifan otib yubordi.

text: {r:Save}[seɪv] – saqlamoq. Men pullarimning barchasini {p:seyv}da {h:saqlayman} va yaxshi qulflaganman. Siz ham kitob orasida saqlashni to’xtating.
examples: {r:There’s little money left to save.} - Saqlash uchun kamgina pul qoldi.
{r:How much money he saved is none of my business.} - U qancha pul saqlab qo'yganiga burnimni tiqishim kerak emas.
{r:She made a little effort to save energy.} - U energiya tejash uchun ozgina harakat qildi.
{r:Many people try to save for the future.} - Ko'p odamlar kelajak uchun pul yig'ishga harakat qiladi.

text: {r:Defence}[dɪˈfɛns] – himoya, mudofaa. {p:Di}rektorimiz {p:fens}i ichishni yaxshi ko’radi issiqda. 'Bu meni zararli quyosh nurlaridan {h:himoya} qiladi' deb hisoblaydi.
examples: {r:This castle has a stronger defence.} - Bu qal'a kuchliroq himoyaga ega.
{r:The new law provides more defence for workers.} - Yangi qonun ishchilar uchun ko'proq himoya beradi.
{r:She argued with little defence against the accusations.} - U ayblovlarga qarshi ozgina himoya bilan bahslashdi.
{r:Many people believe that education is the best defence.} - Ko'p odamlar ta'lim eng yaxshi himoya deb hisoblaydi.

text: {r:Similar}[ˈsɪmɪlər] – o’xshash, kabi. Oldin vay fay uchun alyumin simlar ishlatilgan, hozir esa {h:bunga o’xshash} barcha {p:simlar} mis, volfram, simoblarni ishlatish samarali emasligi isbotlandi. Eng yaxshisi optik tolalar ishlatilishi kerak.
examples: {r:This dress is more similar to the one I saw yesterday.} - Bu ko'ylak men kecha ko'rganimga ko'proq o'xshaydi.
{r:There are a few similar cases in history.} - Tarixda bir nechta o'xshash holatlar mavjud.
{r:She has a little similarity to her mother.} - U onasiga ozgina o'xshaydi.
{r:Many people find the two stories very similar.} - Ko'p odamlar ikkita hikoyani juda o'xshash deb bilishadi.
{r:Similar technology enables us to do more with less.} - Shunga o'xshash texnologiya bizga kamroq resurslar bilan ko'proq ish qilishga imkon bermoqda.

text: {r:Specially}[ˈspɛʃəli] - maxsus, spetsialno. Special(maxsus) so'zining ravish shakli. O'zbek tilida ishlatiladigan 'spetsialno' so'zi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarjimasi.
examples: {r:This dish is specially made for you.} - Bu taom siz uchun maxsus tayyorlangan.
{r:The hotel is specially designed for presidents.} - Mehmonxona maxsus prezidentlar uchun bezatilgan.
{r:She gave a specially prepared gift.} - U maxsus tayyorlangan sovg'a berdi.
{r:Many people appreciate specially crafted items.} - Ko'p odamlar maxsus qo'lda yasalgan buyumlarni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Sincerely}[sɪnˈsɪərli] - samimiy, chin dildan. Sincere(samimiy) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:He apologized more sincerely.} - U ko'proq samimiyat bilan uzr so'radi.
{r:There’s little sincerity in his words.} - Uning so'zlarida unchalik samimiylik yo'q.
{r:He sincerely thanked the mechanic for fixing the engine} – U dvigatelni tuzatib bergani uchun mexanikka chin dildan minnatdorchilik bildirdi.
{r:Many people sincerely value honest opinions.} - Ko'p odamlar samimiy va halol fikrlarni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Optional}[ˈɒpʃənəl] - ixtiyoriy, majburiy emas. Hind kinosida rol o'ynadim va bitta kadrda hind qizini o'pishim kerak edi. Rejjisyorga 'men o'zbekman bu qadriyatlarimizga to'g'ri kelmaydi' degan edim xayriyatki meni tushundi '{p:O'PISHIN} yoki o'pmasligin {h:ixtiyoriy}' dedi.
examples: {r:This course is optional.} - Bu kurs ixtiyoriy.
{r:There’s little optional work in this project.} - Ushbu loyihada unchalik ixtiyoriy ish yo'q.
{r:She chose a few optional activities.} - U bir nechta ixtiyoriy mashg'ulotlarni tanladi.
{r:Many people prefer optional tasks.} - Ko'p odamlar ixtiyoriy vazifalarni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:Likelihood}[ˈlaɪklihʊd] - ehtimollik. Likely(ehtimol) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:There’s a higher likelihood of rain tomorrow.} - Ertaga yomg'ir yog'ish ehtimoli ko'proq.
{r:The likelihood of success is little in this case.} - Bu holatda muvaffaqiyat ehtimoli unchalik ko'p emas.
{r:A few factors increase the likelihood of winning.} - Bir nechta omillar g'alaba qozonish ehtimolini oshiradi.
{r:Many people underestimate the likelihood of failure.} - Ko'p odamlar muvaffaqiyatsizlik ehtimolini kam baholaydi.
{r:There is a likelihood that our boss will yell at you.} - Bizning boshliq senga baqirib berish ehtimoli bor.

text: {r:Popular}[ˈpɒpjʊlər] - mashhur, populyarniy. Aslida bu so'zning ruscha shakli 'populyarniy' o'zbek tilida ham keng qo'llaniladi.
examples: {r:This restaurant is more popular among Uzbeks.} - Bu restoran o'zbeklar orasida mashhurroq.
{r:Solar panels are a popular solution for the energy crisis.} - Quyosh panellari energiya inqirozi uchun mashhur yechim.
{r:My proposal will make you more popular.} - Mening taklifim seni mashhurroq qiladi.
{r:Many people follow popular actors.} - Ko'p odamlar mashhur aktyorlarni kuzatishadi.
{r:Young guys often fall in love with popular girls.} - Yosh yigitlar ko'pincha mashhur qizlarni sevib qolishadi.

text: {r:Brave}[breɪv] – jasur, mard, qo’rqmas. {p:Bravo} guruhining a'zolari mard va {h:jasur} ekan. Qo'rqmasdan Milliondan ajralib chiqib katta konsertlar berayapti.
examples: {r:He is a brave man.} - U jasur kishi.
{r:Majority of our women are brave.} - Ayollarimizning ko'pi jasur.
{r:A few brave soldiers defended the town.} - Bir nechta jasur askarlar shaharni himoya qildi.
{r:Many people admire brave actions.} - Ko'p odamlar jasoratli harakatlarni yaxshi ko'radi.

text: {r:Fluent}[ˈfluːənt] - ravon(biror tilni bilishga nisabatan ishlatiladi). Men bokschi {p:FLOYD} Meyvezrning ashaddiy muxlisiman va uning intervyularini tushunish va u bilan gaplasha olish uchun ingliz tilini {h:ravon} o'rgandim. Ingliz tilini zo'r bilganimdan so'ng dunyo juda keng va qiziqarli ekanligini kashf etdim va FLOYDga muxlisligim yo'qoldi.
examples: {r:She speaks English more fluently than I do.} - U ingliz tilida mendan ravonroq gapiradi.
{r:There’s little fluency in his speech.} - Uning nutqida unchalik ravonlik yo'q.
{r:A few students are fluent in multiple languages.} - Bir nechta talabalar bir nechta tillarni ravon bilishadi.
{r:Many people want to become fluent in a second language.} - Ko'p odamlar ikkinchi tilni ravon o'rganishni xohlashadi.

text: {r:Stock}[stɒk] – zaxira, zapas. Men omborxonaga {p:S}abzini {p:TOK} urganlarini katta {h:zaxira}sini to’plab qo’yganman. Tok urgan sabzi chirimaydi va barra holatda saqlanadi.
examples: {r:This store has a larger stock.} - Bu do'kon ko'proq tovar zaxirasiga ega.
{r:There’s little stock left after the sale.} - Sotuvdan keyin unchalik tovar qolmadi.
{r:A few items in the stock are damaged.} - Zaxiradagi bir nechta mahsulotlar shikastlangan.
{r:Many people buy items when the stock is high.} - Ko'p odamlar zaxira ko'p bo'lganida mahsulotlarni sotib olishadi.

text: {r:Treat}[triːt] - muomalada bo'lmoq. Bolaligimda anavi amakilar menga '{p:TUR IT}' deb haydab yuborgan, juda qo'pol {h:muomala qilganlar.} Men bunday odamlarni hech qachon hurmat qilmayman.
examples: {r:This hotel treats its guests better than the others.} - Bu mehmonxona mehmonlarini boshqalariga qaraganda yaxshiroq kutib oladi.
{r:They treated everyone well except me.} - Ular mendan tashqari hammaga yaxshi munosabatda bo'lishdi.
{r:An apartment owner treated guests nicely.} - Xonadon egasi mehmonlarga yaxshi munosabatda bo'ldi.
{r:They had no hospitality. I was treated badly there.} - Ularning mehmondo'stligi yo'q ekan. Menga yomon muomalada bo'lishdi

text: {r:Despite}[dɪˈspaɪt] – ..ga qaramay, garchi. {h:Garchi} noqulay bo’lsada, {p:dis}klar {p:payt}ini ham o’z gashti bor edi. Hamma uyda DVD lar bo’lar edi.
examples: {r:Despite the rain, the event was more successful.} - Yomg'irga qaramay, tadbir muvaffaqiyatliroq bo'ldi.
{r:There’s little progress despite the efforts.} - Harakatlarga qaramay, unchalik taraqqiyot yo'q.
{r:He set a goal to run every morning despite the cold weather.} – U sovuq havoga qaramasdan har kuni yugurishni maqsad qildi.
{r:Many people succeed despite the challenges.} - Ko'p odamlar qiyinchiliklarga qaramay muvaffaqiyat qozonishadi.
{r:She took notes despite being very tired} – U juda charchaganiga qaramay yozib bordi.

text: {r:Protect}[prəˈtɛkt] - himoya qilmoq. Men stadionda ishlayman. Mening ishim stadiondagi yorituvchi {p:PROJEKT}orlarni {h:himoya qilish} ularning ustiga temir panjara qo'yish orqali.
examples: {r:This jacket protects you better than the old one.} - Bu kurtka eskisiga qaraganda sizni yaxshiroq himoya qiladi.
{r:There’s little protection against the cold.} - Sovuqqa qarshi unchalik himoya yo'q.
{r:A few laws protect workers’ rights.} - Bir nechta qonunlar ishchilarning huquqlarini himoya qiladi.
{r:Many people wear masks to protect themselves.} - Ko'p odamlar o'zlarini himoya qilish uchun niqob kiyishadi.

text: {r:Fund}[fʌnd] – fond; moliyalashtirmoq. Maktab {p:fondi} degan pul yig’imini eshitgansizlar. Bu aynan shu so’z. Yana u 'moliyalashtirmoq' degani hamdir, chunki siz yig’adigan fondning ham maqsadi shu, kamchiliklarni {h:moliyalashtirish}.
examples: {r:This project received more funds in our company.} - Ushbu loyiha kompaniyamizda ko'proq mablag' oldi.
{r:There’s little funding for small businesses.} - Kichik korxonalar uchun unchalik mablag' yo'q.
{r:A few organizations provide funds for education.} - Bir nechta tashkilotlar ta'lim uchun mablag' ajratadi.
{r:Many people donate to charity funds.} - Ko'p odamlar xayriya fondlariga xayriya qilishadi.

text: {r:Handsome}[ˈhænsəm] – chiroyli, kelishgan. Agar {p:HAND}alak {p:SAM}arqandniki bo’lsa zudlik bilan sotib oling. Chunki Samarqand handalaklarini yesangiz {h:chiroyli} bo’lib ketasiz.
examples: {r:He is more handsome than his brother.} - U akasiga qaraganda ko'proq kelishgan.
{r:This guy is handsome but very boring.} - Bu yigit kelishgan ammo juda zerikarli.
{r:I saw a handsome guy in a grocery store.} - Oziq-ovqat do'konida kelishgan yigitni ko'rdim.
{r:Many people love handsome actors.} - Ko'p odamlar kelishgan aktyorlarni yaxshi ko'radi.

text: {r:Ugly}[ˈʌɡli] – xunuk. Tasavvur qiling sizning chaqalog’ingiz bor va unga siz har kuni 4-5 ta taglilani ishlatasiz. Bolangiz har kuni 1-2 marta t{p:AGLI}ni sap-sariq {h:xunuk} qilib qo’yadi.
examples: {r:This building is relatively uglier.} - Bu bino nisbatan xunukroq.
{r:I have never seen such an ugly ladder.} - Men hech qachon bunday xunuk narvon ko'rmaganman.
{r:A few people find modern art ugly.} - Bir nechta odamlar zamonaviy san'atni xunuk deb bilishadi.
{r:Many people avoid ugly situations.} - Ko'p odamlar xunuk vaziyatlardan qochishadi.

text: {r:Bright}[braɪt] – yorqin. Yorqin (Umarov) og'ayni birorta quvnoq qo'shig'ingdan {p:BIR AYT} hammayoq {h:yorishib} ketsin.
examples: {r:This room is brighter.} - Bu xona yorqinroq.
{r:There’s little brightness in this painting.} - Ushbu rasmda unchalik yorqinlik yo'q.
{r:Additionally, A few bright stars will appear tonight.} - Bundan tashqari, bir nechta yorqin yulduzlar paydo bo'ladi bugun tunda.
{r:Many people prefer bright colors.} - Ko'p odamlar yorqin ranglarni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:Rude}[ruːd] - qo'pol. Real Madrid o'yinchisi Antoni {p:RUD}iger oxirgi paytlar juda {h:qo'pol} o'yin ko'rsatayapti va shuning uchun ham Madrid klubi Husanovni Manchester Sitidan sotib olishni rejalashtirayapti.
examples: {r:I thought he was polite but he was ruder.} - Men uni odobli deb o'ylardim lekin u qo'polroq ekan.
{r:There’s little tolerance for rude behavior.} - Qo'pol xatti-harakatlarga unchalik chidash yo'q.
{r:A few people complained about his rude comments.} - Bir nechta odamlar uning qo'pol izohlari haqida shikoyat qilishdi.
{r:A rude guy installed my pipes.} - Qo'pol yigit mening quvurlarimni o'rnatib ketdi.

text: {r:Generous}[ˈdʒɛnərəs] – saxiy, saxovatli. Mamlakatimiz saxiylik qilib {p:JENTR}a beryapti har bitta {p:RUS} fuqaroga. ‘Ivan Grozniy o’z kasbini o’zgartiradi’ filmida shoh aytganidek “oloringlar biz {h:saxiymiz} davlatimiz boyligi kamayib qolmaydi”.(Namuna uchun yozildi xolos)
examples: {r:She is a more generous woman.} - U saxiyroq ayol.
{r:A generous man helped me with my neck surgery.} - Saxiy kishi mening bo'ynim operatsiyasiga yordam berdi.
{r:A few generous donations helped the charity.} - Bir nechta saxiy xayriyalar xayriya tashkilotiga yordam berdi.
{r:A generous guy is distributing food to the needy people on the corner.} - Saxiy yigit burchakda muhtoj odamlarga ovqat tarqatyapti.

text: {r:Enormous}[ɪˈnɔːməs] - ulkan, katta. Bizning bog'imizda juda ulkan anor mevasi bor va {p:ANORIMIZ} {h:kattaligi} bilan ginnes rekordlar kitobiga kiritildi.
examples: {r:This building is relatively enormous.} - Bu bino nisbatan ulkanroq.
{r:There’s little space left in this enormous room.} - Ushbu ulkan xonada unchalik joy qolmadi.
{r:The new skyscraper is an enormous structure.} - Yangi osmono'par bino ulkan inshootdir.
{r:The problem was somewhat enormous, and he struggled with it.} - Muammo birmuncha katta edi va u bilan qiynaldi.

text: {r:treatment}[ˈtriːtmənt] - muomala; muolaja, davolanish. Treat(muomala qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:This new treatment is more effective than the old one.} - Bu yangi davolash usuli eskidan ko'ra samaraliroq.
{r:Despite nice treatment from her husband, she divorced anyway.} - Erining yaxshi muomalasiga qaramasdan u baribir ajrashdi.
{r:A few patients received much better treatment than others.} - Bir nechta bemorlarga boshqalariga qaraganda ancha yaxshiroq muomala qilindi.
{r:I am against bad treatment for the poor and needy.} - Men kambag'al va muhtojlarga yomon munosabat bo'lishiga qarshiman.

text: {r:shiny}[ˈʃaɪni] - yaltiroq. Shine(yaltiramoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:This car is shinier than the one we saw yesterday.} - Bu mashina kecha ko'rganimizdan ko'ra yaltiroqroq.
{r:The car was somewhat shiny after the recent wash.} - Yaqinda yuvilgandan keyin mashina birmuncha porlab turardi.
{r:A few shiny objects caught her attention more than dull ones.} - Bir nechta yaltiroq narsalar uning e'tiborini xira narsalardan ko'ra ko'proq tortdi.
{r:Many people prefer shinier jewelry.} - Ko'p odamlar yaltiroqroq zargarlik buyumlarini afzal ko'radi.
{r:I prefer shiny wallets.} - Men yarqiragan hamyonlarni afzal ko'raman.

text: {r:gigantic}[dʒaɪˈɡæntɪk] - ulkan, gigant
examples: {r:This building is more gigantic than the one downtown.} - Bu bino shahar markazidagidan ko'ra ulkanroq.
{r:There’s less space left in this gigantic room than in the hall.} - Ushbu ulkan xonada koridordan ko'ra kamroq joy qoldi.
{r:A few gigantic trees shade the park much more effectively than smaller ones.} - Bir nechta ulkan daraxtlar parkni kichikroqlariga qaraganda ancha samaraliroq soyabon qiladi.
{r:Many people are more amazed by gigantic structures than by small ones.} - Ko'p odamlar kichik inshootlardan ko'ra ulkan inshootlardan ko'proq hayratda qolishadi.

text: {r:massive}[ˈmæsɪv] - ulkan, katta. Toshkent shahridagi Massiv dahasini bilasizmi? Prezidentimiz buyrug'iga ko'ra {p:Massiv} eng {h:katta} dahaga aylantirilar ekan.
examples: {r:This project is more massive than the one we completed last year.} - Bu loyiha o'tgan yil yakunlaganimizdan ko'ra kattaroq.
{r:There’s less progress on this massive task than we hoped.} - Ushbu katta vazifa bo'yicha biz umid qilganimizdan ko'ra kamroq o'sish bor.
{r:A few massive changes were made to the plan, making it better than before.} - Rejaga bir nechta katta o'zgartirishlar kiritildi, bu esa uni avvalgidan yaxshiroq qildi.
{r:The battle ended in a massive disaster for the losing side.} - Jang mag'lub bo'lgan tomon uchun katta falokat bilan yakunlandi.

text: {r:narrow}[ˈnærəʊ] – tor. Oxirgi paytlar {p:NERV}sht qilganimdan ko’rish diapazonim {h:torayib} boryapti. Xuddiki televizor ekranining yarmi ko’rsatayotgandek bo'lyapti.
examples: {r:This road is narrower than the one we took yesterday.} - Bu yo'l kecha bosib o'tganimizdan ko'ra torroq.
{r:There’s less space to walk on this narrow path than on the main road.} - Ushbu tor yo'lda asosiy yo'lga qaraganda yurish uchun kamroq joy bor.
{r:A few narrow streets lead to the old town, making it more charming than the new part.} - Bir nechta tor ko'chalar eski shaharga olib boradi, bu esa uni yangi qismidan ko'ra jozibaliroq qiladi.
{r:This narrow-minded man is a bit unpleasant.} - Bu tor miyali inson ozroq yoqimsizroq.

text: {r:wide}[waɪd] – keng. Tasavvur qiling ertalab turgandan so’ng bet-qo’lingizni yuvib oynaga qaradingiz va peshanangiz ikki baravar kattalashib kengayib ketgan. Bu vaziyatdan shokka tushdingiz va “{p:VOYD}od peshanam namuncha {h:keng}” deb yubordingiz.
examples: {r:This river is wider than the one we saw last summer.} - Bu daryo o'tgan yoz ko'rganimizdan ko'ra kengroq.
{r:There’s less water in this wide river now than there was in spring.} - Bu keng daryoda hozir bahorda bo'lganidan ko'ra kamroq suv bor.
{r:I need a bit wider road.} - Menga biroz kengroq yo'l kerak.
{r:This wide path leads to a drugstore.} - Mana shu keng yo'lak aptekaga olib boradi.

text: {r:shallow}[ˈʃæloʊ] – sayoz; sayoz fikrli, tor fikrli. Bir kuni {p:SHERL}ok {p:LOV}iya qopi bilan ko’prikdan o’tayotganda ko’prik buzilib daryoga tushib ketibdi. Xayriyatki daryo {h:sayoz} ekan Sherlok loviyasini ko’tarib omon chiqibdi.
examples: {r:This pool is shallower than the one in the park.} - Bu hovuz parkdagidan ko'ra sayozroq.
{r:There’s less water in this shallow lake now than in the past.} - Ushbu sayoz ko'lda hozir o'tmishdagidan ko'ra kamroq suv bor.
{r:The swimming pool is much shallower than the lake.} - Basseyn ko'ldan ancha sayozroq.
{r:Many people prefer shallower water for swimming than deep.} - Ko'p odamlar suzish uchun chuqur suvdan ko'ra sayozroq suvni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:soft}[sɒft] – yumshoq. Sportchilar nega tilla medalni tishlab ko’rishini bilasizmi. Chunki {p:sof t}illa {h:yumshoq} bo’ladi va tishlaganingizdan so’ng shakli o’zgaradi.
examples: {r:This blanket is softer than the one I bought last year.} - Bu ko'rpa o'tgan yil sotib olganimdan ko'ra yumshoqroq.
{r:I have a bit soft voice.} - Mening biroz yumshoq ovozim bor.
{r:A few soft pillows made the bed much more comfortable than before.} - Bir nechta yumshoq yostiqlar kravatni avvalgidan ancha qulay qildi.
{r:Many people prefer softer fabrics for clothing than rough ones.} - Ko'p odamlar qo'pol matolardan ko'ra kiyim uchun yumshoqroq matolarni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:rough}[rʌf] – g’adir-budur, qo’pol, dag’al. {p:RAF}iqamning yuzi uylangan paytim {h:g’adir-budur} edi.Shuning uchun hozir agar janjal qilib qolsa ‘Ey sen menga rahmat de senga uylanganimga’ deb yuboraman.
examples: {r:As a prisoner I used to sleep on rough beds.} - Mahbus sifatida men dag'al kravatda yotardim.
{r:She wrote a rough article just to meet the deadline.} – U faqat muddatga ulgurish uchun shunchaki qo‘pol bir maqola yozdi.
{r:The rough waters made it hard to see the shark approaching.} – Dag‘al (to‘lqinli) suvlar akulaning yaqinlashayotganini ko‘rishni qiyinlashtirdi.
{r:Many people avoid rougher materials in their homes.} - Ko'p odamlar uylarida qo'polroq materiallardan qochishadi(ishlatishmaydi).

text: {r:smooth}[smuːð] – tekis, silliq. Agar uyda muzqaymoq tayyorlamoqchi bo’lsangiz shunchaki {p:S}utni {p:MUZ}xonaga solib qo’ying keyin {h:silliqina} muzqaymoq paydo bo’ladi.
examples: {r:This table is smoother than the one in the dining room.} - Bu stol oshxonadagidan ko'ra silliqroq.
{r:My phone screen is very smooth.} - Mening telefonim yuzasi juda silliq.
{r:A local church has smooth windows.} - Mahalliy cherkov derazalari juda silliq.
{r:Soldiers broke smooth glasses.} - Soldatlar silliq shishalarni sindirib tashlashdi.

text: {r:wet}[wɛt] – nam, ho'l. Men itimni {p:VET}erinarga oborganimda hammayog’ini yalab yulqab {h:ho'l} qilib tashladi.
examples: {r:This towel is wetter than the one I used earlier.} - Bu sochiq ilgari ishlatganimdan ko'ra ho'lroq.
{r:There’s less dryness in this wet climate than in a desert.} - Ushbu ho'l iqlimda cho'ldan ko'ra kamroq quruqlik bor.
{r:Please wipe the table with a wet towel.} - Iltimos, stolni nam sochiq bilan artib oling.
{r:She tried to take notes, but the wet pen didn’t work well.} – U eslatmalar yozishga harakat qildi, ammo ho‘l ruchka yaxshi ishlamadi.

text: {r:dry}[draɪ] – quruq;quritmoq. Tasavvur qiling sochingizni {h:quritmoqchisiz}. Yangi fen sotib olgansiz va qutini ochib qaraganingizda bu aslida {p:TRAY}nik bo’lib chiqdi.
examples: {r:This bread is drier than the one we bought yesterday.} - Bu non kecha sotib olganimizdan ko'ra quruqroq.
{r:The weather is much drier here than in Uzbekistan.} - Ob-havo bu yerda O'zbekistondagidan ancha quruqroq.
{r:Please use this towel to dry your hands.} - Iltimos, qo'llaringizni quritish uchun bu sochiqdan foydalaning.
{r:Someone spilled water on my dictionary. I should dry it now.} - Kimdir lug'at kitobimga suv to'kib yuboribdi. Men uni quritishim kerak.

text: {r:Involvement}[ɪnˈvɒlvmənt] – ishtirok, qatnashish, aralashuv. Bu so‘z biror faoliyat, loyiha yoki vaziyatda ishtirok etish yoki unga aloqador bo‘lishni bildiradi. Masalan: 1) “His involvement in the project was crucial.” — “Uning loyihadagi ishtiroki juda muhim bo‘ldi.” 2) “Parents should encourage their children’s involvement in sports.” — “Ota-onalar farzandlarining sportga qatnashishini qo‘llab-quvvatlashlari kerak.” 3) “The company denied any involvement in illegal activities.” — “Kompaniya noqonuniy faoliyatlarga aloqadorligini rad etdi.” Xulosa: “Involvement” — biror narsaga faol yoki bilvosita aralashuv yoki ishtirok etishni bildiradi.
examples: {r:Her involvement in the project is less significant than his.} - Uning loyihadagi ishtiroki unikidan ko'ra kamroq muhim.
{r:There’s less involvement from the community than we expected.} - Jamoadan biz kutganimizdan ko'ra kamroq ishtirok bor.
{r:He did his best, and the teacher appreciated his involvement in the project.} – U qo‘lidan kelganini qildi va o‘qituvchi uning loyiha ishtirokini qadrladi.

text: {r:painful}[ˈpeɪnfʊl] - og'riqli. Pain so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:This injury is more painful than the one I had last year.} - Bu jarohat o'tgan yil olganimdan ko'ra og'riqliroq.
{r:A few painful memories resurfaced, making her much sadder than before.} - Bir nechta og'riqli xotiralar qayta paydo bo'ldi, bu esa uni avvalgidan ancha xafa qildi.
{r:Some people stay awake because of painful condition.} - Ba'zi odamlar og'riqli vaziyat tufayli uyg'oq qolishadi.
{r:Walking on the rough ground became painful.} - Dag'al yerda yurish og'riqli bo'lib qoldi.

text: {r:focused}[ˈfoʊkəst] - diqqatli, e'tiborli. Focus(diqqat, e'tibor) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She is more focused now than she was during the last exam.} - U hozir oxirgi imtihondagi paytidan ko'ra ko'proq diqqatli.
{r:There’s less focus in this chaotic environment than in a quiet library.} - Ushbu tartibsiz muhitda tinch kutubxonaga qaraganda kamroq diqqat bor.
{r:A few focused students completed the task much more quickly than their peers.} - Bir nechta diqqatli talabalar vazifani tengdoshlaridan ancha tezroq bajardi.
{r:Actually many people struggle to stay focused longer than a few minutes.} - Aslida ko'p odamlar bir necha daqiqadan ko'proq diqqatni jamlashda qiynaladi.

text: {r:representative}[ˌrɛprɪˈzɛntətɪv] - vakil. Represent so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Farmers have their own representatives in the capital also.} - Fermerlarning poytaxtda ham o'z vakillari bor.
{r:Hameed is our former representative.} - Hamid bizning sobiq vakilimiz.
{r:A few representatives attended the meeting, making the discussion more interesting than before.} - Bir nechta vakillar uchrashuvda qatnashdi, bu esa muhokamani avvalgidan ko'ra qiziqarli qildi.
{r:B.Jalolov, representative of Uzbekistan, from the red corner, won today's match.} - O'zbekiston vakili qizil burchakdan Bahodir Jalolov bugungi o'yinni yutdi.

text: {r:saving}[ˈseɪvɪŋ] – omonat, jamg’arma, siz to’playotgan pul. Bugun O’tkir Yusupov Shimoliy Koreya bilan o’yinda bizning darvozamizga tepilgan penaltini ajoyib seyv bilan qutqardi. O’tkir sen o’z {p:SEYVING} bilan o’yinni eng yaxshi o’yinchisi bo’lding va 40 000$ mukofot puliga ega bo’lding. Bu pullarni {p:SEYFING}ga sol va {h:jamg’armangni} oshirib bor.
examples: {r:This account has more savings than the other one.} - Bu hisobda boshqasiga qaraganda ko'proq jamg'arma bor.
{r:There’s fewer savings left after the vacation.} - Ta'tildan keyin kamroq pul qoldi.
{r:Please, give some guidance about effectively using savings.} - Iltimos omonatlardan oqilona foydalanish bo'yicha yo'l-yo'riq bering.
{r:I will spend my valuable savings on environment.} - Men o'zimning qadrli jamg'armamni atrof-muhitga sarflamoqchiman.

text: {r:honest}[ˈɒnɪst] – halol, to’g’ri. Olisdagi bir o’rmonda anakonda ilonlarning prezidenti ekan. Uning boshqaruvida ilonlar saltanati totuvlikda yashabdi. Rahmdil anakonda duch kelgan ilonni davlat ishiga olaveribdi va mamlakatda muammolar boshlanibdi. Mamlakatdagi tanish bilishchilik, korrupsiyani eplay olmagan {p:AN}akonda {p:IST}efoga chiqibdi. Chunki uning o’zi {h:halol} ilon ekan.
examples: {r:He is more honest than his friends.} - U do'stlaridan ko'ra halolroq.
{r:There’s less honesty in his words than in his actions.} - Uning so'zlarida amallariga qaraganda kamroq halollik bor.
{r:Each religion teaches being honest.} - Har bir din halol bo'lishni o'rgatadi.
{r:Many people value honest communication more than polite lies.} - Ko'p odamlar xushmuomala yolg'onlardan ko'ra halol muloqotni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:dumb}[dʌm] – ahmoq. Men uchun eng {h:ahmoq} odam mana bunday yurib ketayotgan {p:DAM}as ustiga chiqib oladiganlar.
examples: {r:This idea is dumber than it sounds.} - Bu g'oya eshitilganidan ko'ra ahmoqonaroq.
{r:Being dumb has no degree.} - Ahmoq bo'lishning darajasi yo'q.
{r:My dumb friends committed lighter crimes but still were sent to prison.} - Mening ahmoq do'stlarim yengilroq jinoyat qilib qo'yishdi ammo shunda ham qamalishdi.
{r:Many people formerly avoided dumb decisions.} - Ko'p odamlar ilgari ahmoqona qarorlardan o'zini tiyishgan.

text: {r:Desire}[dɪˈzaɪər] – istak, xohish. Dizayn jamoasi ketma ket 3 soat tinmasdan konsert berdi va charchadi. Hozir ularning yagona {h:istagi} bor. Chanqog’ini qondirish uchun {p:Dizay}ndagilar ayron ichishni xohlaydi.
examples: {r:She has a strong desire to learn English.} – Uning ingliz tilini o‘rganishga kuchli istagi bor.
{r:His desire for success motivates him.} – Uning muvaffaqiyatga bo‘lgan xohishi uni ilhomlantiradi.
{r:They had little desire to travel.} – Ularning sayohat qilish istagi kam edi.
{r:Desire can lead to great results.} – Istak katta natijalarga olib kelishi mumkin.

text: {r:protection}[prəˈtɛkʃən] - himoya. Protect(himoya qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Museum visitors are provided with full protection.} - Muzey tashrif buyuruvchilari to'liq himoya bilan ta'minlangan.
{r:The new law gives less protection than it promised.} - Yangi qonun va'da qilinganidek himoya bermaydi.
{r:Her protection is twice as good as mine.} - Uning himoyasi menikidan ikki baravar samarali.
{r:My protection is not as weak as yours.} - Mening himoyam senikidek zaif emas?

text: {r:clever}[ˈklɛvər] - aqlli, ziyrak. Amerikalik yozuvchi Jeyms Gardnerning "{p:KELAVER}, olaver" kitobini olsangiz o'qimasangiz ham kitobning ziyosi sizga tarqalib {h:aqlli} bo'lib ketar ekansiz, odamlarning aytishicha.
examples: {r:Parrots aren't as clever as chimpanzees.} - To'tiqushlar shimpanzelardek aqlli emas.
{r:This robot is three times as smart as humans.} - Bu robot odamlardan uch baravar aqlli.
{r:His plan was less clever than hers.} - Uning rejasi unikiga qaraganda kamroq aqlli edi.
{r:I am not as clever as the professor.} - Men professordek aqlli emasman.

text: {r:ancient}[ˈeɪnʃənt] – qadimgi. Qiziqarli fakt eng {h:qadimgi} telefon {p:EYNSHNT}eynni tengdoshi ekan. Lekin u davrda telefon juda oddiy bo'lgan hozirda esa telefon hamma vazifani bajaradi.
examples: {r:These bones aren't as old as dinosaur fossils.} - Bu suyaklar dinozavr qazilmalaridek qadimiy emas.
{r:The first skyscraper was built in ancient Greece.} - Birinchi osmono'par bino qadimgi Gretsiyada qurilgan.
{r:Eagles are not as ancient as dinosaurs.} - Burgutlar dinozavrlardek qadimiy emas.
{r:The tradition is believed to originate from ancient times.} - Bu an'ana qadimiy davrlardan kelib chiqqan deb hisoblanadi.

text: {r:timely}[ˈtaɪmli] - o'z vaqtida, kechikmasadan. Time(vaqt) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Your response wasn't as timely as needed.} - Javobingiz talab qilinganidek o'z vaqtida emas edi.
{r:We should hold meetings in a timely manner.} - Majlislarni o'z vaqtida o'tkazishimiz kerak.
