{r:Thanks for timely advice.} - O'z vaqtida berilgan maslahat uchun rahmat.
{r:A surgeon made a timely decision.} - Jarroh o'z vaqtida qaror qildi.

text: {r:sweet}[swiːt] – shirin. Shakarqamishdan tola olib kiyim tikish mumkin ekan. Mening ushbu {p:SVIT}erim shakarqamishdan, men uni bir tishlab ko'rishim kerak. Kiyimim {h:shirin} bo'lsa kerak.
examples: {r:These apples aren't as sweet as candy.} - Bu olmalar konfetdek shirin emas.
{r:Honey is three times as sweet as sugar.} - Asal shakarga qaraganda uch baravar shirin.
{r:The dessert was less sweet than expected.} - Shirinlik kutganimizdan kamroq shirin edi.
{r:His sweet smile made him look even more handsome.} - Uning shirin tabassumi uni yanada kelishgan qilib ko'rsatdi.

text: {r:bitter}[ˈbɪtər] – achchiqlangan, g'azablangan; achchiq, bemaza. Agar nimadandir qattiq {h:g'azablansangiz} shunchaki hamma narsani unutingda "{p:Bidir}, bidir, bidir" deb takrorlang. Men bu usulni hind kinosidan o'rganganman.
examples: {r:Black coffee isn't as bitter as dark chocolate.} - Qora kofe achchiq shokoladdek achchiq emas.
{r:He felt bitter after hearing what I experienced in my life.} - U hayotimda nimalarni boshimdan kechirganimni eshitgandan so'ng g'azablandi.
{r:I was shy not bitter.} - Men uyalgandim, g'azablanmagandim.
{r:Is dark chocolate as bitter as people say?} - Qora shokolad odamlar aytganidek achchiqmi?

text: {r:spicy}[ˈspaɪsi] - achchiq. Bu vaziyatda {p:SPAY}dermenning {p:AYS}berg ustida {h:achchiq} qalampirli ovqat yeb o'tirganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:This soup is not as spicy as the last one.} - Bu sho'rva oxirgisi kabi achchiq emas.
{r:The red pepper has the same spicy taste as the green one.} - Qizil qalampir yashil qalampir kabi achchiq ta'mga ega.
{r:I do not eat as much spicy food as my friend.} - Men do'stim kabi ko'p achchiq ovqat yemayman.
{r:This restaurant does not have as many spicy dishes as that one.} - Bu restoranda u restorandagidek ko'p achchiq taomlar yo'q.

text: {r:rot}[rɒt] - chirimoq. Viloyatdan Toshkentgacha 10 marta radarga tushgan aka "{p:RAD}aring {h:chirib} ketsin" deb duo qilibdi.
examples: {r:Wood doesn't rot as fast as cardboard.} - Yog'och kartondek tez chirimaydi.
{r:The fruit here rots at the same speed as the fruit in the city.} - Bu yerdagi meva shahardagi meva kabi tez chiriydi.
{r:We do not have as much rot in our garden as they do.} - Bizning bog'imizda ularnikidek ko'p chirish yo'q.
{r:There are not as many rotten apples in this box as in that one.} - Bu qutida u qutidagidek ko'p chirigan olmalar yo'q.

text: {r:courageous}[kəˈreɪdʒəs] - jasur, mard. Courage so'zidan yasalgan
examples: {r:I'm not as courageous as firefighters.} - Men o't o'chiruvchilar kabi jasur emasman.
{r:His actions showed the same courageous spirit as his father's.} - Uning harakatlari otasinikidek jasur ruhni ko'rsatdi.
{r:He does not have as much courage as his brother.} - Uning akasinikidek ko'p jasorati yo'q.
{r:There are not as many courageous people in this story as in the last one.} - Bu hikoyada oldingi hikoyadagidek ko'p jasur odamlar yo'q.

text: {r:accurate}[ˈækjərət] - aniq, tiniq, akkuratniy.
examples: {r:This clock isn't as accurate as the one in the city center.} - Bu soat shahar markazidagi soat kabi aniq emas.
{r:Her answer is accurate.} - Uning javobi aniq-tiniq.
{r:The machine does not give as accurate data as we need.} - Aparat bizga kerak bo'lganidek ko'p aniq ma'lumot bermaydi.
{r:There are not as many accurate answers in this test as in the last test.} - Bu testda oxirgi testdagidek ko'p aniq javoblar yo'q.

text: {r:sane}[seɪn] - aqli raso, sog'.
examples: {r:His decision wasn't as sane as we hoped.} - Uning qarori biz umid qilganimizdek sog'lom emas edi.
{r:His thoughts are the same sane thoughts as before.} - Uning fikrlari avvalgidek aqli raso fikrlar.
{r:He does not show as much sane behavior as he did last year.} - U o'tgan yilgidek ko'p aqli raso xatti-harakat ko'rsatmayapti.
{r:There are not as many sane people in that place as there are here.} - U joyda bu yerdagidek ko'p aqli raso odamlar yo'q.

text: {r:active}[ˈæktɪv] - faol, aktiv. Bu so'z o'zbek tilida ham keng qo'llaniladi.
examples: {r:This volcano isn't as active as the one in Italy.} - Bu vulkan Italiyadagi vulkan kabi faol emas.
{r:His brother has the same active life as he does.} - Uning akasi u kabi faol hayotga ega.
{r:The small child does not have as much active energy as the older children.} - Kichik bolada katta bolalar kabi ko'p faol energiya yo'q.
{r:There are not as many active dogs in the park today as yesterday.} - Bugun parkda kechagidek ko'p faol itlar yo'q.

text: {r:silent}[ˈsaɪlənt] – jim, sokin, tinch. Shahrimiz markazida ulkan va juda chiroyli saylgohimiz bor. Bu yerda ko'plab it, mushuk va o'rdaklarni ham uchratishingiz mumkin. Qiziqarli tomoni {p:SAYL}gohimiz {p:IT}lari juda yuvosh va {h:sokin}, biror marta akillamaydi ham.
examples: {r:The library wasn't as silent as I hoped.} - Kutubxona umid qilganimdek jim emas edi.
{r:The room is the same silent room as it was last night.} - Xona o'tgan kechagidek jim xona.
{r:The street does not have as much silent time as the garden.} - Ko'cha bog' kabi ko'p jim vaqtga ega emas.
{r:There are not as many silent moments in the city as in the village.} - Shaharda qishloqdagi kabi ko'p sokin lahzalar yo'q.

text: {r:Availability}[əˌveɪləˈbɪləti] – mavjudlik, mavjud bo'lish holati, qulaylik. U odatda biror narsa mavjudmi yoki foydalanish mumkinmi, degan ma'noda ishlatiladi. 1) "Please check the availability of the room." — "Iltimos, xonaning mavjudligini tekshirib ko'ring." 2) "Product availability may vary by store." — "Mahsulotning mavjudligi do'konga qarab farq qilishi mumkin." 3) "His availability for the meeting is uncertain." — "Uning uchrashuvda ishtirok eta olishi noma'lum." 4) "Internet availability is important in remote areas." — "Olis hududlarda internetning mavjudligi muhim."
examples: {r:The tickets weren't as available as last year.} - Chiptalar o'tgan yilgidek mavjud emas edi.
{r:There are not as many available rooms in this hotel as in that one.} - Bu mehmonxonada u mehmonxonadagidek ko'p bo'sh xonalar yo'q.
{r:The availability of books increased my desire to read.} – Kitoblarning mavjudligi mening o‘qish istagimni oshirdi.

text: {r:exceptional}[ɪkˈsɛpʃənl] - qoyilmaqom, ajoyib.
examples: {r:Her skills aren't as exceptional as we thought.} - Uning ko'nikmalari biz o'ylagandek ajoyib emas.
{r:His work has the same exceptional quality as his brother's.} - Uning ishi akasiniki kabi ajoyib sifatga ega.
{r:The student does not show as much exceptional talent as the teacher hoped.} - Talaba o'qituvchi umid qilganidek ko'p ajoyib iste'dod ko'rsatmayapti.
{r:There are not as many exceptional stories in this book as in that one.} - Bu kitobda u kitobdagidek ko'p ajoyib hikoyalar yo'q.

text: {r:quality}[ˈkwɒləti] – sifat; sifatli. Mana bugun {p:kval}dani {p:iti}ni oldim. Hozirgi kunda ''iti'' degani ''sifatlisi'' degani.
examples: {r:The copy isn't as good quality as the original.} - Nusxa asliga qadar sifatli emas.
{r:This new phone has the same quality as my old one.} - Bu yangi telefon mening eskisi kabi sifatga ega.
{r:The small table does not have as much quality as the big table.} - Kichik stol katta stol kabi ko'p sifatga ega emas.
{r:Their clothes do not have as many quality parts as ours.} - Ularning kiyimlarida sifatli qismlar biznikidagidek ko'p emas.

text: {r:rat}[ræt] – kalamush. Taxminan 15 yillar oldin kolbasalarning zavoddagi {p:RET}septi quyidagicha bo'lardi: {h:kalamush}, chesnok, loviya, ozgina go'sht, ziravorlar. Yoshi 25 dan o'tgan avlod bu gapimni tasdiqlaydi.
examples: {r:Lab rats aren't as smart as wild rats.} - Laboratoriya kalamushlari yovvoyi kalamushlar kabi aqlli emas.
{r:This rat is the same size as the one I saw yesterday.} - Bu kalamush kecha ko'rganim kabi katta.
{r:The old house does not have as many rats as the new one.} - Eski uyda yangisidagidek ko'p kalamush yo'q.
{r:There is not as much food for rats in this house as in the old one.} - Bu uyda eski uydagidek ko'p kalamushlar uchun ovqat yo'q.

text: {r:identify}[aɪˈdɛntɪfaɪ] - aniqlamoq. Tasavvur qiling siz tanigan {p:OYDIN TUFLI}ni hididan yaxshi-yomonligini {h:aniqlay} oladi.
examples: {r:This app can identify its owner's face.} - Bu telefon o'z egasining yuzini aniqlay oladi.
{r:The problem has the same way to identify as the last one.} - Muammo oxirgisi kabi aniqlash usuliga ega.
{r:We do not have as much information to identify the criminal as we need.} - Bizda jinoyatchini aniqlash uchun kerak bo'lganidek ko'p ma'lumot yo'q.
{r:There are not as many ways to identify the animal as they say.} - Hayvonni aniqlash uchun ular aytgandek ko'p usullar yo'q.

text: {r:pressure}[ˈprɛʃər] – bosim. Rossiyaning oldingi prezidenti Boris Yelsinni eslaysizmi? Ko'pincha katta majlislarga ham, boshqa davlat rahbarlari bilan uchrashuvlarga ham {p:prez}ident {p:shir}akayf bo'lib kelardi. Keyinchalik uning bu lavozimdan ketishi uchun siyosatchilar {h:bosim} qila boshladi.
examples: {r:He is under pressure.} - U bosim ostida.
{r:The water pressure is the same as it was last week.} - Suv bosimi o'tgan haftadagidek.
{r:The small bag is not under as much pressure as the big bag.} - Kichik sumka katta sumka kabi bosim ostida emas.
{r:There are not as many pressure points in this machine as in the old one.} - Bu mashinada eski mashinadagidek ko'p bosim nuqtalari yo'q.

text: {r:prepare}[prɪˈpɛər] – tayyorlamoq, hozirlamoq. Mana bu {p:PREP}aratga {p:AYR}on qo'shib {h:tayyorlasangiz} burun oqishi shu zahoti to'xtaydi.
examples: {r:I am preparing for the exam.} - Men imtihonga tayyorlanayapman.
{r:Home food isn't as well prepared as restaurant food.} - Uy ovqati restoran ovqati kabi yaxshi tayyorlanmagan.
{r:The chef does not have as much preparation time as he needs.} - Oshpazda kerak bo'lganidek ko'p tayyorgarlik vaqti yo'q.
{r:There are not as many prepared meals in the shop today as yesterday.} - Bugun do'konda kechagidek ko'p tayyor ovqatlar yo'q.

text: {r:establish}[ɪˈstæblɪʃ] – asos solish, yo'lga qo'yish. Bilasizmi qaysidir biznesga {h:asos solish} uchun avvalo o'zingizni {p:ISTE}dodingizni {p:BILISH}ingiz kerak. Agar sizga tozalash yoqsa xonadonlarni tozalab beruvchi biznesga, agar o'rgatish yoqsa repetitorlik qilib keyinroq o'quv markaziga asos solishingiz kerak.
examples: {r:We need to establish new rules for the team.} - Biz jamoa uchun yangi qoidalar o'rnatishimiz kerak.
{r:The company plans to establish its largest office in the city next year.} - Kompaniya kelasi yili shahardagi eng katta ofisini ochishni rejalashtirmoqda.
{r:It's important to establish good habits early in life.} - Hayotda erta yaxshi odatlarni shakllantirish muhim.
{r:They hope to establish the most lasting peace in the region.} - Ular mintaqada eng barqaror tinchlikni o'rnatishga umid qilmoqdalar.

text: {r:whatever}[wɒtˈɛvər] – nima bo'lsa ham. Dunyodagi eng baland cho'qqi Everestni zabt etish juda mashaqqatli. Atigi 50 davlat fuqarolari bu tog'ni zabt etishgan. 1990 yillarda O'zbekistonlik Sergey ham bu qiyin vazifani bajarishga kirishdi. U barcha qiyinchiklarga qaramay ''{p:Vat}an uchun {p:ever}estni zabt etaman {h:nima bo'lsa ham}'' dedi va buni uddaladi.
examples: {r:Take whatever you need from the box.} - Qutidan o'zingizga kerakli nimani bo'lsa ham oling.
{r:Whatever happens, we will stay together.} - Nima bo'lsa ham, biz birga qolamiz.
{r:He eats whatever food is put in front of him.} - U oldiga qo'yilgan har qanday ovqatni yeydi.
{r:I set a goal to learn English, whatever happens.} – Men ingliz tilini o‘rganishni maqsad qildim, nima bo‘lishidan qat’i nazar.

text: {r:whenever}[wɛnˈɛvər] - qachonki.
examples: {r:Call me whenever you're ready.} - Qachon tayyor bo'lsangiz, menga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
{r:I fall in love whenever I see her smile} – Uning tabassumini ko‘rsam, har safar sevib qolaman.
{r:You can visit us whenever you like.} - Istagan vaqtingizda biznikiga tashrif buyurishingiz mumkin.
{r:Call me whenever you finish the job correctly.} - Qachonki ishni to'g'ri tugatsang meni chaqir.

text: {r:particular}[pərˈtɪkjələr] - aynan, ma'lum, o'ziga xos, muayyan. Kanareyka qushining aynan bir ajoyib noyob qobiliyati bor. Hamma qushlar yuzi bilan kulsa kanareykani {h:aynan} {p:PATI KULAR}.
examples: {r:What color do you want in particular?} - Aynan qaysi rangni xohlaysiz?
{r:There is not any particular reason.} - Hech qanday o'ziga xos sabab yo'q.
{r:We should identify a particular issue that he is facing.} - Biz aynan u duch kelayotgan muammoni aniqlashimiz kerak.
{r:He has a particular way of solving the hardest problems.} - U eng qiyin muammolarni hal qilishning o'ziga xos usuliga ega.

text: {r:indicate}[ˈɪndɪkeɪt] – ko'rsatmoq, bildirmoq. Indira Miftaxova komiklikdan ketib, endi boshqa sohada bloggerlik qilyapti, qishloq xo'jaligida. Kechagi videosida {p:Indi}ra {p:ket}mon chopishni {h:ko'rsatdi}.
examples: {r:The signs indicate a sharp turn ahead.} - Belgilar oldinda o'tkir burilish borligini ko'rsatmoqda.
{r:His silence may indicate disagreement.} - Uning sukut saqlashi norozilikni bildirishi mumkin.
{r:Studies indicate that exercise is the best for health.} - Tadqiqotlar jismoniy mashqlar sog'liq uchun eng foydali ekanligini ko'rsatadi.
{r:The meter indicates the water level.} - Hisoblagich suv sathini ko'rsatadi.
{r:His tone of voice can indicate emphasis on certain words.} - Uning ovoz ohangi ma'lum so'zlarga urg'u berganligini ko'rsatdi.

text: {r:staff}[stæf] – xodimlar. Bunyodkor stadionida futbol o'yinlari endi kulgiga boy bo'ladi. {p:Sta}dion {p:af}andini ishga oldi sharhlovchi {h:xodim} sifatida.
examples: {r:The hotel staff was very helpful.} - Mehmonxona xodimlari juda yordamga shay edi.
{r:We have the most experienced staff in the company.} - Bizda kompaniyadagi eng tajribali xodimlar bor.
{r:All staff must attend the training session.} - Barcha xodimlar treningga qatnashishi shart.
{r:Firstly our staff are experienced, secondly they have been with us for 10 years.} - Birinchidan xodimlarimiz tajribali, ikkinchidan ular 10 yildan beri biz bilan.

text: {r:harsh}[hɑːrʃ] – qattiq, keskin, qo'pol, yoqimsiz, dag'al. {p:Qarish} bu eng {h:yoqimsiz} jarayonlardan biri. Ajinlaring ko'payib yuz terisi dag'allashib ketadi.
examples: {r:The desert has a harsh climate.} - Sahroda keskin iqlim bor.
{r:His words were harsh, but true.} - Uning so'zlari qattiq edi, lekin rost.
{r:They faced the harshest criticism for their decision.} - Ular o'z qarorlari uchun eng qattiq tanqidga uchradilar.
{r:Avoid using harsh chemicals on your skin.} - Teringizga qo'pol kimyoviy moddalarni ishlatishdan saqlaning.
{r:His rough voice had a harsh tone.} - Uning dag'al ovozi qo'pol ohangga ega edi.

text: {r:bald}[bɔːld] - kal. Fransiyada {h:kal}likning eng antiqa davosi topildi. Mana bu {p:BOLT}larni kallangizga skoch bilan yopishtirib olasiz va boltdagi foydali vitaminlar sizning boshingizga o'tib soch o'sishni boshlaydi.
examples: {r:My uncle started to go bald in his twenties.} - Amakim yigirmalari o'rtalarida kal bo'la boshladi.
{r:The bald seller used to sell pictures.} - Kal sotuvchi rasmlar sotardi.
{r:He tried to hide his bald spot with a hat.} - U shlyapa bilan kal joyini yashirishga harakat qildi.
{r:The baldest areas on his head grew fastest.} - Uning boshidagi eng kal joylar eng tez o'sdi.

text: {r:slim}[slɪm] - ingichka, nozik, oriq. Bu vaziyatda o'zingiz tanigan {p:Salim} ismli insonni juda ham {h:oriqlab} ketganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:She has a very slim figure.} - U juda ingichka qomatga ega.
{r:The chance of success is very slim.} - Muvaffaqiyat qozonish imkoniyati juda kam.
{r:He wore the slimmest suit to the party.} - U bazmga eng ingichka kostyum kiyib bordi.
{r:The new phone has the slimmest design available.} - Yangi telefon mavjud bo'lgan eng ingichka dizaynga ega.

text: {r:elegant}[ˈɛlɪɡənt] – go'zal, kelishgan, maftunkor. Mana bu gantellar orasida {p:ELIG}li {p:GANT}el eng {h:maftunkor} va chiroyli dizaynga ega ekan.
examples: {r:She wore an elegant dress to the ball.} - U balga nafis ko'ylak kiyib bordi.
{r:The old building formerly had the most elegant design in the city.} - Eski bino ilgari shahardagi eng nafis dizaynga ega edi.
{r:He made an elegant speech at the event.} - U tadbirda nafis nutq so'zladi.
{r:The dancer moved with the most elegant steps.} - Raqqosa eng nafis qadamlar bilan harakat qildi.
{r:He looked very handsome in his elegant suit.} - U o'zining nafis kostyumida juda kelishgan ko'rinar edi.

text: {r:plain}[pleɪn] - oddiy. Agar sotib olmoqchi bo'lsangiz eng {h:oddiy} {p:PLYON}kani oling. Plyonka million yilda ham chirimaydi.
examples: {r:I have a plain solution to the current chaos.} - Menda hozirgi tartibsizlikka oddiy yechim bor.
{r:Generally speaking the truth was plain to see.} - Umuman olganda haqiqatni ko'rish oson edi.
{r:He lives in the plainest, simplest house possible.} - U mumkin bo'lgan eng oddiy, eng sodda uyda yashaydi.
{r:The instructions were written in the plainest language for everyone.} - Ko'rsatmalar hamma uchun eng oddiy tilda yozilgan edi.

text: {r:fancy}[ˈfænsi] - chiroyli, ajoyib; xohlamoq, orzu qilmoq; fantaziya. {p:FENSI} ichimligi dasturxonimizdagi eng {h:ajoyib} va maftunkor ne'mat. Men har kuni FENSI ichishni xohlayman.
examples: {r:They went to a fancy restaurant for dinner.} - Ular kechki ovqatga chiroyli restoranga borishdi.
{r:Do you fancy going for a walk?} - Sayrga borishni xohlaysizmi?
{r:She has the fanciest hat I have ever seen.} - Unda men ko'rgan eng chiroyli shlyapa bor.
{r:He drives a very fancy car.} - U juda chiroyli mashina haydaydi.

text: {r:spot}[spɒt] – dog, iz; joy; sezmoq. {p:Spot}ify ilovasi orqali qo'shiq eshitib, kofe ichmoqchi edim. Lekin ilovada paydo bo'lgan birinchi qo'shiq meni cho'chitib yubordi va kofeni qo'limdan tushirib yubordim. Kiyimlarim esa {h:dog'} bo'ldi.
examples: {r:I saw a spot of paint on the carpet.} - Gilamda bir dog' bo'yoq ko'rdim.
{r:This is the best spot for a picnic.} - Bu sayr qilish uchun eng zo'r joy.
{r:Can you spot the difference between the two pictures?} - Ikki rasm orasidagi farqni topa olasizmi?
{r:He found the cleanest spot on the entire floor.} - U butun polda eng toza joyni topdi.

text: {r:van}[væn] – furgon. Tasavvur qiling sizning eski {p:VEN}tilyatoringiz ustida sichqonlar o'zlarining kichkinagina {h:furgonini} haydab ketayapti.
examples: {r:They delivered the furniture in a large van.} - Ular mebellarni katta furgonda yetkazib berishdi.
{r:By chance, their van stopped near my house.} – Tasodifan ularning furgoni mening uyim yonida to‘xtadi.
{r:We rented a van to move our things.} - Biz narsalarimizni ko'chirish uchun furgon ijaraga oldik.
{r:This new van is the fastest one they own.} - Bu yangi furgon ularda mavjud bo'lgan eng tezidir.

text: {r:approach}[əˈproʊtʃ] - yaqinlashmoq. O'tgan darslarning birida bu so'zning 'yondashuv', 'metodika' ma'nolarini o'rgangan edingiz. Bugun esa quyidagi misollar orqali yana bir asosiy ma'nosidan boxabar bo'lasiz.
examples: {r:She carefully approached the wild animal.} - U ehtiyotkorlik bilan yovvoyi hayvonga yaqinlashdi.
{r:He approached the door and knocked.} - U eshik tomon yaqinlashdi va taqillatdi.
{r:They approached the mountain peak after hours of climbing.} - Ular soatlab ko'tarilgandan so'ng tog' cho'qqisiga yaqinlashdi.
{r:The train is approaching the station.} - Poyezd stansiyaga yaqinlashmoqda.

text: {r:preparation}[ˌprɛpəˈreɪʃən] - tayyorgarlik, tayyorlash. Prepare(tayyorlamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:We need to make careful preparation for the exam.} - Imtihonga puxta tayyorgarlik ko'rishimiz kerak.
{r:You should probably make preparations for global hunger.} - Ehtimol global ochlikka tayyorgarlik ko'rib qo'yishingiz kerakdir.
{r:His preparation for the speech was super.} - Uning nutqi uchun tayyorgarligi a'lo darajada edi.
{r:Good preparation is the key to the greatest success.} - Yaxshi tayyorgarlik eng katta muvaffaqiyatning kalitidir.

text: {r:dusty}[ˈdʌsti] - changli. Dust(chang) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The old books on the shelf were very dusty.} - Javondagi eski kitoblar juda changli edi.
{r:We drove along a dusty road.} - Biz changli yo'l bo'ylab yurib keldik.
{r:Our teacher had no idea how dusty the classroom was.} - O'qituvchi sinfxona qanchalik chang bo'lib ketganini bilmasdi.
{r:He wiped the dusty table with a cloth.} - U changli stolni latta bilan artdi.

text: {r:optimistic}[ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk] - optimistik
examples: {r:She is always optimistic about the future.} - U kelajak haqida doim optimistik.
{r:You certainly look needy not optimistic.} - Sen aniq muhtojdek ko'rinayapsan optimistik emas.
{r:The translator looks optimistic.} - Tarjimon optimist ko'rindi.
{r:The team leader is the most optimistic person in the group.} - Jamoa rahbari guruhdagi eng optimistik odam.

text: {r:affection}[əˈfɛkʃən] - mehr.
examples: {r:She showed great affection for her grandchildren.} - U nabiralariga katta mehr ko'rsatdi.
{r:Dogs often show affection by licking.} - Itlar ko'pincha yalab mehr ko'rsatadilar.
{r:His words of affection warmed her heart.} - Uning mehrli so'zlari uning qalbini isitdi.
{r:Women need the most affection when they are pregnant.} - Ayollarga eng ko'p mehr homiladorlik payti kerak.

text: {r:pride}[praɪd] – g'urur. Sizning hayotda eng {h:g'ururlanadigan} mulkingiz bu siz yaqinda sotib olgan {p:PRAD}o mashinasi. Bu mashina nafaqat yo'llarda yura oladi balki qanot yozib osmonda ham uchish salohiyatiga ega.
examples: {r:He takes great pride in his work.} - U o'z ishidan juda faxrlanadi.
{r:The team played with pride and determination.} - Jamoa g'urur va qat'iyat bilan o'ynadi.
{r:She felt the most pride after finishing the marathon.} - Marafonni tugatgandan so'ng u eng katta faxrni his qildi.
{r:Pride can sometimes lead to downfall.} - G'urur ba'zan halokatga olib kelishi mumkin.

text: {r:least}[liːst] – eng kam. Mana bu {p:list}da {h:eng kam} ta'minlangan oilalar ro'yxati berilgan. O'ng tarafda esa ularga davlat tarafdan nimalar berilishi.
examples: {r:This method is the least effective of all options.} - Bu usul barcha variantlar orasida eng kam samaralisi.
{r:She chose the least expensive dress in the store.} - U do'kondagi eng arzon ko'ylakni tanladi.
{r:February has the least rainfall in this region.} - Fevral bu hududda eng kam yog'ingarchilik bo'ladi.
{r:He got the least attention during the presentation.} - U prezentatsiya paytida eng kam e'tiborga sazovor bo'ldi.

text: {r:Dignity} [ˈdɪɡnəti] – g’urur, qadr-qimmat. Titanik filmini suratga olish chog’ida {p:DIK}aprioning {p:ITI} Keytning orqasidan tishlab olib {h:g’ururini} toptadi.
examples: {r:He handled the situation with great dignity.} - U vaziyatni katta g'urur bilan boshqardi.
{r:Every person should have enough dignity to stand up for themselves.} - Har bir inson o'zi uchun kurashishga yetarli g'ururga ega bo'lishi kerak.
{r:There was not enough dignity in his actions.} - Uning harakatlarida yetarli g'urur yo'q edi.
{r:We must protect the dignity of all individuals.} - Biz barcha shaxslarning qadr-qimmatini himoya qilishimiz shart.

text: {r:Sufficient} [səˈfɪʃənt] – yetarli, yetadigan. Onamga aytdim bu yil kuzga menga ishton sotib olish shart emas. O’tgan yildan qolgan ishtonlarim {h:yetarli}, toza {p:SOF ISHTON}lar.
examples: {r:Do you have sufficient time to finish the work?} - Ishni tugatish uchun sizda yetarli vaqt bormi?
{r:The food should be sufficient for everyone.} - Ovqat hamma uchun yetarli bo'lishi kerak.
{r:They did not provide sufficient evidence to prove their case.} - Ular o'z ishlarini isbotlash uchun yetarli dalil keltira olmadilar.
{r:We have received sufficient funds for the project.} - Biz loyiha uchun yetarli mablag' oldik.

text: {r:Stuff} [stʌf] - narsa(lar). Ko'pchilik qimorbozlar futbolga {p:STAF}ka qilyapti, yutqazyapti, hamma {h:narsasini} sotib yana stafka qilyapti va hech vaqosiz qolishyapti.
examples: {r:I really have too much stuff in my room.} - Xonamda haqiqatdan juda ko'p narsalar bor.
{r:You should pack enough stuff for a week.} - Siz bir hafta uchun yetarli narsalarni yig'ishingiz kerak.
{r:They don't have enough stuff to start a business.} - Ularda biznes boshlash uchun yetarli narsalar yo'q.
{r:What kind of stuff do you need for the trip?} - Sayohat uchun qanday narsalar kerak?

text: {r:Amount} [əˈmaʊnt] – miqdor, son. Tasavvur qiling buvangizning yuzlab farzandlari bo’lgan. Shuning uchun ko’p amaki va ammalaringizni tanimaysiz, ba’zan {p:AMMA}laringizni {p:UNT}ib qo’yasiz {h:nechtaligini}.
examples: {r:A small amount of rain fell last night.} - Kecha kechqurun oz miqdorda yomg'ir yog'di.
{r:You need a large amount of courage to do that.} - Buning uchun sizga katta miqdorda jasorat kerak.
{r:We don't have enough amount of food for everyone.} - Bizda hamma uchun yetarli miqdorda ovqat yo'q.
{r:What amount of money do you have?} - Sizda qancha pul bor?

text: {r:Training} [ˈtreɪnɪŋ] - trening, o'quv mashg'uloti.
examples: {r:The new employees must complete their training.} - Yangi xodimlar o'z treninglarini tugatishlari shart.
{r:Is this training long enough to cover all topics?} - Bu trening barcha mavzularni qamrab olish uchun yetarlicha uzunmi?
{r:Her desire to improve grew after the training.} – Treningdan keyin uning yaxshilanish istagi kuchaydi.
{r:Good training is necessary for safety.} - Yaxshi trening xavfsizlik uchun juda muhim.

text: {r:Sweetness} [ˈswiːtnəs] - shirinlik(shirin ekanlik, yeydigan shirinlik emas). Sweet(shirin) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The sweetness of the fruit was perfect.} - Mevaning shirinligi mukammal edi.
{r:This tea has enough sweetness for me.} - Bu choy men uchun yetarli shirinlikka ega.
{r:There isn't enough sweetness in this cake.} - Bu tortda yetarli shirinlik yo'q.
{r:Julia appreciated the sweetness of his words.} - Julia uning so'zlarining shirinligini qadrladi.

text: {r:Trade} [treɪd] – savdo;savdolashmoq. {p:T}oshkentda {p:REYD} bo’lyapti. Agar ko'chada litsenziyasiz nimadir sotayotgan bo'lsangiz sizni militsiya xodimlari olib ketishi mumkin. Ba’zi uddaburon akalar olib ketmasliklari uchun {h:savdolashib} bir-ikki so’m berib qutulib ketayapti.
examples: {r:International trade helps many countries.} - Xalqaro savdo ko'plab mamlakatlarga yordam beradi.
{r:They tried to trade their old car for a new one.} - Ular eski mashinalarini yangisiga almashtirishga harakat qilishdi.
{r:Is there enough trade between these two cities?} - Bu ikki shahar o'rtasida yetarli savdo bormi?
{r:We must learn how to trade fairly.} - Biz adolatli savdo qilishni o'rganishimiz shart.

text: {r:Election} [ɪˈlekʃən] - saylov. Elect(saylamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The election results will be announced tomorrow.} - Saylov natijalari ertaga e'lon qilinadi.
{r:The election committee expects all candidates to cooperate during the interview process.} - Saylov qo'mitasi barcha nomzodlardan intervyu jarayonida hamkorlik qilishlarini kutadi.
{r:We have seen enough elections to know how they work.} - Biz yetarli saylovlarni ko'rganmiz va ularni qanday ishlashini bilamiz.
{r:The next election is very important for the country.} - Keyingi saylov mamlakat uchun juda muhim.
{r:The people elected leaders to govern their new government.} - Xalq o'z yangi hukumatini boshqarish uchun rahbarlarni sayladi.

text: {r:Massage} [ˈmæsɑːʒ] - massaj; massaj qilmoq.
examples: {r:Ideally, I will get a good massage after work.} - Massajni ishdan keyin olsam idealniy bo'lar edi.
{r:Did you have enough time for a massage?} - Massaj uchun sizda yetarli vaqt bormidi?
{r:She knows how to massage tense muscles well.} - U tarang mushaklarni yaxshi massaj qilishni biladi.
{r:A daily massage can be very relaxing.} - Har kuni massaj qilish juda zavqli bo'lishi mumkin.

text: {r:Analysis} [əˈnæləsɪs] - analiz, tahlil.
examples: {r:The team presented a detailed analysis of the data.} - Jamoa ma'lumotlarning batafsil tahlilini taqdim etdi.
{r:We need to do enough analysis before making a decision.} - Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin biz yetarli tahlil qilishimiz kerak.
{r:Is your analysis complete enough?} - Sizning tahlilingiz yetarlicha to'liqmi?
{r:The report included a thorough analysis of the market.} - Hisobot bozorning chuqur tahlilini o'z ichiga olgan.
{r:The research paper will consist of a detailed analysis of the data.} - Tadqiqot ishi ma'lumotlarning batafsil tahlilidan iborat bo'ladi.

text: {r:Benefit} [ˈbenɪfɪt] – foyda; foyda ko'rmoq. Benom guruhi ijodkorlari fitness zaliga qatnayapti. Ko’rinib turibdi {p:BEN}omga {p:FIT}nessni foydasi bo'lyapti, ikkalasi ham baquvvatlashib qolibdi.
examples: {r:Exercise has many benefits for your health.} - Jismoniy mashqlar sog'ligingiz uchun ko'plab foydalarga ega.
{r:We should all benefit from this new policy.} - Hammamiz bu yangi siyosatdan foyda ko'rishimiz kerak.
{r:The thick book gave the couple great benefit} – Qalin kitob juftlikka katta foyda berdi.
{r:You must consider the long-term benefits.} - Siz uzoq muddatli foydalarni hisobga olishingiz shart.
{r:Nobody benefited from this marriage.} - Bu nikohdan hech kim foyda ko'rmadi.

text: {r:Forward} [ˈfɔːrwərd] - oldinga, old, yetakchi. Agar {p:Garvard}ga o'qishga kirsangiz bu hayotingizdagi katta {h:oldinga} tashlangan qadam bo'ladi.
examples: {r:Please step forward and introduce yourself.} - Iltimos, oldinga chiqing va o'zingizni tanishtiring.
{r:We must move forward with this project.} - Biz bu loyiha bilan oldinga siljishimiz shart.
{r:We should look forward.} - Biz oldinga qarashimiz kerak.
{r:They went forward.} - Ular oldinga yurishdi.

text: {r:Skill} [skɪl] – mahorat, qobiliyat. Bobom qishloqda uzoq yillar sigir boqqan. Shuning uchun {p:s}igirni {p:kil}osini bitta qarashda aytib berardi. Juda ajoyib {h:mahorati} bor edi.
examples: {r:Learning a new language requires skill.} - Yangi til o'rganish mahorat talab qiladi.
{r:Do you have enough skill to fix this computer?} - Bu kompyuterni tuzatish uchun sizda yetarli mahorat bormi?
{r:Practice helps to improve your skills.} - Mashq qilish mahoratingizni oshirishga yordam beradi.
{r:He should develop his writing skills more.} - U o'zining yozish mahoratini ko'proq rivojlantirishi kerak.

text: {r:Practice} [ˈpræktɪs] - amaliyot, praktika; shug'ullanmoq, amalda bajarmoq, qilmoq.
examples: {r:Daily practice is necessary for learning music.} - Har kuni mashq qilish musiqani o'rganish uchun juda muhim.
{r:You must practice if you want to get better.} - Agar yaxshiroq bo'lishni istasangiz, mashq qilishingiz shart.
{r:Practice English if you want to learn.} - Ingliz tili bilan shug'ullan agar yaxshiroq o'rganmoqchi bo'lsang.
{r:We have had enough practice for the show.} - Biz shou uchun yetarli mashq qildik.
{r:Practice makes perfect.} - Amaliyot mukammallikka yetaklaydi.

text: {r:Politician} [ˌpɑːləˈtɪʃən] - siyosatchi, politik. Politics(siyosat) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The politician gave a long speech.} - Siyosatchi uzoq nutq so'zladi.
{r:We need to identify all evidence related to the case with a politician.} - Biz siyosatchi ishiga aloqador barcha dalillarni aniqlashimiz kerak.
{r:A good politician should listen to the people.} - Yaxshi siyosatchi odamlarni tinglashi kerak.
{r:Many people are critical of politicians today.} - Ko'p odamlar bugungi siyosatchilarni tanqid qilishadi.
{r:Every politician hopes to have a strong and active follower base.} - Har bir siyosatchi kuchli va faol izdoshlar bazasiga ega bo'lishni orzu qiladi.

text: {r:Ripe} [raɪp] - pishgan, yetilgan. Agar xom pomidorni {p:RAY}hon shoxchalari bilan o'rab qo'ysa uzilgan {p:P}omidor ham {h:pishib} qolar ekan.
examples: {r:The apples are ripe enough.} - Olmalar yetarlicha pishgan.
{r:Is this fruit ripe enough for the cake?} - Bu meva tort uchun yetarlicha pishganmi?
{r:We must pick the ripe tomatoes today.} - Biz bugun pishgan pomidorlarni terib olishimiz shart.
{r:The time is ripe for big changes.} - Katta o'zgarishlar uchun vaqt pishgan.

text: {r:Complicated} [ˈkɑːmplɪkeɪtɪd] – murakkab. Juda chiroyli idishlar {p:KOMPLEKT}ini sotib oldingiz. Lekin u yoqqa burab bu yoqqa burab ham ocholmayapsiz. Ustidagi selofani hech qanaqasiga yirtilmayapti. Komplektni ochish juda {h:murakkab} bo'lyapti va oxiri uni yoqishga qaror qildingiz. Ustidagi qoplami yonib ketib chinni idishlarni o’zi qoldi.
examples: {r:The problem is very complicated.} - Muammo juda murakkab.
{r:This instruction is not simple enough; it's too complicated.} - Bu ko'rsatma yetarlicha oddiy emas; u juda murakkab.
{r:The students took notes because the lesson was complicated.} – Talabalar dars murakkab bo‘lgani uchun eslatmalar yozib bordilar.
{r:The project has become more complicated over time.} - Loyiha vaqt o'tishi bilan yanada murakkablashdi.

text: {r:Spacious} [ˈspeɪʃəs] - keng(xona va uylarga nisbatan). Bizning mehmonxonamizga davlat xizmatchilari joylashtirildi. Yaqin atrofdagi tadbir uchun jo'natilgan davlat xodimlari uchun davlat byudjetidan pul o'tkazib berildi. Eng {h:keng} va shinam xonalar {p:SPETSNAZ} xodimlariga berildi.
examples: {r:The new apartment has a high ceiling, making the room feel more spacious.} - Yangi kvartira baland shiftga ega bo'lib, xonani yanada kengroq his qildiradi.
{r:Is this apartment spacious enough for your family?} - Bu kvartira oilangiz uchun yetarlicha kengmi?
{r:They prefer a house with a spacious garden.} - Ular keng bog'li uyni afzal ko'rishadi.
{r:The spacious rooms are mostly on the top floor.} - Keng xonalar asosan yuqori qavatda joylashgan.

text: {r:Laugh} [læf] – kulmoq, jilmaymoq. Mana bu men va ayolimning to’yimizda olingan {p:LAF} storimiz. Bu videoni ko’rib hamma ustimizdan {h:kuldi}.
examples: {r:He began to laugh loudly.} - U baland ovozda kula boshladi.
{r:Her joke made everyone laugh.} - Uning hazili hammani kuldirdi.
{r:Is your joke funny enough to make us all laugh?} - Sizning hazilingiz hammamizni kuldirish uchun yetarlicha kulgilimi?
{r:We should laugh more often.} - Biz tez-tez ko'proq kulishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Abundant} [əˈbʌndənt] - mo'l, serhosil, serob. Men yozuvchilik faoliyatim davomida asarlarim hech mashhur bo'lmagan edi. Lekin bu yil yozgan '{p:E BANDIT}' nomli detektiv asarim bir million nusxada sotildi va mening daromadim {h:serob} bo'ldi.
examples: {r:Additionally, fish are abundant in this lake.} - Bundan tashqari bu ko'lda baliqlar mo'l.
{r:The harvest was so abundant this year.} - Bu yil hosil juda mo'l bo'ldi.
{r:Do we have abundant resources for the next year?} - Keyingi yil uchun bizda yetarlicha mo'l resurslar bormi?
{r:Water is not always abundant in the desert.} - Cho'lda suv har doim ham mo'l emas.

text: {r:Dishonest} [dɪsˈɑːnəst] - nohalol, halol emas, noto'g'ri. Honest(halol) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:He is too dishonest to be trusted.} - U ishonish uchun juda nohalol.
{r:There was too little evidence to prove he was dishonest for the crime.} - Uning jinoyat uchun nohalol ekanligini isbotlash uchun juda kam dalil bor edi.
{r:Both his actions and words were too dishonest.} - Uning ham harakatlari, ham so'zlari juda noto'g'ri edi.
{r:Many people should avoid dishonest individuals.} - Ko'p odamlar egri odamlardan qochishlari kerak.

text: {r:Careless} [ˈkeərləs] - e'tiborsiz, ehtiyotsiz. Care(e'tibor) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:The waiter is too careless to handle the task.} - Ofitsiant vazifani bajarish uchun juda ehtiyotsiz.
{r:There was too little attention to detail in his careless work.} - Uning ehtiyotsiz ishida tafsilotlarga juda kam e'tibor bor edi.
{r:A few careless mistakes were too costly for the company.} - Bir nechta ehtiyotsiz xatolar kompaniya uchun juda qimmatga tushdi.
{r:The careless viewer cheered loudly during the race.} - Ehtiyotsiz tomoshabin poyga davomida baland ovozda qichqirdi.

text: {r:Similarly} [ˈsɪmələrli] so‘zi o‘zbek tilida "xuddi shunday", "xuddi shuningdek", "o‘xshash tarzda" degan ma’nolarni anglatadi. Bu so‘z ikkita narsa yoki vaziyat bir-biriga o‘xshash ekanligini ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi. Masalan: 1) "She speaks English fluently. Similarly, her brother is very good at languages." — "U ingliz tilida ravon gapiradi. Xuddi shuningdek, uning akasi ham tillarni juda yaxshi biladi." 2) "Many students find math difficult. Similarly, physics can also be challenging." — "Ko‘p talabalar matematika qiyin deb hisoblaydi. Xuddi shunday, fizika ham qiyin bo‘lishi mumkin." 3) "This city is very crowded. Similarly, the neighboring city has a large population." — "Bu shahar juda gavjum. Xuddi shunday, qo‘shni shaharning ham aholisi ko‘p." Xulosa: "Similarly" — biror narsani boshqa bir o‘xshash holat bilan taqqoslash yoki bog‘lash uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:Similarly, this solution isn’t effective enough.} - Xuddi shunday, bu yechim yetarlicha samarali emas.
{r:There was too little difference between the two similarly designed products.} - Ikkita o'xshash dizayndagi mahsulot o'rtasida juda kam farq bor edi.

text: {r:Popularity} [ˌpɑːpjəˈlærəti] - mashhurlik. Popular(mashhur) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:This app is certainly too unpopular to compete with others.} - Bu ilova albatta boshqalar bilan raqobatlashish uchun juda nomashhur.
{r:There was too little popularity for this new trend.} - Ushbu yangi trend uchun juda kam mashhurlik bor edi.
{r:Sensible people really don't want popularity.} - Aqlli odamlar odatda mashhurlikni xohlamaydi.
{r:Many people should not chase popularity.} - Ko'p odamlar mashhurlikni quvmasliklari kerak.

text: {r:Convenient} [kənˈviːniənt] – qulay. Real Madrid Barselona bilan o’yini payti jamoa yulduz Vinisius chanqab ketibdi. Keyin {p:KAN}sterdan {p:VINI} ko’tarib suv ichvoribdi. “Nimaga baklashkadan ichmading?” deyishsa. “Menga shunisi {h:qulay.} Ham bo’kib suv ichaman ham ozgina suv ustimga to’kilganidan salqinlanib ham olaman” debdi.
examples: {r:This location is likely to be convenient for tourists.} - Bu joy turistlar uchun qulay bo'lishi mumkin
{r:This surgery is cheap and convenient too.} - Bu jarrohlik amaliyoti arzon va qulay ham.
{r:Both the new and old options were convenient enough.} - Ham yangi, ham eski variantlar yetarlicha qulay edi.
{r:Many people need convenient solutions.} - Ko'p odamlar qulay yechimlarga muhtoj.

text: {r:Jealous} [ˈdʒeləs] - rashkchi; hasadgo'y. Erim shunchalik {h:rashkchiki} agar {p:JALYUZ}ini quchoqlab tursam shu jalyuzidan ham rashk qiladi meni.
examples: {r:The jealous woman is likely to be awake today.} - Rashkchi ayol bugungi kunini uyg'oq o'tkazishi mumkin.
{r:There was too little reason to be jealous of his success.} - Uning muvaffaqiyatiga hasad qilish uchun juda kam sabab bor edi.
{r:A few jealous comments were made while they were discussing the project.} - Ular loyihani muhokama qilayotganda bir nechta hasadli izohlar aytildi.
{r:Many people should try to overcome jealous feelings.} - Ko'p odamlar hasad(rashk) hissini yengishga harakat qilishlari kerak.

text: {r:Ambitious} [æmˈbɪʃəs] so‘zi o‘zbek tilida {h:"katta maqsadli"}, "ishtiyoqi baland", "manfaatparast" degan ma’nolarni anglatadi. Bu so‘z odatda odamlarning yuqori maqsadlarga ega ekanligini yoki juda katta rejalarga intilayotganini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Masalan: 1) "She is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor." — "U shifokor bo‘lishni xohlaydigan katta maqsadli talabadir." 2) "He has an ambitious plan to expand his business." — "U biznesini kengaytirish bo‘yicha katta maqsadli rejaga ega." 3) "Only ambitious people achieve great success." — "Faqat katta maqsadli odamlar katta muvaffaqiyatga erishadilar." Xulosa: "Ambitious" — insonning katta maqsadlarga ega ekanligini va ularga erishishga intilishini bildiradi.
examples: {r:He is too unambitious to pursue his dreams.} - U o'z orzulariga erishish uchun juda ambitsiyasiz.
{r:He is too ambitious but he never works hard.} - U juda katta maqsadli odam lekin qattiq ishlamaydi maqsadlari ustida.

text: {r:Stubborn} [ˈstʌbərn] - qaysar, o'jar. Qadim zamonlarda Italiyada stakan shakldagi burunga ega inson yashagan ekan. Shuning uchun uning laqabi {p:STA}kan {p:BURUN} ekan. Odamlarning bunday laqabchiligidan u kishi o'jar va {h:qaysar} xarakterga ega bo'lgan ekan.
examples: {r:She is too stubborn.} - U juda qaysar.
{r:There is too little progress when someone is too stubborn.} - Kimdir juda qaysar bo'lsa, juda kam taraqqiyot bo'ladi.
{r:Neither of his stubborn decisions led to success.} - Uning qaysar qarorlarining hech biri muvaffaqiyatga olib kelmadi.
{r:The plumber is stubborn, and his assistant is too.} - Santexnik yigit juda qaysar va uning yordamchisi ham.

text: {r:Fat} [fæt] – semiz: yog’, yog’li. Agar siz {h:semiz} bo’lsangiz, {p:fat}ograflik bilan shug’ullaning. Birinchidan ulardan yaxshi fatograf chiqadi, ikkinchidan ko’proq harakat qilasiz va ozasiz.
examples: {r:This dish is too fatty.} - Bu taom juda yog'li.
{r:There’s too little nutritional value in this fat-rich food.} - Ushbu yog'li ovqatda juda kam ozuqa qiymati bor.
{r:Both the main course and dessert were too fat.} - Ham asosiy taom, ham desert juda yog'li edi.
{r:My uncle is fat and my aunt too.} - Mening amakim juda semiz va xolam ham.

text: {r:Skinny} [ˈskɪni] - ozg'in. Bolaligimda baquvvat bo'lganman va odamlar juda havas qilishgan. Lekin bir kuni ko'z tegdi menga. Men keyin {p:KINNA}chiga borib kinna soldirdim va negadir {h:ozib} ketdim.
examples: {r:She is too skinny.} - U juda ozg'in.
{r:She was naturally skinny and never seemed to gain weight.} - U tabiiy ravishda oriq edi va hech qachon vazn yig'maydigan ko'rinardi.
{r:The skinny boy had a desire to eat the tasty dish.} – Ozg‘in bola mazali taomni yeyishni xohladi.
{r:Many people worry about being too skinny.} - Ko'p odamlar juda ozg'in bo'lishdan xavotirda.

text: {r:Pale} [peɪl] – rangi o’chgan, oqargan, bo’zargan. Mol va qo’ylarning {p:PAYL}arini yeyish inson bo’g’im va paylarini mustahkamlanishiga sababchi bo’ladi. Lekin ehtiyot bo’ling ba’zan{p: PAYL}ar yeganingizda rangingiz {h:o’chib} bo’zarib ketishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:Your cheap t-shirt will likely be pale in 2 months.} - Sening arzon futbolkang 2 oyda oqarib ketishi mumkin.
{r:Your skin is pale too.} - Tering ham oqarib(rangi o'chib) ketibdi.
{r:Your skin is too pale.} - Tering juda oqarib ketibdi.
{r:Many people should prefer pale colors for their walls if they want a calm atmosphere.} - Agar sokin muhit istashsa, ko'p odamlar devorlari uchun oqargan ranglarni afzal ko'rishlari kerak.

text: {r:Actively} [ˈæktɪvli] - faollik bilan, aktivniy. Active ning ravish shakli.
examples: {r:He is not participating actively enough.} - U yetarlicha faol ishtirok etmayapti.
{r:There was too little active participation in this group.} - Ushbu guruhda juda kam faol ishtirok bor edi.
{r:Both members were actively engaged in the discussion.} - Har ikkala a'zo ham muhokamada faol ishtirok etishdi.
{r:Many people need to contribute actively to the team's success.} - Ko'p odamlar jamoaning muvaffaqiyatiga faol hissa qo'shishlari kerak.
{r:Being lazy prevents you from acting actively.} - Dangasa bo'lish sizni faol harakat qilishdan to'xtatadi.

text: {r:Cheerful} [ˈtʃɪərfəl] - quvnoq, xursand. Bir kuni o'rmon ichidan bir chemodan CHIRik PUL topib oldim dollarda. Qaysidirlarini uchi, boshqalarini o'rtasi chirib ketgan edi va ularni hammasini yamay boshladim. Bankka olib borib keyin so'mga almashtirdim va bankdagilar ham muammosiz almashtirishdi. To'g'risi shu {p:CHIR}ik {p:PUL} meni rosa {h:xursand} qildi.
examples: {r:She is cheerful and attentive.} - U juda quvnoq va e'tiborli.
{r:He is sensible and cheerful too.} - U farosatli va quvnoq ham.
{r:We are too cheerful.} - Biz juda quvnoqmiz.
{r:They painted the walls with cheerful scenery to brighten the children's room.} – Bolalar xonasini quvnoq manzara bilan bezab devorlarni bo‘yashdi.

text: {r:Calm} [kɑːm] – xotirjam, sokin; tinchlantirmoq, tinchlanmoq. Agar asabiylashgan bo’lsangiz va o’zingizni {h:tinchlantirmoqchimisiz?} Unda {p:KAM}alakning rasmlarini tomosha qiling.
examples: {r:He is too calm.} - U o'ta xotirjam.
{r:He is calm too.} - U ham xotirjam.
{r:Both the atmosphere and the people were very calm.} - Ham muhit, ham odamlar juda xotirjam edi.
{r:Many people must find ways to seek calm in their daily lives.} - Ko'p odamlar kundalik hayotlarida tinchlik topish yo'llarini topishlari shart.
{r:Stay calm even in long queues.} - Hattoki uzun navbatlarda ham xotirjam qoling.

text: {r:Unusual} [ʌnˈjuːʒuəl] - noodatiy, g'ayrioddiy. Usual(odatdagi) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:This behavior is too unusual to ignore.} - Bu xatti-harakat e'tiborsiz qoldirish uchun juda noodatiy.
{r:There is too little interest in this unusual idea.} - Ushbu g'ayrioddiy g'oyaga juda kam qiziqish bor.
{r:Neither of the patterns was unusual enough to stand out.} - Naqshlarning hech biri ajralib turish uchun yetarlicha noodatiy emas edi.
{r:That was unusual beer.} - Bu noodatiy pivo edi.

text: {r:Odd} [ɑːd] – g’alati, g’ayritabiiy. Olimchik raysga doklad topshiryapti “Rays buva men {p:ODD}iy va {h:g’alati} narsa ixtiro qildim. Nima deysizmi? Televizor, ha oddiy ixtiro. Nimasi g’alati deysizmi? Ertalabdan kechgacha faqat sizni ko’rsatadi.
examples: {r:His reaction was too odd.} - Uning munosabati juda g'alati edi.
{r:There was too much explanation for this odd behavior.} - Ushbu g'alati xatti-harakat uchun juda ko'p izoh bor edi.
{r:Both the sound and the sight were quite odd.} - Ham ovoz, ham ko'rinish juda g'alati edi.
{r:The situation was odd too.} - Vaziyat ham g'alati edi.

text: {r:Unexpected} [ˌʌnɪkˈspektɪd] - kutilmagan. Expect(kutmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The news was too unexpected.} - Yangilik juda kutilmagan edi.
{r:There was too little preparation for such unexpected events.} - Bunday kutilmagan hodisalar uchun juda kam tayyorgarlik bor edi.
{r:A few unexpected guests were arriving while we were preparing dinner.} - Biz kechki ovqat tayyorlayotganda bir nechta kutilmagan mehmonlar kelayotgan edi.
{r:I have seen too many unexpected events.} - Men juda ko'p kutilmagan vaziyatlarni ko'rdim.

text: {r:Dull} [dʌl] - zerikarli, bir xil, monoton. Dalton kasalligiga ega shaxslar ranglarni ajratolmaydi yoki hamma narsani oq-qora rangda ko'radi. {p:DAL}toniklarning aytishicha bu juda {h:zerikarli} sindrom ekan.
examples: {r:This book is too dull.} - Bu kitob juda zerikarli.
{r:Neither the plot nor the characters were interesting enough; they were too dull.} - Na syujet, na personajlar yetarlicha qiziqarli emas edi; ular juda zerikarli edi.
{r:Many people should avoid dull conversations.} - Ko'p odamlar zerikarli suhbatlardan qochishlari kerak.
{r:This dull conversation is none of your business anyway.} – Bu zerikarli suhbat baribir sening ishing emas.

text: {r:Design} [dɪˈzaɪn] - dizayn; dizayn qilmoq.
examples: {r:This design is too simple to be innovative.} - Bu dizayn innovatsion bo'lish uchun juda sodda.
{r:There’s too little creativity in this design.} - Ushbu dizaynda juda kam ijodkorlik bor.
{r:Both the structure and the design need improvement.} - Ham tuzilishi, ham dizayni yaxshilanishga muhtoj.
{r:I design books and edit them too.} - Men kitoblarni dizayn qilaman va ularni tahrirlayman ham.

text: {r:Gun} [ɡʌn] – to’pponcha, qurol. {p:Gan}tel yasadim {h:pistolet} shaklida, ya’ni metal pistolet shaklida, lekin gantel sifatida ishlataman. Ko’rgan odam bir cho’chisin dedim.
examples: {r:Formerly everyone had his own gun.} - Avval har kimning o'z quroli bor edi.
{r:There’s too little safety in handling this gun.} - Ushbu qurolni boshqarishda juda kam xavfsizlik bor.
{r:Both the gun and the ammunition were secured.} - Ham qurol, ham o'q-dorilar xavfsiz holatga keltirilgan edi.
{r:This gun is too dangerous.} - Bu qurol juda xavfli.

text: {r:Meantime}[ˈmiːnˌtaɪm] – shu orada, shu vaqt ichida. Sinfdosh do’stlarimiz bilan Buhoroga sayohatga bordik va ko’plab asori-atiqalarni tomosha qildik. O’rta osiyodagi eng katta minora bo’lmish Minorai Kalon meni juda maftun qildi. Sinfdoshlarimga “Senlar aylanib turaveringlar men {h:shu orada} bu uzun {p:MIN}oraga {p:TAYM}erni qo’yib necha sekundda chiqolarkanman bilmoqchiman” dedim.
examples: {r:The project isn't ready yet; in the meantime, we'll focus on other tasks.} - Loyiha hozircha tayyor emas; shu vaqt ichida boshqa vazifalarga e'tibor qaratamiz.
{r:There's too much to do in the meantime here.} - Shu vaqt ichida bu yerda qilish uchun juda ko'p ish bor.
{r:In the meantime, I packed my baggage.} - Shu vaqt ichida men yukimni yig'dim.
{r:Many people use the meantime productively.} - Ko'p odamlar oradagi vaqtni samarali ishlatishadi.

text: {r:Below}[bɪˈloʊ] – pastda. Haqiqiy o’zbekona {p:PALOV} yemoqchisiz, stol ustidagi palov suzilgan laganni oldingizda {h:pastga} yani yerga o’tirishga qaror qildingiz. Ota bobolarimizdek palovni yerga dasturxon tuzib qo’lda yeyishga qaror qildingiz.
examples: {r:The temperature is too cold, below freezing.} - Harorat juda sovuq, muzlash darajasidan past.
{r:There's too little light below the surface.} - Yuzadan pastda unchalik yorug'lik yo'q.
{r:For more information on this topic, see below.} - Bu mavzu bo'yicha ko'proq ma'lumot uchun pastga qarang.
{r:Many people avoid swimming below the recommended depth.} - Ko'p odamlar tavsiya etilgan chuqurlikdan pastda suzishdan qochishadi.

text: {r:Generosity}[ˌdʒenəˈrɒsɪti] - saxiylik. Generous(saxiy) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Take a seat on the chair and talk about his generosity.} - Stulga o'tir va uning saxiyligi haqida gapirib ber.
{r:There's too little generosity in this community.} - Bu jamoada unchalik saxiylik yo'q.
{r:A few acts of generosity were appreciated by everyone.} - Bir nechta saxiylik harakatlari hamma tomonidan qadrlandi.
{r:Many people admire his generosity greatly.} - Ko'p odamlar uning saxiyligini juda qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Skilled}[skɪld] - mahoratli, qobiliyatli. Skill(mahorat) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She is very skilled.} - U juda mahoratli.
{r:There's too little skilled labor in this industry.} - Ushbu sohada unchalik malakali ishchi yo'q.
{r:A few skilled workers were hired quickly.} - Bir nechta malakali ishchilar tezda ishga olindi.
{r:Many people value skilled professionals.} - Ko'p odamlar malakali mutaxassislarni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Stage}[steɪdʒ] - sahna. Ustozlarimiz aytardi 'Sahnaga chiqishdan oldin {p:SUT ICH.} Shunda kayfiyating yaxshilanib {h:sahna}da yaxshi ijro qilasan.'
examples: {r:The stage is too small for such a large performance.} - Sahna bunday katta tomosha uchun juda kichik.
{r:We performed on stage once.} - Biz sahnada bir marta rol ijro etganmiz.
{r:A few stage lights were not working suddenly.} - Bir nechta sahna chiroqlari to'satdan ishlamay qoldi.
{r:Many people enjoy performing on stage every night.} - Ko'p odamlar har kecha sahnada chiqish qilishni yoqtirishadi.

text: {r:Indeed}[ɪnˈdiːd] – chindan, haqiqatdan. Komik qiz {p:IND}ira {p:DID}li inson ‘{h:chindan ham}’. Biz uning kiyinishidan, xarakteridan buni sezishimiz mumkin.
examples: {r:The problem is too complex indeed.} - Muammo haqiqatan ham juda murakkab.
{r:Remaining students were indeed awake in campus.} - Yotoqxonadagi qolgan talabalar haqiqatdan uyg'oq edi.
{r:Earth is indeed round.} - Yer sayyorasi haqiqatdan dumaloq.
{r:Many people were indeed impressed by the results.} - Ko'p odamlar natijalardan haqiqatan ham hayratda qolishdi.

text: {r:Song}[sɔːŋ] - qo'shiq.
examples: {r:This song is too loud for my ears.} - Bu qo'shiq mening qulog'im uchun juda baland.
{r:There's too little melody in this song.} - Bu qo'shiqda unchalik ohang yo'q.
{r:A few songs were too long for the concert.} - Bir nechta qo'shiqlar konsert uchun juda uzun edi.
{r:This song helps people with depression in prison.} - Bu qo'shiq qamoqxonadagi odamlarga depressiyani yo'q qilishda yordam beradi.

text: {r:Vary}[ˈveəri] – farq qilmoq, o’zgarmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz imlo xatolari bilan yozasiz. Bir kuni oldingizga VERgul kelibdi va shunday debdi “Hoy salgina aqlingni ishlatib yoz. Telefonda matnli xabar yozsang meni umuman ishlatmaysan. Xabaringni o’qigan nima deyayotganingni tushunmaydi. Bitta {p:VER}gulli gap vergulsiz gapdan keskin {h:farq qilishi} mumkin.”
examples: {r:The prices vary too much.} - Narxlar keskin farq qiladi.
{r:Prices vary widely from shop to shop.} - Narxlar do'kondan do'konga farq qiladi.
{r:A few varying opinions were expressed openly.} - Bir nechta turli fikrlar ochiq bildirildi.
{r:My art varies from your art.} - Mening san'atim siznikidan farq qiladi.

text:
{r:Ambition}[æmˈbɪʃən] – orzu-istak, maqsad, intilish, ambitsiya. 
Napoleonni ‘sizni buyuk ishlar kutmoqda’ deb uyg’otishar ekan har tong. Men ham 7 yoshli hali ham onasini emadigan o’g’limga ‘qorningni to’qla, {p:EMIB ISHIN}i qil, {h:orzu-istaklaring} tomon bor’ deyman.
examples: {r:His ambition is too great to ignore.} - Uning intilishlari e'tiborsiz qoldirish uchun juda katta.
{r:There's too little ambition in this team.} - Ushbu jamoada unchalik ambitsiya yo'q.
{r:A few ambitious goals were set last year.} - Bir nechta ambitsiyali maqsadlar o'tgan yili belgilandi.
{r:Many people admire his ambition.} - Ko'p odamlar uning ambitsiyasini qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Guess}[ɡes] - taxmin; taxmin qilmoq. Mening {h:taxminim} bu yil qishda zapravkalarda yana {p:GAZ} bo'lmaydi. To'g'risi bu hammamizning taxminimiz.
examples: {r:This guess is too far from the truth.} - Bu taxmin haqiqatdan juda uzoq.
{r:There's too little evidence to support this guess.} - Ushbu taxminni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun unchalik dalil yo'q.
{r:A few guesses were too odd to consider.} - Bir nechta taxminlar ko'rib chiqish uchun juda g'alati edi.
{r:Many people rely on educated guesses.} - Ko'p odamlar bilimli taxminlarga tayanadi.
{I guess robbery happened at midnight.} - Mening taxminimcha o'g'irlik yarim tunda sodir etilgan.

text: {r:Prove}[pruːv] - isbotlamoq. Mashina haydashni bilasizmi deyishyapti. Mana meni {p:PRAV}am mashina hayday olishimni {h:isbotlaydigan}.
examples: {r:This evidence is too weak to prove the case.} - Bu dalil ishni isbotlash uchun juda zaif.
{r:There's too little time to prove the theory.} - Nazariyani isbotlash uchun unchalik vaqt yo'q.
{r:A few attempts to prove the point failed quickly.} - Bir nechta fikrni isbotlashga urinishlar tezda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
{r:His actions can sometimes indicate and prove his true intentions.} - Uning harakatlari ba'zan uning haqiqiy niyatlarini ko'rsatishi va isbotlashi mumkin.

text: {r:Entire}[ɪnˈtaɪər] – butunlay, butun. Hozirgi kunda internet butunlay katta bir savdo platformasiga aylanib bo’ldi. Masalan {p:INT}ernetda {p:AYR}on sotib olaman har kuni. {h:Butun} O’zbekiston ayronchilarining mahsulot detallari, kontaktlari shu yerda yozilgan.
examples: {r:This task is too big for the entire team.} - Bu vazifa butun jamoa uchun juda katta.
{r:There's too little time to finish the entire project.} - Butun loyihani tugatish uchun unchalik vaqt yo'q.
{r:From this height, you can see the entire city.} - Bu balandlikdan siz butun shaharni ko'rishingiz mumkin.
{r:Many people appreciate the entire effort.} - Ko'p odamlar butun sa'y-harakatni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Claim}[kleɪm] - iddao, da'vo(nimagadir da'vo qilish); da'vo qilmoq. Men maktabga tilladan yasalgan kley ko'tarib borgan edim sinfdoshim 'Bu asli meni {p:KLEYIM}' deb {h:da'vo qilyapti}'.
examples: {r:This claim is too big to believe.} - Bu da'vo ishonish uchun juda katta.
{r:There's too little evidence to support the claim.} - Da'voni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun unchalik dalil yo'q.
{r:He claims for the kingdom.} - U qirollikka da'vo qilyapti.
{r:He claims I have stolen his fridge.} - U men uning muzlatgichini o'g'irlaganimni da'vo qilyapti.

text: {r:Main}[meɪn] - asosiy. Jasur Mavlonovning '{p:MAYIN} mayin yog'ib ketdi yomg'ir' qo'shig'i 2021 - yilning eng xit bo'lgan {h:asosiy} qo'shig'iga aylandi.
examples: {r:This is too important to ignore; it's the main issue.} - Bu e'tiborsiz qoldirish uchun juda muhim; bu asosiy masala.
{r:There's too little focus on the main goal.} - Asosiy maqsadga unchalik e'tibor qaratilmaydi.
{r:A few main points were discussed thoroughly.} - Bir nechta asosiy fikrlar chuqur muhokama qilindi.
{r:My main business is to provide kids with toys.} - Mening asosiy biznesim bolalarni o'yinchoqlar bilan ta'minlash.

text: {r:Above}[əˈbʌv] – yuqorida, tepada. {p:E}rkin {p:Bav}ariya va Barselona o’rtasidagi o’yinni {h:yuqorida}, ikkinchi qavatda tomosha qildi. Agarda bu o’rinda siz futbol muxlisi bo’lmasangiz va Bavariya jamoasini umuman tanimasingiz, Bove shampuni, Bavariya pivosini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:The temperature is too high, above normal.} - Harorat juda yuqori, normadan baland.
{r:Planes and helicopters are flying above us.} - Samolyot va vertolyotlar tepamizdan uchayapti.
{r:Your result is good, above average.} - Natijangiz yaxshi, o'rtachadan baland.
{r:Many people aim to perform above expectations.} - Ko'p odamlar kutganidan yuqori natijalarga erishishni maqsad qiladi.

text: {r:Prominent}[ˈprɒmɪnənt] – mashhur, taniqli. Mana bu professor “Yer tekis” teoriyasi bilan mashhur va millionlab insonlarni bunga ishontira olgan. O’zining internetdagi {h:mashhur} videolari bilan insonlarni miyasini aynitgan {p:PRA}fessor {p:MINNAT} ham qiladi “Insoniyatning ko’zini ochyabman” deb.
examples: {r:This issue is too prominent to ignore.} - Bu masala e'tiborsiz qoldirish uchun juda muhim.
{r:I met countless prominent people.} - Men son-sanoqsiz mashhur odamlar bilan uchrashganman.
{r:A few prominent figures attended the event last week.} - Bir nechta taniqli shaxslar o'tgan hafta tadbirga qatnashdi.
{r:Many people admire prominent leaders.} - Ko'p odamlar taniqli rahbarlarni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Trial}[ˈtraɪəl] - sud jarayoni; sinov (muddati yoki davri). Toshkent shahriga {p:TRAL}eybuslar qaytyapti. Keyingi 3 oy ular uchun {h:sinov} davri bo'ladi. Troleybuslar hozirgi Toshkentga moslashib keta oladimi, ko'ramiz.
examples: {r:This trial is too important.} - Bu sinov jarayoni juda muhim.
{r:There's too little evidence to conclude the trial.} - Sud jarayonini yakunlash uchun unchalik dalil yo'q.
{r:A few trials were conducted yesterday.} - Bir nechta sinovlar kecha o'tkazildi.
{r:You will be sent to prison after the trial.} - Sud jarayonlaridan keyin qamoqqa jo'natilasan.

text: {r:Avoid}[əˈvɔɪd] - oldini olmoq; qochmoq, o'zini chetga olmoq, saqlanmoq, tiyilmoq. Darvinning {p:EVOLYUT}sion nazariyasi odam maymundan paydo bo'lganini aytadi va sovet davri adabiyotlari uning bu da'vosini qo'llab-quvvatlagan. Biz esa hozirgi davrda ko'plab sabablarga ko'ra bu nazariyani {h:chetga olib turamiz va uni qo'llab-quvvatlamaymiz}.
examples: {r:You should avoid mistakes.} - Sen xatolarni oldini olishing kerak.
{r:There's too little effort to avoid conflicts.} - Ziddiyatlardan qochish uchun unchalik harakat yo'q.
{r:A few avoidable errors were made recently.} - Bir nechta qochish mumkin bo'lgan xatolar yaqinda qilindi.
{r:Many people try to avoid unnecessary risks.} - Ko'p odamlar keraksiz risklardan tiyilishga harakat qilishadi.

text: {r:Impact}[ˈɪmpækt] - ta'sir; ta'sir etmoq. Hozir 'Imkon' brendi nomi bilan paketlar ishlab chiqarilyapti va paketlarga har xil motivatsion gaplar yozilyapti. Xaridorlar ham pozitiv kayfiyat uchun Imkonni tanlashyapti. Xullas, {p:IM}kon {p:PAKET}lari odamlar hayotiga pozitiv {h:ta'sir} ko'rsatyapti.
examples: {r:The special effects had a huge impact on every viewer.} - Maxsus effektlar har bir tomoshabinga katta ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
{r:The decision will have a positive impact on people's lives.} - Bu qaror odamlar hayotiga ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatadi.
{r:The decision was made with sudden fury, impacting everyone.} - Qaror birdaniga qahr bilan qabul qilindi, bu hammaga ta'sir qildi.
{r:People want to hear about those issues that impact their lives.} - Odamlar o'z hayotiga ta'sir qilayotgan muammolar haqida eshitishni xohlaydi.

text: {r:Reveal}[rɪˈviːl] – ochmoq, fosh qilmoq; ko’rsatmoq, taqdim qilmoq. Xullas mana bu qo’shiqni aytgan Ravil akani ko’plab sekretlari bor. Bloggerlar {h:fosh qilishgan} {p:RAVIL}ni sirlarini.
examples: {r:This secret is too big to reveal.} - Bu sir oshkor qilish uchun juda katta.
{r:There's too little time to reveal the truth.} - Haqiqatni oshkor qilish uchun unchalik vaqt yo'q.
{r:She stayed dumb until the right moment to reveal the truth.} – U to‘g‘ri vaqtgacha jim turdi va keyin haqiqatni ochdi.
{r:Many people enjoy dramatic reveals.} - Ko'p odamlar dramatik oshkor qilishlardan zavqlanishadi.

text: {r:Weapon}[ˈwɛpən] - qurol. Mana bu {p:VEYPN}i ko'ryapsizmi? Bu ham veyp, ham {h:qurol}.
examples: {r:The detective found a hidden weapon under the floor.} - Detektiv pol taxtalari ostida yashirilgan qurol topdi.
{r:A pen can be as dangerous as a weapon in clever hands.} - Qalam aqlli qo'llarda quroldek xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:The weapons were being transported to the border quickly.} - Qurollar chegara tomon tezda tashilayotgan edi.
{r:You must register any weapon with local authorities.} - Har qanday qurolni mahalliy hokimiyatdan ro'yxatdan o'tkazishingiz shart.

text: {r:Insane}[ɪnˈseɪn] - tentak, ahmoqona. Xullas ensaqotar do'stim. Ko'p {p:ENSEYN}i qotirma, ensasi qotavergan inson {h:ahmoq} bo'lib qoladi deb eshitganman.
examples: {r:He always acts insane when he’s stressed.} - U stressda bo'lganda har doim aqldan ozgan kabi harakat qiladi.
{r:There’s too much pressure; it’s driving him insane.} - Juda ko'p bosim bor; bu uni aqldan ozdiryapti.
{r:A few insane ideas were proposed during the meeting.} - Uchrashuv davomida bir nechta ahmoqona g'oyalar taklif qilindi.
{r:Many people avoid insane situations.} - Ko'p odamlar ahmoqona vaziyatlardan qochishadi.

text: {r:Scary}[ˈskeəri] - qo'rqinchli. Scare(qo'rqitmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She always finds horror movies too scary.} - U ujas filmlarni har doim juda qo'rqinchli deb biladi.
{r:In this story the king is a scary man.} - Bu hikoyada qirol qo'rqinchli bir kishi.
{r:A few scary moments made the movie unforgettable.} - Bir nechta qo'rqinchli lahzalar filmni esda qolarli qildi.
{r:Many people enjoy scary stories.} - Ko'p odamlar qo'rqinchli hikoyalardan zavqlanishadi.

text: {r:Mainly}[ˈmeɪnli] - asosiy, asosan. Main(asosiy) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:He mainly works from home these days.} - U bugungi kunda asosan uydan ishlaydi.
{r:There’s too much to do; he mainly focuses on urgent tasks.} - Juda ko'p ish bor; u asosan shoshilinch vazifalarga e'tibor qaratadi.
{r:Computer prices are increasing mainly because of gamers' high demand.} - Kompyuter narxlari oshyapti asosan geymerlarning yuqori talabi tufayli.
{r:Many people mainly rely on public transport.} - Ko'p odamlar asosan jamoat transportiga tayanadi.

text: {r:Seldom}[ˈsɛldəm] – kamdan-kam, har zamonda, ba’zan. Uyda hech qaysi mahsulot qolmaganda uyilib qolgan {p:SEL}ofanlardan {p:DIM}lama qilib turaman {h:har-har zamonda}.
examples: {r:Unfortunately he seldom goes to the gym.} - Afsuski u kamdan-kam hollarda sport zaliga boradi.
{r:There’s too little time; he seldom takes breaks.} - Juda kam vaqt bor; u kamdan-kam hollarda tanaffus qiladi.
{r:He seldom buys ropes for his cows.} - U har zamonda sigirlari uchun arqon sotib oladi.
{r:Many people seldom travel abroad.} - Ko'p odamlar kamdan-kam hollarda chet elga sayohat qilishadi.

text: {r:Rarely}[ˈreərli] - kamdan-kam hollarda, ba'zan. Rare(noyob) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Fortunately he rarely eats fast food.} - Yaxshiyamki u fastfudni kamdan-kam yeydi.
{r:There’s too much work; she rarely has free time.} - Juda ko'p ish bor; u kamdan-kam hollarda bo'sh vaqtga ega bo'ladi.
{r:Prisoners rarely read books.} - Mahbuslar kamdan-kam hollarda kitob o'qishadi.
{r:Many people rarely complain about small issues.} - Ko'p odamlar kichik muammolar haqida kamdan-kam shikoyat qilishadi.

text: {r:Honesty}[ˈɒnɪsti] - halollik. Honest(halol) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She always values honesty in her friends.} - U do'stlaridagi halollikni har doim qadrlaydi.
{r:There’s too little honesty in politics these days.} - Bugungi kunda siyosatda unchalik halollik yo'q.
{r:Honesty should be your lifelong habit.} - Halollik sening bir umrlik odating bo'lishi kerak.
{r:Many people appreciate honesty in relationships.} - Ko'p odamlar munosabatlardagi halollikni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Laughter}[ˈlɑːftər] – kulgi. {p:LATAR}eyada 100 000 dollar yutgandan beri o’zimni {h:kulgidan} to’xtata olmayapman. Xotinimning aytishicha hatto uxlaganda ham kulib uxlayapman ekan.
examples: {r:He always brings laughter to the room.} - U xonaga har doim kulgi olib keladi.
{r:There’s too much stress; we need more laughter.} - Juda ko'p stress bor; bizga ko'proq kulgi kerak.
{r:There are too many reasons for laughter.} - Kulgi uchun juda ko'p sabablar bor.
{r:Many people believe laughter is the best medicine.} - Ko'p odamlar kulish eng yaxshi dori deb hisoblaydi.

text: {r:Beneficial}[ˌbɛnɪˈfɪʃəl] - foydali. Benefit(foyda) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:This habit is always beneficial for your health.} - Bu odat sizning sog'ligingiz uchun har doim foydali.
{r:This book is really beneficial to your mind.} - Bu kitob miyangizga haqiqatdan foydali.
{r:A few beneficial changes were made to the plan.} - Rejaga bir nechta foydali o'zgarishlar kiritildi.
{r:Many people seek beneficial opportunities.} - Ko'p odamlar foydali imkoniyatlarni qidirishadi.

text: {r:Measure}[ˈmɛʒər] - o'lchamoq. Agar qorningni, yelkangni ushlaganingda nimadir lopillab tursa bilki bu menman. {p:MEn JIR}man(tana yog'i), meni {h:o'lchashingning} foydasi yo'q. Ko'p jismoniy harakat va parhez qilmaguningcha men shu yerdaman, do'stim!
examples: {r:She always measures ingredients carefully.} - U har doim ingredientlarni diqqat bilan o'lchaydi.
{r:There’s too much to measure in this experiment.} - Ushbu tajribada o'lchash uchun juda ko'p narsa bor.
{r:We should measure war costs.} - Biz urush xarajatlarini hisoblashimiz kerak.
{r:Many people measure success differently.} - Ko'p odamlar muvaffaqiyatni boshqacha o'lchashadi.

text:
{r:Shake}[ʃeɪk] - chayqatmoq, silkitmoq, tebratmoq, qilpillamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - shook, shaken. 
'SHEYK {p:SHEYK} madam sheyk' qo'shig'iga rosa {h:qilpillab} o'ynadik biz 2 kun oldin.
examples: {r:He always shakes the bottle before opening it.} - U shishani ochishdan oldin har doim chayqaydi.
{r:There’s too much liquid; it’s hard to shake.} - Juda ko'p suyuqlik bor; uni chayqash qiyin.
{r:The two teams shook hands before the match.} - Ikkala komanda uchrashuv oldidan qo'l siqishishdi.
{r:Many people shake hands when they meet.} - Ko'p odamlar uchrashganda qo'l berishadi.

text: {r:Discover}[dɪˈskʌvər] – kashf etmoq, aniqlamoq. Men bugun ilmiy ishimni yoqlayapman universitetimizda. {p:DIS}ertatsiyamda {p:KAV}Rakning yangi shifobaxsh xususiyatlari {h:kashf} etganim yozilgan. Kavrakni hozir Hindiston, Xitoy va Rossiya dori ishlab chiqaruvchilari bizdan sotib olyapti.
examples: {r:She always discovers new things during her travels.} - U sayohatlari davomida har doim yangi narsalarni kashf qiladi.
{r:There’s too much to discover in this city.} - Ushbu shaharda kashf qilish uchun juda ko'p narsa bor.
{r:Actually Beruniy almost discovered America.} - Aslida Beruniy Amerika qit'asini deyarli kashf qilgan.
{r:They did their best to discover who stole the bike.} – Ular velosipedni kim o‘g‘irlaganini aniqlash uchun qo‘lidan kelganini qilishdi.

text: {r:Adult}[ˈædʌlt] - katta odam(yosh bola yoki o'smir emas). 5 yoshimdan beri taekwondo bilan shug'ullanaman. Bolalik va o'smirlik chog'larimda 238 turnirga qatnashib birorta medal ololmadim. Birinchi medalimni kattalar o'rtasida O'zbekiston chempionatida kutilmaganda oltin oldim.{h: Katta kishi} ham bo'lib qoldim va faoliyatimni tugatmasdan avval nihoyat m{p:EDAL} oldim.
examples: {r:He always acts like an adult in serious situations.} - U jiddiy vaziyatlarda har doim kattalar kabi harakat qiladi.
{r:There are too many adults in children's theater.} - Bolalar teatrida juda ko'p kattalar bor.
{r:A few adults were invited to the meeting.} - Uchrashuvga bir nechta kattalar taklif qilindi.
{r:Many people become more responsible as adults.} - Ko'p odamlar katta bo'lishganida ko'proq mas'uliyatli bo'lishadi.

text: {r:Range}[reɪndʒ] - doira, oraliq, qator, tur. U biror narsaning eng kichik va eng katta qiymatlari orasidagi farqni yoki turli xil variantlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:She always explores a wide range of topics.} - U har doim keng mavzular doirasini o'rganadi.
{r:There’s too much to cover in this range of products.} - Ushbu mahsulotlar doirasini qamrab olish uchun juda ko'p narsa bor.
{r:The price range is from 10usd to 100usd.} - Narx oralig'i 10$ dan 100$ gacha.
{r:We have a range of options.} - Bizda bir qator variantlar bor.
{r:There is a wide range of opinions.} - Bir qator fikrlar bor bu yerda.

text: {r:Mention}[ˈmɛnʃən] - eslatmoq. Men qattiqo'l karate murabbiysiman. Agar shogirdlarim aytganimni bajarmasa shnur bilan uraman. Agar salgina qoida buzishni boshlashsa {p:MEN SHN}urim qo'limda turganligini {h:eslataman}.
examples: {r:He always mentions his family in conversations.} - U suhbatlarda har doim o'z oilasini eslatib o'tadi.
{r:There’s too much to mention in this report.} - Ushbu hisobotda eslatish uchun juda ko'p narsa bor.
{r:Whenever they mention Paris, I remember how I fell in love there.} – Har safar Parijni eslatishsa, men u yerda qanday sevib qolganimni eslayman.
{r:Many people want to be mentioned in speeches.} - Ko'p odamlar nutqlarda eslatilishni xohlaydi.

text: {r:Specific}[spəˈsɪfɪk] - muayyan, aniq, spetsifik.
examples: {r:She always gives specific instructions.} - U har doim aniq ko'rsatmalar beradi.
{r:A few specific examples were provided.} - Bir nechta aniq misollar keltirildi.
{r:I will find this specific book.} - Men aynan shu kitobni topaman.
{r:Many people prefer specific feedback.} - Ko'p odamlar aniq fikr-mulohazalarni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:Unnecessary}[ʌnˈnɛsəˌsɛri] - keraksiz. Necessary(zarur, kerak) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:He always avoids unnecessary expenses.} - U har doim keraksiz xarajatlardan tiyiladi.
{r:There’s too much unnecessary paperwork.} - Juda ko'p keraksiz qog'ozbozlik bor.
{r:Her desire to look thin made her follow unnecessary diets that caused a disease.} – U ozg‘in ko‘rinishga bo‘lgan istagi sabab keraksiz dietalarni qildi va bu kasallikka sabab bo‘ldi.
{r:They avoided unnecessary talk and enjoyed the cool evening by the lake after their swim.} – Ular keraksiz gaplardan qochib, suzishdan keyin ko‘l bo‘yida salqin oqshomdan zavq olishdi.

text: {r:Throughout}[θruːˈaʊt] - davomida, bo'ylab(vaqt va joy uchun ishlatiladi).
examples: {r:She always stays positive throughout the day.} - U kun davomida har doim ijobiy qoladi.
{r:There’s too much to do throughout the week.} - Hafta davomida qilish uchun juda ko'p ish bor.
{r:A few changes were made throughout the project.} - Loyiha davomida bir nechta o'zgarishlar kiritildi.
{r:Many people work hard throughout the year.} - Ko'p odamlar yil davomida qattiq mehnat qilishadi.
{r:His generosity was known throughout the entire community.} - Uning saxiyligi butun jamiyatga ma'lum edi.

text: {r:Property}[ˈprɒpərti] - mulk, uy-joy.
examples: {r:He always takes care of his property.} - U har doim o'z mulkiga yaxshi qaraydi.
{r:There’s too much damage to the property.} - Mulkka juda ko'p zarar yetdi.
{r:This area is private property; no entry without permission.} - Bu hudud xususiy mulk; ruxsatsiz kirish mumkin emas.
{r:Many people invest in property for the future.} - Ko'p odamlar kelajak uchun uy-joyga sarmoya kiritishadi.
{r:Does this property belong to the city?} - Bu mulk shaharga tegishlimi?

text: {r:Instead}[ɪnˈstɛd] - o'rniga, undan ko'ra. Agar uylanmoqchi bo'lsang qizni 'Yor-yor' dan qidirma {h:o'rniga} {p:UNVRSITET}ga bor. Hamma o'qimishli qizlar o'sha yerda.
examples: {r:She always chooses tea instead of coffee.} - U har doim kofe o'rniga choyni tanlaydi.
{r:There’s too much to do; let’s relax instead.} - Juda ko'p ish bor; buning o'rniga dam olaylik.
{r:He chose power instead of a calm life.} - U sokin hayot o'rniga qudratni tanladi.
{r:Many people prefer walking instead of driving.} - Ko'p odamlar haydash o'rniga yurishni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:Tough}[tʌf] - qiyin, og'ir; irodali. Giyohvand moddalarga qarshi departamentda {p:TAF}tishchi bo'lib ishlash {h:qiyin.} Odamlarning burnini ichigacha tekshiramiz. Uyatli joylari haqida gapirib ham o'tirmayman.
examples: {r:He always stays tough in difficult situations.} - U qiyin vaziyatlarda har doim irodali bo'lib qoladi.
{r:There’s too much pressure; it’s a tough job.} - Juda ko'p bosim bor; bu qiyin ish.
{r:A few tough decisions were made.} - Bir nechta qiyin qarorlar qabul qilindi.
{r:Many people admire tough leaders.} - Ko'p odamlar irodali rahbarlarni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Quantity}[ˈkwɒntɪti] – miqdor, son. Mening Titanik kemasiga murojaatim “{p:QUVON TIT}Anik chunki sen haqingda film eng ko’p {h:miqdorda} ko’rilgan va eng katta summada foyda ko’rgan”.
examples: {r:We need to measure the quantity carefully.} - Biz miqdorni diqqat bilan o'lchashimiz kerak.
{r:They haven't calculated the exact quantity yet.} - Ular hali aniq miqdorni hisoblamadilar.
{r:We've already measured a large quantity.} - Biz allaqachon katta miqdorni o'lchaganmiz.
{r:We need to calculate the remaining quantity of materials.} - Biz materiallarning qolgan miqdorini hisoblab chiqishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Thoughtful}[ˈθɔːtfəl] - o’ylangan, g‘amxo‘r, e’tiborli, mulohazali. Bu so‘z kimnidir boshqalar haqida qayg‘urishi, o‘ylab ish tutishi yoki mulohazali bo‘lishini ifodalashda ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:She promised to be more thoughtful.} - U yanada mulohazali bo'lishga va'da berdi.
{r:He gave thoughtful advice.} - U mulohazali maslahat berdi.
{r:They're still being thoughtful neighbors.} - Ular hali ham e'tiborli qo'shnilar.
{r:She was not thoughtful and quickly divorced.} - U mulohazali emas edi va tezda ajrashdi.

text: {r:Various}[ˈveəriəs] - turli, har xil. Amir Temurdan so'ng nega uning davlati tez quladi bilasizmi? Chunki {h:turli-tuman} {p:VORIS}lar juda ko'p edi. Ular bir-biri bilan hokimiyat talashib saltanat tez orada quladi.
examples: {r:It was hard to identify the various objects in the dark.} - Qorong'uda turli xil narsalarni aniqlash qiyin edi.
{r:We have to consider various options.} - Biz turli imkoniyatlarni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
{r:The hotel offers various accommodation options for travelers.} - Mehmonxona sayohatchilar uchun turli xil turar joy variantlarini taklif etadi.
{r:They offer various products that are similar in quality.} - Ular sifat jihatidan o'xshash turli mahsulotlarni taklif qilishadi.
{r:The salad was a colorful mixture of various vegetables.} - Salat turli sabzavotlarning rang-barang aralashmasi edi.

text: {r:Surface}[ˈsɜːrfɪs] - yuza, ust, sirt.
examples: {r:You should clean the surface first.} - Avval sirtni tozalash kerak.
{r:The surface was rough, not smooth.} - Yuza dag'al edi, silliq emas.
{r:They've already repaired the damaged surface.} - Ular shikastlangan yuzani allaqachon ta'mirlashga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
{r:He used a bucket and soap to clean the surface.} - U yuzani tozalash uchun chelak va sovundan foydalandi.

text: {r:Purpose}[ˈpɜːrpəs] - maqsad. Qorqizning {h:maqsadi} qorboboga {p:PO'PIS}a qilib uning ishini egallab olish.
examples: {r:What is your purpose?} - Maqsadingiz nima?
{r:They haven't understood our purpose yet.} - Ular hali bizning maqsadimizni tushunmadi.
{r:He has already explained the purpose.} - U maqsadini allaqachon tushuntirgan.
[center][b]on purpose - ataylab[/b][/center]
{r:He broke the window on purpose} – U derazani atayin sindirdi.
{r:I said it on purpose to make you laugh} – Seni kuldirish uchun atayin shunday dedim.

text: {r:Exist}[ɪɡˈzɪst] – bor bo’lmoq, mavjud bo’lmoq. Mening ikki yildan beri farzand ko’rmayotgan ayolim {p:EGIZ} tug’di {p:IST}anbulga kelib. Doimo {h:bor bo’lsin} bu shahar.
examples: {r:These traditions probably still exist today.} - Bu an'analar balki hali ham mavjud.
{r:We have to prove that life exists elsewhere.} - Biz hayot boshqa joylarda ham borligini isbotlashimiz kerak.
{r:The abundant evidence already exists.} - Ko'pgina dalillar allaqachon mavjud.
{r:Does this species still exist?} - Bu turlar hali ham mavjudmi?
{r:I don't know how many drugstores exist in our town.} - Shaharchamizda nechta apteka mavjudligini bilmayman.

text: {r:Skin}[skɪn] - teri.
examples: {r:You should protect your skin from the sun.} - Siz teringizni quyoshdan himoya qilishingiz kerak.
{r:The doctor personally needs to examine the skin.} - Shaxsan doktor terini tekshirib ko'rishi kerak.
{r:They're still researching skin treatments.} - Ular hali teri davolarini o'rganmoqda.
{r:She has already applied sunscreen to her skin.} - U allaqachon terisiga quyoshdan himoya kremi surgan.

text: {r:Ahead}[əˈhɛd] - oldinda, oldindan, oldinga. 'Men hammadan {h:oldindaman}' bu kimning gapidan iqtibos deb o'ylaysiz? Albatta maqtanchoq {p:AHAD} Qayumning.
examples: {r:We need to plan ahead.} - Biz oldindan rejalashtirishimiz kerak.
{r:There's still time ahead.} - Hali oldinda vaqt bor.
{r:We're already far ahead of schedule.} - Biz allaqachon jadvaldan ancha oldindamiz.
{r:Is the station still ahead?} - Stansiya hali oldindami?
{r:She changed her mind ahead of the trip} – U sayohat oldidan fikrini o‘zgartirdi.

text: {r:Generation} - avlod, nasl.
examples: {r:Each generation has its own values and challenges.} – Har bir avlodning o‘z qadriyatlari va muammolari bo‘ladi.
{r:Knowledge is a beneficial weapon for the younger generation.} - Bilim yosh avlod uchun foydali qurol.
{r:Our generation even admired dusty vans in 1970s.} - Bizning avlod hattoki chang bosgan furgonlarga ham havas qilardi 1970 - yillarda.
{r:I think this generation is ambitious and cheerful however they are stubborn also.} - Mening o'ylashimcha bu avlod ambitsiyali va quvnoq ammo ular ozgina o'jar hamdir.

text: {r:Commercial}[kəˈmɜːrʃəl] - tijoriy, savdoga oid, kommercheskiy.
examples: {r:The company plans to expand commercial activities.} - Kompaniya savdo faoliyatini kengaytirishni rejalashtirmoqda.
{r:They haven't found commercial success yet.} - Ular hali tijoriy muvaffaqiyatiga erishmadi.
{r:The commercial project has already started.} - Tijorat loyihasi allaqachon boshlangan.
{r:Is the product commercially available yet?} - Mahsulot hali savdoga chiqarilmadimi?

text: {r:Item} - narsa, mahsulot, buyum.
examples: {r:This exceptional item is on sale.} - Ushbu noyob mahsulot sotuvda.
{r:She packed all her stuff and important items into a single bag.} - U barcha narsalarini va muhim buyumlarini bitta sumkaga joyladi.
{r:Take your remaining items to your campus.} - Qolgan narsalaringni yotoqxonangga olib ket.
{r:The museum has many rare items.} - Muzeyda ko‘plab noyob narsalar bor.
{r:It is illegal to carry a weapon in public, a dangerous item.} - Jamoat joyida qurol olib yurish noqonuniydir, xavfli narsa.

text: {r:Cancer} - saraton, rak.
examples: {r:Cancer is a serious disease.} - Saraton jiddiy kasallikdir.
{r:She is raising awareness about cancer.} - U saraton haqida xabardorlikni oshirmoqda.
{r:Early detection of cancer can save lives.} - Saratonni erta aniqlash hayotni saqlab qolishi mumkin.
{r:She set a goal to support people with cancer} – U saraton kasalligi bilan og‘rigan odamlarga yordam berishni maqsad qildi.

text: {r:Discovery}[dɪˈskʌvəri] - kashfiyot. Discover(kashf qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Researchers hope to make important discoveries.} - Tadqiqotchilar muhim kashfiyotlar qilishga umid qilmoqda.
{r:They haven't published their discovery yet.} - Ular hali o'z kashfiyotlarini e'lon qilmadi.
{r:The team has already made an important discovery.} - Jamoa allaqachon muhim kashfiyot qilgan.
{r:Has the scientific community accepted the discovery yet?} - Ilmiy jamiyat kashfiyotni qabul qildimi?

text: {r:Reality}[riˈælɪti] - riallik, haqiqat.
