examples: {r:We need to face reality.} - Biz haqiqatga yuz tutishimiz kerak.
{r:They haven't accepted the harsh reality yet.} - Ular hali qattiq haqiqatni qabul qilmadi.
{r:He's already facing reality.} - U allaqachon haqiqatga ro'baro kelmoqda.
{r:Have you understood the new reality yet?} - Siz yangi haqiqatni hali tushunmadingizmi?

text: {r:Rule}[ruːl] - boshqarmoq, hukmronlik qilmoq. Dadamning aytishicha davlatni {h:boshqarish} ham mashinaga o'tirib {p:RUL}ni boshqarishga o'xshar ekan.
examples: {r:The king will hopefully rule the country well.} - Umid qilamizki qirol mamlakatni yaxshi boshqaradi.
{r:She ruled with fairness and justice.} - U adolat va haqqoniylik bilan boshqardi.
{r:They ruled the kingdom with wisdom.} - Ular saltanatni donolik bilan boshqardi.
{r:The emperor ruled vast territories in ancient times.} - Imperator qadim zamonlarda ulkan hududlarni boshqargan.

text: {r:Beat}[biːt] - urmoq, mag'lub etmoq. Tasavvur qiling bitta {p:BIT} sizning sochingizda boshqa bir bitni {h:uryapti}.
examples: {r:His heart began to beat faster.} - Uning yuragi tezroq ura boshladi.
{r:She was formerly beaten by her ex-husband every day.} - Avval u sobiq turmush o'rtog'i tomonidan har kuni kaltaklangan.
{r:He's already beaten his opponent.} - U allaqachon raqibini mag'lub etgan.
{r:Has our team beaten theirs yet?} - Bizning jamoamiz ularnikini hali yutmadimi?

text: {r:Particularly}[pərˈtɪkjələrli] - ayniqsa, aynan. Particular so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:She's particularly good at languages.} - U ayniqsa tillar bo'yicha yaxshi.
{r:They haven't solved this particularly important issue yet.} - Ular hali ayniqsa muhim muammoni hal qilmadi.
{r:She's already found it particularly difficult.} - U allaqachon buni ayniqsa qiyin deb topgan.
{r:Has he explained this particularly difficult concept yet?} - U aynan bu qiyin tushunchani tushuntirdimi?

text: {r:Tend}[tɛnd] - moyil bo‘lmoq. U odatda nimagadir intilish, biror narsaga moyillik yoki parvarish qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:These plants tend to grow quickly.} - Ushbu o'simliklar tez o'sishga moyil.
{r:They haven't fixed their tendency to be late yet.} - Ular hali kechikish odatini tuzatmadi.

{r:The new teacher tried to introduce fun activities, as students tend to lose focus quickly.} – Yangi o‘qituvchi qiziqarli mashg‘ulotlarni joriy qilishga harakat qildi, chunki o‘quvchilar odatda tez chalg‘iydi.
{r:She felt pity for the stray dogs, which tend to meet near the market.} – U bozorda to‘planishga moyil bo‘lgan daydi itlarga achindi.

text: {r:Insufficient}[ˌɪnsəˈfɪʃənt] - yetarli emas. Sufficient(yetarli) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:The evidence proved to be insufficient.} - Dalillar yetarli emasligi aniqlandi.
{r:They haven't solved the insufficient funding problem yet.} - Ular hali yetmayotgan mablag' muammosini hal qilmadi.
{r:They've already declared the budget insufficient.} - Ular allaqachon byudjetni yetarli emas deb e'lon qilishgan.
{r:The religious leader said our effort was insufficient.} – Diniy yetakchi bizning sa’y-harakatimiz yetarli emasligini aytdi.

text: {r:Prevent}[prɪˈvent] – oldini olmoq, to‘smoq. {p:PRI}pravani {p:VENT}ilyatorda xona bo’ylab uchirish xonadonda suvarak va sichqonlar ko’payishini {h:oldini oladi}.
examples: {r:We must act now to prevent climate change.} – Iqlim o‘zgarishining oldini olish uchun hozir harakat qilishimiz kerak.
{r:Regular exercise can prevent many diseases.} – Muntazam mashqlar ko‘plab kasalliklarning oldini oladi.
{r:The police prevented a robbery at the corner shop.} – Politsiya burchakdagi do‘konda o‘g‘rilikning oldini oldi.
{r:A large population needs innovation to prevent future crises.} – Katta aholiga kelajakdagi inqirozlarning oldini olish uchun innovatsiyalar zarur.

text: {r:Bravery}[ˈbreɪvəri] - mardlik, jasurlik. Hozir Tiktok va Instagram chiqib yigitlar ham noziklashib ketyapti. {p:BIROYLI} armiyaga borib kelishni o'zi katta {h:jasorat} bo'lib qoldi.
examples: {r:She showed great bravery during the crisis.} - U inqiroz davrida katta jasorat ko'rsatdi.
{r:She showed the crowd her bravery.} - U olomonga jasoratini ko'rsatdi.
{r:A few acts of bravery were recognized.} - Bir nechta jasoratli harakatlar tan olindi.
{r:Many people admire bravery in difficult situations.} - Ko'p odamlar qiyin vaziyatlarda jasoratni qadrlaydi.

text: {r:Spit}[spɪt] – tupurmoq; so’lak. Ko’chada {p:SPID} bo’lib qolgan mahalladoshimizni ko’rsam ko’nglim buzilib tupurgim keladi.(Namuna uchun yozildi. Hech kimni kamsitmoqchi emasmiz.)
examples: {r:He always spits out his gum after chewing.} - U chaynab bo'lgandan keyin har doim saqichni tupurib tashlaydi.
{r:The doctor asked for some spit from the patient.} - Doktor bemordan ozgina so'lak so'radi.
{r:Firstly you are not allowed to spit here, secondly you are breaking other rules also.} - Birinchidan bu yerda tupurish mumkin emas, ikkinchidan sen boshqa qoidalarni ham buzayapsan.
{r:Many people find spitting in public rude.} - Ko'p odamlar jamoat joylarida tupurishni qo'pol deb bilishadi.

text: {r:Proof}[pruːf] – isbot, dalil. Uyingizga yomg’ir tomchilamasligini xohlaysizmi, unda profnastil qo’ydiring. {p:PROF}nastil uyingiz quruqligi {h:dalili}.
examples: {r:She always asks for proof before believing anything.} - U biror narsaga ishonishdan oldin har doim dalil so'raydi.
{r:He sent the proof to his lawyer.} - U dalilni o'z advokatiga yubordi.
{r:She found proof by chance in the old drawer.} – U tasodifan eski tortmadan dalil topib qoldi.
{r:Many people need solid proof to trust someone.} - Ko'p odamlar kimdirga ishonish uchun qat'iy dalilga muhtoj.

text: {r:Entirely}[ɪnˈtaɪərli] - butunlay. Entire(butun) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:He entirely agreed with the decision.} - U qarorga butunlay rozi bo'ldi.
{r:Unfortunately this task is entirely new for us.} - Afsuski bu vazifa biz uchun butunlay yangi.
{r:A few entirely new ideas were proposed.} - Bir nechta butunlay yangi g'oyalar taklif qilindi.
{r:Many people were entirely satisfied with the results.} - Ko'p odamlar natijalar bilan butunlay qoniqishdi.

text: {r:Partnership}[pɑːrtˈnərʃɪp] - hamkorlik, partnerstvo. Partner(hamkor) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She always values partnership in her work.} - U o'z ishidagi hamkorlikni har doim qadrlaydi.
{r:Fortunately they offered our company a partnership.} - Yaxshiyamki ular kompaniyamizga hamkorlikni taklif qilishdi.
{r:A few partnership agreements were signed.} - Bir nechta hamkorlik shartnomalari imzolandi.
{r:Many people believe partnership leads to success.} - Ko'p odamlar hamkorlik muvaffaqiyatga olib keladi deb hisoblaydi.

text: {r:Mouth}[maʊθ] - og'iz. Mikki {p:Maus}ni nafaqat o'zi botir, balki uning {h:og'zi} ham botir.
examples: {r:He always covers his mouth when he coughs.} - U yo'talganida har doim og'zini yopadi.
{r:The artist gave the figure a small mouth.} - Rassom haykalga kichik og'iz berdi.
{r:Mouth is below the moustache.} - Og'iz mo'ylovdan pastda joylashgan.
{r:Make your mouth firm and don't reveal the secrets.} - Og'zingni mahkam qil va sirlarni ochma.

text: {r:Nose}[noʊz] – burun. Toshkentning eng antiqa metro bekati hech shubhasiz {p:NO’VZ}a bekati. Chunki u yerda {h:burun}ning haykali bor.
examples: {r:She always wrinkles her nose when she’s confused.} - U chalkashganida har doim burnini burishtiradi.
{r:The artist gave the statue a classic nose.} - Rassom haykalga klassik burun berdi.
{r:He gave the mask to me to cover my nose.} - U menga maska berdi burnimni qoplashim uchun.
{r:Many people use tissues to clean their nose.} - Ko'p odamlar burnini tozalash uchun salfetkalardan foydalanishadi.

text: {r:Victim}[ˈvɪktɪm] - qurbon.
examples: {r:He always helps the victims of accidents.} - U har doim baxtsiz hodisa qurbonlariga yordam beradi.
{r:They gave the victim some help.} - Ular jabrlanuvchiga yordam berishdi.
{r:They gave some help to the victim.} - Ular jabrlanuvchiga yordam berishdi.
{r:Many people feel sympathy for the victims.} - Ko'p odamlar qurbonlarga hamdardlik his qilishadi.

text: {r:Threat}[θrɛt] - tahdid, po'pisa. Instagramda mashhur bo'lib ketgan oshpaz nu{p:SRET} 2017 - yilda sobiq xodimiga {h:tahdid qilish}da ayblanib sudlandi va 300 000$ jarima to'lab ozodlikka chiqdi.
examples: {r:She always takes threats seriously.} - U tahdidlarni har doim jiddiy qabul qiladi.
{r:He sent his enemy a threat.} - U dushmaniga tahdid yubordi.
{r:The journalist received threats after writing a bold article.} - Jurnalist jasur maqolasidan so'ng tahdidlar qabul qila boshladi.
{r:Rain is a big threat to the bird nests.} - Yomg'ir qush inlariga katta tahdid.

text: {r:Responsible}[rɪˈspɒnsəbl] - ma'suliyatli, javobgar.
examples: {r:He always feels responsible for his team.} - U har doim o'z jamoasiga javobgar his qiladi.
{r:Anvar is a responsible guy.} - Anvar ma'suliyatli yigit.
{r:A few responsible decisions were made.} - Bir nechta mas'uliyatli qarorlar qabul qilindi.
{r:Responsible leaders give strong statements.} - Ma'suliyatli rahbarlar kuchli bayonotlar berishadi.

text: {r:Smile}[smaɪl] - kulmoq; tabassum. {p:SMAYL}iklar telefondagi {h:tabassumlar} ekanligini bilsangiz kerak.
examples: {r:She always smiles when she’s happy.} - U xursand bo'lganda har doim tabassum qiladi.
{r:She gave her friend a big smile.} - U do'stiga katta tabassum hadya qildi.
{r:He had a cheerful smile on his face.} - Uning yuzida xushchaqchaq tabassum bor edi.
{r:Many people believe a smile can change everything.} - Ko'p odamlar tabassum hamma narsani o'zgartirishi mumkin deb hisoblaydi.

text: {r:Score}[skɔːr] - hisob, ochko; gol urmoq, qandaydir hisobni qayd etmoq.
examples: {r:He always checks the score during the game.} - U o'yin davomida har doim hisobni tekshiradi.
{r:The coach sent the team the final score.} - Murabbiy jamoaga yakuniy hisobni yubordi.
{r:Powerful teams usually score first.} - Qudratli jamoalar odatda birinchi hisobni ochadi.
{r:Many people celebrate when their team scores.} - Ko'p odamlar o'z jamoasi gol urganida nishonlashadi.

text: {r:Audience}[ˈɔːdiəns] - tomoshabinlar, auditoriya.
examples: {r:She always performs well in front of an audience.} - U tomoshabinlar oldida har doim yaxshi ijro etadi.
{r:The singer gave the audience a great show.} - Xonanda tomoshabinlarga ajoyib shou taqdim etdi.
{r:A few audience members left early.} - Bir nechta tomoshabinlar erta ketishdi.
{r:The television viewer is part of a large audience.} - Televizor tomoshabini katta auditoriyaning bir qismidir.

text: {r:Vote}[voʊt] - ovoz bermoq; ovoz(saylovda). Ba'zi bir irimchi siyosatchilar 'Agar saylov kuni {p:VOT}ata(karnay) chaldirsam yutib ketaman. Hamma menga {h:ovoz beradi.}' deb o'ylarkan.
examples: {r:He seldom votes in elections.} - U kamdan-kam saylovlarda ovoz beradi.
{r:He gave the right candidate his vote.} - U yaxshi nomzodga ovozini berdi.
{r:Violences began during voting.} - Ovoz berish chog'ida zo'ravonliklar boshlanib ketdi.
{r:We vote mostly for older candidates.} - Biz asosan qariroq nomzodlarga ovoz beramiz.
{r:He does not like all candidates and he is not going to vote this time on purpose.} - U hech qaysi nomzodlarni yoqtirmaydi va bu safar ataylab ovoz bermoqchi emas.

text: {r:Citizen}[ˈsɪtɪzən] – fuqaro. Agar Italiya fuqaroligini qabul qilmoqchi bo’lsangiz mamlakatda 5 yil yashashingiz kerak. Fuqarolik olish chog’ida mamlakatda keng tarqalgan meva {p:IT UZUM}ni yeb qasamyod qabul qilasiz yangi {h:fuqaro} sifatida.
examples: {r:She always respects the rights of every citizen.} - U har bir fuqaroning huquqlarini har doim hurmat qiladi.
{r:The government gave every citizen equal rights.} - Hukumat har bir fuqaroga teng huquqlar berdi.
{r:Every citizen deserves to live with dignity.} - Har bir fuqaro qadr-qimmat bilan yashashga loyiqdir.
{r:The citizen relaxed in the park after a long day at work.} – Fuqaro ish kunidan keyin parkda hordiq chiqardi.

text: {r:Prevention}[prɪˈvɛnʃən] - oldini olish. Prevent(oldini olmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He always focuses on prevention rather than cure.} - U har doim davolashdan ko'ra oldini olishga e'tibor qaratadi.
{r:There’s too much emphasis on prevention these days.} - Bugungi kunda oldini olishga juda ko'p e'tibor qaratilmoqda.
{r:They collect data for a project on divorce prevention} – Ular ajralishni oldini olish loyihasi uchun ma’lumot to‘plashmoqda.
{r:Many people believe prevention is better than cure.} - Ko'p odamlar oldini olish davolashdan yaxshiroq deb hisoblaydi.

text: {r:Bear}[beər] – ayiq. Bir zamonlar g’orda yashovchi ayiq yosh qizni g’orga olib qochib ketibdi. Lekin qizning tili {p:BIYR}on ekan. “Hoy {h:ayiq}…” deya gap boshlab ayiqni gap-so’zlari bilan rosa egovlabdi. Ayiq esa oxiri “sening menga keraging yo’q” deya qizni qaytib qishlog’iga olib borib tashlagan ekan.
examples: {r:The zoo must maintain a safe fence to keep the bear inside.} – Hayvonot bog‘i ayiqlarni ichkarida saqlash uchun xavfsiz panjarani ta’minlashi kerak.
{r:The zoo showed the visitors a big bear.} - Hayvonot bog'i tashrif buyuruvchilarga katta ayiqni ko'rsatdi.
{r:The bear used its teeth to pull a thick branch from the tree} – Ayiq tishlari bilan daraxtdan qalin shoxni tortib oldi.
{r:This brown bear has a white tail.} - Bu jigarrang ayiq oq dumga ega.

text: {r:Admit}[ədˈmɪt] – tan olmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz O'rta Asrlarda okeanda suzib ketyapsiz. Kema Angliya qiroliga tegishli. {h:Tan olish} uyatli lekin bir g’alati narsani aytaman kema {p:ADM}irali {p:IT.} Ingliz qirolining sevimli iti bo’lgani uchun admiral qilib qo’yishgan. U qaysi tarafga qarab akillasa o’sha tarafga qarab suzamiz.
examples: {r:He always admits his mistakes.} - U har doim o'z xatolarini tan oladi.
{r:She admitted that she had divorced twice in her life} – U hayotida ikki marta ajrashganini tan oldi.
{r:Anyway you should admit your errors.} - Nima bo'lsa ham xatolaringni tan olishing kerak.
{r:Many people respect those who admit their faults.} - Ko'p odamlar o'z kamchiliklarini tan olganlarni hurmat qilishadi.

text: {r:Senior}[ˈsiːniər] - katta(yosh va lavozim uchun ishlatiladi).
examples: {r:She always respects her senior colleagues.} - U har doim o'zining katta yoshdagi hamkasblarini hurmat qiladi.
{r:We gave the senior some good advice.} - Biz keksaga ba'zi yaxshi maslahatlar berdik.
{r:A few senior members retired this year.} - Bu yili bir nechta katta yoshdagi a'zolar nafaqaga chiqdi.
{r:Many people seek advice from senior professionals.} - Ko'p odamlar katta yoshdagi mutaxassislardan maslahat so'rashadi.

text: {r:Assume}[əˈsjuːm] – taxmin qilmoq, mo’ljallamoq; gardaniga olmoq. Men: Bolam sen rosa sho’xsan, esing yo’q seni. Bolam: Dada geometriyada shakllarni o’rganyapmiz. {p:ES YUM}aloq bo’ladimi yoki to’rtburchakmi? Men: Mening {h:taxminimcha} es uchburchak bo’ladi.
examples: {r:I assume your shyness is your biggest enemy.} - Mening taxminimcha sening uyalchangliging eng katta dushmaning.
{r:There’s too much to assume without evidence.} - Dalilsiz taxmin qilish uchun juda ko'p narsa bor.
{r:I assumed he knew the answer, but his curious questions proved otherwise.} – Men u javobni biladi deb o‘ylagandim, lekin uning qiziquvchan savollari aksini isbotladi.
{r:We assumed he would recover quickly, but the healing took much longer than expected.} – Biz u tezda sog‘ayib ketadi deb o‘ylagandik, ammo tiklanish kutilganidan ancha uzoq davom etdi.

text: {r:Treat}[triːt] - davolamoq.
examples: {r:The doctor treated the patient for a viral infection.} - Shifokor bemorni virusli infeksiya uchun davoladi.
{r:She was treated with antibiotics to fight the bacteria.} - U bakteriyani yo'qotish uchun antibiotiklar bilan davolandi.
{r:They treated his wound with antiseptic.} - Ular uning jarohatini antiseptik bilan davolashdi.
{r:He was treated at a specialized clinic for his condition.} - U kasalligi uchun maxsus klinikada davolandi.

text: {r:Expert}[ˈɛkspɜːrt] - ekspert
examples: {r:An expert gave a clever and accurate answer to the complex question.} - Ekspert murakkab savolga aqlli va aniq javob berdi.
{r:He became an expert in his field in five years.} - U besh yilda o'z sohasida ekspert bo'ldi.
{r:He needed expert guidance for his complex project.} - Unga murakkab loyihasi uchun ekspert yo'l-yo'rig'i kerak edi.
{r:The team needed an expert at that exact time.} - Jamoaga aynan o'sha vaqtda ekspert kerak edi.

text: {r:Admit}[ədˈmɪt] - qabul qilmoq. O'tgan darslarda 'admit' ning 'tan olmoq' ma'nosini o'rgangan edik. Qarangki uning yana bir muhim va keng qo'llaniladigan ma'nosi mavjud ekan.
examples: {r:The guard admitted the guests into the VIP section.} - Qo'riqchi mehmonlarni VIP bo'limga kiritdi.
{r:She was admitted to the university after passing the exam.} - U imtihonni muvaffaqiyatli topshirgandan keyin universitetga qabul qilindi.
{r:They admitted only members into the private event.} - Ular faqat a'zolarni xususiy tadbirga kiritishdi.
{r:The club admitted new members last month.} - Klub o'tgan oy yangi a'zolarni qabul qildi.

text: {r:Debate}[dɪˈbeɪt] - bahs, debat; bahs qilmoq
examples: {r:The big debate will be on Tuesday.} - Katta bahs seshanba kuni bo'ladi.
{r:They had a long debate in the morning.} - Ular ertalab uzoq bahslashishdi.
{r:The students prepared for the debate at night.} - Talabalar bahsga tunda tayyorlanishdi.
{r:Many people enjoy watching debates on TV in the evening.} - Ko'p odamlar kechqurun televizorda bahslarni tomosha qilishni yoqtirishadi.

text: {r:Bell}[bɛl] – qong’iroq. Tasavvur qiling {p:bel}ingizga {h:qo’ng’iroq} rasmli tatu chizdirdingiz. Odamlarning ‘nega aynan qo’ng’iroq’ degan savoliga esa 'maktabga qo’ng’iroq chalinishidan oldin yetib borish uchun va darslarni o’tkazib yubormaslik uchun' deb javob berdingiz.
examples: {r:The school bell rings at 8 o'clock.} - Maktab qo'ng'irog'i soat 8 da jiringlaydi.
{r:He heard the bell on his way home on a sunny day.} - U uyiga ketayotganida, quyoshli kunda qo'ng'iroq ovozini eshitdi.
{r:The church bells ring in the morning.} - Cherkov qo'ng'iroqlari ertalab jiringlaydi.
{r:They installed a new bell in December.} - Ular dekabr oyida yangi qo'ng'iroq o'rnatishdi.

text: {r:Investigate}[ɪnˈvɛstɪɡeɪt] - tergov qilmoq, tekshirmoq.
examples: {r:The police started to investigate at noon.} - Politsiya tushdan keyin tergovni boshladi.
{r:They will investigate the prominent case on Monday.} - Ular mashhur ishni dushanba kuni tergov qilishadi.
{r:The company will investigate the problem in May.} - Kompaniya muammoni may oyida tekshiradi.
{r:He decided to investigate the claims in the evening.} - U da'volarni kechqurun tekshirishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Sunset}[ˈsʌnset] - quyosh botishi.
examples: {r:The sunset at 7 p.m. was beautiful.} - Soat 7 da quyosh botishi go'zal edi.
{r:There's too much beauty in a sunset on a clear day.} - Ochiq kunda quyosh botishida juda ko'p go'zallik bor.
{r:A few sunset photos were taken in July.} - Iyul oyida bir nechta quyosh botishi fotosuratlari olingan.
{r:Many people enjoy watching the sunset at the weekend.} - Ko'p odamlar dam olish kunlari quyosh botishini tomosha qilishni yoqtirishadi.

text: {r:Sunrise}[ˈsʌnraɪz] - quyosh chiqishi
examples: {r:The sunrise at 6 a.m. was breathtaking.} - Soat 6 da quyosh chiqishi hayratlanarli edi.
{r:There's too much peace during sunrise on a quiet morning.} - Ertalab quyosh chiqishi paytida juda ko'p tinchlik bor.
{r:I held my cup and watched the sunrise.} – Men krushkamni ushlab, quyosh chiqishini tomosha qildim.
{r:Many people wake up early to see the sunrise.} - Ko'p odamlar quyosh chiqishini ko'rish uchun erta turishadi.

text: (to be) {r:Born}[bɔːrn] - tug'ilmoq. Hamma ona qornidan oyog'i bilan tushsa mana bu yigit birinchi {p:BURN}i bilan chiqib kelib {h:tug'ilgan} ekan.
examples: {r:He was born in April.} - U aprel oyida tug'ilgan.
{r:She was born on a cold winter day.} - U sovuq qish kunida tug'ilgan.
{r:The baby was born at 3 o'clock in the morning.} - Chaqaloq ertalab soat 3 da tug'ilgan.
{r:More people are born in the summer.} - Ko'proq odamlar yozda tug'iladi.

text: {r:Suffer}[ˈsʌfər] - aziyat chekmoq, ...dan qiynalmoq. Andijondan Xorazmgacha bo'lgan {p:SAFAR} va undagi doimiy charchoq va uyqusizlikdan bizning jamoamiz {h:aziyat chekdi}.
examples: {r:She always suffers from headaches at night.} - U har doim tunda bosh og'rig'idan aziyat chekadi.
{r:Many people suffer in silence during difficult times.} - Ko'p odamlar qiyin paytlarda jimlikda azob chekishadi.
{r:The country suffered greatly in the past two years.} - Mamlakat o'tgan ikki yilda katta aziyat chekdi.
{r:He suffered a lot on that long journey.} - U o'sha uzoq safarda ko'p azob chekdi.

text: {r:Boast}[boʊst] - maqtanmoq. Mening bobom har doim {h:maqtanardi} 'Men {p:BO'Z} tuproqli yerlarga ishlov berib, mehnat qilib {p:BO'ST}onga aylantirganman' deb.
examples: {r:Normally he does not boast about his achievements.} - Odatda u yutuqlari haqida maqtanmaydi.
{r:She likes to boast about her wins in the evening.} - U g'alabalari haqida kechqurun maqtanadi.
{r:His boasting was clear on the day of the competition.} - Uning maqtanishi musobaqa kuni aniq edi.
{r:Our school boasts a large library.} – Bizning maktab katta kutubxonasi bilan maqtanadi.

text: {r:Solely}[ˈsoʊlli] - faqatgina, yolg'iz. Sole(yolg'iz) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:She solely focuses on her studies in the mornings.} - U faqat ertalab o'qishiga e'tibor qaratadi.
{r:This success was solely due to his hard work on that specific day.} - Bu muvaffaqiyat faqat uning o'sha kundagi aniq mashaqqatli mehnati tufayli edi.
{r:The decision was based solely on the facts in the report.} - Qaror faqat hisobotdagi faktlarga asoslangan edi.
{r:Many people prefer working solely on their projects at a quiet time.} - Ko'p odamlar o'z loyihalarida tinch vaqtda yolg'iz ishlashni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:Strict}[strɪkt] – qattiqqo’l. Otam har doim {h:qattiqqo’l} bo’lgan va qoidalar bilan yashagan. Yoshligimda har kuni bitta strobar shokoladi olib yerdim. Lekin bir kuni {p:STR}obar {p:IKT}a olganimni otam bilib qoldi va ikkisini ham axlatga tashlab yubordi. Endi bilsam otam har doim tishlarim sog’lom bo’lishini istagan ekanlar.
examples: {r:He is always strict with his students at school.} - U maktabda har doim o'z talabalariga qattiq qoidalar qo'yadi.
{r:The rules were strict in the past.} - Qoidalar ilgari qattiq edi.
{r:She is strict and doesn’t waste any time.} – U qattiqqo‘l va umuman vaqtni isrof qilmaydi.
{r:The prison is situated far from the city and has strict security.} – Qamoqxona shahardan uzoqda joylashgan va qattiq qo‘riqlanadi.

text: {r:Partly}[ˈpɑːrtli] - qisman. Tasavvur qiling siz {h:qisman} {p:PATLI} odamsiz.
examples: {r:She is partly responsible for the mistake.} - U xatoga qisman javobgardir.
{r:The work was only partly done in the morning.} - Ish ertalab faqat qisman bajarildi.
{r:This matter is only partly important.} - Bu masala faqatgina qisman muhim.
{r:The list partly includes fruits, but not all of them.} – Ro‘yxat qisman mevalarni o‘z ichiga oladi, lekin barchasini emas.

text: {r:Deem}[diːm] - ..deb hisoblamoq, ..deb bilmoq. Ro'zg'orimda kamchiliklarim ko'p. Birinchi bo'lib uyni ovqat hidi bosmasligi uchun {p:DIM}oxod qurish kerak {h:deb hisoblayman}.
examples: {r:He always deems it necessary to help others.} - U har doim boshqalarga yordam berish zarur deb biladi.
{r:They deemed the event a success at the end of the day.} - Ular tadbirni kun oxirida muvaffaqiyatli deb hisoblashdi.
{r:The teacher deemed the boy rude for shouting against her.} – O‘qituvchi unga baqirgani uchun bolani qo‘pol deb hisobladi.
{r:I deemed his question reasonable.} – Men uning savolini o‘rinli deb hisobladim.

text: {r:Monkey}[ˈmʌŋki] – maymun. Maymunlar podshohi juda injiq ekan. {h:Maymun} hech narsa yeyishni xohlamayapti, faqatgina {p:MAN}darindan {p:QIY}om keltirishsa tanovul qilishi mumkin ekan.
examples: {r:The monkey climbed the tree at sunrise.} - Maymun quyosh chiqishi paytida daraxtga chiqdi.
{r:There is a new baby monkey born in the zoo in spring.} - Hayvonot bog'ida bahorda yangi maymuncha tug'ildi.
{r:The monkey's painting showed exceptional quality and artistic skill.} - Maymunning chizgan rasmi ajoyib sifat va badiiy mahoratni ko'rsatdi.
{r:Many people enjoy watching monkeys at the zoo.} - Ko'p odamlar hayvonot bog'ida maymunlarni tomosha qilishni yoqtirishadi.

text: {r:Lightning}[ˈlaɪtnɪŋ] – chaqmoq, yashin. Radio eshittirishimiz qushlar olamida juda mashhur. Bizni burgutlar, maynalar, laylaklar sevib eshitishadi. Chunki biz yomg’irlar, qorlar, do’llar, to’fonlar va chaqmoqlar haqida ma’lumot beramiz. Bugun yurtimizda yuqoridagilarning deyarli hech biri kutilmayapti lekin {p:LAY}Lak {p:TING}lovchilarimiz sizlar ehtiyot bo’ling. Agar baland stolbalarga in qurib olgan bo’lsangiz bugun bizda {h:chaqmoq} chaqish ehtimoli bor.
examples: {r:The lightning struck at midnight.} - Chaqmoq yarim kechada chaqdi.
{r:There’s too much danger during a lightning storm in summer.} - Yozda chaqmoq bo'roni paytida juda ko'p xavf bor.
{r:There was minor lightning in the evening.} - Kechqurun kichik chaqmoq bo'ldi.
{r:Many people are afraid of lightning at night.} - Ko'p odamlar tunda chaqmoqdan qo'rqishadi.

text: {r:Disturb}[dɪˈstɜːrb] – bezovta qilmoq. Men o’zim yetishtirgan ekinlarni cho’ntagimda olib yurishni yaxshi ko’raman. Masalan kecha {p:DIS}kotekaga {p:TURP}im bilan bordimda ikkita qo’limga ikkita turpni ushlab olib o’ynadim. Odamlar ko’rib qo’ysin turplarni qanday zo’r yetishtirganimni dedimda. Lekin diskoteka oxranasi meni bezovta qildi. “Agar mana shunaqa qiliqlar qilib odamlarni {h:bezovta qilsang} yo’qol” deyishdi. Men odamlarni bezovta qilmadim senlar meni bezovta qildilaring yaramaslar.
examples: {r:He always disturbs others during meetings.} - U har doim yig'ilishlar paytida boshqalarni bezovta qiladi.
{r:Please do not disturb him at this time.} - Iltimos, uni hozircha bezovta qilmang.
{r:I was disturbed by the thick dust on my blanket.} - Ko'rpamdagi qalin changdan bezovtalandim.
{r:Many people dislike being disturbed.} - Ko'p odamlar bezovta qilinishni yoqtirmaydilar.

text: {r:Ash}[æʃ] - kuya. Tasavvur qiling sizga qora kuya kerak bo'lib qoldi. Nima qilishni bilmay oxiri {p:ESH}igingizni yoqib yuborib {h:kuya} qildingiz.
examples: {r:The ash from the volcano covered the town.} - Vulqon kuli shaharni qoplagan.
{r:There was a lot of ash in the air after the fire at night.} - Yong'indan keyin tunda havoda juda ko'p kul bor edi.
{r:Don’t let the ash enter your body.} – Kulning tanangga kirishiga yo‘l qo‘yma.
{r:The ash in the air made the government cancel all flights.} – Havodagi kul sababli hukumat barcha reyslarni bekor qildi.

text: {r:Slave}[sleɪv] – qul. Tasavvur qiling siz Amir Temur saroyida xizmatchisiz. O’zingizning oylik daromadingizdan tashqari {p:Sa}royda {p:LEYVI} ham qilib pul topasiz(noqonuniy yo’llar bilan degani norasmiy ma’nosi). Sizning noqonuniy daromadingizdan xabar topgan Amir sizni {h:qul} qilishlarini buyurdi.
examples: {r:Robert was a skinny slave of a famous politician.} - Robert mashhur siyosatchining ozg'in quli edi.
{r:There’s too much history about slavery in this region.} - Bu mintaqada qullik haqida juda ko'p tarix bor.
{r:Some charged money by showing how slaves used to work.} – Ba'zilar qullar qanday ishlaganini ko‘rsatib haq olishdi.
{r:Slaves did not charge money for their service.} - Qullar xizmati uchun haq olishmagan.
{r:Many people are against any form of slavery.} - Ko'p odamlar qullikning har qanday shakliga qarshi.

text: {r:Depart}[dɪˈpɑːrt] – jo’namoq, jo’nab ketmoq. Rossiya Ukraina urushi boshlanganidan so’ng 15 yildan beri Rossiya fuqaroligiga ega bo’lgan fransuz aktyori {p:DEPARD}iye Rossiyadan va nihoyat butunlay {h:jo’nab ketdi}.
examples: {r:The train seldom departs on time.} - Poyezd kamdan-kam o'z vaqtida jo'naydi.
{r:There’s too much preparation before departure.} - Jo'nashdan oldin juda ko'p tayyorgarlik bor.
{r:Prominent politician will depart soon to travel throughout the country.} - Mashhur siyosatchi tez orada mamlakat bo'ylab sayohat qilish uchun jo'nab ketadi.
{r:The crowd departed from the stadium.} - Olomon stadiondan chiqib ketdi.

text: {r:Spare}[spɛər] - qo'shimcha, zaxiradagi.
examples: {r:He always keeps a spare key, particularly for his home.} - U har doim zaxira kalitni saqlaydi, ayniqsa uyinikini.
{r:Do you have any spare time on Saturday?} - Shanba kuni bo'sh vaqtingiz bormi?
{r:A few spare parts were used for repairs.} - Ta'mirlash uchun bir nechta zaxira qismlar ishlatildi.
{r:Many people want to have spare time in the evening.} - Ko'p odamlar kechqurun bo'sh vaqtga ega bo'lishni xohlaydi.

text: {r:Mission}[ˈmɪʃən] - missiya, topshiriq, vazifa.
examples: {r:The rescue mission lasted from morning to night.} - Qutqaruv missiyasi ertalabdan kechgacha davom etdi.
{r:We will work on this mission until Saturday.} - Biz bu missiya ustida shanbagacha ishlaymiz.
{r:This new mission will bring benefits and help us move forward.} - Bu yangi missiya foyda keltiradi va bizga oldinga siljishga yordam beradi.
{r:They prepared for the mission for many hours.} - Ular missiyaga ko'p soat davomida tayyorlanishdi.

text: {r:Participant}[pɑːrˈtɪsɪpənt] - ishtirokchi. Participate(ishtirok etmoq so'zidan yasalgan.)
examples: {r:The event had participants from July to August.} - Tadbirda iyuldan avgustgacha ishtirokchilar bor edi.
{r:All participants must register until 5 p.m.} - Barcha ishtirokchilar soat 5 gacha ro'yxatdan o'tishlari kerak.
{r:She has been a participant in the program since last year.} - U o'tgan yildan beri dasturda ishtirokchi bo'lib kelmoqda.
{r:He trained for the competition for three months.} - U musobaqaga uch oy davomida tayyorlandi.

text: {r:Comply}[kəmˈplaɪ] – bo’ysunmoq, itoat etmoq, rioya qilmoq. Egasi Rossiyaga ketgan laycha it “Men egamga {h:bo’ysunaman} va qayerga borsa men ham o’sha yerga borib xizmat qilaman’’ debdi va {p:KOMP}asni shimolga qaratib Rossiyaga yo’lga tushibdi {p:LAY}cha it.
examples: {r:The company complied with the rules from the start to the end of the year.} - Kompaniya yil boshidan oxirigacha qoidalarga rioya qildi.
{r:You must entirely comply with the terms continuously.} - Doimo shartlarga butunlay rioya qilishingiz kerak.
{r:He is not complying with rules on purpose.} - U ataylab qoidalarga rioya qilmayapti.
{r:They always comply with orders for their safety.} - Ular xavfsizliklari uchun har doim buyruqlarga rioya qilishadi.

text: {r:Equal}[ˈiːkwəl] – teng. Ikra yemoqchimiz akam bilan. Ikkita vilka, bitta qoshiq bor ekan. Akamga qoshiqni berib o’zimga vilkani oldim, lekin akam '{h:tenglik} bo’lsin ukajon {p:IK}rani{p: VIL}ka bilan yeymiz ikkalamiz ham' dedilar.
examples: {r:Their scores were equal from the first round to the last.} - Ularning ballari birinchi raunddan oxirigacha teng edi.
{r:Slave owners did not deem slaves as equal with free people.} - Qul egalari qullarni erkin odamlar bilan teng hisoblamagan.
{r:We have worked for equal rights since the 1990s.} - Biz 1990-yillardan beri teng huquqlar uchun kurashdik.
{r:They fought for equality for many years.} - Ular ko'p yillar davomida tenglik uchun kurashishdi.

text: {r:Retire}[rɪˈtaɪər] – nafaqaga chiqmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz {h:nafaqaga} chiqqan kuningiz {p:RED}iskali {p:AYR}on ichib nishonlayapsiz. Sizning og'aynilaringiz esa bira to'la spirtli ichimlik ichishyapti.
examples: {r:He worked solely from 1980 to 2020 and then retired.} - U 1980-yildan 2020-yilgacha yolg'iz ishladi va keyin nafaqaga chiqdi.
{r:She will work until next year before retiring.} - U nafaqaga chiqishdan oldin kelasi yilgacha ishlaydi.
{r:My father has been retired since last month.} - Otam o'tgan oydan beri nafaqada.
{r:Many people save money for many years before they retire.} - Ko'p odamlar nafaqaga chiqishdan oldin ko'p yillar davomida pul yig'adilar.

text: {r:Graduate}[ˈɡrædʒuət] – o’qishni bitirmoq. Biz yoshligimizda it, mushuklarni dadam garajda davolar edilar. Bizga ham o'rgatdilar va hayvonlarni davolashni yaxshi o'rgandik. Lekin rasman bu sohada o'qiy olmadim. Shuning uchun har doim aytaman men '{p:GARAJ}da {p:VET}erinariyani {h:bitirganman.}'
examples: {r:She studied from 2015 to 2019 and then graduated.} - U 2015-yildan 2019-yilgacha o'qidi va keyin bitirdi.
{r:He will continue studying until he graduates.} - U bitirguncha o'qishni davom ettiradi.
{r:We have known him since he graduated from university.} - Biz uni universitetni bitirganidan beri bilamiz.
{r:The students prepared for graduation for a long time.} - Talabalar bitiruvga uzoq vaqt davomida tayyorlanishdi.

text: {r:Disappointment}[ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntmənt] - xafagarchilik. Disappoint(xafa qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Adding more rules would only complicate the entire process and cause more disappointment.} - Ko'proq qoidalar qo'shish butun jarayonni murakkablashtiradi va ko'proq xafagarchilikka sabab bo'ladi.
{r:He was disappointed until the good news arrived.} - Yaxshi xabar kelguncha u xafa edi.
{r:I have felt disappointment since the competition ended.} - Musobaqa tugagandan beri men xafa bo'ldim.
{r:The team worked hard for many weeks, but still felt disappointment.} - Jamoa ko'p haftalar davomida qattiq ishladi, ammo baribir xafagarchilikni his qildi.

text: {r:Fine}[faɪn] - jarima; jarima solmoq. 4-darsda bu so'zning "yaxshi" degan ma'nosini o'rgangan edik. Quyidagi misollar orqali uning "jarima" ga oid ma'nolarini ham o'rganishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:The new law on fines will be active from next week to the end of the year.} - Jarimalar bo'yicha yangi qonun keyingi haftadan yil oxirigacha faol bo'ladi.
{r:You have time until tomorrow to pay the fine.} - Jarimani to'lash uchun ertagacha vaqtingiz bor.
{r:He has been paying fines since he started driving.} - U mashina haydashni boshlaganidan beri jarimalar to'lab kelmoqda.
{r:The city collected fines for months.} - Shahar bir necha oy davomida jarimalar yig'di.

text: {r:Chill}[tʃɪl] - mazza qilmoq, zavqlanmoq, tinchlanmoq. Men 40 yosh bo'lsam ham hozirgacha bolalar bilan {p:CHILL}ak o'ynab {h:maza qilaman}.
examples: {r:Several friends of mine are chilling in the mountains without me.} - Bir nechta do'stlarim tog'da mensiz maza qilishyapti.
{r:We are chilling with pretty people at Anna's.} - Biz Annalarnikida ajoyib odamlar bilan dam olib o'tiribmiz.
{r:Guys chill out! Everything is ok.} - Yigitlar tinchlaning! Hammasi joyida.
{r:Chill out David! The train departs in 2 hours.} - David tinchlan! Poyezd 2 soatdan so'ng jo'naydi.

text: {r:Thrive}[θraɪv] - rivojlanmoq, gullab yashnamoq. Mana bu yigit qaynotasining ishxonasida tez {h:rivojlanib} ko'tarilib ketdi. Xotini va qaynotasiga qanday paxta qo'yishni yaxshi bilgan yigit xotini ismini o'ziga familiya qilib oldi. Hozir familiyasi {p:SURAYOYEV}.
examples: {r:The weapon business thrived from 2010 to 2020.} - Qurol biznesi 2010-yildan 2020-yilgacha rivojlandi.
{r:The plants will thrive until the cold season starts.} - O'simliklar sovuq mavsum boshlanguncha rivojlanadi.
{r:This company has hardly thrived since its launch.} - Bu kompaniya ishga tushirilgandan beri zo'rg'a rivojlanyapti.
{r:They worked for many years to make the company thrive.} - Ular kompaniyani rivojlantirish uchun ko'p yillar davomida ishlashdi.

text: {r:Nut}[nʌt] – yong’oq. Topqir Xitoyliklar endi {h:yong’oq} ko’rinishidagi gra{p:NAT}lar ishlab chiqaryapti. Bu ayyorlik dushmanlarni chalg’itishi kutilyapti.
examples: {r:The tree produced nuts from summer to autumn, particularly in August.} - Daraxt yozdan kuzgacha yong'oq berdi ayniqsa avgustda.
{r:We will collect nuts until the end of the month.} - Biz oy oxirigacha yong'oq yig'amiz.
{r:She has been eating nuts since childhood.} - U bolaligidan beri yong'oq yeb kelmoqda.
{r:He gathered nuts for a few hours.} - U bir necha soat davomida yong'oq yig'di.

text: {r:Chew}[tʃuː] - chaynamoq. Agar birorta shirinlik yeyotganingizda umringizda uchratmagan tamni his qilsangiz bilinki siz shirinlikka kelgan {p:CHU}molini {h:chaynab} qo'ygansiz.
examples: {r:He chewed gum from morning till afternoon.} - U ertalabdan tushgacha saqich chaynab yurdi.
{r:Keep chewing until it loses its flavor.} - Mazasi yo'qolguncha chaynab turing.
{r:She has been chewing ice since the hot day began.} - U issiq kun boshlanganidan beri muz chaynab kelmoqda.
{r:They chewed their food for a long time.} - Ular ovqatlarini uzoq vaqt chaynadilar.

text: {r:Forest}[ˈfɒrɪst] – Fonarlar bilan qoplangan restoranga qanday qilib borish mumkinligini bilasizmi. {p:Fo}narli {p:rest}oranga faqat {h:o’rmon} orqali borish mumkin. O’rmonga restoranning nurlari tushib yuradi, shuning uchun yo’l yop-yorug’.
examples: {r:The trip lasted from sunrise to sunset in the forest.} - Sayohat o'rmonda quyosh chiqishidan quyosh botishigacha davom etdi.
{r:They will certainly explore the forest until it gets dark.} - Ular albatta qorong'u tushguncha o'rmonni o'rganishadi.
{r:We have walked in this forest since childhood.} - Biz bolaligimizdan beri bu o'rmonda sayr qilib kelamiz.
{r:He formerly owned this forest.} - Avval shu o'rmonga u egalik qilardi.

text: {r:Judge}[dʒʌdʒ] – sudya, sud raisi. Tasavvur qiling sizning 10 yoshli o’g’lingiz yoki qarindoshingiz shu yoshida suddagi sudya bo’lib dunyodagi eng {p:JAJ}ji {h:sudya} bo’libdi.
examples: {r:The judge worked from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.} - Sudya ertalab soat 9 dan kechki soat 5 gacha ishladi.
{r:This judge needs no introduction, he is already popular.} - Bu sudyani tanishtirish shart emas, u allaqachon mashhur.
{r:He has been a judge since 2010.} - U 2010-yildan beri sudya bo'lib kelmoqda.
{r:Andrew is a former judge.} - Endryu sobiq sudya.

text: {r:Publish}[ˈpʌblɪʃ] - nashr etmoq, chiqarmoq. Bir qancha o'zbek geymerlari birgalikda '{p:PAB}jini {p:BILISH} kerak' nomli kitob yozib uni {h:nashrdan chiqarishdi}.
examples: {r:The book was partly published.} - Kitob qisman nashr etildi.
{r:They will edit the article until it is ready for publication.} - Ular maqolani nashrga tayyor bo'lguncha tahrirlashadi.
{r:This magazine has been published since 1999.} - Bu jurnal 1999-yildan beri nashr etiladi.
{r:She worked on her novel for a year before publishing.} - U romani ustida nashr etishdan oldin bir yil davomida ishladi.

text: {r:Release}[rɪˈliːs] - chiqarmoq(qo'shiq, kino, yangi mahsulot), ozodlikka chiqarmoq.
examples: {r:The movie was released from December to January.} - Film dekabrdan yanvargacha chiqarildi.
{r:They will promote the song until its release date.} - Ular qo'shiqni chiqarilish sanasigacha reklama qilishadi.
{r:Their purpose is to release the movie as soon as possible.} - Ularning maqsadi kinoni iloji boricha tezroq chiqarish.
{r:Of course the company prepared the product for months before its release.} - Kompaniya albatta mahsulotni chiqarilishidan oldin bir necha oy davomida tayyorladi.

text: {r:Miss}[mɪs] - o'tkazib yubormoq, nishonga tegmaslik.
examples: {r:I have 99 missed calls.} - Menda 99 ta o'tkazib yuborilgan qo'ng'iroq bor.
{r:You must not miss this chance until it's late.} - Bu imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy bermang kech bo'lmasidan.
{r:She has missed the target.} - U nishonga tekiza olmadi.
{r:I missed the bus twice.} - Avtobusni ikki marta o'tkazib yubordim.

text:
{r:Recall}[rɪˈkɔːl] – eslamoq.
 - Hindistonga borganda nimalar sizni hayratga soldi, nimalarni eslaysiz. 
 - {p:Rik}sha {p:ko’l}da ham harakatlanayotganini {h:eslayman.} Haydovchilar ishlashi kerak, shuning uchun oldidan jar chiqsa, suv chiqsa ham mijozni manzilga yetkazish kerak.
examples: {r:He recalled the events from his childhood to his adult life.} - U bolaligidan kattaligigacha bo'lgan voqealarni esladi.
{r:I couldn't recall her name until you mentioned it.} - Siz aytmaguningizcha uning ismini eslay olmadim.
{r:She has been recalling old memories since she visited her hometown.} - U tug'ilgan shahriga tashrif buyurganidan beri eski xotiralarni eslab kelmoqda.
{r:We tried to recall the details for a long time.} - Biz uzoq vaqt davomida tafsilotlarni eslashga harakat qildik.

text: {r:Stare}[stɛər] - tikilmoq, ko'z uzolmaslik. Mana bu {p:STYAR}dessa shunchalik go'zalki samolyotga chiqqan erkaklar undan {h:ko'z uzolishmaydi}.
examples: {r:He stared at the painting from morning till evening.} - U ertalabdan kechgacha rasmga tikilib turdi.
{r:Julia kept staring until he looked away.} - U boshqa tomonga qaramaguncha Julia unga tikilib turdi.
{r:They have been staring at the screen since afternoon.} - Ular tushdan beri ekranga tikilib turishibdi.
{r:He stared at the sky for a long time.} - U uzoq vaqt davomida osmonga tikilib turdi.

text: {r:Safety}[ˈseɪfti] - xavfsizlik. Mana bu seyflarni bizdan sotib olsangiz pullaringizni qo'riqlash uchun katta it ham qo'shib beramiz. {p:SEYF ITI} pullaringiz {h:xavfsizligini} ta'minlashda yordam beradi.
examples: {r:The safety measures were in place from January to December.} - Xavfsizlik choralari yanvardan dekabrgacha amalda bo'ldi.
{r:The knife is usually kept in the kitchen drawer for safety.} - Pichoq odatda oshxona tortmasida xavfsizlik uchun saqlanadi.
{r:We have improved safety since the accident.} - Biz baxtsiz hodisadan beri xavfsizlikni yaxshiladik.
{r:They discussed safety for an hour.} - Ular bir soat davomida xavfsizlikni muhokama qilishdi.

text: {r:Compliance}[kəmˈplaɪəns] - rioya qilish, amal qilish. Comply(amal qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Compliance with the rules is necessary at school} – Maktabda qoidalarga rioya qilish zarur.
{r:No violations were found after inspection.} - Tekshiruvdan keyin hech qanday qoida buzilishi topilmadi.
{r:Are you monitoring compliance during operations?} - Operatsiyalar davomida qonuniyatlarga rioya qilinishini kuzatyapsizmi?
{r:While auditing, we noticed full compliance.} - Audit paytida to'liq rioya qilinishini aniqladik.

text: {r:Sleeve}[sliːv] - yeng(kiyimdagi). Tasavvur qiling yengingizda mikroblar joylashib olgan va u yerda o'zlarining ta'lim markazlarini ochib olishgan. Masalan o'ng {h:yengingizda} mikroblarning 9-{p:SINIF}lari o'qiydi.
examples: {r:Fold sleeves before washing the shirt.} - Ko'ylakni yuvishdan oldin yenglarni buklang.
{r:She fixed the tear on the sleeves after noticing it.} - Yenglardagi yirtiqni payqagach u yengni tikib qo'ydi.
{r:My shirt's sleeves are too long.} - Ko'ylagimning yenglari juda uzun.
{r:While sewing, she adjusted both sleeves.} - Tikish paytida u ikkala yengni moslab oldi.

text: {r:Deliberate}[dɪˈlɪbərət] - atayin. Mana bu {p:DILI BRAT} manga {h:ataylab} suv sepib videoga olib ustimdan kulgan.
examples: {r:Plan before making deliberate changes.} - Atayin o'zgartirishlar kiritishdan oldin reja tuzing.
{r:They apologized after the deliberate act.} - Atayin harakatdan keyin uzr so'rashdi.
{r:Was this error deliberate during testing?} - Sinovlar davomida bu xato atayin qilinganmi?
{r:Breaking the rule deliberately often results in a fine.} - Qoidani ataylab buzish ko‘pincha jarimaga olib keladi..

text: {r:Attempt}[əˈtempt] - urinish, urinmoq.
examples: {r:Warm up before attempting the exercise.} - Mashqni boshlashdan oldin qizishib oling.
{r:Success came after several attempts.} - Bir necha urinishlardan keyin muvaffaqiyat qozonildi.
{r:Did you record attempts during trials?} - Sinovlar davomida urinishlarni yozib oldingizmi?
{r:While practicing, he improved his attempts.} - Mashq qilish paytida u urinishlarini yaxshiladi.
{r:Skinny guy made countless attempts to overcome the obstacle.} - Ozg'in yigit to'siqni yengish uchun son-sanoqsiz urinishlar qildi.

text: {r:Fame}[feɪm] - mashhurlik, shuhrat. Mnemonik namuna uchun famous(mashhur) ga qarang.
examples: {r:Train hard before seeking fame.} - Shuhrat qozonishdan oldin qattiq mashq qiling.
{r:Her attitude partly changed after achieving fame.} - Shuhrat qozonganidan keyin uning munosabati qisman o'zgardi.
{r:How do you handle pressure during fame?} - Mashhurlik paytida bosimni qanday boshqarasiz?
{r:While performing, she ignored her growing fame.} - Ijro etish paytida u o'sib borayotgan shuhratiga e'tibor bermadi.

text: {r:Departure}[dɪˈpɑːrtʃər] - jo'nash, ketish. Depart(jo'namoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Pack before departure time.} - Ketish vaqtidan oldin yuklaringizni tayyorlang.
{r:They called after our departure.} - Biz ketganimizdan keyin qo'ng'iroq qilishdi.
{r:Were there delays during departure?} - Ketish paytida kechikishlar bormidi?
{r:While preparing for departure, we found missing items.} - Ketishga tayyorlanish paytida yo'qolgan narsalarni topdik.

text: {r:Recruitment}[rɪˈkruːtmənt] - ishga qabul qilish. Recruit(ishga qabul qilish) so'zidan olingan.
examples: {r:Review CVs before recruitment starts.} - Ishga qabul boshlanishidan oldin rezyumelarni ko'rib chiqing.
{r:New policies were introduced after recruitment.} - Ishga qabul qilingandan keyin yangi qoidalar joriy qilindi.
{r:Are tests conducted during recruitment?} - Ishga qabul jarayonida testlar o'tkaziladimi?
{r:While recruiting, we focus on skills, therefore our employees are skilled.} - Ishga qabul qilish paytida biz ko'nikmalarga e'tibor qaratamiz shuning uchun bizning ishchilarimiz mahoratli.

text: {r:Access}[ˈækses] – dostup, kirish. Bu so'zning o’zbek tilida aniq bir tarjimasi yo’q. Rus tilida esa 'доступ' deyiladi. Biror narsadan foydalanishga bo’lgan huquq yoki imkoniyatni bildiradi.
examples: {r:Get permission before accessing files.} - Fayllarga kirishdan oldin ruxsat oling.
{r:I have access solely for this platform.} - Faqatgina shu tizimga kirish huquqim bor.
{r:Was access restricted during maintenance?} - Texnik xizmat ko'rsatish davomida kirish cheklanganmi?
{r:While accessing the database, be careful.} - Ma'lumotlar bazasiga kirish paytida ehtiyot bo'ling.

text: {r:Recovery}[rɪˈkʌvəri] - tuzalish, tiklanish. Recover(tuzalmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Recovery after surgery took so long.} - Operatsiyadan keyingi tiklanish ko'p vaqtni oldi.
{r:She had a quick recovery from stress.} - U stressdan tez tiklandi.
{r:Earth needs serious recovery.} - Yer sayyorasiga jiddiy tiklanish kerak.
{r:While recovering, avoid strenuous activity.} - Tiklanish paytida jismoniy zo'riqishdan saqlaning.

text: {r:Crisis}[ˈkraɪsɪs] - krizis.
examples: {r:Prepare plans before crisis hits.} - Inqiroz yuz berguncha rejalar tuzing.
{r:Perhaps new leaders will appear after the crisis.} - Balki inqirozdan keyin yangi yetakchilar paydo bo'ladi.
{r:How did you make payments during the crisis?} - Inqiroz davomida to'lovlarni qanday amalga oshirdingiz?
{r:Prevention of the crisis was almost impossible.} - Bu inqirozni oldini olish deyarli imkonsiz edi.
{r:The team worked hard to rescue people during the crisis.} - Jamoa inqiroz paytida odamlarni qutqarish uchun ko'p mehnat qildi.

text: {r:Wage}[weɪdʒ] – oylik. Amerikada do’stingiz fura haydaydi va 12 000$ {h:oylik} ishlab topadi. Buni eshitib siz “{p:VAY J}allod, men ham tez ketishim kerak. Grin karta qachon o’ynalardi?” dedingiz.
examples: {r:Negotiating before accepting the wage is beneficial.} - Ish haqini qabul qilishdan oldin muzokaralar olib borish foydalidir.
{r:Taxes were deducted after receiving wages.} - Ish haqini olganimizdan keyin soliqlar ushlab qolindi.
{r:Are wages paid on time during holidays?} - Bayramlar davomida ish haqi vaqtida to'lanadimi?
{r:While discussing wages, consider experience.} - Ish haqi haqida suhbatlashish paytida tajribani hisobga oling.

text: {r:Track}[træk] - izidan bormoq, kuzatmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz josus bo'lib ishlaysiz. {p:TREK}erga minib olib odamlarning ortidan {h:kuzatasiz}.
examples: {r:Check equipment before the track begins.} - Kuzatish boshlanishidan oldin uskunalarni tekshiring.
{r:Results were analyzed after tracking.} - Kuzatishdan keyin natijalar tahlil qilindi.
{r:Were there errors during tracking?} - Kuzatish davomida xatolar bormi?
{r:While tracking progress, take notes.} - Taraqqiyotni kuzatish paytida eslatma yozib boring.

text: {r:Freedom}[ˈfriːdəm] - ozodlik. Free(erkin) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:They are ready for freedom.} - Ular ozodlikka tayyor.
{r:He is a prominent member of the local community, a former freedom fighter.} - U mahalliy jamiyatda taniqli a'zo, sobiq ozodlik kurashchisi.
{r:How do you value freedom during travel?} - Sayohat davomida erkinlikni qanday qadrlaysiz?
{r:While enjoying freedom, respect others.} - Erkinlikdan bahramand bo'lish baravarida boshqalarga hurmat ko'rsating.
{r:He fought for the freedom and dignity of his people.} - U o'z xalqining erkinligi va qadr-qimmati uchun kurashdi.

text: {r:Object}[ˈɒbdʒɪkt] – qarshi chiqmoq, e’tiroz bildirmoq. Agar ayolimni bitta o’psam kulib qo’yadi, {p:O’PICH EKT}a bo’lsa {h:e’tiroz bildiradi}.
examples: {r:People objected to the present situation.} - Odamlar hozirgi holatga qarshi chiqishdi.
{r:They objected after hearing the plan.} - Rejani eshitgach, ular qarshi chiqishdi.
{r:Despite his stubborn personality, he has not objected.} - O'jar fe'l-atvoriga qaramay, u qarshi chiqmadi fikrimga.
{r:I never object to your decisions.} - Men hech qachon qarorlaringizga qarshi chiqmayman.

text: {r:Attitude}[ˈætɪtjuːd] - munosabat. Mana bu {p:ETIK TUT}tan qilingan. Bu sehrli etik. Agar uni kiyib yursangiz odamlarni sizga {h:munosabati} 100% o'zgaradi yaxshi tomonga.
examples: {r:Check your attitude before responding.} - Javob berishdan oldin munosabatingizni tekshiring.
{r:Her attitude improved after feedback.} - Fikr-mulohazalardan keyin uning munosabati yaxshilandi.
{r:Did attitude change during the project?} - Loyiha davomida munosabat o'zgardimi?
{r:While working, maintain positive attitude.} - Ishlash paytida ijobiy munosabatda bo'ling.
{r:His lazy attitude often leads to failure.} - Uning dangasa munosabati ko'pincha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka olib keladi.

text: {r:Labor}[ˈleɪbər] - mehnat. Tasavvur qiling siz ertayu-kech {p:LABAR}otoriyada {h:mehnat} qilasiz. U yerni har kuni 10 marta pol latta bilan artib chiqasiz.
examples: {r:Rest well before labor begins.} - Mehnat boshlanishidan oldin yaxshi dam oling.
{r:Wages were paid after completing labor.} - Mehnat tugagandan keyin ish haqi to'landi.
{r:Were breaks provided during labor?} - Mehnat davomida tanaffuslar berildimi?
{r:While laboring, use proper equipment.} - Mehnat qilish paytida mos uskunalardan foydalaning.

text: {r:Refer}[rɪˈfɜːr] - ta'rif bermoq, murojaat qilmoq. U biror narsani tilga olish, eslatib o‘tish yoki ma’lumot uchun boshqa joyga murojaat qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:Research before referring to sources.} - Manbalarga murojaat qilishdan oldin tadqiqot qiling.
{r:He referred to the character as a lonely man searching for meaning.} – U bu qahramonni ma'no izlayotgan yolg‘iz odam deb ta’rifladi.
{r:Did you refer notes during presentation?} - Taqdimot davomida eslatmalarga murojaat qildingizmi?
{r:Please refer to the map for the nearest entrance.} – Eng yaqin kirish joyi uchun iltimos, xaritaga murojaat qiling.

text: {r:Therefore}[ˈðɛərfɔːr] - shuning uchun.
examples: {r:They were indeed guilty, therefore they disturbed the investigation.} - Ular haqiqatdan aybdor edilar shuning uchun ham tergovga xalaqit berishdi.
{r:It was a major mistake; therefore, we had to start over.} – Bu katta xato edi, shuning uchun biz hammasini qayta boshlashga majbur bo‘ldik.
{r:She spent years on this painting; therefore, it’s worth displaying.} – U bu rasm ustida yillar sarfladi, shuning uchun uni ko‘rsatishga arziydi.
{r:She recovered within days; therefore, she didn’t need additional treatment.} – U bir necha kun ichida sog‘ayib ketdi, shuning uchun unga qo‘shimcha davolanish kerak bo‘lmadi.

text: {r:Investigation}[ɪnˌvɛstɪˈɡeɪʃən] - tergov.
examples: {r:Gather evidence before investigation starts.} - Tergov boshlanishidan oldin dalillarni to'plang.
{r:The truth emerged after thorough investigation.} - Puxta tergovdan keyin haqiqat oshkor bo'ldi.
{r:Were witnesses interviewed during investigation?} - Tergov davomida guvohlar bilan suhbatlashildimi?
{r:Adding more details can complicate any investigation.} - Qo'shimcha tafsilotlarni qo'shish har qanday tergovni murakkablashtirishi mumkin.
{r:The investigation will reveal the truth.} - Tekshiruv haqiqatni oshkor qiladi.

text: {r:Spirit}[ˈspɪrɪt] - kayfiyat, ruh. {h:Kayfiyatni} ko'tarish uchun eng yaxshi narsa menimcha bu {p:SPRAYT} ichimligi.
examples: {r:Laughter increases my spirit.} - Kulgi kayfiyatimni ko'taradi.
{r:A cheerful song made us all feel better, showing our spirit.} - Xushchaqchaq qo'shiq hammamizni yaxshi his qilishimizga sabab bo'ldi, bizning ruhimizni ko'rsatdi.
{r:Did you feel team spirit during challenge?} - Qiyinchilik paytida jamoa ruhini his qildingizmi?
{r:While competing, maintain fighting spirit.} - Musobaqalashish paytida kurash ruhini saqlang.

text: {r:Front}[frʌnt] - old, oldida. Adabiyot darsliklarida Ikkinchi jahon urushi payti frontga ketdi degan matnlarni ko'p ko'rgan bo'lsangiz kerak. {p:FRONT} bu urushning {h:old} qismi.
examples: {r:The car is parked in front of the house.} - Mashina uy oldida turibdi.
{r:She stood in front of the mirror in her room.} - U o'z xonasida oynaning oldida turdi.
{r:The teacher stood in front of the class.} - O'qituvchi sinf qarshisida turdi.
{r:There is a garden in front of the building.} - Binoning oldida bog' bor.

text: {r:Cousin}[ˈkʌzən] – amakivachcha, xolavachcha, tog’avachcha. Tasavvur qiling siz hamma amakivachcha, xolavachcha, tog’avachchalaringizga {p:KAZIN}aki tarqatib chiqyapsiz.
examples: {r:I and my cousin live on opposite sides of the city.} - Men va amakivachcham shaharning qarama-qarshi taraflarida yashaymiz.
{r:She is my favorite cousin among relatives.} - U qarindoshlar orasidagi eng sevimli amakivachcham.
{r:We played with our cousins in the park.} - Biz bog'da amakivachchalarimiz bilan o'ynadik.
{r:His cousin lives in Tashkent.} - Uning amakivachchasi Toshkentda yashaydi.
{r:My cousin's exceptional skill and practice were evident in his work.} - Amakivachchamning g'ayrioddiy mahorati va amaliyoti o'z ishida yaqqol ko'rinib turardi.

text: {r:Premise}[ˈprɛmɪs] - bino, inshoot, muassasa. Agar siz Toshkent aeroportida ishlasangiz oyligingiz plastik kartaga tushirib beriladi. Lekin {p:PREMYEZ} faqatgina aeroport {h:binosi hududida} naqd pul ko'rinishida beriladi.
examples: {r:The business premise is located in the city center.} - Biznes binosi shahar markazida joylashgan.
{r:They checked at the entrance of the premise.} - Ular binoni kirish joyida tekshirishdi.
{r:All visitors must register at the main premise.} - Barcha tashrif buyuruvchilar asosiy binoda ro'yxatdan o'tishlari kerak.
{r:There are many offices in this premise.} - Bu binoda ko'plab ofislar bor.

text: {r:Troop}[truːp] - qo'shin, armiya. Rossiya-Ukraina urushi boshlanganida Rossiyaning Voronej oblastida yashar edim. Rossiya birdaniga 10 000 lik qo'shinni bizning qishloqdan o'tkazgan va armiya {h:askarlari} men dalaga ekib qo'ygan {p:TRUP}larimni ustidan yurib payhon qilib ketishgan.
examples: {r:The troop marched in the streets.} - Qo'shin ko'chalarda yurdi.
{r:Timur's troop was the biggest at that time.} - Temurning armiyasi o'sha payti eng kattasi edi.
{r:The general wore his uniform with pride, knowing he was in charge of his troops.} - General o'z qo'shinlariga mas'ul ekanligini bilib, formasini faxr bilan kiyib yurdi.
{r:The troop was well-trained at the base.} - Qo'shin bazada yaxshi tayyorlangan edi.

text: {r:Client}[ˈklaɪənt] - klent, mijoz.
examples: {r:The lawyer met with his client at the office.} - Advokat mijozi bilan ofisda uchrashdi.
{r:She is a regular client at the salon in the city.} - U shahardagi salonning doimiy mijozidir.
{r:The client was satisfied with the service at the bank.} - Mijoz bankdagi xizmatdan mamnun edi.
{r:The guy on the corner is my regular client.} - Burchakdagi yigit mening doimiy mijozim.

text:
{r:Variety}[vəˈraɪəti] – turfa xillik; variant, sort; bir qancha.
- Juda ajoyib restoran ekan, yeyishga nima aytding? 
- {p:Ver}mishel {p:aytdi} ukam, bu yerda vermishelni bir nechta {h:varyantlari} bor va hammasi turfa xil, ta'mi biri ikkinchisini takrorlamaydi.
examples: {r:The store offers a variety of products in its main area.} - Do'kon o'zining asosiy hududida turli xil mahsulotlarni taklif etadi.
{r:She enjoys a variety of hobbies at home.} - U uyda turli xil hobbiylardan zavqlanadi.
{r:The garden has a variety of flowers on the ground.} - Bog'dagi yerda turli xil gullar bor.
{r:A variety of options are available at the counter.} - Peshtaxtada turli xil variantlar mavjud.

text: {r:Bottle}[ˈbɒtl] – shisha, baklashka. Tasavvur qiling Botir ismli do’stingiz {h:baklashkadan} fanta ichayotgan paytda tilini kesib oldi. Endi u ismini so’rashsa “{p:BOTL}, meni ismim” deb javob beryapti.
examples: {r:He drank a bottle of water in the car.} - U mashinada bir baklashka suv ichdi.
{r:The bottle was empty on the table.} - Baklashka stol ustida bo'sh edi.
{r:She found a bottle of vodka by chance under her husband's table.} - Erining stoli tagidan tasodifan u bir shisha aroq topib oldi.
{r:The baby drank from the bottle in her bed.} - Chaqaloq o'z kravatida shishadan ichdi.

text: {r:Label}[ˈleɪbəl] – yorliq, etiketka. Bir kuni {p:LAY}cha {p:BIL}et sotib olibdi kinoteatrga. Biletning chekkasida {h:etiketkasi} bor ekan “Itlar faqat orqada o’tirsin” degan.
examples: {r:The label on the package was torn.} - Paketdagi yorliq yirtilgan edi.
{r:She read the label carefully at the store.} - U do'konda yorliqni diqqat bilan o'qidi.
{r:The label says "Fragile" on the box.} - Qutidagi yorliqda "Mo'rt" deb yozilgan.
{r:He forgot to label the boxes in the garage.} - U garajdagi qutilarni yorliqlashni unutdi.

text: {r:Crossroad}[ˈkrɒsroʊd] - chorraha.
examples: {r:We stopped at the crossroad.} - Biz chorrahada to'xtadik.
{r:The crossroad was busy with traffic in the morning.} - Chorraha ertalab tirband edi.
{r:He stood at the crossroad, unsure which way to go.} - U chorrahada turib, qaysi tomonga borishni bilmas edi.
{r:The crossroad is dangerous at night.} - Chorraha kechqurun xavfli.

text: {r:Scar}[skɑːr] – chandiq. 'Qirol sher'(Simba) multfilmidagi {p:SKAR}ni eslaysizmi? Uning ismi bekorga {p:Skar} emas chunki yuzida katta {h:chandig}'i bor.
examples: {r:He has a scar on his arm.} - Uning qo'lida chandiq bor.
{r:The scar reminded her of the accident in the past.} - Chandiq unga o'tmishdagi baxtsiz hodisani eslatdi.
{r:The scar is healing well.} - Chandiq yaxshi tuzalmoqda.
{r:Additionally, he got a scar from the surgery at the hospital.} - Bundan tashqari u kasalxonadagi operatsiyadan keyin chandiq oldi.

text: {r:Cheek}[tʃiːk] – yanoq. Agar qishki sovuqda {h:yanog’ingiz} qizarib ketsa {p:CHIG}it tegizib turing biroz vaqt.
examples: {r:She kissed him on the cheek.} - U uni yanog'idan o'pdi.
{r:His cheeks turned red in the cold weather.} - Uning yanoqlari sovuq ob-havoda qizarib ketdi.
{r:The baby has round cheeks.} - Chaqaloqning yonoqlari yumaloq.
{r:Sardor wiped the tear from her cheek.} - Sardor uning yanog'idagi yoshni artdi.

text: {r:Row}[roʊ] - qator. Kecha do'stlar bilan ichib katta janjal ko'taribmiz shahar markazida va militsiya bizni ushlab olib ketishdi. {p:ROV}dda {h:qator} bo'lib o'tirgan rasmlarimiz internetga tarqalib ketdi keyin.
examples: {r:They sat in the front row at the theater.} - Ular teatrda birinchi qatorda o'tirishdi.
{r:The students stood in a row on the stage.} - O'quvchilar sahnada qator turishdi.
{r:There was a row of trees along the road.} - Yo'l bo'ylab daraxtlar qatori bor edi.
{r:I was in the same row as my friend.} - Men do'stim bilan bitta qatorda edim.

text: {r:Coast}[koʊst] – qirg’oq. Tasavvur qiling okeanni tomosha qilaman deb {h:qirg’oq} bo’yiga kelsangiz hamma yerda {p:KOST}umlar sochilib yotibdi. Hayron bo’ldim bu yerda to’y qilib keyin kostumlarini tashlab ketishganmi deb o’yladim.
examples: {r:We seldom drive along the coast.} - Biz kamdan-kam sohil bo'ylab haydaymiz.
{r:The coast is beautiful at sunset.} - Quyosh botayotganda sohil juda chiroyli.
{r:They live on the coast.} - Ular sohilda yashaydilar.
{r:The house is on the coast.} - Uy qirg'oqda joylashgan.

text: {r:Jail}[dʒeɪl] – qamoq, zindon; qamalmoq. Gulinurning ‘{p:JAYL}an’ qo’shig’i kimgadir yoqmagan shekilli uni bu qo’shig’i uchun qamab qo’yishibdi {h:qamoqqa}.
examples: {r:He was sent to jail.} - U qamoqqa tashlandi.
{r:He was jailed.} - U qamaldi.
{r:She visited her brother in jail.} - U qamoqxonada akasiga tashrif buyurdi.
{r:The jail is located outside the city.} - Qamoqxona shahardan tashqarida joylashgan.
{r:We had no idea what the jail was like.} - Qamoqxona qandayligini umuman bilmasdik.

text: {r:Shade}[ʃeɪd] – soya. Aytishlaricha {p:SHAYT}onning o’zi qizil {h:soyasi} esa sariq bo’larkan.
examples: {r:They sat in the shade of the tree.} - Ular daraxt soyasida o'tirishdi.
{r:The shade kept us cool at the park.} - Soyali joy bizni bog'da salqin qildi.
{r:I had rest under the shade.} - Soya ostida dam oldim.
{r:The shade of the building provided relief from the sun.} - Binoning soyasi quyoshdan yengillik berdi.

text: {r:Preferably}[ˈprɛfərəbli] - afzal(roq), iloji bo'lsa. Prefer(afzal ko'rmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:We should meet at the cafe, preferably in the quiet corner.} - Biz kafeda uchrashishimiz kerak, tinchroq burchagida bo'lgani afzalroq.
{r:Preferably, we should finish the project in the office.} - Iloji bo'lsa, biz loyihani ofisda tugatishimiz kerak.
{r:She prefers tea, preferably with milk.} - U choyni iloji bo'lsa sut bilan ichishni afzal ko'radi.
{r:Preferably, we should avoid this route.} - Biz bu yo'ldan yurmaganimiz ma'qulroq.

text: {r:Library}[ˈlaɪbrəri] – kutubxona. Bu vaziyatda {p:LAY}lak {p:BRI}tva bilan {h:kutubxonada} soqol olayotganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:She spends hours entirely in the library.} - U  soatlab vaqtini butunlay kutubxonada o'tkazadi.
{r:The library has a vast collection of books.} - Kutubxonada kitoblarning katta to'plami mavjud.
{r:He borrowed a book from the library.} - U kutubxonadan kitob oldi.
{r:The library is quiet and peaceful.} - Kutubxona jimjit va tinch.
{r:The new library is a new addition to the campus.} - Yangi kutubxona kampusga yangi qo'shimcha.

text: {r:Desert}[ˈdɛzərt] – cho’l. Tasavvur qiling siz {h:cho’l} o’rtasida xotiningiz tayyorlagan {p:desert}ni uni sog’inib yeb o’tiribsiz.
examples: {r:They crossed the desert on camels.} - Ular cho'lni tuya orqali kesib o'tishdi.
{r:The desert is hot during the day.} - Cho'l kunduzi juda issiq.
{r:She loves the beauty of the desert.} - U cho'lning go'zalligini yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:The desert is full of sand dunes.} - Cho'l qumtepalar bilan to'la.

text: {r:Office}[ˈɒfɪs] - ofis.
examples: {r:This decision depends solely on the office manager.} - Bu qaror faqat ofis menejeriga bog'liq.
{r:The office is closed on weekends.} - Ofis dam olish kunlarida yopiq.
{r:She decorated her office with plants.} - U o'z ofisini o'simliklar bilan bezatdi.
{r:The office is located on the 5th floor.} - Ofis 5-qavatda joylashgan.

text: {r:Assumption}[əˈsʌmpʃən] - taxmin. Assume(taxmin qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:His assumption was incorrect.} - Uning taxmini noto'g'ri edi.
{r:We made an assumption based on the data.} - Biz ma'lumotlarga asoslanib taxmin qildik.
{r:The assumption led to a misunderstanding.} - Taxmin tushunmovchilikka olib keldi.
{r:Shahzoda doubted his assumption in the meeting.} - Shahzoda uchrashuvda uning taxminiga shubha qildi.

text: {r:Workplace}[ˈwɜːrkpleɪs] - ish joyi, ishxona. Work(ish) va place(joy) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Our workplace has a strict no-smoking policy.} - Bizning ish joyimizda chekmaslik bo'yicha qat'iy siyosat bor.
{r:She decorated her workplace with small plants.} - U ish joyini kichik o'simliklar bilan bezadi.
{r:A clean workplace improves productivity.} - Toza ish joyi samaradorlikni oshiradi.
{r:The new workplace is closer to my home, therefore I don't spend money on transport.} - Yangi ish joyi uyimga yaqinroq shuning uchun transportga pul sarflamayman.

text: {r:Equality}[ɪˈkwɒlɪti] - tenglik. Equal(teng) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Equality is important in society.} - Tenglik jamiyatda muhimdir.
{r:They fought for gender equality.} - Ular gender tengligi uchun kurashdilar.
{r:The law ensures equality for all.} - Qonun hamma uchun tenglikni ta'minlaydi.
{r:Equality should exist in every workplace.} - Har bir ish joyida tenglik mavjud bo'lishi kerak.

text: {r:Factory}[ˈfæktəri] – zavod, fabrika. Yog’ {h:zavodi} O’zbekistonda yopilib ketganini asosiy sababi bu xomashyo yetishmasligi {p:FAKTORI}dadir.
examples: {r:He works in a car factory like a slave.} - U avtomobil zavodida quldek ishlaydi.
{r:The factory produces shoes.} - Zavod poyabzal ishlab chiqaradi.
{r:The factory is located outside the city.} - Zavod shahardan tashqarida joylashgan.
{r:The factory workers went on strike because of low wages.} - Zavod ishchilari past maosh tufayli ish tashlashga chiqdilar.

text: {r:Responsibility}[rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪləti] - mas'uliyat, javobgarlik. Responsible(mas'ul) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She has a lot of responsibilities at work.} - Uning ishda ko'plab mas'uliyatlari bor.
{r:Parents have a responsibility to their children.} - Ota-onalarning farzandlariga nisbatan mas'uliyatlari bor.
{r:He accepted responsibility for the mistake.} - U xato uchun mas'uliyatni qabul qildi.
[b]take a responsibility - ma'suliyatni o'z zimmasiga olmoq[/b]
{r:He took responsibility for the mistake.} – U xato uchun javobgarlikni bo'yniga oldi.
{r:They will take responsibility for the project.} – Ular loyiha uchun ma’suliyatni o'z zimmasiga oladilar.

text: {r:Theater}[ˈθiːətər] - teatr.
examples: {r:We went to the theater last night.} - Kecha biz teatrga bordik.
{r:The theater was full of people.} - Teatr odamlar bilan to'la edi.
{r:She loves performing in the theater.} - U teatrda ijro etishni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:The theater is located in the city center.} - Teatr shahar markazida joylashgan.

text: {r:Classroom}[ˈklæsruːm] - sinfxona. class va room so'zlarining qoshilishi orqali yasalgan.
examples: {r:The students from this classroom will graduate next year.} - Bu sinfxona o'quvchilari keyingi yil bitiradi.
{r:The classroom is clean and bright.} - Sinf xonasi toza va yorug'.
{r:The teacher wrote on the classroom board.} - O'qituvchi sinf doskasiga yozdi.
{r:The classroom has new chairs and tables.} - Sinf xonasida yangi stullar va stollar bor.

text:
{r:District}[ˈdɪstrɪkt] – tuman. 
 Esingdami oldin disk, kasetalar ishlatardik. Hozir hech kim ishlatmay qo’ydi. 
 {p:Disk tirik}, biz hali ham ishlatamiz. Qayerda? Bizning {h:tumanda}.
examples: {r:This is the richest district in the city.} - Bu shaharning eng boy tumani.
{r:The district is known for its markets and modern bridges.} - Tuman o'z bozorlari va zamonaviy ko'priklari bilan mashhur.
{r:They live in a quiet district, no weapon allowed here.} - Ular tinch tumanda yashaydilar. Bu yerda qurolga ruxsat yo'q.
{r:The district has many schools and parks.} - Tumanda ko'plab maktablar va bog'lar bor.

text: {r:Border}[ˈbɔːrdər] – chegara. Eshikka qulf qo’yishimiz kerak. Uyda drell bormi? Yo’q. Bu atrofda drell sotilmaydi. {p:Bor dr}ell, {h:chegara} bo’yidagi do’konda sotiladi.
examples: {r:The river forms a natural border.} - Daryo tabiiy chegara hosil qiladi.
{r:They crossed the border at night.} - Ular kechasi chegaradan o'tishdi.
{r:The border is heavily guarded.} - Chegara qattiq qo'riqlanadi.
{r:The two countries share a long border.} - Ikki davlat uzun chegara bilan chegaradosh.

text: {r:Slope}[sloʊp] – qiya, qiyalik, nishablik. Yangi yilga buyurtirgan tortingiz juda ham chiroyli chiqibdi. Yangi yilni ham kutmasdan yeb qo’ygingiz kelyapti. Tortni yon tomondan SILAB {p:SILAB} yon tarafini {h:qiyshaytirib} ham qo’yibsiz.
examples: {r:The house is built on a steep slope.} - Uy tik qiyalikda qurilgan.
{r:They skied down the slope.} - Ular qiyalikda chang'i uchishdi.
{r:The slope is partly covered with grass.} - Qiyalik qisman o't bilan qoplangan.
{r:Be careful when walking on the slope.} - Qiyalikda yurganingizda ehtiyot bo'ling.

text: {r:Horizon}[həˈraɪzən] - gorizont, ufq.
examples: {r:The sun disappeared below the horizon.} - Quyosh ufqdan g'oyib bo'ldi.
{r:The horizon was clear and beautiful.} - Ufq aniq va chiroyli edi.
{r:The old tree on the horizon looks like a dark scar against the sky.} - Ufqdagi eski daraxt osmonning yuzidagi qorong'i chandiqqa o'xshaydi.
{r:The mountains were somewhat visible on the horizon.} - Ufqdagi tog'lar  bir muncha ko'rinarli edi.

text: {r:Shore}[ʃɔːr] – qirg’oq, sohil. Tasavvur qiling {p:SHO’R}danak yigitlari dengiz {h:sohiliga} dam olish uchun borishibdi. Lekin omadlari kelmay sohilda timsoh hujumiga uchrab bir amallab qochib qutulibdi.
examples: {r:They walked along the shore.} - Ular qirg'oq bo'ylab yurishdi.
{r:The shore was full of seashells.} - Qirg'oq dengiz chig'anoqlari bilan to'la edi.
{r:The ship reached the shore safely.} - Kema xavfsiz qirg'oqqa yetib keldi.
{r:The shore is a popular tourist spot.} - Qirg'oq mashhur sayyohlik joyidir.

text: {r:Cliff}[klɪf] – tik qoya. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:KLIP} olasiz va bu klipda siz tik {h:qoyani} zabt etmoqchi bo'lasiz.
examples: {r:The cliff is dangerous to climb.} - Qoyalarga chiqish xavfli.
{r:They stood at the edge of the cliff.} - Ular qoya chetida turishdi.
{r:The view from the cliff was amazing.} - Qoyadan manzara ajoyib edi.
{r:The waves crashed against the cliff.} - To'lqinlar qoyaga urildi.
{r:A prominent movie was shot on this cliff.} - Mashhur kino shu qoyada olingan.

text: {r:Ground}[ɡraʊnd] - yer. Menga folbin '{h:yerga} o'tirib davlat imtihonlarini topshirsang {p:GRAND}GA kirib ketasan' degandi. Men ham irimchilik qilib hamma hayron qolsa ham grandga kiray deb yerga o'tirib oldim. Lekin folbinning gapi to'g'ri chiqmadi.
examples: {r:The ground was wet after the rain.} - Yomg'irdan keyin yer ho'l edi.
{r:He fell to the ground.} - U yerga yiqildi.
{r:The ground is covered with snow.} - Yer qor bilan qoplangan.
{r:They sat on the ground to have a picnic.} - Ular piknik qilish uchun yerga o'tirishdi.
{r:They met at the crossroad where the old road met new ground.} - Ular eski yo'l yangi yerga qo'shilgan chorrahada uchrashishdi.

text: {r:Sidewalk}[ˈsaɪdwɔːk] – trotuar, yo'lak. Tasavvur qiling {p:SAID}ni {p:VOK}zalga kuzatib qo'yishingiz kerak. Vokzalga esa mana bu {h:trotuar} olib boradi.
examples: {r:The sidewalk was crowded with people.} - Yo'lak odamlar bilan to'la edi.
{r:She walked on the sidewalk.} - U yo'lakdan yurdi.
{r:The sidewalk is under construction.} - Yo'lak qurilish jarayonida.
{r:The children played on the sidewalk.} - Bolalar yo'lakda o'ynashdi.

text: {r:Compliant}[kəmˈplaɪənt] - mos, muvofiq. Comply(amal qilmoq, mos bo'lmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The company is compliant with the law.} - Kompaniya qonunga mos keladi.
{r:She was compliant with the rules.} - U qoidalarga bo'ysundi.
{r:The device is compliant with safety standards.} - Qurilma xavfsizlik standartlariga mos keladi.
{r:The building is compliant with environmental regulations.} - Bino atrof-muhit qoidalariga mos keladi.

text: {r:Replace}[rɪˈpleɪs] – yangisiga almashtirmoq, o’rnini egallamoq. Biror narsa ikkinchi narsani o’rnini egallaganda qo’llaniladi. Oldinlari Leys chipslarini Messi reklama qilardi. Futbolchi faoliyati pasaygandan so’ng hozir mashhur amerikalik {p:REP}per {p:LEYS}ning yangi reklama yuziga aylandi. Xullas Messining {h:o’rnini Eminem egalladi}.
examples: {r:They replaced the old furniture.} - Ular eski mebellarni almashtirdilar.
{r:The battery needs to be replaced.} - Batareyani almashtirish kerak.
{r:Julia replaced him as the team leader.} - Julia jamoa rahbari sifatida uning o'rnini egalladi.
{r:The broken window was replaced.} - Singan oyna almashtirildi.

text: {r:Brain}[breɪn] - miya.
examples: {r:The brain is the most important organ.} - Miya eng muhim a'zodir.
{r:He has a brilliant brain.} - Uning aqli juda yaxshi.
{r:The brain controls all body functions.} - Miya tananing barcha funktsiyalarini boshqaradi.
{r:She suffered a brain injury.} - U miya jarohati oldi.

text: {r:Bottom}[ˈbɒtəm] – tag, pastki. Tabiat qo’ynida sayr qilib yurgan vaqtim qop-qora botqoqqa {p:BOTTIM.} Do’stlarim kelib qolib meni u yerdan chiqarishdi. Lekin tanamning {h:‘pastki’} qismi qop-qora bo’lib qoldi.
examples: {r:The keys are at the bottom of the bag.} - Kalitlar sumkaning tubida.
{r:The bottom of the lake is muddy.} - Ko'lning tubi loyqa.
{r:He reached the bottom of the stairs.} - U zinapoyaning pastki qismiga yetdi.
{r:The bottom of the page is blank.} - Sahifaning pastki qismi bo'sh.
{r:She found some old pictures hidden in the bottom drawer.} - U pastki tortmada yashiringan ba'zi eski rasmlarni topdi.

text: {r:Feature}[ˈfiːtʃər] - funksiya, vazifa, xususiyat. Ajoyib yangi ilova chiqibdi kundalik rejalarni yozib borish uchun va reja amalga oshirilishi kerak bo'lgan vaqtda sms xabarlar jo'natadi eslatish maqsadida. Agar shu mobil ilova do'stlaringizda ham bo'lsa boshqa bir ajoyib {h:funksiyasi} orqali umumiy bo'sh vaqtni topib {p:VECHER} yoki o'tirish ham qilib yuborsa bo'ladi.
examples: {r:The new phone has many features.} - Yangi telefonda ko'plab funksiyalar mavjud.
{r:The most significant feature of this phone is its long battery life.} – Ushbu telefonning eng muhim xususiyati uning uzoq batareya ishlashidir.
{r:You can add new features on your phone.} - Telefoningizda yangi funksiyalar qo'shishingiz mumkin.
{r:The app has a unique feature.} - Ilova noyob xususiyatga ega.

text: {r:Dozen}[ˈdʌzən] - o'nlab, bir nechta. Talabalar yotoqxonasida yashagan paytim hamma mendan dazmol so'rayverardi. Oxiri bozorga borib {h:o'nlab} {p:DAZM}ol sotib oldim.
examples: {r:She bought a dozen eggs.} - U o'nlab tuxum sotib oldi.
{r:There were dozens of people at the event.} - Tadbirda o'nlab odamlar bor edi.
{r:He has dozens of books in his library.} - Uning kutubxonasida o'nlab kitoblari bor.
{r:A dozen roses were delivered to her.} - Unga o'nlab atirgullar yetkazib berildi.
{r:Prevention of dozens of natural disasters might be possible.} - O'nlab tabiiy ofatlarni oldini olish mumkin bo'lib qolishi mumkin.

text: {r:Possibility}[ˌpɒsəˈbɪləti] - ehtimollik, imkoniyat, amalga oshish. Possible(ehtimol) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Additionally, there is a possibility of rain tomorrow.} - Bundan tashqari, ertaga yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin.
{r:We are exploring the possibility of a new project.} - Biz yangi loyiha imkoniyatini o'rganyapmiz.
{r:The possibility of success is high.} - Muvaffaqiyat imkoniyati yuqori.
{r:He considered the possibility of moving abroad.} - U chet elga ko'chib ketish ehtimolligini ko'rib chiqdi.

text:
Eslatma: Bu mavzu kattaroq! Shuning uchun ikki qismga bo'lib, iloji bo'lsa ohista o'rganing! 

 {r:Cure}[kjʊər] – davolamoq; davo, dori. Yozda issiqlik toshishiga eng yaxshi {h:davo} bu {p:kuy}a surtish.
examples: {r:The doctor found a cure diner the old book.} - Shifokor eski kitobdan malhamni topdi.
{r:Finding a cure for his illness is my current purpose.} - Uning kasalligiga davo topish bu mening hozirgi maqsadim.
{r:A good rest is a cure over many small problems.} - Yaxshi dam olish ko'plab kichik muammolarga davodir.
{r:They seek a cure across many countries.} - Ular ko'plab mamlakatlar bo'ylab davo izlaydilar.

text: {r:Date}[deɪt] – sana; yigit/qiz bilan uchrashib yurmoq. Chaplinning Daydi obrazini eslaysizmi. {p:Dayd}i va nihoyat o’z baxtini topdi va gul sotuvchi qiz bilan {h:uchrashmoqda}.
examples: {r:The old letter had a date under the picture.} - Eski xatda rasm ostida sana bor edi.
{r:He put the date next to his name.} - U sanani o'z ismining yoniga qo'ydi.
{r:We saw the date on the wall opposite the door.} - Biz sanani eshikning ro'parasidagi devorda ko'rdik.
{r:They walked along the street during their first date.} - Ular birinchi uchrashuvlarida ko'cha bo'ylab yurishdi.
{r:Julia dates Robert.} - Julia Robert bilan uchrashib yuribdi.

text: {r:Stick}[stɪk] - tayoq. Ota va qizlar suhbati: Qizlarim sila bollaga telegramda har xil stikerla jo'natibsila noz-karashma qilib. Mana hozir har bitta {p:STIK}erga bittadan {h:tayoq} yeysilar.
examples: {r:He picked up a stick from under the tree.} - U daraxt ostidan tayoq oldi.
{r:The dog ran through the garden with a stick.} - It bog' orqali tayoq bilan yugurdi.
{r:The small stick was behind the big rock.} - Kichik tayoq katta toshning orqasida edi.
{r:The boy jumped over the stick.} - Bola tayoq ustidan sakradi.

text: {r:Scale}[skeɪl] – daraja, masshtab, ko’lam, miqyos. {p:Skel}etlar odamlar bilan keng {h:ko’lamli} janglarga tayyorgarlik ko’ryapti.
examples: {r:The city was rebuilt on a large scale after the earthquake.} – Zilziladan keyin shahar keng ko'lamda qayta qurildi.
{r:We can’t imagine the scale of the damage caused by the fire.} – Yong‘in keltirgan zarar darajasini tasavvur qilib bo‘lmaydi.
{r:The company operates on a global scale.} – Kompaniya global miqyosda faoliyat yuritadi.
{r:The pollution problem is growing in scale.} – Ifloslanish muammosi ko'lami tobora kattalashib bormoqda.

text: {r:Lack}[læk] – kam bo’lmoq. {p:Lek}siya o’tayotgan kishi hozirda leksiyada o’tirgan odamlarga sabr va qiziqish {h:yetishmasligini} ta'kidladi.
examples: {r:The small plant died because of a lack of water.} - Kichik o'simlik suv yetishmasligi sababli qurib qoldi.
{r:The problem was hidden behind a lack of information.} - Muammo ma'lumot yetishmasligi ortida yashiringan edi.
{r:He felt a lack of energy throughout the day.} - U kun davomida energiya yetishmasligini his qildi.
{r:The lack of food was felt across the country.} - Oziq-ovqat yetishmasligi butun mamlakat bo'ylab sezildi.

text: {r:Handle}[ˈhændl] – eplamoq, boshqarmoq. {p:Handal}ak ekkan edik, hosili zo’r bo’di. Endi hosilni yig’ish kerak, ishchi yollash kerak, bu jarayonlarni hammasini dadam mendan yaxshi {h:eplaydi}.
examples: {r:She couldn’t handle her emotions when the car went past her old house.} – Mashina eski uyi yonidan o‘tayotganda, u his-tuyg‘ularini boshqara olmadi.
{r:She can handle the work well.} - U ishni yaxshi eplay oladi.
{r:She handled the argument calmly, even though the opposite side was shouting.} – Qarama-qarshi tomoni baqirayotgan bo‘lsa ham, u bahsni xotirjamlik bilan boshqardi.
{r:He probably can't handle the pressure, particularly now.} - U ehtimol bosimni eplay olmadi, ayniqsa hozir.

text: {r:Roll}[roʊl] – o’ramoq, dumalatmoq. Boshqa shaharga ketayotgan paytimda o’zim bilan eng qadrdon buyumlardan birini olvoldim. Bu meni {p:rol}igim, uni yaxshilab {h:o’radim} va o’zim bilan olib ketdim.
examples: {r:The ball rolled under the table.} - To'p stol ostiga dumalab ketdi.
{r:A rare type of cheese began to roll from the shelf.} – Noyob turdagi pishloq javondan yumalab tushdi.
{r:The stone rolled across the road.} - Tosh yo'l bo'ylab dumalab o'tdi.
{r:She sat lonely as the tears rolled down her cheeks.} – Yuzida yoshlar yumalab tushar ekan, u yolgʻiz oʻtirardi.

text: {r:Screen}[skriːn] – ekran. Tasavvur qiling, ekranga kirib chiqish mumkin. Ekranda reklama qilinayotgan Fantani qo’lingizni tiqib olishingiz mumkin. Kunlardan bir kun {h:ekranga} kirish bo’lyapti ekan. Qo’riqchi kirayotganlarga ‘’ {p:Siz krin}, siz krin, sizga mumkin emas’’ deb turibdi.
examples: {r:He saw the small animal under the screen.} - U ekran ostida kichik hayvonni ko'rdi.
{r:The big screen was opposite the door.} - Katta ekran eshikning ro'parasida edi.
{r:The light from the screen shone through the window.} - Ekrandan tushgan yorug'lik derazadan o'tdi.
{r:He walked past the screen in the shop.} - U do'kondagi ekranning yonidan o'tib ketdi.

text: {r:Gain}[ɡeɪn] - erishmoq, orttirmoq, to'plamoq.
examples: {r:He tried to gain knowledge under the guidance of his teacher.} - U o'qituvchisining rahbarligi ostida bilim olishga harakat qildi.
{r:The team tried to gain victory over their opponent.} - Jamoa raqib ustidan g'alaba qozonishga harakat qildi.
{r:They gained new friends through the school.} - Ular maktab orqali yangi do'stlar orttirdilar.
