{r:He gained speed as he ran across the field.} - U maydon bo'ylab yugurganida tezlik oldi.

text: {r:Reside}[rɪˈzaɪd] – yashamoq. Xalqimizning sevimli san’atkori Munisa {p:RIZAY}eva homiladorlik paytida Argentinada {h:yashashga} qaror qildi.
examples: {r:The old man likes to reside under the big tree.} - Qariya katta daraxt ostida yashashni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:He decided to reside in the house opposite the park.} - U parkning ro'parasidagi uyda yashashga qaror qildi.
{r:Many people reside along the river.} - Ko'plab odamlar daryo bo'ylab yashaydilar.
{r:The family chose to reside in the mountains.} - Oila tog'larda yashashni tanladi.

text: {r:Shame}[ʃeɪm] – uyat, or; xijolat qilmoq, uyatga qo’ymoq. Men uyimga elektr tarmogi o’tkazilmay kambag’illikdan {p:SHAM} yoqib o’tirganimdan {h:uyaldim}.
examples: {r:He felt a deep shame under his smile.} - U tabassumi ostida chuqur uyat his qildi.
{r:The truth was hidden behind a wall of shame.} - Haqiqat uyat devori ortida yashiringan edi.
{r:It was a shame to see him walk past us without a word.} - Uning bizning yonimizdan biror so'z demasdan o'tib ketganini ko'rish uyatli edi.
{r:They are shaming him because he is fat.} - Ular uning semizligini uyatga solmoqda.

text: {r:Accessible}[ækˈsɛsəbl] – bu siz o'tgan safar o’rgangan 'access' so’zining sifat so’z turkumiga xos shakli. Kirsa, foydalansa va erishsa bo’ladigan narsa va predmetlarga nisbatan qo’llaniladi.
examples: {r:The website is not accessible now.} - Vebsaytga hozir kirib bo'lmayapti.
{r:The new path made the mountain accessible through the forest.} - Yangi yo'l tog'ni o'rmon orqali kirish mumkin qildi.
{r:The information became accessible across the internet.} - Ma'lumot internet orqali mavjud bo'ldi.
{r:The old house was accessible along the river.} - Eski uyga daryo bo'ylab yetishish mumkin edi.

text: {r:Communicate}[kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt] - kommunikatsiya qilmoq, muloqot qilmoq, aloqa qilmoq.
examples: {r:They communicate through signs when it is silent.} - Ular jim bo'lganda ishoralar orqali muloqot qilishadi.
{r:It is hard to communicate over long distances.} - Uzoq masofalarda muloqot qilish qiyin.
{r:The two friends communicate across different apps.} - Ikki do'st turli ilovalar orqali muloqot qilishadi.
{r:They tried to communicate with the people behind the wall.} - Ular devor ortidagi odamlar bilan muloqot qilishga harakat qilishdi.

text: {r:Presence}[ˈprɛzəns] – bor bo’lish, ishtirok etish, qatnashish. Bolgariya {p:prez}identi {p:nos} chekib olib majlisda {h:qatnashyapti.} Qiziqarli tarafi og’zida nosi bo’lgani uchun zo’rg’a gapiryapti.
examples: {r:His presence was felt immediately.} - Uning borligi darhol sezildi.
{r:The dog felt a presence of something behind the door.} - It eshik ortida nimadir borligini his qildi.
{r:Her strong presence was felt across the room.} - Uning borligi xona bo'ylab sezildi.
{r:The king's presence was known to the whole country.} - Qirolning qatnashishi butun mamlakatga ma'lum edi.

text: {r:Volume}[ˈvɒljuːm] – hajm, sig’im. {p:VOL}eybol {p:YUM}shoq, havosi chiqarilgan to’pda o’ynalishi kerak. Shunda tomoshabinlar uchun stadion {h:sig’imini} kengaytirish mumkin. Muxlislarga qattiq to’p tegmaydida shunda, yumshoqroq to’p tegsa ham hech narsa qilmaydi.
examples: {r:The volume of the music was too high.} - Musiqa balandligi juda baland edi.
{r:The human brain processes an incredible volume of information.} - Inson miyasi aql bovar qilmaydigan hajmdagi ma'lumotni qayta ishlaydi.
{r:The volume of water in the lake is decreasing.} - Ko'ldagi suv hajmi kamaymoqda.
{r:The drugstore ordered a large volume of medicine before winter.} – Dorixona qish fasli oldidan katta miqdorda dori buyurtma berdi.

text: {r:Grab}[ɡræb] – tortmoq. Qishloqda yashasangiz grabl nimaligini bilsangiz kerak. Nimanidir tortish uchun ishlatiladigan bu asbob nomi aynan shu so’zdan olingan. Tasavvur qiling sho’xlik qilgingiz kelib qoldi, {p:grab}l bilan xotiningiz sochini {h:tortyapsiz}.
examples: {r:The child tried to grab the ball from under the table.} - Bola stol ostidan to'pni tortib olishga harakat qildi.
{r:He quickly grabbed his hat from behind the door.} - U shlyapasini eshik ortidan tezda oldi.
{r:She tried to grab the apple as it rolled over the grass.} - U olma chim ustidan dumalab ketayotganda uni tortib olishga harakat qildi.
{r:He had to grab the rope when he went through the narrow space.} - U tor joydan o'tayotganda arqonni ushlashi kerak edi.

text: {r:Fence}[fɛns] – panjara; panjara bilan to’smoq. Ozodlikdagilar faqat Fanta ichishadi, {h:panjara} ortidagilar esa faqat {p:FENSi} ichishyapti.
examples: {r:The ball rolled under the fence.} - To'p panjara ostiga dumalab ketdi.
{r:The small animal entered through the hole in the fence.} - Kichik hayvon panjaradagi teshik orqali kirdi.
{r:They built a new fence along the river.} - Ular daryo bo'ylab yangi panjara qurdilar.
{r:He saw his friend walk past the fence.} - U do'stining panjara yonidan o'tib ketganini ko'rdi.

text: {r:Shape}[ʃeɪp] – shakl, forma. Mening bobom 30 yil professional hokkey o’ynagan. Shuning uchun ham qariganda hokkey {p:shayb}asi {h:shakl}idagi hassa yasatdirdik.
examples: {r:The hidden treasure was found under a strange shape.} - Yashirin xazina g'alati shakl ostida topildi.
{r:He managed to escape despite the awkward shape of the window.} – Derazaning gʻalati shakliga qaramay, u qochishga muvaffaq boʻldi.
{r:The water flowed through a pipe with a strange shape.} - Suv g'alati shakldagi quvur orqali oqdi.
{r:He saw a strange shape behind the bushes.} - U butalar ortida g'alati shaklni ko'rdi.

text: {r:Willing}[ˈwɪlɪŋ] – tayyor, hozir. Bu vilkalaringiz juda qalin ekan. Agar {p:vil}kani {p:ing}ichkasini topsangiz olishga {h:tayyorman}.
examples: {r:Perhaps she is willing to help.} - Balki u yordam berishga tayyor.
{r:Maybe Anvar was willing to take the risk.} - Balki Anvar xavfni o'z zimmasiga olishga tayyor edi.
{r:They are willing to learn new skills.} - Ular yangi ko'nikmalarni o'rganishga tayyor.
{r:The team is willing to work hard.} - Jamoa qattiq ishlashga tayyor.
{r:Her generous nature made her willing to help anyone in need.} - Uning saxiy tabiati uni muhtojlarga yordam berishga tayyor qildi.

text: {r:Previous}[ˈpriːviəs] – sobiq, oldingi. Bolalar {p:priv}ivkasi {p:yuz} ming edi {h:oldingi} narxi. Hozir mutlaqo tekin.
examples: {r:The previous book was found under the table.} - Oldingi kitob stol ostidan topildi.
{r:He looked at his previous house, which was opposite his new one.} - U o'zining yangi uyining ro'parasidagi oldingi uyiga qaradi.
{r:The previous owner lived along this street for many years.} - Oldingi egasi bu ko'cha bo'ylab ko'p yillar yashagan.
{r:He walked past the previous shop where he used to buy bread.} - U ilgari non sotib oladigan oldingi do'konning yonidan o'tib ketdi.

text: {r:Obvious}[ˈɒbviəs] – aniq, ravshan. Tasavvur qiling siz tanigan eng ko’p gapiruvchi odam {p:OB}id {p:VAY}Saqi, bu {h:aniq-ravshan} gap. O’zingiz tanigan xohlagan Obidni tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:It was obvious that she felt lonely in the big house.} – Katta uyda u o‘zini yolg‘iz his qilgani ayon edi.
{r:The answer became obvious after hard work.} - Javob qattiq mehnatdan so'ng aniq bo'ldi.
{r:The solution seems obvious now.} - Siz tushuntirgandan keyin yechim aniq ko'rinmoqda.
{r:The difference between the two was obvious when they stood opposite each other.} - Ikkisi o'zaro qarama-qarshi turganda farq aniq edi.

text: {r:Target}[ˈtɑːrɡɪt] – nishon, maqsad;nishonga olmoq. Men tarakan ovchisiman. Bir kuni qarasam bir {p:tar}akan {p:git}ara chalib qolgan tarakanlarga konsert beryapti. O’sha payti ko’pchiligini yo’q qildim. Lekin gitarist qochib ketdi, endi tarakan gitarist mening asosiy {h:nishonim}.
examples: {r:He saw the target under the tree.} - U nishonni daraxt ostida ko'rdi.
{r:The arrow flew over the target.} - O'q nishon ustidan uchib o'tdi.
{r:Our sales target for this month is high.} - Bu oy uchun savdo maqsadimiz yuqori.
{r:The advertisement targets young people.} - Reklama yoshlarga qaratilgan.

text: {r:Deliver}[dɪˈlɪvər] – yetkazmoq. Mana bu kasal delfinni tezroq {p:del}fin {p:vr}achga {h:yetkazing}.
examples: {r:He will deliver the letter to the door.} - U xatni eshikkacha yetkazib beradi.
{r:The news was delivered across the country.} - Yangiliklar butun mamlakat bo'ylab yetkazildi.
{r:Your membership card will be delivered soon.} - Sizning a'zolik kartangiz tez orada yetkaziladi.
{r:He will deliver the flowers to the house opposite the school.} - U gullarni maktabning ro'parasidagi uyga yetkazib beradi.

text: {r:Blink}[blɪŋk] – yonib o’chmoq, miltillamoq; ko’zni yumib ochmoq. Ozodbek Nazarbekov ‘’Dunyoga keldimki {p:biling} ey do’stlar, ikki dushmani bor erkak kishini’’ qo’shig’ini shunchalik hayajon bilan aytdiki ko’zini bir necha bor {h:yumib ochdi}.
examples: {r:The small light blinked under the big sign.} - Kichik chiroq katta belgi ostida miltilladi.
{r:He did not blink as the car drove past him.} - Mashina uning yonidan o'tib ketayotganda u ko'zini ham pirpiratmadi.
{r:He didn't blink during the talk.} - Suhbat davomida uning ko'zlari yumilmadi.
{r:He saw the light blink over the hill.} - U tepalik ustidan chiroqning miltillaganini ko'rdi.

text: {r:Abroad}[əˈbrɔːd] – chet elda. {p:Abr}or {p:ud}arnikni professional chaladi, hayolida esa Amerika, {h:chet el}da ko’p to’laydi deb o’ylaydi. Bu so’z uchun agar Abror yo udarnikni tasavvur qilolmasangiz, boshqa ism va predmetlardan foydalanishingiz mumkin. Masalan, Abdullajon, ud, udobniy.
examples: {r:She is studying abroad.} - U chet elda o'qiyapti.
{r:Perhaps he traveled abroad for work.} - Balki u ish uchun chet elga safar qildi.
{r:Maybe they have friends living abroad.} - Balki ularning chet elda yashaydigan do'stlari bordir.
{r:Going abroad is her dream.} - Chet elga borish uning orzusi.
{r:He felt homesick after living abroad for a year.} - U bir yil chet elda yashagach, uyini sog'indi.

text: {r:Cruel}[ˈkruːəl] – shafqatsiz, zolim. Men juda mehribon erman. Xotinim idishlarni yuvib ust boshimni toza tutadi. Shuning uchun men ham mehribon bo’lishga harakat qilaman. Lekin agar {p:KIR YUVIL}masa men ham {h:shafqatsiz} erga aylanaman.
examples: {r:The king was cruel to his people.} - Shoh o'z xalqiga shafqatsizlik qildi.
{r:It’s entirely cruel to treat animals badly.} - Hayvonlarga yomon munosabatda bo'lish butunlay shafqatsizlikdir.
{r:The cruel weather destroyed the crops.} - Shafqatsiz ob-havo hosilni yo'q qildi.
{r:The cruel system treated each individual as a slave.} - Shafqatsiz tizim har bir shaxsga quldek munosabatda bo'ldi.

text: {r:Childish}[ˈtʃaɪldɪʃ] - detskiy, bolalarcha. Child(bola) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The barber's behavior was childish.} - Sartaroshning xatti-harakati detskiy edi.
{r:He acts childish on purpose.} - U ataylab o'zini bolalarcha tutadi.
{r:The argument was childish.} - Bahs bolalarcha edi.
{r:He made a childish drawing.} - U bolalarcha rasm chizdi.

text: {r:Furious}[ˈfjʊəriəs] - jahli chiqqan, g'azabli. Siz bu so'z uchun Furqat ismli tanishingizni rais bo'lib ketganini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin. {p:FUR}qat {p:RAIS} har doim {h:g'azabnok}, nedovolniy odam. Rais bo'lganidan beri hech kimni mensimay qo'ydi.
examples: {r:She was furious when she heard the news.} - U yangiliklarni eshitganda jahli chiqdi.
{r:The teacher was furious with the students.} - O'qituvchi o'quvchilardan jahli chiqdi.
{r:He gave her a furious look.} - U unga g'azabli qaradi.
{r:The furious storm caused damage.} - G'azabli bo'ron zarar keltirdi.

text: {r:Fond}[fɒnd] - yaxshi ko'rmoq, yoqtirmoq, ishqibozi bo'lmoq. Bizning maktabdagi ustozlar {p:FOND}ga deb pul yig'ishni haqiqiy {h:ishqibozi}. Har doim '[b]to be fond of[/b]' shakli ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:She is fond of reading books.} - U kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:He is fond of his grandchildren.} - U nevaralarini juda yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:They are fond of traveling.} - Ular sayohat qilishni yaxshi ko'radilar.
{r:I am fond of this place.} - Menga bu joy yoqadi.

text: {r:Envious}[ˈɛnviəs] - hasadgo'y. Envy(hasad) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She was envious of her friend’s success.} - U do'stining muvaffaqiyatiga hasad qildi.
{r:He felt envious of their new car.} - U ularning yangi mashinasiga hasad qildi.
{r:The envious look on her face was obvious.} - Uning yuzidagi hasadli qarash ravshan edi.
{r:Don’t be envious of others.} - Boshqalarga hasad qilmang.

text: {r:Aware}[əˈwɛər] – xabardor. ChatGPT dan ajoyib fakt {p:EVE}rest {p:YER}ning eng baland nuqtasi ekanligidan dunyo aholisining atigi 21 foizi {h:xabardor} ekan.
examples: {r:She is aware of the problem.} - U muammodan xabardor.
{r:He wasn’t aware of the changes.} - U o'zgarishlardan xabardor emas edi.
{r:They became aware of the danger.} - Ular xavfdan xabardor bo'lishdi.
{r:Are you aware of the rules?} - Siz qoidalardan xabardormisiz?
{r:The company became aware of external pressure.} - Kompaniya tashqi bosimdan xabardor bo'ldi.

text: {r:Conscious}[ˈkɒnʃəs] – ong, ongli ravishda; hushi bor, xabardor. Menimcha siz 40 yildan beri kiyib yurgan {p:KALISHIZ}ni odam {h:ong}iga qo’yish kerak shunda juda mustahkam bo’ladi.
examples: {r:He was conscious during the operation.} - U operatsiya paytida hushida edi.
{r:She made a conscious effort to improve.} - U yaxshilanish uchun ongli harakat qildi.
{r:Maybe he is conscious of his mistakes.} - Balki u o'z xatolaridan xabardor.
{r:The patient became conscious after the surgery.} - Bemor operatsiyadan keyin hushyor bo'ldi.
{r:He lay awake, fully conscious of the strange noise outside.} - U uyg'oq yotar edi, tashqaridagi g'alati shovqindan to'liq xabardor bo'lib.

text: {r:Tolerant}[ˈtɒlərənt] - tolerant, bag'rikeng, bardoshli.
examples: {r:She is tolerant of different opinions.} - U turli fikrlarga tolerant.
{r:We should be tolerant of others.} - Biz boshqalarga bag'rikeng bo'lishimiz kerak.
{r:He is tolerant of noise.} - U shovqinga bardoshli.
{r:The teacher is tolerant of mistakes.} - O'qituvchi xatolarga bardoshli.

text: {r:Capable}[ˈkeɪpəbl] – qobiliyatli, layoqatli, qodir. Mol-sigirlarni qanday qilib osonlik bilan semirtirish yo’lini bilasizmi? Ularni {p:KEP}ak {p:BIL}an boqish kerak, shunda ular 1 oyda 80 kg gacha vazn solishga {h:qodir}.
examples: {r:She is capable of solving the problem.} - U muammoni hal qilishga qodir.
{r:He is capable of great things.} - U katta ishlarni qila oladi.
{r:The team is capable of winning.} - Jamoa g'alaba qozona oladi.
{r:She proved she is capable.} - U o'z qobiliyatini isbotladi.

text: {r:Incapable}[ɪnˈkeɪpəbl] - qobiliyatsiz, layoqatsiz, qila olmaslik. Capable ning teskarisi.
examples: {r:He is incapable of lying.} - U yolg'on gapira olmaydi.
{r:She felt incapable of finishing the task.} - U vazifani tugata olmasligini his qildi.
{r:The machine is incapable of working.} - Mashina ishlay olmaydi.
{r:He is incapable of understanding.} - U tushuna olmaydi.

text: {r:Hopeless}[ˈhoʊpləs] - umidsiz. Hope(umid) so'zining negativ shakli.
examples: {r:The situation seemed hopeless.} - Vaziyat umidsiz ko'rinardi.
{r:He is hopeless at math.} - U matematikada umidsiz.
{r:She felt hopeless after the failure.} - U muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan keyin umidsizlikni his qildi.
{r:The team was hopeless in the match.} - Jamoa o'yinda umidsiz edi.

text: {r:Engage}[ɪnˈɡeɪdʒ] - 'jalb qilmoq', 'band qilmoq', 'qatnashmoq'. U turli kontekstlarda ishlatilishi mumkin: 1) "The teacher tries to engage students in discussions." — "O‘qituvchi talabalarni muhokamalarga jalb qilishga harakat qiladi." 2) "He was engaged in an important project." — "U muhim loyiha bilan band edi." 3) "The company engages with customers through social media." — "Kompaniya mijozlar bilan ijtimoiy tarmoqlar orqali muloqot qiladi." Xulosa: 'Engage' so‘zi odamlarni jalb qilish, biror ish bilan band bo‘lish yoki faol ishtirok etish ma’nolarini bildiradi.
examples: {r:He is engaged in a new project.} - U yangi loyihada band.
{r:They are engaged in conversation.} - Ular suhbatda band.

text: {r:Treasure}[ˈtrɛʒər] – xazina. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:TRENAJOR} zaliga muskullaringizni kattartirish uchun borib u yerda {h:xazina} topib oldingiz va boyib ketdingiz.
examples: {r:They found treasure in the cave.} - Ular g'or ichida xazina topdilar.
{r:The treasure was hidden under the tree.} - Xazina daraxt ostida yashirilgan edi.
{r:It is obvious that stories about big treasure are just a myth.} - Shunisi aniqki katta xazina haqidagi hikoyalar shunchaki afsona.
{r:The treasure map led them to the gold.} - Xazina xaritasi ularni oltinga olib bordi.

text: {r:Sample}[ˈsæmpl] – namuna, misol, shablon. Bilasizmi eng yaxshi poydevor qanday bo’ladi? Yaxshi chiqishi uchun {p:SEM}entga {p:PL}astmassa qo’shish kerak. Mana rasmda {h:namunalar} bor.
examples: {r:She took a sample of the water.} - U suvdan namuna oldi.
{r:The store gave free samples.} - Do'kon bepul namunalar berdi.
{r:He tested the sample in the lab.} - U laboratoriyada namunani sinovdan o'tkazdi.
{r:The sample was too small.} - Namuna juda kichik edi.

text: {r:Contribute}[kənˈtrɪbjuːt] - hissa qo'shmoq. Agar kontr o'ynasak {p:KONTR}dagi {p:BOT}larni yo'q qilish bilan jamoa g'alabasiga {h:hissa qo'shaman}.
examples: {r:He contributed to the discussion.} - U muhokamaga hissa qo'shdi.
{r:She contributed money to the charity.} - U xayriyaga pul hissa qo'shdi.
{r:Everyone contributed to the success.} - Hamma muvaffaqiyatga hissa qo'shdi.
{r:The team contributed their ideas.} - Jamoa o'z fikrlarini bilan hissa qo'shdi.

text: {r:Settle}[ˈsɛtl] – o’rnashmoq, joylashmoq; hal qilmoq. Mana bu narsani bizda satil deydi. Toshkentga {h:o’rnashganimizdan} beri chelak deyishga majbur bo’lyapmiz, {p:satil} desak hech kim tushunmayapti.
examples: {r:Actually they settled in a new city.} - Ular yangi shaharda joylashdilar.
{r:She settled the argument.} - U bahsni hal qildi.
{r:He settled the bill at the restaurant.} - U restoranda hisobni hal qildi.
{r:The dust settled on the table.} - Chang stol ustiga o'rnashdi.

text:
{r:Feed}[fiːd] – ovqatlantirmoq, boqmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - fed, fed. 
Habibulla Nizomov fidokorlar deganda birinchi navbatda chetda ishlayotgan migrantlarni tushunishini aytdi. Haqiqatda ular bizning {p:fid}okorlar, oilasini {h:boqish} uchun uyidan, vatanidan uzoqda mehnat qilishyapti.
examples: {r:She feeds the birds every morning.} - U har kuni ertalab qushlarni boqadi.
{r:He fed the dog with some meat.} - U itga go'sht berdi.
{r:The baby was fed by her mother.} - Chaqaloqni onasi boqdi.
{r:The farmer feeds the cows.} - Fermer sigirlarni boqadi.

text: {r:Faith}[feɪθ] – ishonch, etiqod. {p:Feys}buk nomini o’zgartirgandan beri, unga bo’lgan {h:ishonch}im qolmadi. Eski nom bilan eski sifat ham ketdi.
examples: {r:She has faith in her team.} - U o'z jamoasiga ishonadi.
{r:He lost faith in the system.} - U tizimga ishonchini yo'qotdi.
{r:They have strong faith.} - Ularning ishonchi kuchli.
{r:Faith can move mountains.} - Iymon tog'larni ham siljitadi.

text: {r:Promote}[prəˈmoʊt] – targ'ib qilmoq, qo’llab-quvvatlamoq, ko'tarilmoq. Professor tabiatni asrash harakatini {h:qo’llab-quvvatlaydi.} Shuning uchun u mashina umuman haydamaydi. Tabiat uchun bexatar deya {p:PRO}fessor {p:MOT}osikl haydaydi.
examples: {r:He was promoted to manager.} - U menejer lavozimiga ko'tarildi.
{r:She promotes healthy eating.} - U sog'lom ovqatlanishni targ'ib qiladi.
{r:The company promotes teamwork.} - Kompaniya jamoa ishini qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.
{r:Exercise is beneficial for your health, promoting health.} - Jismoniy mashqlar sog'lig'ingiz uchun foydalidir, sog'liqni oshiradi.
{r:We should promote generous behavior in our society.} - Biz jamiyatimizda saxiy xatti-harakatlarni targ'ib qilishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Fed up with}[ˈfɛd ʌp wɪð] - joniga tekmoq. Burger sotish bilan shug'ullanuvchi Feed up(fidap) kompaniyasi boshqa bizneslarga ham qo'l uryapti va hozirda kiyim, soyabon, krossovka, lapsha mahsulotlarini ham ishlab chiqarishyapti. Eng qizig'i {p:FIDAP VAZ}ilin ham chiqarishni boshlabdi. Xullas {h:jonga tegdi} bular.(namuna uchun yozildi va feed up ga hech qanday xusumatimiz yo'q)
examples: {r:She is fed up with the noise every day.} - Har kungi shovqin uni joniga tekkan.
{r:There’s too much to be fed up with in this situation.} - Bu vaziyatda zerikish uchun juda ko'p narsa bor.
{r:A few people are fed up with the delays.} - Bir nechta odamlar kechikishlardan zerikishgan.
{r:Many people get fed up with long meetings.} - Ko'p odamlar uzoq yig'ilishlardan to'yib ketishgan.

text: {r:Subway}[ˈsʌbweɪ] - metro. Ishdan chiqishim bilan SOBOYga(o'zi bilan ovqat olaman) ovqat olaman va metroga tushib uyga jo'nayman. Lekin {p:SOBOY}ga olingan ovqatni {h:metroda} qattiq tekshirishadi. Salafanni och, ovqatni ko'rsat, hidi hamma yoqqa tarqab ketgan. Soboyiz bo'lsa mtroda ketmay qo'yavering
examples: {r:He goes to work by subway every morning,, therefore he is never late.} - U har kuni ertalab ishga metroda boradi shuning uchun hech kechikmaydi.
{r:There’s a lot of crowd on the subway during rush hour.} - Tig'iz vaqtda metroda juda ko'p olomon bor.
{r:Regarding the price, travelling by subway is beneficial.} - Narx bo'yicha metroda qatnash foydaliroq.
{r:Many people prefer the subway for travel.} - Ko'p odamlar sayohat uchun metroni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:Beside}[bɪˈsaɪd] – yonida, yon tarafida. {p:BI}llyardxona {p:SAID}ning uyining yonginasida lekin Said faqat stol tennis o’ynaydi.
examples: {r:She sat beside her friend at the table.} - U stolda do'sti yonida o'tirdi.
{r:There’s too little space beside the window.} - Deraza yonida unchalik joy yo'q.
{r:A few books were placed beside the lamp.} - Bir nechta kitoblar chiroq yoniga qo'yildi.
{r:Many people enjoy sitting beside the fire.} - Ko'p odamlar olov yonida o'tirishni yoqtirishadi.

text: {r:Extinguish}[ɪkˈstɪŋɡwɪʃ] - o'chirmoq(olovni).
examples: {r:He extinguished the fire quickly.} - U olovni tez o'chirdi.
{r:Nothing could extinguish his love for Julia.} - Uning Juliaga bo'lgan muhabbatini hech narsa o'chirolmaydi.
{r:A few attempts to extinguish the flames failed.} - Olovni o'chirishga bir nechta urinishlar muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi.
{r:Many people know how to extinguish small fires with water.} - Ko'p odamlar kichik olovlarni suv bilan qanday o'chirishni bilishadi.

text: {r:Slavery}[ˈsleɪvəri] - qullik. Slave(qul) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Slavery was ended many years ago.} - Qullik ko'p yillar oldin bekor qilindi.
{r:There’s too much history about slavery in this region.} - Bu mintaqada qullik haqida juda ko'p tarix bor.
{r:A few books discuss the impact of slavery.} - Bir nechta kitoblar qullikning ta'sirini muhokama qiladi.
{r:Slavery still exists within this society.} - Qullik bu jamiyat ichida hali ham mavjud.

text: {r:Strictly}[ˈstrɪktli] - qat'iy. Strict(qat'iy) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The rules are strictly enforced.} - Qoidalar qat'iy joriy qilinadi.
{r:This job strictly requires a university degree.} – Bu ish universitet diplomini qat’iy talab qiladi.
{r:They strictly searched the room for hidden items.} – Ular yashirin buyumlarni topish uchun xonani qat’iy tekshirishdi.
{r:Many people follow strictly organized schedules.} - Ko'p odamlar qat'iy tashkil etilgan jadvalga amal qilishadi.

text: {r:Terms}[tɜːrmz] – shartnoma yoki kelishuv shartlari. Men Sibirga ishlashga ketayotgan qo’shnimga {p:termis} berib yubordim, faqat bitta {h:shart} bilan. U qaytganidan so’ng termisni berishi kerak.
examples: {r:The terms of the agreement were clear.} - Kelishuv shartlari aniq edi.
{r:There’s too much confusion about the terms.} - Shartlar haqida juda ko'p chalkashlik bor.
{r:A few terms were discussed at the meeting.} - Uchrashuvda bir nechta shartlar muhokama qilindi.
{r:Many people read the terms with care before signing.} - Ko'p odamlar imzolashdan oldin shartlarni diqqat bilan o'qishadi.

text: {r:Wild}[waɪld] – yovvoyi. Tasavvur qiling siz juda madaniyatli va tarbiyalisiz. Lekin 210 {p:VOLT} tok urganidan so'ng siz biroz {h:yovvoyi} bo'lib qoldingiz.
examples: {r:The wild animals were seen near the forest.} - O'rmon yaqinida yovvoyi hayvonlar ko'rildi.
{r:There’s too much danger in wild areas.} - Yovvoyi hududlarda juda ko'p xavf bor.
{r:A few wild plants were used in the medicine.} - Bir nechta yovvoyi o'simliklar dorida ishlatildi.
{r:Many people enjoy exploring wild places.} - Ko'p odamlar yovvoyi joylarni o'rganishni yoqtirishadi.

text: {r:Vehicle}[ˈviːɪkl] – transport, ulov. Mashina o’g’risiga tanbeh berishdi ‘’Agar mana shu qo’llaring bilan birovning {h:transport vositasi}ni olib qochgan bo’lsang, {p:VI}jdon {p:IKKAL}a qo’lingda ham yo’q ekan’’.
examples: {r:Maybe you will lend me your vehicle.} - Balki menga ulovingizni berib turarsiz.
{r:There’s too much traffic for the vehicle to move quickly.} - Transport vositasi tez harakatlanishi uchun juda ko'p tirbandlik bor.
{r:A few vehicles were parked beside the building.} - Bir nechta transport vositalari binoning yoniga qo'yildi.
{r:Many people rely on vehicles for daily travel.} - Ko'p odamlar kundalik sayohat uchun transport vositalariga tayanadi.

text: {r:Observe}[əbˈzɜːrv] – kuzatmoq. Gavdasi kichkina bo’lishiga qaramasdan, {p:Ob}id{p: zo’rav}onlarni to’rttasini mazasini qochirib qo’ydi. Men esa {h:kuzatib turdim}.
examples: {r:She seldom observed the stars at night.} - U kamdan-kam kechasi yulduzlarni kuzatardi.
{r:There’s too little time to observe everything.} - Hammasini kuzatish uchun unchalik vaqt yo'q.
{r:The teacher observed everything, including the smallest mistakes.} – O‘qituvchi eng kichik xatolarni ham, hamma narsani kuzatib bordi.
{r:Many people enjoy observing nature.} - Ko'p odamlar tabiatni kuzatishni yoqtirishadi.

text: {r:Facility}[fəˈsɪləti] – bino, inshoot.
examples: {r:The facility was too large to manage alone.} - Bu inshootni yolg'iz boshqarish uchun juda katta edi.
{r:There’s too much equipment in the facility.} - Inshootda juda ko'p jihozlar bor.
{r:A few facilities were closed for service on Monday.} - Bir nechta inshootlar dushanba kuni xizmat ko'rsatish uchun yopildi.
{r:Many people use the facility for training.} - Ko'p odamlar inshootni mashq qilish uchun ishlatishadi.

text: {r:Earn}[ɜːrn] – ishlamoq, qozonmoq(pul, hurmat). Hozirgi yosh qizlarga bo’lajak {p:ern}i qancha {h:topishi} juda muhim factor.
examples: {r:As a seller, he earns enough to support his family.} - Sotuvchi sifatida u o'z oilasini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun yetarli daromad oladi.
{r:There’s too little time to earn extra money.} - Qo'shimcha pul ishlash uchun unchalik vaqt yo'q.
{r:He worked hard to earn enough money to reach his target.} - U o'z maqsadiga erishish uchun yetarli pul topish maqsadida qattiq ishladi.
{r:If you want to earn respect, you should chase your goals with honesty.} - Agar hurmat qozonmoqchi bo'lsangiz, maqsadlaringizni halollik bilan ta'qib qilishingiz kerak.

text: {r:Advantage}[ədˈvɑːntɪdʒ] - afzallik, ustunlik.
examples: {r:There’s too little understanding about the advantages.} - Afzalliklar haqida unchalik tushuncha yo'q.
{r:A few advantages were discussed during the meeting.} - Uchrashuv davomida bir nechta afzalliklar muhokama qilindi.
{r:Many people take advantage of opportunities.} - Ko'p odamlar imkoniyatlardan foydalanishadi.
{r:The new policy proved to be beneficial to everyone and brought advantages.} - Yangi siyosat hamma uchun foydali bo'ldi va afzalliklar keltirdi.

text:
{r:Emerge}[ɪˈmɜːrdʒ] – paydo bo’lmoq, ko’rinmoq, chiqmoq. 
 Pingvin: {p:E Morj} qayerdan kelding, hamma baliqlarimizni yeb qo'yyapsan. 
 Morj: Arktikada {h:paydo bo’lganmiz.} Odamlar u yerlarni ham o’zlashtiryapti, ovqat qidirib shu yerga keldim.
examples: {r:The sun emerged from behind the clouds.} - Quyosh bulutlar orqasidan chiqdi.
{r:There’s too much fog for the stars to emerge.} - Yulduzlar chiqishi uchun juda ko'p tuman bor.
{r:A few new trends emerged this year.} - Bu yili bir nechta yangi trendlar paydo bo'ldi.
{r:Many people were surprised when the truth emerged.} - Haqiqat paydo bo'lganda ko'p odamlar hayratda qolishdi.

text: {r:Envy}[ˈɛnvi] - hasad, havas; hasad qilmoq. Liverpul futbol jamoasining stadioni Enfild o'zining chiroyi, shinamliligi bilan ajralib turadi. Boshqa komandalar Liverpulga {p:ENF}Ild sabab {h:hasad qilishadi}.
examples: {r:She felt too much envy about her friend’s success.} - U do'stining muvaffaqiyatiga juda ko'p hasad qildi.
{r:There’s too little reason to feel envy.} - Havas qilish uchun unchalik sabab yo'q.
{r:Envy remains his biggest problem.} - Hasad uning eng katta muammosi bo'lib qolmoqda.
{r:Many people struggle with feelings of envy.} - Ko'p odamlar hasad hissi bilan kurashishadi.

text: {r:Sales}[seɪlz] – sotuv. Bizning mahallamizdagi saylov uchastkasida tumonat odam to’plangan. Bunday paytda {p:sayl}ovda {p:s}igaret sotib bozorchi xolalar foyda ko’ryapti, {h:sotuv} zo’r bugun.
examples: {r:The sales were too good to ignore.} - Sotuvlar e'tiborsiz qoldirish uchun juda yaxshi edi.
{r:There’s too little time to prepare for the sales.} - Sotuvlarga tayyorgarlik ko'rish uchun unchalik vaqt yo'q.
{r:I work as a sales manager.} - Men sotuv menejeri sifatida ishlayman.
{r:We need to examine the sales process.} - Biz sotuv jarayonini tekshirishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Replacement}[rɪˈpleɪsmənt] - almashtirish, o'zgartirish. Replace so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The replacement part was too expensive.} - Almashtirish qismi juda qimmat edi.
{r:There’s too little time to find a replacement.} - Almashtirish uchun unchalik vaqt yo'q.
{r:Your charger cable is working. No need for a replacement.} - Zaryadchiging kabeli ishlayapti. Almashtirish shart emas.
{r:Many people prefer original parts over replacements.} - Ko'p odamlar almashtiriladigan qismlarga qaraganda original qismlarni afzal ko'radi.

text: {r:Real}[riːl] – haqiqiy, chin. Real so'zi o'zbek va rus tillarida ham "haqiqiy", "chin" degan ma'noni anglatadi leking ingliz tilidagi real so'zining talaffuzi ozgina boshqacha.
examples: {r:Is this diamond real or fake?} - Bu olmos haqiqiymi yoki soxtami?
{r:She gave me real advice that helped.} - U menga haqiqiy maslahat berdi va bu yordam berdi.
{r:He finally found real happiness.} - U nihoyat chin baxtni topdi.
{r:Her room has real dust everywhere.} - Uning xonasida hamma joyda haqiqiy chang bor.

text: {r:Come in}[kʌm ɪn] - kirmoq. Bu yerdagi {p:in} harakat {h:ichkariga} bo'layotganini ko'rsatadi.
examples: {r:Please come in and sit down.} - Iltimos, kiring va o'tiring.
{r:Her cousin came in through the back door.} - Uning xolavachchasi orqa eshikdan kirdi.
{r:"Come in!" the teacher said to the student.} - "Kiring!" dedi o'qituvchi talabaga.
{r:He came in quietly not to wake anyone.} - U hech kimni uyg'otmaslik uchun jim kirdi.

text: {r:Get in}[ɡet ɪn] - chiqmoq(mashinaga, transportga), kirmoq. Bu yerdagi in harakat ichkariga bo'layotganini ko'rsatadi.
examples: {r:Hurry up and get in the car!} - Shoshiling va mashinaga chiqing!
{r:They got in the taxi and left.} - Ular taksiga o'tirishdi va ketishdi.
{r:She couldn't get in because the door was locked.} - U kira olmadi, chunki eshik qulflangan edi.
{r:Get in the boat before it rains.} - Yomg'ir yog'ishidan oldin qayiqga o'tiring.

text: {r:Come out}[kʌm aʊt] - chiqmoq, tark etmoq. Bu yerda {p:out} harakat {h:tashqariga} bo'layotganini ko'rsatadi.
examples: {r:The cat came out of the house.} - Mushuk uydan chiqdi.
{r:Come out and play with us!} - Chiq va biz bilan o'yna!
{r:He came out of the room smiling.} - U xonadan tabassum bilan chiqdi.
{r:The students came out when the bell rang.} - Qo'ng'iroq chalingach talabalar chiqishdi.

text: {r:Go out}[ɡoʊ aʊt] - ko'chaga chiqmoq, qayergadir ketmoq.
examples: {r:Let's go out for dinner tonight.} - Kechki ovqatga ko'chaga chiqamiz.
{r:They went out to watch a movie.} - Ular film ko'rishga chiqishdi.
{r:She goes out with friends every weekend.} - U har dam olish kunida do'stlari bilan chiqadi.
{r:We're going out to celebrate.} - Biz nishonlash uchun ko'chaga chiqyapmiz.

text: {r:Eat out}[iːt aʊt] - ko'chada ovqatlanmoq(uyda ovqatlanmaslikka nisbatan ishlatiladi).
examples: {r:We eat out on Fridays.} - Biz juma kunlari ko'chada ovqatlanamiz.
{r:Do you want to eat out or cook at home?} - Ko'chada ovqatlanishni yoki uyda pishirishni xohlaysizmi?
{r:They ate out because the kitchen was messy.} - Ular ko'chada ovqatlanishdi, chunki oshxona tartibsiz edi.
{r:I love eating out with my family.} - Men oilam bilan ko'chada ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'raman.

text: {r:Wake up}[weɪk ʌp] - uyg'onmoq.
examples: {r:I wake up at 7 AM every day.} - Men har kuni ertalab soat 7 da uyg'onaman.
{r:Wake up! It's time for school.} - Uyg'on! Maktab vaqti bo'ldi.
{r:The baby woke up crying.} - Chaqaloq yig'lab uyg'ondi.
{r:She woke up late and missed the bus.} - U kech uyg'ondi va avtobusni o'tkazib yubordi.

text: {r:Stand up}[stænd ʌp] - o'rnidan turmoq. {p:Up} bu yerda {h:tepaga} harakatni bildiradi.
examples: {r:Stand up when the teacher enters.} - O'qituvchi kirganda turib oling.
{r:He stood up to shake my hand.} - U men bilan qo'l siqishish uchun turdi.
{r:Please stand up for the national anthem.} - Iltimos, davlat madhiyasi uchun turib oling.
{r:She stood up and walked to the door.} - U turdi va eshik tomon yurdi.

text: {r:Speak up}[spiːk ʌp] - balandroq gapirmoq, ovozni ko'tarmoq.
examples: {r:Speak up! I can't hear you.} - Ovozingizni ko'taring! Sizni eshitolmayapman.
{r:The shy boy finally spoke up in class.} - Uyatchan bola nihoyat sinfda balandroq gapira boshladi.
{r:You need to speak up in meetings.} - Yig'ilishlarda ovozingizni ko'tarib gapirishingiz kerak.
{r:"Speak up," the judge told the witness.} - "Ovozingizni ko'taring," dedi sudya guvohga.

text: {r:Get up}[ɡet ʌp] - uyqudan turish. Agar 'wake up' uyqudan uyg'onish bo'lsa 'get up' butunlay uyqudan uyg'onib o'rnidan ko'tarilish degani.
examples: {r:Get up or you'll be late!} - Uyqudan tur yoki kechikib qolasan!
{r:He got up from the sofa slowly.} - U divandan sekin turdi.
{r:She gets up early to exercise.} - U mashq qilish uchun erta turadi.
{r:Get up and help me clean.} - Turing va menga tozalashda yordam bering.

text: {r:Sit down}[sɪt daʊn] - o'tirmoq(stolga, divanga). {p:Down} {h:pastga} harakatni ifodalaydi.
examples: {r:Sit down and relax for a while.} - O'tiring va bir oz dam oling.
{r:The guests sat down at the table.} - Mehmonlar stolga o'tirishdi.
{r:"Sit down, please," the doctor said.} - "Iltimos, o'tiring," dedi doktor.
{r:He sat down to tie his shoes.} - U poyabzalini bog'lash uchun o'tirdi.

text: {r:Calm down}[kɑːm daʊn] - tinchlanmoq, tinchlantirmoq.
examples: {r:Calm down and take a deep breath.} - Tinchlaning va chuqur nafas oling.
{r:The teacher calmed down the noisy class.} - O'qituvchi shovqinli sinfni tinchlantirdi.
{r:Mom told me to calm down after the fight.} - Onam janjaldan keyin tinchlan dedi.
{r:The dog calmed down when its owner returned.} - It egasi qaytganda tinchlandi.

text: {r:Put down}[pʊt daʊn] - qo'yib qo'ymoq.
examples: {r:Put down the book and listen carefully.} - Kitobni qo'ying va tinglang, ayniqsa diqqat bilan.
{r:She put down her bag on the chair.} - U sumkasini stulga qo'ydi.
{r:Put down the glass carefully.} - Stakanni ehtiyotkorlik bilan qo'ying.
{r:He put down his phone during dinner.} - U kechki ovqat paytida telefonini qo'ydi.

text: {r:Fall down}[fɔːl daʊn] - yiqilib tushmoq, to'kilmoq.
examples: {r:The baby fell down but didn't cry.} - Chaqaloq yiqildi, lekin yig'lamadi.
{r:Leaves fall down in autumn, particularly in September.} - Kuzda barglar to'kiladi, ayniqsa Sentyabrda.
{r:Be careful, or you'll fall down!} - Ehtiyot bo'ling, aks holda yiqilasiz!
{r:The old tree fell down in the storm.} - Qari daraxt bo'ronda yiqildi.

text: {r:Run away}[rʌn əˈweɪ] - qochib ketmoq.
examples: {r:The thief ran away from the police.} - O'g'ri politsiyadan qochib ketdi.
{r:Our dog ran away last night.} - Itimiz kecha qochib ketdi.
{r:The kids ran away laughing.} - Bolalar kulib qochishdi.
{r:Don't run away from your problems!} - Muammolaringizdan qochmang!

text: {r:Go away}[ɡoʊ əˈweɪ] - uzoqqa ketmoq. {p:Away} bu yerda {h:uzoqlikni} bildiruvchi preposition(qo'shimcha fe'l).
examples: {r:Go away! I'm busy right now.} - Ket! Hozir bandman.
{r:They went away for the weekend.} - Ular dam olish kunlari uchun ketishdi.
{r:The pain will go away soon.} - Og'riq tez orada yo'qoladi.
{r:Summer vacation went away too fast.} - Yozgi ta'til juda tez o'tib ketdi.
{r:They went away deliberately not to do the housework.} - Ular ataylab uzoqqa ketib qolishdi uy ishlarini qilmaslik uchun.

text: {r:Give away}[ɡɪv əˈweɪ] - berib yubormoq(tekinga).
examples: {r:We gave away old clothes to charity.} - Biz eski kiyimlarni xayriya qildik.
{r:She gave away her toys to younger kids.} - U o'yinchoqlarini kichik bolalarga berdi.
{r:He gave away his extra books.} - U ortiqcha kitoblarini berib yubordi.
{r:The company gave away free samples on purpose to attract customers.} – Kompaniya mijozlarni jalb qilish uchun atayin bepul namunalar tarqatdi.

text: {r:Go back}[ɡoʊ bæk] - orqaga qaytmoq. Back bu yerda harakat orqa tomonga bo'lishini ifodalaydi.
examples: {r:Let's go back home now.} - Keling endi uyga qaytamiz.
{r:He went back to school after lunch.} - U tushlikdan keyin maktabga qaytdi.
{r:I forgot my keys and, therefore had to go back.} - Kalitlarimni unutib qo'ydim va shuning uchun qaytishim kerak bo'ldi.
{r:They went back to the same restaurant.} - Ular o'sha restoranga qaytishdi.

text: {r:Come back}[kʌm bæk] - qaytmoq.
examples: {r:Please come back soon!} - Iltimos, tezroq qaytib keling!
{r:She came back with a cup of coffee.} - U bir stakan kofe bilan qaytib keldi.
{r:The birds come back every spring.} - Qushlar har bahorda qaytib keladi.
{r:Come back when you're ready.} - Tayyor bo'lganingizda qaytib keling.

text: {r:Call back}[kɔːl bæk] - qayta qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.
examples: {r:I'll call you back in 10 minutes.} - Men 10 daqiqadan so'ng qayta qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
{r:The doctor called back to give results.} - Doktor natijalarni aytish uchun qayta qo'ng'iroq qildi.
{r:She missed your call but will call back.} - U sizning qo'ng'iroqingizni o'tkazib yubordi, lekin qayta qo'ng'iroq qiladi.
{r:Call me back after dinner.} - Kechki ovqatdan keyin menga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

text: {r:Look around}[lʊk əˈraʊnd] - atrofga qaramoq; atrofni qarab aylanib chiqmoq. {p:Around} bu yerda harakat {h:yaqin-atrofga} tegishli ekanligini bildiradi.
examples: {r:Let's look around the museum.} - Keling, muzeyni aylanib chiqamiz.
{r:She looked around the shop but didn't buy anything.} - U do'konda aylanib chiqdi, lekin hech narsa sotib olmadi.
{r:We looked around the park for the lost dog.} - Biz yo'qolgan itni qidirish uchun bog'ni aylanib chiqdik.
{r:Look around before you cross the street.} - Ko'chani kesib o'tishdan oldin atrofga qarang.

text: {r:Turn around}[tɜːrn əˈraʊnd] - qayrilmoq, o'girilmoq.
examples: {r:Turn around and smile for the photo!} - Orqangizga o'giriling va surat uchun tabassum qiling!
{r:The bus turned around at the end of the street.} - Avtobus ko'cha oxirida orqaga o'girildi.
{r:He turned around when I called his name.} - Men ismini aytganimda u orqaga o'girildi.
{r:Please turn around and go back home.} - Iltimos, orqangizga o'giriling va uyga qayting.

text: {r:Fly over}[flaɪ ˈoʊvər] - ustidan uchmoq. Bu yerda '{p:over}' harakat nimadir {h:ustida} bo'lishini anglatadi.
examples: {r:The plane flew over our house.} - Samolyot uyimiz ustidan uchib o'tdi.
{r:Birds flew over the lake.} - Qushlar ko'l ustidan uchib o'tishdi.
{r:We watched jets fly over the city.} - Biz shahar ustidan reaktiv samolyotlar uchib o'tishini tomosha qildik.
{r:A helicopter flew over the accident.} - Vertolyot baxtsiz hodisa joyi ustidan uchib o'tdi.

text: {r:Climb over}[klaɪm ˈoʊvər] - oshib o'tmoq.
examples: {r:The cat climbed over the fence.} - Mushuk to'siqdan oshib o'tib ketdi.
{r:We climbed over the rocks to reach the beach.} - Biz plyajga yetish uchun qoyalar ustidan oshib o'tdik.
{r:Don't climb over the gate—it's dangerous!} - Darvozadan oshib o'tmang - bu xavfli!
{r:He climbed over the wall to escape.} - U qochish uchun devordan oshib o'tdi.

text: {r:Get along}[ɡet əˈlɒŋ] - chiqishmoq, yaxshi munosabatda bo'lmoq.
examples: {r:My sisters get along very well.} - Opalarim juda yaxshi chiqishishadi.
{r:Do you get along with your neighbors?} - Siz qo'shnilaringiz bilan yaxshi chiqishasizmi?
{r:They got along at work but not outside.} - Ular ishda yaxshi chiqishishardi, lekin ishdan tashqarida emas.
{r:I get along with most people.} - Men ko'pchilik odamlar bilan yaxshi munosabatdaman.

text: {r:Look after}[lʊk ˈæftər] - qarab turmoq, g'amxorlik qilmoq(bolalar, qariyalar, o'simlik va hayvonlarga).
examples: {r:Can you look after my dog this weekend?} - Shu dam olish kunlari itimga qaray olasizmi?
{r:She looks after her little brother after school.} - U maktabdan keyin ukasiga qaraydi.
{r:Grandma looked after me when I was sick.} - Men kasal bo'lganimda buvim menga qaragan.
{r:Who will look after the plants while we're away?} - Biz yo'qligimizda kim o'simliklarga qaraydi?

text: {r:Find out}[faɪnd aʊt] - bilib olmoq, bilib qolmoq.
examples: {r:I just found out we have a test tomorrow!} - Men endigina ertaga testimiz borligini bilib oldim!
{r:Find out what time the movie starts.} - Film qachon boshlanishini bilib oling.
{r:We just found out that our wage is 180$.} - Biz hozirgina oyligimiz atigi 180$ ekanligini bilib qoldik.
{r:She found out the truth about the accident.} - U baxtsiz hodisa haqidagi haqiqatni bilib oldi.

text: {r:Figure out}[ˈfɪɡər aʊt] - tushunmoq, tushunib yetmoq.
examples: {r:I can't figure out this math problem.} - Men bu matematika masalasini tushunolmayapman.
{r:It took hours to figure out the instructions.} - Ko'rsatmalarni tushunib yetish uchun soatlar kerak bo'ldi.
{r:Did you figure out how to use the new phone?} - Yangi telefondan qanday foydalanishni tushunoldingizmi?
{r:We finally figured out where we went wrong.} - Nihoyat biz qayerda xato qilganimizni tushunib yetdik.

text: {r:Give up}[ɡɪv ʌp] - taslim bo'lmoq, tashlamoq, to'xtatmoq.
examples: {r:Don't give up on your dreams!} - O'z orzularingizdan voz kechmang!
{r:He gave up smoking last year.} - U o'tgan yili chekishni tashladi.
{r:Never give up.} - Hech qachon taslim bo'lma!
{r:They gave up after three failed attempts.} - Ular uch marta urinishdan keyin taslim bo'ldilar.

text: {r:End up}[ɛnd ʌp] - oxir oqibat nimadir qilmoq, oxiri qandaydir vaziyatga tushmoq.
examples: {r:We ended up at a boring party.} - Biz zerikarli kechaga borib qoldik oxiri.
{r:She ended up working late again.} - U yana kechqurungacha ishlaydigan bo'ldi.
{r:They got lost and ended up in another town.} - Ular adashib ketishdi va boshqa shaharga borib qoldilar.
{r:I ended up buying this expensive weapon.} - Men oxir-oqibat shu qimmat qurolni sotib oldim.
{r:We ended up disturbing them by mistake.} - Biz tasodifan ularni bezovta qilib qo'ydik

text: {r:Come across}[kʌm əˈkrɒs] - duch kelmoq, uchratmoq.
examples: {r:I came across a prominent actor.} - Men mashhur aktyorga duch keldim.
{r:He came across a $20 bill on the street.} - U ko'chada 20 dollarlik banknotaga duch keldi.
{r:We came across a cute café while walking.} - Biz sayr qilayotib yoqimli kafega duch keldik.
{r:Did you come across my keys?} - Siz mening kalitlarimni uchratmadingizmi?

text: {r:Hold on}[hoʊld ɒn] - kutmoq, kutib turmoq.
examples: {r:Hold on—I need to tie my shoe!} - Kuting - poyabzalimni bog'lashim kerak!
{r:Hold on a minute while I check.} - Men tekshirib ko'rayotganimda bir daqiqa kuting.
{r:"Hold on," said the teacher, "I have not finished."} - "Kuting," dedi o'qituvchi, "men hali tugatmadim."
{r:Hold on, I will let you know if the boss is in the office.} - Kutib turing, boshlig'imiz ofisdami bilib beraman.

text: {r:Go on}[ɡoʊ ɒn] - davom etmoq, davom ettirmoq.
examples: {r:The show must go on!} - Ko'rsatuv davom etishi kerak!
{r:Go on, tell me what happened next.} - Davom eting, keyin nima bo'lganini aytib bering.
{r:Life goes on even after hard times.} - Qiyin paytlardan keyin ham hayot davom etadi.
{r:She went on talking for an hour.} - U bir soat davomida gapirishda davom etdi.
{r:Go on with your dreams/goals.} - Orzularingda davom et.

text: {r:Keep on}[kiːp ɒn] - davom etmoq, davom ettirmoq.
examples: {r:Keep on practicing and you'll improve.} - Mashq qilishda davom eting va siz yaxshilanasiz.
{r:He kept on asking questions.} - U savollar berishda davom etdi.
{r:Keep on walking—we're almost there!} - Yurishda davom eting - biz deyarli yetib keldik!
{r:They kept on working despite the noise.} - Ular shovqinlarga qaramay ishlashda davom etishdi.

text: {r:Drop out}[drɒp aʊt] - o'qishni tashlab ketmoq, to'xtatmoq.
examples: {r:He decided to drop out of college.} - U kollejni tashlab ketishga qaror qildi.
{r:Many students drop out because of financial problems.} - Ko'p talabalar moliyaviy muammolar tufayli o'qishni tashlab ketishadi.
{r:She dropped out of the race after the first lap.} - U birinchi aylanishdan keyin poygadan chiqib ketdi.
{r:Don't drop out just because it's difficult!} - Faqat qiyin bo'lgani uchun tashlab ketmang!

text: {r:Get rid of}[ɡet rɪd ʌv] – qutulmoq, halos bo'lmoq.
examples: {r:I want to get rid of this old chair.} - Men bu eski stuldan qutulmoqchiman.
{r:She got rid of her bad habits.} - U yomon odatlaridan qutuldi.
{r:We need to get rid of the garbage.} - Biz chiqindidan qutulishimiz kerak.
{r:Did he get rid of the problem?} - U muammodan qutuldimi?

text: {r:Break up}[breɪk ʌp] – ajralishmoq, munosabatni tugatmoq.
examples: {r:They decided to break up after five years.} – Ular besh yildan so‘ng ajralishga qaror qilishdi.
{r:Did you break up with her?} – Sen u bilan ajrashdingmi?
{r:He was sad after the break-up.} – Ajralishdan keyin u xafa edi.
{r:Sometimes it's better to break up than to stay unhappy.} – Ba'zida baxtsiz bo‘lib qolishdan ko‘ra ajralish yaxshiroq.

text: {r:Take part} [teɪk pɑːrt] – ishtirok etmoq.
examples: {r:She wanted to take part in the school play.} - U maktab spektaklida ishtirok etishni xohladi.
{r:Will you take part in the marathon next year?} - Siz kelasi yilgi marafonda ishtirok etasizmi?
{r:Everyone is going to take part in cleaning the park.} - Hamma parkni tozalashda ishtirok etmoqchi.
{r:I took part in a conference last month.} - Men o'tgan oy konferensiyada ishtirok etdim.

text: {r:Take place} [teɪk pleɪs] – sodir bo'lmoq, bo'lib o'tmoq.
examples: {r:The concert will take place tomorrow evening.} - Konsert ertaga kechqurun bo'lib o'tadi.
{r:When did the incident take place?} - Bu voqea qachon sodir bo'lgan?
{r:The meeting takes place every Monday.} - Yig'ilish har dushanba kuni bo'lib o'tadi.
{r:The festival will take place in the city park.} - Festival shahar parkida bo'lib o'tadi.

text: {r:Disadvantage}[ˌdɪsədˈvɑːntɪdʒ] - kamchilik. Advantage(ustunlik) so'ziga inkor old qo'shimcha dis- qo'shish yordamida yasaladi.
examples: {r:The disadvantage of this plan is the cost.} - Ushbu rejaning kamchiligi narxidir.
{r:There are some disadvantages of living in the city.} - Shaharda yashashning ba'zi kamchiliklari bor.
{r:He explained the disadvantages of the project.} - U loyihaning kamchiliklarini tushuntirdi.
{r:The main disadvantage is the lack of time.} - Asosiy kamchilik vaqt yetishmasligidir.

text: {r:Reject}[rɪˈdʒekt] – rad etmoq. Boshlig’ingizga ish rejasini olib kirganda {p:REJ}angiz {p:EKT}a bo’lsin. Agar bittasini {h:rad etsa}, ikkinchisini taqdim etasiz.
examples: {r:I did my best to help, but my offer was rejected.} – Men yordam berish uchun qo‘limdan kelganini qildim, ammo mening taklifim rad qilindi.
{r:He was rejected by the university and he can't calm down now.} - Universitet uni qabul qilmadi va u tinchlana olmayapti.
{r:They rejected the idea.} - Ular g'oyani rad etishdi.
{r:I had to reject the invitation.} - Men taklifni rad etishim kerak edi.

text: {r:Willingness}[ˈwɪlɪŋnəs] - tayyorlik. Willing(tayyor) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She showed willingness to help.} - U yordam berishga tayyorligini ko'rsatdi.
{r:His willingness to learn is impressive.} - Uning o'rganishga tayyorligi hayratlanarli.
{r:They appreciated his willingness to work hard.} - Ular uning qattiq ishlashga tayyorligini qadrlashdi.
{r:I admire her willingness to take risks.} - Men uning xavfni o'z zimmasiga olishga tayyorligini qadrlayman.

text: {r:Obviously}[ˈɒbviəsli] - ochig'i, ravshanki, ko'rinib turibdiki. Obvious(aniq, ravshan) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Obviously, he didn’t understand.} - Ochig'i, u tushunmadi.
{r:She was obviously ready for an appointment.} - U rasmiy uchrashuvga aniq tayyor edi.
{r:The answer is obviously correct.} - Javob aniq to'g'ri.
{r:He was obviously lying.} - U aniq yolg'on gapiryapti.
{r:Obviously we can't hear the teacher, he has to speak up.} - Biz o'qituvchini aniq eshitolmayapmiz u balandroq gapirishi kerak.

text: {r:Previously}[ˈpriːviəsli] - oldin, ilgari. Previous(oldingi) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:She had previously worked as a teacher.} - U ilgari o'qituvchi bo'lib ishlagan.
{r:He mentioned it previously.} - U buni ilgari aytgan edi.
{r:The problem was previously discussed.} - Muammo ilgari muhokama qilingan edi.
{r:I previously had many obligations.} - Mening ilgari burchlarim ko'p edi.

text: {r:Awareness}[əˈwɛərnəs] - xabardorlik, ogohlik.
examples: {r:She has a clear awareness of the situation.} - U vaziyatni yaxshi tushunadi.
{r:The campaign raised awareness about the issue.} - Kampaniya muammo haqida xabardorlikni oshirdi.
{r:He lacks awareness of the risks.} - U xavflarni tushunmaydi.
{r:Public awareness is important.} - Jamoatchilikning xabardorligi muhim.

text: {r:Compete}[kəmˈpiːt] – musobaqalashmoq, kurashmoq, raqobatlashmoq. Mana bu ikkita {p:KANFIT} kim shirinroq deya {h:musobaqalashyapti} ekan. Ularning tamini bir tishlab ko’rgan bolalar esa ikkalasini ham yeb qo’yishibdi.
examples: {r:She is highly capable of competing at a professional level.} - U professional darajada raqobatlashishga juda qodir.
{r:She wants to compete in the race.} - U poygada qatnashmoqchi.
{r:The companies compete for customers.} - Kompaniyalar mijozlar uchun raqobat qiladi.
{r:He is ready to compete.} - U raqobatga tayyor.
{r:He came out of competition immediately.} - U musobaqadan tezda chiqib ketdi.

text: {r:Gather}[ˈɡæðər] – to’planmoq; to’plamoq. Bir do’stimiz hammamizni to’yidan so’ng uyiga o’tirishga chaqirdi. Dasturxonlar to’la bo’ladi deb kutgan edik. Borsak to’ydan qolgan {p:GAZIR}ovkalarni terib qo’ygan ekan. Shularni ichdik {h:to’planib} olib keyin.
examples: {r:They gathered in the park.} - Ular bog'da to'planishdi.
{r:She gathered information for the report.} - U hisobot uchun ma'lumot to'pladi.
{r:He gathered his friends for a meeting.} - U do'stlarini uchrashuv uchun yig'di.
{r:The team was willing to gather extra information for the report.} - Jamoa hisobot uchun qo'shimcha ma'lumot to'plashga tayyor edi.

text: {r:Annual}[ˈænjuəl] - yillik.
examples: {r:The company holds an annual meeting.} - Kompaniya yillik yig'ilish o'tkazadi.
{r:She took part in the annual conference.} - U yillik konferentsiyada qatnashdi.
{r:The annual report was published.} - Yillik hisobot nashr etildi.
{r:They celebrated the annual festival.} - Ular yillik festivalni nishonladilar.

text: {r:Affair}[əˈfɛər] - voqea, hodisa. 2006 - yili Amerika prezidenti Jorj Bushga Iroqlik jurnalist press konferensiya vaqti o'z tuflisini uloqtirgan. Bu {h:voqea} jonli {p:EFIR} payti sodir bo'lgan va butun dunyoda katta shov-shuvga sabab bo'lgan.
examples: {r:The affair caused a lot of gossip.} - Voqea ko'p mish-mishlarga sabab bo'ldi.
{r:She is handling the affair well.} - U voqeani yaxshi boshqarmoqda.
{r:The affair was discussed in the meeting.} - Yig'ilishda voqea muhokama qilindi.
{r:He was involved in the affair.} - U voqeaga aralashgan edi.

text: {r:Spread}[sprɛd] – tarqatmoq; tarqamoq. Tasavvur qiling, siz Sprite uchun ishlaysiz va ishingiz {p:sprayt}ni do’konlarga {h:tarqatish}.
examples: {r:She spread the rumours deliberately.} - U g'iybatlarni atayin tarqatdi.
{r:The fire spread to the next building.} - Yong'in keyingi binoga tarqaldi.
{r:The roots spread out at the bottom of the tree.} - Ildizlar daraxtning tagida yoyilgan.
{r:The disease spread rapidly.} - Kasallik tez tarqaldi.
{r:The organization works to promote peace and spread kindness.} - Tashkilot tinchlikni ilgari surish va ezgulikni yoyish ustida ishlaydi.

text: {r:Ignore}[ɪɡˈnɔːr] – e'tiborga olmaslik, mensimaslik. Qadimda shahzoda o’ziga xotin tanlashda ularga {p:igna or}asidan ip o’tkazishni so’rardi. Bu ishni eplay olmaganlarni esa shahzoda {h:e’tiborga ham olmasdi}.
examples: {r:Julia ignored his comments.} - Julia uning fikrlarini e'tiborsiz qoldirdi.
{r:He ignored the warning once and regretted.} - U ogohlantirishni bir marta e'tiborsiz qoldirdi va afsuslandi.
{r:It's better to ask than to ignore facts and make an assumption.} - Faktlarga e'tibor bermaslik va taxmin qilishdan ko'ra so'ragan ma'qul.
{r:I can’t ignore the noise.} - Men shovqinni e'tiborsiz qoldira olmayman.

text: {r:Gift}[ɡɪft] – sovg’a. Sariq bola gif qilyapti ekan. Agar u aytgan barcha Instagram akkountlariga a’zo bo’lishsa g’olib bo’lgan odamga {p:GIF}da Treker {h:sovg’a} qilinadi.
examples: {r:She received a beautiful gift.} - U chiroyli sovg'a oldi.
{r:Sobir gave her a gift for her birthday.} - Sobir unga tug'ilgan kuni uchun sovg'a berdi.
{r:Come in, I will show you my gift.} - Uyga kir, men senga sovg'amni ko'rsataman.
{r:They exchanged gifts at the party.} - Ular kechada sovg'alarni almashishdi.
{r:He was very generous and always gave unexpected gifts.} - U juda saxiy edi va doim kutilmagan sovg'alar berar edi.

text: {r:Review}[rɪˈvjuː] – ko’rib chiqmoq, qaytadan o’rganmoq. Men 3 – sinfda o’qiydigan ukam bilan uyga vazifalarni {h:ko’rib chiqyapmiz.} Birinchi o’qish kitobidagi rivoyatni o’qiymiz. {p:RIV}oyat {p:YU}mronqoziq haqida.
examples: {r:She wrote a review of the book.} - U kitob haqida sharh yozdi.
{r:Get in the car, we will review the report carefully.} - Mashinaga chiq, hisobotni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqamiz.
{r:They reviewed the plan before starting.} - Ular boshlashdan oldin rejani ko'rib chiqishdi.
{r:I need to review my notes.} - Men eslatmalarimni ko'rib chiqishim kerak.

text: {r:Speed}[spiːd] – tezlik. Mashinani {h:tezligini} bilish uchun odatda {p:SPID}ometrga qaraymiz.
examples: {r:The car was moving at high speed.} - Mashina yuqori tezlikda harakatlanardi.
{r:She increased the speed of her work.} - U ish tezligini oshirdi.
{r:He ran with great speed.} - U juda tez yugurdi.
{r:Slow internet speed can frustrate users greatly.} - Sekin internet tezligi foydalanuvchilarni juda xafa qilishi mumkin.
{r:The subway train can reach high speed in the city.} - Metro poyezdi shaharda yuqori tezlikka erisha oladi.

text:
{r:Male} [meɪl] – erkak.
- Abdurahmon, Qobil hamma {p:meyl}isga! 
 - Men ham boray rais buva 
 - Yo’q bu faqat {h:erkak}lar uchun
examples: {r:Male dogs and cats wake up earlier.} - Erkak it va mushuklar ertaroq uyg'onishadi.
{r:Is the new employee male or female?} - Yangi xodim erkakmi yoki ayolmi?
{r:Only male students graduated from this university this year.} - Faqat o'g'il bola talabalar bu yil bu universitetni bitirishdi.
{r:Male monkeys are usually deemed weaker.} - Erkak maymunlar odatda kuchsizroq hisoblanadi.

text: {r:Wave} [weɪv] – to'lqin; qo'l siltamoq, hilpiratmoq. Tasavvur qiling {h:To’lqin} ismli jinoyatchini tutish uchun militsiya mashinasi ‘VIYV, {p:VEYV}’ deya qattiq tovush chiqarib boryapti.
examples: {r:We cannot prevent unnecessary waves from spreading.} - Biz keraksiz to'lqinlarni tarqalishini oldini ololmaymiz.
{r:The ocean waves crashed against the shore.} - Okean to'lqinlari qirg'oqqa urildi.
{r:He waved goodbye to his friends.} - U do'stlariga xayr deya qo'l siltadi.
{r:A new wave of technology is emerging.} - Texnologiyaning yangi to'lqini paydo bo'lmoqda.

text: {r:Quarter} [ˈkwɔːrtər] – chorak, kvartal. Bilasizmi men butun bir Fayzobod kvartalini ko’tara olaman. Qanday qilib deysizmi, mana bunday qilib, {h:kvartalni} maketini {p:KO’TAR}ib albatta.
examples: {r:I'll meet you at a quarter past three.} - Siz bilan uchdan chorak o'tganda uchrashaman.
{r:She divided the apple into four quarters.} - U olmani to'rt chorakka bo'ldi.
{r:The company's profits increased in the last quarter.} - Kompaniyaning foydasi oxirgi chorakda oshdi.
{r:They live in the old quarter of the city.} - Ular shaharning eski kvartalida yashaydilar.

text: {r:Background} [ˈbækɡraʊnd] – kelib chiqish, nasl-nasab; orqa fon. Toshkent moliya institutida {p:BEK}orchilarga {p:GRAND} e’lon qilindi. Asosiy sharti esa ‘{h:nasl-nasabigacha}’ bekorchilar bo’lishi kerak ekan. Shunday qilib ota-bola hatto bobolargacha kelib hujjat topshirib ketishyapti.
examples: {r:The mountains in the background looked majestic.} - Orqa fondagi tog'lar ulug'vor ko'rinardi.
{r:The team has a variety of people from different backgrounds.} - Jamoada turli xil millatlarga mansub odamlar bor.
{r:What is your background?} - Kelib chiqishing qanday?
{r:The old stone crossroad in the background adds to the historic feel.} - Orqa fondagi eski tosh chorraha tarixiy kayfiyatni kuchaytiradi.

text: {r:Broad} [brɔːd] – keng. 2 – jahon urushi vaqtida Yevropadan kelgan millionlab qochqinlarni xalqimiz ko’ksini {h:‘keng’} ochib {p:BROD}arlik qilib kutib olishgan.
examples: {r:The river was very broad at that point.} - Daryo o'sha joyda juda keng edi.
{r:She has a broad knowledge of history.} - Uning tarix bo'yicha keng bilimi bor.
{r:I'll look around the broad hall.} - Men keng zalni aylanib chiqaman.
{r:The company has a broad range of products.} - Kompaniya keng turdagi mahsulotlarga ega.

text: {r:Partially}[ˈpɑːrʃəli] - qisman. Tasavvur qiling siz {h:qisman} {p:QARSHILI}siz. Sizning buvingiz Qarshidan.
examples: {r:The project was partially finished when the deadline passed.} - Muddat o'tganda loyiha qisman tugallangan edi.
{r:She partially opened the window before leaving.} - U ketishdan oldin derazani qisman ochdi.
{r:While partially deaf, he could still hear music.} - Qisman kar bo'lishiga qaramay, u musiqani eshita olardi.
{r:I found out that my aunt was partially aware of my secrets.} - Xolam sirlarimdan qisman xabardor ekanligini bilib oldim.

text: {r:Limit}[ˈlɪmɪt] - limit, cheklov, chegara.
examples: {r:If you limit screen time, focus improves.} - Agar ekran vaqtini cheklasangiz, diqqatingiz yaxshilanadi.
{r:Check the speed limit before driving.} - Haydashdan oldin tezlik chegarasini tekshiring.
{r:While respecting budget limits, plan carefully.} - Byudjet chegaralarini hurmat qilgan holda, diqqat bilan rejalashtiring.
{r:After exceeding the limit once, warnings appear.} - Cheklovlardan bir marta oshgandan so'ng, ogohlantirishlar paydo bo'ladi.

text: {r:Female}[ˈfiːmeɪl] – ayollarga oid;ayol jinsiga oid.
examples: {r:When female athletes compete, records break.} - Ayol sportchilar musobaqalashganda, rekordlar yangilanadi.
{r:The female CEO arrived before the meeting.} - Ayol bosh direktor yig'ilishdan oldin keldi.
{r:Only female athletes can take part in the competition.} - Faqat ayol sportchilar bu musobaqada qatnasha oladi.
{r:After hiring more females, diversity increased.} - Ko'proq ayollarni ishga olgandan so'ng, xilma-xillik oshdi.
{r:All individuals, male or female, are deemed equal.} - Barcha shaxslar, erkak yoki ayol, teng deb hisoblanadi.

text: {r:Observation}[ˌɒbzərˈveɪʃən] - kuzatish. Observe(kuzatmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:When making observations, record details carefully.} - Kuzatuvlar qilayotganda, tafsilotlarni diqqat bilan yozib oling.
{r:The scientist's observation happened before the discovery.} - Olimning kuzatuvlari kashfiyotdan oldin sodir bo'ldi.
{r:Based on my observation, many people object to these changes.} - Mening kuzatishlarimga ko'ra ko'p odamlar bu o'zgarishlarga e'tiroz bildirishadi.
{r:After careful observation, we understood what we needed most.} - Diqqatli kuzatuvlardan so'ng, bizga nima eng ko'p kerakligini tushunib yetdik.

text: {r:Cruelty}[ˈkruːəlti] - shafqatsizlik. Cruel(shafqatsiz) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Such cruelty should never take place again.} – Bunday shafqatsizlik boshqa hech qachon bo‘lmasligi kerak.
{r:The law prohibits animal cruelty before slaughter.} - Qonun so'yishdan oldin hayvonlarga shafqatsizlik qilishni taqiqlaydi.
{r:While witnessing cruelty, intervene safely.} - Shafqatsizlikka guvoh bo'layotganda, xavfsiz tarzda aralashing.
{r:She was treated with obvious cruelty.} - U ochiqdan-ochiq shavqatsizlik bilan munosabatda bo'lindi.

text: {r:Consciousness}[ˈkɒnʃəsnəs] - ong, hush. 'Conscious' so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 'conscious' so'ziga qarang.
examples: {r:When regaining consciousness, stay calm.} - Hushga qaytayotganda, sokin bo'ling.
{r:He wants to take part in activities that raise consciousness about health} – U sog‘liq haqida ongni oshiradigan faoliyatlarda qatnashishni xohlaydi.
{r:While monitoring consciousness, watch for changes.} - Ongni kuzatayotganda, o'zgarishlarga e'tibor bering.
{r:If he loses consciousness, call for help.} - Agar u hushidan ketsa, yordamga chaqiring.

text: {r:Influence}[ˈɪnflʊəns] – ta’sir; ta’sir etmoq. Inflyatsiya nafaqat narxlarni oshishiga balki ba’zi tovarlarni bozordan yo’qolishiga ham sababchi bo’ladi. Masalan O’zbekistonda {p:INFLY}atsiya {p:UNS}izlakka olib keladi va insonlar hayotiga {h:ta'sir qiladi}.
examples: {r:When leaders influence positively, teams thrive.} - Yetakchilar ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatganda, jamoalar rivojlanadi.
{r:Her influence grew before the election.} - Saylovdan oldin uning ta'siri kuchaydi.
{r:His recommendation had a strong influence on our decision.} - Uning tavsiyasi bizning qarorimizga kuchli ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
{r:Your arrival will not influence our decisions.} - Sening yetib kelishing qarorimizga ta'sir ko'rsatmaydi.
{r:Reading helps to influence and develop your brain power.} - Kitob o'qish miya kuchingizni rivojlantirishga ta'sir qiladi.

text: {r:Destroy}[dɪˈstrɔɪ] – vayron qilmoq. Tarixdagi birinchi desant operatsiyasi(dushman egallagan hududda jangovar harakat qilishga moʻljallab samolyot, vertolyot va dengiz, daryo orqali tushirilgan yoki shu maqsadda tuzilgan qoʻshin) haqida gapirib beraman. Troya filmini ko’rgan bo’lsangiz kerak. Spartaliklar Troyaga tinchlik ramzi sifatida katta ot haykalini jo’natishadi, troyaliklar esa xursandchilikdan ichishadi. Ot haykalining ichida esa ko’plab desantlar yashiringan edi. Ular mast aholini osongina qirib tashlaydi. Shunday qilib {p:DES}antlar {p:TROY}ani {h:vayron qilishadi}.
examples: {r:If fires destroy homes, act quickly.} - Agar olov uylarni vayron qilsa, tez harakat qiling.
{r:The storm destroyed crops before harvest.} - Bo'ron hosilni yig'ishdan oldin vayron qildi.
{r:While destroying terrorist bases, planes flew over us.} - Terror bazalarini yo'q qilayotganda, samolyotlar ustimizdan uchib o'tdi.
{r:Enemies did not think for a second when they destroyed the cities.} - Dushman shaharlarni vayron qilayotganida bir soniya ham o'ylamadi.

text: {r:Submit}[səbˈmɪt] – topshirmoq, taqdim qilmoq; bo’ysunmoq. Odamlarni kuldirgani va ko’nglini olgani uchun mukofotimiz {p:SAB}zi {p:MIT}ti.me ga {h:topshiriladi}.
examples: {r:When you submit applications, double-check.} - Ariza topshirayotganda, ikki marta tekshiring.
{r:He submitted the report before lunch.} - U tushlikdan oldin hisobotni topshirdi.
{r:While submitting proposals, track deadlines.} - Takliflarni topshirayotganda, muddatlarni kuzatib boring.
{r:After submitting complaints, wait for responses.} - Shikoyatlarni topshirgandan so'ng, javoblarni kutib turing.

text: {r:Grade}[ɡreɪd] – baho; sinf. 5 – sinfda o’qiyotgan vaqtimda jismoniy tarbiya darsida ajoyib mashg’ulot bo’lgan edi. {p:G}arajga {p:reyd} uyushtirganmiz, eng ko’p mashinalarga chizib tashlaganlar eng yaxshi {h:baho} olishgan.
examples: {r:After getting low grades, he dropped out of school.} - Yomon baholar olganidan so'ng u maktabni tashlab ketdi.
{r:What is your overall grade?} - Umumiy bahoying necha?
{r:Shuhrat is in the sixth grade.} - Shuhrat 6 - sinfda o'qiydi.
{r:We used to study until ninth grade.} - Biz 9-sinfga qadar o'qir edik.

text: {r:Bone}[boʊn] – suyak. Big {p:Bon}dan yangi mahsulot. Bu qadoq ichida har doimgi lapsha emas balki {h:suyak.} Ilik sho’rva qilib ichishingiz uchun.
examples: {r:I could not remember where I put down the bones for my dog.} - Itim uchun olingan suyakni qayerga qo'yib qo'yganligimni eslolmayman.
{r:The dog buried its bone before dinner.} - It kechki ovqatdan oldin suyagini ko'mdi.
{r:My dog is searching for bones.} - Itim suyak qidiryapti.
{r:He fell down and broke his bones.} - U yiqilib tushdi va suyaklarini sindirib oldi.

text: {r:Extend}[ɪkˈstend] – uzaytirmoq, kengaytirmoq, cho’zmoq. Tasavvur qiling {p:eks}kavatorda {p:ten}nis o’ynayapsiz, ustida, chunki sizning maqsadingiz bo’yingizni {h:uzaytirish}.
examples: {r:When you extend deadlines, notify everyone.} - Muddatlarni uzaytirganingizda, hammaga xabar bering.
{r:The company extended benefits before negotiations.} - Kompaniya muzokaralardan oldin imtiyozlarni kengaytirdi.
{r:The tree's branches reached high and extended over the roof.} – Daraxt shoxlari balandga yetib, tom ustiga yoyilib ketgan edi.
{r:The store extended its hours every day except Sunday.} – Do‘kon har kuni ish vaqtini uzaytirdi, yakshanba bundan mustasno.

text: {r:Chief}[tʃiːf] – boshliq, rahbar. Tasavvur qiling xuddi multfilmlardagidek hayvonlar ham gapirib odamlarga qo’shilib jamiyat hayotida faol qatnashsa. Fil sizning kasbdoshingiz, {p:CHIV}in esa {h:boshlig’}ingiz bo’lardi.
examples: {r:If the chief speaks, listen carefully.} - Agar boshliq gapirsa, diqqat bilan tinglang.
{r:If the chief is thirsty, give him a cup of water.} - Agar boshliq chanqasa unga bir krushka suv ber.
{r:The chief revealed all necessary information.} - Boshliq hamma kerakli ma'lumotlarni oshkor qildi.
{r:After the chief retired, traditions continued.} - Boshliq nafaqaga chiqqanidan keyin ham an'analar davom etdi.

text: {r:Combine}[kəmˈbaɪn] – birlashtirmoq, bog’lamoq. Tasavvur qiling odamlar uchun ham {p:kombayn} ishlab chiqarilyapti. Faqat uning vazifasi odamlar beliga dum {h:‘’birlashtirish’’}.
examples: {r:When you combine ingredients, mix thoroughly.} - Mahsulotlarni aralashtirganda, yaxshilab qorishtiring.
{r:She combined colors before painting.} - U bo'yashdan oldin ranglarni aralashtirdi.
{r:If you combine these ingredients, you might come across a surprising new taste.} - Agar bu ingredientlarni aralashtirsangiz, kutilmagan yangi ta'mga duch kelishingiz mumkin.
{r:After combining efforts, success followed.} - Kuchlarni birlashtirgandan so'ng, muvaffaqiyat keldi.

text: {r:Remind}[rɪˈmaɪnd] – eslatmoq. Italiyaning Rim shahriga sayohatga boryapman. Borganda Yuventus va Romaning o’yinlarini tomosha qilaman. Romadagi hamyurtim Eldor bilan rasmga tushmoqchiman. Shuningdek Gladiatorlar jang qilgan Kolizeyni ko’rib kelaman va oxirida {p:RI}mdagi {p:MAYN}alar muzeyiga ham tashrif buyuraman. Lekin bu eng ahamiyatsizi shuning uchun esimdan chiqib ketishi mumkin. Agar esimdan chiqsa xotinim {h:eslatadi} chunki bu ko'proq uning ideyasi.
examples: {r:If you remind politely, people appreciate it.} - Agar odamlarga xushmuomalalik bilan eslatsang, ular buni qadrlaydi.
{r:He reminded me something important when I was cooking.} - Ovqat pishirayotganimda u menga muhim narsani eslatdi.
{r:Pregnant women should be reminded not to smoke.} - Homilador ayollarga chekmaslik eslatilishi kerak.
{r:After reminding them twice, she stopped.} - Ikkita eslatishdan so'ng, u to'xtadi.

text: {r:Victory}[ˈvɪktəri] – g’alaba. Ruslar va yevropa xalqlaridagi Viktor va Viktoriya ismlari aynan shu so’zdan olingan. Agar futbol tomosha qilsangiz Viktor Valdezni eslashingiz yetarli. Barselona doimo {h:g’alaba} qozonardi, chunki ularning darvozasini {p:Viktor} qo’riqlagan.
examples: {r:When celebrating victory, stay humble.} - G'alabani nishonlaganda, kamtarin bo'ling.
{r:Their victory was clear before halftime, therefore I left stadium.} - Ularning g'alabasi tanaffusdan oldin aniq edi shuning uchun stadionni tark etdim.
{r:That was a victory of entire humanity.} - Bu butun insoniyatning g'alabasi edi.
{r:After the victory, we all went back home.} - G'alabadan so'ng biz hammamiz uyga qaytdik.

text: {r:Daily}[ˈdeɪli] - kunlik, har kungi. Day(kun) so'zidan olingan.
examples: {r:When tracking daily progress, use charts.} - Kunlik progressni kuzatayotganda, jadvallardan foydalaning.
{r:She completed her daily tasks before afternoon.} - U kunlik vazifalarini tushdan oldin bajardi.
{r:I make daily exercises on the field.} - Men kundalik mashqlarni maydonda qilaman.
{r:I practice English on a daily basis.} - Men har kuni Ingliz tilini mashq qilaman.

text: {r:Pair}[peər] – juftlik. Ayolingiz {h:juftingizga} tort olib berishga imkoningiz bo’lmasa, ozgina arzonroq bo’lgan {p:PIYR}og berib uni xursand qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:When you pair students, consider skills.} - O'quvchilarni juftlashtirganda, ularning ko'nikmalarini hisobga oling.
{r:The former champions returned as a strong pair.} – Sobiq chempionlar kuchli juftlik sifatida qaytishdi.
{r:We bought an additional pair of shoes for the trip.} – Sayohat uchun qo‘shimcha bir juft oyoq kiyim sotib oldik.
{r:Turn around and you will see a pair of socks.} - Orqangga o'giril va sen bir juft paypoqni ko'rasan.

text: {r:Slightly}[ˈslaɪt.li] – biroz, sal, ozgina. Menimcha maktabda har bir dars slaydlar bilan tushuntirib berilishi kerak. {p:Slaydli} darslar o’quvchilarga {h:biroz} yaxshiroq tushunarli bo’lishi isbotlangan.
examples: {r:She was slightly tired after the walk.} – U sayrdan keyin sal charchagan edi.
{r:The soup is slightly salty.} – Sho‘rva biroz sho‘rroq.
{r:Prices have increased slightly.} – Narxlar biroz oshgan.
{r:The divorce slightly affected her health, and she caught a disease.} - Ajralish uning sog‘lig‘iga biroz ta’sir qildi va u kasallikka chalinib qoldi.

text: {r:Knee}[niː] – tizza. Bu o’rinda siz {h:‘tizzangizga’’} {p:NI}nachi qo’nganini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin. Yanada yaxshiroq esda qolishi uchun bu tasavvurni yanada bo’rttirishimiz mumkin. Masalan juda katta ninachi, rangi esa pushti.
examples: {r:If your knee hurts, reduce activity.} - Tizzangiz og'riganda, faollikni kamaytiring.
{r:He iced his knee before the game.} - U o'yindan oldin tizzasini muzlab oldi.
{r:When your knee hurts, immediately go to see a doctor.} - Tizzang og'rigan payti doktorga ko'rinishga bor.
{r:My uncle broke his left knee and I have to look after him.} - Amakim chap tizzasini sindirib olibdi va men unga endi qarab turishim kerak.
{r:You need to bend your knees slightly when you lift heavy objects.} - Og'ir narsalarni ko'targaningizda tizzalaringizni biroz bukishingiz kerak.

text: {r:Hire}[ˈhaɪər] – yollamoq. Tasavvur qiling yangi biznes boshlandingiz va sizga ishchilar kerak. Siz esa tasodifan 4 ta {p:Hayr}iddin ismli yigitlarni {h:yolladingiz}.
examples: {r:If you hire wisely, productivity increases.} - Agar aql bilan yollasangiz, unumdorlik oshadi.
{r:They hired new staff before expansion.} - Ular bizneslari kattarishidan oldin yangi xodimlarni ishga oldilar.
{r:Keep on hiring skilled and experienced people.} - Mahoratli va tajribali odamlarni yollashda davom eting.
{r:After hiring the candidate, provide training.} - Nomzodni ishga olgandan so'ng, trening o'tkazing.

text: {r:Apparently}[əˈpærəntli] - ko'rinishidan, aniq, muqarrar. Apparent(ko'rinishidan) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:If it's apparently true, we should investigate.} - Agar bu ko'rinishidan haqiqat bo'lsa, biz tekshirishimiz kerak.
{r:Apparently Anvar steals my documents.} - Ko'rinishidan Anvar hujjatlarimni o'g'irlayapti.
{r:If the results are apparently wrong, recheck them.} - Agar natijalar ko'rinishidan noto'g'ri bo'lsa, ularni qayta tekshiring.
{r:Apparently, they won’t agree unless we offer more money.} – Ko‘rinishidan, biz ko‘proq pul taklif qilmaguncha ular rozi bo‘lmaydi.

text: {r:Ignorance}[ˈɪɡnərəns] - e'tiborsizlik. Ignore(e'tibor bermaslik) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:If you show ignorance, ask questions politely.} - Agar e'tiborsizlik ko'rsatsangiz, savollarni xushmuomala bering.
{r:Problems will entirely grow if ignorance continues.} - Agar e'tiborsizlik davom etsa, muammolar butunlay kattalashadi.
{r:Because of their ignorance, the prisoner ran away.} - Ularning e'tiborsizligi tufayli mahbus qochib ketdi.
{r:Unless we fight ignorance, progress is impossible.} – E'tiborsizlikka qarshi kurashmasak, taraqqiyot imkonsizdir.

text: {r:Widely}[ˈwaɪdli] - keng. Wide(keng) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:If it's widely known, why hide it?} - Agar bu keng tarqalgan(hamma bilsa) bo'lsa, nega yashirish kerak?
{r:The idea will spread if shared widely.} - Agar ulashilsa, g'oya keng tarqaladi.
{r:If the product is widely available, buy it locally.} - Agar mahsulot keng ko'lamda mavjud bo'lsa, uni mahalliy sotuvdan oling.
{r:Knowledge cannot be widely spread unless people are willing to teach.} – Odamlar o‘rgatishga tayyor bo‘lmasa, bilim keng tarqalmaydi.

text: {r:Threaten}[ˈθrɛtn] – tahdid qilmoq. Mana bu serialni eslasangiz kerak. Amir har doim Nihonga ‘tahdid qiladi’. Agar Nihon Amirni tashlab ketsa Nihonning ukasi jinoyatchi ekanligini isbotlovchi {p:SURATN}i politsiyaga topshirish bilan {h:tahdid qiladi}.
examples: {r:If you threaten others, expect consequences.} - Agar boshqalarni tahdid qilsangiz, oqibatlariga tayyor bo'ling.
{r:Animals attack if they feel threatened.} - Hayvonlar o'zlarini xavf ostida his qilsalar, hujum qilishadi.
{r:He threatened to call the police unless they left immediately.} – Agar ular darhol ketmasa, u politsiyani chaqirish bilan tahdid qildi.
{r:The local drugstore is being threatened.} - Mahalliy dorixonaga tahdid qilishyapti.

text: {r:Familiar}[fəˈmɪliər] – tanish, yaqin(asosan narsa va predmetlarga nisbatan). Qishloqda yashab qanday boyib ketish mumkin? O’zingizga {h:tanish} ishdan boshlang. Ferma oching, {p:FE}rma {p:MILLYAR}der qilib yuboradi sizni agar tinmasdan mehnat qilsangiz.
examples: {r:Don't talk to people unless they seem familiar.} - Odamlar bilan gaplashma agar tanish tuyulmasa.
{r:You'll learn faster if the topic is familiar.} - Agar mavzu tanish bo'lsa, tezroq o'rganasiz.
{r:If his face looks familiar, introduce yourself.} - Agar uning yuzi tanish tuyulsa, o'zingizni tanishtiring.
{r:Mistakes happen if procedures aren't familiar.} - Agar protseduralar tanish bo'lmasa, xatolar sodir bo'ladi.

text: {r:Appropriate}[əˈproʊpriət] – mos. Siz hech narsa bilan shug’ullanmay zerikyapsizmi hozir? Siz uchun eng mos mashg’ulot hozir opera eshitish, {p:APR}el {p:OPERA} eshitish uchun eng {h:‘mos’} oy.
examples: {r:If the dress isn't appropriate, probably you have to change it.} - Agar ko'ylak mos kelmasa, balki uni almashtirish kerak.
{r:Kids will behave well if given appropriate toys.} - Agar bolalarga mos o'yinchoqlar berilsa, ular yaxshi xulq ko'rsatishadi.
{r:If your words aren't appropriate, apologize.} - Agar so'zlaringiz tayinli bo'lmasa, uzr so'rang.
{r:The meeting will fail without appropriate preparation.} - Agar mos tayyorgarlik bo'lmasa, yig'ilish muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ladi.
{r:Please call to confirm if the time is still appropriate for our meeting.} - Iltimos, uchrashuvimiz uchun vaqt hali ham mosmi yoki yo'qligini tasdiqlash uchun qo'ng'iroq qiling.

text: {r:Supply}[səˈplaɪ] – ta’minlamoq, yetkazib bermoq; taminot. Siz eng ajoyib ishlardan biriga egasiz.{p: SAP}yorlarga {p:LAY}cha itlar {h:yetkazib} berasiz.
examples: {r:If the supply runs low, order more.} - Agar ta'minot kamayib ketsa, yana buyurtma bering.
{r:Prices will rise if the supply decreases.} - Agar ta'minot kamaysa, narxlar ko'tariladi.
{r:They will supply whatever is needed for the project.} - Ular loyiha uchun kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani yetkazib berishadi.
{r:Factories close if raw materials aren't supplied.} - Agar xom ashyo ta'minlanmasa, fabrikalar yopiladi.
{r:After the good harvest, food was abundant and the supply was plentiful.} - Yaxshi hosildan keyin oziq-ovqat mo'l-ko'l edi va ta'minot yetarli edi.

text: {r:Constant}[ˈkɒnstənt] – doimiy, muttasil. Konsta ajoyib ijodkor, uning fikrlashi boshqalarnikidan mutlaqo farqli. U ko’proq erkinlik tarafdori va shuning uchun ham {h:doimiy} ravishda {p:KONSTa ANT}iradarlarni reklama qiladi.(namuna uchun yozildi)
examples: {r:You won't notice any constant improvement unless you practice every day.} – Har kuni mashq qilmasang, doimiy taraqqiyotni sezmaysan.
{r:Progress slows if changes are constant.} - Agar o'zgarishlar doimiy bo'lsa, taraqqiyot sekinlashadi.
{r:If your support is constant, your cousin will succeed.} - Agar sizning qo'llab-quvvatlashingiz doimiy bo'lsa, amakivachchangiz muvaffaqiyatga erishadi.
{r:Machines break if use is constant.} - Agar foydalanish doimiy bo'lsa, mashinalar buziladi.

text: {r:Tie}[taɪ] – galstuk: bog’lamoq. Siz noodatiy insonlardan birisiz, hovlingizdagi {p:tay}oqni {h:galstuk} qilib bog’lab olgansiz.
examples: {r:I gave away my tie to my cousin.} - Men galstugimni amakivachchamga berib yubordim.
{r:If your shoes are tied, you won't trip.} - Agar poyabzallaringiz bog'langan bo'lsa, chalinmaysiz.
{r:You are not allowed entry unless you have a tie.} - Galstugingiz bo'lmasa sizga kirishga ruxsat yo'q.
{r:I was forced to stand up in class because I forgot my tie.} - Meni tikka turib dars tinglashga majburlashdi chunki galstugim esimdan chiqqandi.

text: {r:Primary}[ˈpraɪməri] – asosiy. Tasavvur qiling sizda {p:PRAY}niklar {p:MIRI}shkori nomli sertifikat bor. Bu degani siz shahar yoki viloyatdagi eng {h:asosiy} praynik pishirib sotadigan qandolatchisiz.
examples: {r:If the primary color is red, mix carefully.} - Agar asosiy rang qizil bo'lsa, ehtiyotkorlik bilan aralashtiring.
{r:Students thrive if primary needs are met.} - Agar talabalarning asosiy ehtiyojlari qondirilsa, ular rivojlanadi.
{r:If the primary reason changes, inform us.} - Agar asosiy sabab o'zgarsa, bizga xabar bering.
{r:The plan won’t work unless we solve the primary problem first.} – Avval asosiy muammoni hal qilmasak, reja ishlamaydi.

text: {r:Circle}[ˈsɜːrkl] – aylana; doira. Mana bu {p:SIR}ka {p:KAL} odamning boshidan chiqib keta olmayapti. Chunki kallasining kal joyi {h:‘aylana’} shaklida ekan. Aylanib-aylanib chiqib keta olmayapti.
examples: {r:If you circle the right answer, you'll pass.} - Agar to'g'ri javobni aylana qilib belgilasangiz, o'tasiz.
{r:Trust grows if your circle is small.} - Agar doirangiz kichik bo'lsa, ishonch ortadi.
{r:If wolves circle the camp, stay calm.} - Agar bo'rilar lagerni o'rab olsa, tinchlaning.
{r:Ideas improve if shared within a circle.} - Agar g'oyalar do'stlar doirasi ichida baham ko'rilsa, ular yaxshilanadi.

text: {r:Alarm}[əˈlɑːrm] – signalizatsiya, trevoga; cho’chish, qo’rquv. Turkiyada Isroil {p:EL}chixonasi {p:ARM}aturalar bilan qurollangan aholining hujumiga uchradi. Muassasa hududida kuchli {h:signalizatsiya} borligi tufayli elchixona xodimlari zudlik bilan evakuatsiya qilindi.
examples: {r:If the alarm sounds, exit immediately.} - Agar signal chalinsa, darhol chiqib keting.
{r:You'll wake neighbors if the alarm rings at night.} - Agar signal kechqurun chalinsa, qo'shnilaringizni uyg'otasiz.
{r:The villagers showed no alarm unless the dogs barked.} – Itlar hurmasa, qishloq aholisi xavotirlanmasdi.
{r:There was no alarm in his voice unless he spoke about the war.} – Urush haqida gapirmaguncha uning ovozida vahima yo'q edi.

text: {r:Offend}[əˈfend] - haqorat qilmoq. Aytishlaricha Afandi instagramda vayner bo'lgan ekan. Odamlarni yaxshi kuldirsa ham bir kun uni 'Bachkana' deb {h:haqorat qilishibdi}. Haqoratlangan {p:AFAND}i bu ishlarini tashlab, qishloqqa ketib dehqonchilik qilishni boshlabdi.
