examples: {r:If you offend someone personally, apologize sincerely.} - Agar kimnidir shaxsan xafa qilsangiz, samimiy uzr so'rang.
{r:Sobir was calm unless offended.} - Sobir haqorat qilinmaguncha tinch o'tirgandi.
{r:If his words offend you, speak up.} - Agar uning so'zlari sizni xafa qilsa, gapiring.
{r:Discussions fail if participants feel offended.} - Agar ishtirokchilar xafa bo'lsa, munozaralar muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ladi.

text: {r:Absolutely}[ˈæbsəluːtli] - mutlaqo, albatta. Absolute(mutlaqo) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:If you're absolutely sure, sign the contract.} - Agar sizning mutlaqo ishonchingiz komil bo'lsa, shartnomani imzolang.
{r:I absolutely get along well with the chief.} - Men boshliq bilan mutlaqo yaxshi kelishaman.
{r:If the answer isn't absolutely clear, ask again.} - Agar javob mutlaqo aniq bo'lmasa, yana so'rang.
{r:This woman absolutely loves luxury.} - Bu ayol mutlaqo hashamatni sevadi.
{r:I absolutely hate long queues.} - Men uzun navbatlarni butunlay yomon ko'raman.

text: {r:Regret}[rɪˈɡret] - afsuslanmoq; afsus, pushaymonlik. Bizning maktabda ayol o'qituvchilar dekretga chiqadida ishlamasdan ham oylikni olaveradi. Erkaklarga ham {p:DEKRET}ga o'xshash narsa yo'qligidan {h:afsuslanaman}.
examples: {r:If you regret your choice, it's never too late.} - Agar tanlovingizdan pushaymon bo'lsangiz, hech qachon kech emas.
{r:We decided to eat out but regretted later because we got stuck in a traffic jam.} - Biz ko'chada ovqatlanishga qaror qildik va keyinchalik afsuslandik chunki probkada qolib ketdik.
{r:If she shows regret, forgive her.} - Agar u pushaymonlik ko'rsatsa, uni kechiring.
{r:I tried to persuade her, but she didn't want to regret her decision later.} - Men uni ishontirishga harakat qildim, lekin u keyinchalik qaroridan afsuslanishni istamadi.

text: {r:Pollute}[pəˈluːt] - ifloslantirmoq(havo, tabiat). Tasavvur qiling har safar telefoningizda {p:POLYOT}ni o'chirib yoqsangiz havo {h:ifloslanib} ketadi.
examples: {r:If we pollute rivers, wildlife suffers.} - Agar daryolarni ifloslasak, yovvoyi tabiat aziyat chekadi.
{r:Future generations will pay if we pollute carelessly.} - Agar beparvo ifloslasak, kelajak avlodlari buni to'lashadi.
{r:If factories pollute illegally, fine them.} - Agar fabrikalar noqonuniy havoni ifloslantirsa, ularga jarima soling.
{r:Air quality drops if cars pollute excessively.} - Agar mashinalar haddan tashqari ifloslantirsa, havo sifati pasayadi.

text: {r:Alive}[əˈlaɪv] - tirik. Live(yashamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:If plants stay alive, water them weekly.} - Agar o'simliklar tirik qolsa, ularni haftasiga bir marta sug'oring.
{r:Traditions remain alive if practiced regularly.} - Agar an'analar muntazam ravishda amal qilinsa, ular tirik qoladi.
{r:If the patient is still alive, don't lose hope.} - Agar bemor hali tirik bo'lsa, umidni yo'qotmang.
{r:Stories feel alive if told passionately.} - Agar hikoyalar ehtiros bilan aytilsa, ular tirik tuyuladi.

text: {r:Chicken}[ˈtʃɪkɪn] – tovuq. Aslida inglizchadagi 'chicken' so’zi ham o’zbekchadan olingan ekan. Matqobil aka Amerikaga borib tovuq boqishni boshlabdi. Ba’zan uning hovlisida aylanib yurgan tovuqlarni qo’shnilarning iti bezovta qilar edi. Agar qo’shni itlar tovuqlarga hamla qilmoqchiligini sezsa Matqobil bitta yaxshilab {p:CHEKIN} deb baqirarkan va {h:tovuq}lari o’zlarining kataklariga kirib ketisharkan.
examples: {r:If the chicken is undercooked, cook it longer.} - Agar tovuq yetarlicha pishmagan bo'lsa, uni uzoqroq pishiring.
{r:Farmers struggle if chicken prices drop.} - Agar tovuq narxlari tushsa, fermerlar qiynalishadi.
{r:If you eat raw chicken, you'll get sick.} - Agar xom tovuq yesangiz, kasal bo'lasiz.
{r:The recipe fails if chicken isn't fresh.} - Agar tovuq yangi bo'lmasa, retsept muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ladi.

text: {r:Abuse}[əˈbjuːz] – suiiste'mol qilish; so’kish. {p:Ab}ror kattalarga hurmatsizlik qildi, {p:yuz}iga oyoq qo’ygandek bo’ldi. Odamlarning ishonchini {h:suiiste'mol qildi} va kimlarningdir so’kishini ham eshitdi.
examples: {r:If you abuse power, you'll lose respect.} - Agar hokimiyatni suiiste'mol qilsangiz, hurmatni yo'qotasiz.
{r:You won't hear any abuse from her unless someone offends her first.} – Kimdir avval uni haqorat qilmasa, undan hech qachon so‘kish eshitmaysiz.
{r:The teacher avoids abuse unless the students break all the rules.} – O‘qituvchi faqat o‘quvchilar barcha qoidalarni buzganidagina haqoratli so‘zlardan foydalanadi.
{r:Trust shatters if abuse of trust occurs.} - Agar ishonchni suiiste'mol qilish sodir bo'lsa, ishonch parchalanadi.

text: {r:Domestic}[dəˈmɛstɪk] – uyga oid, domashniy. Bu so’z aynan uyning o’zini bildirmaydi, balki uyga oid obyektlarni anglatadi. Rus tilidagi 'domashniy' so’zining inglizcha tarjimasi.
examples: {r:If domestic flights are apparently cheaper, book them.} - Agar ichki reyslar ko'rinishidan arzonroq bo'lsa, ularni bron qiling.
{r:Economies grow if domestic production increases.} - Agar ichki ishlab chiqarish ko'paygan bo'lsa, iqtisodiyot rivojlanadi.
{r:If domestic animals seem ignored, call authorities.} - Agar uy hayvonlari e'tiborsiz qoldirilganga o'xshasa, hokimiyatga murojaat qiling.
{r:Laws change if domestic violence rates rise.} - Agar oiladagi zo'ravonlik darajasi o'sgan bo'lsa, qonunlar o'zgaradi.

text: {r:Competition}[ˌkɒmpəˈtɪʃən] - musobaqa; raqobat. Mana bu {p:KAMPIR ISHTON} tikish {h:musobaqasida} g'olib bo'libdi.
examples: {r:If there were no competition, prices would rise.} - Agar raqobat bo'lmasa, narxlar ko'tarilar edi.
{r:We would win if the competition were fairer.} - Agar raqobat adolatliroq bo'lsa, biz yutar edik.
{r:Sit down and watch the competition. Our neighbour will take part there.} - O'tirib ol va musobaqani tomosha qil. Bizning qo'shnimiz ham qatnashadi.
{r:She would enter if the competition weren't so intense.} - Agar raqobat shu qadar qattiq bo'lmasa, u ishtirok etar edi.
{r:The competition is taking place in Turkey.} - Musobaqa Turkiyada bo'lib o'tmoqda.

text: {r:Gathering}[ˈɡæðərɪŋ] - yig'ilish. Gather(yig'moq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:If the gathering were smaller, we'd know everyone.} - Agar yig'ilish kichikroq bo'lsa, biz hammani tanigan bo'lar edik.
{r:They'd cancel the gathering if pollution levels rose.} - Agar ifloslanish darajasi ko'tarilsa, ular yig'ilishni bekor qilar edilar.
{r:If we combined two gatherings, it would save money.} - Agar ikkita yig'ilishni birlashtirsak, pul tejab qolar edik.
{r:I would take part in the gathering if it were more organized.} - Agar yig'ilish yaxshiroq tashkil qilinganida, men qatnashar edim.

text: {r:Pollution}[pəˈluːʃən] - ifloslanish. Pollute(ifloslamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:If pollution decreased, cities would be healthier.} - Agar ifloslanish kamaysa, shaharlar sog'lomroq bo'lar edi.
{r:We would swim if the pool weren't polluted.} - Agar hovuz ifloslanmagan bo'lsa, biz suzgan bo'lar edik.
{r:The new law imposes a heavy fine for pollution.} - Yangi qonun ifloslanish uchun katta jarima soladi.
{r:Animals would thrive if pollution weren't so extreme.} - Agar ifloslanish shu qadar qattiq bo'lmasa, hayvonlar yaxshi rivojlanar edi.
{r:The environment does not deserve to be polluted; we must save its natural beauty.} - Atrof-muhit ifloslanishga loyiq emas; biz uning tabiiy go'zalligini saqlashimiz kerak.

text: {r:Combination}[ˌkɒmbɪˈneɪʃən] - kombinatsiya, birikma, uyg'unlik. U ikki yoki undan ortiq narsa birgalikda bir butun hosil qilgan holatni ifodalashda ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:If this combination worked, results would improve.} - Agar bu kombinatsiya ishlasa, natijalar yaxshilanar edi.
{r:She would succeed if the combination were perfect.} - Agar kombinatsiya mukammal bo'lsa, u muvaffaqiyat qozonar edi.
{r:If we expanded the combination, it would help more.} - Agar bu uyg'unlikni kengaytirsak, yanada ko'proq yordam berar edi.
{r:They'd regret it if the combination failed.} - Agar kombinatsiya muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa, ular pushaymon bo'lar edilar.

text: {r:Assess}[əˈsɛs] – baholamoq, tahlil qilmoq. {p:ESES}er davlatini hamma har xil {h:baholaydi.} Kimdir uchun repressiya va qatag'onlar davlati bo'lgan bu davlat yana kimdir uchun xalqlar do'stligi timsoli.
examples: {r:If you assessed risks properly, you would avoid danger.} - Agar xavflarni to'g'ri baholaganingizda, xatardan qochgan bo'lar edingiz.
{r:We would trust him if he assessed fairly.} - Agar u adolatli baholaganida, biz unga ishonar edik.
{r:If I could assess the damage, I'd help more.} - Agar men zararni baholay olganimda, ko'proq yordam berar edim.
{r:They'd panic if they assessed the real situation.} - Agar ular haqiqiy vaziyatni baholay olganida, vahimaga tushar edilar.

text: {r:Fuel}[ˈfjuːəl] – yoqilg'i. Borussiya Dortmund o'yinchisi Nikolas {p:Fyul}krug to'xtamasdan gollar uryapti. 'Benzinmi dizelmi qandaydir {h:yoqilg'i} ichyapsanmi bunday yaxshi o'ynash uchun?' deb hazillashishar ekan.
examples: {r:If fuel prices dropped, we'd travel more.} - Agar yoqilg'i narxlari tushganida, biz ko'proq sayohat qilar edik.
{r:Cars would be cleaner if fuel quality improved.} - Agar yoqilg'i sifati yaxshilanganida, mashinalar toza bo'lar edi.
{r:If they explored alternatives, fuel dependence would decrease.} - Agar ular muqobil variantlarni o'rganishganida, yoqilg'iga bo'lgan qaramlik kamayar edi.
{r:How much is fuel?} - Yoqilg'ining narxi qancha?

text: {r:Pool}[puːl] – ko'lmak: basseyn. Bugun omadingiz kelmadi, {h:basseynga} sho'rtigingiz bilan tushdingiz cho'milish uchun. Lekin hamma {p:pul}ingiz sho'rtigingiz cho'ntagida ekan.
examples: {r:If the pool were heated, we'd swim daily.} - Agar hovuz isitilganida, biz har kuni suzgan bo'lar edik.
{r:Kids would play safely if the pool were shallower.} - Agar hovuz sayozroq bo'lganida, bolalar xavfsiz o'ynar edilar.
{r:If they expanded the pool, it would attract tourists.} - Agar ular hovuzni kengaytirishganida, bu sayyohlarni jalb qilar edi.
{r:I'd exercise more if a pool were nearby.} - Agar yaqinimda hovuz bo'lganida, men ko'proq mashq qilar edim.
{r:I work in a swimming pool for a small wage.} - Men kichkina maoshga basseynda ishlayman.

text: {r:Climb}[klaɪm] – yuqoriga chiqmoq, ko'tarilmoq. Everest cho'qqisiga mashaqqat bilan {h:ko'tarildingiz.} Lekin u yerda ajoyib voqeani guvohi bo'ldingiz. Mollar {p:KLA}viaturani {p:YEM} sifatida yeb turishibdi.
examples: {r:If you climbed carefully, you wouldn't fall.} - Agar ehtiyotkorlik bilan chiqqaningizda, yiqilmas edingiz.
{r:We'd reach the summit if the climb weren't icy.} - Agar ko'tarilish muzli bo'lmaganida, biz cho'qqiga yetgan bo'lar edik.
{r:If they predicted the weather, the climb would be safer.} - Agar ular ob-havoni oldindan aytishganida, ko'tarilish xavfsizroq bo'lar edi.
{r:She'd join us if the climb were easier.} - Agar ko'tarilish osonroq bo'lganida, u bizga qo'shilar edi.

text: {r:Pitch}[pɪtʃ] – maydon. Bunyodkor maydoni yomg'ir natijasida loylari ko'chib futbol o'ynashga yaroqsiz bo'lib qoldi. Endi {p:stadion} ma'sullari maydonga {h:PICH}an solishni reja qilyapti.
examples: {r:If the pitch were smoother, players wouldn't get injured.} - Agar maydon silliqroq bo'lganida, o'yinchilar jarohat olmas edilar.
{r:They'd win if the pitch conditions were better.} - Agar maydon sharoiti yaxshiroq bo'lganida, ular yutar edilar.
{r:If we could expand the pitch, more teams would come.} - Agar maydonni kengaytira olganimizda, ko'proq jamoalar kelar edi.
{r:I'd play if the pitch weren't so muddy.} - Agar maydon shu qadar loyqa bo'lmaganida, men o'ynar edim.

text: {r:Expand}[ɪkˈspænd] – kengaymoq, kengaytirmoq. Flavis ichimligi anordan qilinadi va 2024 – yili sotuvlar ko'lami bo'yicha Coca Colani ortda qoldirdi. Asosiy zavodi Andijonda joylashgan. Talab yuqoriligi uchun barcha viloyatlardan anor keltirilyapti. Anor {p:EKSp}orti {p:AND}ijonga bo'lyapti. Yuk tashuvchi furalarning ko'pligidan pereval ham {h:kengaytirilyapti}.
examples: {r:Additionally, if we expanded the team, we'd handle more projects.} - Bundan tashqari agar jamoani kengaytirganimizda, ko'proq loyihalarni bajarar edik.
{r:The business would grow if we expanded overseas.} - Agar chet elga kengayganimizda, biznes rivojlanar edi.
{r:If you explored new markets, opportunities would increase.} - Agar yangi bozorlarni o'rganganingizda, imkoniyatlar ko'payar edi.
{r:They'd hire you if they expanded operations.} - Agar ular operatsiyalarni kengaytirishganida, sizni ishga olishar edi.

text: {r:Lip}[lɪp] – lab. Tasavvur qiling {p:lib}osingizning hamma yerida {h:lab}ning rasmlari bor.
examples: {r:My lips are red.} - Lablarim qizil.
{r:She'd smile more if her lip weren't injured.} - Agar labi jarohatlanmaganida, u ko'proq kulgan bo'lar edi.
{r:If the doctor assessed your lip properly, it'd heal faster.} - Agar shifokor labingizni to'g'ri tekshirganida, u tezroq tuzalgan bo'lar edi.
{r:I'd kiss you if your lip weren't bleeding.} - Agar labingiz qonamaganida, men sizni o'pgan bo'lardim.

text: {r:Mental}[ˈmɛntl] – aqliy, ruhiy. Daraxtlarning eng aqllisi tol ekan. Tasavvur qiling siz o'z {h:aqliy} salohiyatingizni juda yuqori baholaysiz. Shuning uchun o'zingizni insonlarning toli hisoblaysiz. Xullas siz '{p:MEN TOL}' deysiz.
examples: {r:Depending on your mental health, taking breaks can help you recharge and feel better.} - Ruhiy salomatligingizga qarab, tanaffus qilish sizni tetiklashtirib, yaxshi his qilishingizga yordam beradi.
{r:We'd understand more if mental processes were simpler.} - Agar aqliy jarayonlar soddaroq bo'lganida, biz ko'proq tushungan bo'lar edik.
{r:If they explored mental wellness, productivity would rise.} - Agar ular aqliy farovonlikni o'rganishganida, unumdorlik oshar edi.
{r:She'd recover if mental stress decreased.} - Agar aqliy stress kamayganida, u tuzalib ketar edi.

text: {r:Explore}[ɪkˈsplɔːr] – tadqiq etmoq, o'rganmoq, sinab ko'rmoq. Qulog'ingizdan to'xtamasdan tarakanlar chiqyapti. Siz esa xavotir olib lorga bordingiz va xayriyatki sizning muammongizni {p:EKSP}ert {p:LOR} {h:tadqiq} etdi va yordam berdi.
examples: {r:If we explored more, we'd discover hidden gems.} - Agar biz ko'proq tadqiq etganimizda, yashirin qimmatbaho javohirlarni topgan bo'lar edik.
{r:They'd fund us if we explored profitable ideas.} - Agar biz foydali g'oyalarni o'rganganimizda, ular bizni moliyalashtirgan bo'lar edilar.
{r:If you could explore alternatives, you'd find better options.} - Agar muqobillarni o'rganish imkoniyatingiz bo'lganida, yaxshiroq variantlarni topgan bo'lar edingiz.
{r:I'd travel if I explored cheaper routes.} - Agar arzonroq yo'llarini o'rganganimda, sayohat qilgan bo'lardim.

text: {r:Obtain}[əbˈteɪn] – qo'lga kiritmoq, egallamoq. {p:Obid tiyin} tangalarni yig'ishni yaxshi ko'radi. Bu qiziqishini eshitgan amakisi bir kuni unga sovet davridan qolgan bir uy tangalarini berib yuboribdi. Shunday qilib u o'zi uchun katta xazinani {h:qo'lga kiritdi}.
examples: {r:If you obtained permission, we'd start immediately.} - Agar ruxsat olganingizda, biz darhol boshlagan bo'lar edik.
{r:The research would progress if we obtained funding.} - Agar moliyalashtirish olganimizda, tadqiqotlar rivojlanar edi.
{r:If they could obtain the documents, they'd solve the case.} - Agar ular hujjatlarni olishganida, ishni hal qilgan bo'lar edilar.
{r:We'd celebrate if we obtained the license.} - Agar litsenziyani olganimizda, nishonlagan bo'lar edik.

text: {r:Surround}[səˈraʊnd] – o'rab olmoq. Siz ko'rib turgan suratxona egasi avval duradgor bo'lib ishlagan. Shuning uchun ham {p:SUR}atxona {p:RANd}a bilan {h:o'ralgan}.
examples: {r:If trees surrounded the house, it would be quieter.} - Agar uyni daraxtlar o'rab olganida, jimjitroq bo'lar edi.
{r:We'd feel safer if walls surrounded the house.} - Agar devorlar uyni o'rab turganida, biz o'zimizni xavfsizroq his qilar edik.
{r:They'd panic if enemies surrounded them.} - Agar dushmanlar ularni o'rab olishganida, vahimaga tushishgan bo'lar edilar.
{r:Despite the beautiful scenery that surrounded him, he still felt homesick.} - Uni o'rab turgan go'zal manzaraga qaramay, u hali ham uyini sog'indi.

text: {r:Predict}[prɪˈdɪkt] – oldindan aytmoq, bashorat qilmoq. {p:Pre}zidentlar {p:dikt}ofonda ovozlari yozib olinib tarqab ketishlaridan qo'rqishadi. Shuning uchun ularning ovozlarini maxfiy yozib olishga urinishadigan holatlarni, hokimiyatda paydo bo'luvchi muammolarni {h:oldindan aytib beradigan} insonlarni o'zlariga yollayaptilar.
examples: {r:If we could predict the future, we'd avoid mistakes.} - Agar kelajakni oldindan aytish imkoniyatimiz bo'lganida, xatolardan qochgan bo'lar edik.
{r:Scientists can predict the likelihood of natural disasters.} - Olimlar tabiiy ofatlar ehtimolini bashorat qila oladi.
{r:Scientists predict that the immune system might reject the new organ.} - Olimlar immun tizimi yangi organni rad etishi mumkinligini taxmin qilishmoqda.
{r:I'd invest if experts predicted growth.} - Agar mutaxassislar o'sishni bashorat qilishganida, men investitsiya qilgan bo'lardim.

text: {r:Supreme}[suːˈpriːm] – oliy, yuqori. Men uchun {h:eng yaxshi} kelin tozalikka amal qilib yashaydigan kelin. Har kuni uy yig'ishtirib, artib tozalab yursa. Meni har ko'rganda 'Uylarni yana {p:SUPRIYMI}' deb tursa ayni muddao.
examples: {r:If the supreme court ruled differently, laws would change.} - Agar oliy sud boshqacha qaror chiqarganida, qonunlar o'zgargan bo'lar edi.
{r:They would appeal if the supreme decision were unfair.} - Agar oliy qaror adolatsiz bo'lganida, ular shikoyat qilishgan bo'lar edilar.
{r:If supreme leaders agreed, peace would follow.} - Agar oliy rahbarlar kelishishganida, tinchlik kuzatilgan bo'lar edi.
{r:This is supreme quality.} - Bu oliy sifat.

text: {r:Pocket}[ˈpɒkɪt] – cho'ntak. Tasavvur qiling shimingiz cho'ntagi yirtilib ketdi butunlay. Siz esa shimning ikkita {h:cho'ntagiga} ham mato o'rniga ikkita {p:paket}ni tikib qo'yib oldingiz.
examples: {r:If your pocket were deeper, you would carry more.} - Agar cho'ntagiz chuqurroq bo'lganida, ko'proq narsa olib yurgan bo'lar edingiz.
{r:I'd buy snacks if I had pocket money.} - Agar cho'ntagimda pul bo'lganida, gazak sotib olgan bo'lardim.
{r:If pickpockets surrounded us, we would hide our pockets.} - Agar cho'ntak o'g'irlari bizni o'rab olishganida, cho'ntaklarimizni yashirgan bo'lar edik.
{r:He would look smarter if his pockets weren't torn.} - Agar uning cho'ntaklari yirtilmaganida, u aqlliroq ko'ringan bo'lar edi.

text: {r:Influential}[ˌɪnfluˈɛnʃəl] - kuchli ta'sirga ega, ta'sirli. Influence(ta'sir qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:If you were more influential, people would listen.} - Agar siz yanada qudratli bo'lganingizda, odamlar tinglagan bo'lar edilar.
{r:Policies would change if influential leaders cared.} - Agar ta'sirli rahbarlar qayg'urganida, siyosat o'zgargan bo'lar edi.
{r:If this book were influential, minds would shift.} - Agar bu kitob ta'sirli bo'lganida, fikrlar o'zgargan bo'lar edi.
{r:We would succeed if we had influential allies.} - Agar ta'sirli ittifoqchilarimiz bo'lganida, biz muvaffaqiyat qozongan bo'lar edik.

text: {r:Consequence}[ˈkɒnsɪkwəns] – oqibat, natija. Futbolni odatda chips va kola bilan tomosha qilishadi. Hozirgi payt Toshkentda {p:KONS}ertni {p:KVAS} ichib tomosha qilishyapti. {h:Natijada} sahnaga chiqib ketib janjal uyushtirayotganlar soni ko'payapti.
examples: {r:If consequences were clearer, people would behave better.} - Agar oqibatlar aniqroq bo'lganida, odamlar yaxshiroq xulq qilishgan bo'lar edilar.
{r:She would reconsider if the consequences were severe.} - Agar oqibatlari jiddiy bo'lganida, u qayta o'ylagan bo'lar edi.
{r:If we predicted the consequences, we'd act differently.} - Agar oqibatlarni oldindan aytolganimizda, boshqacha harakat qilgan bo'lar edik.
{r:The full consequence of his actions, previously hidden, is now clear.} - Uning harakatlarining ilgari yashiringan to'liq oqibati endi aniq.

text: {r:Crash}[kræʃ] – avariya, to'qnashuv; avariya bo'lmoq, to'qnashmoq. Men katta yo'lda normal tezlikda ketayotgan bo'lsamda qarama-qarshi yo'lakdan mashina kelib urildi. Keyin ma'lum bo'lishicha mashina haydovchisi {p:KRESH}ki paketini ochaman deb chalg'ib ketibdi va {h:to'qnashib} ketdi.
examples: {r:If the car hadn’t crashed, they would have arrived on time.} - Agar mashina avariyaga uchramaganda edi, ular vaqtida yetib kelgan bo'lar edi.
{r:The loud crash startled everyone.} - Baland shovqin hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
{r:She heard a crash in the kitchen.} - U oshxonadan shovqin eshitdi.
{r:The crash caused a lot of damage, particularly to a grey car.} - Avariya ko'p zarar keltirdi, ayniqsa kulrang mashinaga.

text: {r:Pleasant}[ˈplɛzənt] - yoqimli. Please(ko'nglini olmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:If the weather had been pleasant, we would have gone for a walk.} - Agar ob-havo yoqimli bo'lganda edi, sayr qilgan bo'lar edik.
{r:She had a pleasant conversation with her friend.} - U do'sti bilan yoqimli suhbat qildi.
{r:The hotel had a pleasant atmosphere.} - Mehmonxonada yoqimli muhit bor edi.
{r:It was a pleasant surprise.} - Bu yoqimli syurpriz edi.

text: {r:Interrupt}[ˌɪntəˈrʌpt] – bo'lmoq(gapni), suqilmoq, aralashmoq. Bir necha yillardan beri Italiyada yashayman. Italiyaning bir necha shaharlari bo'ylab taksi haydayman. Yo'llari meni qoniqtiradi, yaxshi lekin baribir shoshib tezlikni oshiradiganlar ham bor. Kecha masalan orqamdan bitta avtobus {h:suqilyapti.} Oynadan qarasam {p:INTER}ni {p:APT}obusi ekan. Mashhur futbol jamoasini aytyapman. Xursand bo'lib ketdim va ularga yo'l berdim. Avtobusning yoniga tushib olib mashhur futbolchilarni tomosha qilib ketdim. O'zbek futbolchilariga o'xshab karta o'ynab o'tiribdi.
examples: {r:If you hadn’t interrupted me, I would have finished my story.} - Agar siz meni to'xtatmaganingizda edi, hikoyamni tugatgan bo'lardim.
{r:The phone call interrupted their meeting.} - Telefon qo'ng'irog'i ularning uchrashuvini bo'ldi.
{r:She didn’t mean to interrupt you.} - U sizni bo'lmoqchi emas edi.
{r:The noise interrupted his concentration.} - Shovqin uning diqqatini bo'ldi.

text: {r:Annoy}[əˈnɔɪ] - xafa qilmoq, jahlini chiqarmoq. Agar sizning oilangizda kimdir onangiz, akangiz va sizni {h:xafa qilayotgan} bo'lsa bu k{p:ENOY}i bo'lishi mumkin.(namuna uchun yozildi, hech kimga xusumatimiz yo'q).
examples: {r:If Robert hadn’t annoyed her, she wouldn’t have left.} - Agar Robert uni jahlini chiqarmaganda edi, u ketmagan bo'lardi.
{r:The constant noise annoyed everyone.} - Doimiy shovqin hammani jahli chiqardi.
{r:Julia was annoyed by his behavior.} - Uning xatti-harakati Juliani xafa qildi.
{r:Don’t annoy the dog on purpose.} - Itni ataylab jahli chiqarma.

text: {r:Litter}[ˈlɪtər] - axlat tashlamoq, musor qilmoq; axlat, musor. Bizning axlatxonaga 100 tacha butilkada {p:LITR}ovkalar {h:tashlab ketishibdi.} Natijada mahallamiz alkashlari katta bazm qilishdi.
examples: {r:If people hadn’t littered, the park would have been clean.} - Agar odamlar axlat tashlamaganida edi, bog' toza bo'lgan bo'lardi.
{r:She picked up the litter and threw it in the dustbin.} - U axlatni olib, chiqindi qutisiga tashladi.
{r:The beach was full of litter.} - Qirg'oq chiqindi bilan to'la edi.
{r:Littering is not allowed here.} - Bu yerda chiqindi tashlash mumkin emas.

text:
{r:Freeze}[friːz] - muzlamoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - froze, frozen. 
Mana bu idishdagi suyuqlik antifriz. Lekin bu muzlashga qarshi suyuqlik emas, balki teskarisi. Agar bu anti{p:FRIZ}dan sepsangiz odam ham, suv ham, tog' ham {h:muzlab} qoladi.
examples: {r:If the water hadn’t frozen, we could have gone swimming.} - Agar suv muzlamaganida edi, suzishga borgan bo'lar edik.
{r:She froze when she saw the bear.} - U ayiqni ko'rib, qotib qoldi.
{r:The pipes froze in the cold weather.} - Sovuq ob-havoda quvurlar muzlab qoldi.
{r:The computer screen froze; therefore, I called you back.} - Kompyuter ekrani qotib qoldi va shuning uchun sizga qayta qo'ng'iroq qildim.

text: {r:Familiarity}[fəˌmɪlɪˈærəti] - tanishlik, xabardorlik, bilish. Familiar(tanish) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:If there had been more familiarity, the team would have worked better.} - Agar ko'proq xabardorlik bo'lganida edi, jamoa yaxshiroq ishlagan bo'lardi.
{r:His familiarity with the subject impressed everyone.} - Uning mavzu bilan tanishligi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
{r:She spoke with familiarity about the topic.} - U mavzu haqida tanishlik bilan gapirdi.
{r:Familiarity leads to comfort.} - Xabardorlik qulaylikka yetaklaydi.

text: {r:Primarily}[praɪˈmɛrəli] - asosan. Primary(asosiy) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:If the event had been primarily for students, more would have attended.} - Agar tadbir asosan talabalar uchun bo'lsa edi, ko'proq odam qatnashgan bo'lardi.
{r:The book is primarily about history.} - Kitob asosan tarix haqida.
{r:She is primarily responsible for the project.} - U asosan loyiha uchun mas'ul.
{r:The company primarily focuses on technology.} - Kompaniya asosan texnologiyaga e'tibor qaratgan.

text: {r:Alarming}[əˈlɑːrmɪŋ] - xavfli, xavotirli. Alarm so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:If the situation hadn’t been so alarming, they wouldn’t have called for help.} - Agar vaziyat shunchalik xavfli bo'lmaganda edi, ular yordam chaqirmagan bo'lardi.
{r:The news was slightly alarming.} - Yangiliklar biroz xavotirli edi.
{r:She noticed an alarming trend.} - U xavfli tendentsiyani payqadi.
{r:The report contained alarming statistics.} - Hisobotda xavfli statistikalar bor edi.

text: {r:Adopt}[əˈdɒpt] - qabul qilmoq; asrab olmoq. Bobom menga 10 ta kitob sotib olibdi har xil mavzularga oid. {p:ADAB}iyotga qiziqqanligim uchun shu mavzudagi kitoblarni {h:qabul qildim} va qolganlarini amakivachchalarimga berib yubordim.
examples: {r:If they had adopted the plan earlier, the project would have succeeded.} - Agar ular rejani ertaroq qabul qilganida edi, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgan bo'lardi.
{r:She decided to adopt a new strategy.} - U yangi strategiyani qabul qilishga qaror qildi.
{r:They adopted a child last year.} - Ular o'tgan yili farzand asrab olishdi.
{r:The company adopted new policies.} - Kompaniya yangi qoidalarni qabul qildi.

text: {r:Breast}[brɛst] - ko'krak.
examples: {r:If she had checked her breast earlier, the disease could have been prevented.} - Agar u ko'kragini ertaroq tekshirtirganida edi, kasallikni oldini olish mumkin edi.
{r:She felt pain in her breast.} - U ko'kragida og'riq sezdi.
{r:Breast cancer is a serious illness.} - Ko'krak bezi saratoni jiddiy kasallikdir.
{r:The baby was fed directly from the breast.} - Chaqaloq ko'krak suti bilan boqildi.

text: {r:Acknowledge}[əkˈnɒlɪdʒ] – tan olmoq, e'tirof etmoq. {p:Ek}inzordan hosilni sotib olishga kelgan xaridorga faqat {p:nalich}ni qabul qilinishini aytdi dehqonbobo. ' {h:Tan olaman} amaki tarvuzni zo'r yetishtiribsiz, mayli men plastigimni pul qildirib kelaman' dedi xaridor.
examples: {r:If he had acknowledged his mistake, the problem would have been solved.} - Agar u xatosini tan olganida edi, muammo hal bo'lgan bo'lardi.
{r:My female boss acknowledged my help.} - Ayol rahbarimiz mening yordamimni e'tirof etdi.
{r:The company acknowledged the issue.} - Kompaniya muammoni tan oldi.
{r:Her work played a prominent role in the project's success, gaining widespread acknowledgment.} - Uning ishi loyiha muvaffaqiyatida muhim rol o'ynadi, bu unga keng e'tirof olib keldi.

text: {r:Conclude}[kənˈkluːd] - xulosa qilmoq, yakunlamoq, tugatmoq. {h:Xulosa qilib} aytishim mumkinki dunyodagi eng serqirra odam bu {p:JAN KLOD} Van Damm. U aktyor, sportchi, dublyaj ustasi, raqqos va hokazo.
examples: {r:If they had concluded the meeting earlier, they would have saved time.} - Agar ular uchrashuvni ertaroq yakunlaganida edi, vaqtni tejagan bo'lardi.
{r:She concluded her speech with a quote.} - U nutqini iqtibos bilan yakunladi.
{r:They concluded the deal successfully.} - Ular bitimni muvaffaqiyatli yakunladilar.
{r:The data indicates a clear conclusion.} - Ma'lumotlar aniq xulosani ko'rsatadi.(conclusion - xulosa)

text: {r:Shadow}[ˈʃædoʊ] - soya. Biz do'stlarimiz bilan ovga chiqdik yovvoyi tabiatga. Bitta kattamiz 'bo'ldi {p:SHET}ta {p:OV} qilamiz, daraxt tagida {h:soya} joy bor ekan. Jaziramada quyosh tagida yugurib yurmaymiz' dedi.
examples: {r:If the shadow hadn’t scared her, she wouldn’t have screamed.} - Agar soya uni qo'rqitmaganda edi, u qichqirmagan bo'lardi.
{r:The tree had a long shadow.} - Daraxt uzun soyaga ega edi.
{r:She walked in the shadow of the building.} - U binoning soyasida yurdi.
{r:The shadow moved in the moonlight.} - Soy oy yorug'ida harakatlandi.

text: {r:Struggle}[ˈstrʌɡl] – kurashmoq, olishmoq; qiynalmoq; harakat qilmoq, tirishmoq; kurashish, tirishish. {p:ST}adiondagi {p:REKL}amalar odamning joniga tegdi, mazza qilib futbol ham ko'rolmaysan. Qo'shimchasiga televizor ekranida ham reklamalar. Biz futbol fanatlari reklamalarga qarshi {h:kurashish}ga qaror qildik.
examples: {r:If they hadn’t struggled so much, they would have finished on time.} - Agar ular shunchalik qiynalmaganda edi, vaqtida tugatgan bo'lar edi.
{r:She struggled to carry the heavy bag.} - U og'ir sumkani ko'tarish uchun qiynaldi.
{r:The team struggled to win the game.} - Jamoa o'yinda g'alaba qozonish uchun kurashdi.
{r:The economic crisis threatened their livelihood and caused much struggle.} - Iqtisodiy inqiroz ularning tirikchiligiga tahdid soldi va ko'p kurashlarga sabab bo'ldi.
{r:She was wide awake and struggled to fall asleep.} - U uyg'oq edi va uxlab qolishga qiynaldi.

text: {r:Shift}[ʃɪft] – smena. Tasavvur qiling siz uy ta'mirlovchi ustasiz. Lekin bir yildan beri faqat bitta odamning shiftini remont qilyapsiz. {p:Shift} shunchalik kattaki ikkita usta {h:smena} bilan ishlab bitira olmayapsiz.
examples: {r:If the shift had been shorter, she wouldn’t have been so tired.} - Agar smena qisqaroq bo'lsa edi, u shunchalik charchamagan bo'lardi.
{r:He worked the night shift.} - U tungi smenada ishladi.
{r:I should take a bath before a boring shift starts.} - Men zerikarli smenam boshlanmasdan oldin dush qabul qilib olishim kerak.
{r:I have 20 shifts a month.} - Mening 1 oyda 20 ta smenam bor.

text: {r:Maintenance}[ˈmeɪntənəns] – ta'mirlash, tuzatish, remont. Mayna qushlar orasida ajoyib va mustahkam in qura olishi bilan mashhurdir. Ini mustahkam bo'lishi uchun {p:MAYN}a {p:TANASI} bilan inini qattiq bosib turadi va in ancha jips bo'ladi. Natijada kelajakda {h:remont qilish}ga hojat qolmaydi.
examples: {r:If the maintenance had been done regularly, the machine wouldn’t have broken.} - Agar ta'mirlash muntazam ravishda bajarilganda edi, mashina buzilmagan bo'lardi.
{r:The building requires regular maintenance.} - Bino muntazam remontni talab qiladi.
{r:He is responsible for the maintenance of the equipment.} - U uskunalarga texnik xizmat ko'rsatish uchun mas'ul.
{r:Maintenance costs are apparently high.} - Ta'mirlash xarajatlari ko'rinishidan yuqori.

text: {r:Cute}[kjuːt] – yoqimli, jozibador, yoqimtoy. Siz kitoblarni yaxshi ko’ruvchi yigitsiz va shuning uchun {h:jozibador} {p:KUT}ubxonachi qizni kelinlikka qidiryapsiz.
examples: {r:My uncle wore cute sunglasses yesterday.} – Amakim kecha yoqimli ko'zoynak kiyib olgan edi.
{r:She was a cute girl and dangerous at the same time.} – U yoqimtoy qiz edi va xavfli edi shuningdek.
{r:That baby has such a cute smile.} – Bu chaqaloqning tabassumi juda jozibador.
{r:He drew a cute cartoon character.} – U yoqimli multfilm qahramonini chizdi.

text:
{r:Tiny}[ˈtaɪni] – juda kichkina, mitti. 
 Men:  - Telefonni ochadigan ignachani qayerga qo’yding? 
 Do'stim: Bilmayman, juda {h:kichkina} narsada yo’qolib qolaveradi. 
 Men: Shuning uchun {p:tayinli} joyga qo’yib yurginda.
examples: {r:The insect was so tiny I almost didn’t see it.} – Hasharot shu qadar kichkina ediki, men uni deyarli ko‘rmadim.
{r:The town has a tiny population.} – Shaharchaning kichkina aholisi bor.
{r:They live in a tiny village in the mountains.} – Ular tog‘larda joylashgan juda kichik qishloqda yashashadi.
{r:He gave me a tiny piece of chocolate.} – U menga kichkina bir bo‘lak shokolad berdi.

text: {r:Tight}[taɪt] – mahkam, qattiq, siqilgan, tarang. Men Tayd kir yuvish kukunini hech kimga tavsiya etmayman. Kiyimlarimni {p:TAYD} bilan yuvganimdan so’ng hamma kiyimlarim {h:taranglashib}, kichrayib ketdi.
examples: {r:She wore a tight dress that fit perfectly.} – U tanasiga juda mos tushgan mahkam ko‘ylak kiygan edi.
{r:I am presently at the grocery store with a tight budget.} – Men hozirda oziq-ovqat do‘konidaman va byudjetim tarang.
{r:He gave me a tight hug before leaving.} – U ketishdan oldin meni mahkam quchoqladi.
{r:The solution is simply evident, but the schedule is tight} – Yechim shunchaki ravshan, ammo jadval tarang (juda zich).

text: {r:Rudeness}[ˈruːdnəs] - qo'pollik. Rude(qo'pol) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:His rudeness, which shocked everyone, was entirely unacceptable.} - Uning hammani hayratga solgan qo'polligi mutlaqo qabul qilib bo'lmas darajada edi.
{r:The boy who showed rudeness was sent home.} - Qo'pollik ko'rsatgan bola uyiga jo'natildi.
{r:It was the kind of rudeness that made everyone angry.} - Bu hammani g'azablantirgan qo'pollik edi.
{r:The teacher addressed his rudeness, which was a problem in class.} - O'qituvchi uning qo'polligini muhokama qildi, bu darsda muammo edi.

text: {r:Moral}[ˈmɒrəl] – axloqiy, ma’naviy: ruhiy. Tasavvur qiling xotiningizdan {p:marli} topib kostyumingizni dazmollashni so’rayapsiz. Chunki siz odamlar oldida {h:ma’naviyatli}, ziyoli va axloqiy inson sifatida ko’rinishni istaysiz.
examples: {r:The story has a strong moral lesson that we should all learn.} - Hikoya biz hammamiz o'rganishimiz kerak bo'lgan kuchli axloqiy darsga ega.
{r:He is a man who has high moral standards.} - U yuqori axloqiy standartlarga ega odam.
{r:The book, which has a clear moral, is good for children.} - Aniq axloqiy ma'noga ega bo'lgan kitob bolalar uchun yaxshi.
{r:We need to combine moral principles that are strong with practical solutions.} - Biz kuchli axloqiy tamoyillarni amaliy yechimlar bilan birlashtirishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Otherwise}[ˈʌðərwaɪz] - aks holda. Biz hozir do'stlarimiz bilan Jumanji o'yinini o'ynayapmiz. Mening yurishim bo'lgan payt Jumanji ko'rsatgan xabar shunday edi 'Tezroq o'yinni tugat {h:aks holda} do'sting {p:Aziz}dek {p:vays}aqi bo'lib qolasan'.
examples: {r:You should hurry, otherwise you'll be late.} - Shoshilishingiz kerak, aks holda kech qolasiz.
{r:He must be tired, otherwise he would have come.} - U charchagan bo'lishi kerak, aks holda kelgan bo'lar edi.
{r:Follow the instructions, otherwise it won't work.} - Ko'rsatmalarga amal qiling, aks holda ishlamaydi.
{r:She must be busy, otherwise she would have called.} - U band bo'lishi kerak, aks holda qo'ng'iroq qilgan bo'lar edi.

text: {r:Somehow}[ˈsʌmhaʊ] – bir amallab, ilojini qilib, qandaydir tarzda. {p:Sam}olyot {p:hav}oga ko'tarilganda ba'zi bir yo'lovchilarni vahima bosishi mumkin. Styuardessalarni vazifasi esa ularni {h:bir amallab} yupatish.
examples: {r:Somehow, I managed to finish the project which was very challenging.} - Qandaydir tarzda men juda qiyin bo'lgan loyihani tugatishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.
{r:He is the man who somehow found his way home.} - U bir amallab uyiga yo'l topgan odam.
{r:The problem, that was hard, somehow got solved.} - Qiyin bo'lgan muammo bir amallab hal qilindi.
{r:She somehow knew the answer, which surprised everyone.} - U qandaydir tarzda javobni bilardi, bu hammani hayratda qoldirdi.

text: {r:Revenue}[ˈrevənjuː] – daromad. Tasavvur qiling sizning akangiz {p:REV}matolog {p:NYU} yorkda, bir yillik {h:daromadi} 2 million dollar. Sizning esa daromadingiz 20 million so'm bir yilda.
examples: {r:The company's revenue, which increased this year, was a positive sign.} - Kompaniyaning bu yil oshgan daromadi ijobiy belgi edi.
{r:They are looking for new sources of revenue that will help them grow.} - Ular o'sishga yordam beradigan yangi daromad manbalarini qidirmoqda.
{r:The government collects revenue from taxes, which is used for public needs.} - Hukumat soliqlardan daromad yig'adi, bu esa jamoat ehtiyojlari uchun ishlatiladi.
{r:The festival generated a lot of revenue, which was unexpected.} - Festival ko'p daromad keltirdi, bu kutilmagan edi.

text: {r:Generate}[ˈdʒenəreɪt] – yuzaga keltirmoq, sababchi bo'lmoq. Kecha tush ko'rdingiz. Tushingizda {p:JEN}tra {p:REYT}inglarda, ya'ni dunyo reytinglarida eng ko'p sotilayotgan mashina bo'layotgan ekan. Bu esa mamlakatda 2 million yangi ish o'rni {h:yaratilishini} yuzaga keltiribdi.
examples: {r:The wind turbines generate electricity, which powers many homes.} - Shamol turbinalari elektr energiyasini ishlab chiqaradi, bu esa ko'plab uylarni quvvatlantiradi.
{r:The new policy will generate more jobs that are needed in the economy.} - Yangi siyosat iqtisodiyotda kerakli bo'lgan ko'proq ish o'rinlarini yaratadi.
{r:The meeting generated many ideas, which were presented to the board.} - Uchrashuv kengashga taqdim etilgan ko'plab g'oyalarni keltirib chiqardi.
{r:The new factory will generate many jobs, and the town may boom.} – Yangi zavod ko‘plab ish o‘rinlari yaratadi va shahar rivojlanishi mumkin.

text: {r:Loan}[loʊn] – qarz, kredit. Aytishlaricha birinchi kredit qarz munosabatlari Italiyada o'rta asrlarda paydo bo'lgan. O'shanda qarzga {p:LOV}iya {p:UN}i berilgan ekan. Hozir esa hatto soch ektirish ham {h:kredit}.
examples: {r:The bank approved her loan application, which made her very happy.} - Bank uning kredit arizasini ma'qulladi, bu esa uni juda xursand qildi.
{r:He took out a loan that helped him buy a car.} - U mashina sotib olishga yordam bergan kredit oldi.
{r:They are struggling to repay the loan that they took out last year.} - Ular o'tgan yili olgan kreditini qaytarish uchun qiynalishmoqda.
{r:The loan has a high interest rate, which is a concern for many people.} - Kreditning foiz stavkasi yuqori, bu esa ko'pchilik uchun tashvishlidir.

text: {r:Thief}[θiːf] - o'g'ri. Mana bu dunyodagi eng murakkab tuzilgan seyf. Bu {p:SEYF}ni hech qaysi {h:o'g'ri} ocholmaydi.
examples: {r:The thief who stole her purse was quickly identified.} - Uning sumkasini o'g'irlagan o'g'ri tezda aniqlandi.
{r:She saw the thief who was running away from the police.} - U politsiyadan qochayotgan o'g'rini ko'rdi.
{r:The money that the thief stole was never found.} - O'g'ri o'g'irlagan pul hech qachon topilmadi.
{r:The house that the thief entered was old and dark.} - O'g'ri kirgan uy eski va qorong'u edi.

text: {r:Butcher}[ˈbʌtʃər] - qassob.
examples: {r:The butcher who cut the meat into pieces was very skilled.} - Go'shtni bo'laklarga bo'lgan qassob juda mohir edi.
{r:She bought some chicken from the butcher who works near her house.} - U uyining yaqinida ishlaydigan qassobdan tovuq go'shti sotib oldi.
{r:The shop that the butcher works in is always clean.} - Qassob ishlaydigan do'kon har doim toza.
{r:The meat, which was fresh, came from the butcher.} - Yangi bo'lgan go'sht qassobdan keldi.

text: {r:Fool}[fuːl] - ahmoq; ahmoq qilmoq.
examples: {r:The fool who didn't understand the joke made everyone laugh.} - Hazilni tushunmagan ahmoq hammani kuldirdi.
{r:He felt like a fool after the mistake that he made.} - U qilgan xatosidan keyin o'zini ahmoqdek his qildi.
{r:The story, which was about a fool, made us smile.} - Ahmoq haqidagi hikoya bizni kuldirdi.
{r:She called him a fool who could not understand simple things.} - U uni oddiy narsalarni tushunmaydigan ahmoq deb atadi.
{r:She is fooling you.} - U seni ahmoq qilyapti.

text: {r:Coward}[ˈkaʊərd] - qo'rqoq. Oxirgi marta to'yga borgan paytim {p:QAVRD}oq yegan edim o'shandan beri {h:qo'rqoq} bo'lib qoldim.
examples: {r:The coward hid behind his friends, which was shameful.} - Qo'rqoq do'stlarining orqasiga yashiringani bu uyatli edi.
{r:He was called a coward who ran away from the fight.} - U jangdan qochgan qo'rqoq deb ataldi.
{r:The action that the coward took was not brave.} - Qo'rqoq qilgan harakat, jasur emas edi.
{r:Julia accused him of being a coward who did not help his friend.} - Julia uni do'stiga yordam bermagan qo'rqoq deb aybladi.

text: {r:Tenant}[ˈtɛnənt] - ijarachi. Bizning ikkinchi uyimizda yashovchi ijarachi juda ziqna, ijara pulini har doim kechiktirib beradigan odam. Lekin puli kam qashshoq emas, harbiy okrugda ley{p:TENANT} bizning {h:ijarachi}.
examples: {r:The tenant who paid the rent on time received a discount.} - Ijarani vaqtida to'lagan ijarachi chegirma oldi.
{r:The landlord met with the tenant who lived in the old house.} - Uy egasi eski uyda yashaydigan ijarachi bilan uchrashdi.
{r:The tenant complained about the noise that was coming from next door.} - Ijarachi yon uydan kelayotgan shovqindan shikoyat qildi.
{r:The new tenant, who moved in yesterday, is very quiet.} - Kecha ko'chib kelgan yangi ijarachi juda jim.

text: {r:Rely}[rɪˈlaɪ] – tayanmoq, suyanmoq. Agar uyda yolg'iz qolgan bo'lsangiz uy xizmatchisi {p:RE}ks {p:LAY}chaga {h:tayanishingiz} mumkin. Xohlasangiz rasmda ko'rsatilgandek tayaning xohlasangiz yordamiga tayaning.
examples: {r:He relies on his friends for support.} - U qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun do'stlariga tayanadi.
{r:You can rely on him, who always keeps his promise.} - Siz unga ishonishingiz mumkin, u har doim va'dasini bajaradi.
{r:The system that we rely on is slightly old.} - Biz tayanadigan tizim biroz eski.
{r:We rely on technology which helps us communicate easily.} - Biz oson muloqot qilishimizga yordam beradigan texnologiyaga tayanamiz.

text: {r:Widow}[ˈwɪdoʊ] – beva ayol. Menga qo'shni {h:beva} ayollarning hammasi ertalabdan kechgacha youtubeda {p:VIDEO}lar tomosha qilib yotishadi.
examples: {r:The widow inherited her husband's property, which was quite large.} - Beva erining mulkini meros qilib oldi, bu juda katta edi.
{r:She met a widow who lived in the next village.} - U keyingi qishloqda yashaydigan bevani uchratdi.
{r:The house that the widow lived in was very old.} - Beva yashagan uy juda eski edi.
{r:The widow kept a cute, tiny cat in her house.} - Beva ayol uyida yoqimli, juda kichkina mushukni boqardi.

text: {r:Sunshine}[ˈsʌnʃaɪn] - quyosh nuri.
examples: {r:They enjoyed the sunshine at the beach, which made their day perfect.} - Ular plyajda quyosh nurlaridan zavqlanishgani ularning kunini mukammal qildi.
{r:The plants need sunshine that comes from the sky.} - O'simliklar osmondan keladigan quyosh nuriga muhtoj.
{r:The sunshine, which was bright, made everyone happy.} - Yorqin bo'lgan quyosh nuri hammani xursand qildi.
{r:The day that had a lot of sunshine was very warm.} - Ko'p quyosh nuri bo'lgan kun juda issiq edi.

text: {r:Universe}[ˈjuːnɪvɜːrs] – olam, koinot. Qadimgi hindlar olamni fil ko'tarib turadi deb o'ylashgan. Qadimgi {p:YUN}onlar {p:VERS}iyasiga ko'ra esa {h:olam} toshbaqa kosasi ustida joylashgan deb o'ylashgan.
examples: {r:The universe is full of stars and galaxies that are still being discovered.} - Koinot hali ham kashf etilayotgan yulduzlar va galaktikalarga to'la.
{r:Scientists study the universe, which is vast and mysterious.} - Olimlar keng va sirli bo'lgan koinotni o'rganadilar.
{r:The book that talks about the universe is very interesting.} - Koinot haqida gapiradigan kitob juda qiziqarli.
{r:He likes to watch movies which show the beauty of the universe.} - U koinot go'zalligini ko'rsatadigan filmlarni tomosha qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

text: {r:Aim}[eɪm] – maqsad. n{p:EYM}arning {h:maqsadi} har doim Oltin To'pni olish bo'lgan. Lekin faoliyatining gullagan davri boshqa futbolchilar Ronaldo va Messining yorqin g'alabalari davriga to'g'ri keldi va Oltin To'p Neymarga nasib etmadi.
examples: {r:His aim is to become a doctor, which is a big dream.} - Uning maqsadi shifokor bo'lish, bu katta orzu.
{r:The project has an aim that will help many people.} - Loyihaning maqsadi ko'plab odamlarga yordam berish.
{r:The team has a clear aim, which is to win the game.} - Jamoaning aniq maqsadi bor, bu o'yinni yutish.
{r:I am aiming to be a doctor.} - Men doktor bo'lishni maqsad qilyapman.
{r:He was willing to aim high, which helped him achieve his dreams.} - U yuqori maqsad qo'yishga tayyor edi, bu unga orzulariga erishishga yordam berdi.

text: {r:Crew}[kruː] – ekipaj, brigada. Tasavvur qiling {p:GRU}ziya havo yo'llarida Gruziyaga sayohat qilish uchun ketyapsiz. Lekin samolyot {h:ekipaj}i sizni hayratga soldi. Erkaklar yubka kiygan, ayollarda esa shim!
examples: {r:The film crew, who worked late into the night, finished the scene.} - Kechasi kechgacha ishlagan film ekipaji sahnani tugatdi.
{r:The crew finished the successful mission, which was a great achievement.} - Ekipaj muvaffaqiyatli missiyani tugatgani katta yutuq edi.
{r:The pilot thanked the crew that helped him during the flight.} - Uchuvchi parvoz paytida unga yordam bergan ekipajga minnatdorchilik bildirdi.
{r:The crew members, who were very professional, helped all the passengers.} - Juda professional bo'lgan ekipaj a'zolari barcha yo'lovchilarga yordam berdi.

text: {r:Capture}[ˈkæptʃər] – qo'lga olmoq, asir olmoq, rasmga olmoq. Kaptarni qo'lga olishning eng yaxshi yo'li unga qopqon qo'yishdir. {p:KAP}tar {p:CHIR}indilarni yaxshi ko'radi va ulardan qo'yilgan xo'rak natijasida {h:qo'lga olinadi}.
examples: {r:The artist captured the beauty of the landscape that inspired her.} - Rassom unga ilhom bergan landshaftning go'zalligini aks ettirdi.
{r:Police managed to capture the thief who stole the money.} - Politsiya pulni o'g'irlagan o'g'rini qo'lga olishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
{r:The moment, which was cute, was captured by the camera.} - Yoqimtoy bo'lgan lahza kamera tomonidan muhrga olindi.
{r:The soldiers tried to capture the base that was behind the hill.} - Askarlar tepalik ortida bo'lgan bazani egallashga harakat qilishdi.

text: {r:Chest}[ʧest] – ko'krak. Bu holatda {h:ko'krak}da {p:CHES}nokni tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:She went to the doctor complaining of chest pains.} - U ko'krakdagi og'riqdan shikoyat qilib doktorga bordi.
{r:He was shot at chest.} - Uni ko'kragidan otishdi.
{r:The chest pain was his secondary problem.} - Ko'krak og'rig'i hozir uning ikkinchi darajali muammosi edi.
{r:Bahodir has a broad chest.} - Bahodirning ko'kragi keng.

text: {r:Freezing}[ˈfriːzɪŋ] - juda sovuq, qahraton. Freeze(muzlamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The weather is freezing today.} - Bugun ob-havo juda sovuq.
{r:The cold air I felt was freezing.} - Men his qilgan sovuq havo qahraton edi.
{r:This is the kind of weather I can't tolerate, it is freezing.} - Bu men chiday olmaydigan ob-havo, u qahraton.
{r:The place where it is freezing is very far from here.} - Qahraton joy bu yerdan juda uzoqda.

text: {r:Conserve}[kənˈsɜːrv] – saqlamoq, asramoq. Pullaringizni eng yaxshi qaysi usulda saqlash kerak bilasizmi? Menimcha ularni {p:KONSERV}a qutilarida {h:saqlash} eng yaxshi usul. Kitob orasida emas.
examples: {r:We need to conserve water during the drought that we are experiencing.} - Biz boshdan kechirayotgan qurg'oqchilik davrida suvni tejashimiz kerak.
{r:The energy he tries to conserve is important for the future.} - U tejashga harakat qiladigan energiya kelajak uchun muhim.
{r:This is the resource they are working to conserve for everyone.} - Bu ular hamma uchun tejashga harakat qilayotgan resurs.
{r:We are conserving fuel for emergency which is important.} - Biz favqulotta vaziyatlar uchun yoqilg'i saqlayapmiz, bu muhim.

text: {r:Largely}[ˈlɑːrdʒli] - asosan. Large(katta, keng) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:The success was largely due to teamwork, which made everyone happy.} - Muvaffaqiyat asosan jamoa ishi tufayli erishildi, bu esa hammani xursand qildi.
{r:The book is largely based on real events that happened long ago.} - Kitob asosan uzoq vaqt oldin sodir bo'lgan haqiqiy voqealar asosida yozilgan.
{r:The problem, which was largely solved, made us feel good.} - Asosan hal qilingan muammo bizni yaxshi his qilishimizga sabab bo'ldi.
{r:He is largely responsible for the project's failure, which was a big problem.} - U loyihaning muvaffaqiyatsizligida asosiy javobgar, bu katta muammo edi.
{r:Your performance will largely determine the outcome that we expect.} - Sizning ish faoliyatingiz biz kutgan natijani asosan aniqlaydi.

text: {r:Virus}[ˈvaɪrəs] - virus.
examples: {r:A variety of viruses spread quickly across the country, which was a concern.} - Turli xil viruslar butun mamlakat bo'ylab tez tarqalganligi tashvishli edi.
{r:The virus she caught made her stay home for a week.} - U yuqtirib olgan virus uni bir hafta uyda qolishga majbur qildi.
{r:This is the virus they are studying a lot about.} - Bu ular ko'p o'rganayotgan virus.
{r:The computer was infected with a virus that came from the internet.} - Kompyuter internetdan kelgan virus bilan zararlangan edi.

text: {r:Path}[pæθ] – yo'l. Mening do'stim Germaniya pasportini olyapti. Sababini so'rasam 'Shunchaki bu {p:PAS}port bilan hayot {h:yo'lini} osonroq qurish mumkin' dedi. Men esa uning yo'lini takrorlamagan yaxshi deyman.
examples: {r:The path through the forest was narrow, which made walking difficult.} - O'rmon orqali o'tadigan yo'l tor edi, bu esa yurishni qiyinlashtirdi.
{r:The path he took was long and hard.} - U bosib o'tgan yo'l uzun va qiyin edi.
{r:This is the path we walked along yesterday.} - Bu biz kecha yurgan yo'l.
{r:The place where the path starts is beautiful.} - Yo'l boshlanadigan joy chiroyli.

text: {r:Speedy}[ˈspiːdi] - tez. Speed(tezlik) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The speedy delivery impressed the customer, who was very happy.} - Tez yetkazib berish mijozni hayratda qoldirdi, u juda xursand edi.
{r:The solution we need is a speedy one.} - Bizga kerak bo'lgan yechim tezkor yechim.
{r:This is the car they are looking for a speedy performance from.} - Bu ular tezkor ishlashini kutayotgan mashina.
{r:Apparently we need a speedy solution to this problem, which is growing fast.} - Ko'rinishidan bu muammoga tezda yechim topishimiz kerak, bu tez o'sib bormoqda.

text: {r:Charity}[ˈtʃærəti] – xayriya, ehson. Yevropa davlatlarining birida {p:CHER}kov {p:ITI} o'zi yashayotgan muassasa uchun odamlardan {h:xayriya} puli ya'ni tangalarni yig'ib uni og'zida tashib cherkovga olib kelib beradi.
examples: {r:He donated money to a charity that helps homeless people.} - U uysizlarga yordam beradigan xayriya tashkilotiga pul xayriya qildi.
{r:The charity he supports helps children.} - U qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan xayriya tashkiloti bolalarga yordam beradi.
{r:This is the charity he works for.} - Bu u ishlaydigan xayriya tashkiloti.
{r:The charity event, which raised a lot of funds, was a great success.} - Ko'p mablag' to'plagan xayriya tadbiri katta muvaffaqiyat edi.

text: {r:Cash}[kæʃ] – naqd pul. Do'konga kirsam faqatgina{p: KASH}a {h:naqd pul}ga olib bo'lar ekan. Boshqa tovarlar esa karta orqali xarid qilinadi.
examples: {r:I paid in cash for the groceries that I bought.} - Men sotib olgan oziq-ovqatlar uchun naqd pul to'ladim.
{r:The cash he withdrew was a lot.} - U yechib olgan naqd pul ko'p edi.
{r:This is the safe place she keeps her cash in.} - Bu u naqd pulini saqlaydigan xavfsiz joy.
{r:This is the shop where you can pay with cash.} - Bu siz naqd pul bilan to'lashingiz mumkin bo'lgan do'kon.

text: {r:Emergency}[ɪˈmɜːrdʒənsi] – favqulodda vaziyat. Mashhur Kamol va Nixon seriali oxiriga yetmoqda. Emirni otib ketishdi, kim otgani esa noma'lum. Nihoyat {p:EMIR JINSI}sida qon izlari topildi. {h:Favqulodda vaziyat} endi jinoyatchini tutish kerak.
examples: {r:Call 911 in case of an emergency that needs quick help.} - Tez yordam kerak bo'lgan favqulodda vaziyatda 911 ga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
{r:The emergency they faced was big.} - Ular duch kelgan favqulodda vaziyat katta edi.
{r:This is the room they go to in an emergency.} - Bu ular favqulodda vaziyatda boradigan xona.
{r:This is the hospital where they have an emergency room.} - Bu favqulodda yordam bo'limi bor bo'lgan kasalxona.

text: {r:Deed}[diːd] - amal, ish, qilingan va amalga oshirilgan harakatlar. {p:Did}ie Drogbani eslasangiz kerak. Futbolchining eng oliyjanob {h:ishi} mamlakatda fuqarolar urushini to'xtatishga yordam berganidir. Drogba o'z mamlakatida shunchalik mashhur ediki. Urushni to'xtatishga bo'lgan so'rovini har ikkala taraf ham qabul qilgan.
examples: {r:She was honored for her brave deeds that helped many people.} - U ko'plab odamlarga yordam bergan jasoratli harakatlari uchun mukofotlandi.
{r:The good deed he did made everyone happy.} - U qilgan yaxshi ish hammani xursand qildi.
{r:This is the deed he was proud of.} - Bu u g'ururlangan ish.
{r:A deed of kindness, which is a small act, can change someone’s life.} - Kichik bir harakat bo'lgan mehribonlik harakati kimningdir hayotini o'zgartirishi mumkin.

text: {r:Select}[sɪˈlekt] - tanlamoq. Tanlashga oid seleksiya va seleksioner so'zlarini eshitgan bo'lsangiz kerak o'zbek tilida ham. Rasmda futbol seleksionerlari tasvirlangan.
examples: {r:She selected the best dress for the party that she would attend.} - U o'zi boradigan ziyofat uchun eng yaxshi ko'ylakni tanladi.
{r:The teacher selected three students he wanted to go to the competition.} - O'qituvchi tanlovga borishini xohlagan uchta o'quvchini tanladi.
{r:This is the item you can select from.} - Bu siz tanlashingiz mumkin bo'lgan narsa.
{r:The team was selected based on their performance, which was very good.} - Jamoa natija asosida tanlandi, bu juda yaxshi edi.
{r:You can select whatever you prefer from the menu, which has many options.} - Menyudan xohlaganingizni tanlashingiz mumkin, u ko'plab variantlarga ega.

text: {r:Root}[ruːt] - ildiz. Men sho'rtakkina qurtlarni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Nafaqat o'zim yeyman balki uy gullarining {h:ildiz}igacha kovlab u yerga qu{p:RUT} tashlab qo'yaman. Mening gullarim ham qurtlarni sevadi.
examples: {r:The tree's roots are very deep, which helps it stand strong.} - Daraxtning ildizlari juda chuqur, bu unga mustahkam turishga yordam beradi.
{r:The root he found was slightly old.} - U topgan ildiz ozgina eski edi.
{r:This is the root I was talking about.} - Bu men gapirayotgan ildiz.
{r:The garden where the roots are deep is very green.} - Ildizlari chuqur bo'lgan bog' juda yashil.

text: {r:Declare}[dɪˈkleər] – e’lon qilmoq, bildirmoq, bayon qilmoq. Maktabda turli mavzularda diktantlar yozamiz. Masalan {p:DIK}tant {p:kleyr} shampuni haqida, Vatan, bolalik, sevimli kitob haqida bo'lishi mumkin. Kleyr shampunini yaxshi ko'rishimni diktantda {h:bildirdim}.
examples: {r:The president declared a state of emergency, which was needed for the country.} - Prezident mamlakat uchun kerak bo'lgan favqulodda holat e'lon qildi.
{r:The news they declared made everyone sad.} - Ular e'lon qilgan yangilik hammani xafa qildi.
{r:This is the truth he wants to declare to the world.} - Bu u dunyoga e'lon qilmoqchi bo'lgan haqiqat.
{r:Uzbekistan declared independence in 1991, which was a historic moment.} - O'zbekiston 1991 - yili mustaqillik e'lon qilgan, bu tarixiy lahza edi.

text: {r:Appreciate}[əˈpriːʃieɪt] – qadrlamoq. Dzyudo bo'yicha ikki karra jahon chempioni Rishod Sobirov faoliyatini tugatdan so'ng apelsin yetishtirish bilan shug'ullanyapti. {p:AP}elsin {p:RISHOD}ning sevimli mevasi. U issiqxonadan juda ko'p hosil olyapti. Chunki Rishod natijani {h:qadrlaydi}, sportda ham, bog'da ham.
examples: {r:I appreciate your help, which was very important to me.} - Men sizning yordamingizni qadrlayman, bu men uchun juda muhim edi.
{r:The help I appreciate is very big.} - Men qadrlaydigan yordam juda katta.
{r:This is the kind person I appreciate working with.} - Bu men birga ishlashni qadrlaydigan mehribon odam.
{r:He appreciated the gesture that was made, which was very kind.} - U qilingan harakatni qadrladi, bu juda mehribonlik edi.

text: {r:Launch}[lɔːntʃ] - ishga tushirmoq, boshlamoq, kirishmoq. Bu so'zga mnemonik namuna yozgandan ko'ra uning ma'nosini o'zbek tilida tushuntirishga qaror qildik. Chunki bu so'zning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarjimasi o'zbek tilida yo'q. Launch so'zi biror loyihani boshlash, raketani samoga uchirish, qaysidir faoliyatni boshlash, qandaydir ishga kirishish ma'nolarini bildiradi. Agar rus tilini bilsangiz ruschadagi tarjimasi 'zapusk' bo'ladi.
examples: {r:The company launched a new product, which was very popular.} - Kompaniya juda mashhur bo'lgan yangi mahsulotni ishga tushirdi.
{r:The product they launched was a success.} - Ular ishga tushirgan mahsulot muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.
{r:This is the project they are working to launch.} - Bu ular ishga tushirishga harakat qilayotgan loyiha.
{r:This is the place where they launched the rocket.} - Bu ular raketani uchirgan joy.

text: {r:Outcome}[ˈaʊtkʌm] – natija, oqibat. Bobom Sobiq ittifoq davrida otasidan qolgan oltin quymani davlatga topshirishi kerak edi davlat talabiga ko'ra. Lekin bobom qanday qilib oltinni hukumatdan yashirish yo'llarini qidirgan. {h:Natijada} oltindan {p:OT KAM}ari yasagan va hech kim bu kamarni oltindan ekanligini payqamagan.
examples: {r:Whatever happens, we will accept the outcome, which is important.} - Nima bo'lishidan qat'iy nazar, biz natijani qabul qilamiz, bu muhim.
{r:The outcome we expected was different.} - Biz kutgan natija boshqacha edi.
{r:This is the goal they are working towards for a good outcome.} - Bu ular yaxshi natijaga erishish uchun harakat qilayotgan maqsad.
{r:She was pleased with the outcome that resulted from her hard work.} - U mehnatidan kelib chiqqan natijadan mamnun edi.
{r:When they saw the outcome, which was unexpected, they realized their efforts were worth it.} - Kutilmagan natijani ko'rgach, ular sa'y-harakatlari bunga arziganligini angladilar.

text: {r:Duty}[ˈduːti] – majburiyat, vazifa. Skruch Makdakning uyini tikanlar qoplabdi. Chirmoviqlar esa Skruch va jiyanlarini o'rab olib asir etishibdi. Faqatgina uning sevimli jiyani Dyu ularning hamlasidan qochib uyni tikanlardan ozod etishni o'zining majburiyati sifatida qabul qildi. Kuch to'plab qaytgan {p:DYU TI}kanlarga sprey sepib ularni yo'q qilibdi va o'zining yaqinlari oldidagi {h:majburiyatini} bajaribdi.
examples: {r:It is your duty to protect the environment that you live in.} - Siz yashayotgan atrof-muhitni himoya qilish sizning burchingiz.
{r:The duty he performed was hard.} - U bajargan vazifa qiyin edi.
{r:This is the task he is on duty for.} - Bu u navbatchilik qilayotgan vazifa.
{r:The soldier was on duty all night, which was very tiring.} - Askar butun kecha navbatchilik qildi, bu juda charchatuvchi edi.

text: {r:Ensure}[ɪnˈʃʊər] – kafolatlamoq. {p:EN}aga {p:SHUR}ik bolangizning xursand ulg'ayishini {h:kafolatlaydi}.
examples: {r:We must ensure the safety of everyone, which is our main goal.} - Biz hammaning xavfsizligini ta'minlashimiz kerak, bu bizning asosiy maqsadimiz.
{r:The safety we must ensure is for all people.} - Biz ta'minlashimiz kerak bo'lgan xavfsizlik barcha odamlar uchundir.
{r:This is the plan they are working on to ensure success.} - Bu ular muvaffaqiyatni ta'minlash uchun ishlayotgan reja.
{r:Please focus on the remaining task to ensure it's finished on time, which is crucial.} - Iltimos, uni o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun qolgan vazifaga e'tibor qarating, bu juda muhim.

text: {r:Extent}[ɪkˈstent] – ko'lam, miqdor. Siz oltin konida ekskavator haydaysiz. Har kuni {p:EKS}kavatorda {p:TENT}akcham qo'shig'ini eshitasiz. Ish samaradorligingiz shunchalik oshib ketdiki siz qazigan joylardan har kuni 1 tonna oltin olinyapti. Bu qo'shiq sababli ish {h:ko'lami} juda kattalashib ketadi.
examples: {r:The extent of the damage is unknown, which is a big problem.} - Zarar miqdori noma'lum, bu katta muammo.
{r:The extent he knew was very little.} - U bilgan ko'lam juda oz edi.
{r:This is the problem he did not know the full extent of.} - Bu u to'liq ko'lamini bilmagan muammo.
{r:He didn't realize the extent of his mistake, which was very big.} - U o'z xatosining ahamiyatini anglamadi, bu juda katta edi.

text: {r:Contrast}[ˈkɒntræst] – farq. Rus tilida ham keng qo'llaniladi. Astronomlar ham xuddi bizdek inson. Ularning ham biznikidek hobbi va qiziqishlari bor. Masalan {p:KONTR AST}ronomlarning eng sevimli o'yini. Lekin {h:farqli} tomoni KONTRni ASTronomlar juda yomon o'ynashar ekan.
examples: {r:The contrast between the two colors is big, which makes the painting beautiful.} - Ikkala rangning kontrasti juda katta, bu esa rasmni chiroyli qiladi.
{r:The contrast he saw was clear.} - U ko'rgan farq aniq edi.
{r:He was talking about contrast.} - U tafovut haqida gapirayotgan edi.
{The contrast between rich and poor is evident.} - Boy va kambag'allar orasidagi farq aniq.

text: {r:Muscle}[ˈmʌsəl] - muskul. Agar televizorda reklama qilinayotgan {p:MASEL}kadan tez-tez yeb tursangiz {h:muskul}laringiz kattalashib ketadi.
examples: {r:He has been exercising to build muscle.} - U mushak o'stirish uchun mashq qilayotgan edi.
{r:He felt the muscle pain at the very bottom of his leg.} - U oyog'ining eng pastki qismida mushak og'rig'ini his qildi.
{r:She has been stretching to relax her muscles.} - U mushaklarini bo'shash uchun cho'zilayotgan edi.
{r:The athlete has strong muscles.} - Sportchi kuchli mushaklarga ega.

text: {r:Beauty}[ˈbjuːti] – chiroy. Bilasizmi qaysi kinoni haqiqiy {h:chiroy} namunasi deb bilish mumkin. Men uchun bu {p:BUYU}k {p:TI}tanik filmi.
examples: {r:She has been working on her beauty routine.} - U go'zallik tartibini yaxshilash uchun ishlayotgan edi.
{r:The beauty of the landscape is exciting.} - Landshaftning go'zalligi ajoyib.
{r:He has been painting the beauty of nature.} - U tabiatning go'zalligini chizayotgan edi.
{r:The beauty of her voice amazed everyone.} - Uning ovozining go'zalligi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.

text: {r:Internal}[ɪnˈtɜːrnəl] - ichki.
examples: {r:The company has been facing internal issues.} - Kompaniya ichki muammolarga duch kelayotgan edi.
{r:A festival will take place in the city, despite internal problems.} – Shaharda ichki muammolarga qaramay festival bo‘lib o‘tadi.
{r:The internal structure of the building is complex.} - Binoning ichki tuzilishi murakkab.
{r:He has been dealing with internal conflicts.} - U ichki nizolarni hal qilayotgan edi.

text: {r:Extreme}[ɪkˈstriːm] - ekstrimal, o'ta, juda.
examples: {r:The weather is extremely hot today, get in the car faster.} - Bugun ob-havo o'ta issiq, tezroq mashinaga chiq.
{r:She has been practicing extreme sports since childhood.} - U bolaligidan ekstremal sport turlari bilan shug'ullanayotgan edi.
{r:The situation has been extremely stressful.} - Vaziyat juda stressli bo'ldi.
{r:The legal team was prepared for any extreme circumstance that might arise in court.} - Yuridik guruh sudda yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo'lgan har qanday ekstremal vaziyatga tayyor edi.

text: {r:Theft}[θɛft] - o'g'irlik. Thief(o'g'ri) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The police have been investigating the theft for 10 days.} - Politsiya o'g'irlikni 10 kundan beri tergov qilayotgan edi.
{r:She has been worried about theft in the area.} - U hududdagi o'g'irliklardan tashvishlanayotgan edi.
{r:The theft of the painting shocked everyone.} - Rasmning o'g'irlanishi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
{r:He has been accused of theft and came out of prison after 2 months.} - U o'g'irlikda ayblanayotgan edi va ikki oydan keyin qamoqdan chiqdi.

text: {r:Pilot}[ˈpaɪlət] - pilot, uchuvchi. Talaffuziga e'tibor bering chunki inglizcha pilot(paylt) va o'zbekchada biz qo'llaydigan pilot turlicha talaffuz qilinadi.
examples: {r:He has been training to become a pilot for a year.} - U uchuvchi bo'lish uchun 1 yildan beri mashq qilayotgan edi.
{r:The pilot has been flying for 10 hours.} - Uchuvchi 10 soatdan beri uchayotgan edi.
{r:The pilot wants to get rest today. He will probably eat out with his family.} - Uchuvchi bugun dam olishni xohlaydi. U balki oilasi bilan ko'chada ovqatlansa kerak.
{r:The pilot has been praised for his skills.} - Uchuvchi mahorati uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi.

text: {r:Warn}[wɔːrn] – ogohlantirmoq. 'Vor zakon' nima ekanligini bilsangiz kerak. Mafiya degani qisqasi. Bashoratchi Vanga 2024 – yili Amerikaga juda katta {p:VORN}i kelishidan {h:ogohlantirgan} ekan.
examples: {r:The teacher has been warning the students about the deadline.} - O'qituvchi o'quvchilarni oxirgi muddat haqida ogohlantirayotgan edi.
{r:The deep scar seemed to warn others about the danger he faced.} - Chuqur chandiq boshqalarni u duch kelgan xavf haqida ogohlantirgandek edi.
{r:She has been warning her friends about the scam all day.} - U do'stlarini kuni bo'yi firibgarlik haqida ogohlantirayotgan edi.
{r:The weather service has been warning about the storm.} - Ob-havo xizmati bo'ron haqida ogohlantirayotgan edi.

text: {r:Ultimately}[ˈʌltɪmətli] – oxir-oqibatda, yakunda. Amerikaliklar dunyodagi eng qisqa filmni ishlashga qaror qilishdi. {h:Oxir-oqibatda} {p:OLTI MINUTLI} film bilan ginnes rekordlar kitobiga kirishdi.
examples: {r:She has been working towards her ultimate goal for 2 years.} - U 2 yildan beri o'zining eng katta maqsadiga erishish uchun ishlayotgan edi.
{r:Ultimately, the decision has been made.} - Yakunda qaror qabul qilindi.
{r:Ultimately, he reached New York after travelling for 2 years.} - Nihoyat u 2 yil sayohat qilganidan so'ng Nyu Yorkka yetishdi.
{r:Their ultimate goal was to make everyone object to the unfair system.} - Ularning asosiy maqsadi barcha odamlarni adolatsiz tizimga e'tiroz bildirishga undash edi.
{r:The brain is the ultimate center of thought and emotion.} - Miya fikr va hissiyotlarning yakuniy markazidir.

text: {r:Capacity}[kəˈpæsəti] – hajm, ko'lam, quvvat, qobiliyat. {p:QAFAS ITI}ning ajoyib {h:qobiliyatlari} bor. Masalan ular o'z hajmini kichraytirib bitta qafasning ichiga o'nlab itlar joylasha oladi.
examples: {r:The hall has been filled to its full capacity.} - Zal to'liq sig'imi bilan to'ldi.
{r:She has been working at full capacity.} - U to'liq quvvat bilan ishlayotgan edi.
{r:The factory has been operating beyond its capacity.} - Zavod o'z sig'imidan ortiq ishlayotgan edi.
{r:He has been testing his mental capacity since yesterday.} - U kechadan beri o'zining aqliy qobiliyatini sinab ko'rayotgan edi.

text: {r:Circumstance}[ˈsɜːrkəmstəns] – vaziyat, ahvol, sharoit. Sirka yani uksus turli xil {h:vaziyatlar}da qo'llaniladi. Masalan ovqatlanish paytida, changlar va dog'larni tozalashda, bo'yoqlarni o'chirishda. Men ham sirka tayyorlayman va mening {p:SIRKAM TENNIS} tayoqchasini artishda foydalaniladi.
examples: {r:She has been dealing with difficult circumstances since she dropped out.} - U o'qishni tashlab ketganidan beri qiyin sharoitlarni boshdan kechirayotgan edi.
{r:The circumstances have been changing rapidly.} - Sharoitlar tez o'zgaryapti.
{r:He has been adapting to new circumstances.} - U yangi sharoitlarga moslasha boshladi.
{r:The circumstances have been beyond our control.} - Sharoitlar nazoratimizdan tashqarida edi.
{r:You can call for assistance whenever the circumstance requires it.} - Qachonki vaziyat shuni talab qilganda yordam so'rash uchun qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:Pursue}[pərˈsuː] – quvmoq, ta'qib qilmoq. Gruziyada o'tgan oy {p:PR}ezidentga {p:SYU}qlik sepgan siyosatchi {h:ta'qib qilinyapti}(bo'lgan voqea).
examples: {r:He has been pursuing his dreams.} - U orzularini ta'qib qilayotgan edi.
{r:She has been pursuing a career in law since graduation.} - U bitirganidan beri huquq sohasida karyera qilish uchun harakat qilyapti.
{r:The police have been pursuing the suspect for 2 hours.} - Politsiya 2 soatdan beri gumondorni ta'qib qilyapti.
{r:He has been pursuing wealth for a long time.} - U anchadan beri boylik ketidan quvayapti.

text: {r:Slip}[slɪp] - sirg'almoq, sirpanmoq, toyinmoq. Maktabdan qaytayotganimizda sirpanchiq muzlagan joyga duch keldik. Kimdir {h:toyinib} ketmasin deb 5-6 ta o'quvchi muzlagan joyga {p:SIYIP} tashladik va tez orada erib ketdi.
examples: {r:She slipped on the icy road, therefore she bought new shoes just now.} - U muzlagan yo'lda sirg'alib tushdi shuning uchun ham hozirgina yangi poyabzal sotib oldi.
{r:She slipped on the icy sidewalk and dropped her phone.} – U muzlagan yo‘l yoqasida sirpanib ketdi va telefonini tushirib yubordi.
{r:The glass slipped from her hand.} - Stakan uning qo'lidan sirg'alib tushdi.
{r:He tried to hold the fish, but it slipped out of his hands.} – U baliqni ushlamoqchi bo‘ldi, lekin u qo‘lidan sirg‘anib chiqib ketdi.

text: {r:Soil}[sɔɪl] – tuproq. Qishloqdagilarning aytishicha agar sigir so'yilishini oldindan sezsa {h:tuproq} yeyishni boshlaydi. {p:SO'YIL}adigan sigirning shunday injiqliklari bo'ladi.
examples: {r:The farmer has been working on the soil since June.} - Fermer iyundan beri tuproq bilan ishlayapti.
{r:The soil has been drying up due to the heat.} - Issiqlik tufayli tuproq qurib ketayotgan edi.
{r:The soil is beneficial for plants.} - Tuproq o'simliklar uchun foydali.
{r:The soil has been enriched with compost otherwise we can't get any yield.} - Tuproq kompost bilan boyitildi yo'qsa biz hech qanday hosil ololmaymiz.

text: {r:Estimate}[ˈɛstɪmeɪt] – baholamoq, taxminan hisoblamoq; baho, taxmin. {p: EST}alikka {p:TIMOT}i bilan rasmga tushganman 2006 – yili. Rossiyalik repper vaqt o'tishi bilan juda mashhur bo'lib ketdi. Mening esa bu eski suratim ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda mashhur bo'lib ketdi va men uni sotishga qaror qildim. Mening rasmim 10 000$ ga {h:baholanyapti}.
examples: {r:He has been estimating the cost of the project.} - U loyihaning narxini hisoblayotgan edi.
{r:She has been estimating the time required.} - U kerakli vaqtni hisoblayotgan edi.
{r:The company has been estimating its profits.} - Kompaniya foyda miqdorini hisoblayotgan edi.
{r:He has been estimating the distance to the city.} - U shaharga qadar bo'lgan masofani hisoblayotgan edi.
{r:Our ultimate estimate suggests the project will be completed ahead of schedule.} - Bizning yakuniy hisob-kitoblarimiz loyihaning muddatidan oldin yakunlanishini ko'rsatmoqda.

text: {r:Crazy}[ˈkreɪzi] – telba; shaydo, ishqiboz. Mening 60 yoshli amakim {p:KREYZI} maks muzqaymog'ini {h:telba}larcha yaxshi ko'radi.
examples: {r:She has been acting crazy lately.} - U oxirgi paytlarda g'alati harakat qilayotgan edi.
{r:He has been driving everyone crazy.} - U hammani aqldan ozdirayotgan edi.
{r:The idea has been sounding crazy to me.} - Bu g'oya menga g'alati tuyulayotgan edi.
{r:She has been laughing like crazy.} - U qattiq kulayotgan edi.

text: {r:Branch}[bræntʃ] – shox; shoxobcha, filial. Tasavvur qiling siz BLINCHik qilib sotasiz. Bir xil ish bilan shug'ullanaverganingiz uchun mahsulotingiz sifati keskin yaxshilanib {p:BLINCH}ik do'koni ochdingiz. Odamlar mahsulotingizni mazza qilib yeya boshladi va siz yuzlab yangi {p:BLINCH}ik {h:filiallar} ochdingiz.
examples: {r:The tree has been growing new branches.} - Daraxt yangi shoxlar o'stirishni boshladi.
{r:He has been working at a new branch of the company since April.} - U apreldan beri kompaniyaning yangi filialida ishlayapti.
{r:She has been studying the branches of science since last year.} - U o'tgan yildan beri fanning tarmoqlarini o'rganayapti.
{r:Additionally, the bank has been opening new branches.} - Bundan tashqari bank yangi filiallar ochayotgan edi.

text: {r:Frequently}[ˈfriːkwəntli] – tez-tez, ketma-ket. Kartoshka fri sotish yaxshi biznes lekin barcha bizneslar kabi uning ham o'z qiyinchiliklari bor. {p:FRI QUNTLI} odamning biznesi. Boshida mijozlar ko'p kelmaydi va sizning joyingizni tanib olgunicha vaqt ketadi. Sabrli bo'lmagan frichilarning biznesi {h:tez-tez} yopilib ketyapti.
examples: {r:She has been visiting the library frequently.} - U kutubxonaga tez-tez tashrif buyurayotgan edi.
{r:He has been making frequent mistakes since he came.} - U tez-tez xatolar qilyapti kelganidan beri.
{r:The bus has been running frequently.} - Avtobus tez-tez qatnayotgan edi.
{r:She often wakes up at midnight and can't sleep later.} - U tez-tez yarim tunda uyg'onib ketadi va keyin uxlay olmaydi.

text: {r:Relief}[rɪˈliːf] – yengillashish. Mana bu reklamani ko'rgan bo'lsangiz kerak. {p:Relif} – sizning {h:yengillashishingiz} sababchisi. Haqiqatdan ham bu dori tez-tez televizorda reklama qilinadi va ich qotishini yumshatib yengillashishingizga sabab bo'ladi.
examples: {r:The medicine brought her relief.} - Dori unga yengillik keltirdi.
{r:He sighed in relief.} - U yengillanib nafas oldi.
{r:Relief efforts are continuing.} - Yordam ishlari olib borilmoqda.
{r:The relief on his face was obvious.} - Uning yuzidagi yengillik sezilarli edi.

text: {r:Manner}[ˈmænər] – fe'l, xulq, odob; tarz, taxlit. Oldinlari haqiqatdan ham sofdil, oqko'ngil inson bo'lishga harakat qilganman. Lekin insonlarga odob bilan munosabat qilganim sari ular haddidan oshib odobsizlik qilishgan. {p:MEN NER}vniy bo'lib ketaman hozir agar kimdir {h:odob}ga odobsizlik bilan javob bersa.
examples: {r:She has been behaving in a polite manner.} - U xushmuomala harakat qilayotgan edi.
{r:He stood up and left the gathering in a rude manner.} - U o'rnidan turdi va qo'pol tarzda yig'ilishdan chiqib ketdi.
{r:The teacher has been teaching in an effective manner.} - O'qituvchi samarali usulda dars beryotgan edi.
{r:She has been handling the situation in a calm manner.} - U vaziyatni sokinlik bilan hal qilayotgan edi.

text: {r:Wise}[waɪz] – dono, aqlli. O’zbekiston tarixidagi eng {h:aqlli} {p:VAZ}ir bu shubhasiz Alisher Navoiy. Vazirlik chog’ida ko’plab maktab, masjid, kanal va karvonsaroylar qurdirgan.
examples: {r:She is a wise woman who gives good advice.} – U yaxshi maslahat beradigan dono ayol.
{r:It was a wise decision to wait.} – Kutish dono qaror bo‘ldi.
{r:He talked with wise words.} – U aqlli so‘zlar bilan gapirdi.
{r:We should listen to wise people.} – Biz dono odamlarga quloq solishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Unusually}[ʌnˈjuːʒuəli] - g'ayrioddiy, noodatiy. Unusual so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:She had been unusually quiet during the meeting, so no one heard her ideas.} - Uchrashuv davomida u noodatiy jim edi, shuning uchun hech kim uning g'oyalarini eshitmadi.
{r:He had had unusually good luck that day before he lost his keys.} - U kalitlarini yo'qotishidan oldin o'sha kuni g'ayrioddiy omadli o'tgan edi.
{r:The weather had been unusually cold for May that year, so we stayed indoors.} - O'sha yili may oyi uchun ob-havo g'ayrioddiy sovuq bo'lgan edi, shuning uchun biz uyda qoldik.
{r:His influence had increased unusually before the changes were made.} - O'zgarishlar qilinishidan oldin uning ta'siri g'ayrioddiy tarzda oshgan edi.

text: {r:External}[ɪkˈstɜːrnəl] – tashqi, tashqi tomondan. San’at muzeyiga borgan paytim 3000 yillik ko’zani tushirib yubordim. Yaxshiyamki ozgina {h:tashqi} tomondan {p:EKS}ponat  {p:TIRNAL}di. Muzey meni kichkina jarima bilan qo’yib yubordi.
examples: {r:The external walls of the building had been painted before the rain came.} - Yomg'ir kelishidan oldin binoning tashqi devorlari bo'yalgan edi.
{r:She had been dealing with external pressures before she found a solution.} - U yechim topishidan oldin tashqi bosimlar bilan kurashayotgan edi.
{r:The external danger had been clear to everyone before the war started.} - Urush boshlanishidan oldin tashqi xavf hamma uchun aniq bo'lgan edi.
{r:The external appearance of the house had changed a lot over the years before they sold it.} - Uyni sotishdan oldin uning tashqi ko'rinishi yillar davomida juda o'zgargan edi.

text: {r:Percent}[pərˈsɛnt] - protsent, foiz.
examples: {r:Ten percent of the students had passed the exam before the results were announced.} - Natijalar e'lon qilinishidan oldin o'quvchilarning o'n foizi imtihondan o'tgan edi.
{r:She had saved fifty percent of her salary before she bought the new car.} - U yangi mashina sotib olishidan oldin maoshining ellik foizini tejagan edi.
{r:The price had increased by twenty percent last month before we bought it.} - Biz uni sotib olishimizdan oldin narx o'tgan oy yigirma foizga oshgan edi.
{r:He had completed ninety percent of the project by the deadline before he went on holiday.} - U ta'tilga chiqishidan oldin loyihaning to'qson foizini muddatgacha tugatgan edi.

text: {r:Stranger}[ˈstreɪndʒər] – begona. Men ko'chatchimam. Ko'chatlarni mehr bilan yetishtiraman. Afsuski men mehr bilan {p:ST}akanlarda {p:ANJIR} ko'chatlarini yetishtiraman lekin u ko'chatni bir {h:begona} olib huzurini o'zi ko'radi.
examples: {r:A stranger had helped her carry the bags before she asked for help.} - U yordam so'rashidan oldin notanish odam unga sumkalarni ko'tarishda yordam bergan edi.
{r:Julia had never seen the stranger before that day when he came to her door.} - Julia o'sha notanish odamni ilgari ko'rmagan edi u eshigiga kelgan o'sha kungacha.
{r:The stranger had left before she could thank him for his kindness.} - Notanish odam uning mehribonligi uchun rahmat aytishidan oldin ketgan edi.
{r:He had been warned not to talk to strangers before he went to the city.} - U shaharga borishidan oldin notanish odamlar bilan gaplashmaslik haqida ogohlantirilgan edi.
{r:The stranger had arrived before we did, so he was waiting.} - Begona bizdan oldin kelgan edi, shuning uchun u kutayotgan edi.

text: {r:Reply}[rɪˈplaɪ] – javob bermoq, javob qaytarmoq. Oldin odamlar rep aytib mashhur bo'lgan bo'lsa hozir itlar rep aytib mashhurlikka erishyapti. Masalan yaqinda alabay it rep aytgan ekan orqasidan {p:REP}per {p:LAY}cha unga {h:javob qaytaribdi}. Xullas ular ham bir-birini so'kib tashlayapti qo'shiqlarida.
examples: {r:She had replied to the email before the meeting started.} - U uchrashuv boshlanishidan oldin elektron pochtaga javob yozgan edi.
{r:What was your reply to his claims? I said 'It is none of your business'.} - Uning da'volariga sizning javobingiz qanday edi? 'Ishing bo'lmasin' dedim.
{r:I will reply to his letters then I will go to bed.} - Men uning xatlariga javob beraman, keyin esa uxlashga yotaman.
{r:They had already replied to the invitation before I called them.} - Men ularga qo'ng'iroq qilishimdan oldin ular taklifga allaqachon javob berishgan edi.

text: {r:Morality}[məˈræləti] - axloq, odob. Moral so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:The story had a strong sense of morality before the end.} - Hikoyada oxirigacha kuchli axloqiy tuyg'u bor edi.
{r:He had been questioning the morality of the decision for a while before he made his choice.} - U o'z tanlovini qilishidan oldin qarorning axloqiyligini biroz vaqtdan beri so'roq qilayotgan edi.
{r:The film had explored themes of morality before it became popular.} - Film mashhur bo'lishidan oldin axloqiy mavzularni o'rganishgan edi.
{r:She gave wise advice on morality to the students.} - U talabalarga axloq haqida dono maslahat berdi.

text: {r:Fee}[fiː] - to'lov. Oxirgi marta Fidapga(feedup - eng mashhur fast fud tarmoqlaridan biri) kirib ovqatlanib qarasam pulim yo'q to'lashga. Keyin {h:to'lov}ni o'rniga {p:FI}dapni idishlarini yuvib ketdim.
examples: {r:He had paid the fee before the deadline passed.} - U muddat o'tishidan oldin to'lovni amalga oshirgan edi.
{r:The fee had increased since last year, so it was more expensive now.} - To'lov o'tgan yilidan beri oshgan edi va hozir qimmatroq edi.
{r:She had forgotten to pay the registration fee before the event started.} - U tadbir boshlanishidan oldin ro'yxatdan o'tish to'lovini unutgan edi.
{r:The fee had been waived for students before the new rule came.} - Yangi qoida kelishidan oldin talabalar uchun to'lov bekor qilingan edi.

text: {r:Match}[mætʃ] - mos kelmoq, to'g'ri tushmoq. 36 - darsda bu so'zning 'match', 'o'yin' ma'nolarini o'rgangan edik. Quyidagi misollar orqali bu so'zning yana bir muhim ma'nosini bilib oling.
examples: {r:She had matched her shoes with her dress before she left.} - U chiqib ketishidan oldin poyabzalini ko'ylagi bilan moslashtirgan edi.
{r:He had matched the puzzle pieces correctly before he showed it to us.} - U bizga ko'rsatishidan oldin boshqotirma qismlarini to'g'ri moslashtirgan edi.
{r:They had matched the candidates with suitable job positions before the interviews.} - Ular intervyulardan oldin nomzodlarni mos ish o'rinlari bilan bog'lashgan edi.
{r:This job matches with my expectations.} - Bu ish mening kutilmalarimga mos keladi.
