text: {r:Frame}[freɪm] - ramka; ramkaga solmoq. Men kartoshka frini qo'vurib, ketchup qo'shib keyin {p:FRIYIM}I rasmga olib {h:ramka}ga solib qo'ydim.
examples: {r:He had framed the picture beautifully before he put it on the wall.} - U rasmni devorga qo'yishdan oldin chiroyli ramkaga solgan edi.
{r:The window frame had been painted white before the house was sold.} - Uy sotilishidan oldin deraza ramkasi oq rangga bo'yalgan edi.
{r:The painting is mostly green but the frame is yellow.} - Rasm asosan yashil rangda, lekin ramkasi esa sariq.
{r:Put down the frame somewhere else.} - Hozircha ramkani qayergadir qo'yib tur.

text: {r:Eliminate}[ɪˈlɪmɪneɪt] - bartaraf etmoq, yo'q qilmoq, chiqarib yubormoq. Elyor men tanigan eng minnatchi bola. {p:EL}yor {p:MINNAT}chiligini {h:yo'q qilishi} kerak.
examples: {r:The team had eliminated all errors before the final review.} - Jamoa yakuniy ko'rib chiqishdan oldin barcha xatoliklarni bartaraf etgan edi.
{r:She had eliminated sugar from her diet.} - U ovqatlanishidan shakerni chiqarib tashlagan edi.

{r:The competition had eliminated weaker candidates in the first round before the main part started.} - Tanlov asosiy qismi boshlanishidan oldin birinchi bosqichda zaifroq nomzodlar chiqarib yuborilgan edi.
{r:He had been eliminated in the first round before he had a chance to show his skills.} - U o'z mahoratini ko'rsatish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishidan oldin birinchi bosqichda chiqarib yuborilgan edi.

text: {r:Host}[hoʊst] – mezbon; mezbonlik qilmoq. {h:Mezbon} sifatida mehmon kutishni yomon ko'raman. Agar qarindosh do'stlar men tarafga ish bilan kelsalar menikiga emas {p:HOST}elga borishsin. Bir kuniga 30 000 so'm to'laydida yashayveradi.
examples: {r:She had hosted the event successfully.} - U tadbirni muvaffaqiyatli o'tkazdi.
{r:The hotel had hosted many famous guests before it closed.} - Mehmonxona yopilishidan oldin ko'plab taniqli mehmonlarni qabul qilgan edi.
{r:The city had hosted the international conference before the new mayor came.} - Yangi mer kelishidan oldin shahar xalqaro konferentsiyaga mezbonlik qilgan edi.
{r:The host had greeted all the guests before the party started.} - Mezbon ziyofat boshlanishidan oldin barcha mehmonlar bilan salomlashib chiqdi.

text: {r:Hall}[hɔːl] – zal. Mana dunyodagi eng antiqa zal. Qachonki bu zalni shvabra bila {p:HO'L} qilib artsangiz {h:zal}ning rangi boshqa tusga kiradi.
examples: {r:The hall had been decorated for the wedding before the guests arrived.} - Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin zal to'y uchun bezatilgan edi.
{r:She had entered the hall quietly before anyone saw her.} - U uni hech kim ko'rmasidan oldin zalga jim kirdi.
{r:The thief had run away through this broad hall before the police came.} - O'g'ri politsiya kelishidan oldin shu keng zal orqali qochib ketgan edi.
{r:The hall had been filled with guests before the music started.} - Musiqa boshlanishidan oldin zal mehmonlar bilan to'lgan edi.

text: {r:Smart}[smɑːrt] - aqlli, topqir. Bu so'z uchun mnemonik namuna yozilmadi chunki smart so'zi oxirgi paytlar juda ko'p qo'llanilyapti. Masalan smartfon, smartwatch, smart televizor va hk.
examples: {r:He had made a smart decision that saved them money before they lost everything.} - U hamma narsani yo'qotishidan oldin ularga pulni tejab bergan aqlli qaror qabul qilgan edi.
{r:How can I be smart and cute?} - Qanday qilib aqlli va yoqimtoy bo'lsam bo'ladi?
{r:The smart solution had saved them time before the problem got bigger.} - Muammo kattalashishidan oldin aqlli yechim ularga vaqtni tejab bergan edi.
{r:He had been praised for his smart work before he left the company.} - U kompaniyani tark etishidan oldin o'zining aqlli ishi uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'lgan edi.

text: {r:Length}[leŋθ] - uzunlik, uzoqlik, davomiylik. Temur bobomizni zamondoshlari Temur {p:LENGS} deb atashgan. Ba'zilar sababi uning cho'loqligida desa boshqalar uning oyog'i {h:uzun}ligida deyishadi.
examples: {r:The length of the movie had surprised everyone before it ended.} - Filmning uzunligi tugashidan oldin hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
{r:She had measured the length of the room before buying furniture.} - U mebel sotib olishdan oldin xonaning uzunligini o'lchagan edi.
{r:The boat is ten metres in length.} - Qayiqning uzunligi 10 metr.
{r:He had been running the entire length of the field before he stopped.} - U to'xtashidan oldin maydonning butun uzunligi bo'yicha yugurgan edi.

text: {r:Initial}[ɪˈnɪʃəl] – dastlabki. Siz bozorda optomchisiz va asosan shlang sotasiz. {h:Dastlab} faoliyatingizni {p:IN}gichka {p:SHL}ang sotishdan boshlagansiz. Keyin esa qalinroqlarini sotgansiz, keyin esa shlanglarni optom sotishni boshlagansiz.
examples: {r:She had made an initial payment before the goods were shipped.} - U mollar jo'natilishidan oldin dastlabki to'lovni amalga oshirgan edi.
{r:The initial reaction had been positive before the news came out.} - Yangiliklar chiqishidan oldin dastlabki reaktsiya ijobiy bo'lgan edi.
{r:He had forgotten his initial idea before he started the new project.} - U yangi loyihani boshlashidan oldin o'zining dastlabki g'oyasini unutib qo'ydi.
{r:The initial results had been good before the final check.} - Yakuniy tekshiruvdan oldin dastlabki natijalar yaxshi bo'lgan edi.

text: {r:Oppose}[əˈpoʊz] – qarshi chiqmoq. O'zining smartfonlari bilan mashhur OPPO kompaniyasi endi aqlli uzuklar ham ishlab chiqaryapti. {p:OPPO UZ}uglari yordamida soatni ko'rishingiz va taymerdan foydalanishingiz mumkin. Ularning ommalashib ketishidan qo'rqqan tillachilar esa bu soat sotuvga chiqishiga {h:qarshilik qilishmoqda}.
examples: {r:He had opposed the decision from the beginning.} - U qarorga boshidan qarshi chiqqan edi.
{r:Why do you oppose me?} - Sen nega menga qarshi chiqyapsan?
{r:Nobody opposes you.} - Hech kim sizga qarshi emas.
{r:Many people had opposed the pollution in the city before it got worse.} - Shahardagi ifloslanishga yomonlashishidan oldin ham ko'pchilik qarshi chiqqan edi.

text: {r:Timetable}[ˈtaɪmteɪbl] - jadval.
examples: {r:The timetable had been changed last week before I saw it.} - Jadval o'tgan hafta men uni ko'rishimdan oldin o'zgartirilgan edi.
{r:His wages had been calculated according to this timetable for years before he got a new job.} - U yangi ish topishidan oldin uning oyliklari yillar davomida shu jadval asosida hisoblangan edi.
{r:The train had departed according to the timetable before we arrived at the station.} - Biz stansiyaga yetib kelishimizdan oldin poyezd jadval bo'yicha jo'nab ketgan edi.
{r:He had missed the bus because of the wrong timetable he had used.} - U ishlatgan noto'g'ri jadval tufayli avtobusni o'tkazib yuborgan edi.

text: {r:Exhibit}[ɪɡˈzɪbɪt] – ko'rgazma qilmoq, namoyish qilmoq. Toshkentda shu kunlarda ijodkor {p:EGIZ}ak {p:BIT}larning {h:ko'rgazmasi uyushtirilyapti}. Ularning ijod namunalarini ko'rish uchun odamlar oqib kelmoqda.
examples: {r:The museum had exhibited ancient artifacts for years before it closed for renovation.} - Muzey ta'mirlash uchun yopilishidan oldin yillar davomida qadimiy artefaktlarni namoyish etgan edi.
{r:She had visited the art exhibit last month before it ended.} - U tugashidan oldin o'tgan oy san'at ko'rgazmasiga tashrif buyurgan edi.
{r:The exhibit had attracted many visitors before the news spread.} - Yangilik tarqalishidan oldin ko'rgazma ko'plab tashrif buyuruvchilarni jalb qilgan edi.
{r:He had been impressed by the exhibit before he left the city.} - U shaharni tark etishidan oldin ko'rgazmadan hayratda qolgan edi.

text: {r:Rush}[rʌʃ] – shoshmoq. Psixologlarning aytishicha {p:RASH}kchi erkaklar ishdan chiqishi bilan uyga {h:shoshar} ekan.
examples: {r:Where are you rushing to?} - Qayerga shoshilyapsan?
{r:I am rushing to the toilet.} - Hojatxonaga shoshilyapman.
{r:He had been in a rush to finish the project before the deadline.} - U loyihani muddatidan oldin tugatish uchun shoshilgan edi.
{r:The crowd had rushed into the new bridge before the security arrived.} - Xavfsizlik xizmati kelishidan oldin olomon yangi ko'prikka shoshildi.

text: {r:Vast}[væst] – keng, ulkan, yirik. Tasavvur qiling bir kuni sizning oldingizga yuristlar kelib sizga o'zining uzoq qarindoshingiz shahar markazidan {h:ulkan} uyni {p:VAS}iyat qilib qoldirganini aytishdi.
examples: {r:The vast desert had seemed endless before they found water.} - Ular suv topishidan oldin keng sahro cheksiz tuyulgan edi.
{r:She had been amazed by the vast ocean.} - U keng okeandan hayratda qolgan edi.
{r:The vast majority had agreed with the proposal before the meeting ended.} - Uchrashuv tugashidan oldin aksariyat taklifga rozi bo'lgan edi.
{r:He had explored the vast forest before he decided to go home.} - U uyiga borishga qaror qilishidan oldin keng o'rmonni o'rgangan edi.

text: {r:Significantly}[sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli] - sezilarli, ulkan, ancha. Significant so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:She's improving her English significantly for the exam next week.} - U kelasi haftadagi imtihon uchun ingliz tilisini sezilarli darajada yaxshilayapti.
{r:The project is progressing significantly, and it finishes next month.} - Loyiha sezilarli rivojlanmoqda va u kelasi oy tugaydi.
{r:The bus service changes significantly next Monday.} - Avtobus xizmati kelasi dushanba sezilarli o‘zgaradi.
{r:The concert starts significantly earlier this Friday.} - Konsert juma kuni odatdagidan sezilarli darajada ertaroq boshlanadi.

text: {r:Nonsense}[ˈnɒnsəns] - bema'ni, ahmoqona. O'tgan darslarimizda sense(ma'no, fahm) so'zini o'rgangan edik. Bu so'zning oldidan 'non' old qo'shimchasining qo'shilishi ma'noni teskarisiga o'giradi. Shunday qilib nonsense bu yerda 'bema'ni', 'ahmoqona' ma'nosini bildiradi.
examples: {r:He's talking nonsense about tomorrow’s plan.} - U ertangi reja haqida bema’ni gapiryapti.
{r:She's spreading nonsense about the meeting next week.} - U kelasi haftadagi yig‘ilish haqida bema’nilik tarqatayapti.
{r:Our math lesson, which feels like nonsense, starts at 9:00 tomorrow.} - Bizning bema’ni matematika darsimiz ertaga soat 9:00 da boshlanadi.
{r:The nonsense lecture ends at 3:00 on Wednesday.} - Bema’ni ma’ruza chorshanba kuni soat 3 da tugaydi.

text: {r:Reliable}[rɪˈlaɪəbl] – ishonchli.
examples: {r:The new car is very reliable; it arrives next week.} - Yangi mashina juda ishonchli; u kelasi hafta keladi.
{r:She's helping arrange the reliable transport for tomorrow's trip.} - U ertangi sayohat uchun ishonchli transportni tashkil etishda yordam beryapti.
{r:The new train service is reliable; it leaves every day at 7 AM.} - Yangi poyezd xizmati ishonchli; u har kuni ertalab soat 7 da jo‘naydi.
{r:The data was not reliable enough, so the committee decided to reject the proposal.} - Ma'lumotlar yetarlicha ishonchli emas edi, shuning uchun qo'mita taklifni rad etishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Debt}[dɛt] – qarz. {p:DED} moroz yangi yilga bolalar uchun juda ham ko'p sovg'alar olibdi va oxiri {h:qarz}ga kirib qolibdi.
examples: {r:He's paying off his debt by the end of the year.} - U yil oxirigacha qarzini to'laydi.
{r:She's still struggling with debt, so she isn't joining us on vacation.} - U hali ham qarzidan qiynalyapti, shuning uchun biz bilan ta'tilga bormaydi.
{r:He is not coming back home because of huge debt.} - U katta qarzi tufayli uyiga qaytib kelolmayapti.
{r:The debt meeting starts at 10 AM on Monday.} - Qarz bo‘yicha yig‘ilish dushanba kuni ertalab 10:00 da boshlanadi.
{r:The support program for debt ends next Friday.} - Qarz bo‘yicha yordam dasturi kelasi juma tugaydi.

text: {r:Coverage}[ˈkʌvərɪdʒ] - qoplam, yoritilish.
examples: {r:She's following the coverage of the sports event next week.} - U kelasi haftadagi sport tadbirining yoritilishini kuzatyapti.
{r:The event is receiving worldwide coverage; it starts tomorrow.} - Tadbir butun dunyo bo'ylab yoritiladi; u ertaga boshlanadi.
{r:The insurance coverage updates next month.} - Sug'urta qoplamasi kelasi oy yangilanadi.
{r:The new insurance coverage is very beneficial.} - Yangi sug'urta qoplamasi juda foydali.

text: {r:Aside}[əˈsaɪd] - dan tashqari, qo'shimchasiga. Asosan Amerika inglizchasida qo'llaniladi. Misollar: 1) "Aside from English, she also speaks Spanish." — "Ingliz tilidan tashqari, u ispan tilida ham gapiradi." 2) "Aside from the high price, the hotel was perfect." — "Narxi qimmatligidan tashqari, mehmonxona juda zo'r edi." 3) "Aside from a minor delay, the trip went smoothly." — "Kichik kechikishdan tashqari, sayohat yaxshi o'tdi." 4) "Aside from his job, he enjoys painting in his free time." — "Ishidan tashqari, u bo'sh vaqtida rasm chizishni yoqtiradi."
examples: {r:Aside from the main speaker, we're having three other presentations tomorrow.} - Asosiy ma'ruzachidan tashqari, ertaga yana uchta taqdimotimiz bor.
{r:Aside from the renovation, the shop is opening as planned next week.} - Ta'mirlashdan tashqari, do'kon kelasi hafta rejalashtirilganidek ochiladi.
{r:Aside from the current tasks, we're taking on a new project in July.} - Joriy vazifalardan tashqari, biz iyul oyida yangi loyihani boshlaymiz.

text: {r:Bond}[bɒnd] – rishta, aloqa, munosabat. Sinfdoshlarimga 'og'aynichilik {h:munosabat}larimiz yo'qolmasin uchrashib turaylik' desam har doim bir xil javob berishadi. '{p:BAND}man'.
examples: {r:They're building a strong bond during their trip.} - Ular sayohat davomida mustahkam rishta qurishyapti.
{r:The siblings are meeting tomorrow to strengthen their bond.} - Aka-ukalar ertaga rishtalarini mustahkamlash uchun uchrashishyapti.
{r:That bond between cousins will last a lifetime.} – Amakivachchalar o‘rtasidagi bu rishtalar butun umr davom etadi.
{r:The school program begins next Tuesday to form student bonds.} - Maktab dasturi talabalar orasida munosabatlar yaratish uchun kelasi seshanba boshlanadi.

text: {r:Master}[ˈmæstər] - master, usta; kuchli o'zlashtirmoq, egallamoq. O'zbek tilida ham qo'llaniladigan 'master' so'zining ingliz tilida ot va fe'l so'z turkumlariga xos shakllari qo'llaniladi.
examples: {r:He's mastering the art of cooking for the competition next month.} - U kelasi oy musobaqa uchun ovqat pishirish san'atini o'zlashtiryapti.
{r:She's practicing hard because she is mastering the piano for the show.} - U konsert uchun pianinoni o‘zlashtiryapti.
{r:The class starts at 10, and she attends to master the subject.} - Dars soat 10 da boshlanadi va u mavzuni egallash uchun qatnashyapti.
{r:The chess tournament begins on Friday; he's ready to prove he's a master.} - Shaxmat turniri juma kuni boshlanadi; u master ekanini isbotlashga tayyor.

text: {r:Wing}[wɪŋ] – qanot. Tasavvur qiling endi {p:VINN}i Puxni {h:qanoti} bor endi u do'stlari yo'lbars, cho'chqa va Kristofer Robinning oldiga uchib bora oladi.
examples: {r:The bird is spreading its wings for the flight tomorrow morning.} - Qush ertaga ertalab uchish uchun qanotlarini yoymoqda.
{r:No human has a wing.} - Hech qaysi odamning qanoti yo'q.
{r:The plane leaves at 6 AM, and its wings are ready for the journey.} - Samolyot ertalab 6 da uchadi va uning qanotlari safar uchun tayyor.
{r:Chickens have wings but they are not able to fly.} - Tovuqlarning qanoti bor lekin ucholmaydi.

text: {r:Hero}[ˈhɪəroʊ] – qahramon. Yaponiyaning {p:Hiro}sima shahri {h:qahramon} shahar hisoblanadi. Chunki u dunyoda birinchi bo'lib atom bombasi tashlangan va shunday bo'lsada tez tiklangan shahar.
examples: {r:She's always admired her childhood hero and is meeting her next week.} - U bolalikdagi qahramonini har doim yaxshi ko'rgan va kelasi hafta u bilan uchrashyapti.
{r:Our local hero is meeting the president tomorrow.} - Bizning mahalliy qahramon ertaga prezident bilan uchrashyapti.
{r:The film about a local hero starts at 7 PM tomorrow.} - Mahalliy qahramon haqidagi film ertaga soat 7 da boshlanadi.
{r:The heroes exhibition opens next Monday.} - Qahramonlar ko‘rgazmasi kelasi dushanba ochiladi.

text: {r:Stretch}[strɛtʃ] – cho'zmoq, uzaytirmoq; cho'zilmoq, uzaymoq. Tasavvur qiling mashina haydab yurgan paytingiz {p:STRECH}ga(qarama qarshi yo'lga) chiqib ketdingiz va qarama-qarshi yo'nalishdagi mashinalar bu vaziyatda harakatdan to'xtab uzoqqa {h:cho'zilgan} tirbandlik paydo bo'ldi.
examples: {r:She's stretching before the workout tomorrow morning.} - U ertaga ertalab mashqdan oldin cho'zilish mashqlarini qilmoqchi.
{r:The road stretches to the new city, and the bus leaves at 7 AM.} - Yo‘l yangi shaharga cho‘ziladi, avtobus soat 7 da u yerga jo‘naydi.
{r:You cannot stretch this rope.} - Bu arqonni cho'zolmaysan.
{r:The yoga class stretches for one hour and starts at 6 PM.} - Yoga mashg‘uloti bir soat davom etadi va soat 18:00 da boshlanadi.

text: {r:Seed}[siːd] – urug'. Muzlik davri multfilmidagi {p:SID} shu multfilmning boshqa bir personajiga o'xshab {h:urug'} orqasidan quvlaydigan odat chiqardi.
examples: {r:He's planting seeds in the school garden tomorrow.} - U ertaga maktab bog‘iga urug‘ ekyapti.
{r:A wise farmer plants each seed carefully.} - Dono dehqon har bir urug‘ni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ekadi.
{r:The seed show starts at 9 o’clock on Sunday.} - Urug‘ ko‘rgazmasi yakshanba kuni soat 9 da boshlanadi.
{r:She's keeping some seeds for the biology class tomorrow.} - U ertangi biologiya darsi uchun urug‘lar saqlayapti.

text: {r:Pepper}[ˈpɛpər] – qalampir. Bu vaziyatda Portugaliyalik futbolchi {p:PEPe R}onaldoga {h:qalampir} uzatayotganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:She's adding pepper to the salad tonight.} - U bugun kechqurun salatga qalampir qo‘shmoqchi.
{r:He's buying peppers at the market tomorrow morning.} - U ertaga ertalab bozorga qalampir sotib olishga boryapti.
{r:The food festival opens at 10 AM and offers spicy peppers.} - Oziq-ovqat festivali soat 10 da ochiladi va achchiq qalampir namoyish etiladi.
{r:They're cooking a special dish with pepper on Friday.} - Ular juma kuni qalampirli maxsus taom pishirishadi.

text:
{r:Multiple}[ˈmʌltɪpl] – ko'p sonli, bir qancha, talaygina. 
 {p:MultikPul} ilovasi orqali {h:bir qancha} multfilm tomosha qiling va pul ishlang. Eng yaxshisi boru, shu ilovaga kiringda yosh bolangizga berib qo'ying. Ham pul ishlaysiz, ham bolani ovutasiz.
examples: {r:She's working on multiple projects this month.} - U shu oy bir nechta loyihalar ustida ishlayapti.
{r:She has multiple problems.} - Uning bir qancha muammolari bor.
{r:They're discussing multiple topics in the meeting tomorrow.} - Ular ertaga yig‘ilishda bir nechta mavzuni muhokama qilishadi.
{r:The new exhibition shows multiple paintings at 5 PM.} - Yangi ko‘rgazma soat 17:00 da bir qancha rasmlarni namoyish qiladi.

text: {r:Essential}[ɪˈsɛnʃəl] – muhim, zarur. Bugun biz '{p:ESAN}kiragan {p:SHL}ang' multfilmini ko'ramiz. Shlang suvni nazorat qilish va faqatgina kerakli qismini sepish o'rniga ko'p suv sepaveradi va hammayoq botqoq bo'lib o'zi ham botib ketadi va nima qilishni bilmay esankirab qoladi. Bu multik odamlarga shlang taqdiridan xulosa chiqarish kerakligi va har doim normani bilish {h:muhim} ekanligini o'rgatadi.
examples: {r:Water is essential, and the lecture about it starts at 2 PM.} - Suv muhim va bu haqidagi ma’ruza soat 14:00 da boshlanadi.
{r:She's preparing the essential documents for tomorrow's interview.} - U ertangi suhbat uchun muhim hujjatlarni tayyorlayapti.
{r:They're bringing essential equipment to the site next Monday.} - Ular keyingi dushanba kuni muhim jihozlarni joyga olib kelishadi.
{r:The essential training begins at 10 AM tomorrow.} - Muhim trening ertaga soat 10 da boshlanadi.

text:
{r:Diary}[ˈdaɪəri] – kundalik, yodnoma. 
 Qog'oz taqchil zamonlarda sigir terisiga ishlov berib o'z {h:kundaliklarimni} yozib borar edim (maktabdagi kundalik emas). Keyinchalik shaharda 2 yil yashab qaytib kelsam ukam anavi terini {p:DOIR}a qilib yuboribdi. O'sha doirani chetida hali ham mening yozuvlarim turibdi 'Men bugun birinchi muhabbatimga xat yozdim' degan.
examples: {r:She's writing in her diary tonight about the trip.} - U bugun kechqurun sayohat haqida kundaligiga yozmoqchi.
{r:He's buying a new diary at the bookstore tomorrow.} - U ertaga kitob do‘konidan yangi kundalik sotib olyapti.
{r:The diary session starts at 11 AM on Saturday.} - Kundalik yozish mashg‘uloti shanba kuni soat 11 da boshlanadi.
{r:She's keeping a travel diary on purpose. She wants to show them to her grandchildren.} - U atayin sayohat kundaligi tutyapti. Ularni qariganda nevaralariga ko'rsatmoqchi.

text: {r:Passenger}[ˈpæsɪndʒər] – yo'lovchi, passajir. Jamoat transportida yurganda yuqumli kasalliklar yuqtirib olishdan juda ehtiyot bo'ling. Masalan {p:PES} yuqtirdi {p:SANJAR} do'stim {h:yo'lovchilardan}.
examples: {r:The passenger is catching the bus at 8 tomorrow morning.} - Yo‘lovchi ertaga soat 8 da avtobusga chiqadi.
{r:She's traveling as a passenger on the train tonight.} - U bugun kechqurun poezdda yo‘lovchi bo‘lib sayohat qiladi.
{r:The passenger flight leaves at 3 PM today.} - Yo‘lovchi reysi bugun soat 15:00 da uchadi.
{r:They're helping passengers with their luggage at the airport tomorrow.} - Ular ertaga aeroportda yo‘lovchilarga yuklari bilan yordam berishadi.

text: {r:Exhibition}[ˌɛksɪˈbɪʃən] - ko'rgazma. Exhibit(namoyish qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She's visiting the art exhibition on Sunday afternoon.} - U yakshanba kuni tushdan keyin san’at ko‘rgazmasiga tashrif buyuradi.
{r:The exhibition opens at 10 AM tomorrow.} - Ko‘rgazma ertaga soat 10 da ochiladi.
{r:He's preparing a painting for the exhibition next week.} - U kelasi haftadagi ko‘rgazma uchun rasm tayyorlayapti.
{r:The science exhibition starts on Monday at 2 PM.} - Fan ko‘rgazmasi dushanba kuni soat 14:00 da boshlanadi.

text: {r:Core}[kɔːr] – meva o'zagi; asosiy, asos. Tasavvur qiling {p:ko'r}pangizni yirtib ichida nima bor ekan deb qarasangiz bir gala sabzi {h:o'zak}lari bor ekan.
examples: {r:The teacher is explaining the core ideas tomorrow.} - O‘qituvchi ertaga asosiy g‘oyalarni tushuntiradi.
{r:They're focusing on the core topics for the meeting tonight.} - Ular bugun kechqurun yig‘ilishda asosiy mavzularga e’tibor qaratishadi.
{r:The new lecture on Earth's core starts at 9 AM.} - Yer o'zagi haqidagi yangi ma’ruza ertalab 9 da boshlanadi.
{r:The core of the problem is being discussed on Friday.} - Muammoning asosi juma kuni muhokama qilinadi.

text: {r:Witness}[ˈwɪtnəs] – guvohi bo'lmoq; guvoh. Kecha televizorda bir xabarni eshitib hayron bo'ldim. {p:VIT}aminlar qatoriga {p:NOS} ham qo'shilibdi, sog'liqni saqlash vazirligi bu haqida e'lon qilganiga o'zim {h:guvoh}man.
examples: {r:He's witnessing the football match tomorrow evening.} - U ertaga kechqurun futbol o‘yiniga guvoh bo‘ladi.
{r:She's giving her statement as a witness next Monday.} - U kelasi dushanba kuni guvoh sifatida bayonot beryapti.
{r:The witness interview starts at 10 AM tomorrow.} - Guvoh bilan suhbat ertaga soat 10 da boshlanadi.
{r:They're calling her as a witness at the trial on Friday.} - Ular uni juma kuni sudga guvoh sifatida chaqirishyapti.

text: frequent - tez-tez. Frequently(tez-tez) so'zining sifat so'z turkumiga xos shakli. Mnemonik namuna uchun 100 - darsdagi frequently ga qarang.
examples: {r:I am surprised by his frequent visits.} - Men uning doimiy tashrifidan hayronman.
{r:He will frequently check his phone while he is waiting for the news.} - Yangiliklarni kutayotganida u tez-tez telefonini tekshiradi.
{r:As soon as she gets her promotion, she will frequently travel for work.} - U lavozimga ko'tarilishi bilanoq, ish uchun tez-tez sayohat qiladi.
{r:She made frequent calls until he finally answered.} – U oxiri javob berguncha tez-tez qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.
{r:The bus was frequent until midnight.} – Avtobuslar tun yarmigacha tez-tez qatnardi.

text: perceive – tushunmoq, payqamoq, deb qabul qilmoq. Televizorda ertayu kech {p:PERSIL} kir yuvish kukunini reklama qilishayotgani tufayli siz ham kiyim dog’larini ketkazish uchun PERSILdan oldingiz. Ammo bu soda bilan yuvganingizdan keyin {h:payqadingizki} dog’lar ikki barobar kattalashib ketgan.
examples: {r:When you perceive the truth, your perspective will change.} - Siz haqiqatni payqaganingizda, nuqtai nazaringiz o'zgaradi.
{r:She will perceive the hidden meaning after she reads the letter carefully.} - U xatni diqqat bilan o'qiganidan keyin yashirin ma'noni tushunadi.
{r:As soon as he perceives any danger, he will warn everyone.} - U har qanday xavfni sezishi bilanoq, hamma ogohlantiradi.
{r:They will not act until they have clearly perceived the full scale of the problem.} - Ular muammoning to'liq ko'lamini aniq tushunmagunlaricha harakat qilishmaydi.

text: pour – quymoq, to’kmoq. Yurtimizda {p:POR}axo’rlar jazolanishining yangi usullari qo’llanilyapti. Masalan bu jinoyat bilan qo’lga tushganlarning omma oldida ustiga mazg’ava {h:quyilyapti}.
examples: {r:After I clean the kettle, I will pour the hot water for tea.} - Choynakni tozalagandan so'ng, men choy uchun qaynoq suv quyaman.
{r:He will pour the cement into the mold after it is mixed properly.} - U sementni to'g'ri aralashtirilganidan keyin qolipga quyadi.
{r:The river will pour into the ocean until it reaches its delta.} - Daryo o'z deltasiga yetib borguncha okeanga quyiladi.
{r:She will pour her energy into the new project while she is feeling motivated.} - U o'zini g'ayratli his qilayotganida yangi loyihaga o'z energiyasini bag'ishlaydi.

text: stir – qo’zg’amoq, chayqatmoq, aralashtirmoq. Sizning antiqa {p:STIR}alniy mashinangiz 1 minutda 16 marta kiyimlaringizni {h:qo’zg’ab}, chayqab beradi.
examples: {r:When the coffee is ready, please stir it for me.} - Qahva tayyor bo'lganida, iltimos, uni men uchun aralashtiring.
{r:He will stir the paint well before he starts painting the wall.} - U devorni bo'yashni boshlashdan oldin bo'yoqni yaxshilab aralashtiradi.
{r:The wind will stir the leaves until they fall from the trees.} - Barglar daraxtlardan tushmaguncha shamol ularni qo'zg'atadi.
{r:She will stir up trouble if she talks about that topic again.} - Agar u yana o'sha mavzu haqida gapirsa, u muammoni qo'zg'atadi.

text: "Judgement" so‘zi o‘zbek tilida "hukm", "qaror", "fikr" degan ma’nolarni anglatadi. U turli kontekstlarda ishlatiladi: 1) "His judgement was fair and logical." — "Uning hukmi adolatli va mantiqiy edi." 2) "She showed good judgement in choosing a career." — "U kasb tanlashda to‘g‘ri qaror qabul qildi." 3) "Don’t rush to judgement without knowing the facts." — "Faktlarni bilmasdan turib shoshilinch xulosa chiqarmang." 4) "The court’s judgement was in his favor." — "Sudning qarori uning foydasiga chiqdi."
examples: {r:When the jury delivers its judgement, the trial will end.} - Hay'at o'z hukmini chiqarganida, sud tugaydi.
{r:After he has considered all the evidence, he will make his final judgement.} - U barcha dalillarni ko'rib chiqqanidan keyin yakuniy hukmini chiqaradi.
{r:Don't form a judgement until you have heard both sides of the story.} - Hikoyaning ikkala tomonini ham eshitmaguningizcha xulosa qilmang.

text: tip – choychaqa; maslahat. Restoranda ovqat tanovul qilganingizdan so’ng ofitsiantlardan biri yaxshi servis uchun choychaqa so’radi. Siz esa “Mening {h:choychaqa}ga pulim yo’q, lekin mana buni berishim mumkin” deya sumkangizdan {p:TIP}ratikanni olib ofitsiantga uzatdingiz.
examples: {r:I will give you a good tip when I finish my meal.} - Men ovqatni tugatganimda sizga yaxshi choychaqa beraman.
{r:As soon as he arrives, I will ask him for a useful tip about the project.} - U kelishi bilanoq, men undan loyiha haqida foydali maslahat so'rayman.
{r:Before you start your journey, I will share some travel tips with you.} - Sayohatni boshlashdan oldin, men siz bilan ba'zi sayohat maslahatlarini bo'lishaman.
{r:She will leave a generous tip after she has received fantastic service.} - U ajoyib xizmat ko'rsatilganidan keyin kattagina choychaqa qoldiradi.

text: Accept – qabul qilmoq, maqullamoq. Koronavirus pandemiyasi davrida ba’zi odamlar juda ehtiyotkor bo’lib qolishdi. Mahalla raisimiz {p:AK}mal {p:SEP}di har bir kelgan odamning qo'llariga antiseptik vositalarni va keyin {h:qabul qildi}.
examples: {r:When he accepts the job offer, he will move to a new city.} - U ish taklifini qabul qilganida, yangi shaharga ko'chib o'tadi.
{r:He fell in love with her, but she didn’t accept his feelings} – U qizni sevib qoldi, lekin qiz uning his-tuyg‘ularini qabul qilmadi.
{r:They will not accept any excuses until they see real progress.} - Ular haqiqiy o'zgarishni ko'rmagunlaricha hech qanday bahonani qabul qilishmaydi.
{r:As soon as the terms are clear, we will accept the agreement.} - Shartlar aniq bo'lishi bilanoq, biz kelishuvni qabul qilamiz.

text: disgusting - jirkanch, bema'ni, yoqimsiz. Zamon rivojlanib ketdi va biz oldin maza qilib ishlatib yuradigan ko'p narsalar yo'q bo'lib ketdi. Radio, kodak fotoplyonka, ayniqsa {p:DISK, KASITANG} eng {h:jirkanch} va yoqimsiz narsaga aylanib qoldi.
examples: {r:When he smells the rotten food, he will find it disgusting.} - U chirigan ovqatni hidlaganida, uni jirkanch deb biladi.
{r:She will find the movie disgusting after she watches the whole thing.} - U filmni to'liq tomosha qilganidan keyin, uni jirkanch deb topadi.
{r:The taste will be disgusting until you add some sugar.} - Siz shakar qo'shmaguningizcha ta'mi yoqimsiz bo'ladi.
{r:As soon as he tells that joke, everyone will find it disgusting.} - U o'sha hazilni aytishi bilanoq, hamma uni jirkanch deb topadi.

text: hole - teshik, tuynuk, o'ra. Tasavvur qiling ertalab tursangiz {p:HOVL}ingizda katta {h:chuqur} paydo bo'lib qolibdi. Bir necha soatlardan so'ng esa olim va tadqiqotchilar kelib sizning hovlingizga meteorit tushganini aytishdi.
examples: {r:When he digs a hole, he will plant a tree in it.} - U chuqur qaziganida, unga daraxt ekadi.
{r:She will fall into a hole if she walks carelessly in the dark.} - Agar u qorong'ida ehtiyotsiz yursa, chuqurga tushib qoladi.
{r:After the rain stops, the hole will be full of water.} - Yomg'ir to'xtaganidan keyin, chuqur suv bilan to'ladi.
{r:He will fill the hole with soil until it is completely covered.} - U chuqurni butunlay yopilgunicha tuproq bilan to'ldiradi.

text: towards - ga, tomonga. Aslida bu so'z to(ga) ning kitoblar va kinolarda uchrab turadigan norasmiy shakli.
examples: {r:When she walks towards the park, she will meet her friends.} - U bog' tomonga yurganida, do'stlarini uchratadi.
{r:He will show kindness towards his neighbors after he has understood their difficulties.} - U qo'shnilarining qiyinchiliklarini tushunganidan keyin ularga mehribonlik ko'rsatadi.
{r:She stood up and walked towards her husband.} - U o'rnidan turdi va eri tomonga yurdi.
{r:She will feel a strong sense of responsibility towards her family while she is living abroad.} - U chet elda yashayotganida o'z oilasiga nisbatan kuchli mas'uliyat his qiladi.

text: tidy - toza, ozoda; tartibga solmoq, yig'ishtirmoq.
examples: {r:After she tidies her room, she will relax and read a book.} - U xonasini yig'ishtirganidan keyin, dam oladi va kitob o'qiydi.
{r:I will tidy up the kitchen when I finish cooking dinner.} - Kechki ovqatni pishirishni tugatganimda oshxonani yig'ishtiraman.
{r:The house will look much better after they have tidied up everything.} - Ular hamma narsani yig'ishtirganlaridan keyin uy ancha yaxshi ko'rinadi.
{r:She will make the bed tidy before she leaves for work every morning.} - U har kuni ertalab ishga ketishidan oldin kravatni tartibga soladi.

text: juice – sharbat. Odatda kichik {p:JUS}sali, pushti rangli olmalardan yaxshi {h:sharbat} tayyorlasa bo’ladi.
examples: {r:When I make fresh juice, I will offer you a glass.} - Men yangi sharbat tayyorlaganimda, sizga bir stakan taklif qilaman.
{r:He will make the juice from the oranges after he buys them.} - U apelsinlarni sotib olganidan keyin ulardan sharbat qiladi.
{r:Drink some juice while you are exercising.} - Siz mashq qilayotganingizda ozgina sharbat iching.
{r:The store will sell a variety of fresh juices when summer arrives.} - Yoz kelganida do'kon turli xil yangi sharbatlarni sotadi.

text: incredible – ajoyib, qoyilmaqom. Menga ota-onam ajoyib ism-familiya tanlashgan. Bilasizmi nima? {p:INKOR ETIL}diyev. Ba'zan nimagadir ariza topshirsam shu zahotiyoq ‘inkor etildi arizangiz, iye kechirasiz bu ism-familiyangiz ekanku, {h:qoyilmaqom} ism-familiya’ deyishadi.
examples: {r:When he sees the view from the mountain top, he will find it incredible.} - U tog' cho'qqisidan manzarani ko'rganida, uni ajoyib deb biladi.
{r:After Julia hears his life story, she will think it is truly incredible.} - Julia uning hayot hikoyasini eshitganidan keyin, uni chinakam ajoyib deb o'ylaydi.
{r:He will show an incredible talent when he performs on stage for the first time.} - U sahnada birinchi marta chiqish qilganida ajoyib qobiliyatini ko'rsatadi.
{r:The progress they make will be incredible if they continue working like this.} - Agar ular shunday ishlashda davom etsalar, erishadigan yutuqlari ajoyib bo'ladi.

text: uncertain - noaniq. Certain(aniq) so'zining teskarisi
examples: {r:When the future is uncertain, we will always hope for the best.} - Kelajak noaniq bo'lganida, biz har doim eng yaxshisiga umid qilamiz.
{r:He will be uncertain of the results until he receives the official report.} - U rasmiy hisobotni olmaguncha natijalarga ishonchi komil bo'lmaydi.
{r:The weather will remain uncertain today until the storm passes completely.} - Bo'ron butunlay o'tib ketmaguncha bugun ob-havo noaniq bo'lib qoladi.
{r:As soon as the situation becomes uncertain, they will activate their emergency plan.} - Vaziyat noaniq bo'lishi bilanoq, ular favqulodda rejasini ishga tushirishadi.

text: completely - butunlay. Mana bu {p:KOMPLEKTLI} idishlar naborini ko'ryapsizmi? Agar inglizchani o'rgansangiz shuni sizga {h:butunlay} berib yuboraman.
examples: {r:She will completely forget about her worries when she goes on vacation.} - U ta'tilga chiqqanida tashvishlarini butunlay unutadi.
{r:I will completely agree with his proposal after he has presented all the facts.} - U barcha faktlarni taqdim etganidan keyin men uning taklifiga butunlay qo'shilaman.
{r:The task will be completely finished before the deadline arrives.} - Vazifa muddat kelishidan oldin butunlay tugatiladi.
{r:He will completely understand the concept while he is attending the lecture.} - U ma'ruzada qatnashayotganida konsepsiyani butunlay tushunadi.

text: advertise - reklama qilmoq. Mnemonik namuna uchun 104 - darsdagi advertisement ga qarang.
examples: {r:They will advertise the new product on TV when it is ready for launch.} - Ular yangi mahsulotni ishga tushirishga tayyor bo'lganida uni televizorda reklama qilishadi.
{r:I never advertise cigarettes.} - Men hech qachon sigaretlarni reklama qilmayman.
{r:The company will advertise heavily after they have secured new funding.} - Kompaniya yangi moliyalashtirishni naqd qilganidan keyin keng reklama qiladi.
{r:He will advertise his services online before he opens his new business.} - U yangi biznesini ochishdan oldin xizmatlarini onlayn reklama qiladi.

text: {r:Besides}[bɪˈsaɪdz] – bundan tashqari, qo‘shimcha ravishda.
examples: {r:Besides English, she speaks French.} - Ingliz tilidan tashqari, u fransuz tilida ham gapiradi.
{r:Besides being smart, he is very kind.} - Aqlli bo‘lishidan tashqari, u juda mehribon.
{r:I don’t want to go out. Besides, it’s raining.} - Men tashqariga chiqishni xohlamayman. Qo'shimchasiga, yomg‘ir ham yog‘ayapti.
{r:They discussed how to govern the country with emphasis on law besides economy.} - Ular iqtisoddan tashqari qonunga urg‘u berib mamlakatni qanday boshqarishni muhokama qilishdi.

text: limited - cheklangan. Limit(cheklamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:When the resources are limited, we will prioritize what is most important.} - Resurslar cheklangan bo'lganida, biz eng muhim narsalarni ustuvor qilamiz.
{r:His movement will be limited until he recovers fully from the injury.} - U jarohatdan to'liq tuzalmaguncha uning harakatlanishi cheklangan bo'ladi.
{r:The offer will be for a limited time, so make sure to apply quickly!} - Taklif cheklangan vaqt uchun bo'ladi, shuning uchun tezda ariza topshirishing!
{r:He will have limited access to information while he is working on the confidential project.} - U maxfiy loyiha ustida ishlayotganida ma'lumotlarga cheklangan kirish imkoniyatiga ega bo'ladi.

text: merely – atigi, xolos, shunchaki. {p:MERLI}nni kuchli sehrgar deb o’ylasangiz xato qilasiz. Merlin sehr orqali faqat choy damlab keladigan sehrgar {h:xolos}.
examples: {r:When she says that, she will merely be expressing her opinion.} - U shunday deganida, u faqat o'z fikrini bildirayotgan bo'ladi xolos.
{r:I am merely a beginner.} - Men boshlang'ichman xolos.
{r:I merely said that I was tired.} - Men shunchaki charchaganligimni aytdim.
{r:She will merely smile when you ask her about her secret.} - Siz uning sirini so'raganingizda u shunchaki tabassum qiladi.

text: definitely – shubhasiz, aniq, albatta. Mana bu {p:DELFIN ITLI} delfin ya’ni it boqadigan delfin. Qiziq bu nima deb o’ylaysiz? {h:Shubhasiz} multfilm, chunki delfin dengizda yashaydi, it esa quruqlikda. Shuning uchun bu rasm reallikka to’g’ri kelmaydi.
examples: {r:When I see him next time, I will definitely recognize him.} - Uni keyingi safar ko'rganimda, men uni shubhasiz tanib olaman.
{r:He will definitely succeed after he has put in all this hard work.} - U shuncha mashaqqatli mehnat qilganidan keyin shubhasiz muvaffaqiyat qozonadi.
{r:The answer will definitely be yes when they announce the final decision.} - Ular yakuniy qarorni e'lon qilganlarida javob albatta ha bo'ladi.
{r:She will definitely make the right choice before she signs the contract.} - U shartnomani imzolashdan oldin albatta to'g'ri tanlov qiladi.

text: {r:Seriously}[ˈsɪriəsli] – jiddiy, seryozniy. {p:Serious}(jiddiy) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:Ali could take the matter seriously if he understood its importance} - Agar Ali uning ahamiyatini tushunganda, u masalani jiddiy qabul qilishi mumkin edi.
{r:The accident could have been less serious if Gulnara had been wearing a helmet} - Agar Gulnara kaska kiyganida, baxtsiz hodisa unchalik jiddiy bo'lmasligi mumkin edi.
{r:They could seriously consider the offer if the terms were better} - Agar shartlar yaxshiroq bo'lganda, ular taklifni jiddiy ko'rib chiqishlari mumkin edi.
{r:Diyor couldn't have spoken more seriously about the issue} - Diyor bu masala haqida bundan jiddiyroq gapira olmasdi; hamma diqqat bilan tingladi.

text: {r:Initially}[ɪˈnɪʃəli] – dastlab, avval. {p:Initial}(daslabki) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Initially, Kamila could have disagreed with the plan} - Dastlab, Kamila rejaga qarshi chiqishi mumkin edi, lekin u uni qo'llab-quvvatlashga qaror qildi.
{r:Ali was initially hesitant to join} - Ali dastlab qo'shilishga ikkilanayotgan edi.
{r:Initially, she didn’t want to take part in the game.} – Dastlab u o‘yinda qatnashishni istamadi.
{r:Nilufar initially thought it was a joke} - Nilufar dastlab buni hazil deb o'ylagan edi.

text: {r:Experiment}[ɪkˈspɛrɪmənt] – eksperiment, tajriba, sinov.
examples: {r:They could conduct an experiment in the lab tomorrow} - Ular ertaga laboratoriyada tajriba o'tkazishlari mumkin.
{r:Madina was excited about the science experiment} - Madina fan tajribasidan xursand edi.
{r:The scientists were willing to experiment with new methods.} - Olimlar yangi usullar bilan tajriba o'tkazishga tayyor edilar.
{r:Jamshid could prepare for the experiment for weeks to get better results} - Jamshid yaxshiroq natijalar olish uchun tajribaga haftalab tayyorgarlik ko'rishi mumkin.

text: {r:Lake}[leɪk] – ko’l. Sizning qoningizdagi {p:LEYK}otsitlar odam {h:ko’lda} suzib yurgandek qon tomirlaringizda suzib aylanib yuradi.
examples: {r:They could go fishing at the lake this weekend} - Ular shu dam olish kunlari ko'lga baliq ovlashga borishlari mumkin.
{r:The lake could have been calm and peaceful if the wind hadn't picked up} - Agar shamol kuchaymaganda, ko'l tinch va osoyishta bo'lishi mumkin edi.
{r:Zarina had never seen such a beautiful lake} - Zarina bunday chiroyli ko'lni hech ko'rmagan edi; u ko'zlariga ishonolmasdi.
{r:Does this river originate in the mountains or a lake?} - Bu daryo tog'lardan yoki ko'ldan kelib chiqqanmi?

text: {r:Bedroom}[ˈbɛdruːm] – yotoqxona. {p:Bed}(krovat) va {p:room}(xona) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Dilnoza could decorate her bedroom beautifully if she had more time} - Agar Dilnozaning ko'proq vaqti bo'lganda, u yotoqxonasini chiroyli bezatishi mumkin edi.
{r:Alisher was cleaning his bedroom but he could have finished it quickly} - Alisher yotoqxonasini tozalayotgan edi, ammo u tezroq tugatishi mumkin edi.
{r:The bedroom could have had a large window but our plans changed then} - Yotoqxonada katta deraza bo'lishi mumkin edi lekin keyinroq planimiz o'zgardi.
{r:I could have decorated your bedroom well. But you did not want changes} - Yotoqxonangni yaxshi bezatib berishim mumkin edi. Lekin sen o'zgarishlarni xohlamading.

text: {r:Plenty}[ˈplɛnti] – ko’p, serob. Uyingizni remont qilyapsiz va pulingiz kamaygani sari qurilish mollari yetishmovchiligi ortyapti. Lekin sizda o’tgan qurilishdan qolgan juda {h:ko’p} {p:PLENT}us bor ekan. Bu plentuslarni boshqalar bilan qurilish mollariga ayirboshlashga qaror qildingiz.
examples: {r:There could have been plenty of food at the party if more guests had come} - Agar ko'proq mehmon kelganida, bazmda ko'p ovqat bo'lishi mumkin edi.
{r:Madina had plenty of time to finish the project so she could have taken rest.} - Madinaning loyihani tugatish uchun ko'p vaqti bor edi, shuning uchun u dam olishi mumkin edi.
{r:They could have plenty of reasons to celebrate after the results come in} - Natijalar kelgandan so'ng, ularda nishonlash uchun ko'p sabablar bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:Rustam had plenty of experience in the field} - Rustamning bu sohada ko'p tajribasi bor edi.

text: {r:diamond}[ˈdaɪəmənd] – olmos. Tasavvur qiling siz ko'chaga aylanishga chiqdingiz va hashamatli kiyinib olgan, {h:olmos} taqib olgan {p:MAYMUN}ni ko'rdingiz va hayratlandingiz.
examples: {r:He could have given her a diamond necklace for her birthday.} - U uning tug'ilgan kuniga olmos marjon berishi mumkin edi (lekin bermadi).
{r:The diamond could sparkle even more brightly if it were in direct sunlight.} - Agar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri quyosh nuri ostida bo'lsa, olmos yanada yorqinroq yarqirashi mumkin.
{r:She could wear a diamond ring to the party if she wanted to.} - Agar xohlasa, u ziyofatga olmos uzuk taqishi mumkin.
{r:I can't afford buying that diamond.} - O'sha olmosni olishga qurbim yetmaydi.

text: {r:advertisement}[ədˈvɜːrtɪsmənt] – reklama. {p:Edvard} reklama e’loni osayotgan payt {p:tay}oq ko’targan {p:ment}ga duch keldi. Ment esa “Bu yerda {h:reklama} osish mumkin emas, boshqa joyga boring” dedi.
examples: {r:They could have seen the advertisement on TV if they had watched that channel.} - Agar ular o'sha kanalni tomosha qilganlarida, reklamani televizorda ko'rishlari mumkin edi.
{r:The advertisement could attract even more customers if it ran longer.} - Agar reklama uzoqroq davom etsa, u yanada ko'proq mijozlarni jalb qilishi mumkin.

{r:She was working on the advertisement campaign, so she could have told you all about it.} - U reklama kampaniyasi ustida ishlayotgan edi, shuning uchun u sizga bu haqda hamma narsani aytib berishi mumkin edi.
{r:I came across a strange advertisement for a new type of water.} - Men yangi turdagi suv uchun g'alati reklamaga duch keldim.

text: {r:decline}[dɪˈklaɪn] – rad etmoq. Bu {p:DIK}tant {p:LAY}chalar haqida bo'lib, kelajakda ularning bo'yi yanada {h:pasayib} ketishi taxmin qilindi.
examples: {r:The company could decline to comment on the matter, but it might hurt their reputation.} - Kompaniya bu masala bo'yicha izoh berishdan bosh tortishi mumkin, lekin bu ularning obro'siga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.
{r:The couple declined the invitation to the party.} – Er-xotin ziyofatga taklifni rad etishdi.
{r:I invited him to the meeting but he declined.} - Men uni majlisga taklif qildim lekin u rad etdi.
{r:She could have declined the offer politely if she was too busy.} - Agar u juda band bo'lganda, u taklifni muloyimlik bilan rad etishi mumkin edi.

text: {r:expose}[ɪkˈspoʊz] – fosh qilmoq, oshkor qilmoq. '{p:EKSPO}rtbop {p:UZ}um ko’chatlarini mendan sotib olib boy bo’lib keting' deya aldayotgan ko’chatchilarning yolg’oni mana bu videoda {h:fosh qilingan}.
examples: {r:The journalist could have exposed the scandal earlier if he had found enough evidence.} - Agar jurnalist yetarli dalil topganida, u janjalni avvalroq oshkor qilishi mumkin edi.
{r:I could have exposed your lies earlier.} - Men sening yolg'onlaringni ertaroq fosh qilsam bo'lardi.
{r:New research will expose details that were previously unknown to the public.} - Yangi tadqiqot ilgari jamoatchilikka noma'lum bo'lgan tafsilotlarni ochib beradi.
{r:He could expose the truth by releasing the confidential documents.} - U maxfiy hujjatlarni e'lon qilish orqali haqiqatni oshkor qilishi mumkin edi.

text: {r:solid}[ˈsɑːlɪd] – mustahkam, qattiq, pishiq. Mana bu juda ham kuchli {p:SALYUD.} Agar buni uyga qaratib otsangiz, {h:mustahkam} uyni ham buzib yuboradi.
examples: {r:The table could have been made of solid wood to ensure durability.} - Stol mustahkam bo'lishi uchun qattiq yog'ochdan yasalishi mumkin edi.
{r:The evidence couldn't have been more solid; it proved his guilt beyond a doubt.} - Dalillar bundan mustahkamroq bo'lishi mumkin emasdi; u uning aybini shubhasiz isbotladi.
{r:He could build a solid reputation by consistently delivering good work.} - U doimiy ravishda yaxshi ish olib borish orqali mustahkam obro' qozonishi mumkin.
{r:She had a solid plan for the project, so she could have presented it with confidence.} - U loyiha uchun mustahkam rejaga ega edi, shuning uchun u uni ishonch bilan taqdim etishi mumkin edi.

text: {r:achieve}[əˈtʃiːv] – erishmoq, yetishmoq. {p:E}lyor {p:chiv}inlarning barchasini yo'q qilib, uyida osoyishtalikka {h:erishdi}.
examples: {r:She could have achieved her goal if she had worked a little harder.} - Agar u biroz qattiqroq ishlaganida, u o'z maqsadiga erishishi mumkin edi.

{r:He was working hard to achieve success, so he could have gotten there sooner with more help.} - U muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun qattiq ishlayotgan edi, shuning uchun agar ko'proq yordam bo'lganda, u bunga tezroq erishishi mumkin edi.
{r:The team could achieve even greater results next season with their new coach.} - Yangi murabbiyi bilan jamoa keyingi mavsumda yanada katta natijalarga erishishi mumkin.
{r:It takes time to realize your full potential and achieve your goals.} - O'z qobiliyatingizdan to'liq foydalanish va maqsadlaringizga erishish uchun vaqt kerak bo'ladi.

text: {r:convince}[kənˈvɪns] – ishontirmoq, ko’ndirmoq. Amaldorlarga insof yetishmaydi. Hammamiz {p:KONV}ertga {p:INS}ofdan ozgina solib jo’natib yuboraylik shularga. Zora shularni bizga sifatli yo’l qurishga {h:ko’ndira olsak}.
examples: {r:It was difficult to convince the stubborn child to eat his vegetables.} - O'jar bolani sabzavot yeyishga ishontirish qiyin edi.
{r:He had been trying to convince her for hours, so he couldn't have given up then.} - U uni soatlab ko'ndirishga harakat qilgan edi, shuning uchun u o'sha paytda taslim bo'lishi mumkin emasdi.
{r:Her strong powers of persuasion could convince anyone to join the team.} - Uning kuchli ishontirish qobiliyati har qanday odamni jamoaga qo'shilishga ishontirishi mumkin edi.
{r:We need to convince everyone that the new plan is crucial for success.} - Biz yangi reja muvaffaqiyat uchun juda muhimligiga hammani ishontirishimiz kerak.

text: {r:physician}[fɪˈzɪʃən] – doktor, shifokor. Olovuddinning sehrli chirog'i bo'lsa, bu {p:FIZI}kning {p:SHN}uri bor ekan. Shnurni yerga bir ursa, {h:doktor}ga aylanar ekan, yana bir ursa, qayta fizikka aylanar ekan.
examples: {r:She could visit the physician for a check-up if she felt unwell.} - Agar u o'zini yomon his qilsa, u tekshiruv uchun shifokorga borishi mumkin.

{r:He had been working as a physician for years, so he could have diagnosed the complex case.} - U yillardan beri shifokor bo'lib ishlagan edi, shuning uchun u murakkab holatga tashxis qo'yishi mumkin edi.
{r:The physician could have prescribed different medicine, but this was sufficient.} - Shifokor boshqa dori yozib berishi mumkin edi, ammo bu yetarli edi.
{r:She was a cute physician who took care of every patient.} - U har bir bemor haqida qayg'uradigan yoqimli bir doktor edi.

text: {r:approve}[əˈpruːv] – ma'qullamoq, tasdiqlamoq. "Bizning uyga qizil, oq, yashil profnastillar kerak emas. Agar {p:AP}elsinrang {p:PROF}nastil qo'ydirsangiz, men buni {h:ma'qullayman}" dedi xotinim.
examples: {r:The manager could approve the plan if it met all of the requirements.} - Agar reja barcha talablarga javob bersa, menejer uni tasdiqlashi mumkin.
{r:He had been waiting for the approval, and he could have received it earlier.} - U tasdiqlanishini kutayotgan edi va uni avvalroq olishi mumkin edi.
{r:The committee couldn't have approved the proposal without further discussion.} - Qo'mita keyingi muhokamasiz taklifni tasdiqlay olmasdi.
{r:His parents will approve of his decision to graduate early.} - Ota-onasi uning erta bitirish qarorini ma'qullaydi.

text: {r:virtually}[ˈvɜːrtʃuəli] – deyarli. {p:VOR}larni og'ziga {p:CHILI} qalampirlarini tiqib jazolash kerak. O’shanda ular jinoiy faoliyatini to'xtatib, O'zbekistonda {h:deyarli} vor qolmaydi.
examples: {r:The meeting was virtually attended by everyone; it couldn't have been more successful online.} - Uchrashuvda hamma deyarli ishtirok etdi; onlayn majlis bundan ham muvaffaqiyatliroq bo'lishi mumkin emasdi.
{r:The project was virtually complete, so we could have submitted it sooner.} - Loyiha deyarli tugagan edi, shuning uchun biz uni tezroq topshirishimiz mumkin edi.
{r:She had virtually no experience in that field, so she couldn't have led the team.} - Uning bu sohada deyarli tajribasi yo'q edi, shuning uchun u jamoaga rahbarlik qila olmasdi.
{r:These twins are virtually the same.} - Bu egizaklar deyarli bir xil.

text: {r:proper}[ˈprɑːpər] – o'rinli, mos, munosib, kerakli. Bu so'zni o'zbek tiliga bitta so'z bilan tarjima qilish qiyin. Quyidagi misollar orqali so'zning ma'nosini yaxshiroq tushunishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:The proper tools were not available, so we couldn't have finished the repair.} - Kerakli asboblar mavjud emas edi, shuning uchun biz ta'mirlashni tugata olmasdik.
{r:He had been following the proper procedure, so he couldn't have made a mistake.} - U to'g'ri tartibda ishlagan edi, shuning uchun u xato qilgan bo'lishi mumkin emasdi.
{r:She could have given a proper explanation if she had understood the topic better.} - Agar u mavzuni yaxshiroq tushunganida, u to'g'ri tushuntirish berishi mumkin edi.
{r:She had been trained in the proper techniques, so she could have completed the task perfectly.} - U to'g'ri usullar bo'yicha o'qitilgan edi, shuning uchun u vazifani mukammal bajara olardi.

text: {r:Guilt}[ɡɪlt] – aybdorlik, pushaymonlik. Bu so‘z biror noto‘g‘ri ish qilganlik yoki majburiyatni bajarmaganlik hissini bildiradi.
examples: {r:She had been struggling with guilt, and she couldn't have found peace until she confessed.} - U aybdorlik hissi bilan kurashayotgan edi va iqror bo'lmaguncha tinchlik topa olmasdi.
{r:The guilt was overwhelming; he couldn't ignore it any longer.} - Aybdorlik hissi haddan tashqari edi; u endi uni e'tiborsiz qoldira olmasdi.
{r:In the emergency, the thief showed guilt on his face.} - Favqulodda vaziyatda o‘g‘rining yuzida aybdorlik bilinib turardi.
{r:He was not able to hide his guilt.} - U o‘z aybdorligini yashira olmadi.

text: {r:muscular}[ˈmʌskjələr] – mushakli, muskulli.
examples: {r:He could have a more muscular body if he had trained consistently.} - Agar u doimiy ravishda mashq qilganida, u mushakli qomatga ega bo'lishi mumkin edi.
{r:She was working out to become more muscular, so she could lift heavier weights.} - U ko'proq mushakli bo'lish uchun mashq qilayotgan edi, shuning uchun u og'irroq og'irliklar ko'tara olardi.
{r:The athlete was very muscular; he couldn't have achieved that without years of training.} - Sportchi juda mushakli edi; u bunga yillar davomida mashq qilmasdan erisha olmasdi.
{r:He had been training to improve his muscular strength, and he could already feel the difference.} - U mushak kuchini oshirish uchun mashq qilgan edi va u allaqachon farqni his qila olardi.

text: {r:acquire}[əˈkwaɪər] – ega bo’lmoq, orttirmoq. Akvariumdagi baliqlar och qolishdi. Bola {p:akv}ariumga {p:ayr}on to'kib yuboribdi. Baliqlar hech bo'lmasa ichish uchun nimagadir {h:ega bo’ldik} deya xursand bo’lishibdi.
examples: {r:She could have acquired a new skill if she had dedicated enough time to it.} - Agar u yetarli vaqt ajratganida, u yangi ko'nikma orttirishi mumkin edi.
{r:He was trying to acquire more knowledge, and he could have learned faster with a tutor.} - U ko'proq bilim olishga harakat qilayotgan edi va o'qituvchi bilan tezroq o'rganishi mumkin edi.
{r:The company could acquire a smaller firm to expand its market share.} - Kompaniya bozor ulushini kengaytirish uchun kichikroq firmani sotib olishi mumkin.
{r:It's hard to acquire a quick reply from the team when the system is slow.} - Tizim sekin bo'lsa, jamoaning tez javobini olish qiyin.

text:
"Perception" so‘zi o‘zbek tilida "idrok", "tushuncha", "qarash" degan ma’nolarni anglatadi. U biror narsani qanday qabul qilish yoki ko‘rish usulini bildiradi.

[b]Misollar:[/b]
1) "Her perception of the problem is different." — "Uning muammo haqidagi tushunchasi boshqacha."
2) "Public perception of the company has improved." — "Jamoatchilikning kompaniyaga bo‘lgan qarashi yaxshilandi."
3) "Color perception can vary from person to person." — "Rangni idrok etish odamdan odamga farq qilishi mumkin."
4) "His perception of art is very unique." — "Uning san’at haqidagi qarashi juda o‘ziga xos."

{r:Pleasure}[ˈplɛʒər] – huzur-halovat, lazzat. Madagaskar multfilmi qahramonlari hozir plyajda mazza qilib dam olishyapti. Ayniqsa {p:PLYAJ JIR}afaning jonu-dili, u bu yerda Gloria bilan suhbatlashib o’tirishdan {h:maroq} oladi.
examples: {r:It was a great pleasure for her to finally be free from debt.} - Nihoyat qarzdan xalos bo'lish uning uchun katta zavq edi.
{r:You will have pleasure if you stretch your legs.} - Oyoqlaringni cho'zib o'tirsang maza qilasan.
{r:It was an incredible pleasure to witness such a beautiful performance.} - Bunday go'zal chiqishga guvoh bo'lish ajoyib zavq edi.
{r:Having a free timetable is the biggest pleasure.} - Erkin jadvalga ega bo'lish eng katta lazzat.

text: {r:Welfare}[ˈwɛlfer] – farovonlik, sihat-salomatlik, xushnudlik. Mening bobom Soyuz davrida juda kambag'al yashagan. Bir kuni fransuz filmini tomosha qilgan bobom {h:farovon} hayot sari intilish uchun {p:VEL}ikda {p:FR}ansiyaga yo'lga chiqqan va 1 yilda yetib borgan.
examples: {r:We have started effective welfare programs} - Biz samarali farovonlik dasturlarini boshladik.
{r:Welfare will not be achieved if there is no peace} - Tinchlik bo'lmasa farovonlikka erishib bo'lmaydi.
{r:He must be concerned about the welfare of his employees} - U xodimlarining farovonligi haqida tashvishlangan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She can't have ignored the welfare issues} - U farovonlik masalalarini e'tiborsiz qoldirgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u juda mas'uliyatli.

text: {r:Assure}[əˈʃʊr] – kafolat bermoq, ishontirmoq. Mana bu kinoni ko’rgan bo’lsangiz kerak. {p:ESH}shak {p:SHUR}ik bilan gaplashyapti “Xavotirlanma Shurik biz Ninani aniq topamiz {h:kafolat beraman}”.
examples: {r:I can assure you that he is fully aware of the situation.} - Sizga shuni ishontirib aytamanki, u vaziyatdan to'liq xabardor.
{r:I can assure you that your assumption is correct.} - Sizning taxminingiz to'g'ri ekanligini ishontirib aytaman.
{r:They must have assured the clients about the delivery} - Ular mijozlarni yetkazib berish bo'yicha ishontirgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:He can't have assured them without checking the details} - U tafsilotlarni tekshirmasdan ularga kafolat bergan bo'lishi mumkin emas.
{r:We can assure you that every female employee will receive virtually equal pay.} - Sizni ishontirib aytamizki, har bir ayol xodim deyarli teng maosh oladi.

text: {r:Joke}[dʒoʊk] – hazil; hazil qilmoq. Twitterda kecha mashhur tennischi Novok {p:JOK}ovich xabar qoldirdi “Men tennis o’ynashni to’xtatib endi futbol bilan shug’ullanmoqchiman” deya. Keyingi kuni esa boshqa xabar qoldirdi “Kechagi gapim 1 – aprel {h:hazili} edi”.
examples: {r:Obviously, you must be joking.} - Siz aniq hazillashayotgan bo'lsangiz kerak.
{r:She can't be serious. This must be a joke.} - U jiddiy bo'lishi mumkin emas; bu hazil bo'lishi kerak.
{r:They must have made a joke about the situation} - Ular vaziyat haqida hazil qilgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:He can't have joked with the boss} - U boshliq bilan hazillashmagan bo'lsa kerak.

text: {r:Lock}[lɑːk] – qulflamoq; qulf. Siz bu vaziyatda {h:qulf}ni zanglamasligi uchun {p:LOK}laganingizni tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:He must have locked the door} - U eshikni qulflagan bo'lishi kerak; men ocholmayapman.
{r:She can't have forgotten to lock the car} - U mashinani qulflashni unutgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u juda ehtiyotkor.
{r:They must be locking the office now} - Ular hozir ofisni qulflayotgan bo'lishi kerak; kech bo'ldi.
{r:He can't have lost the keys} - U kalitlarni yo'qotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u ularni hozirgina olgan edi.

text: {r:Dig}[dɪɡ] – qazimoq. Mana bu {p:DIK}tofonda juda sirli suhbatlar mavjud. Siz chuqur {h:qazib} mana shu diktofonni ko'mib yuborishingiz lozim.
examples: {r:They must be digging in the garden} - Ular bog'da qaziyotgan bo'lishi kerak; shovqin eshitilayapti.
{r:She can't have dug the hole herself} - U o'zi chuqur qazigan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u juda katta.
{r:He must have dug for hours to find the treasure} - U xazinani topish uchun soatlab qazigan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:They can't be digging in the wrong place} - Ular noto'g'ri joyda qaziyotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; ularning xaritasi bor.
{r:They had to dig to the very bottom of the well to find water.} - Ular suv topish uchun quduqning eng tubigacha qazishga majbur bo'lishdi.

text: {r:Chase}[tʃeɪs] – quvmoq, ta’qib qilmoq; quvish. Inglizlar choyxo’r millat va choyga bo’lgan hurmati ham juda yuqori. Agar ingliznikiga mehmonga borib sizga choy quysayu {p:CHOYIZ} ichilmasdan ketib qolsangiz sizni {h:quvalab} borishadida baribir choyingizni ichirib qo’yishadi.
examples: {r:He must be chasing the dog} - U itni quvib yurgan bo'lishi kerak; u qochib ketdi.
{r:She can't have chased the thief alone} - U o'g'rini yolg'iz quvib yurgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; bu xavfli.
{r:They must have chased the car for kilometres} - Ular mashinani kilometrlab quvib yurgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:He can't be chasing the ball} - U to'pni quvib yurgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u o'tiribdi.

text: {r:Unlock}[ʌnˈlɑːk] – qulfdan ochmoq. Lock(qulflamoq) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:She must have unlocked the door} - U eshikni ochgan bo'lishi kerak; hozir ochiq.
{r:He can't have unlocked the safe} - U seyfni ochgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u kodni bilmaydi.
{r:They must be unlocking the gate} - Ular darvozani ochayotgan bo'lishi kerak; ovoz eshitilayapti.
{r:She can't have forgotten to unlock the car} - U mashinani ochishni unutgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u juda puxta.

text: {r:Warning}[ˈwɔːrnɪŋ] – ogohlantirish. Warn(ogohlantirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He must have ignored the warning} - U ogohlantirishni e'tiborsiz qoldirgan bo'lishi kerak; u hozir muammoda.
{r:She can't have missed the warning} - U ogohlantirishni o'tkazib yuborgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u juda aniq edi.
{r:They must be giving a warning to the students} - Ular o'quvchilarni ogohlantirishayotgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:He can't have misunderstood the warning} - U ogohlantirishni noto'g'ri tushungan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u takrorlangan edi.

text: {r:Whisper}[ˈwɪspər] – pichirlamoq. Sinfdosh do’stimizning to’yi bo’lyapti. Boshqa bir do’stimiz esa u haqida g’iybat bilan ovvora. “Kostum-shim, kelin ko’ylak hammasini prokatga olgan bular. Hattoki mana shu tarqatayotgan {p:VIZ}itkasiyam {p:PR}okat bularni” dedi {h:pichirlab}.
examples: {r:She must be whispering because it’s a secret} - U shivirlayotgan bo'lishi kerak; chunki bu sir.
{r:He can't have whispered the answer} - U javobni shivirlagan bo'lishi mumkin emas; hech kim uni eshitmadi.
{r:They must have whispered during the meeting} - Ular uchrashuv paytida shivirlashgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She can't be whispering to him} - U unga shivirlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; ular bir-biridan uzoqda.
{r:She managed to whisper her message in a silent room.} - U xabarini jim xonada shivirlab aytishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

text: {r:Dislike}[dɪsˈlaɪk] – yoqtirmaslik. Like(yoqtirmoq) so'zining teskarisi. Dis - old qo'shimchasi ba'zi so'zlarning ma'nosini teskarisiga o'zgartiradi.
examples: {r:He initially disliked a yellow umbrella but later it ended up being his favourite} - U avval sariq soyabonni yoqtirmadi keyinchalik bu soyabon uning sevimli soyaboniga aylandi.
{r:She can't have disliked the movie} - U kinoni yoqtirmagan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u butun vaqt tabassum qildi.
{r:They must be disliking the new rules} - Ular yangi qoidalarni yoqtirmayotgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:He can't have disliked the gift} - U sovg'ani yoqtirmagan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u unga iliq minnatdorchilik bildirdi.

text: {r:Fear}[fɪr] – qo'rqmoq; qo'rquv. Bobom Soyuz davrida fermer bo'lgan. {p:FER}mer sifatida bobomning eng katta {h:qo'rquvi} paxta planini bajara olmaslik bo'lgan. Planni bajarish odamlarga zug'um qilib paxta dalasiga haydashni anglatgan lekin bajara olmaslik 1988 - yili bobomning qamalishiga olib kelgan.
examples: {r:She must fear the dark} - U qorong'ulikdan qo'rsa kerak; u har doim chiroq yoqib uxlaydi.
{r:He can't have feared the challenge} - U qiyinchilikdan qo'rqqan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u darhol qabul qildi.
{r:They must be fearing the worst} - Ular eng yomonidan qo'rqayotgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She can't have feared the exam} - U imtihondan qo'rqqan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u yaxshi tayyorlangan edi.

text: {r:Imagine}[ɪˈmædʒɪn] – tasavvur qilmoq. Mana bu {p:IMO}rat {p:JIN}niki. Alovuddining sehrli chirog'idagi. Siz ham bu imoratga havas qildingiz va sizda ham shunday imorat bo'lishi haqida {h:tasavvur qildingiz}.
examples: {r:He must be imagining himself as a hero} - U o'zini qahramon deb tasavvur qilayotgan bo'lsa kerak.
{r:It's hard to imagine that such a simple solution was previously ignored.} - Bunday oddiy yechim ilgari e'tibordan chetda qolganini tasavvur qilish qiyin.
{r:They must be imagining a better future} - Ular yaxshiroq kelajakni tasavvur qilayotgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:It's hard to imagine how complex the human brain is.} - Inson miyasi qanchalik murakkab ekanligini tasavvur qilish qiyin.
{r:Can you imagine a design where all the patterns match perfectly?} - Barcha naqshlar mukammal mos keladigan dizaynni tasavvur qila olasizmi?

text: {r:Harvest}[ˈhɑːrvɪst] – hosil; hosil olmoq. Tasavvur qiling harbiylar Chirchiq yaqinidagi qishloqda {p:HARB}iy {p:EST}afeta musobaqalarini uyushtirishibdi. Tayinli joy topa olishmagan ekan birovning dalasida kartoshka hosilini ustida o’tkazishibdi va {h:hosilini} payhon qilishibdi.
examples: {r:They must be harvesting the crops now} - Ular hozir ekinlarni yig'ishtirishayotgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She can't have harvested all the apples alone} - U barcha olmalarni yolg'iz yig'ishtirgan bo'lishi mumkin emas.
{r:He must have harvested a lot of wheat this year} - U bu yili ko'p bug'doy yig'ishtirgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:They can't be harvesting in the rain} - Ular yomg'ir ostida ekin yig'ishtirishayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; juda ho'l.

text: {r:Sweep}[swiːp] – supurmoq. Mening buvim farroshlikda ham faxr bilan ishlagan. Ko’chalarni maza qilib {p:SEVIB} {h:supurganlar}. Eng muhimi halol rizq bilan yashaganlar.
examples: {r:She must be sweeping the floor} - U polni supurayotgan bo'lishi kerak; supurgi ovozini eshitayapman.
{r:He can't have swept the room} - U xonani supurgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u hali ham iflos.
{r:They must have swept the yard this morning} - Ular hovlini ertalab supurgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She can't be sweeping now} - U hozir supurmayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u uchrashuvda.

text: {r:Mop}[mɑːp] – artmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz bilgan {p:MAP}tun ertayu-kech pol {h:artadi}.
examples: {r:He must be mopping the kitchen} - U oshxonani artayotgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She can't have mopped the floor} - U polni artgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; pol hali ham kir.
{r:They must have mopped the hallway already} - Ular koridorni allaqachon artgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:He can't be mopping now} - U hozir artayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u tashqarida.

text: {r:Organize}[ˈɔːrɡənaɪz] – tashkillashtirmoq, organizatsiya qilmoq.
examples: {r:She must be organizing the event} - U tadbirni tashkil qilayotgan bo'lishi kerak; u juda band.
{r:He can't have organized the meeting} - U uchrashuvni tashkil qilgan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u bu yerda yangi.
{r:They must have organized the files by now} - Ular fayllarni hozirgacha tartibga solgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:It's difficult to organize the event if you have to combine several different teams.} - Agar siz bir nechta turli jamoalarni birlashtirishingiz kerak bo'lsa, tadbirni tashkil qilish qiyin.

text: {r:Greet}[ɡriːt] – salomlashmoq, so’rashmoq. Siz bitta o’zingiz yashaysiz va bitta it ham boqasiz. Kuningizni ertalab turib shu {p:KIR IT} bilan {h:salomlashishdan} boshlaysiz. Bequntligingizdan itingizni ham cho’miltirmagansiz.
examples: {r:He must be greeting the guests} - U mehmonlar bilan so'rashayotgan bo'lishi kerak; ovozlar eshitilayapti.
{r:She can't have greeted everyone} - U hamma bilan ko'rishib chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin emas; u hozirgina keldi.
{r:They must have greeted the visitors warmly} - Ular mehmonlarni iliq kutib olgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:They waited in a long row to greet the famous singer.} - Ular mashhur xonandani kutib olish uchun uzun qatorda turishdi.

text: {r:Define}[dɪˈfaɪn] – ta’riflamoq, aniqlamoq, belgilamoq.
examples: {r:He must be trying to define the problem clearly} - U muammoni aniq ta'riflashga harakat qilayotgan bo'lishi kerak, chunki u ko'p savollar beryapti.
{r:She can't have defined the terms correctly} - U shartlarni to'g'ri ta'riflagan bo'lishi mumkin emas; tushuntirishi chalkash.
{r:They must have defined their roles before starting the project} - Ular loyihani boshlashdan oldin o'z rollarini belgilagan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:He can't be defining the scope without consulting the team} - U jamoa bilan maslahatlashmasdan ko'lamni belgilayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas.

text:
{r:Contemporary}[kənˈtɛmpərəri] – o’sha davrning, zamonasining; zamondosh; zamonaviy. 
 1980 – yillarda Kanareyka qushining tana harorati 42 C ni tashkil etishi aniqlangan va jonivorlar orasida {p:KAN}areyka {p:TEMPER}atu{p:R}asi {h:zamonasining} eng yuqori harorati hisoblangan. Lekin 2000 – yillar boshida limurlarning tana harorati 43 C ekanligi ma’lum bo’ldi va kanareykalarning rekordini yangiladi.
examples: {r:This painting may have been created by a contemporary artist} - Bu rasm zamonaviy rassom tomonidan yaratilgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:She might have attended the contemporary art exhibition} - U zamonaviy san'at ko'rgazmasida qatnashgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:He must be a contemporary of my grandfather} - U mening bobomning zamondoshi bo'lishi kerak.
{r:They can't have ignored the contemporary trends} - Ular zamonaviy tendentsiyalarni e'tiborsiz qoldirgan bo'lishi mumkin emas.

text: {r:Specifically}[spəˈsɪfɪkli] – aynan, ayniqsa. Specific(aynan, muayyan) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:She may have specifically asked for this book} - U aynan ushbu kitobni so'ragan bo'lishi mumkin.

{r:They must have been specifically trained for this task} - Ular ushbu vazifa uchun maxsus tayyorlangan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:You should clarify a lot of things, specifically your purposes.} - Ko'p narsalarni aniqlashtirib olishing kerak, ayniqsa maqsadlaringni.

text: {r:Household}[ˈhaʊshoʊld] – uyga oid, domashniy; xo'jalik.
examples: {r:This tool may have been a common household item in the past} - Bu asbob o'tmishda keng tarqalgan uy-ro'zg'or buyumi bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:We have 111 households in our mahalla} - Mahallamizda 111 xo'jalik bor.
{r:Their household income might have decreased last year because of covid.} - O'tgan yili ularning oilaviy daromadi kovid tufayli pasaygan bo'lsa kerak.
{r:Cleaning a disgusting drain is one of the least favorite household tasks.} - Jirkanch drenajni tozalash uy ishlarining eng yoqimsizlaridan biridir.

text: {r:Achievement}[əˈtʃiːvmənt] – yutuq. Bu 'achieve' ning ot so’z turkumiga oid shakli.
examples: {r:She may have achieved her goal by now} - U hozirgacha o'z maqsadiga erishgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:He might have celebrated his achievement with his family} - U o'z yutuqlarini oilasi bilan nishonlagan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They must have recognized his achievement} - Ular uning yutuqlarini tan olgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She can't have ignored such a significant achievement} - U bunday muhim yutuqni e'tiborsiz qoldirmagandir.
{r:Her exceptional achievement earned her much honor.} - Uning ajoyib yutug'i unga katta sharaf keltirdi.

text: {r:Reverse}[rɪˈvɜːrs] – aks, zid, teskari; teskari aylantirmoq, o’girmoq. Siz tanigan {p:RIF}at {p:VERS}achi kiyib olibdi. Qimmat pulga olgan bo’lsa kerak. Lekin shu narsaga pul topibdiku lekin farosat topmabdi. {h:Teskari} tarafini kiyib olibdi. U o’ng bilan teskari tarafini farqiga bormaydi.
examples: {r:He gave a reverse description of the event, starting from the end.} – U voqeani oxiridan boshlab teskari tavsiflab berdi.
{r:They prescribed a treatment that could reverse the damage.} – Ular zararni qaytarishi mumkin bo‘lgan davolanishni belgilashdi.
{r:You think he is clever. But actually the reverse is true.} - Sen uni aqlli deb o'ylaysan. Aslida teskarisi to'g'ri.
{r:This coin has a bird image on the reverse.} - Bu tanganing teskari tarafida qushning rasmi bor.

text: {r:Bloom}[bluːm] – gullamoq, ochilmoq. Bahor bu yil shunchalar yashillika boy bo'ldiki hattoki {p:PULIM} ham {h:gullab} yubordi.
examples: {r:The flowers may have bloomed early this year} - Gullar bu yil erta ochilgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:She might have planted the seeds that are now blooming} - U hozir ochilayotgan urug'larni ekkan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They must have watered the plants regularly for them to bloom} - Ular gullar ochilishi uchun o'simliklarni muntazam sug'orishgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She can't have missed the blooming season} - U gullash mavsumini o'tkazib yuborgan bo'lishi mumkin emas.

text: {r:Melt}[mɛlt] – erimoq, eritmoq, yumshamoq. Sizga bezorilar miltiq bilan hujum qilishdi va siz shu payt o’zingizning sehrli qobiliyatingizni kashf etdingiz. Qo’lingizni ko’tarib {p:MILT}iqni {h:eritib} yubordingiz. Endi Bekoboddagi metal zavod sizni katta oylikka ishga olmoqchi u yerdagi temirlarni eritib berishingiz uchun.
examples: {r:The ice may have melted in the sun} - Muz quyoshda erigan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:She might have left the chocolate in the car, and it melted} - U shokoladni mashinada qoldirgan va u erigan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They must have used heat to melt the metal} - Ular metallni eritish uchun issiqlikdan foydalanishgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:He can't have melted the ice so quickly} - U muzni shu qadar tez eritgan bo'lishi mumkin emas.

text: {r:Crack}[kræk] – yoriq, darz; yormoq, darz ketmoq. Mening mashinamga Afrikaga sayohat qilganimda {p:KRAK}adil hujum qilgan va mashinamda {h:yoriq} va darzlar paydo bo’lgan.
examples: {r:The glass may have cracked due to the heat} - Shisha issiqlik tufayli yorilib ketgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:The customer might have dropped the vase, causing it to crack} - Mijoz vazani tushirib yuborgan va u darz ketgan bo'lishi mumkin.

{r:He can't have fixed the crack without tools} - U asboblarsiz yorilgan joyni tuzatgan bo'lishi mumkin emas.

text: {r:Forever}[fərˈɛvər] – bir umrga, butunlay. Agar {p:FOR}mula1 poygalari {p:EVER}est tog’larida o’tkazilsa {h:bir umrga} unutilmas voqea bo’lardi. Dunyoning eng baland cho’qqisida mashina poygalari.
examples: {r:Julia may have promised to love him forever} - Julia uni abadiy sevishga va'da bergan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:He might have thought the moment would last forever} - U bu lahza abadiy davom etadi deb o'ylagan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They must have believed their friendship would last forever} - Ular do'stliklari abadiy davom etadi deb ishongan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:A wise person knows that friendship can last forever.} - Dono odam do‘stlik abadiy davom etishini biladi.

text: {r:Honour}[ˈɑːnər] – shon, sharaf; sharaflamoq(amer. honor). {p:ANOR} dunyoning ko’plab xalqlari uchun qonni, kurashni va {h:shon-sharaf}ni bildiradi.
examples: {r:He may have been honoured for his contributions} - U o'z hissasi uchun mukofotlangan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:Rebecca might have attended the ceremony in his honour} - Rebekka uning sharafiga marosimda qatnashgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:It is an honour to work with you.} - Siz bilan ishlash sharaf.
{r:The event was held to promote and honour local artists.} - Tadbir mahalliy san'atkorlarni targ'ib qilish va ularni sharaflash uchun o'tkazildi.

text: {r:Wrap}[ræp] – o’ramoq. Men xullas ko’cha bolasiman, rep aytaman. {p:REP}larim bilan qizlarni {h:o’rab olaman}, yuragini o’g’irlayman.
examples: {r:She may have wrapped the skirt beautifully} - U yubkani chiroyli o'rab qo'ygan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:He might have forgotten to wrap the present} - U sovg'ani o'rab qo'yishni unutgan bo'lishi mumkin.

{r:She can't have wrapped the box so quickly} - U qutini shu qadar tez o'rab qo'ygan bo'lishi mumkin emas.

text: {r:Display}[dɪˈspleɪ] – ko'rsatmoq, namoyish qilmoq.
examples: {r:The museum may have displayed the artifacts recently} - Muzey yodgorliklarni yaqinda namoyish etgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:She might have visited the art display last week} - U o'tgan hafta san'at ko'rgazmasiga tashrif buyurgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They must have organized the display carefully} - Ular ko'rgazmani diqqat bilan tashkil qilishgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:The museum took great pleasure in putting its new acquisitions on display.} - Muzey yangi qo'lga kiritilgan narsalarni namoyish etishdan katta zavq oldi.

text: {r:Asset}[ˈæsɛt] – aktivlar. Qiziq, 'asset' so'zining o'zbekchasi aktivlar kundalik so'zlashuvda umuman ishlatilmaydi va 95% odamlar aktivlar nima ekanini bilishmaydi ham. Lekin ingliz tilida asset so'zi juda ko'p ishlatiladi. Iqtisodiyotga oid bu terminni siz uchun soddalashtirishga harakat qilaman. Aktivlar - inson, korxona, muassasa tomonidan egalik qilinadigan mol-mulk, pul mablag'lari, resurslari. Lekin asset ingliz tilida ko'pincha ko'chma ma'noda qo'llaniladi va 'kuchli tomon' ma'nosini bildiradi.
examples: {r:He may have considered the property as a valuable asset} - U mulkni qimmatli aktiv deb bilgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:She might have invested in assets for the future} - U kelajak uchun aktivlarga sarmoya kiritgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They must have recognized the importance of the asset} - Ular aktivning ahamiyatini tushungan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:Your consistency is your biggest asset} - Sening barqarorliging bu eng kuchli tomoning.
{r:My son is the biggest asset of our family} - O'g'lim oilamizning eng kuchli tomoni.

text: {r:Pray}[preɪ] – ibodat qilmoq. Siz ibodat qilishdan oldin {h:ibodatingiz} xushbo’y bo’lishi uchun xonaga s{p:PREY} sepib yuborasiz.
examples: {r:Sitora may have prayed for his recovery} - Sitora uning tuzalishi uchun duo qilgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:He might have forgotten to pray before the trip} - U safar oldidan duo qilishni unutgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They must have prayed together for success} - Ular muvaffaqiyat uchun birga duo qilishgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She can't have stopped praying during difficult times} - U qiyin paytlarda duo qilishni to'xtatgan bo'lishi mumkin emas.
{r:We can only pray that the construction team will stick to the new timetable.} - Biz faqat qurilish jamoasi yangi jadvalga rioya qilishini duo qilib so'ray olamiz.

text: {r:Barely}[ˈberli] – zo’rg’a, arang. Mana bu hashamatli uy bir kelgindiniki, yerli aholiniki emas. {p:BU YERLI}la {h:zo’rg’a} pastham uy solishyapti. Bu odam esa hashamatli qasr quribdi.
examples: {r:He may have barely passed the exam} - U imtihondan zo'rg'a o'tgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:She might have barely finished the project on time} - U loyihani vaqtida zo'rg'a tugatgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They may have barely survived the storm} - Ular bo'rondan zo'rg'a omon qolishgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:He might have barely noticed the changes} - U o'zgarishlarni zo'rg'a sezgan bo'lishi mumkin.

text: {r:Permit}[pərˈmɪt] – ruxsat bermoq; ruxsat; ruxsatnoma. Agar siz Shotlandiyalik erkak bo’lib yubka kiyib yursangiz Misrga borib {p:PIRAMID}a ko’rishga sizga {h:ruxsat} berilmaydi.
examples: {r:She may have forgotten to get a permit} - U ruxsatnoma olishni unutgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:He might have applied for the permit last week} - U o'tgan hafta ruxsatnoma uchun ariza topshirgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They must have obtained the permit before starting the construction} - Ular qurilishni boshlashdan oldin ruxsatnoma olgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:Did they permit you to discuss external affairs?} - Ular sizga tashqi ishlar haqida gapirishga ruxsat berishdimi?

text: {r:Priority}[praɪˈɒrəti] – muhim ish, prioritet. Agar siz praynik ishlab chiqaradigan biznesmen bo’lsangiz xoynahoy daromadingizni ko’paytirishni istasangiz kerak. Unda {p:PRAY}nikni {p:YORITI}ng ya’ni mahsulotingiz tovlanib tursin shunda ko’proq sotasiz. Biznesda eng {h:muhim ish} innovatsiyalar qilish.
examples: {r:Giving a quick reply should be your first priority} - Tez javob berish sizning ustuvor vazifangiz bo'lishi kerak.
{r:She might have ignored the priority list} - U ustuvorliklar ro'yxatini e'tiborsiz qoldirgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They must have discussed the priorities during the meeting} - Ular uchrashuv paytida ustuvor ishlarni muhokama qilishgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:He may have forgotten the priority of the project} - U loyihaning ustuvorligini unutgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:Customer satisfaction is our highest priority} - Mijozlarning qoniqishi bizning eng muhim ustuvor vazifamizdir.

text: {r:Request}[rɪˈkwɛst] – iltimos, talab; iltimos qilmoq(n/v). Men Hindistondan Riksha olib keltirdim va unda odam tashiyapman. Juda ko’p harakat qilganim uchun {p:RIK}sha haydab {p:VES} tashlayapman. Odamlarga o’zim {h:iltimos} qilyapman 'sizni eltib qo’yay pul ham olmayman' deb.
examples: {r:She may have submitted the request yesterday} - U so'rovni kecha topshirgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:Visitors are requested not to walk on the grass.} - Tashrif buyuruvchilardan o't ustida yurmaslik talab qilinadi.
{r:They must have approved the request quickly} - Ular so'rovni tez tasdiqlashgan bo'lishi kerak.
{r:We need a quick reply to our formal request.} - Rasmiy so'rovimizga tezkor javob kerak.
{r:Whenever you have a request, please let me know directly.} - Qachonki sizda qandaydir iltimos bo'lsa, menga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri xabar bering.

text: {r:Advance}[ədˈvɑːns] – oldinga siljimoq, harakatlanmoq; oldindan qilinadigan, oldindan. Bizning xalq qo’shiqlarini ijro etuvchi ansamblga sobiq advokat Ahmad aka rahbarlik qiladi. Sobiq {p:ADV}okat {p:ANS}amblni oddiy tuman folklor jamoasidan Respublika darajasidagi ansamblga aylantirdi. Mahmud aka bilan ancha {h:oldinga siljidik}.
examples: {r:He may have advanced to the next level} - U keyingi bosqichga o'tgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:The technology is still relatively new, but it is advancing quickly.} - Texnologiya hali nisbatan yangi, lekin u katta yutuqlarni ko'rsatmoqda.
{r:I gave you advance warnings.} - Men senga oldindan ogohlantirishlar bergandim.(advance bu yerda sifat)
{r:Accept my advance congratulations.} - Oldindan qutlovimni qabul qiling.(advance bu yerda sifat)
