[center][b]in advance - oldindan[/b][/center]
{r:We booked the tickets in advance.} - Biz chiptalarni oldindan band qildik.
{r:Please call me in advance if you can’t come.} - Kela olmasang, iltimos oldindan qo‘ng‘iroq qil.

text: {r:Disagree}[ˌdɪsəˈɡriː] - qarshi chiqmoq, qo'shilmaslik, kelishmaslik(kimningdir fikriga yoki qaroriga. Agree(qo'shilmoq, rozi bo'lmoq) so'zining teskarisi.)
examples: {r:She may have disagreed with the decision} - U qarorga qarshi chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:He might have expressed his disagreement politely} - U o'z noroziligini xushmuomala bildirgan bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:I disagree with you} - Men sizning fikringizga qo'shilmayman.
{r:He can't have disagreed without a valid reason} - U asossiz sababga ko'ra qarshi chiqqan bo'lishi mumkin emas.

text: {r:Approval}[əˈpruːvəl] – ma'qullash, tasdiq, qo'llab-quvvatlov. Approve(ma'qullamoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:You needn’t seek approval for small changes} - Kichik o'zgarishlar uchun tasdiq olishingiz shart emas.
{r:She didn't need to get approval} - U tasdiq olishi shart emas edi.
{r:They mustn’t give approval without reviewing the documents} - Ular hujjatlarni ko'rib chiqmasdan tasdiq bermasliklari kerak.
{r:He needn’t have asked for approval} - U tasdiq so'rashi shart emas edi; u allaqachon berilgan edi.
{r:We need the committee's approval for this recommendation to proceed.} - Bu tavsiyaning amalga oshishi uchun qo'mitaning tasdig'i kerak.

text: {r:Extremely}[ɪkˈstriːmli] – o'ta, juda, nihoyatda. O'zbek tilida qo'llaniladigan {p:ekstremalniy} so'zi shu so'zdan kelib chiqqan.
examples: {r:You don’t need to be extremely careful with this task} - Ushbu vazifa bilan juda ehtiyot bo'lishingiz shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have been extremely worried} - U juda tashvishlanishi shart emas edi; hammasi yaxshi bo'ldi.
{r:They mustn’t drive extremely fast in this residential area} - Ular bu turar-joy hududida juda tez haydamasliklari kerak.
{r:He didn't need to be extremely precise} - U juda aniq bo'lishi shart emas edi, shuning uchun tezda tugatdi.

text: {r:Greeting}[ˈɡriːtɪŋ] – salomlashish. Greet(salomlashmoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:I needn’t send a greeting card for every occasion} - Har bir tadbir uchun tabriknoma yuborishim shart emas edi.
{r:Greetings to our friends} - Do'stlarimizga salomlar!
{r:He extended his hand as a greeting} - U salomlashish uchun qo'lini cho'zdi.
{r:She didn't reply to my greeting} - U mening salomimga javob qaytarmadi.

text: {r:Scream}[skriːm] – baqirmoq, qichqirmoq. Mana bu vaziyatda telefonim ‘Tezroq zaryadkaga qo’y’ deb {h:baqirayotganini} {p:SKRIN}shot qilganman.
examples: {r:You needn’t scream to get customer's attention} - Mijoz e’tiborini jalb qilish uchun qichqirish shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have screamed so loudly} - U bunchalik baland qichqirishi shart emas edi; hamma uni eshitdi.
{r:Readers mustn’t scream inside the library} - O'quvchilar kutubxona ichida qichqirmasliklari kerak.
{r:He didn't need to scream for help} - U yordam so'rab qichqirishi shart emas edi, chunki kimdir allaqachon kelayotgan edi.

text: {r:Drag}[dræɡ] – tortmoq, sudramoq. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:D}amasga {p:REG}istonni bog’lab {h:sudrayapsiz.} Lekin baribir ham uni joyidan siljita olmadingiz. Agar futbolni tushunsangiz mashhur futbolchi {p:DRAG}bani nimadir {h:sudrab} ketayotganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:You don’t need to drag the heavy box alone} - Og'ir qutini yolg'iz sudrab olib borishingiz shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have dragged the chair} - U stulni sudrashi shart emas edi; kimdir yordam berishni taklif qildi.
{r:They mustn’t drag furniture across the wooden floor} - Ular yog'och pol bo'ylab mebelni sudrab yurmasliklari kerak.
{r:He didn't need to drag the conversation on} - U suhbatni cho'zishi shart emas edi, shuning uchun tezda tugatdi.

text: {r:Transform}[trænsˈfɔːrm] – tubdan o’zgartirmoq, tubdan o’zgarmoq. Bizning mahallamizdagi {p:TRANSFORM}ator oxirgi paytda yomg’ir yog’ib portlab ketganidan so’ng hokimiyat ishchilari tomonidan yangi qurildi va ko’rinish, dizayn, xavfsizligi {h:tubdan o’zgardi}.
examples: {r:You needn’t transform the entire plan} - Butun rejani o'zgartirish shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have transformed the room completely} - U xonani butunlay o'zgartirishi shart emas edi; bir nechta o'zgarishlar kifoya qilardi.
{r:How will you transform your message to get a better reply?} - Yaxshiroq javob olish uchun xabaringizni qanday o'zgartirasiz?
{r:He didn't need to transform his presentation} - U o'z taqdimotini o'zgartirishi shart emas edi; u allaqachon a'lo edi.

text: {r:Evolve}[ɪˈvɒlv] – rivojlanmoq, o’zgarmoq.
examples: {r:You don’t need to evolve the strategy immediately} - Strategiyani darhol o'zgartirishingiz shart emas.

{r:As society continues to evolve, people acquire new ways of learning and communicating} - Jamiyat rivojlanishda davom etar ekan, odamlar o'rganish va muloqot qilishning yangi usullarini o'rganadilar.
{r:They mustn’t stop trying to evolve their methods} - Ular o'z usullarini rivojlantirishga urinishni to'xtatmasliklari kerak.
{r:He didn't need to evolve his thinking on the subject} - U mavzu bo'yicha fikrini o'zgartirishi shart emas edi; uning dastlabki g'oyalari yaxshi edi.

text: {r:Shrink}[ʃrɪŋk] – qisqarmoq, kichraymoq, toraymoq. {p:Shurik} vaqtlar {h:torayishidan} foydalanib o’tmishga sayohat qila oladi.
examples: {r:You needn’t shrink the image size} - Rasm hajmini kichraytirish shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have shrunk the sweater so much} - U sviterni bunchalik kichraytirishi shart emas edi; u endi juda kichik.
{r:They mustn’t shrink the budget any further} - Ular byudjetni yanada qisqartirmasliklari kerak.
{r:He didn't need to shrink his expectations} - U o'z umidlarini kamaytirishi shart emas edi; loyiha yaxshi ketayotgan edi.
{r:It's difficult to imagine how small the universe would shrink if all matter collapsed.} - Agar barcha materiya qulab tushsa, koinot qanchalik kichrayishini tasavvur qilish qiyin.

text: {r:Suspect}[ˈsʌspɛkt] – shubha, gumon; gumonlanuvchi. Militsiya xodimlari jinoyatda gumonlanuvchi sifatida sizning og’ayningizni olib ketishibdi va birozdan so’ng qo’yib yuborishibdi. Siz esa unga tanbeh berdingiz “Albatta sendan {h:gumon} qilishadida, qara o’zingga {p:SASP KET}gansan, bomsh va jinoyatchilarga o’xshab qolibsan, og’ayni yuvinib yur”.
examples: {r:You needn’t suspect everyone around you} - Atrofingizdagi hammadan shubhalanish shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have suspected him} - U undan shubhalanishi shart emas edi; u boshidan beri aybsiz edi.
{r:They mustn’t suspect their colleagues without any evidence} - Ular hech qanday dalilsiz o'z hamkasblaridan shubhalanmasliklari kerak.
{r:He didn't need to suspect the stranger} - U begona odamdan shubhalanishi shart emas edi; u ishonchli ko'rinardi.
{r:The police began to suspect there was an external influence on the jury's decision.} - Politsiya hakamlar hay'ati qaroriga tashqi ta'sir bo'lganidan shubhalana boshladi.

text: {r:Unable}[ʌnˈeɪbəl] – qo’lidan kelmaydi, imkonsiz, qila olmaslik. Apple telefonlari(ayfon) shunchalik mustahkamki agar {p:AN}akonda {p:EPL}ni yutvorsa adashib telefonga hech {h:narsa qilmaydi}. Anakonda axlat chiqarganda qo’shilib chiqib kelaveradi.
examples: {r:The suspect is unable to hire a lawyer in advance.} - Gumonlanuvchi oldindan advokat yollay olmaydi. U kutishi kerak.
{r:She needn’t have worried about being unable to attend} - U qatnasha olmasligi haqida tashvishlanishi shart emas edi; uchrashuv bekor qilindi.
{r:The fighter is totally unable to gain strength after the knockdown} - Jangchi nokdaundan so'ng butunlay kuch yig'a olmayapti.
{r:I am simply unable to sleep} - Men shunchaki uxlay olmayman.

text: {r:Expense}[ɪkˈspɛns] – xarajat. Ekskavatorchi bo’lib pensiyaga chiqqanman. Pensiyam juda katta chunki ko’p soliq to’laganman, ko’p oylik olganman. Xullas {p:EKS}kavatorchining {p:PENS}iyasi barcha {h:xarajatlarni} qoplaydi.
examples: {r:You needn’t worry about the expense} - Xarajat haqida tashvishlanish shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have paid for the entire expense herself} - U butun xarajatni o'zi to'lashi shart emas edi.
{r:Despite the expense, the family found great pleasure in their annual vacation.} - Xarajatlarga qaramay, oila har yillik ta'tillaridan katta zavq oldi.
{r:He didn't need to submit an expense report for such a small amount} - U shunchalik kichik summa uchun xarajat hisobotini topshirishi shart emas edi.

text: {r:Arrest}[əˈrɛst] – arest, hibs; qamoqqa olish.
examples: {r:You needn’t fear arrest if you follow the rules} - Qoidalarga rioya qilsangiz, hibsdan qo'rqish shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have run away} - U qochishi shart emas edi; politsiya shunchaki savol bermoqchi edi.
{r:They mustn’t resist arrest} - Ular hibsga qarshilik ko'rsatmasliklari kerak, bu faqat vaziyatni yomonlashtiradi.
{r:He didn't need to worry about arrest} - U hibsdan tashvishlanishi shart emas edi, chunki uning isboti bor edi.

text: {r:Fade}[feɪd] – o'chmoq, so'nmoq. 2015 - yil Shahzoda va {p:FEYDI} 'Habibi' qo'shig'ini ommaga taqdim etishdi va tez orada bu qos'hiq butun dunyoda mashhur bo'lib ketdi. Chunki FEYDi oddiy qo'shiqchi emas balki Avstraliyalik mashhur xonanda edi. Lekin shu duetdan so'ng ikkalasining ham ijodiy faolligi {h:so'ndi}.
examples: {r:You don’t need to worry; colour will not fade easily.} - Tashvishlanish shart emas; rang osonlikcha o'chmaydi.
{r:She needn’t have tried to prevent the fabric from fading} - U matoning rang o'chishini oldini olishga urinishi shart emas edi; bu tabiiy jarayon.
{r:They mustn’t let the light fade on this important issue} - Ular bu muhim masala bo'yicha umidini so'ndirmasliklari kerak.
{r:He didn't need to fix the fading paint} - U o'chayotgan bo'yoqni tuzatishi shart emas edi, chunki u baribir qayta bo'yaladi.

text: {r:Schedule}[ˈʃɛdʒuːl] – jadval. Mana bu jadvalda hind aktrissasi {p:KEJL}(Kajol yoziladi) ning barcha ish {h:jadvali} bor.
examples: {r:You needn’t stick to the schedule strictly} - Jadvalga qattiq rioya qilish shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have changed her schedule} - U o'z jadvalini o'zgartirishi shart emas edi; dastlabki reja yaxshi edi.
{r:The subway runs on a very busy schedule.} - Metro juda tig'iz jadval bo'yicha ishlaydi.
{r:He didn't need to update the schedule} - U jadvalni yangilashi shart emas edi, chunki yangi o'zgarishlar yo'q edi.
{r:The tight schedule ensured the project stayed alive despite many challenges.} - Tig'iz jadval ko'plab qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, loyihaning tirik qolishini ta'minladi.

text: {r:Brief}[briːf] – qisqa. Siyosatchilar bilan bo’ladigan {p:BRIF}inglar aslida {h:qisqa} bo’lishi kerak bo’lsada bizning g’ayratli siyosatchilarimizning g’ayrati tufayli cho’zilib ketadi.
examples: {r:You needn’t make the presentation too brief} - Taqdimotni juda qisqa qilish shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have given a brief explanation} - U qisqa tushuntirish berishi shart emas edi; hamma uni yaxshi tushundi.
{r:They mustn’t give such a brief overview of the complex topic} - Ular murakkab mavzu bo'yicha bunchalik qisqa umumiy ma'lumot bermasliklari kerak.
{r:He doesn't need to write a brief summary} - U qisqa xulosa yozishi shart emas.
{r:Please keep your reply brief and to the point, as time is limited.} - Iltimos, vaqt cheklanganligi sababli javobingizni qisqa va aniq qoldiring.

text: {r:Purchase}[ˈpɜːrtʃəs] – sotib olmoq, xarid qilmoq. Men Qo’yliq bozorida chesnok sotaman. Bir kuni {p:PR}ezidentimiz {p:CHES}nok {h:sotib oldi} mendan. ‘Bozordagi vaziyatni, xalqning turmushini tekshiryapman’ dedilar ketayotib.(Namuna uchun yozildi)
examples: {r:You don’t need to make a purchase if you don’t need it} - Agar kerak bo'lmasa, xarid qilishingiz shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have purchased so many items} - U bunchalik ko'p narsalarni sotib olishi shart emas edi; ba'zilari keraksiz edi.
{r:You don't need to purchase a gift in advance. His birthday is after 3 months} - Oldindan sovg'a olishingiz shart emas. Hali uning tug'ilgan kuniga 3 oy bor.
{r:He didn't need to purchase a new car} - U yangi mashina sotib olishi shart emas edi; eskisi yaxshi edi.

text: {r:Steel}[stiːl] – po’lat. Siz bu vaziyatda {p:STIL}niy kiyinib olgan {h:Po’lat} Alendarni tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:You needn’t use steel for this project} - Ushbu loyiha uchun po'lat ishlatish shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have chosen steel} - U po'latni tanlashi shart emas edi; yengilroq material ham ish berardi.
{r:Steel factory owner is influencing the politics} - Po'lat fabrikasi egasi siyosatga ta'sir etyapti.
{r:He didn't need to order more steel} - U ko'proq po'lat buyurtma qilishi shart emas edi; ularda yetarlicha zaxira bor edi.

text: {r:Layer}[ˈleɪər] – qatlam, qavat. Universitetda o’qiysiz va tez-tez leksiyalarda qatnashasiz. Agar siz jamiyatning yuqori {h:qatlamidan} bo’lsangiz sizga chiroyli kreslo berishadi. Agar kambag’al qatlamidan bo’lsangiz {p:LEK}siyani {p:YER}da o’tirib tinglashingizga to’g’ri keladi. Yoki bu vaziyatda ozgina boshqacharoq namuna bersak ham bo’ladi. Agar siz birinchi qavatda leksiya tinglasangiz kresloda o’tirasiz, ikkinchi qavatdagi {p:LE}ksiyalar esa {p:YER}da tinglanadi.
examples: {r:You needn’t add another layer of paint} - Yana bir qatlam bo'yoq qo'shishing shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have applied an extra layer} - U qo'shimcha qatlam qo'llashi shart emas edi; birinchisi yetarli edi.
{r:They mustn’t skip any layer in the construction process} - Ular qurilish jarayonida hech qanday qatlamni o'tkazib yubormasliklari kerak.
{r:He didn't need to worry about the top layer getting damaged} - U eng yuqori qatlamning shikastlanishi haqida tashvishlanishi shart emas edi.

text: {r:Coin}[kɔɪn] – tanga. Mana mening antiqa {p:KO’YN}agim (ba’zi shevalarda ko’ylak shunday ataladi). {h:Tangalarni} ipga terilganidan qilingan.
examples: {r:You don’t need to collect every coin you find} - Topgan har bir tangani yig'ishingiz shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have bought that rare coin} - U o'sha noyob tangani sotib olishi shart emas edi; u soxta edi.
{r:They mustn’t use foreign coin in this vending machine} - Ular bu avtomatda xorijiy tanga ishlatmasliklari kerak.
{r:He didn't need to search for a specific coin} - U ma'lum bir tangani qidirishi shart emas edi; har qanday mayda pul kifoya qilardi.
{r:I don't have cash, I barely have these coins.} - Naqd pulim yo'q. Zo'rg'a mana shu tangalarim bor.

text: {r:Preserve}[prɪˈzɜːrv] – saqlamoq, ehtiyot qilmoq, asramoq. Amerika prezidenti Donald Tramp o’z hokimiyatini saqlab qolish uchun hamma narsaga tayyor. {p:PREZ}ident {p:ZO’RAV}onlikdan ham qaytmaydi hokimiyatini {h:saqlab} qolish uchun.
examples: {r:You needn’t preserve all the old documents} - Barcha eski hujjatlarni saqlash shart emas.
{r:She needn’t have preserved every tiny detail} - U har bir kichik tafsilotni saqlashi shart emas edi; asosiy fikrlar kifoya edi.
{r:They mustn’t forget to preserve the historical heritage of the city} - Ular shaharning tarixiy merosini saqlashni unutmasliklari kerak.
{r:They firmly decided to preserve their family traditions.} – Ular oilaviy an’analarini saqlab qolishga qat’iy qaror qilishdi.

text:
{r:Discourage}[dɪsˈkʌrɪdʒ] – biror ishdan qaytarmoq, umidsizlantirmoq. Encourage(ruhlantirmoq) so'zining teskarisi. 
 Ichib olganimda kallamga g’alati ideyalar keladi. Kecha eski {p:DISK}ni {p:KALISH} bilan urib maydalab yubormoqchi bo’libman. Yaxshiyamki do’stlarim {h:qaytarib qolibdi}.
examples: {r:You should have discouraged him from taking such risks} - Uni shunday xavfli qadamlar qo'yishdan qaytarishingiz kerak edi.

{r:The new safety features aim to discourage reckless driving and prevent a serious crash.} - Yangi xavfsizlik funksiyalari beparvo haydashni to'xtatish va jiddiy avariyaning oldini olishni maqsad qilgan.
{r:They should have discouraged Anvar from dropping out of university.} - Ular Anvarni universitetni tashlab ketishdan qaytarishlari kerak edi.
{r:The tough regulations are meant to discourage actions that threaten the environment.} - Qattiq qoidalar atrof-muhitga tahdid soluvchi harakatlarni to'xtatishga qaratilgan.

text: {r:Sparkle}[ˈspɑːrkəl] – yarqiramoq, tovlanmoq; tovlanish. Bizning eng yorqin milliy brendimiz qaysiligini bilasizmi? Menimcha bu spark. {p:SPARK KL}ometrlab uzoqlikdan ham {h:tovlanib} turadi.
examples: {r:You should have seen how her eyes sparkled with joy} - Uning ko'zlari qanday quvonch bilan yarqirashini ko'rishingiz kerak edi.
{r:Julia shouldn’t have ignored the sparkle in his eyes} - Julia uning ko'zlaridagi tovlanishni e'tiborsiz qoldirmasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should notice the sparkle of the diamonds} - Ular olmoslarning tovlanishini payqashlari kerak.
{r:Her eyes began to sparkle when she found a dress that would match her new shoes.} - Yangi poyabzallariga mos keladigan ko'ylak topganida uning ko'zlari porlay boshladi.
{r:Nargiza's eyes would sparkle every time her husband fulfilled her smallest request.} - Nargizaning eri uning bitta kichik iltimosini bajarsa ham Nargizaning ko'zlari har safar porlab ketardi.

text: {r:Childhood}[ˈtʃaɪldhʊd] – bolalik. Child(bola) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:You should have studied English since childhood} - Ingliz tilini bolalikdan o'rganishingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have forgotten her childhood friends} - U bolalikdagi do'stlarini unutmasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should share many childhood stories} - Ular ko'plab bolalik hikoyalari bilan bo'lishishlari kerak.
{r:During his childhood, he dreamed of a device that could make any task easier.} – Bolaligida u har qanday vazifani osonlashtiradigan qurilmani orzu qilgan.

text: {r:Goods}[ɡʊdz] – mahsulotlar, tovarlar. Do'konimda sport tovarlari sotaman. Yagona 'xodovoy' {h:tovarim} {p:BUTZ}ilar.
examples: {r:The store offers a wide variety of goods} - Do‘kon keng turdagi mahsulotlarni taklif qiladi.
{r:She bought some luxury goods during her trip} - U safar davomida ba’zi hashamatli mahsulotlarni sotib oldi.
{r:They exported agricultural goods to several countries} - Ular bir necha davlatga qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini eksport qilishdi.
{r:Many people prefer buying local goods} - Ko‘p odamlar mahalliy mahsulotlarni sotib olishni afzal ko‘radilar.

text: {r:Back}[bæk] – qo'llab-quvvatlamoq. Menimcha 'back' so'zi 'orqa' degan ma'noni bildirishini bilib bo'ldingiz. Bu so'zning inglizchada ramziy ma'noda 'qo'llab-quvvatlamoq', 'orqasida turib bermoq' ma'nosi ham bor. Qiziq tomoni o'zbek tilida ham shunga o'xshashlik kuzatiladi. Ya'ni 'orqasida turib bermoq' qo'llab-quvvatlamoq ma'nosini bildiradi.
examples: {r:She always backs her friends in tough situations} - U har doim do‘stlarini qiyin vaziyatlarda qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.
{r:They backed the candidate throughout the election} - Ular nomzodni butun saylov jarayonida qo‘llab-quvvatlashdi.
{r:He needs someone to back him during negotiations} - U muzokaralar davomida uni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydigan odamga muhtoj.
{r:The company backed his proposal for innovation} - Kompaniya uning innovatsiya taklifini qo‘llab-quvvatladi.

text: {r:Double}[ˈdʌbəl] – ikkitalik, dvoynoy; ikkitaga ko'paytirmoq, ikki baravar oshirmoq.
examples: {r:You should have doubled the recipe for the party} - Bazm uchun retseptni ikki baravar ko'paytirishingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have doubled the amount of sugar} - U shakarning miqdorini ikki baravar ko'paytirmasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should double their efforts to finish the project} - Ular loyihani tugatish uchun harakatlarini ikki baravar ko'paytirishlari kerak.
{r:He shouldn’t double the budget without approval} - U byudjetni ma'qullashsiz ikki baravar ko'paytirmasligi kerak.

text: {r:Occupy}[ˈɒkjupaɪ] – egallamoq. Tasavvur qiling dengiz baliqlari olamida telefon aloqasi uzilib qolibdi. {p:AKU}lalar {p:PAY}netni {h:egallab} olibdi tezroq muammoni bartaraf etishni talab qilib.
examples: {r:You should have occupied the front seats} - Oldingi o'rindiqlarni egallashingiz kerak edi.
{r:My neighbour shouldn’t have occupied the parking spot for so long} - Qo'shnim parkovka joyini uzoq vaqt egallamasligi kerak edi.
{r:It's difficult to convince someone to occupy a position with so much responsibility.} - Bunday katta mas'uliyatli lavozimni egallashga kimnidir ko'ndirish qiyin.
{r:My cousins shouldn’t occupy the room without permission} - Xolavachchalarim ruxsatsiz xonani egallamasligi kerak.
{r:I will occupy your time for only a brief moment to explain the new policy.} - Yangi siyosatni tushuntirish uchun vaqtingizni faqat qisqa vaqtga olaman.

text: {r:Abandon}[əˈbændən] – voz kechmoq, tashlamoq, tark etmoq. Biz hammamiz tanigan Afandi unchalik ham oliyjanob va mard emas ekan. {p:APANDI ON}asini qariyalar uyiga {h:tashlab} o'zi chet elga ketib qolibdi.
examples: {r:You should have abandoned the plan earlier} - Siz rejadan oldinroq voz kechishingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have abandoned her responsibilities} - U o'z mas'uliyatlaridan voz kechmasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should abandon the old methods forever} - Ular eski usullaridan bir umrga voz kechishlari kerak.
{r:He shouldn’t abandon the project without a reason} - U loyihani sababsiz tashlamasligi kerak.
{r:After waiting for weeks, he decided to abandon hope for a reply to his letter.} - Haftalar davomida kutgandan so'ng, u maktubiga javob olish umididan voz kechishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Skip}[skɪp] – qoldirmoq, bormay qolmoq, o’tkazib yubormoq. Konservatoriyada maza qilib o’qiyapman lekin bitta shu skripka darslari yoqmaydi. G’o’ngillagan tovushini eshitmaslik uchun har bitta {p:SKRIP}ka darsini {h:o’tkazib yuboraman}.
examples: {r:You should have skipped specifically the unnecessary details} - Aynan keraksiz tafsilotlarni o'tkazib yuborishingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have skipped the important meeting} - U muhim uchrashuvni o'tkazib yubormasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should skip breakfast to save time} - Ular vaqt tejash uchun nonushtani o'tkazib yuborishlari kerak.
{r:How many times did you skip lessons?} - Necha marta dars qoldirding?

text: {r:Spin}[spɪn] – aylantirmoq. Hozirgi kunda ko'pchilik orasida mashhur bo'lgan {p:spin}ner o'yinchog'i aynan mana shu so'zdan olingan.
examples: {r:You should have spun the wheel more carefully} - G'ildirakni ko'proq ehtiyotkorlik bilan aylantirishingiz kerak edi.
{r:The washing device began to spin faster than usual} – Kir yuvish qurilmasi odatdagidan tezroq aylanib ketdi.
{r:The Earth spins around the Sun} - Yer quyosh atrofida aylanadi.

{r:The yoga instructor showed us how to spin and stretch our spines for better flexibility.} - Yoga o'qituvchisi bizga egiluvchanlikni oshirish uchun umurtqa pog'onamizni aylantirish va cho'zishni ko'rsatdi.

text: {r:Suppose}[səˈpoʊz] – taxmin qilmoq, faraz qilmoq, chamalamoq. Mana bu sapog haqiqiy teridan qilingan ekan, tikilishi ham juda mustahkam. Dadam buni bozordan naqd 600$ sotib olibdi. Men bu {p:SAPOG}ni {p:UZ}masdan 10 yil kiyolsam kerak deb {h:taxmin qilyapman}.
examples: {r:You should have supposed that he would be late} - Uning kechikishini taxmin qilishingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have supposed the worst without evidence} - U dalilsiz eng yomonini taxmin qilmasligi kerak edi.
{r:I suppose his habit of tapping his pen is meant to annoy me deliberately.} - Menimcha, uning ruchkasini chertish odati meni ataylab bezovta qilishga mo'ljallangan.
{r:We all supposed him to be German, but actually he was Italian} - Biz hammamiz uni nemis deb taxmin qilgan edik, lekin u italyan ekan.

text: {r:Evaluate}[ɪˈvæljueɪt] – baholamoq, hisoblamoq, o’rganib chiqmoq. Siz ukangizga aytyapsiz “Sen qanchadan-qancha sindirilgan, ushalgan nonlarni tashlab yuboribsan. {p:UVOL UYAT} ukajonim. Sen oila byudjetiga bu uvol bilan qancha zarar keltirganingni {h:hisoblab chiqaman} va oyligingdan olib qolaman”.
examples: {r:You should have evaluated the risks more carefully} - Xavflarni ehtiyotkorlik bilan baholashingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have evaluated the situation so quickly} - U vaziyatni shu qadar tez baholamasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should evaluate all the options before deciding} - Ular qaror qilishdan oldin barcha variantlarni o'rganib chiqishi kerak.
{r:We need to evaluate all external factors before making a decision.} - Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin barcha tashqi omillarni hisoblashimiz kerak.

text: {r:Memorize}[ˈmɛməraɪz] – yodlamoq. Memory(xotira) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:You were unable to memorize the important details} - Muhim tafsilotlarni yodlab ololmading.
{r:She shouldn’t have memorized the wrong information} - U noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarni yod olmasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should memorize the entire script} - Ular butun matnni yod olishlari kerak.
{r:It's difficult to memorize all the external rules.} - Barcha tashqi qoidalarni yodlash qiyin.

text: {r:Applause}[əˈplɔːz] – qarsak, olqish. Tasavvur qiling har safar {h:qarsak} chalganingizdan so'ng qo'llaringiz {p:IPLOS} bo'lib qoladi.
examples: {r:You must have enjoyed their applause} - Ularning olqishidan maza qilgan bo'lsang kerak.
{r:She shouldn’t have ignored the audience’s applause} - U tomoshabinlarning olqishlarini e'tiborsiz qoldirmasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should receive a lot of applause} - Ular ko'plab olqishlar olishlari kerak.
{r:The crowd’s applause grew when the players approached the gate} – O‘yinchilar darvozaga yaqinlashganda, olomonning qarsaklari kuchaydi.

text:
{r:Frown}[fraʊn] – qovog’ini solmoq, qovog'ini solib jahlini ko'rsatmoq. 
Bu vaziyatda Musa alayhisalomga {h:qovog’ini solib} uning faoliyatini yoqtirmagan {p:FIRAVN} haqida tasavvur qiling. Agar Firavn va Musa alayhisalom haqidagi rivoyatni bilmasangiz shunchaki sizga qovog’ini solgan Firavn haqida tasavvur qiling(Misrning qadimgi podshohlari Firavn deyilgan).
examples: {r:You should have noticed her frown during the meeting} - Uchrashuv paytida uning qovog'ini solganini payqashingiz kerak edi.
{r:Julia shouldn’t have frowned at his suggestion} - Julia uning taklifiga jahli chiqmasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should frown upon the decision} - Ular qarorni ma’qullamasliklari kerak.
{r:The smell of the rotten food made her frown in a truly disgusting way} - Buzilgan ovqatning hidi uni chinakam jirkanch tarzda qovog'ini solishga majbur qildi.

text: {r:Collapse}[kəˈlæps] - qulamoq, yiqilmoq, ag'darilmoq; qulash. {p:KOL}basani {p:LEPS} reklama qilayotgan ekan reklama maydonchasida {h:qulab tushibdi}. Kim u Leps deysizmi? Grigoriy Leps mashhur Rossiyalik qo'shiqchi.
examples: {r:The old building could collapse at any moment if there's a strong earthquake} - Kuchli zilzila bo'lsa, eski bino har qanday lahzada qulashi mumkin.
{r:A lot of businesses collapsed during the recent crisis} - Yaqindagi krizis davomida juda ko'p bizneslar quladi.
{r:You should have seen the collapse of the bridge after the storm} - Bo'rondan keyin ko'prikning qulashini ko'rishingiz kerak edi.
{r:Without countries cooperating, the agreement could collapse.} – Davlatlar hamkorlik qilmasa, kelishuv buzilishi mumkin.

text: {r:Whistle}[ˈwɪsəl] – hushtak; hushtak chalmoq. Qishloqda qizlar va yigitlar uchrashib yurolmasdi bizning yoshlik paytlarimizda. Yaxshi ko'rgan qizim bilan uchrashgan paytim yosh bolalar ko'rib qolsa {h:hushtak} chalardi {p:VISOL} onlarimni beliga tepib.
examples: {r:You should have whistled to get their attention} - Ular e'tiborini jalb qilish uchun hushtak chalishingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have whistled during the performance} - U ijro paytida hushtak chalmasligi kerak edi.
{r:She can virtually whistle for hours without stopping} - U deyarli soatlab to‘xtamasdan hushtak chalishi mumkin.
{r:Whistling is considered rude these days} - Hozirgi kunlarda hushtak chalish qo'pollik hisoblanadi.

text:
{r:Edit}[ˈɛdɪt] – tahrirlamoq, tuzatmoq, montaj qilmoq. 
 Tasavvur qiling siz {p:ADID}as kompaniyasida {h:tahrirlovchi} inson sifatida ishlaysiz. Agar kiyimlarga Adidos yoki Abibas deb adashib yozib qo'yishsa ularni tahrirlab xatolarni tuzatib chiqasiz.
examples: {r:You should have edited the document more carefully} - Hujjatni ehtiyotkorlik bilan tahrirlashingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have edited the photos without permission} - U ruxsatsiz fotosuratlarni tahrirlamasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should edit the video before publishing it} - Ular videoni nashr etishdan oldin montaj qilishlari kerak.

{r:The final version of the movie had an incredible amount of special effects, because of careful editing.} - Filmning yakuniy versiyasi ehtiyotkorlik bilan montaj qilinishi tufayli ko'p miqdordagi maxsus effektlarga ega edi.

text: {r:Bake}[beɪk] – non yopmoq, pishirmoq(duxobka yoki tandirda). Tasavvur qiling {p:BEK}xem Angliyadan O’zbekistonga kelib non {h:yopish} ishi bilan shug’ullanyapti ekan. Agar Bekxemni tanimasangiz har qanday Bekzod yoki Begalini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:You should have baked the cake longer} - Tortni uzoqroq pishirishingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have baked the cookies at such a high temperature} - U pechenelarni shu qadar yuqori haroratda pishirmasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should bake the bread fresh this morning} - Ular nonni ertalab yangi pishirishlari kerak.
{r:He shouldn’t bake the pie without following the recipe} - U retseptga amal qilmasdan pirog pishirmasligi kerak.

text: {r:Earnings}[ˈɜːrnɪŋz] – daromad, topish-tutish. G’alati bir to’yga bordim. To’ydagi {p:O’RNINGIZ} {h:topish-tutishingiz}ga bog’liq ekan. Qari-qari chollarni pastga o’tqazib 20 yoshli bolalarni to’rga olib chiqib qo'yishyapti.
examples: {r:You should have saved more from your earnings} - Daromadingizdan ko'proq tejashingiz kerak edi.
{r:She shouldn’t have spent all her earnings on unnecessary things} - U barcha daromadini keraksiz narsalarga sarflamasligi kerak edi.
{r:They should increase their earnings this year} - Ular bu yili daromadlarini oshirishlari kerak.
{r:She was sincere about her small earnings, adding that extra work was optional} – U kichik daromadlari haqida samimiy gapirib, qo‘shimcha ish ixtiyoriy ekanini qo‘shimcha qildi.

text: {r:Prayer}[preər] – namoz, duo, iltijo. Turkiya prezidenti Erdog’an eng dindor prezidentlardan biridir. Mamlakatning to’g’ri yo’lda rivojlanishi uchun {p:PRE}zident {p:YER}ga boshini qo’yib {h:namoz} o’qiydi va Xudodan o’z davlati farovonligini so’raydi.
examples: {r:You’d better say a prayer before the exam} - Imtihondan oldin duo qilsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:She’d better not forget her morning prayer} - U ertalabki ibodatini unutmasa yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time he recognized the importance of prayer} - U ibodatning ahamiyatini tan olishining vaqti keldi.
{r:After the divorce, she took a deep breath and made a silent prayer} – Ajralishdan keyin u chuqur nafas olib, sokin duo qildi.

text: {r:Definition}[ˌdɛfɪˈnɪʃən] – ta’rif, izoh. {p:DEP}utatlar {p:NISHON} bilan taqdirlab yotibdi bir-birini Oliy majlisda hech qanday {h:ta’rif va izohsiz}.
examples: {r:You’d better look up the definition of the word} - So'zning ta'rifini izlab ko‘rsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:True pleasure, by definition, comes from internal peace, not from material possessions.} - Haqiqiy zavq, ta'rifi bo‘yicha, moddiy narsalardan emas, balki ichki xotirjamlikdan keladi.
{r:They’d better not misunderstand the definition} - Ular ta'rifni noto‘g‘ri tushunmasalar yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time she paid attention to the definition in the textbook} - U darslikdagi izohga e’tibor berishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Initiative}[ɪˈnɪʃətɪv] – initsiativa, tashabbus. O‘xshash so‘zlar!
examples: {r:You’d better take the initiative in this project} - Ushbu loyihada tashabbus ko‘rsatsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time for us to show some initiative} - Tashabbus ko‘rsatish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better appreciate her initiative} - Ular uning tashabbusini qadrlasalar yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time he realized the importance of taking initiative} - U tashabbus ko‘rsatishning ahamiyatini tushunishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Occupation}[ˌɒkjʊˈpeɪʃən] – kasb, ish; egallab olish. Tasavvur qiling siz hozir urush maydonidasiz. Qiladigan {h:ishingiz} {p:OKOP}lardan {p:SHN}ur o‘tkazish. Okop bu urush maydonlarida qazilgan chuqurliklar.
examples: {r:You’d better find a suitable occupation} - Mos kasb topsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time for him to choose an occupation} - U uchun kasb tanlash vaqti keldi.
{r:She’d better change her occupation soon} - U kasbini tez orada o‘zgartirsa yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:He works solely as an artist, it's his only occupation.} - U faqat rassom bo‘lib ishlaydi, bu uning yagona kasbi.

text: {r:Mood}[muːd] – kayfiyat. Agar mashinalarni {p:MUD}datli to‘lovga hech qanday foizlarsiz berishsa odamlarning {h:kayfiyati} ko‘tarilib ketadi.
examples: {r:You’d better not disturb Nigora, her mood is extremely bad} - Nigorani bezovta qilmasangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi; uning kayfiyati juda yomon.
{r:It’s time to improve your mood} - Kayfiyatingizni yaxshilash vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better notice his cheerful mood} - Ular uning quvnoq kayfiyatini payqasalar yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:He had a cheerful smile on his face, indicating his mood.} - Uning yuzida xushchaqchaq tabassum bor edi, bu uning kayfiyatini ko‘rsatardi.

text: {r:Ink}[ɪŋk] – siyoh. Televizorda reklama qilinayotgan {p:ENG}elberg eshiklarining yaxshi tomoni agar chang yoki {h:siyoh} tegib ketsa ham {p:ENG}elberg ularni o‘ziga yutib olib top-toza bo‘lib turaveradi.
examples: {r:You’d better refill the ink in the printer} - Printerga siyoh qo‘ysangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to buy new ink for the pen} - Qalam uchun yangi siyoh sotib olish vaqti keldi.
{r:The artist could imagine the entire painting in his head before putting any ink to paper.} - Rassom qog‘ozga siyoh tushirishdan oldin butun rasmini boshida tasavvur qila olardi.
{r:It is time he paid attention to the low ink warning} - U siyoh kamligi haqidagi ogohlantirishga e’tibor berishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Reduce}[rɪˈdjuːs] – kamaymoq. Oxirgi paytlarda rediskani ham issiqxonada yetishtirishyapti. Issiqxonada qo‘shimcha issiqlikni ta’minlash va xarajatlarni {h:kamaytirmoqchi} bo‘lsangiz tepadan {p:red}iskaga {p:dyus}el lampochkalarini ilib qo‘ying. Dyusel chiroqlari ham issiqlik ham yorug‘lik bilan ta’minlaydi.
examples: {r:Initially, you’d better reduce your expenses} - Dastlab xarajatlaringizni kamaytirsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to reduce the amount of sugar in your diet} - Dietangizdagi shakar miqdorini kamaytirish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better reduce the price of the product} - Ular mahsulot narxini kamaytirishsa yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time she recognized the need to reduce waste} - U chiqindilarni kamaytirish zarurligini tan olishining vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Helmet}[ˈhɛlmɪt] – kaska. Tasavvur qiling {p:HOLMAT} ismli tanishingiz har doim {h:kaska} kiyib yuradi hatto uxlaganda ham, ovqatlanganda ham. U kaskani yechmaydi.
examples: {r:You’d better wear a helmet while riding the bike} - Velosiped haydashda kaska kiysangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to replace your old helmet} - Eski kaskangizni almashtirish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better not forget their helmets at home} - Ular kaskalarini uyda unutmasalar yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time he acknowledged the safety benefits of a helmet} - U kaskaning xavfsizlik foydalarini tan olishining vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Advisable}[ədˈvaɪzəbəl] – tavsiyali, maslahat qilingan. Advise (maslahat bermoq) so‘zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It's advisable to track every small expense when planning a trip abroad.} - Chet elga sayohatni rejalashtirayotganda har bir kichik xarajatni kuzatsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to consider the advisable options} - Maslahat berilgan variantlarni ko‘rib chiqish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better choose the most advisable solution} - Ular eng tavsiya etilgan yechimni tanlashsa yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time she followed the advisable precautions} - U maslahat berilgan ehtiyot choralariga amal qilishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Vital}[ˈvaɪtl] – muhim, zarur. Tasavvur qiling hayotingizda eng iqtisodiy qiynalgan paytingiz hovlingizda xojatxona uchun chuqur qaziyotib bir ko‘za oltin topib oldingiz. ‘{p:VAY TIL}la, aynan shu narsa {h:zarur} edi menga hozir’ dedingiz.
examples: {r:You’d better focus on the vital tasks first} - Avval muhim vazifalarga e’tibor qilsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to address the vital issues} - Muhim masalalarni hal qilish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better understand the vital importance of the project} - Ular loyihaning muhimligini tushunishsa yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time he considered the vital details} - U muhim tafsilotlarni ko‘rib chiqishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Rent}[rɛnt] – ijara; ijaraga olmoq; ijaraga bermoq. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:RENT}gen apparatini {h:ijaraga} berib daromad qilasiz.
examples: {r:You’d better pay the rent on time or in advance} - Ijara haqini vaqtida yoki oldindan to‘lasangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to negotiate the rent with the landlord} - Uy egasi bilan ijara haqini muhokama qilish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better increase the rent carefully} - Ular ijarani ehtiyotkorlik bilan oshirishsa yaxshi bo‘lardi (uy egasi haqida gapirilmoqda).
{r:They decided to rent an apartment for a year.} - Ular bir yilga kvartira ijaraga olishga qaror qilishdi.

text: {r:Landlord}[ˈlændlɔːrd] – uy egasi. Xonadon ijaraga berilganda egasi 'landlord', ijarachi esa 'tenant' deyiladi.
examples: {r:You’d better inform the landlord about the repairs} - Ta’mirlash haqida uy egasiga xabar bersangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to discuss the lease with the landlord} - Uy egasi bilan shartnomani muhokama qilish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better contact the landlord in advance} - Ular uy egasi bilan oldindan bog‘lansa yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time he followed the landlord’s instructions} - U uy egasining ko‘rsatmalariga amal qilishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Notice}[ˈnoʊtɪs] – sezmoq, payqamoq; e'lon. Pianino chalganingizda {p:NOTAYIZ} uchib havoga ko‘tarilayotganini {h:sezganmisiz?}
examples: {r:I have noticed changes in your character} - Xulqingizda o'zgarishlarni sezdim.
{r:I have noticed something strange behind the gate} - Darvozani orqasida qandaydir g'alati narsani sezdim.
{r:It’s time to read the notice on the board} - Doskadagi e’loni o‘qish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better not miss the notice about the meeting} - Ular yig‘ilish haqidagi e’loni o‘tkazib yubormasalar yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time she paid attention to the notice from the school} - U maktabdan kelgan e’lonlarga e’tibor berishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Fault}[fɔːlt] – xato. Folbin menga 3 yil ichida boyib ketishimni aytgandi. Mana 9 yil o‘tdi, boyib ketganim yo‘q. {p:FOL} {h:xato} ekan.
examples: {r:You’d better admit your fault} - Xatoyingizni tan olsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to fix the fault in the system} - Tizimdagi xatoni tuzatish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better identify the fault already} - Ular xatoni allaqachon aniqlashsa yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time he acknowledged the fault in the report} - U hisobotdagi xatoni tan olishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Descend}[dɪˈsɛnd] – pastga tushmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz tog‘ tepasida yashaysiz, nevaralaringiz pastda. Siz har kuni {p:DESERT} tayyorlab {h:pastga tushib} nevaralaringizga berasiz.
examples: {r:You’d better descend the stairs carefully} - Zinadan ehtiyotkorlik bilan tushsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to descend to the lower level} - Pastki qavatga tushish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better descend the mountain safely} - Ular tog‘dan xavfsiz tushishsa yaxshi bo'lardi.
{r:It is time she recognized the steepness of the descent} - U tushishning tikligini tan olishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Hike}[haɪk] – piyoda sayr. Do‘stlaringiz bilan {h:piyoda sayr qilyapsiz.} Yo‘lning yarmida {p:HAYK}al ham sizga qo‘shilib ketdi.
examples: {r:You’d better prepare well for the hike} - Sayrga yaxshi tayyorlansangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to start the hike before it gets dark} - Qorong‘u bo‘lishidan oldin sayrni boshlash vaqti keldi.
{r:Many teenagers want to take part in the summer hike.} – Ko‘plab o‘smirlar yozgi piyoda sayrda qatnashishni xohlashadi.
{r:It is time he considered the difficulty of the hike} - U sayrning qiyinligini ko‘rib chiqishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Shiver}[ˈʃɪvər] – titramoq, qaltiramoq. Yashil {p:SHIFR} panjarasi odamlarni {h:titrashiga} sabab bo‘lmoqda.
examples: {r:You’d better wear a jacket; You are shivering} - Kurtka kiysangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi; titrayapsiz.
{r:It’s time to warm up; I am shivering} - Isinish vaqti keldi; titrayapman.
{r:They’d better not shiver from fear} - Ular qo'rquvdan qaltiramasalar yaxshi bo'lardi.
{r:It is time she overcame the shiver of fear} - U qo‘rquv titrashini yengishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Confess}[kənˈfɛs] – tan olmoq, iqror bo‘lmoq. Men aybimga {h:iqror bo’lmoqchiman}. Kecha {p:KAN}yaklar {p:FEST}ivalida ichimlik tekin bo’lgani uchun bo’kib ichdim 10 litr konyak. Ertansi kuni esa 9 litr konyak qusdim.
examples: {r:You’d better confess your mistake} - Xatoyingizni tan olsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to confess the truth} - Haqiqatni tan olish vaqti keldi.
{r:He will finally confess to his lies.} - U nihoyat yolg'onlariga iqror bo'ladi.
{r:It is time he confessed to his crimes} - U jinoyatlariga iqror bo‘lishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Announce}[əˈnaʊns] – e’lon qilmoq. Bu yil Qozog’iston un eksport qilmayapti bizga. Shuning uchun davlatimizda keskin un taqchilligi kuzatilyapti. Mening qandolatchi {p:ENA}m {p:UNS}izlikka qarshi kurashishini va bu holatga chidab bo’lmasligini {h:e’lon qildi}. Almatiga borib Qozog’iston prezidenti bilan gaplashib ham kelmoqchi.
examples: {r:You’d better announce specifically this news} - Aynan shu yangilikni e’lon qilsangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It’s time to announce the winner} - G‘olibni e’lon qilish vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better announce the results in advance} - Ular natijalarni oldindan e’lon qilsalar yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:The coach was about to announce the new training regimen.} - Murabbiy yangi mashg‘ulot rejimini e’lon qilish arafasida edi.

text: {r:Hug}[hʌɡ] – quchoqlamoq. Do’konlarning hech birida pampers qolmabdi chaqalog’im uchun. Oxiri bitta do’konning skladida bir dona {p:HAG}GIS nomli pampers qolibdi. Hozir kak raz haggisni televizorda ham rosa reklama qilyapti. Xursandligimdan do’kon egasini {h:quchoqlab} olibman.
examples: {r:You’d better give her a hug} - Uni quchoqlasangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi; u xafa ko‘rinadi.
{r:It’s time to hug your loved ones} - Yaqinlaringizni quchoqlash vaqti keldi.
{r:They’d better hug each other after the reunion} - Ular uchrashuvdan keyin quchoqlashsa yaxshi bo‘lardi.
{r:It is time he showed affection with a hug} - U mehrini quchoqlash bilan ko‘rsatishi vaqti keldi.

text: {r:Overall}[ˌoʊvərˈɔːl] – hammasi bo’lib, umumiy. Men do’stlarim bilan har oy ovchilikka chiqib turaman. Bizning bir qiziq odatimiz bor. Bizda {p:OV ROL}iklarda amalga oshiriladi va tez roliklarni haydab tezroq harakatlana olganimiz tufayli {h:hammasi bo’lib} 40 dan ortiq o’rdak tutamiz.
examples: {r:I would love to see the overall progress of the project} - Loyihaning umumiy rivojlanishini ko'rishni xohlar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t agree with the overall decision} - U umumiy qarorga rozi bo'lmasdi.
{r:They would have considered the overall impact} - Ular umumiy ta'sirni hisobga olishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:He wouldn't have ignored the overall plan} - U umumiy rejani e'tiborsiz qoldirmagan bo'lar edi.
{r:Overall, everything is good} - Umuman olganda hammasi yaxshi.

text: {r:Similarity}[ˌsɪmɪˈlærɪti] – o'xshashlik. Similar(o'xshash) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I would notice the similarity between the two paintings} - Ikki rasm o'rtasidagi o'xshashlikni payqar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t find any similarity in their stories} - U ularning hikoyalarida hech qanday o'xshashlik topmasdi.
{r:They would have discussed the similarity in detail} - Ular o'xshashlikni batafsil muhokama qilishgan bo'lar edi.

{r:You can observe a clear similarity between the two and see they are somewhat similar.} - Ikkalasi o'rtasida aniq o'xshashlikni kuzatishingiz va ularning birmuncha o'xshash ekanligini ko'rishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:Stuck}[stʌk] – qolib ketmoq, chiqib ketolmaslik. Aslida bu so'z stick(yopishmoq) ning 3 - zamon shakli. Tirbandlikda qolib ketish, majlisda ushlanib qolish, qaysidir vaziyatdan chiqolmay qolib ketish holatlarida majoziy ma'noda ingliz tili so'zlashuvchilari 'yopishib qoldim' deyishadi(to be stuck). Tasavvur qiling {p:Stak}an shahar aylanish uchun mashinada ko'chaga chiqibdi va tirbandlikda {h:qolib ketibdi}.
examples: {r:I would help you if I weren’t stuck in traffic} - Tirbandlikda qolmasam, sizga yordam berar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t stay stuck in this situation for long} - U bu vaziyatda uzoq vaqt qolmasdi.
{r:They would have gotten stuck in the meeting} - Ular uchrashuvda qolib ketishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:Hold on, I am fully stuck in a traffic jam.} - Kutib tur, men butunlay probkada qolib ketdim.
{r:The key got stuck in the lock, and we couldn't open the door for hours.} - Kalit qulfga tiqilib qoldi va biz eshikni bir necha soat davomida ocha olmadik.

text: {r:Damn}[dæm] – la'nati(slang so'z). Mening akam Damas olish uchun kredit rasmiylashtirgandi. Hozir esa kreditni qaytarishga qiynalyapti va har safar 'Bu {h:la'nati} {p:DAM}as boshga balo bo'ldi' deyapti.
examples: {r:I would never say such a damn thing} - Men hech qachon bunday la'nati narsa demasdim.
{r:She wouldn’t use such damn language in public} - U jamoat joylarida bunday la'nati so'zlarni ishlatmasdi.
{r:They would have been damn tired after the trip} - Ular safardan keyin dahshat charchagan bo'lar edi.
{r:Damn, my fuel has finished.} - La'nati, yoqilg'im tugab qoldi.

text: {r:Mine}[maɪn] – qazib olmoq. 'Mine' qazilma boyliklariga nisbatan ishlatilganda 'qazib olmoq' ma'nosini bildiradi.
examples: {r:They would mine gold from deep underground} - Ular yer ostidan oltin qazib olgan bo'lar edilar.
{r:He would use specialized equipment to mine coal} - U ko'mir qazib olish uchun maxsus uskunalardan foydalangan bo'lar edi.
{r:Many workers would mine precious stones in dangerous conditions} - Ko'plab ishchilar xavfli sharoitlarda ham qimmatbaho toshlarni qazib olgan bo'lar edilar.
{r:Foreign countries want to mine our gold forever.} - Chet davlatlar bizning oltinimizni bir umr qazib olishni xohlaydi.

text:
{r:Forgive}[fərˈɡɪv] – kechirmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - forgave, forgiven. 
Instagramda mashhur {p:FOK}uschi {p:GIV} qilibdi va 10 ta mashina qo'yibdi. Giv tugagandan so'ng 10 ta mashina o'z egalarini topibdi. Lekin 1 kundan so'ng o'sha mashinalar yo'q bo'lib qolibdi va fokuschining bu fokusini ichki ishlar {h:kechirmabdi} va uni qamab qoyishibdi.
examples: {r:Actually I would forgive him if he apologized} - Aslida u uzr so'rasa, men uni kechirar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t forgive such a mistake easily} - U bunday xatoni osonlikcha kechirmasdi.
{r:They would have forgiven each other by now} - Ular hozirgacha bir-birlarini kechirgan bo'lar edi.
{r:Firstly, we must specifically forgive those prominent writers} - Birinchidan, biz aynan o'sha mashhur yozuvchilarni kechirishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Kiss}[kɪs] – o’pmoq. Boyib ketganimdan so’ng qarz so’rovchi odamlar ko’payib ketdi va ular hozir {p:KISS}amni {h:o’pishga} tayyor.
examples: {r:I would kiss her if she allowed me} - U ruxsat bersa, men uni o'par edim.
{r:I don't want to kiss the cat even if it is cute.} - Men mushukni o'pishni xohlamayman garchi u juda yoqimtoy bo'lsa ham.
{r:They would have kissed goodbye at the station} - Ular stansiyada xayrlashish uchun o'pishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:He wouldn't have ignored the kiss on the cheek} - U yanoqdan o'pishni e'tiborsiz qoldirmagan bo'lar edi.

text: {r:Scratch}[skrætʃ] – tirnamoq, timdalamoq; tirnalgan joy. Eng boy o’rdak {p:SKRUCH} agar kimdir uning boyliklariga ko’z olaytirsa {h:tirnab}, timdalab tashlaydi.
examples: {r:I would scratch the surface to see what’s underneath} - Men tagida nima borligini ko'rish uchun yuzani tirnar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t scratch the new furniture} - U yangi mebellarni tirnamasdi.
{r:They would have scratched the car while parking} - Ular mashinani parkova qilish paytida tirnab qo'yishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:He wouldn't have ignored the scratch on the table} - U stoldagi tirnalgan e'tiborsiz qoldirmagan bo'lar edi.

text: {r:Betray}[bɪˈtreɪ] – xiyonat qilmoq. Buxoroda o'qituvchilarini ustiga bitiruv marosimida suv sepib yuborgan bolani eslaysizmi? Yangiliklarda rosa muhokama qilishgandi. Bola maktabni {p:BITIREY} deganda o'qituvchilarining mehnati va mehriga {h:xiyonat qildi}.
examples: {r:I would never betray my friends} - Men hech qachon do'stlarimga xiyonat qilmasdim.
{r:She wouldn’t betray her principles for money} - U pul uchun o'z prinsiplariga xiyonat qilmasdi.
{r:They would have betrayed their promises} - Ular o'z va'dalariga xiyonat qilishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:He was not aware that his friend planned to betray him.} - U do'stining uni sotmoqchi ekanligidan xabardor emas edi.

{r:His sudden actions seemed to betray his team, leading to their project to crash.} - Uning to'satdan qilgan harakatlari jamoasiga xiyonat qilgandek tuyuldi, bu esa ularning loyihasining buzilishiga olib keldi.

text: {r:Flip}[flɪp] – o'girmoq, ag'darmoq, o'girilmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:FILIP}pin bayrog’ini qayta-qayta u yoq bu yoqqa {h:o’girdingiz}.
examples: {r:Hold on a minute, I will flip the pancake carefully} - Kutib tur, men blinchikni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ag'dararaman.
{r:She wouldn’t flip through the pages so quickly} - U varaqlarni shu qadar tez o'girdi.
{r:They would have flipped the switch by mistake} - Ular kalitni xato bilan o'zgartirishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:I flipped the book to look at the back cover.} - Men kitobni o'girdim orqa muqovasini ko'rish uchun.

text: {r:Clap}[klæp] – qarsak chalmoq, olqishlamoq. Rus yumori biznikidan ancha kuchli. Masalan Komedi {p:KLAP}ni olaylik. Odamlar qotib qolishadi kulgidan. {h:Qarsaklar}dan zal portlab ketay deydi.
examples: {r:I would clap if the performance was good} - Ijro yaxshi bo'lsa, men olqishlar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t clap for such a poor show} - U bunday yomon ko'rsatuv uchun olqishlamasdi.
{r:We kept on clapping their performance} - Biz ularning ijrosini olqishlashda davom etdik.
{r:He is unable to clap; he has no left hand.} - U qarsak chalolmaydi. Uning chap qo'li yo'q

text: {r:Error}[ˈɛrər] – xato, kamchilik. Bo’lajak {p:ER}ingiz {p:OR}kestrda musiqachi bo’lib ishlasa bu {h:xato} tanlov. Chunki u uyda ham asbobini chalaverib quloq-miyangizni yeydi.
examples: {r:I would correct the error immediately} - Men xatoni darhol tuzatar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t make such a silly error} - U bunday ahmoqona xato qilmasdi.
{r:They would have noticed the error in the report} - Ular hisobotdagi xatoni payqashgan bo'lar edi.
{r:It was a simple error, but the manager insisted it was entirely his fault.} - Bu oddiy xato edi, ammo menejer bu butunlay uning aybi ekanligini ta'kidladi.

text: {r:Formal}[ˈfɔːrməl] – rasmiy. Formula 1 avtopoygalarini bilsangiz kerak. Yaqinda {p:FORMUL}a 1 ga Yaponiyalik poygachi hammani hayratga solib {h:rasmiy} kiyimda keldi va g'oliblikni qo'lga kiritdi. Rasmiy kiyinish ba'zan omad ham olib kelar ekan.
examples: {r:I would wear formal clothes to the event} - Men tadbirga rasmiy kiyim kiyar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t attend the formal meeting in casual clothes} - U rasmiy uchrashuvga oddiy kiyimda qatnashmasdi.
{r:The company needs to generate a formal report on the environmental impact of its operations.} - Kompaniya o'z faoliyatining atrof-muhitga ta'siri bo'yicha rasmiy hisobot tayyorlashi kerak.
{r:His resignation was deemed a formal protest against the decision.} - Uning iste'fosi qarorga qarshi rasmiy norozilik deb topildi.

text: {r:Existence}[ɪɡˈzɪstəns] – mavjudlik. Exist(mavjud bo'lmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I would question the existence of such a place} - Men bunday joyning mavjudligini shubha ostiga olar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t doubt the existence of aliens} - U o'zga sayyoraliklarning mavjudligiga shubha qilmasdi.
{r:They would have discussed the existence of the problem} - Ular muammoning mavjudligini muhokama qilishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:The existence of such a proposal is somewhat unusual.} – Bunday taklifning mavjudligi biroz g‘ayrioddiy.

text: {r:Consistent}[kənˈsɪstənt] – barqaror, doimiy, qat’iy. Men Ozodbek Nazarbekov {p:KONS}ertida a{p:SISTENT} bo’lib ishlashni xohladim va shuning uchun Ozod akaga telefon qilaverdim ko’p marta. Oxirida “Ha mayli asistent bo’lsang bo’laqol juda {h:qat’iy} yigit ekansan.” dedilar Ozod aka.
examples: {r:I would appreciate consistent effort} - Men izchil harakatni qadrlardim.
{r:She wouldn’t be consistent in her work} - U o'z ishida izchil bo'lmasdi.
{r:They would have maintained consistent quality} - Ular izchil sifatni saqlab qolishgan bo'lar edi.

{r:You have to be consistent with your practice if you imagine achieving mastery in any skill.} - Agar siz biron bir ko'nikmada mahoratga erishishni tasavvur qilsangiz, mashg'ulotlaringizda izchil bo'lishingiz kerak.

text: {r:Niece}[niːs] – qiz bola jiyan.
examples: {r:My niece is extremely skinny. Her purpose is to gain weight.} - Mening jiyanim o'ta ozg'in. Uning maqsadi vazn to'plash.
{r:My niece dropped out of college because she was fed up with studying} - Mening jiyanim o'qishdan bezor bo'lganligi uchun kollejni tashlab ketdi.
{r:They would have visited their niece last weekend} - Ular o'tgan dam olish kunida jiyanlariga tashrif buyurishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:My niece is a virtually independent girl} - Mening jiyanim deyarli mustaqil qiz.

text: {r:Acceptance}[əkˈseptəns] – Bu acceptable va accept ning ot so’z turkumiga xos shakli va 2 xil ma’noni anglatadi: 1) qabul qilinish 2) ma’qul bo’lish
examples: {r:I would seek acceptance from my peers} - Men tengdoshlarimdan qabul qilinishni izlardim.
{r:The acceptance of his idea brought fun to the team, but they failed to finish on time.} – Uning g‘oyasi qabul qilingani jamoaga quvonch keltirdi, ammo ular vaqtida tugata olishmadi.
{r:They would have achieved acceptance in the community} - Ular jamoada qabul qilinishga erishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:She was excited about her acceptance into the university.} – U universitetga qabul qilinganidan hayajonlandi.

text: {r:Punish}[ˈpʌnɪʃ] – jazolamoq. Agar kimda kim maktabga kech qolsa mana bu {p:PANSH}axa bilan {h:jazolayman}.
examples: {r:I would punish the wrongdoer} - Men xatoga yo'l qo'yganni jazolardim.
{r:She wouldn’t punish her child so harshly} - U bolasini shu qadar qattiq jazolamasdi.
{r:The king promised to punish the traitors after the battle.} – Qirol jangdan keyin xoinlarni jazolashga va’da berdi.
{r:The enormous drop in grades led the teacher to punish the whole class.} – Baholarning ulkan pasayishi o‘qituvchini butun sinfni jazolashga olib keldi.

text: {r:Slam}[slæm] – qarsillatmoq, qarsillatib yopmoq. Bolangizni tinchlatiradigan va {h:qarsillab} uni quvontiradigan narsa sotib olmoqchimisiz? Unda {p:SLAYM} sotib oling bir quchoq yam-yashil yoki pushtisidan har safar qo’lingiz bilan qisganingizda 'g’arch' etgan tovush chiqaradi.
examples: {r:I would slam the door if I were angry} - Men g'azablanganda eshikni urar edim.
{r:She wouldn’t slam the book on the table} - U stolga kitobni urmasdi.
{r:The patient slammed the massive door in anger at the rude treatment.} – Bemor qo‘pol muomaladan jahli chiqib, katta eshikni qarsillatib yopdi.
{r:The boy slammed the shiny new door in excitement.} – Bola hayajon bilan yaltiroq yangi eshikni qarsillatib yopdi.

text: {r:Roast}[roʊst] – qovurmoq. Bu vaziyatda siz Titanik filmidagi {p:ROUZ} ning tuxum {h:qovurayotganini} tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin!
examples: {r:I would roast the vegetables for dinner} - Men kechki ovqat uchun sabzavotlarni qovurardim.
{r:She wouldn’t roast the meat for too long} - U go'shtni uzoq vaqt qovurmasdi.
{r:They would have roasted the chicken perfectly} - Ular tovuqni mukammal qovurishgan bo'lar edi.
{r:The smell of roasted coffee filled the narrow kitchen.} – Qovurilgan qahva hidi tor oshxonani to‘ldirdi.

text: {r:Multiply}[ˈmʌltɪplaɪ] – ko'paytirmoq. Xullas men fokuschiman. Pullarni ko'paytiraman. Agar bir o'ram pulni sanaganingizda 500 ming chiqqan bo'lsa, qo'limga bitta {p:MAN TUPLAY} sanab sizga 1 million so'm chiqarib {h:ko'paytirib} beraman ikki baravarga.
examples: {r:You don't have to multiply every number manually; the calculator can do it.} - Har bir raqamni qo'lda ko'paytirishingiz shart emas, buni kalkulyator qila oladi.
{r:He doesn't have to multiply the recipes for a large group, we are only four people.} - U katta guruh uchun retseptlarni ko'paytirishi shart emas, biz faqat to'rt kishimiz.
{r:We didn't have to multiply the data ourselves, the program did it automatically.} - Ma'lumotlarni o'zimiz ko'paytirishimiz shart emas edi, dastur buni avtomatik bajardi.
{r:They didn't have to multiply their efforts to finish the task on time.} - Vazifani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun o'z harakatlarini ko'paytirishlari shart emas edi.

text: {r:Rejection}[rɪˈdʒɛkʃən] – rad etish, rad etilish.
examples: {r:You don't have to accept this rejection without a valid reason.} - Siz bu rad etilishni asosli sababsiz qabul qilishingiz shart emas.
{r:He doesn't have to worry about the rejection letter; he has a job offer from another company.} - U rad etish maktubi haqida xavotirlanishi shart emas, unga boshqa kompaniyadan ish taklifi bor.
{r:We didn't have to deal with the rejection, our application was approved immediately.} - Biz rad etilish bilan shug'ullanishimiz shart emas edi, arizamiz darhol tasdiqlandi.
{r:She didn't have to feel bad about the rejection, she tried her best.} - U rad etilgani uchun o'zini yomon his qilishi shart emas edi, u qo'lidan kelgan barcha harakatni qildi.

text: {r:Informal}[ɪnˈfɔːrməl] – norasmiy. Formal(rasmiy) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:You don't have to wear a suit, the meeting is informal.} - Siz kostyum kiyishingiz shart emas, uchrashuv norasmiy.
{r:The teacher said we don't have to use formal language in our presentation.} - O'qituvchi taqdimotimizda rasmiy til ishlatishimiz shart emasligini aytdi.
{r:They didn't have to keep the conversation informal} - Ular suhbatni bunday norasmiy uslubda olib borishlari shart emas edi.
{r:We didn't have to send a formal invitation, an informal one was enough.} - Biz rasmiy taklifnoma yuborishimiz shart emas edi, norasmiy taklifnoma yetarli edi.

text:
{r:Deserve}[dɪˈzɜːrv] – munosib bo’lmoq, loyiq bo’lmoq. 
 {p:DIZ}ayn jamoasi a'zolari qorong’ida ketayotganida {p:ZO’RAV}onlarga duch kelibdi va yaxshigina kaltaklanibdi. Jamoa a'zosi Qobil esa “Biz bunday munosabatga {h:loyiq emasdik}” deya intervyu beribdi.
examples: {r:You don't have to work extra hours to deserve a promotion, your hard work is already noticed.} - Lavozimga ko'tarilishga loyiq bo'lish uchun qo'shimcha ishlashingiz shart emas, mehnatingiz allaqachon sezilgan.
{r:He doesn't have to prove anything to deserve our respect.} - U hurmatimizga loyiq bo'lish uchun hech narsani isbotlashi shart emas.
{r:We didn't have to receive a prize, we didn't feel we deserved it.} - Biz mukofot olishimiz shart emas edi, biz o'zimizni unga loyiq deb hisoblamadik.
{r:She didn't have to beg for help, she deserved support from her friends.} - U yordam so'rab iltijo qilishi shart emas edi, u do'stlarining yordamiga loyiq edi.

text: {r:Glad}[ɡlæd] – xursand. Bugun mening sevimli filmim {p:GLAD}iatorning ikkinchi qismi chiqibdi 30 yildan so’ng. Juda {h:xursand} bo’lib ketdim bu yangilikdan.
examples: {r:You don't have to pretend to be glad, it's okay to feel sad.} - Xursanddek ko'rsatishingiz shart emas, xafa bo'lishingiz mumkin.
{r:He doesn't have to be glad about the news, it's not good news for him.} - U bu xabardan xursand bo'lishi shart emas, bu uning uchun yaxshi xabar emas.
{r:I didn't have to be glad to see him, but I was surprised and smiled.} - Uni ko'rganimdan xursand bo'lishim shart emas edi, lekin hayratlandim va jilmaydim.
{r:We didn't have to be glad about the outcome, but it was better than we expected.} - Natijadan xursand bo'lishimiz shart emas edi, lekin u biz kutgandan yaxshiroq bo'ldi.

text: {r:Elsewhere}[ˌɛlsˈwɛər] – boshqa biror joyda, boshqa joyga. Hot Lunch bu {p:EL S}evgan {p:VER}mishel, O’zbekistondan {h:boshqa biror joyda} topolmaysiz.
examples: {r:She doesn't have to look for a job elsewhere; there are many open positions here.} - U boshqa joydan ish qidirishi shart emas, bu yerda ko'plab bo'sh ish o'rinlari bor.
{r:We don't have to go elsewhere for dinner, we have plenty of food at home.} - Kechki ovqat uchun boshqa joyga borishimiz shart emas, uyda yetarli oziq-ovqatimiz bor.
{r:He didn't have to move elsewhere, his family was happy right here.} - U boshqa joyga ko'chishi shart emas edi, oilasi shu yerda baxtli edi.
{r:They didn't have to search for the solution elsewhere; it was in the manual all along.} - Ular yechimni boshqa joydan qidirishlari shart emas edi, u doim qo'llanmada bor edi.

text: {r:Garbage}[ˈɡɑːrbɪdʒ] – axlat, musor. Yangi uy sotib olib garajini tekshirib ko’ray dedim. Borsam {p:GAR}aj {p:BIJ}g’ib yotibdi. Odamlar uyni yangi egasi ko’chib kelgunicha garajimni {h:musor} xona qilib tashlashibdi.
examples: {r:You don't have to throw out the garbage; I already did it this morning.} - Axlatni tashlashingiz shart emas, men allaqachon bugun ertalab tashladim.
{r:She doesn't have to sort the garbage for recycling, the city's system handles it.} - U qayta ishlash uchun axlatni saralashi shart emas, shahar tizimi buni o'zi boshqaradi.
{r:We didn't have to buy a new bag, the last one was still in the cabinet.} - Yangi axlat qopi sotib olishimiz shart emas edi, oxirgisi hali ham shkafda turgan edi.
{r:He didn't have to clear all the garbage from the yard alone; his friends helped him.} - U hovlidagi barcha axlatni yolg'iz tozalashi shart emas edi, do'stlari unga yordam berdi.

text: {r:Resist}[rɪˈzɪst] – qarshilik qilmoq. Toshkent havosining ifloslanishiga asosiy sabab mashinalardan chiqayotgan gazlar emas balki zavodlar tomonidan {p:REZ}inalar {p:ISIT}ish uchun yoqilayotganida. Shuning uchun biz hammamiz bu zavodlarga {h:qarshilik qilishimiz} kerak va tabiatga zarar bermaydigan alternativ yoqilg'i turiga o’tishlariga majburlashimiz lozim.
examples: {r:You don't have to resist the offer, it's a great opportunity.} - Taklifga qarshilik qilishingiz shart emas, bu ajoyib imkoniyat.
{r:He doesn't have to resist his curiosity, he can ask all the questions he wants.} - U o'z qiziquvchanligiga qarshilik qilishi shart emas, u istagan barcha savollarini berishi mumkin.
{r:We didn't have to resist the changes, they were for the better.} - Biz o'zgarishlarga qarshilik qilishimiz shart emas edi, ular yaxshi tomonga edi.
{r:She didn't have to resist her feelings, it was okay to be in love.} - U o'z his-tuyg'ulariga qarshilik qilishi shart emas edi, sevish mumkin edi.

text: {r:Elaborate}[ɪˈlæbərəɪt] – puxta, yaxshi o’ylangan; batafsil gapirmoq, ma'lumot bermoq. Olimlar juda {h:puxta}lik bilan yangi narsa ixtiro qilishdi. Qanday ixtiro deysizmi? {p:ILO}nlarga {p:BRIT}va o'ylab topishdi.
examples: {r:You don't have to elaborate on every small detail; just give us the main points.} - Har bir kichik tafsilot haqida batafsil ma'lumot berishingiz shart emas, shunchaki asosiy fikrlarni ayting.
{r:He didn't have to elaborate on his reasons, we already knew why he did it.} - U o'z sabablarini batafsil tushuntirishi shart emas edi, biz uning nima uchun bunday qilganini allaqachon bilardik.
{r:We didn't have to elaborate on our proposal, the committee liked it from the start.} - Biz o'z taklifimizni batafsil tushuntirishimiz shart emas edi, qo'mita uni boshidan ma'qulladi.
{r:They're making the most elaborate preparations for the wedding.} - Ular to'yga juda puxta tayyorgarlik ko'rishyapti.
{r:She had an elaborate schedule.} - Uning jadvali puxta edi.

text: {r:Stake}[steɪk] – steyk; riskka qo'ymoq, xavfga qo'ymoq; risk, xavf. Tovuqli {p:STEYK}ni ko'mirda uzoq vaqt pishirilib kuydirib qo'yilganini yeyish inson sog'lig'ini {h:xavfga qo'yish} demakdir.
examples: {r:You don't have to stake your reputation on this; it's a team project.} - Siz o'z obro'ingizni bu loyihaga riskka qo'yishingiz shart emas, bu jamoaviy loyiha.
{r:He doesn't have to stake his savings on a risky investment.} - U o'z jamg'armasini xavfli sarmoyaga qo'yishi shart emas.
{r:We didn't have to stake all our money on one bet; we could have diversified.} - Biz butun pulimizni bitta tikishda xavfga qo'yishimiz shart emas edi, biz diversifikatsiya qilishimiz mumkin edi.
{r:She didn't have to stake her career on a job she wasn't passionate about.} - U o'z karyerasini unga ishtiyoqi bo'lmagan ish uchun xavfga qo'yishi shart emas edi.

text: {r:Accompany}[əˈkʌmpəni] – birga bormoq, yo’ldosh bo’lmoq. {p:A}rtel {p:kompani}asi har doim sizga {h:hamroh} bo’ladi. Chunki ular siz ishlatadigan gaz plitasi, konditsioner, telefon va boshqa uy jihozlari ishlab chiqaradi.
examples: {r:You don't have to accompany me to the airport, I can take a taxi.} - Aeroportgacha menga hamrohlik qilishingiz shart emas, taksi bilan borishim mumkin.
{r:She doesn't have to accompany her brother to the party, he is old enough to go alone.} - U akasiga bazmda hamrohlik qilishi shart emas, u yolg'iz borishi mumkin bo'ladigan yoshda.
{r:He didn't have to accompany me to the meeting; I had all the notes I needed.} - U uchrashuvda menga hamrohlik qilishi shart emas edi, menda kerakli barcha ma'lumotlar bor edi.
{r:We didn't have to accompany them on the trip, they had a guide.} - Biz ularga sayohatda hamrohlik qilishimiz shart emas edi, ularning gidlari bor edi.

text: {r:Inevitably}[ɪˈnɛvɪtəbli] – muqarrar, sodir bo'ladigan, nihoyat. Mening do'stim itiga novvotdan uy qurdi. Ajoyib {p:UY NOVVOTLI} lekin yomg'ir yoqsa erib ketishi {h:muqarrar}.
examples: {r:A mistake doesn't have to inevitably lead to failure, you can learn from it.} - Xato nihoyat muvaffaqiyatsizlikka olib kelishi shart emas, undan saboq olish mumkin.
{r:A small problem doesn't have to inevitably cause a major crisis.} - Kichik muammo muqarrar ravishda katta inqirozni keltirib chiqarishi shart emas.

{r:The project's delay didn't have to inevitably happen; we could have managed the time better.} - Loyiha kechikishi muqarrar sodir bo'lishi shart emas edi, biz vaqtni yaxshiroq boshqarishimiz mumkin edi.
{r:Her resignation didn't have to be the inevitable result of the argument.} - Uning iste'fosi tortishuvning muqarrar natijasi bo'lishi shart emas edi.

text: {r:Constraint}[kənˈstreɪnt] – cheklov, chegara. Men har hafta {p:KONST}aning {p:TREN}inglarida qatnashyapman repperlik bo’yicha. Ovoz imkoniyatlari {h:cheklangan} insonlarni ham bo'kirib qo'shiq va rep aytishiga yordam berar ekan.
examples: {r:You don't have to feel limited by these constraints; they are meant to guide you.} - Bu cheklovlar bilan cheklanganlikni his qilishingiz shart emas, ular sizni yo'naltirish uchun mo'ljallangan.
{r:The artist doesn't have to follow every constraint, he can be creative.} - Rassom har bir cheklovga rioya qilishi shart emas, u kreativ bo'lishi mumkin.

{r:We didn't have to work with such a tight budget constraint; we could have requested more funds.} - Biz bunday qattiq byudjet cheklovi bilan ishlashimiz shart emas edi, ko'proq mablag' so'rashimiz mumkin edi.

{r:They didn't have to face such harsh constraints on their project, the rules were not that strict.} - Ular o'z loyihalarida bunday qattiq cheklovlarga duch kelishlari shart emas edi, qoidalar unchalik qattiq emas edi.

text: {r:Finger}[ˈfɪŋɡər] – barmoq. {p:FIN}lyandiyalik {p:GER}man ismli do'stim menga hamma narsani {h:barmoq}lari bilan ko'rsatib tushuntirishni yaxshi ko'radi.
examples: {r:You don't have to point a finger at anyone; we are all responsible.} - Birovni ayblash uchun barmoq bilan ko'rsatishingiz shart emas, hammamiz mas'ulmiz.
{r:He pointed his finger at the wide gate, giving a timely warning.} – U barmog‘i bilan keng darvozani ko‘rsatib, o‘z vaqtida ogohlantirdi.
{r:My brother has 6 fingers.} - Akamning 6 ta barmog'i bor.
{r:She touched the soft flower with her wet finger.} – U nam barmog‘i bilan muloyim gulga tegdi.

text: {r:Bulk}[bʌlk] – asosiy qism, katta qism. {p:BALK}on konsert zalimizning {h:asosiy qism}ini tashkil qiladi Turkiston konsert zalida.
examples: {r:You don't have to handle the bulk of the work alone, we can help you.} - Ishning asosiy qismini yolg'iz bajaringiz shart emas, biz sizga yordam bera olamiz.
{r:She doesn't have to buy in bulk; the grocery store is nearby.} - U optom(ko'p miqdorda) xarid qilishi shart emas, oziq-ovqat do'koni yaqin joyda.
{r:We didn't have to move the bulk of the furniture ourselves; the moving company did it.} - Mebelning asosiy qismini o'zimiz ko'chirishimiz shart emas edi, ko'chirish kompaniyasi buni qildi.
{r:He didn't have to explain the bulk of the theory, we were already familiar with it.} - U nazariyaning ko'p qismini tushuntirishi shart emas edi, biz u bilan allaqachon tanish edik.

text: {r:Liver}[ˈlɪvər] – jigar. Men Liverpul futbol klubi muxlisiman. {p:LIVER}pulning har bir o’yinchisi mening {h:jigarlarimdek}(yaqin odam).
examples: {r:You don't have to eat the liver if you don't like it; you can choose something else.} - Agar yoqtirmasangiz, jigarni yeyishingiz shart emas, boshqa narsani tanlashingiz mumkin.
{r:He doesn't have to worry about his liver health anymore; all his tests came back negative.} - U endi jigar salomatligi haqida xavotirlanishi shart emas, barcha testlari manfiy chiqdi.
{r:She didn't have to undergo a liver transplant; the treatment worked perfectly.} - U jigar transplantatsiyasini o'tkazishi shart emas edi, davolash a'lo darajada tugadi.
{r:We didn't have to be concerned about his liver function after the surgery.} - Jarrohlik amaliyotidan so'ng uning jigar faoliyati haqida xavotirlanishimiz shart emas edi.

text: {r:Disagreement}[ˌdɪsəˈɡriːmənt] – kelishmovchilik. Disagree(kelishmaslik) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:We don't have to let this small disagreement ruin our friendship.} - Bu kichik kelishmovchilik do'stligimizni buzishiga yo'l qo'yishimiz shart emas.
{r:She doesn't have to be the one to resolve every disagreement in the team.} - U jamoada har bir kelishmovchilikni hal qilishi shart emas.

{r:The team didn't have to have a major disagreement about the new plan, they could have compromised.} - Jamoaning yangi reja bo'yicha katta kelishmovchiligi bo'lishi shart emas edi, ular kelishishlari mumkin edi.
{r:They didn't have to end their partnership over a simple disagreement.} - Ular oddiy kelishmovchilik tufayli hamkorliklarini tugatishlari shart emas edi.

text: {r:Palace}[ˈpæləs] – qasr. Mening bobom qishloqda {p:POLIZ} ekinlaridan {h:saroy} qurgan ekanlar o’tgan asrning 40 – yillarida. Urush payti ocharchilik bo’lib qovun-tarvuzdan qurilgan saroyni xalq yeb qo’ygan.
examples: {r:You don't have to live in a palace to feel like a king.} - O'zingizni shohdek his qilish uchun qasrda yashashingiz shart emas.
{r:The king doesn't have to spend all his money on building a new palace.} - Shoh barcha pullarini yangi qasr qurishga sarflashi shart emas.
{r:We didn't have to buy a ticket to see the palace from the outside.} - Saroyni tashqaridan ko'rish uchun chipta sotib olishimiz shart emas edi.
{r:They didn't have to enter the palace to understand its historical significance.} - Ular saroyga kirishlari shart emas edi uning tarixiy ahamiyatini tushunish uchun.

text: {r:Noticeable}[ˈnoʊtɪsəbəl] – sezilarli, ko'rinarli. Notice(sezmoq, payqamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:You don't have to make the changes noticeable; the team will still appreciate them.} - O'zgarishlarni sezilarli qilishingiz shart emas, jamoa ularni baribir qadrlaydi.
{r:She could identify the rat in the room by its noticeable smell.} – U xonadagi kalamushni uning sezilarli hididan bilib oldi.
{r:He looked handsome despite the noticeable scar on his face.} – Yuzidagi sezilarli chandiqqa qaramay, u chiroyli ko‘rinardi.

{r:The improvement in his behavior didn't have to be so noticeable for us to know he was trying.} - Uning xulq-atvoridagi yaxshilanish shunchalik sezilarli bo'lishi shart emas edi, biz uning harakat qilayotganini bilar edik.

text: {r:Crush}[krʌʃ] – ezmoq, bosmoq; maydalamoq, bo’lmoq. Tarakanlar {p:kurash}ini ko’rganmisiz? Ularda yutgan tarakan yutqazgan tarakanni {h:maydalab} tashlaydi.
examples: {r:You don't have to crush the ice for the cocktail; the cubes are fine as they are.} - Kokteyl uchun muzni maydalashingiz shart emas, kublar shundayligicha yaxshi.
{r:She doesn't have to crush her opponents in the debate to win; she can be respectful.} - U bahsda g'alaba qozonish uchun raqiblarini maydalab tashlashi shart emas, u hurmatli bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:They wanted to crush doubts and establish trust, whatever the challenge.} – Ular shubhalarni yo‘qotib, ishonch o‘rnatishni xohlashdi, qiyinchilik qanday bo‘lmasin.
{r:We didn't have to crush the competition; we were already the best in the market.} - Biz raqobatni ezib tashlashimiz shart emas edi, biz bozorda allaqachon eng yaxshi edik.

text: {r:Relieve}[rɪˈliːv] – yengillashtirmoq. Relief(yengillashish) so'zining fe'l so'z turkumiga xos shakli. Mnemonik namuna uchun 100-darsdagi relief ga qarang.
examples: {r:I wish this medicine could relieve my pain faster.} - Qaniydi bu dori og'rig'imni tezroq yengillashtira olganida.
{r:I wish I could relieve all her stress.} - Qaniydi uning barcha stressini yengillashtira olganimda.
{r:We wish we had done something to relieve their worries.} - Qaniydi biz ularning tashvishlarini yengillashtirish uchun biror narsa qilganimizda.
{r:I wish someone would relieve her of her duties.} - Qaniydi kimdir uning vazifalarini yengillashtirib yuborsa.

text: {r:Occur}[əˈkɜːr] – sodir bo’lmoq. Qadimda bir odam okeanning chekkasida orol quraman deb {p:OK}eanga {p:KUR}akda qum tashir ekan. Lekin uning orol g’oyasi hech qachon {h:sodir bo’lmadi}.
examples: {r:I wish that accident had not occurred.} - Qaniydi o'sha baxtsiz hodisa sodir bo'lmaganida.
{r:Nothing occurred.} - Hech narsa sodir bo'lmadi.
{r:She wishes the event would occur on a different day.} - Qaniydi tadbir boshqa kunda bo'lganida u uchun.
{r:I wish this thought would occur to him sooner.} - Qaniydi bu fikrim u bilan tezroq sodir bo'lsa.

text: {r:Considerably}[kənˈsɪdərəbli] – talaygina, anchagina. Men qishloq joyda yashayman va har kuni uyga suv tashishim kerak. Agar chelakda tashisam u suv urvoq ham bo’lmaydi. Agar {p:KANSTR BIL}an tashisam bir hafta maza qilib ishlataman {h:talaygina} suvni.
examples: {r:I wish the price hadn't increased so considerably.} - Qaniydi narx bunchalik sezilarli darajada oshmaganida.
{r:He wishes his salary would increase considerably.} - Qaniydi uning maoshi anchagina oshganida.
{r:They wish the situation had improved considerably.} - Qaniydi vaziyat sezilarli darajada yaxshilanganida.
{r:I wish the company would increase my salary considerably.} - Qaniydi kompaniya maoshimni anchagina oshirganida.

text: {r:Turkey}[ˈtɜːrki] – kurka. Turkiyaga sayohatga ketish oldidan albatta dudlangan {h:kurka} go’shti olib keting va {p:Turkiy}ada {p:turkey} yeng.
examples: {r:I wish we hadn't cooked such a big turkey.} - Qaniydi bunchalik katta kurka pishirmagan bo'lganimizda.
{r:She wishes they would have a different meat for Thanksgiving instead of turkey.} - Qaniydi ular Minnatdorchilik kuni uchun kurka o'rniga boshqa go'sht yeganlarida.
{r:I wish the turkey had been cooked a little longer.} - Qaniydi kurka biroz ko'proq pishirilganida.
{r:I wish you could have a delicious turkey this holiday season.} - Qaniydi bayram mavsumida mazali kurka yesangiz.

text: {r:Neat}[niːt] – toza, ozoda. {h:Ozodalikni} {p:NID}erlandiyaliklardan o’rganing. Kecha futbol bo’yicha jahon chempionatia yutqazib qo’ygan jamoa futbolchilari kiyinish xonasini, muxlislari esa stadionni yig’ishtirib ketishibdi.
examples: {r:I wish my room was as neat as hers.} - Qaniydi mening xonam ham uning xonasichalik ozoda bo'lganida.
{r:He wishes his handwriting was neat.} - Qaniydi uning qo'lyozmasi ozoda bo'lganida.
{r:I wish you would keep your desk a bit more neat.} - Qaniydi siz stolingizni biroz tartibliroq saqlaganingizda.
{r:I wish he would keep his car neat and tidy.} - Qaniydi u o'z mashinasini toza va tartibli saqlaganida.

text: {r:Brake}[breɪk] – tormoz, tormoz bermoq. Agar siz yo’lda ketayotib {h:tormoz} bermoqchi bo’lsangiz avval “{p:BIR EK}ki” deb sanashingiz lozim.
examples: {r:I wish he had pressed the brake sooner.} - Qaniydi u tormozni ertaroq bosganida.
{r:He wishes the car's brake worked properly.} - Qaniydi mashinaning tormozi to'g'ri ishlaganida.
{r:I wish the car would slow down and use the brake.} - Qaniydi mashina sekinlashib tormozdan foydalanganida.
{r:I wish the mechanic had checked the brake system.} - Qaniydi mexanik tormoz tizimini tekshirganida.

text:
{r:Forbid}[fərˈbɪd] – taqiqlamoq, yo’l qo’ymaslik. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - forbade, forbidden. 
Yirik futbol uchrashuvlari natijasini taxmin qiluvchi sakkizoyoq, quyon, qushlar ko’payib ketdi. Yaqinda {p:FOLBIN IT} ham chiqibdi futbol natijasini taxmin qiladigan. Xullas biz bunday be’maniliklarga {h:yo’l qo’ymasligimiz} lozim. Bunday oldin aytib beruvchilar hisobiga ko’plab odamlar qimorboz bo’lib ketyapti.
examples: {r:I wish the rules didn't forbid us from talking.} - Qaniydi qoidalar bizga gaplashishni taqiqlamaganida.
{r:She wishes her parents wouldn't forbid her from going out.} - Qaniydi ota-onasi unga tashqariga chiqishni taqiqlamaganida.
{r:He wishes the law didn't forbid such a simple thing.} - Qaniydi qonun bunday oddiy narsani taqiqlamaganida.
{r:I wish they wouldn't forbid children from playing here.} - Qaniydi ular bu yerda bolalarga o'ynashni taqiqlamaganlarida.

text: {r:Brutal}[ˈbruːtəl] – shafqatsiz, berahm. Mahallamizda hozir qizlar ham sport bilan faol shug’ullanyapti. Masalan {p:BRU}sda {p:DIL}dora ismli qiz har kuni shug’ullanib yigitlarni {h:shafqatsizlarcha} urib tashlyapti.
examples: {r:I wish the truth wasn't so brutal.} - Qaniydi haqiqat bunchalik shafqatsiz bo'lmaganida.
{r:She wishes the winter hadn't been so brutal.} - Qaniydi qish bunchalik shafqatsiz bo'lmaganida.
{r:He wishes his criticism wouldn't be so brutal.} - Qaniydi uning tanqidlari bunchalik shafqatsiz bo'lmaganida.
{r:I wish the storm hadn't been so brutal on our home.} - Qaniydi bo'ron uyimizga bunchalik shafqatsiz ta'sir qilmaganida.

text: {r:Opt}[ɒpt] – ma’qul ko’rmoq, tanlamoq. Men nimadir sotib olmoqchi bo’lsam {p:OPT}om bozorga boraman. U yerdan mahsulotlarni arzonga olishni {h:ma’qul ko’raman}.
examples: {r:I wish I had opted for a different meal.} - Qaniydi boshqa ovqatni tanlaganimda.
{r:He wishes he could opt to stay at home.} - Qaniydi u uyda qolishni tanlay olganida.
{r:They wish they hadn't opted for the more expensive option.} - Qaniydi ular qimmatroq variantni tanlamaganlarida.
{r:I wish he would opt to stay a little longer.} - Qaniydi u biroz ko'proq qolishni tanlaganida.

text: {r:Valid}[ˈvælɪd] – amal qiladigan, arzirli. To'g'risi bu so'zni o'zbek tilida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarjimasi yo'q. Lekin quyidagi misollar orqali bu so'zning ma'nosi va qanday kontekstda qo'llanilishini tushunib olishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:I wish this ticket was still valid.} - Qaniydi bu chipta hali ham amal qilganida.
{r:She wishes she had a valid reason for her absence.} - Qaniydi uning yo'qligi uchun asosli sababi bo'lganida.
{r:He wishes his excuse was considered valid.} - Qaniydi uning bahonasi asosli deb topilganida.
{r:I wish the judge had considered her claim as valid.} - Qaniydi sudya uning da'vosini asosli deb hisoblaganida.

text: {r:Remove}[rɪˈmuːv] – olib tashlamoq, olib qo’ymoq, sug'urmoq. O’rta asrlarda remenlar shunchalik uzun bo’lganki {p:REM}enlarni {p:MUV}affaqiyatli {h:yechib olish} katta bir ish hisoblangan.
examples: {r:I wish I could remove this stain from my shirt.} - Qaniydi ko'ylagimdagi bu dog'ni olib tashlay olganimda.
