{r:He wishes he hadn't been removed from his position.} - Qaniydi u o'z lavozimidan olib tashlanmaganida.
{r:She wishes she could remove the memory of that day.} - Qaniydi u o'sha kunning xotirasini o'chirib tashlay olganida.
{r:I wish the government would remove the new tax.} - Qaniydi hukumat yangi soliqni olib tashlaganida.

text: {r:Offender}[əˈfɛndər] – jinoyatchi. {p:AFANDI ER} xotiniga e’tibor bermay boshqa ayollarga suykalgani uchun qamalibdi va {h:jinoyatchi} deb topilibdi. Afandi eshakka teskari o'tqazilib xalq orasida sazoyi qilinibdi.
examples: {r:I wish they had caught the offender sooner.} - Qaniydi ular jinoyatchini ertaroq tutganlarida.
{r:We wish the law was stricter with repeat offenders.} - Qaniydi qonun qayta-qayta jinoyat qiluvchilarga nisbatan qattiqroq bo'lganida.
{r:I wish the offender would apologize for his actions.} - Qaniydi jinoyatchi o'z harakatlari uchun uzr so'raganida.
{r:I wish the court would find the offender guilty.} - Qaniydi sud jinoyatchini aybdor deb topsa.

text: {r:Distinct}[dɪˈstɪŋkt] – farqli, o'ziga xos, boshqacha. {p:D}oktorlar {p:INSTINKT}i kuchliligi bilan oddiy odamlardan {h:farq qiladi.} Ular kuchli zehni bilan ham ajralib turadi.
examples: {r:I wish the difference between the two was more distinct.} - Qaniydi ikkalasi o'rtasidagi farq aniqroq bo'lganida.
{r:He wishes his voice was more distinct.} - Qaniydi uning ovozi o'ziga xosroq bo'lganida.
{r:She wishes she could tell the two species apart more distinctly.} - Qaniydi u ikkala turni aniqroq farqlay olganida.
{r:I wish the painter had used more distinct colors.} - Qaniydi rassom farqliroq ranglardan foydalanganida.

text: {r:Exhausted}[ɪɡˈzɔːstɪd] – charchamoq, holdan toymoq. Egizak farzandlarim bor, rosa sho'x ikkovi ham. Har kuni {p:EGIZ}aklar {p:OST}onadan mehmonxonaga yuguraveradi va oxiri o’ynab-o’ynab {h:charchab} qolishadi.
examples: {r:I wish I wasn't so exhausted after the long day.} - Qaniydi uzun kundan keyin bunchalik charchamagan bo'lganimda.
{r:The team wishes they hadn't felt so exhausted after the game.} - Jamoa qaniydi o'yindan keyin bunchalik holdan toygan bo'lmaganida.
{r:I wish I could relieve the feeling of being exhausted.} - Qaniydi holdan toyish hissini yengillashtira olganimda.
{r:I wish the long hike hadn't left me so exhausted.} - Qaniydi uzoq sayohat meni bunchalik charchatmaganida.

text: {r:Fragile}[ˈfrædʒəl] – mo’rt, kuchsiz. {p:FRA}nsiyalik {p:JAL}lod Napoleonni qatl qilmoqchi bo’lganida jallodning {h:mo’rt} boltasi sinib ketgan ekan. Keyin esa bunda qandaydir hikmat bor deya uning jonini saqlab qolishgan va surgunga jo’natib yuborishgan.
examples: {r:I wish the glass wasn't so fragile.} - Qaniydi shisha bunchalik mo'rt bo'lmaganida.
{r:He wishes his ego was not so fragile.} - Qaniydi uning egosi bunchalik mo'rt bo'lmaganida.
{r:I wish the country's economy wasn't so fragile.} - Qaniydi mamlakat iqtisodiyoti bunchalik mo'rt bo'lmaganida.
{r:I wish their relationship wasn't so fragile.} - Qaniydi ularning munosabatlari bunchalik mo'rt bo'lmaganida.

text: {r:Objection}[əbˈdʒɛkʃən] – e'tiroz. Object(e'tiroz bildirmoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:I wish he wouldn't raise an objection every time.} - Qaniydi u har safar e'tiroz bildiravermaganida.
{r:She wishes there had been no objection to the plan.} - Qaniydi rejaga hech qanday e'tiroz bo'lmaganida.
{r:I wish I had voiced my objection sooner.} - Qaniydi men o'z e'tirozimni ertaroq bildirganimda.
{r:I wish they would withdraw their objection.} - Qaniydi ular o'z e'tirozlarini qaytarib olsalar.

text: {r:Tale}[teɪl] – ertak. {p:TAYL}and bu Osiyodagi eng ekzotik va {h:ertak}namo qirollik. Insonlarning odobi va madaniyati juda a’lo darajada. Bu ertaknamo davlatga 100 millionlab turistlar tashrif buyuradi.
examples: {r:I wish she would tell us a different tale.} - Qaniydi u bizga boshqa bir hikoya aytib berganida.
{r:He wishes he had written a tale about his childhood.} - Qaniydi u o'z bolaligi haqida hikoya yozganida.
{r:We wish the movie was based on a more fascinating tale.} - Qaniydi film qiziqroq hikoyaga asoslangan bo'lganida.
{r:I wish this fairy tale had a different ending.} - Qaniydi bu ertak boshqacha yakunlanganida.

text: {r:Gentle}[ˈdʒɛntəl] – muloyim, oliyjanob, yaxshi. Aslida {p:JENTL}men(oliyjanob, mard kishi) aynan shu so'zdan olingan va jentlmen so'zini eslash orqali bu so'zning ma'nosini osongina tushunishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:I wish he had a more gentle smile.} - Qaniydi uning muloyimroq tabassumi bo'lganida.
{r:She wishes the breeze would be more gentle.} - Qaniydi shabada muloyimroq bo'lganida.
{r:I wish you would speak in a more gentle voice.} - Qaniydi siz muloyimroq ovozda gapirganingizda.
{r:I wish the wind would blow more gently.} - Qaniydi shamol muloyimroq esganida.

text: {r:Announcement}[əˈnaʊnsmənt] – e'lon. Announce(e'lon qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I wish they had made the announcement yesterday.} - Qaniydi ular e'lonni kecha qilganlarida.
{r:He wishes the announcement wasn't so boring.} - Qaniydi e'lon bunchalik zerikarli bo'lmaganida.
{r:She wishes she hadn't missed the important announcement.} - Qaniydi u muhim e'lonni o'tkazib yubormaganida.
{r:I wish the company would make an official announcement.} - Qaniydi kompaniya rasmiy e'lon qilganida.

text: {r:Betrayal}[bɪˈtreɪəl] – xiyonat. Betray(xiyonat qilmoq) so'zdan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I wish I hadn't felt such a sense of betrayal.} - Qaniydi bunday xiyonat hissini sezmaganimda.
{r:The smooth plan failed after her involvement in the betrayal was revealed.} – Uning xiyonatdagi ishtiroki oshkor bo‘lgach, silliq reja barbod bo‘ldi.
{r:I wish he could forgive the betrayal.} - Qaniydi u xiyonatni kechira olganida.
{r:I wish the truth about the betrayal had never been revealed.} - Qaniydi xiyonat haqidagi haqiqat hech qachon oshkor bo'lmaganida.

text: {r:Resistance}[rɪˈzɪstəns] – qarshilik ko'rsatish. Resist(qarshilik ko'rsatmoq, kurashmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The material's resistance was tested} - Materialning chidamliligi sinovdan o'tkazildi.
{r:He was faced with strong resistance} - U kuchli qarshilikka duch keldi.
{r:The resistance movement was strongly supported} - Qarshilik harakati kuchliroq qo'llab-quvvatlandi.
{r:Resistance never stopped even after the arrival of troops } - Qarshilik to'xtamadi hattoki qo'shin yetib kelishidan so'ng ham.

text: {r:Allege}[əˈlɛdʒ] – da'vo qilmoq, ayblamoq (isbotlanmagan holatda). Qanday kontekstda ishlatiladi? 1. Sud va huquqiy holatlar: Biror kishini jinoyatda ayblash, lekin bu hali isbotlanmagan bo'lsa. 2. OAV (media) va yangiliklarda: Isbotlanmagan voqealarni bildirganda. 3. Shaxsiy fikr va taxmin bildirayotganda: Kimdir biror narsa haqida gapirsa, lekin u narsa rost yoki yolg'on ekanini bilmasa.
examples: {r:Corruption is alleged in the report} - Hisobotda korrupsiya da'vo qilinadi.
{r:He was alleged to have stolen the money} - U pulni o'g'irlagani da'vo qilingan.
{r:The prosecution will allege that his main occupation was actually a mask for illegal activities.} - Prokuratura uning asosiy kasbi aslida noqonuniy faoliyat uchun niqob bo'lganligini da'vo qiladi.
{r:It was alleged by her that she was mistreated} - Unga yomon munosabatda bo'lgani uning tomonidan da'vo qilindi.

text: {r:Supposedly}[səˈpoʊzɪdli] – go'yoki, taxminan, aytilishicha. U turli kontekstlarda ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:He is supposedly an expert} - U aytishlaricha mutaxassis.
{r:The document was supposedly lost} - Hujjat yo'qolgan deb taxmin qilinadi.
{r:His watch was supposedly stolen} - Aytishlaricha uning soatini o'g'irlab ketishgan.
{r:The meeting was supposedly canceled} - Uchrashuv bekor qilingan deb taxmin qilinadi.

text: {r:Predator}[ˈprɛdəˌtɔr] – yirtqich, vahshiy.
examples: {r:The lion is a natural predator} - Sher tabiiy yirtqichdir.
{r:The company is considered a predator in the market} - Kompaniya bozorda yirtqich deb hisoblanadi.
{r:Food is hunted by predators} - Oziq-ovqat yirtqichlar tomonidan ovlanadi.
{r:The predator got caught in the trap} - Yirtqich tuzoqqa tushdi.

text: {r:Soar}[sɔːr] – keskin ko’tarilmoq; uchmoq. Olimpiada o’yinlari g’olibligi uchun {p:SOVR}in jamg’armasi keskin {h:ko’tarildi}.
examples: {r:The eagle soared in the sky} - Burgut osmonda uchdi.
{r:Prices were soared last year} - O'tgan yili narxlar keskin ko'tarildi.
{r:Her spirits soared after the good news} - Yaxshi xabardan so'ng uni kayfiyati ko'tarildi.
{r:The temperature soared in the summer} - Yozda harorat ko'tarildi.

text: {r:Squeeze}[skwiːz] – siqmoq, qismoq, ezmoq. Agar nimanidir chizmoqchi bo’lib {p:Eskiz}(ya’ni qoralama) qilsangiz va agar u yaxshi o’xshamasa qog’ozni olib {h:siqib} ezib tashlang.
examples: {r:The lemon was squeezed by the customer} - Limon mijoz tomonidan siqildi.
{r:My baggage got squeezed by airport staff} - Mening bagajim aeroport xodimlari tomonidan siqib tashlandi.
{r:Its suppliers were squeezed by the company} - Yetkazib beruvchilari kompaniya tomonidan siqib chiqarildi.
{r:His hand was gently squeezed by Julia} - Uning qo'li Julia tomonidan muloyim siqildi.

text: {r:Magic}[ˈmædʒɪk] – mo’jiza, sehr. Toshkentdagi {p:MEJIK} Siti har kuni {h:mo’jizalar} sodir bo’ladigan joy.
examples: {r:Magic tricks were performed by the magician} - Sehrli fokuslar sehrgar tomonidan ko'rsatildi.
{r:Children and some adults still believe in magic} - Bolalar va ba'zi kattalar hali ham sehrga ishonadi.
{r:Despite the shallow feedback, her magic performance impressed everyone.} – Sayoz fikr-mulohazalarga qaramay, uning sehrli chiqishi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.
{r:He felt dumb for not noticing the gigantic magic trick on stage.} – U sahnadagi ulkan sehrli fokusni payqamagani uchun o‘zini ahmoqdek his qildi.

text: {r:Insect}[ˈɪnˌsɛkt] – hashorat. Tasavvur qiling mahallangiz hududidagi {p:inspek}tor jinoyatlarni pora bilan yopib yuborganligi uchun {h:hashoratga} aylanib qolibdi.
examples: {r:The insect flew into the room} - Hasharot xonaga uchib kirdi.
{r:Insects were studied by her in biology} - Biologiyada hasharotlar uning tomonidan o'rganildi.
{r:She saw a slim insect crawling on the spot of sunlight.} – U quyosh nuri tushgan joyda ingichka hasharotni ko‘rdi.
{r:Insects are vital for the ecosystem} - Hasharotlar ekotizim uchun muhimdir.

text: {r:Superior}[suːˈpɪəriər] – ustun, ortiq(solishtirishlarda qo’llaniladi). Menimcha hamma LED lampalar ishlatishi kerak. Ular {p:SUPER YO}Ritgichlar va oddiy lampochkalardan {h:ustun} ham kamroq tok yeyishi va ko’proq yoritishi bilan.
examples: {r:He felt considerably superior to his colleagues} - U o'zini hamkasblaridan anchagina ustun his qildi.
{r:The superior quality was evident} - Yuqori sifat ko'rinib turgan edi.
{r:It has superior quality} - Buning sifati yuqori.
{r:The order was given by the superior officer} - Buyruq yuqori martabali ofitser tomonidan berildi.

text: {r:Inferior}[ɪnˈfɪəriər] – past, sifatsiz. Superior(yuqori, ustun) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:The product was of inferior quality} - Mahsulot past sifatli edi.
{r:He felt inferior in the group} - U guruhda o'zini past his qildi.
{r:The failure was caused by the inferior materials} - Muvaffaqiyatsizlikka past sifatli materiallar sabab bo'ldi.
{r:Inferior treatment was refused to be accepted by her} - Past munosabatni qabul qilishdan u bosh tortdi.

text: {r:Hunt}[hʌnt] – ovlamoq; ov. Tasavvur qiling {p:HAND}alak hajviy ko’rsatuvi aktyorlari Zokir va Ortiq akalar Afrikaga sayohatga borib junglida adashib qolishibdi va yovvoyi qabilalar ularni {h:ovlab} oyog’idan osib qo’yganmish.
examples: {r:Deer are hunted by the lion} - Bug'ular sher tomonidan ovlanadi.
{r:Hunting was done by them in the forest} - Ular o'rmonda ov qilishdi.
{r:The hunt was successful} - Ov muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.
{r:Dogs still retain some similarity to wolves, which helps them hunt in packs.} - Itlar haligacha bo'rilarga o'xshashlikni saqlab qolgan, bu ularga to'dalarda ov qilishga yordam beradi.

text: {r:Echo}[ˈɛkoʊ] – aks-sado, exo; aks-sado qaytarmoq.
examples: {r:His words echoed in the room} - Uning so'zlari xonada aks-sado tarqatdi.
{r:The echo of the gunshot was heard} - Otishma aks-sadosi eshitildi.
{r:The valley gets filled with echoes} - Vodiy aks-sadolar bilan to'ladi.
{r:Her laughter echoed through the house} - Uning kulgisi uy bo'ylab aks etdi.

text: {r:Pill}[pɪl] – dori, tabletka. Mana bu dori nimadan qilingan deb o’ylaysiz. Bu {h:tabletka} {p:PIL}la qurtini qovurib keyin biriktirilganidan qilingan.
examples: {r:A pill for her headache was taken by her} - Bosh og'rig'i uchun dori u tomonidan ichildi.
{r:Some pills were prescribed by the doctor} - Bir nechta dorilar shifokor tomonidan yozib berildi.
{r:The pill was hard to swallow} - Dori yutish qiyin edi.
{r:She objected to selling these pills. They were not useful.} - U bu dorilarni sotishga e'tiroz bildirdi. Ular foydali emas edi.

text: {r:Bare}[bɛər] – yalang’och, ochiq; minimum, zaruriy, eng kamida. Siz bu vaziyatda mashhur Real Madrid o’yinchisi Garet {p:BEYL}ni beldan tepasi {h:yalang’och}ligini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:The tree was bare in winter} - Qishda daraxt yalang'och edi.
{r:He stood barefoot on the grass} - U oyoq yalang holda o'tda turardi.
{r:The kid did not hide his bare body} - Bolakay yalang'och tanasini yashirmadi.
{r:The bare truth was told by her inevitably} - Ochiq haqiqat oxir-oqibat u tomonidan aytildi.

text: {r:Subtle}[ˈsʌtəl] – bilinar-bilinmas, ko’z ilg’amas, sezilmas; ustalik bilan, mohirona, nozik. “Shoushenkdan qochish” filmini ko’rganmisiz? Qahramon yigit 20 yil davomida qamoqxona devorini teshib chiqqan qumlarni shimlariga chang sifatida yopishtirib tashqariga chiqib qoqib tashlagan. Samarqandda ham bir maxbus 5 yil davomida devorni teshib chiqqan qumni {p:SATIL}ga {h:bilinar-bilinmas} qilib ishqalab keyin hammomga kirib satilini yuvib tashlagan va u ham qochib ketishga muvaffaq bo’lgan. Ba'zi bir shevalarda satil 'chelak' degani.
examples: {r:Subtle colors were present on the painting} - Rasmda nozik ranglar bor edi.
{r:A subtle hint was made by him} - Nozik ishora uning tomonidan qilindi.
{r:The difference was subtle} - Farq bilinar-bilinmas edi.
{r:A subtle change was noticed by her} - Nozik o'zgarish uning tomonidan sezildi.

text: {r:Pump}[pʌmp] – nasos; nasos bilan chiqarmoq, nasoslamoq, dam bermoq. Tasavvur qiling chaqaloqlar yanada go’zal ko’rinishi uchun {h:nasoslangan} {p:PAMP}erslar sotilyapti.
examples: {r:The pump was used to water the plants} - O'simliklarni sug'orish uchun nasos ishlatildi.
{r:Air was pumped by him into the tire} - Shinaga havo uning tomonidan berildi.
{r:Blood is pumped by the heart} - Qon yurak tomonidan aylantiriladi(nasoslanadi).
{r:He was brutally beaten for stealing the pump.} - U nasosni o'g'irlagani uchun shafqatsiz kaltaklandi.

text: {r:Candy}[ˈkændi] – shirinlik, qand. Hindistonlik ayollarning sarisi ularning qorin va kindigini qoplamaydi. Hind ayollari erlariga men qanddek shirinman deyish uchun {p:KINDI}klariga {h:oqqand} suqib yurishadi.
examples: {r:A piece of candy was given to him by her} - Unga bir bo'lak konfet uning tomonidan berildi.
{r:The candy was slightly sweet} - Konfet biroz shirin edi.
{r:A bag of candy was bought by him} - Bir paket konfet uning tomonidan sotib olindi.
{r:The candy store was colorful} - Konfet do'koni rang-barang edi.

text: {r:Urge}[ɜːrdʒ] – undamoq; undov, istak. Futbol terma jamoamizning ashaddiy muxlisiman. Vatanim oldidagi b{p:URCH}im meni har safar stadionga borib o’yinni tomosha qilishga va jamoa yutqazib qo’ysa futbolchilarni so’kishga {h:undaydi.}(Namuna uchun yozildi. So'kinish tarafdori emasmiz.)
examples: {r:An urge to travel was felt by her} - Sayohat qilish undovini u his qildi.
{r:Julia was urged to stay by him} - U Juliani qolishga undadi.
{r:The urge to eat was strong} - Ovqatlanish istagi kuchli edi.
{r:The urge to laugh was resisted by her} - Kulish istagiga u qarshilik ko'rsatdi.
{r:I urged my brother to take part in the gathering.} - Men akamni yig'ilishda qatnashishga undadim.

text: {r:Negotiate}[nɪˈɡoʊʃieɪt] – muzokara olib bormoq. Bozorda kiyim sotib olib olayotgan vaqtimda kiyimning narxi menga biroz qimmatlik qildi lekin kiyim ham yoqdi. Nima qilishni bilmay turganimda qo’shnim {p:NIGOSH SHAT}ta kelib sotuvchi bilan {h:muzokaralar} olib borib narxni tushirib tashladi.
examples: {r:The contract was negotiated by them} - Shartnoma uchun ular tomonidan muzokaralar olib borildi.
{r:A better deal was negotiated by him} - Yaxshiroq shartnoma u tomonidan tuzildi.
{r:The bald manager shared a plan to negotiate better prices.} – Sochlari to‘kilgan menejer yaxshiroq narxlar uchun muzokara qilish rejasini o'rtoqlashdi.
{r:Her salary was negotiated by her} - Uning maoshi o'zi tomonidan muzokara qilindi.

text: {r:Manufacture}[ˌmænjuˈfæktʃər] – ishlab chiqarmoq.
examples: {r:Cars get manufactured by the company} - Avtomobillar kompaniya tomonidan ishlab chiqariladi.
{r:The product is manufactured in China} - Mahsulot Xitoyda ishlab chiqariladi.
{r:Overall, high-quality watches are manufactured by them} - Umuman olganda yuqori sifatli soatlar ular tomonidan ishlab chiqariladi.
{r:Electronics are manufactured by the factory} - Zavod tomonidan elektronika ishlab chiqariladi.

text: {r:Peasant}[ˈpɛzənt] – dehqon. Tushingizda o’rta asrlardagi bir qirolikka tushib qolibsiz. Qirol bir safar yaxshi chiqmagan ovqat tufayli saroydagi barcha {p:PAZAND}a oshpazlarni saroydan quvib qishloqda {h:dehqon} bo’lib ishlashga majburlabdi. “Kartoshka, piyozlarni isrof qildilaringmi endi o’zlaring dehqon bo’lib sabzavot yetishtirasilar” debdi.
examples: {r:It is said that the peasant worked hard in the fields} - Dehqon dalada qattiq ishladi deyishadi.
{r:The life of a peasant is supposed to be hard} - Dehqon hayoti odatda qiyin bo'ladi.
{r:It is believed that the peasant grew various vegetables} - Dehqon turli sabzavotlar yetishtirgan deb ishoniladi.
{r:The village was said to be full of peasants} - Qishloq dehqonlar bilan to'la bo'lgan deyishdi.

text: {r:Revolt}[rɪˈvoʊlt] – qo'zg'olon qilmoq, bosh ko'tarmoq. Bunyodkorda futbol o'ynagan mashhur Braziliyalik {p:RIVALD}oni eslaysizmi. 2008 - yili bizda futbol o'ynagan Rivaldo oradan 15 yil o'tib klubga {h:bosh ko'tarish}ga qaror qildi va klub unga kam pul to'laganini da'vo qilyapti.
examples: {r:It is said that the peasants started a revolt inevitably} - Dehqonlar qo'zg'olonni oxir-oqibatda boshlagan deyishyapti.
{r:The revolt was supposed to be quickly suppressed} - Qo'zg'olon tezda bostirilishi kerak edi (kutilgan edi).
{r:He is said to have joined the revolt against the king} - U shoxga qarshi qo'zg'olonga qo'shilgan deyishadi.

{r:The new policy caused a domestic revolt among farmers who felt unfairly treated.} - Yangi siyosat o'zlarini adolatsiz munosabatda bo'lgan deb hisoblagan fermerlar orasida ichki qo'zg'olonni keltirib chiqardi.
{r:Prisoners attempted to revolt and escape from jail.} - Mahbuslar qo'zg'olon ko'tarib, qamoqdan qochishga urindilar.

text: {r:Combat}[ˈkɒmbæt] – jang qilmoq, olishmoq; jang, olishuv. Mashhur Mortal {p:KOMBAT} o’yinini o’ynaganlar ko’p bo’lsa kerak. Agar bu o’yinni bilsangiz combat so’zining ham ma’nosini taxmin qilishingiz va nima ekanligini fahmlashingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:It is said that the soldiers are trained for combat.} - Askarlar jang qilishga o'rgatilgan deyishadi.
{r:He is believed to have been injured in combat.} - U jangda yaralanganiga ishoniladi.
{r:The soldiers are supposed to be prepared for combat.} - Askarlar jangga tayyor bo'lishi kerak.
{r:They are not supposed to engage in combat without orders.} - Ular buyruqsiz jangga kirishishi taqiqlanadi.

text: {r:Hunter}[ˈhʌntər] – ovchi. Mnemonik namuna uchun 113 darsdagi hunt so'ziga qarang.
examples: {r:It is alleged that the hunter set traps in the forest.} - Ovchi o'rmonda tuzoqlar qo'ygani da'vo qilinmoqda.
{r:The hunter is reported to have tracked the deer for days.} - Ovchi kiyikni bir necha kun kuzatgani haqida xabar berilmoqda.
{r:The hunter is supposed to return with a rabbit.} - Ovchi quyon bilan qaytishi kutilmoqda.
{r:The hunter is not supposed to hunt in the restricted area.} - Ovchiga taqiqlangan hududda ov qilishga ruxsat berilmaydi.

text: {r:Flour}[ˈflaʊər] – un. Bu so'z flower(gul) bilan bir xil talaffuz qilinadi. Tasavvur qiling gulni quritib va maydalab un qilish mumkin.
examples: {r:It is thought that she bought a bag of flour.} - U bir qop un sotib olgan deb o'ylashyapti.
{r:An ancient market sold flour and many spicy foods.} – Qadimiy bozorda un va ko‘plab achchiq taomlar sotilardi.
{r:The flour is supposed to be used for baking bread.} - Undan non pishirish uchun foydalanilishi kerak.
{r:The flour is not supposed to be stored in a humid place.} - Unni nam joyda saqlash mumkin emas.

text: {r:Curve}[kɜːrv] – bukmoq, qayirmoq;burilish, qayrilish. Tasavvur qiling siz ertayu-kech {p:KO'RP}a {h:qayirish} bilan shug'ullanasiz.
examples: {r:The road is considered to have a sharp curve.} - Yo'lda keskin burilish bor deb hisoblanadi.
{r:The river is expected to follow a gentle curve.} - Daryo muloyim egri chiziq bo'ylab oqishi kutilmoqda.
{r:She is supposed to draw a curve on the paper.} - U qog'ozga egri chiziq chizishi kerak.
{r:He curved the wire with his hands.} – U simni qo‘llari bilan egdi.

text: {r:Closet}[ˈklɒzɪt] – devoriy shkaf. Oh bratan namuncha ozib ketdingiz. {p:KILOYIZ IT}tiki bilan bir xil bo’lib qolibdiku. {h:Devoriy shkaf}ga osilib chiqvosangiz shu mo’rt shkaf ham qiyshaymaydi, joyidan siljimaydi.
examples: {r:It is said that her dress was hung in the closet.} - Uning ko'ylagi shkafga osilgan deyishadi.
{r:The closet is believed to be full of clothes.} - Shkaf kiyimlar bilan to'la ekanligiga ishoniladi.
{r:The closet door is supposed to be closed.} - Shkaf eshigi yopiq turishi kerak.
{r:You are not supposed to put heavy items in the closet.} - Shkafga og'ir narsalar qo'yishingiz mumkin emas.

text: {r:Pig}[pɪɡ] – cho’chqa. Koreys restoraniga kirib {p:PIG}udi sotib oldingiz. Lekin PIGudi {h:cho’chqa} go’shtidan qilinganini eshitib qusib yubordingiz.
examples: {r:It is alleged that the pig ate all the food.} - Cho'chqa barcha ovqatni yeb qo'yganligi da'vo qilinmoqda.
{r:The pig is reported to have rolled in the mud.} - Cho'chqa loyga dumalaganligi haqida xabar berilmoqda.
{r:Pigs are supposed to be raised by the farmer.} - Fermer cho'chqalarni boqishi kerak.
{r:You are not supposed to feed the pig with sugar.} - Cho'chqaga shakar berishingiz mumkin emas.

text: {r:Fold}[foʊld] – qayirmoq, buklamoq. {p:FOLT}chining aytishicha men hozirgi arzon telefonimni {h:qayirib}, {h:buklab} tashlasam keyin menga kimdir Ayfon Pro Maks sovg’a qilar ekan.
examples: {r:It is thought that the map was folded into a square.} - Xarita kvadrat shaklga buklangan deb o‘ylashadi.
{r:The letter is understood to have been folded neatly by her.} - Xat uning tomonidan tartibli qilib buklangani tushunilgan.
{r:The chair is supposed to be folded for storage.} - Stulni saqlash uchun buklash kerak deb hisoblanadi.
{r:You are not supposed to fold the clothes that have just been ironed.} - Endigina dazmollangan kiyimlarni qayirish kerak emas.

text: {r:Survive}[sərˈvaɪv] – tirik qolmoq, omon qolmoq, yashamoq. Bizning mahallamizda so’rovnoma o’tkazishyapti ekan. {p:So’r}ovnoma {p:vayf}ay olib kelish haqida emish. Ha Baraka topgirlar bizni {h:yashashimiz omonligimiz} uchun kerak bo’lgan toza suv olib kelishsin avval. Ikkilamchi ehtiyoj keyin ham qondirilaveradi.
examples: {r:It is considered that many ancient traditions have survived for centuries.} - Ko'plab qadimiy an'analar asrlar davomida saqlanib qolgan deb hisoblanadi.
{r:These species is thought to have survived for millions of years.} - Bu turlar millionlab yillar davomida omon qolgan deb o'ylashyapti.
{r:The plants are expected to survive the drought.} - O'simliklar qurg'oqchilikdan omon qolishi kutilmoqda.
{r:The species is not supposed to survive in this polluted environment.} - Tur bu ifloslangan muhitda yashab qolishi kutilmaydi.
{r:Many ancient traditions have survived for centuries.} - Ko'plab qadimiy an'analar asrlar davomida saqlanib qolgan.

text: {r:Beef}[biːf] – mol go’shti. Tasavvur qiling xotiningiz sizga {p:BIF}shteks tayyorlab berdi faqat {h:mol go’shti}dan makaroni ham, kotleti ham. Pyurisi ham xatto go’shtdan.
examples: {r:It is said that the beef was tender and juicy.} - Mol go'shti yumshoq va shirali bo'lgan deyishadi.
{r:Beef is believed to have been cooked by her for dinner.} - Kechki ovqat uchun mol go'shti u tomonidan pishirilganiga ishoniladi.
{r:You are supposed to eat beef constantly to gain weight.} - Vazn olish uchun doim mol go'shti yeb turishingiz kerak.
{r:You are not supposed to eat raw beef.} - Xom mol go'shti yeyishga ruxsat berilmaydi.

text: {r:Ban}[bæn] – taqiqlamoq; taqiq. {p:BEN}om guruhining nomi bo’lmaganligi uchun litsenziyasini olib qo’yib qo’shiq aytishni {h:taqiqlab} qo’yishibdi.
examples: {r:It is alleged that the ban affected many businesses.} - Taqiq ko'plab bizneslarga ta'sir ko'rsatgani da'vo qilinmoqda.
{r:The ban is reported to have been imposed by the government.} - Taqiq hukumat tomonidan qo'yilganligi haqida xabar berilmoqda.
{r:The ban is supposed to be lifted after the protests.} - Taqiq noroziliklardan keyin olib tashlanishi kerak.
{r:Smoking is not banned in this area.} - Bu hududda chekish taqiqlanmagan.

text: {r:Removal}[rɪˈmuːvəl] – olib tashlash, sug'urish. Remove(olib tashlamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It is thought that the removal of the old furniture was scheduled by her.} - Eski mebellarni olib tashlash u tomonidan rejalashtirilgan deb o'ylashyapti.
{r:The removal of the statue is believed to have caused controversy.} - Haykalni olib tashlash bahs-munozaralarga sabab bo'lganiga ishonishyapti.
{r:The removal process is supposed to be quick.} - Olib tashlash jarayoni tez bo'lishi kerak.
{r:The workers are not supposed to handle the removal without gloves.} - Ishchilar olib tashlashni qo'lqopsiz amalga oshirishga ruxsat berilmaydi.

text: {r:Punishment}[ˈpʌnɪʃmənt] – jazo. Punish(jazolamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It is considered that the punishment should fit the crime.} - Jazo jinoyatga mos kelishi kerak deb hisoblanadi.
{r:He is expected to receive punishment for his actions.} - U o'z harakatlari uchun jazo olishi kutilmoqda.
{r:Extra homework is supposed to be given as punishment.} - Qo'shimcha uy vazifasi jazo sifatida berilishi kerak.
{r:The punishment is not supposed to be cruel or unusual.} - Jazo shafqatsiz yoki g'ayrioddiy bo'lmasligi kerak.

text: {r:Confession}[kənˈfɛʃən] – iqror bo'lish, tan olish. Confess(tan olmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It is said that a confession was made by him to the police.} - U politsiyaga iqror bo'lgan deyishadi.
{r:The confession is believed to have led to his arrest.} - Iqrorlik uning qo'lga olinishiga olib kelganiga ishoniladi.
{r:The confession is supposed to be recorded.} - Iqrorlik yozib olinishi kerak.
{r:A confession is not supposed to be forced out of anyone.} - Hech kimdan iqrorlik majburlab olinmasligi kerak.

text: {r:Magician}[məˈdʒɪʃən] – sehrgar. Magic(sehr) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It is alleged that the magician pulled a rabbit out of a hat.} - Sehrgar shlyapadan quyon chiqarganligi da'vo qilinmoqda.
{r:The magician is reported to have performed amazing tricks.} - Sehrgar ajoyib fokuslar ko'rsatgani haqida xabar berilmoqda.
{r:The children are expected to be amazed by the magician.} - Bolalar sehrgardan hayratda qolishi kutilmoqda.
{r:The magician is not supposed to reveal his secrets.} - Sehrgar o'z sirlarini ochmasligi kerak.

text: {r:Accelerate}[əkˈsɛləreɪt] – tezlashtirmoq, oshirmoq. Javohir issiqxona quryapti ekinzori o’rniga, selofan yopishni boshladi buning uchun, ammo birdan politsiya xodimlari {p:ekinzorla}ga {p:reyd} o’tkazib uning xonadiga kirib kelishdi. Dastavval Javohirni noqonuniy giyohvand modda yetishtiryapti deb o’ylagan Politsiya xodimlari, ular yanglishgan ekanliklarini tan olishdi. Javohir esa ‘’Bo’ldi endi men ishlashim kerak, sizlarga ruxsat, {h:tezlashing’’} dedi.
examples: {r:The company is thought to have accelerated its growth.} - Kompaniya o'sishini tezlashtirgan deb o'ylashyapti.
{r:The doctors tried to accelerate his recovery, hoping to keep him alive.} - Shifokorlar uni tirik saqlash umidida uning tuzalishini tezlashtirishga harakat qilishdi.
{r:The car is supposed to accelerate quickly.} - Mashina tezda tezlashishi kerak.
{r:You are not supposed to accelerate in a residential area.} - Turar-joy hududida tezlikni oshirishga ruxsat berilmaydi.

text: {r:Resume}[rɪˈzuːm] – qaytadan boshlamoq, davom ettirmoq(to'xtagan faoliyatning yana davom etishi). Endi nafaqat ishga kirish uchun balki institutda o’qish uchun ham rezyume tayyorlash kerak. Bizning dekanimiz “Hamma o’zi haqida {p:REZYUM}e tayyolagandan keyingina o’qishni {h:davom ettirishi mumkin.} Aks holda o’qishni to’xtatib turishingiz mumkin” dedi.
examples: {r:Her work is considered to have been resumed after the break.} - Uning ishi tanaffusdan keyin davom ettirilgan deb hisoblanadi.
{r:The meeting is expected to resume at 3 PM.} - Yig'ilish soat 3 da davom etishi kutilmoqda.
{r:The game is supposed to resume after the rain stops.} - Yomg'ir to'xtagach, o'yin davom etishi kerak.
{r:You are not supposed to resume your work without permission.} - Ruxsatsiz ishingizni davom ettirishga ruxsat berilmaydi.

text: {r:Postpone}[poʊstˈpoʊn] – kechiktirmoq, keyinga qoldirmoq. Men yurtimga posbon bo'lishni niyat qildim. Armiyaga borishim kechikib ketaverdi. Chunki singillarimni uzatdim, akamni uylab qo'ydim, keyin uy qurdim. {h:Kechikib bo'lsada} 40 yoshda {p:POSBON} bo'ldim va 42 yoshda uylandim.
examples: {r:It is said that the meeting was postponed by them.} - Yig'ilish ular tomonidan keyinga qoldirilgan deyishyapti.
{r:Her trip is believed to have been postponed once again.} - Uning safari yana bir marta keyinga qoldirilganiga ishoniladi.
{r:The decision is supposed to be postponed until next week.} - Qaror keyingi haftagacha qoldirilishi kerak.
{r:The event is not supposed to be postponed without a valid reason.} - Voqea asosli sababsiz qoldirilmasligi kerak.

text: {r:Hesitate}[ˈhɛzɪteɪt] – ikkilanmoq, o’ylanmoq. Agar kimdir tunda xonangizga bostirib kirib qurol o’xtalib “{p:XAZINANI AYT} qayerdaligini” desa nima deyishni bilmay {h:ikkilanib} qolsangiz kerak.
examples: {r:It is alleged that she hesitated to ask for help.} - U yordam so'rashdan ikkilangani da'vo qilinmoqda.
{r:They are reported to have hesitated to make a decision.} - Ular qaror qabul qilishda ikkilanishgani haqida xabar berilmoqda.
{r:You are not supposed to hesitate to chase your dreams.} - Siz orzularingizga erishishda ikkilanmasligingiz kerak.
{r:The leader is not supposed to hesitate in a crisis.} - Lider inqirozda ikkilanmasligi kerak.

text: {r:Renew}[rɪˈnuː] – yangilatmoq, yangilamoq. Re(qayta) va new(yangi) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I had my passport renewed last week} - O'tgan hafta pasportimni yangilatdim.
{r:She got her driver’s license renewed at the office} - U ofisda haydovchilik guvohnomasini yangilatdi.
{r:We had our membership renewed for another year} - A'zoligimizni yana bir yilga uzaytirdik.
{r:They got their contract renewed by the manager} - Ular shartnomalarini menejer tomonidan yangilatdilar.
{r:We need to negotiate terms to renew the contract before it expires.} - Muddat tugashidan oldin shartnomani yangilash shartlarini muzokara qilishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Expansion}[ɪkˈspænʃən] – kengaytirish, kengayish. Expand(kengaymoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The company had its office expansion completed last month} - Kompaniya o'tgan oy ofisini kengaytirishni tugattirdi.
{r:We got the expansion plans approved by the board} - Kengaytirish rejalarini direktorlar kengashi tomonidan tasdiqlatdik.
{r:The company is actually planning an expansion next year.} – Kompaniya aslida kelasi yili kengayishni rejalashtirmoqda.
{r:She got the expansion project funded by investors} - U loyihani investorlar tomonidan moliyalashtirdi.

text: {r:Allegation}[ˌæləˈɡeɪʃən] – da'vo, ayblov. Allege(da'vo qilmoq, ayblamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He had the allegations investigated by a private detective} - U da'volarni xususiy detektiv tomonidan tekshirtirdi.
{r:They got the false allegations dismissed in court} - Ular sudda yolg'on da'volarni rad ettirdilar.
{r:Despite the allegation, the scar did not prove his involvement.} - Ayblovga qaramay, chandiq uning ishtirokini isbotlamadi.
{r:We got the allegations against us dropped by providing evidence} - Dalillar taqdim etib, bizga qarshi da'volarni olib tashlatdik.
{r:The environmental group made an allegation that the company failed to conserve energy.} - Ekologik guruh kompaniya energiyani tejashga muvaffaq bo'lmaganligi haqida ayblov qo'ydi.

text: {r:Sentence}[ˈsɛntəns] – hukm qilmoq. 'Gap' ma'nosini bildiruvchi ushbu so'z jinoyatchilarga nisbatan ishlatilganda 'hukm qilmoq' ma'nosini bildiradi.
examples: {r:The judge sentenced him to five years in prison} - Sudya uni besh yilga qamoq jazosiga hukm qildi.
{r:My niece was sentenced to community service for her crime} - Jiyanim jinoyati uchun jamoat xizmatiga hukm qilindi.
{r:They sentenced the suspect based on strong evidence} - Ular gumondorni mustahkam dalillarga asoslanib hukm qilishdi.
{r:The judge gave a long jail sentence.} - Sudya uzoq muddatli qamoq jazosini tayinladi.

text: {r:Cow}[kaʊ] – sigir. Mana bu {p:KAV}ush {h:sigir}ning oshlangan terisidan qilingan. O’tda yonmaydi, pichoq bilan kesilmaydi. Asteroid ustiga qulasa ham yo’q bo’lib ketmaydi.
examples: {r:The farmer had his cows vaccinated by the vet} - Fermer sigirlarini veterinar tomonidan emlatdi.
{r:She got the cow milked in advance} - U bugun ertalab sigirni ertaroq sog'dirdi.

{r:There is a surprising similarity between the digestive system of a cow and some other herbivores.} - Sigirning hazm qilish tizimi va boshqa o'txo'r hayvonlarning hazm qilish tizimi o'rtasida ajablanarli o'xshashlik bor.
{r:We got the cow’s health checked by an expert} - Biz sigirning sog'ligini mutaxassis tomonidan tekshirtirdik.

text: {r:Drown}[draʊn] – cho'kmoq. O'zbekistonda drondan foydalanish mumkin emas. Lekin men chet davlatdan komponentlarini sotib olib o'zim uyda yasadim. Baribir bu sohani professionali emasman {p:DRON} yomg'ir payti suvga qulab {h:cho'kib ketdi}.
examples: {r:He had his sorrows drowned in work} - U qayg‘ularini ishga ko‘mib yubordi.
{r:They got the noise drowned out by playing loud music} - Ular baland musiqani chalib shovqinni bosdirdilar.
{r:My friend drowned in the lake and he got rescued by the guards} - Mening do'stim ko'lda cho'kib ketgan va qo'riqchilar uni qutqarib qolishgan.
{r:Enemies tried to drown me but they could not do so} - Dushmanlarim meni cho'ktirmoqchi bo'ldi lekin bunday qilolmadi.

text: {r:Implement}[ˈɪmplɪˌmɛnt] – amalga oshirmoq, amaliyotga tadbiq qilmoq, joriy etmoq. Yaqin do’stingiz ment bo’lib ishlaydi va xizmat vazifasini o’tash chog’ida urib tishini qiyshaytirib qo’yishdi. Endi {p:IMPL}ant qo’ydirmoqchi {p:MENT} do’stingiz. Lekin buni {h:amalga tadbiq qilish} uchun 500$ pul kerak unga.
examples: {r:The company had the new system implemented by IT experts} - Kompaniya yangi tizimni IT mutaxassislari tomonidan joriy qildi.
{r:She got the changes implemented quickly} - U o'zgarishlarni tez amalga oshirdi.
{r:They had the policy implemented nationwide} - Ular siyosatni butun mamlakat bo'ylab joriy qildilar.
{r:The company will implement new safety measures at the facility.} - Kompaniya inshootda yangi xavfsizlik choralarini joriy qiladi.

text: {r:Rumor}[ˈruːmər] – g’iybat. “{p:RUM}ka {p:MIR}za ko’tarib olibdi to’yda ko’rdim. Keyin konsert paytida ham ozgina mast edi. Alkash bo’lib ketgan Mirzabek” degan {h:g’iybat}lar ko’payibdi Mirzabek Xolmedov haqida keyin bilsam u rol ijro etyapti ekan.
examples: {r:He had the rumor investigated by his team} - U mish-mishni o'z jamoasi tomonidan tekshirtirdi.
{r:She got the false rumor dismissed by providing evidence} - U dalillar taqdim etib yolg'on mish-mishni rad ettirdi.
{r:They had the rumor spread by someone in the office} - Ular mish-mishni ofisdagi bir kishi tomonidan tarqatishdi.
{r:We got the rumor clarified by speaking to the source} - Biz manbaga murojaat qilib mish-mishni aniqlatdik.

text: {r:Longtime}[ˈlɒŋˌtaɪm] – uzoq yillik, uzoq vaqt. Long(uzoq) va time(vaqt) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He had his longtime dream fulfilled by traveling the world} - U o'zining uzoq yillik orzusini dunyoni kezib amalga oshirdi.
{r:She got her longtime project completed with the help of her team} - U o'zining uzoq yillik loyihasini jamoasi yordamida tugatdi.
{r:They had their longtime friendship celebrated with a party} - Ular o'zlarining uzoq yillik do'stligini ziyofat bilan nishonladilar.
{r:My longtime friend offended me badly} - Mening uzoq yillik do'stim yomon xafa qildi.

text: {r:Restrict}[rɪˈstrɪkt] – cheklamoq, taqiqlamoq. Mana bu baliq restorani. Oldinlari bu yerda tirik baliq ham sotilardi. Lekin hozir {p:REST}oranda {p:TIRIK} baliq sotish {h:cheklangan}.
examples: {r:The government had access to the area restricted by the police} - Hukumat hududga kirishni politsiya tomonidan cheklatdi.
{r:She got her social media use restricted by her parents} - U ota-onasi tomonidan ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan foydalanishi cheklandi.
{r:We should immediately restrict our expenses} - Biz zudlik bilan xarajatlarni cheklashimiz kerak.
{r:We got the rules restricted to ensure safety} - Xavfsizlikni ta'minlash uchun qoidalarni cheklatdik.

text: {r:Frost}[frɒst] – muzlash, qirov. Tasavvur qiling shunchalik sovuq bo'ldiki tomoqni chayish uchun olib kelingan {p:FURATS}ilin(chayqash uchun sariq dori) ham uy ichida {h:muzlab qoldi}.
examples: {r:They had to postpone the spring planting because of an unexpected late frost.} - Kutilmagan kech sovuq tufayli bahorgi ekishni qoldirishga majbur bo'lishdi.
{r:She had her plants protected from the frost} - U o‘simliklarini qirovdan himoyalatdi.
{r:We should get the pipes insulated before frost season} - Qirov faslidan oldin quvurlarni izolyatsiya qildirishimiz kerak.
{r:The harsh frost damaged the crops, whatever the farmers tried.} – Qattiq sovuq dehqonlar nima qilmasin, hosilga zarar yetkazdi.

text: {r:Nail}[neɪl] – tirnoq. Aytishlaricha {p:NAY L}aklangan qo’l bilan ushlab chalinsa juda ajoyib musiqa chiqar ekan. Shuning uchun erkak kishi bo’lsangiz ham {h:tirnog’ingizni} laklab nay chalmoqchisiz.
examples: {r:We got the broken nail removed at the salon} - Biz singan tirnoqni salonda oldirib tashladik.
{r:She got her nails shaped and polished} - U tirnoqlarini shakllantirib, jilolattirdi.
{r:She got her nails painted for the wedding} - U to‘y uchun tirnoqlarini bo‘yattirdi.
{r:She showed her elegant nails with a wide smile.} – U keng tabassum bilan nafis tirnoqlarini ko‘rsatdi.

text: {r:Soak}[soʊk] – ivitmoq, suvga botirib qo’ymoq; namlamoq, ho’llamoq. Yozda muzlatgichingiz bo’lmasayu siz mazza qilib muzdek dinay {p:SOK}larini ichmoqchi bo’lsangiz shunchaki sokni suvga {h:botirib} qo’ying.
examples: {r:The rain soaked his plain shirt.} – Yomg‘ir uning oddiy ko‘ylagini ho‘l qildi.
{r:They had the beans soaked overnight for cooking} - Ular loviyani pishirish uchun bir kecha suvga solib qo‘ydilar.
{r:I’ll get my feet soaked in warm water after work} - Ishdan keyin oyoqlarimni iliq suvga solib qo‘yaman.
{r:He had his phone ruined by soaking in water} - Uning telefoni suvga tushib buzildi.

text: {r:Companion}[kəmˈpænjən] – hamroh. Mening uyim Bilayn {p:KOMPANIY}asi {p:YON}ida joylashgan. Bu kompaniya oxirgi 10 yilda nafaqat telefon aloqasidagi balki mahallada ham mening {h:hamrohim}ga aylangan.
examples: {r:She got her dog trained as a travel companion} - U itini sayohat hamrohi sifatida o‘rgatdi.
{r:She takes her companion with her whenever she goes to a fancy restaurant.} – U qachon hashamatli restoranga borsa, yoniga hamrohini olib boradi.
{r:I got my sister to accompany me as a companion} - Men singlimni hamroh qilib o‘zim bilan olib ketdim.
{r:He had his best friend act as his companion during the trip} - U safar davomida eng yaqin do‘stini hamroh qilib oldi.

text: {r:Rip}[rɪp] – yirtmoq, yirtilmoq. Mana bu {p:rep}per konsert payti ustidagi futbolkasini {h:yirtib} tashladi va yarim yalang’och konsert berdi.
examples: {r:I got my jeans ripped to look modern} - Mening shimimni zamonaviy ko'rinishi uchun yirttirdim.
{r:She had the old curtains ripped down and replaced} - U eski pardalarni yirtib tashlatib, yangilarini qo‘ydi.
{r:She worries her dress might rip whenever she wears something elegant.} – U nafis kiyim kiyganida ko‘ylagi yirtilib qolishidan xavotirlanadi.
{r:He had his shirt torn in the fight} - U urush paytida ko‘ylagini yirtib yubordi.

text: {r:Drain}[dreɪn] – quritmoq, zaxni qochirmoq; kuchsizlantirmoq, holdan toydirmoq. O’zbek tilida ham drenaj so’zi mavjud bo’lib quritish tizimi ma’nosini bildiradi. Shuning uchun biz bu so’zning ikkinchi ma'nosiga e’tibor berishimiz kerak. Tasavvur qiling siz drenajda ishlaysiz va 12 soat bu yerda mehnat qilish sizni holdan toydiradi.
examples: {r:The ultimate challenge was to prevent the dam from experiencing a total water drain.} - Yakuniy muammo to'g'onning butunlay suvsizlanishini oldini olish edi.
{r:She had the kitchen drain unblocked yesterday} - U kecha oshxonadagi drenajni tozalatdi.
{r:They got the water drained from the flooded basement} - Ular suv bosgan podvaldan suvni chiqartirib yuborishdi.
{r:He had the pool drained for cleaning} - U hovuzni tozalash uchun suvini chiqartirib yubordi.

text: {r:Mud}[mʌd] – loy. Siz bu vaziyatda {p:Mad}ina ismli qizning {h:loy}ga chaplanganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:She got her shoes covered in mud which annoyed her} - U sayr paytida poyabzallarini loyga belab qo‘ydi va bu uni xafa qildi.
{r:They had the muddy car washed at the station} - Ular loyga belangan mashinasini stansiyada yuvdirishdi.
{r:I’ll get these muddy clothes cleaned tomorrow} - Men loyga belangan kiyimlarni ertaga tozalattiraman.
{r:I am supposed to get this mud cleaned} - Men bu loyni tozalattirishim kerak.

text: {r:Privilege}[ˈprɪvəlɪdʒ] – imtiyoz, priveligiya. Imtiyoz so'zini anglatuvchi 'priveligiya so'zi oxirgi paytlarda o'zbek tilida ham keng qo'llanilyapti.
examples: {r:She was granted virtually VIP privileges at the hotel} - Unga mehmonxonada deyarli VIP imtiyozlar berildi.
{r:They had their membership privileges revoked} - Ular a‘zolik imtiyozlaridan mahrum qilindi.
{r:This job gives a lot of privileges} - Bu ish juda ko'p imtiyozlar beradi.
{r:We had special parking privileges assigned at work} - Bizga ish joyida maxsus parkovka imtiyozi berildi.

text: {r:Temple}[ˈtɛmpl] – ibodatxona. Mana bu {p:TEM}ir {p:pl}isos shaklida qilingan dunyodagi eng antiqa {h:ibodatxonalardan} biri, Hindistonda joylashgan.
examples: {r:They got the ancient temple restored by experts} - Ular qadimiy ibodatxonani mutaxassislar tomonidan ta‘mirlatdi.
{r:She had her wrist massaged near the temple area} - U bilagini ibodatxona yaqinida massaj qildirdi.
{r:We’ll get the temple walls cleaned next month} - Biz ibodatxona devorlarini keyingi oyda tozalatamiz.
{r:The temple is just next to that garbage can. Let me accompany you there.} - Ibodatxona ana shu musor qutisining yonida joylashgan.U yergacha hamrohlik qilishimga ruxsat bering.

text: {r:Shift}[ʃɪft] – ko'chirmoq, o'zgartirmoq. Tasavvur qiling yomg'ir payti qalin shifrlaringiz ham uydan suv o'tishini to'xtata olmayapti. Siz esa SHIFrlaringizni {p:shift}ga(potolok) {h:ko'chirishga} qaror qildingiz.
examples: {r:He shifted his chair closer to the table} - U kursisini stolga yaqinroq surdi.
{r:She shifted her focus to a new project, therefore she is too busy} - U e’tiborini yangi loyihaga yo‘naltirdi shuning uchun ham u juda band.
{r:They shifted their strategy to adapt to market changes} - Ular bozor o‘zgarishlariga moslashish uchun strategiyani o‘zgartirishdi.
{r:The company shifted its headquarters to another city} - Kompaniya o‘z bosh qarorgohini boshqa shaharga ko‘chirdi.

text: {r:Persist}[pərˈsɪst] – o’jarlik qilmoq, qaysarlik qilmoq. Mening xotinim kir buyumlarni yuvib qo’yishi uchun Tide va Ariel kir yuvish sodalarini olib keldim lekin ayolim “Menga {p:PERSIL} kerak” deb {h:turib oldi}.
examples: {r:She said that she would persist until she succeeded.} - U muvaffaqiyatga erishmagunicha qat'iy davom etishini aytdi.
{r:He told me that I needed to persist in my efforts.} - U menga harakatlarimda qat'iy bo'lishim kerakligini aytdi.
{r:She persists in her studies every day} - U har kuni o'qishida qat'iyat ko'rsatadi.
{r:They persisted despite the challenges} - Ular qiyinchiliklarga qaramay davom etishdi.
{r:If you persist in your demands, it will be harder to negotiate a compromise.} - Agar o'z talablaringizda qat'iy tursangiz, murosaga kelish qiyinroq bo'ladi.

text: {r:Worsen}[ˈwɜːrsən] – yomonlashmoq. Worse(yomonroq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:He said that the weather was worsening.} - U ob-havo yomonlashayotganini aytdi.
{r:She told me that her health had worsened.} - U menga sog'lig'i yomonlashganini aytdi.
{r:The situation worsened after the meeting} - Uchrashuvdan keyin vaziyat yomonlashdi.
{r:His condition worsened overnight} - Uning ahvoli bir kechada yomonlashdi.

text: {r:Weaken}[ˈwiːkən] – zaiflashmoq. Weak(zaif) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She said that the economy was weakening.} - U iqtisodiyot zaiflashayotganini aytdi.
{r:He told me that his decision had weakened.} - U menga uning qarori zaiflashganini aytdi.
{r:The storm weakened by the evening} - Bo'ron kechgacha zaiflashdi.
{r:Her voice weakened as she spoke} - U gapira boshlaganda ovozi zaiflasha boshladi.
{r:The cat was small and skinny, indicating its weakness.} - Mushuk kichkina va ozg'in edi, bu uning zaifligini ko'rsatardi.(weakness - zaiflik)

text: {r:Soften}[ˈsɒfən] – yumshatmoq. Soft(yumshoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She said that the butter had softened.} - U saryog' yumshab qolganini aytdi.
{r:He told me that her attitude had softened over time.} - U menga uning munosabati vaqt o'tishi bilan yumshaganini aytdi.
{r:The rules softened after the protests} - Noroziliklardan keyin qoidalar yumshatildi.
{r:Her tone softened when she apologized} - U uzr so'raganda ohangi yumshadi.

text: {r:Bull}[bʊl] – ho'kiz. Tasavvur qiling {p:BUL}dozer va {h:ho'kiz} bir-biriga shoxini tirab urushmoqchi.
examples: {r:He said that the bull was very aggressive.} - U ho'kiz juda tajovuzkor ekanini aytdi.
{r:She told me that she had seen a bull in the field.} - U menga dalada ho'kiz ko'rganini aytdi.
{r:The bull attacked the farmer} - Ho'kiz fermerga hujum qildi.
{r:They avoided the bull in the field} - Ular daladagi ho'kizdan qochishdi.

text: {r:Swallow}[ˈswɒloʊ] – yutmoq, yutib yubormoq. Mening mahallamda 100 ga yaqin svarkachi yashaydi. Men ularni yaxshi bilaman. {p:SVA}rkachilar {p:LOV}iya {h:yutadi} ko'zini baquvvatlashtirib ish payti og'rimasligi uchun.
examples: {r:She said that she couldn't swallow that pill.} - U bu dorini yutolmasligini aytdi.
{r:He told me that the bird had swallowed the fish.} - U menga qush baliqni yutib yuborganini aytdi.
{r:She swallowed her pride and apologized} - U mag'rurlikni yutib, uzr so'radi.
{r:The child swallowed the medicine quickly} - Bola dorisini tez yutib yubordi.

text: {r:Motivate}[ˈmoʊtɪveɪt] – motivatsiya bermoq, ruhlantirmoq.
examples: {r:She said that that speech would motivate everyone.} - U bu nutq hammaga ilhom berishini aytdi.
{r:Temur told me that he had been motivated by Durdona's words.} - Temur menga Durdonaning so'zlari uni ilhomlantirganini aytdi.
{r:The coach motivated the team before the game} - Murabbiy o'yin oldidan jamoani ruhlantirdi.
{r:They motivated each other to keep going} - Ular bir-birlarini davom etishga undashdi.

text: {r:Fraud}[frɔːd] – firibgarlik, qalloblik. "Iye qani meni sochim, parigimni yechib olib ketishibdi" deb uyg'ondim bugun ertalab. Keyin parigimni opketib qolgan {h:firibgar} xonadoshim {p:FARHOD} kal bo'lib chiqdi.
examples: {r:He said that the company had committed fraud.} - U kompaniya firibgarlik qilganini aytdi.
{r:She told me that she had been a victim of fraud.} - U menga firibgarlik qurboni bo'lganini aytdi.
{r:The fraud was discovered by the auditors} - Auditorlar firibgarlikni fosh qilishdi.
{r:They reported the fraud to the police} - Ular firibgarlik haqida politsiyaga xabar berishdi.

text: {r:Tremble}[ˈtrɛmbəl] – qaltiramoq. Biz jo'ralarimiz bilan {p:TRAMPL}indan sakrashga bordik. Tepalikdan qo'rqadigan odam sifatida men rosa {h:qaltiradim} va sakramaslikka qaror qildim.
examples: {r:She said that she had trembled with fear.} - U qo'rquvdan qaltiraganini aytdi.
{r:He told me that the ground had trembled during the earthquake.} - U menga zilzila paytida yer qaltiraganini aytdi.
{r:Her hands trembled as she spoke} - U gapirganda qo'llari qaltirardi.
{r:The dog trembled in the cold} - It sovuqda qaltirardi.
{r:I could feel my hands tremble slightly as I prepared to negotiate the final price.} - Yakuniy narxni muzokara qilishga tayyorlanar ekanman, qo'llarim biroz titraganini his qildim.

text: {r:Cave}[keɪv] – g'or. Tasavvur qiling zamburug'lar tishingiz {p:KAV}aklarini {h:g'or} qilib olib yashyapti.
examples: {r:He said that they had explored the cave the day before.} - Ular g'orni oldingi kuni kashf etganliklarini aytdi.
{r:She told me that the cave was very dark.} - U menga g'or juda qorong'u ekanligini aytdi.
{r:They entered the cave cautiously} - Ular ehtiyotkorlik bilan g'orga kirishdi.
{r:The cave was filled with bats} - G'or ko'rshapalaklar bilan to'lgan edi.

text: {r:Facilitate}[fəˈsɪlɪteɪt] – imkon tug’dirmoq, osonlashtirmoq. Hozirgi kunda robotlar miyasidagi sun’iy intellekt dasturi qandolatchi robotlarga {p:FASLLI TORT}lar qilish {h:imkonini beryapti.} Robot qandolatchi bu vaziyatda sanani tekshiradi va faslga qarab to’rtni bezatadi. Yani tortdagi ranglar va dizayn hozirgi faslga mos bo’ladi.
examples: {r:She said that the new software would facilitate their work} - U yangi dastur ularning ishini osonlashtirishini aytdi.
{r:The new platform will combine various tools to facilitate remote work effectively.} - Yangi platforma masofaviy ishlarni samarali tashkil etish uchun turli vositalarni birlashtiradi.
{r:They said the guide would facilitate our museum tour} - Ular qo‘llanma bizning muzey ekskursiyamizni osonlashtirishini aytdi.
{r:The manager said that the meeting had been facilitated by the new technology} - Menejer yangi texnologiya uchrashuvni osonlashtirganini aytdi.
{r:A good teacher is capable of facilitating learning for all students.} - Yaxshi o'qituvchi barcha talabalar uchun o'rganishni osonlashtirishga qodir.

text: {r:Overwhelmed}[ˌoʊvərˈwɛlmd] – o’zini yo’qotib qo’ygan, hayratga tushgan, larzaga kelgan. Men yozuvchi adibman. Yaqinda “{p:OVOR}a {p:VELIKD}A yuribman tentirab” nomli kitobim 1 millionda nusxada sotildi va menga 2 million dollar daromad olib keldi va men {h:o’zimni yo’qotib qo’ydim}.
examples: {r:He said that he was overwhelmed with responsibilities} - U mas'uliyatlardan o'zini yo'qotib qo'yganini aytdi.
{r:She said the news had overwhelmed her completely} - U xabar uni butunlay hayratga solganini aytdi.
{r:They said that the workload had overwhelmed their team} - Ular ish yuki jamoani haddan tashqari charchatganini aytdilar.
{r:The student said the exam questions had overwhelmed him} - Talaba imtihon savollari uni qiynab qo'yganini aytdi.

text: {r:Motive}[ˈmoʊtɪv] – sabab. Asosan jinoyatlarning sababiga nisbatan ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:The detective said he knew the criminal's motive} - Detektiv jinoyatchining sababini bilishini aytdi.
{r:She said jealousy had been the main motive} - U hasad asosiy sabab bo‘lganini aytdi.
{r:They said that financial gain was the suspect's motive} - Ular gumondorning moliyaviy foydani maqsad qilganini aytdilar.
{r:He said that no one understood his true motives} - U hech kim uning asl niyatlarini tushunmasligini aytdi.

text: {r:Flood}[flʌd] – toshqin; suv toshmoq. Yekaterinburgga {p:VLAD}imir Putin tashrif buyurgan payti shaharga {h:suv toshib ketdi.}(Namuna uchun yozildi)
examples: {r:The reporter said that the flood had destroyed virtually 20 homes} - Muhbir suv toshqini deyarli 20 ta uylarni vayron qilganini aytdi.
{r:She said that the river might flood again next week} - U daryo kelasi haftada yana toshishi mumkinligini aytdi.
{r:They said that the basement had flooded during the storm} - Ular bo‘ron paytida podvalni suv bosganini aytdilar.
{r:He said the government should prepare for more floods} - U hukumat yana suv toshqinlariga tayyorlanishi kerakligini aytdi.

text: {r:Nightmare}[ˈnaɪtmeər] – yomon tush; dahshat. Tasavvur qiling siz kecha {h:yomon tush} ko’rdingiz. Tushingiz esa {p:NAY} chalayotgan {p:MAYR}am ismli qiz bilan boshlandi. Keyin sizlarga o’zga sayyoraliklar hujum qildi. Sizlar bunkerga qochdingiz va hokazo…
examples: {r:She said that the accident had been a complete nightmare} - U baxtsiz hodisa haqiqiy dahshat bo‘lganini aytdi.
{r:Having to postpone the wedding for a second time was a complete nightmare.} - To'yni ikkinchi marta qoldirishga majbur bo'lish butunlay dahshatli tush edi.
{r:They said that the project deadline was becoming a nightmare} - Ular loyiha muddatining dahshatga aylanayotganini aytdilar.
{r:The patient said that she had recurring nightmares} - Bemor takroriy dahshatli tushlar ko‘rayotganini aytdi.

text: {r:Possess}[pəˈzɛs] – egalik qilmoq, bor bo’lmoq. {p:PAZ}anda {p:ES}meraldaning oshiqlari {h:bor.} Bittasi Xose Armando yana bittasi doktor Malaver. Ikkalasi ham Esmeraldaning ovqatlari orqali sevib qolgan.
examples: {r:The teacher said that he possessed rare knowledge} - Oʻqituvchi noyob bilimga ega ekanini aytdi.
{r:She said the museum possessed ancient artifacts} - U muzeyda qadimiy artefaktlar borligini aytdi.
{r:They said that the suspect possessed illegal weapons} - Ular gumondor noqonuniy qurollarga ega ekanini aytdilar.
{r:You must be aware of the responsibility you possess with this power.} - Siz bu kuch bilan sizga tegishli bo'lgan mas'uliyatdan xabardor bo'lishingiz kerak.
{r:Great leaders often possess the ability to influence large groups of people.} - Buyuk rahbarlar ko'pincha katta guruh odamlarga ta'sir ko'rsatish qobiliyatiga ega.
{r:Even with limited resources, they somehow possess the ability to achieve great things.} - Cheklangan resurslarga qaramay, ular qandaydir tarzda buyuk ishlarni amalga oshirish qobiliyatiga ega.

text: {r:Consistently}[kənˈsɪstəntli] – barqaror, doimiy. Consistent so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:The coach said that the team needed to perform consistently} - Murabbiy jamoa doimiy ravishda yaxshi oʻynashi kerakligini aytdi.
{r:She consistently helped her friends} - U doimiy ravishda do‘stlariga yordam berardi.
{r:They said overall sales had grown consistently all year} - Ular sotuvlar butun yil davomida muntazam oshganini aytdilar.
{r:He admitted that he hadn't practiced consistently} - U mashgʻulotlarni muntazam bajarmaganini tan oldi.

text: {r:Basement}[ˈbeɪsmənt] – podval. Do’konda ishlagan paytlarim qozoq hamkorim bo’lardi. {h:Podvalga} tush og’ayni tovarlarni chiqaraylik” desam har doim “{p:BES MINUT} da barem” derdi.
examples: {r:She said that the basement needed urgent repairs} - U podvalni zudlik bilan taʼmirlash kerakligini aytdi.
{r:They said that water had leaked into the basement} - Ular suv podvalga sizib kirganini aytdilar.
{r:He said that old furniture was stored in the basement} - U eski mebellar podvalda saqlanayotganini aytdi.
{r:The inspector said the basement might collapse} - Inspektor podval qulab tushishi mumkinligini aytdi.

text: {r:Burden}[ˈbɜːrdən] – yuk, tashvish. Tasavvur qiling siz tarakanlarni yo’q qilish uchun pol va devorlarga bor bilan chizib chiqdingiz(suvaraklar bilan kurashish uchun haqiqatda shunday qilinadi). Tarakanlar esa “Bu {p:BORDAN} yeb otravlenie bo’ldik, o’zimizga {h:tashvish} orttirdik” deyapti.
examples: {r:He said the debt had become a heavy burden} - U qarz katta yukga aylanganini aytdi.
{r:She said that caring for her sick mother was a burden} - U kasal onasiga qarash katta mas’uliyat ekanini aytdi.
{r:They said taxes placed a burden on small businesses} - Ular soliq kichik bizneslar uchun ogʻir yuk ekanini aytdilar.
{r:The worker said that overtime work was a constant burden} - Ishchi ortiqcha ishlash doimiy tashvish ekanligini aytdi.
{r:The heavy burden of debt made it difficult for the family to survive financially.} - Qarzning og'ir yuki oilaning moliyaviy jihatdan omon qolishini qiyinlashtirdi.

text: {r:Suck}[sʌk] – so’rmoq; yomon bo'lmoq, yemaslik, o'xshamaslik. Mana bu rasmda it {p:SAK}kiz raqamini suyak deb o’ylab {h:so’rayapti}.
examples: {r:She bought a packet of sweets to suck on the journey} - U yo'lda so'rish uchun bir paket shirinliklar oldi.
{r:Children sometimes suck their fingers} - Bolalar ba'zan barmog'ini so'rishadi.
{r:She said the new policy completely sucked} - U yangi siyosat juda yomon ekanini aytdi.
{r:He said that his phone battery life sucked lately} - U telefonining batareya ishlash muddati yomonlashganini aytdi.
{r:They said that the food at that restaurant sucked} - Ular restorandagi ovqat sifatsiz ekanini aytdilar.
{r:The player said that losing the championship sucked} - Oʻyinchi chempionatni yutqazish juda yomon ekanini aytdi.

text: {r:sheep}[ʃiːp] – qo'y. Tasavvur qiling siz {h:qo'y} bo'qmoqchisiz lekin qayerda boqishni bilmay oxiri bo'sh yotgan dala {p:SHIP}onini tanladingiz.
examples: {r:He asked me where the sheep were.} - U mendan qo'ylar qayerdaligini so'radi.
{r:Could you tell me if the sheep are in the field?} - Qo'ylar daladami, ayta olasizmi?
{r:I wonder how many sheep they have.} - Ularda qancha qo'y bor ekan, hayronman.
{r:They wanted to know why the sheep grazed peacefully.} - Ular qo'ylar nega tinch o'tlayotganini bilishni xohlashdi.

text: {r:restriction}[rɪˈstrɪkʃən] - cheklov. Restrict(cheklamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Do you know what the restrictions are?} - Cheklovlar nima ekanligini bilasizmi?
{r:He asked me when the restrictions would be lifted.} - U mendan cheklovlar qachon olib tashlanishini so'radi.
{r:I wonder if the restrictions caused the delays.} - Cheklovlar kechikishlarga sabab bo'lganmi, hayronman.
{r:She wanted to know if our brain knows no restriction.} - U bizning miyamiz cheklovlarni bilmasligini bilishni xohladi.

text: {r:fraudulent}[ˈfrɔːdʒələnt] - firibgarona, ayyorona. Fraud(firibgarlik) so'zining sifat so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:She regrets that she took part in a fraudulent scheme.} – U firibgarlik ishida qatnashganidan afsuslanadi.
{r:Could you tell me if the scheme was fraudulent?} - Sxema firibgarlik bo'lganmi, ayta olasizmi?
{r:I asked them why the fraudulent activities were threatening his freedom.} - Men ulardan nega firibgarona ishlar uning ozodligiga tahdid solayotganini so'radim.
{r:They wanted to know how they could investigate the fraudulent claims.} - Ular firibgar da'volarni qanday tekshirishlari mumkinligini bilishni xohlashdi.

text: {r:warrior}[ˈwɒriər] – jangchi. Buyuk {h:jangchi} bo'lish uchun o'rta asrlarda {p:VOR}onaksimon {p:YER}yong'oq yeyishgan ekan.
examples: {r:He wanted to know who the greatest warrior was.} - U mendan eng buyuk jangchi kim ekanligini bilishni xohladi.
{r:She asked me if the warrior fought bravely.} - U mendan jangchi mardona jang qilganmi, deb so'radi.
{r:It is wise for a warrior to train every day.} - Jangchi har kuni mashq qilishi dono qarordir.
{r:Could you tell me how they honored the warrior's memory?} - Ular jangchi xotirasini qanday sharaflaganini ayta olasizmi?

text: {r:curtain}[ˈkɜːrtən] – parda. Hortn ismli fil haqidagi multfilm esingizdami. O'sha {p:HORTN} hozir {h:parda} tikyapti ekan.
examples: {r:She asked me if the curtains blocked the sunlight.} - U mendan pardalar quyosh nurini to'sganmi, deb so'radi.
{r:He wanted to know if they brought new curtains for the living room.} - Ular mehmonxonaga yangi pardalar olib kelishganmi yo'qmi bilishni xohladi.
{r:Could you tell me why your niece bought an extremely expensive curtain?} - Jiyaningiz nega o'ta qimmat parda sotib olganini ayta olasizmi?
{r:I wonder why you requested your husband to purchase a relatively cheap curtain.} - Siz nega eringizdan nisbatan arzonroq parda sotib olishini iltimos qilganingizga hayronman.

text: {r:pond}[pɒnd] – hovuz, havza. Bakteriyalar yomg'ir mavsumida {p:Pand}aning boshida {h:hovuz} qurishibdi.
examples: {r:He asked me how deep the pond was.} - U mendan hovuz qancha chuqur ekanligini so'radi.
{r:She wanted to know if the pond was full of fish.} - U hovuz baliqlarga to'lami yoki yo'q bilishni xohladi.
{r:Do you know why the children played by the pond?} - Bolalar nega hovuz bo'yida o'ynaganini bilasizmi?
{r:I wonder who cleaned the pond last week.} - O'tgan hafta hovuzni kim tozalagan ekan, hayronman.

text: {r:guilty}[ˈɡɪlti] – aybdor, gunohkor. Qo'shnimizning eri kecha sudlandi va xotiniga bayram kuni {p:GULTI}kon sovg'a qilganlikda {h:abdor} deb topildi.
examples: {r:Julia asked if he was guilty of the crime.} - Julia undan jinoyatda aybdormi yoki yo'qligini so'radi.
{r:He asked me if the jury found him guilty.} - U mendan hakamlar hay'ati uni aybdor deb topdimi yo'qmi so'radi.
{r:I wonder why the guilty verdict shocked everyone.} - Nega aybdor degan hukm hammani hayratda qoldirgan ekan, hayronman.
{r:Could you tell me if he will face a significant fine if found guilty?} - Aybdor deb topilsa, u sezilarli jarimaga tortiladimi, ayta olasizmi?

text: {r:dump}[dʌmp] – tashlamoq, qo'ymoq; chiqindixona, musorka. Qulog'i katta uchadigan fil {p:Damp}o haqidagi multfilmni eslaysizmi? Hozir DAMPo sirkda ishlamayapti. U hozir katta musor paketlarni svalkaga uchib borib {h:tashlab} kelyapti. Agar Damponi tanimasangiz ariqdagi DAMBa musorga to'lib ketganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:He asked me where they had dumped the waste.} - U mendan ular chiqindilarni qayerga tashlashganini so'radi.
{r:She asked if the dump was full.} - U chiqindixona to'lib ketganmi, deb so'radi.
{r:I wanted to know why they dumped the trash illegally.} - Men ular nega chiqindilarni noqonuniy tashlashganini bilishni xohladim.
{r:Could you tell me if the dump causes environmental problems?} - Chiqindixona ekologik muammolarga sabab bo'ladimi, ayta olasizmi?

text: {r:harm}[hɑːrm] - zarar keltirmoq; zarar, ziyon. {p:Halim} ovqatini doimiy iste'mol qilish inson sochlariga {h:zarar} yetkazadi va kallikka olib keladi.
examples: {r:She asked me if it would harm the environment.} - U mendan bu atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazadimi yo'qmi so'radi.
{r:He asked me what kind of harm the chemicals could cause.} - U mendan kimyoviy moddalar qanday zarar yetkazishi mumkinligini so'radi.
{r:I wonder how much harm the storm caused.} - Bo'ron qancha zarar keltirgan ekan, hayronman.
{r:They wanted to know if they could minimize the harm.} - Ular zararni minimallashtirishlari mumkinmi bilishni xohlashdi.

text: {r:endure}[ɪnˈdjʊər] - chidamoq, bardosh bermoq.
examples: {r:He wondered how long we could endure this.} - U bunga qancha vaqt chidashimiz mumkin ekanligiga hayron bo'ldi.
{r:She told me that they had endured the hardship.} - U menga ular qiyinchiliklarga bardosh berishganini aytdi.
{r:I asked if the team had endured the challenges.} - Men jamoa qiyinchiliklarni yengdimi yo'qmi so'radim.
{r:Do you know how they endured the pain with patience?} - Ular og'riqni qanday sabr bilan yengganini bilasizmi?

text: {r:simultaneous}[ˌsaɪməlˈteɪniəs] – bir vaqtning o'zida, barobar. Agar ipli tennis to'rini ishlatsangiz biroz vaqtdan so'ng to'r teshilishni boshlaydi va 3 oydan keyin ishlatib bo'lmay qoladi. Agar {p:SIMLI TENNIS} to'rini ishlatsangiz bu to'r uzoq vaqtga chidab beradi. Lekin bitta qattiq zarba simli torni {h:bir vaqtning o'zida} sochilib ketishiga sababchi bo'ladi.
examples: {r:She asked me if the events were simultaneous.} - U mendan tadbirlar bir vaqtda bo'ladimi deb so'radi.
{r:He asked me whether the broadcasts were simultaneous.} - U mendan eshittirishlar bir vaqtda bo'lganmi deb so'radi.
{r:I wonder how the simultaneous translations helped everyone.} - Bir vaqtda tarjima hammaga qanday yordam bergan ekan, hayronman.
{r:They wanted to know who planned the events to be simultaneous.} - Ular tadbirlarni bir vaqtda bo'lishini kim rejalashtirganini bilishni xohlashdi.

text: {r:trigger}[ˈtrɪɡər] – qurol tepkisi; turtki bermoq, sababchi bo'lmoq. Mana bu ayol {p:TIRIK ER}I bo'lsa ham 'beva qoldim' deb boshqasiga erga tegib olibdi. Bu voqea birinchi er qaytib kelganidan so'ng ko'plab muammolarga {h:sababchi bo'libdi} va birinchi er rashkdan qurol {h:tepkisini} ishlatishga majbur bo'libdi.
examples: {r:I asked him what had triggered his headache.} - Men undan bosh og'rig'iga nima sabab bo'lganini so'radim.
{r:She wondered if the incident would trigger a protest.} - U bu voqea norozilikka sabab bo'ladimi, deb hayron bo'ldi.
{r:He wanted to know what had triggered the argument.} - U bahsga nima sabab bo'lganini bilishni xohladi.
{r:Could you tell me if the smell of cotton candy always triggered happy childhood memories?} - Paxta konfetining hidi har doim baxtli bolalik xotiralarini qo'zg'atganmi, ayta olasizmi?

text: {r:grace}[ɡreɪs] – joziba, tarovat. {p:G}ulistonga {p:REYS} eng jozibali poyezd Afrosiyobda {h:jozibali} poyezd xodimlari hamrohligida amalga oshiriladi.
examples: {r:Julia asked if her grace impressed everyone.} - Julia o'zining jozibasi hammani maftun etdimi yo'qmi so'radi.
{r:He wanted to know if the dancer moved with grace.} - U raqqosa joziba bilan harakat qilganmi, bilishni xohladi.
{r:Tell me how can I have grace.} - Qanday qilib jozibaga ega bo'lishim mumkin ayt.
{r:Do you know why Julia lacks grace?} - Nega Juliaga joziba yetishmaydi bilasizmi?

text:
{r:convict}[kənˈvɪkt] – hukm qilmoq, jazoga tortmoq; mahkum. 
Mana bu er-xotin {p:KAN}adaliklar {p:VIKT}orinada qatnashadi va bu television viktorinada million dollar yutib oladi. Qiziq tarafi maktabni 3 bahoga bitirgan kishi professorlar ham eplolmagan bilimlar sinaladigan viktorinada yutishi ko'pchilikni hayratga soldi va rejissyor o'yinni qayta ko'rganida bu kishining xotini har bir to'g'ri variant aytilgan payt yo'talib turganini sezib qoladi. Xullas bu voqea ko'plab muhokamalarga sabab bo'ladi. {p:KAN}adalik {p:VIKT}orinachi er-xotinlar esa 2 yil qamoqqa {h:hukm qilinadi.}(bo'lgan voqea)
examples: {r:He asked why the jury convicted the man.} - U mendan hakamlar hay'ati nega odamni aybdor deb topganini so'radi.
{r:She wanted to know how the convict escaped from prison.} - U mahkum qamoqdan qanday qochib ketganini bilishni xohladi.
{r:I wonder how long the convict was sentenced.} - Mahkumga qancha yil qamoq jazosi berilgan ekan, hayronman.
{r:Could you tell me if they convicted him based on the evidence?} - Ular uni dalillar asosida aybdor deb topishganmi, ayta olasizmi?

text: {r:persistence}[pərˈsɪstəns] - qat'iyat, davomiylik. Persist so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She asked if persistence was the key to success.} - U qat'iyat muvaffaqiyat kalitimi, deb so'radi.
{r:He wanted to know if my persistence had paid off.} - U mening qat'iyatim o'z samarasini berganini bilishni xohladi.
{r:I don't know why his persistence is not appreciated?} - Uning qat'iyatini nega qadrlashmaydilar bilmayman.
{r:The designer’s persistence led to a particular and elegant collection.} – Dizaynerning qat’iyati o‘ziga xos va nafis to‘plam yaratishga olib keldi.

text: {r:cotton}[ˈkɒtən] - paxta. {p:XOTTIN}imning ismi {h:Paxta}oy, uning o'zi ham paxtadek yumshoq va oppoq.
examples: {r:He asked if the shirt was made of cotton.} - U ko'ylak paxtadan tikilganmi, deb so'radi.
{r:She wanted to know which cotton clothes I preferred.} - U qaysi paxta kiyimlarni afzal ko'rishimni bilishni xohladi.
{r:Could you tell me how big the cotton fields were?} - Paxta dalalari qancha katta bo'lganini ayta olasizmi?
{r:I wonder when they harvested the cotton.} - Ular paxtani qachon yig'ib olishgan ekan, hayronman.

text: {r:naked}[ˈneɪkɪd] – yalang'och. {p:NAYK} kiyib olgan {p:IT} odamlarni {h:yalang'och} ko'ra olish qobiliyatiga ega ekan.
examples: {r:She asked me if the baby was born naked.} - U mendan bola yalang'och tug'ilganmi, deb so'radi.
{r:He asked me why the tree was naked in winter.} - U mendan daraxt qishda nega yalang'och bo'lishini so'radi.
{r:I wonder if the man stood naked in the rain.} - Erkak yomg'irda yalang'och turganmi, hayronman.
{r:Could you tell me if they found a naked truth in the story?} - Ular hikoyada ochiq haqiqatni topishganmi, ayta olasizmi?

text: {r:modify}[ˈmɒdɪfaɪ] - o'zgartirishlar kiritmoq, o'zgartirmoq.
examples: {r:He asked me why we needed to modify the plan.} - U mendan rejani nega o'zgartirishimiz kerakligini so'radi.
{r:She wanted to know if the design was modified.} - U dizayn o'zgartirilganmi, bilishni xohladi.
{r:Do you know if they modified the car for better performance?} - Ular mashinani yaxshiroq ishlashi uchun o'zgartirishlar kiritishganmi, bilasizmi?
{r:I wonder who modified the recipe to include less sugar.} - Retseptga kamroq shakar qo'shilishi uchun uni kim o'zgartirgan ekan, hayronman.

text: {r:survival}[sərˈvaɪvəl] - omon qolish. Survive(omon qolmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She asked me if survival was the first priority.} - U mendan omon qolish birinchi ustuvorlikmi yoki yo'qmi so'radi.
{r:He wanted to know how the survival rate had improved.} - U omon qolish darajasi qanday yaxshilanganini bilishni xohladi.
{r:I wonder what survival skills helped them in the wild.} - Yovvoyi tabiatda ularga qanday omon qolish ko'nikmalari yordam bergan ekan, hayronman.
{r:Could you tell me why they celebrated their survival?} - Ular nega omon qolganliklarini nishonlashganini ayta olasizmi?

text: {r:Particle}[ˈpɑːrtɪkl] – qism, bo'lak, parcha,zarra. Kechagi portlashda qushlar azob chekdi. Ko'p qushlarni patlari parcha-{h:parcha} bo'lib sochilib ketgan. Hozir o'sha parcha {p:PAT}lar {p:TIKIL}yapti yerdan yig'ilib. Biz shunday qilib qushlarga yordam beryapmiz.
examples: {r:Have you seen the particle? Yes, I have.} - Siz zarrachani ko'rdingizmi? Ha ko'rdim.
{r:I can't see the particle. Neither can I.} - Men zarrachani ko'ra olmayman. Men ham.
{r:Do you think the particle is causing the problem? I think so.} - Bo'lakcha muammoga sabab bo'lyapti deb o'ylaysizmi? Menimcha, ha.
{r:The particle is too small to see, isn't it?} - Parcha ko'rish uchun juda kichik, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Boost}[buːst] – yuksalmoq, o'smoq, yaxshilanmoq. Agar shaxsiy {h:rivojlanishni} istasangiz bitta {p:BO'ST}onliqni tog'lariga chiqib miyani kislorodga to'ldirib keling. Keyin energiya bilan ishlayverasiz!
examples: {r:Did the new policy boost the economy? No, it did not.} - Yangi siyosat iqtisodiyotni yuksaltirdimi? Yo'q, yuksaltirmadi.
{r:She is trying to boost her confidence. So am I.} - U o'ziga ishonchini oshirishga harakat qilyapti. Men ham.
{r:Will this campaign boost sales? I hope so.} - Bu kampaniya savdolarni oshiradimi? Umid qilamanki.
{r:The new strategy will not boost our performance, will it?} - Yangi strategiya faoliyatimizni yaxshilamaydi, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Weird}[wɪərd] – g'alati. O'zbekiston hududida birinchi marta shu yili {p:VIRT}ual to'y bo'lib o'tdi. Kelin Xorazmdan kuyov esa Toshkentdan turib onlayn nikohdan o'tishdi. {h:G'alati.} Chimildiq qayerda bo'ladi?
examples: {r:Does he behave weirdly? Yes, he does.} - U g'alati harakat qiladimi? Ha, shunday.
{r:I don't find this weird. Neither do I.} - Buni g'alati deb hisoblamayman. Men ham.
{r:Do you think this is weird? I suppose so.} - Bu g'alati deb o'ylaysizmi? Menimcha, ha.
{r:The situation feels a bit weird, doesn't it?} - Vaziyat biroz g'alati tuyulyapti, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Undermine}[ˌʌndərˈmaɪn] – zaiflashtirmoq, kuchsizlantirmoq, pasaytirmoq. {p:ANDATR}a {p:MAYN}ani ustidan kulibdi "Sening ismingni xunukligini qara o'zbekchada mayna 'masxara' degani" deya uning o'ziga bo'lgan ishonchini {h:zaiflashtiribdi}.
examples: {r:Did his actions undermine our efforts? Yes, they did.} - Uning harakatlari bizning sa'y-harakatlarimizni zaiflashtirdimi? Ha, shunday bo'ldi.
{r:I don't want to undermine his confidence. Neither do I.} - Men uning ishonchini zaiflashtirishni istamayman. Men ham.
{r:Do you think this criticism will undermine his authority? I hope not.} - Bu tanqid uning obro'sini pasaytiradi deb o'ylaysizmi? Umid qilmayman.
{r:The new regulation might undermine the project, won't it?} - Yangi qoida loyihaga putur yetkazishi mumkin, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Sweat}[swɛt] – ter; terlamoq. Tasavvur qiling tepada turgan {p:SVET} shunchalik qizityaptiki siz {h:terlab} ketyapsiz.
examples: {r:Does he sweat a lot during workouts? Yes, he does.} - U mashqlar paytida ko'p terlaydimi? Ha, shunday.
{r:I'm sweating a lot in this heat. So am I.} - Bu issiqda juda ko'p terlayapman. Men ham.
{r:Is it going to be hot today? I think so.} - Bugun issiq bo'ladimi? Menimcha, ha.
{r:She's sweating a lot, isn't she?} - U juda ko'p terlayapti, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Drunken}[ˈdrʌŋkən] – mast, ichgan. Drink(ichmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Was he drunken last night? Yes, he was.} - Kecha kechqurun u mast edimi? Ha, shunday edi.
{r:I haven't seen the drunken man before. Neither have I.} - Men mast odamni avval ko'rmaganman. Men ham.
{r:Do you think he was drunken? I suppose so.} - U mast edi deb o'ylaysizmi? Menimcha, ha.
{r:He was behaving like a drunken person, wasn't he?} - U mast odam kabi o'zini tutdi, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Praise}[preɪz] – maqtov; maqtamoq. Tasavvur qiling siz butun mahallangiz oldida shaxsan {p:PREZ}identdan {h:maqtov} eshitdingiz.
examples: {r:Did the teacher praise your work? Yes, she did.} - O'qituvchi ishingizni maqtaganmi? Ha, maqtadi.
{r:I don't like to praise people easily. Neither do I.} - Men odamlarni osongina maqtashni yoqtirmayman. Men ham.
{r:Do you think he will praise my effort? I hope so.} - U mening sa'y-harakatlarimni maqtaydi deb o'ylaysizmi? Umid qilamanki.
{r:The student received high praise, didn't he?} - Talaba yuqori maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Wilderness}[ˈwɪldərnəs] – yovvoyi tabiat. Men va do'stim {h:yovvoyi tabiat} qo'ynida {p:VIL}kada {p:TENNIS} o'ynadik.
examples: {r:Can he survive in the wilderness? Yes, he can.} - U yovvoyi tabiatda omon qola oladimi? Ha, omon qola oladi.
{r:I'm not used to the wilderness. Neither am I.} - Men yovvoyi tabiatga ko'nikmaganman. Men ham.
{r:Do you think we can find water here? I hope so.} - Bu yerda suv topa olamiz deb o'ylaysizmi? Umid qilamanki.
{r:Exploring the wilderness is not dangerous, is it?} - Yovvoyi tabiatni o'rganish xavfli emas, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Endless}[ˈɛndləs] – bitmas, tugamas. End(nihoya, tugash) va muayyan so'z ma'nosini teskarisiga o'girib yuboruvchi -less qo'shimchalarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Does the paperwork seem endless? Yes, it does.} - Qog'ozbozlik bitmas-tuganmas tuyulyaptimi? Ha, shunday.
{r:I can't deal with the endless objections. Neither can I.} - Men cheksiz e'tirozlarga dosh bera olmayman. Men ham.
{r:Will this project ever finish? I hope so.} - Bu loyiha qachondir tugaydimi? Umid qilamanki.
{r:This meeting feels endless, doesn't it?} - Bu uchrashuv cheksiz tuyulyapti, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Profound}[prəˈfaʊnd] – ulkan, kuchli, ta'sirli. O'zbekistonda {p:PROPAN} gazining taqchilligi zapravkalar oldida {h:ulkan} navbatlarni hosil qilyapti.
examples: {r:Did the speech have a profound impact? Yes, it did.} - Nutq chuqur ta'sir ko'rsatdimi? Ha, shunday.
{r:I think the movie was profound. So do I.} - Menimcha, film chuqur ta'sirli edi. Men ham shunday o'ylayman.
{r:Do you think this book is profound? I think so.} - Bu kitobni chuqur ta'sirli deb o'ylaysizmi? Menimcha, ha.
{r:The experience has had a profound impact on them, hasn't it?} - Tajriba ularga chuqur ta'sir ko'rsatdi, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Unite}[juːˈnaɪt] – birlashmoq, birlashtirmoq. Biz Manchester {p:YUNAYT}ed muxlislarini jamoaga bo'lgan muhabbat {h:birlashtiradi.} Biz katta umumiy oilamiz.
examples: {r:Did they unite to solve the problem? Yes, they did.} - Ular muammoni hal qilish uchun birlashishdimi? Ha, birlashishdi.
{r:I want to unite with them. So does my friend.} - Men ular bilan birlashishni istayman. Mening do'stim ham.
{r:Do you think they will unite for the cause? I hope so.} - Ular bu ish uchun birlashadi deb o'ylaysizmi? Umid qilamanki.
{r:The team has united to achieve the goal, hasn't it?} - Jamoa maqsadga erishish uchun birlashdi, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Scatter}[ˈskætər] – har tomonga tarqamoq(tarqatmoq), tarqamoq, tarqatmoq. Men kecha tarix muzeyi ichkarisiga 10 ta oshlangan teri olib kelgan edim. Ertangi kuni kelsam terilar hammayoqqa sochilib yotibdi. Kim qildi ekan deb kamerani tekshirsam {p:SKE}let {p:TER}ilarni {h:sochib tashlagan} ekan. Skeletlarga tunda jon kirib xona bo'ylab harakatlanar ekan.
examples: {r:Did the wind scatter the leaves? Yes, it did.} - Shamol barglarni sochib yubordimi? Ha, sochib yubordi.
{r:I wanted to scatter the papers. So did my colleague.} - Men qog'ozlarni sochib yuborishni istadim. Men ham.
{r:Will the police scatter the crowd? I think so.} - Politsiya olomonni tarqatib yuboradimi? Menimcha, ha.
{r:The seeds were scattered by the wind, weren't they?} - Urug'lar shamol bilan sochilib ketdi, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Convey}[kənˈveɪ] – ifodalamoq, bildirmoq, aytmoq, xabardor qilmoq; tashimoq, yetkazmoq. Mana bu sizning bo'lajak turmush o'rtog'ingizga xatingiz. Xatda mebel olish shartmasligini {h:ifodalagansiz} va buni {p:KONVER}tga solib pochta xizmati orqali jo'natyapsiz.
examples: {r:Does this letter convey the urgency? Yes, it does.} - Bu xat zudlikni bildiryaptimi? Ha, bildiryapti.
{r:I can convey my feelings well. So can my teacher.} - Men o'z his-tuyg'ularimni yaxshi ifodalay olaman. Mening ustozim ham.
{r:Do you think he will convey the message? I hope so.} - U xabarni yetkazadi deb o'ylaysizmi? Umid qilamanki.
{r:She did not convey the message clearly, did she?} - U xabarni aniq bildirmadi, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Complex}[ˈkɒmplɛks] – murakkab, qiyin.
examples: {r:Is the problem complex? No, it is not.} - Muammo murakkabmi? Yo'q, unday emas.
{r:I don't understand this complex theory. Neither do I.} - Men bu murakkab nazariyani tushunmayapman. Men ham.
{r:Does the task seem complex? I think so.} - Vazifa murakkab tuyulyaptimi? Menimcha, ha.
{r:The situation is not quite complex, is it?} - Vaziyat murakkab emas, shunday emasmi?

text: {r:Twist}[twɪst] – bukmoq, qayirmoq, buzmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:TURIST} erkakni O'zbekistonda adashib ayollar hojatxonasiga kirib ketganligi uchun bo'ynidan {h:qayirib} qiynayapsiz.
examples: {r:Can he twist the facts? Yes, he can.} - U faktlarni buzib ko'rsata oladimi? Ha, ola oladi.
{r:I don't like how they twist the rules. Neither does my father.} - Ular qoidalarni buzib ko'rsatishi menga yoqmaydi. Dadamga ham.
{r:Do you think he will twist the story? I hope not.} - U hikoyani o'zgartirib yuboradi deb o'ylaysizmi? Umid qilmayman.
{r:The story has a new twist, hasn't it?} - Hikoya yangi burilish oldi, shunday emasmi?
{r:Don't twist your language to sound like someone from Tashkent.} - Toshkentlikka o'xshab ko'rinish uchun tilingni qayirma.

text: {r:Harmful}[ˈhɑːmfəl] – zararli, ziyonli. Harm(zarar qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Is smoking harmful? Yes, it is.} - Chekish zararlimi? Ha, zararli.
{r:I don't want to use any harmful chemicals. Neither do we.} - Men zararli kimyoviy moddalardan foydalanishni istamayman. Biz ham.
{r:Do you think this substance is harmful? I think so.} - Bu modda zararli deb o'ylaysizmi? Menimcha, ha.
{r:The chemicals are very harmful, aren't they?} - Kimyoviy moddalar juda zararli, shunday emasmi?
