examples: {r:It's no use sacrificing your health for work} - Ish uchun sog'ligingizni fido qilishning foydasi yo'q.
{r:She had difficulty sacrificing her free time for the project} - U loyiha uchun bo'sh vaqtini fido qilishda qiyinchilik ko'rdi.
{r:It's worth sacrificing a little now for a better future} - Yaxshi kelajak uchun hozir ozgina qurbonlik qilishga arziydi.
{r:There's no point in making sacrifices if no one appreciates them} - Agar hech kim qadrini bilmasa, fidoyilik qilishning ma'nosi yo'q.

text: {r:Loyal}[ˈlɔɪəl] – sodiq, sadoqatli. Mana bu yo’l asfalt yoki betondan qilinmagan. Bu yo’l {p:LOYL}i yo’l. Odamlar mana shu yo’lni shunchalik yaxshi ko’radiki hokimiyatdan kelib asfalt qilib beramiz deyishganda ham odamlar bu yo’lga {h:sodiq}ligini aytib rad javobini berishgan.
examples: {r:He had trouble finding a loyal friend} - U sodiq do'st topishda qiyinchilik ko'rdi.
{r:It's worth being loyal to those who care about you} - Sizni qadrlaydigan odamlarga sodiq bo'lish arziydi.
{r:There's no point in staying loyal to someone who betrays you} - Sizni xiyonat qilgan odamga sodiq bo'lib turishning ma'nosi yo'q.
{r:They were extremely loyal to their religion.} - Ular o'z dinlariga o'ta sadoqatli edilar.

text: {r:Slap}[slæp] – tarsaki; tarsaki tushirmoq. Kecha meni haqorat qilib g’ururim bilan o’ynashgan odamga juda qattiq, kuch bilan {h:tarsaki} tushirgan edim lekin mo’ljalda sal adashdim shekilli u ablahni faqatgina {p:SILAB} o’tdi. Sizning ham tarsakingiz SILAB o’tganmi?
examples: {r:It's no use slapping someone to make them understand} - Kimnidir tushunishi uchun urishning foydasi yo'q.
{r:She had difficulty controlling her anger and almost slapped him} - U g'azabini boshqarishda qiyinchilik ko'rdi va deyarli uni urib yubordi.
{r:There's no point in slapping someone over a small mistake} - Kichik xato uchun kimnidir urishning ma'nosi yo'q.
{r:It was a brutal reality, like a cold slap in the face, that his efforts were in vain.} - Bu shafqatsiz haqiqat edi, xuddi yuziga sovuq shapaloq tushurgandek, uning harakatlari behuda edi.

text: {r:Jaw}[dʒɔː] – jag’. Siz bu vaziyatda {h:jag’}i singan {p:JO’Vl}on ismli yigitni tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:Don't fight with a broken jaw otherwise the consequences will be horrible} - Singan jag' bilan mushtlashma aks holda oqibati qo'rqinchli bo'ladi.
{r:He had difficulty speaking after injuring his jaw} - U jag'ini jarohatlaganidan keyin gapirishda qiyinchilik ko'rdi.
{r:It's worth taking care of your jaw; it's an important part of your body} - Jag'ingizga g'amxo'rlik qilish arziydi; bu tanangizning muhim qismi.
{r:There's no point in ignoring jaw pain; see a doctor} - Jag' og'rig'ini e'tiborsiz qoldirishning ma'nosi yo'q; shifokorga ko'rin.

text: {r:Cancellation}[ˌkænsəˈleɪʃən] – bekor bo'lish yoki qilinish. Cancell(bekor qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It's no use complaining about the cancellation; it's out of our control} - Bekor qilinish haqida shikoyat qilishning foydasi yo'q; bu bizning nazoratimizda emas.
{r:She had difficulty accepting the cancellation of the event} - U tadbirning bekor qilinishini qiyinchilik bilan qabul qildi.
{r:Despite the cancellation, he was still willing to drive his vehicle to help his friends} – Bekor qilinganiga qaramay, u do‘stlariga yordam berish uchun mashinasini haydashga hanuz tayyor edi.
{r:There's no point in getting upset over a cancellation; things happen} - Bekor qilinishdan xafa bo'lishning ma'nosi yo'q; hamma narsa bo'lishi mumkin.

text: {r:Lung}[lʌŋ] – o'pka. Tasavvur qiling ichagingizda suzib yurgan gijjalar sizning {h:o’pka}ngizga {p:LANG}ar tashlab o’z kemalarini to’xtatibdilar.
examples: {r:It's no good smoking if you want to protect your lungs} - Agar o'pkangizni himoya qilishni istasangiz, chekishdan foyda yo'q.
{r:It's worth exercising regularly to keep your lungs healthy} - O'pkangizni sog'lom saqlash uchun muntazam ravishda mashq qilish arziydi.

{r:There's no point in trying to hold your breath for too long; it can damage your lungs} - Nafasingizni juda uzoq ushlab turishga urinishning ma'nosi(foydasi) yo'q; bu o'pkangizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.
{r:He had trouble breathing after running up the hill, a sign that his lungs were exhausted} - Tepalikka yugurgandan keyin uning nafasi qisib qoldi, bu uning o'pkasi charchaganligining belgisi edi.

text: {r:Propose}[prəˈpoʊz] – taklif qilmoq; turmush qurishni taklif qilmoq. Qish payti prapan juda taqchil bo’ladi. Zapravkalarda katta navbatlar, yoqilg’i kamchiligi kabi muammolar barchani qiynaydi. Shuning uchun deputatlarimiz prapanni O’zbekistonda ishlab chiqarib uning nomini {p:PRAP}an {p:O’Z}bekiston deyishni {h:taklif qilishmoqda}.
examples: {r:He had trouble proposing to her in front of so many people} - U shunchalik ko'p odamlar oldida unga turmush qurishni taklif qilishda qiyinchilik ko'rdi.
{r:It's not worth proposing a plan if you can't get any support} - Agar hech qanday qo'llab-quvvatlashga erisha olmasangiz, reja taklif qilishga arzimaydi.
{r:He wanted to propose a new rule that does not exclude any gender} - U hech qanday jinsni chiqarib tashlamaydigan yangi qoida taklif qilmoqchi bo‘ldi.
{r:In the quiet room, he was thinking how he could possibly propose to her} – Tinch xonada u qanday qilib turmush qurish taklifini berishni o‘ylardi.

text: {r:Resign}[rɪˈzaɪn] – iste'foga chiqmoq, ishdan ketmoq. Bugun Munisa {p:RIZAY}eva kal erining talabi bilan san’atdan {h:ketganligini} e’lon qildi.
examples: {r:It's no use trying to convince him; he's decided on resigning} - Uni ishontirishga urinishning foydasi yo'q; u iste'foga chiqishga qaror qildi.
{r:She had difficulty resigning from a job she loved so much} - U juda yaxshi ko'rgan ishidan iste'foga chiqishda qiynaldi.
{r:It's worth resigning from a toxic workplace for your mental health} - Ruhiy salomatligingiz uchun zararli ish joyidan iste'foga chiqish arziydi.
{r:It was a cool and wise decision to resign early} – Erta iste’foga chiqish ajoyib va oqilona qaror edi.

text: {r:Trash}[træʃ] – axlat, chiqindi. Agarda axlat qutilaridan boshqa joyga {h:musor} tashlasam vijdonim qiynaladi shekilli qo’llarimda ti{p:TRASH} bo’ladi.
examples: {r:It's no good leaving trash on the street; it's a big mess} - Ko'chada axlat qoldirishning yaxshi tomoni yo'q; bu katta tartibsizlik.
{r:I was busy removing the trash when you called} - Siz qo'ng'iroq qilganingizda, men axlatni olib tashlash bilan band edim.
{r:On a windy day, the guard collected the trash to reduce its negative effect} – Shamolli kunda qo‘riqchi axlatni yig‘ib, uning salbiy ta’sirini kamaytirdi.
{r:Can you do me a favour and take out the trash? It smells horrible} – Menga bir yaxshilik qilib, axlatni olib chiqib yuborasanmi? Juda yomon hid kelyapti.

text: {r:Adapt}[əˈdæpt] – moslashmoq, adaptatsiya qilmoq.
examples: {r:Animals adapt to their environment.} - Hayvonlar o‘z muhitiga moslashadi.
{r:Anvar helped her quickly adapt to her new job.} - Anvar uni tezda yangi ishiga moslashishiga yordam berdi.
{r:Besides the weather, we must adapt to new conditions.} - Ob-havodan tashqari biz yangi sharoitlarga moslashishimiz kerak.
{r:It is evident that children adapt quickly because of their curiosity.} - Bolalar qiziquvchanligi sabab tez moslashishi aniq.

text: {r:Outdoor}[ˈaʊtˈdɔːr] – tashqarida, ochiq havoda. U bino ichida emas, tashqarida bo‘ladigan faoliyatlar yoki joylarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:We installed lights to illuminate the outdoor area} - Biz ochiq maydonni yoritish uchun chiroqlar o'rnatdik.
{r:This jacket is for outdoor activities} - Bu kurtka ochiq havodagi faoliyatlar uchun.
{r:She trained hard so that she could win the outdoor competition} - U ochiq havoda bo'ladigan musobaqada g'alaba qozonish uchun qattiq mashq qildi.
{r:Bring tools to repair the outdoor furniture} - Tashqaridagi mebellarni ta'mirlash uchun asboblarni olib keling.

text: {r:Indoor}[ˈɪndɔːr] – ichkarida, binoning ichida, yopiq joyda. U bino ichida bo‘ladigan faoliyatlar, joylar yoki narsalarni ifodalashda ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:They bought plants to purify the indoor air} - Ular yopiq inshootdagi havoni tozalash uchun o'simliklar sotib olishdi.
{r:These shoes are for indoor use only} - Bu poyabzalar faqat ichkariga kiyish uchun.
{r:She sat beside the window indoors so that she could enjoy the sunlight without going outside} – U tashqariga chiqmasdan quyosh nuridan bahramand bo‘lishi uchun ichkarida deraza yonida o‘tirdi.
{r:Use this mat to protect indoor floors} - Ichkaridagi pollarni himoya qilish uchun bu gilamdan foydalaning.

text: {r:Bodyguard}[ˈbɒdɪɡɑːrd] – qo'riqchi, oxrana.
examples: {r:Celebrities hire bodyguards to ensure their safety} - Mashhurlar o'z xavfsizligini ta'minlash uchun qo'riqchilarni yollaydilar.
{r:I will distribute all of these candies to my bodyguards} - Men bu konfetlarni qo'riqchilarimga tarqatib yuboraman.
{r:Rumors about Jasur were spread by his bodyguard} - Jasur haqidagi mish-mishlar uning qo'riqchisi tomonidan tarqatildi.
{r:Wear this earpiece to communicate with other bodyguards} - Boshqa qo'riqchilar bilan aloqa qilish uchun bu quloqchinlarni kiyib oling.

text: {r:Brush}[brʌʃ] – cho'tka; cho’tkalamoq. Xotinim menga ‘’Dadasi uyda guruch yo’q nimadan endi osh qilaman” dedi. Men esa “Topgan narsangdan qilaver menga farqi yo’q” dedim. Xotinim keyin {p:BIR OSH} qilibdi guruch o’rniga {h:cho’tka} solibdi. Uyimizda 40 yildan beri saqlanayotgan eski 100 ta cho’tkani maydalab osh qilibdi.
examples: {r:Use this brush to clean delicate surfaces} - Nozik yuzalarni tozalash uchun bu cho'tkadan foydalaning.
{r:Beside the mirror, he kept a comb and brush to gain a neat look before going out} – Oyna yonida u ko‘rinishini silliq qilish uchun taroq va cho‘tka saqlardi.
{r:My cousin brushes his teeth every morning after waking up} - Mening amakivachcham har kuni ertalab uyg'onganidan so'ng tishini cho'tkalaydi.
{r:I need a smaller brush to paint the details} - Menga detallarni bo'yash uchun kichikroq cho'tka kerak.

text: {r:Mystery}[ˈmɪstəri] – sir, sinoat, sirlilik. Mening Xitoylik millioner do’stim o’z familiyasini o’zgartirgan. U o’ziga dunyodagi eng qisqa familiyani tanlagan, familiyasi I. Biz uni {p:MISTER I} deb chaqiramiz. Mister I ning sobiq familiyasi hammaga {h:sir}.
examples: {r:A man from abroad came in with a mystery box that nobody could open} – Chet eldan kelgan bir kishi hech kim ocholmaydigan sirli quti bilan ichkariga kirdi.
{r:This book is for mystery lovers} - Bu kitob sirli voqealarni yaxshi ko'radiganlar uchun.
{r:He stood up so that he could see the mystery hidden behind the curtain} – U pardalar ortida yashiringan sirni ko‘rish uchun o‘rnidan turdi.
{r:We analyzed fingerprints to uncover the mystery} - Biz sirni ochish uchun barmoq izlarini tahlil qildik.

text: {r:Donate}[doʊˈneɪt] – in'om qilmoq, bermoq; hayr-ehson qilmoq. Bu yili bug’doy donining narxi shunchalar arzon bo’ldiki {p:DON}ni {p:IT}larga {h:in’om qilib} yubordik.
examples: {r:He decided to donate money to help patients with lung disease.} - U o‘pka kasalligi bilan og‘rigan bemorlarga yordam berish uchun pul ehson qilishga qaror qildi.
{r:This box is for donating toys} - Bu quti o'yinchoqlarni xayriya qilish uchun.
{r:He pretends donating money to charity consistently but actually he does not} - U doimo o'zini pul xayriya qilayotgandek tutadi lekin unday qilmaydi.
{r:Visit the website to learn how to donate blood} - Qon topshirish haqida bilib olish uchun veb-saytga tashrif buyuring.

text: {r:Inmate}[ˈɪnmeɪt] – mahbus. Kalamushlarning {p:INI MEYT}a burchakdagi teshikda. Agar hozir shu teshikka kichkina panjara qoqsam kalamushlar shu teshikning {h:mahbus}iga aylanadi.
examples: {r:Dozens of inmates have come out of jail recently} - O'nlab mahbuslar yaqinda qamoqdan chiqishdi.
{r:These rules are for inmate safety} - Bu qoidalar mahbuslarning xavfsizligi uchun.
{r:Guards monitor closely so that inmates won't violate protocols} - Nazoratchilar mahbuslar protokollarni buzmasligi uchun diqqat bilan kuzatadilar.
{r:They provide education to prepare inmates for release} - Ular mahbuslarni ozodlikka tayyorlash uchun ta'lim berishadi.

text: {r:Tackle}[ˈtækəl] – yechim topmoq, hal qilmoq. Men 1999 – yilda tug’ilganman. Men tug’ilgan yili O’zbekistonda chaqaloqlar ishtonini ho’llab, bulg’ab qo’yishining {h:yechimi topilgan} va odamlar yoppasiga {p:TAGL}iklarni qo’llashni boshlagan.
examples: {r:We have tackled the most complex issues lately} - Biz oxirgi paytlarda eng qiyin muammolarni hal qildik.
{r:She decided to speak up so that the team could tackle the issue before it got worse} – Jamoa muammo yanada yomonlashmasdan uni hal qila olishi uchun u baland ovozda gapirishga qaror qildi.
{r:He spoke up so that they could tackle the problem together} – U muammoni birgalikda hal qilishlari uchun balandroq gapirdi.
{r:The manager asked the team to sit down and tackle the drop in sales together} – Menejer jamoaga savdodagi pasayishni birgalikda hal qilish uchun o‘tirishni so‘radi.

text: {r:Bow}[baʊ] – ta’zim qilmoq, egilmoq, bukilmoq. 2021 – yil Barselona vs BAVariya o’yini 2:8 hisobida Bavariya foydasiga yakunlandi. Messi boshchiligidagi Barselona {p:BAV}ariyaga {h:ta’zim qilish}ga majbur bo’ldi.
examples: {r:The employee pretended to bow to his boss} - Ishchi o'zini boshlig'iga ta'zim qilgandek ko'rsatdi.
{r:The king asked the villagers to bow, hoping it would decrease tensions} - Podshoh qishloq aholisidan ta’zim qilishni so‘radi, bu keskinlikni kamaytiradi degan umidda.

{r:The dancers bow simultaneously at the end of their performance, creating a striking visual harmony} - Raqqoslar chiqishlarining oxirida bir vaqtning o‘zida ta’zim qilishadi, jozibador vizual uyg‘unlik hosil qilib.
{r:The ancient warrior would bow to his opponent before battle, honoring the rules of war} - Qadimgi jangchi jang qoidalarini hurmat qilib, raqibiga jang oldidan ta’zim qilar edi.

text: {r:Bubble}[ˈbʌbəl] – pufak, ko’pik. Siz do’stingiz {p:BOBUR}ni {h:pufak} ichida tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:Children blow soap to create bubbles} - Bolalar sovun puflash orqali pufakchalar hosil qilishadi.
{r:This solution is for making giant bubbles} - Bu eritma katta pufakchalar yasash uchun.
{r:He plays with bubbles to calm down} - U tinchlanish uchun ko'piklar bilan o'ynaydi.
{r:Small bubbles are flying over us} - Kichkina pufakchalar tepamizdan uchib o'tyapti.

text: {r:Buddy}[ˈbʌdi] – oshna, og’ayni. Men hayotdagi eng yaqin {h:og’aynim} bilan {p:BAD}minton o’yinida tanishganman.
examples: {r:Hey buddy, sit down here!} - Og'ayni shu yerga o'tir.
{r:I will call you back, buddy.} - Men senga qayta qo'ng'iroq qilaman do'stim.
{r:A cruel truth emerged when my buddy told me what really happened} – Do‘stim aslida nima bo‘lganini aytganda, shafqatsiz haqiqat yuzaga chiqdi.
{r:I found out that my buddy made a childish plan to skip work.} - Mening do‘stim ishga bormaslik uchun detskiy reja tuzganini bilib qoldim.

text: {r:Sword}[sɔːrd] – qilich. Tasavvur qiling {p:SUV O’RD}aklari bir-birlar bilan {h:qilichlar} ko’tarib katta jang qilibdi.
examples: {r:The knight raised his sword to defend the castle} - Ritsar qal'ani himoya qilish uchun qilichini ko'tardi.
{r:This stone is for sharpening swords} - Bu tosh qilichlarni charxlash uchun.
{r:He trained relentlessly so that his sword skills would be unmatched} - U qilichbozlik mahoratini tengsiz qilish uchun tinimsiz mashq qildi.
{r:I fell down, dropped my sword, and felt furious at my own mistake} – Men yiqilib, qilichimni tushirib yubordim va o'z xatoyimdan qattiq jahlim chiqdi.

text: {r:Glory}[ˈɡlɔːri] – sharaf, shuhrat. Tasavvur qiling Madagaskar multfilmidagi {p:GLORI}a sizning do’stingiz {h:Shuhrat} bilan qo’shiq aytibdi.
examples: {r:Athletes compete to achieve glory} - Sportchilar shon-shuhratga erishish uchun bellashadilar.
{r:If you run away now, you will lose the chance for glory} – Agar hozir qochib ketsang, shuhrat qozonish imkoniyatini boy berasan.
{r:The nation witnessed the decline of its former glory after the war.} - Millat urushdan keyin o'zining avvalgi shon-sharafining pasayishiga guvoh bo'ldi.
{r:Study history to understand ancient concepts of glory} - Qadimgi shon-shuhrat tushunchalarini tushunish uchun tarixni o'rganing.

text: {r:Queen}[kwiːn] – qirolicha.
examples: {r:He will propose that the queen should not resign so soon.} - U qirolichaning bunchalik tez iste’foga chiqmasligini taklif qiladi.
{r:This crown was made for the queen's coronation} - Bu toj malikaning toj kiyish marosimi uchun yasalgan.
{r:The queen was considerably brutal to her opponents} - Qirolicha o'z raqiblariga nisbatan anchagina shafqatsiz edi.
{r:The queen was virtually unable to speak after the illness} - Qirolicha kasallikdan so'ng deyarli gapirolmas edi.

text: {r:Merchant}[ˈmɜːrtʃənt] – savdogar. Aslida {p:MIR}za {p:CHAND}ir oldi-sotdisi bilan shug’ullanadigan {h:savdogar} bo'lgan ekan.
examples: {r:They traveled east to trade as merchants} - Ular sharqqa savdogar sifatida savdo qilish uchun sayohat qilishdi.
{r:This license is for merchant businesses only} - Bu litsenziya faqat savdogarlar biznesi uchun.
{r:The merchant was fond of helping the poor, so he often gave away food for free} – Savdogar kambag‘allarga yordam berishni yaxshi ko‘rardi, shuning uchun u tez-tez bepul ovqat tarqatardi.
{r:Learn negotiation skills to succeed as a merchant} - Savdogar sifatida muvaffaqiyat qozonish uchun muzokara mahoratlarini o'rganing.

text: {r:Concrete}[ˈkɒŋkriːt] – beton; haqiqatda, aniq, real. O’zbek tilida ham keng qo’llaniladigan 'konkret' so’zi ingliz tilida ham keng qo’llaniladi. Lekin inglizchada bu so’zning ikki xil ma’nosi bor. Bittasi xuddi bizning tildagidek 'haqiqatda', 'real' ma’nosi bo’lsa, ikkinchisi qurilishda ishlatiladigan 'beton'. Tasavvur qiling ‘’{p:KONKRET} zo’r chiqadi’’ nomli {h:beton} zavodi ochdingiz.
examples: {r:Workers mixed materials to pour concrete} - Ishchilar beton quyish uchun materiallarni aralashtirdilar.
{r:These boots are for walking on wet concrete} - Bu etiklar ho'l betonda yurish uchun.
{r:They reinforced the structure so that the concrete wouldn't crack} - Ular beton yorilmasligi uchun konstruksiyani mustahkamlashdi.
{r:We need a concrete plan so that no one will drop out halfway} – Hech kim yarim yo‘lda kursni tashlab ketmasligi uchun bizga aniq reja kerak.

text: {r:Peach}[piːtʃ] – shaftoli. Agar shaftoli sovuq urmasligini xohlasangiz uni {p:PICH}an bilan {h:o'rab qo'ying} sovuq tushmasdan.
examples: {r:The farmer grew trees to harvest peaches} - Fermer shaftoli mevasini olish uchun daraxtlar o'stirdi.
{r:This basket is for picking peaches} - Bu savat shaftoli terish uchun.
{r:We have been eating a lot of peaches lately} - Biz oxirgi paytlarda juda ko'p shaftoli yemoqdamiz.
{r:Add sugar to enhance the peach flavor} - Shaftoli tamini oshirish uchun shakar qo'shing.

text: {r:Thorough}[ˈθʌroʊ] – puxta, sinchkov. Mnemonik namuna uchun 127 - darsdagi thoroughly ga qarang.
examples: {r:She is thorough in her work.} - U ishida juda sinchkovdir.
{r:This checklist is for thorough inspections} - Bu tekshiruv ro'yxati sinchkov tekshiruvlar uchun.
{r:He documented everything so that his research would be thorough} - U tadqiqoti puxta bo'lishi uchun hamma narsani hujjatlashtirdi.
{r:Allocate time to conduct a thorough review} - Puxta tekshiruv o'tkazish uchun vaqt ajrating.

text: {r:Distance}[ˈdɪstəns] – masofa, distansiya.
examples: {r:They booked the hotel in advance because of the long distance} – Ular uzoq masofa tufayli mehmonxonani oldindan band qilishdi.
{r:This tracker device is for measuring travel distances} - Bu kuzatuvchi qurilma sayohat masofalarini o'lchash uchun.
{r:The cool boy swam a great distance without stopping} – Ajoyib yigit katta masofani to‘xtamasdan suzdi.
{r:After traveling a long distance, they came back with a sample of the hidden treasure} – Uzoq masofani bosib o‘tib, ular yashirin xazinaning bir namunasini olib qaytishdi.

text: {r:Hostage}[ˈhɒstɪdʒ] – garovga olinganlar, tutqun. Mana bu guruch donalari {p:HASIPPI ICH}ida {h:tutqun}likda.
examples: {r:The kidnappers were afraid to release the hostage without a guarantee} - O'g'rilar kafolatsiz garovni ozod qilishdan qo'rqishdi.
{r:Hostages are being constantly threatened} - Garovdagilarga muntazam tahdid qilinyapti.
{r:The police were interested to negotiate with the hostage-takers to ensure safety} - Politsiya xavfsizlikni ta'minlash uchun garovchilar bilan muzokaralar olib borishga qiziqdi.
{r:The negotiator worked tirelessly to resolve the brutal hostage situation peacefully.} - Muzokara olib boruvchi shafqatsiz garovga olish holatini tinch yo'l bilan hal qilish uchun tinimsiz ishladi.

text:
{r:Drum}[drʌm] – do'mbira, baraban; do'mbira yoki baraban chalmoq. 
Amerika prezidenti Donald {p:TRAM}pning sevimli hobbisi {h:do'mbira} chalish.
examples: {r:I am afraid to play the drum solo in front of an audience, as I might make a mistake} - Men tomoshabinlar oldida baraban solo chalishdan qo'rqyapman, chunki xato qilishim mumkin.
{r:She is afraid of making too much noise with the drum and disturbing the neighbors} - U baraban bilan juda ko'p shovqin chiqarib, qo'shnilarni bezovta qilishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested in learning how to play the drum as a hobby} - U baraban chalishni xobbi sifatida o'rganishga qiziqdi.
{r:They were sorry for breaking the drum during the performance} - Ular chiqish paytida barabanni sindirganliklari uchun uzr so'rashdi.
{r:The idea of a rabbit playing the drum seemed utterly ridiculous to the children.} - Bolalarga quyonning baraban chalishi butunlay bema'ni tuyuldi.

text: {r:Faint}[feɪnt] – hushidan ketmoq. Tasavvur qiling Alisher {p:FAY}zga {p:NOT}alar hujum qilibdi va Alisher Fayz natijada hushidan ketib qolibdi.
examples: {r:I am afraid to faint during the marathon, so I'm drinking water a lot} - Marafon paytida hushimdan ketishdan qo'rqyapman, shuning uchun ko'p suv ichyapman.
{r:She is afraid of fainting in public, as it's happened before} - U jamoat joyida hushidan ketishdan qo'rqyapti, chunki bu avval ham sodir bo'lgan.
{r:He was interested to know why some people faint in extreme heat} - U ba'zi odamlar qattiq issiqda nega hushidan ketishini bilishga qiziqdi.
{r:I'm sorry to say he might faint if we don't give him some water} - Buni aytishdan afsusdaman lekin unga suv bermasak u hushidan ketishi mumkin.

text: {r:Ancestor}[ˈænsɛstə] – ota-bobo, ajdod. Bundan 500 yil keyin o'sha davrda yashovchi avlod hozirgi o'zbek estradasini eshitib “Iye {h:ota-bobolarimiz} mana shunaqa {p:ENS}aqotirar {p:ESTR}adani eshitib yurgan ekanda qiynalib” desa kerak.
examples: {r:I am afraid to forget the stories of my ancestors; they are part of my heritage} - Ajdodlarim haqidagi hikoyalarni unutishdan qo'rqyapman; ular shajaramning bir qismi.
{r:She is afraid of losing connection with her ancestors' culture} - U ajdodlarining madaniyati bilan aloqani yo'qotishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested in learning more about his ancestors' lives and struggles} - U ajdodlarning hayoti va kurashlari haqida ko'proq bilishga qiziqdi.
{r:We're sorry for not preserving our ancestors' traditions more carefully} - Ajdodlarimizning an'analarini ehtiyotkorroq saqlab qolmaganimiz uchun uzr so'raymiz.

{r:My ancestors likely never imagined a world where one could buy so much candy.} - Mening ajdodlarim hech qachon shunchalik ko'p konfet sotib olish mumkin bo'lgan dunyoni tasavvur qilmagan bo'lsalar kerak.

text: {r:Condemn}[kənˈdɛm] – ayblamoq, tanbeh bermoq. Artel konditsioneridan olgandim Bahodir Jalolov reklama qilyapti deb. {p:KAND}itsionerni {p:EM}ali ko'chib ketdi 1 haftani ichida. Keyin Bahodirni oldiga borib yaxshilab {h:tanbeh bermoqchi} bo'ldim lekin duxim yetmadi.
examples: {r:I am afraid to condemn someone without having all the evidence} - Barcha dalillarga ega bo'lmasdan kimnidir qoralashdan qo'rqyapman.
{r:She is afraid of being condemned for making an honest mistake} - U samimiy xato qilgani uchun qoralanishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested to understand why some societies condemn certain behaviors} - U ba'zi jamiyatlar nima uchun ba'zi xatti-harakatlarni qoralashini tushunishga qiziqdi.
{r:I'm sorry to condemn your actions, but they were unacceptable} - Harakatlaringizni qoralashimdan afsuslanaman, ammo ular qabul qilinmas darajada edi.
{r:Activists object to and condemn the cruel treatment of animals.} - Faollar hayvonlarga nisbatan shafqatsiz munosabatni qoralashadi va unga e'tiroz bildirishadi.

text: {r:Steam}[stiːm] – bug'; bug'lanmoq. Men emizikli onaman. Bolamni qaynonamga qoldirib o'zim issiqda ko'chada ishlayapman. Issiqligidan ko'krak {p:SUTIM} {h:bug'lanib} ketyapti.
examples: {r:I am afraid to touch the steam directly from the boiling kettle} - Men qaynab turgan choynakdan chiqayotgan bug'ga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tegishdan qo'rqyapman.
{r:She is afraid of burning herself with the hot steam from the iron} - U dazmoldan chiqayotgan issiq bug' bilan kuyishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested to learn how steam engines work and their history} - U bug' dvigatellari qanday ishlashini va ularning tarixini o'rganishga qiziqdi.
{r:We're sorry for letting the steam fill the kitchen like that} - Oshxonani shunday bug'ga to'ldirganimiz uchun uzr so'raymiz.

text: {r:Inspiration}[ˌɪnspəˈreɪʃən] – ilhom. Inspire(ilhomlantirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I am afraid to lose my inspiration for writing my novel} - Men romanimni yozish uchun ilhomimni yo'qotishdan qo'rqyapman.
{r:She is afraid of running out of inspiration when facing a new project} - U yangi loyihaga duch kelganda ilhomining tugashidan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested in finding new sources of inspiration for his art} - U o'z san'ati uchun yangi ilhom manbalarini topishga qiziqdi.
{r:I'm sorry to interrupt your moment of inspiration} - Ilhomlanish lahzangizni buzganim uchun uzr so'rayman.

text: {r:Loyalty}[ˈlɔɪəlti] – sodiqlik, sadoqat. Loyal(sodiq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I am afraid to question his loyalty after all he's done for me} - Men uning men uchun qilgan barcha ishlaridan keyin uning sadoqatini shubha ostiga olishdan qo'rqyapman.
{r:She is afraid of losing loyalty to the team by joining a rival company} - U raqib kompaniyaga qo'shilish orqali jamoadoshlariga bo'lgan sadoqatini yo'qotishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested to learn about the concept of loyalty in different cultures} - U turli madaniyatlarda sadoqat tushunchasi haqida bilishga qiziqdi.
{r:They were sorry for betraying their friend's loyalty during a difficult time} - Ular qiyin paytda do'stlarining sadoqatiga xiyonat qilganliklari uchun uzr so'rashdi.

text: {r:Cage}[keɪdʒ] – qafas. Ma Reks sutni ich, {p:KE ICH}, icholmaysan, chunki sen {h:qafas}dasan, chiqolmaysan.
examples: {r:I am afraid to open the cage and let the bird fly away, as it might not survive} - Men qafasni ochib, qushni uchirishdan qo'rqyapman, chunki u omon qolmasligi mumkin.
{r:She is afraid of being trapped in a cage with no escape} - U qafasga qamalib qolishdan qo'rqyapti, undan qochish yo'li yo'q.
{r:He was interested in building a cage for his pet that is both safe and comfortable} - U o'z hayvoni uchun ham xavfsiz, ham qulay bo'lgan qafas qurishga qiziqdi.
{r:I'm sorry to see the animal in such a small cage} - Hayvonni bunday kichik qafasda ko'rishdan afsusdaman.

text: {r:Homeland}[ˈhoʊmlænd] – ona yurt, vatan. Home(uy) va Land(yer) so'zlarining birlashuvidan tuzilgan.
examples: {r:I am afraid to leave my homeland forever, even for a better opportunity} - Men yaxshi imkoniyat uchun ham vatanimni tark etishdan qo'rqyapman.
{r:She is afraid of forgetting her homeland's traditions and language while abroad} - U chet elda vatanining an'analari va tilini unutishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested in exploring the history and cultural heritage of his homeland} - U vatanining tarixi va madaniy merosini o'rganishga qiziqdi.
{r:We're sorry for abandoning our homeland during the war, but we had no choice} - Urush paytida vatanimizni tark etganimiz uchun afsuslanamiz, ammo bizda tanlov yo'q edi.

text: {r:State}[steɪt] – aytmoq, bayon qilmoq, bildirmoq. Bu so'zning ma'nolari juda ko'p, masalan 'shtat', 'holat'. Lekin agar u fe'l so'z turkumiga xos so'z sifatida kelsa 'bildirmoq', 'bayon qilmoq' ma'nosini bildiradi.
examples: {r:She was afraid to state her opinion directly, fearing disagreement} - U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fikrini aytishdan qo'rqardi, chunki u kelishmovchilikdan qo'rqardi.
{r:He was interested to state his case clearly to the jury} - U o'z ishini hakamlar hay'atiga aniq bayon qilishga qiziqdi.
{r:I'm sorry to state the obvious, but we're running out of time} - Men aniq narsani aytishimdan afsuslanaman, lekin vaqtimiz tugayapti.
{r:They were sorry for not stating their concerns earlier} - Ular o'z tashvishlarini avvalroq bayon etmaganliklari uchun uzr so'rashdi.

text: {r:Cartoon}[kɑːrˈtuːn] – multfilm. Kelajakda texnologiyalar shunchalik rivojlanib ketadiki {p:KARTON} ustida {h:multfilm} ko'rib o'tirsa bo'ladi.
examples: {r:I am afraid to watch horror cartoons because they give me nightmares} - Men qo'rqinchli multfilmlarni tomosha qilishdan qo'rqyapman, chunki ular menda dahshatli tushlar ko'rishga sabab bo'ladi.
{r:She is afraid of missing her favorite cartoon's new episode} - U sevimli multfilmining yangi qismini o'tkazib yuborishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He wanted to propose a silly idea for a new cartoon.} - U yangi multfilm uchun ahmoqona g‘oya taklif qilmoqchi bo‘ldi.
{r:I'm sorry to tell you, but your favorite cartoon was canceled} - Buni aytishdan afsusdaman, sevimli multfilmingiz bekor qilindi.

text: {r:Productivity}[ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti] – samarodorlik, produktivnost, mahsuldorlik. Productive(samarali) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I am afraid to lose my productivity at work due to distractions} - Ish joyida chalg'ituvchi narsalar tufayli samaradorligimni yo'qotishdan qo'rqyapman.
{r:She is afraid of being blamed for low productivity in the team} - U jamoada past samaradorlik uchun ayblanishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested in improving his productivity with new time management techniques} - U yangi vaqtni boshqarish usullari bilan samaradorligini oshirishga qiziqdi.
{r:We're sorry for the decrease in productivity this quarter} - Bu chorakda samaradorlikning pasayishi uchun uzr so'raymiz.

text: {r:Bug}[bʌɡ] – kana, hashorat; texnik nosozlik. Tasavvur qiling mashinangiz {p:BAG}ajini ochsangiz {h:kana} to'lib ketibdi bagajda.
examples: {r:I am afraid to touch the bug, thinking it might be poisonous} - Men kanaga tegishdan qo'rqyapman, chunki u zaharli bo'lishi mumkin deb o'ylayman.
{r:She is afraid of being bitten by a bug, especially in her sleep} - U kana chaqishidan qo'rqyapti, ayniqsa uyqusida.
{r:He was interested in studying the behavior of different types of bugs} - U turli xil hashoratlarning xulq-atvorini o'rganishga qiziqdi.
{r:I'm sorry for the bug in the software; we're working to fix it} - Dasturdagi nosozlik uchun uzr so'rayman; biz uni tuzatishga harakat qilyapmiz.

text: {r:Hostile}[ˈhɒstaɪl] – adovatli, dushmanlik ruhidagi. Bu yil kartoshka hosilim zo'r bo'ldi. {p:HOSIL}imni yig'ishtirib olib omborxanada saqlashni boshladim. Lekin yaxshi hosil olganimni ko'rolmagan, {h:adovatli} qo'shnilarim {p:HOSIL}imga o't qo'yib yuborishibdi.
examples: {r:I am afraid to enter the hostile territory alone} - Men dushman hududiga yolg'iz kirishdan qo'rqyapman.
{r:She is afraid of facing hostile people in her new job} - U yangi ishida adovatli odamlar bilan yuzlashishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested to understand why some people are hostile towards strangers} - U ba'zi odamlar nega begonalarga adovatli bo'lishini tushunishga qiziqdi.
{r:They imposed a hostile restriction on border crossings during the conflict.} - Ular mojaro paytida chegaradan o'tishlarga adovatli cheklovlarni joriy qildilar.

text: {r:Instant}[ˈɪnstənt] – tez, darhol. Universitetimizning telegram gruppasida rektorni masxara qilganim uchun {p:INSTTAN} {h:darhol} haydab yuborishgan.
examples: {r:I am afraid to make instant decisions without careful thought} - Men yaxshilab o'ylamasdan darhol qaror qabul qilishdan qo'rqyapman.
{r:She is afraid of missing the instant opportunity to invest} - U sarmoya kiritish uchun darhol fursatni o'tkazib yuborishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested in learning about instant solutions to complex problems} - U murakkab muammolarga tez yechimlar haqida bilishga qiziqdi.
{r:I'm sorry to interrupt, but I need an instant response} - Uzr bo'lganim uchun, lekin menga tez javob kerak.

text: {r:Measure}[ˈmɛʒər] – chora. Biror muammoning zararlarini kamaytirish uchun qo'llaniladigan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:They introduced strict measures to control traffic and give fines.} - Ular tirbandlikni nazorat qilish va jarimalar berish uchun qattiq choralar kiritdilar.
{r:She is afraid of the government not taking enough measures to combat poverty} - U hukumatning qashshoqlikka qarshi kurashish uchun yetarli choralar ko'rmasligidan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested to learn about the measures taken by other countries during the crisis} - U inqiroz davrida boshqa davlatlar tomonidan ko'rilgan choralar haqida bilishga qiziqdi.
{r:We're sorry for not implementing safety measures earlier} - Xavfsizlik choralarini avvalroq joriy qilmaganimiz uchun uzr so'raymiz.

text: {r:Afterward(s)}[ˈæftərwərdz] – keyinchalik, bundan keyin.
examples: {r:They decided to go away afterwards to forget the pain of their failure} – Ular muvaffaqiyatsizlik iztirobini unutish uchun keyinroq ketishga qaror qilishdi.
{r:She put down the phone afterwards and adjusted her tie before the meeting} – Keyin u telefonini qo‘ydi va uchrashuvdan oldin galstugini tuzatdi.
{r:Obviously, they looked after the injured man, and afterwards he recovered fully} – Ayonki, ular jarohatlangan odamga qarashdi va keyin u to‘liq sog‘ayib ketdi.
{r:Hold on for a few minutes, and afterwards we will go together} – Bir necha daqiqa kut, keyin birga boramiz.

text: {r:Spectacular}[spɛkˈtækjələr] – ajoyib, qoyilmaqom. 'Parvona' o'zbek teatri tarixidagi eng {h:ajoyib} {p:SPEKTAKL}.
examples: {r:Her performance has been absolutely spectacular lately} - Uning ijrosi rosa qoyilmaqom bo'lyapti oxirgi paytlarda.
{r:The competition was so spectacular that I want to go back and compete next year} – Musobaqa shu qadar ajoyib bo‘ldiki, men kelasi yili qaytib borib, musobaqada qatnashmoqchiman.
{r:He was interested in creating a spectacular event that everyone would remember} - U hamma eslaydigan ajoyib tadbir tashkil qilishga qiziqdi.
{r:I'm sorry to interrupt your spectacular presentation} - Ajoyib taqdimotingizni bo'lganim uchun uzr so'rayman.

text: {r:Ruin}[ˈruːɪn] – vayrona, xaroba; barbod qilmoq, vayron qilmoq. Yaqinda yuz bergan kuchli shamol butun {p:RAYON}ni {h:vayron qildi}.
examples: {r:The heavy rain ruined the annual festival, so they had to turn around and go home} – Kuchli yomg‘ir yillik festivalni barbod qildi, shuning uchun ular orqaga qaytib, uyga ketishdi.
{r:She is afraid of ruining her reputation by making a bad decision} - U yomon qaror qabul qilib, o'z obro'sini buzishdan qo'rqyapti.
{r:He was interested in restoring the ruined ancient castle} - U vayron qilingan qadimiy qasrni tiklashga qiziqdi.

{r:The map provided precise instructions on how to accompany the tour group through the ancient ruins.} - Xarita qadimiy xarobalar bo'ylab sayyohlik guruhiga qanday hamrohlik qilish bo'yicha aniq ko'rsatmalar berdi.

text: {r:Thoroughly}[ˈθʌroʊli] – detalniy, batafsil, e'tibor bilan. Mening xotinim Hindistonlik. Yaqinda uylanib O'zbekistonga olib kelgandim Mirobod bozorida yo'qotib qo'ydim. Ana endi {h:diqqat bilan} bozorda {p:SARILI} ayolni qarindoshlarimiz bilan qidirib yuribmiz.
examples: {r:I saw him thoroughly clean the room} - Men uning xonani diqqat bilan tozalashini ko'rdim.
{r:She heard the mechanic thoroughly check the car} - U mexanikning mashinani diqqat bilan tekshirishini eshitdi.
{r:He felt the doctor thoroughly examine his injury} - U shifokorning jarohatini diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqishini his qildi.
{r:They noticed the chef thoroughly cooking the meal} - Ular oshpazning ovqatni puxta pishirishini payqadilar.

text: {r:Shoulder}[ˈʃoʊldər] – yelka. 'xed{p:SHOLDER}s' shampunini eslaysizmi? Avvalari har kuni televizorda reklama qilinardi. Inglizcha nomi Head and Shoulders ya'ni bosh va {h:yelka.} Demak bu shampun nafaqat sochga balki yelkani ham xushbo'y qilib qo'yadi.
examples: {r:Initially I saw him carry the heavy bag on his shoulder later he just disappeared} - Men dastlab uning og'ir sumkani yelkasida ko'tarib yurganini ko'rdim keyinchalik esa u yo'qolib qoldi.
{r:He got up, put his bag on his shoulder, and went to contribute to the charity event} – U o‘rnidan turdi, sumkasini yelkasiga soldi va xayriya tadbiriga hissa qo‘shish uchun yo‘l oldi.
{r:Beside the old bridge, I came across a man carrying a heavy bag on his shoulder} – Eski ko‘prik yonida men yelkasida og‘ir sumka ko‘tarib ketayotgan odamga duch keldim.
{r:I looked around the market with my camera hanging from my shoulder} – Men bozor atrofida yelkamda osilgan kamera bilan qarab yurdim.

text: {r:Explode}[ɪkˈsploʊd] – portlatmoq, portlamoq. Televizor plutlarining ham o'zining mutaxassislari bor ekan. Ustasi farang {p:EKSP}ert {p:PLUT}shunoslar kerakli tugmalarni bosib televizorni ham {h:portlatib} yubora oladi.
examples: {r:I saw the fireworks explode in the sky} - Men salyutlarning osmonda portlashini ko'rdim.
{r:She heard the bomb explode in the distance} - U uzoqdan bomba portlashini eshitdi.
{r:He felt the building explode during the earthquake} - U zilzila paytida binoning portlashini his qildi.
{r:They noticed the gas tank explode in the fire} - Ular yong'inda gaz bakining portlashini payqadilar.

text: {r:Tremendous}[trəˈmɛndəs] – ulkan, katta, bahaybat. Bir kuni do'stim hazillashib chahlimni chiqarib qo'ydi. Jahlim chiqqanida {p:REMEN} bilan {p:DO'S}timni soniga bir urdim. Temir bilan ursa qattiq tegar ekan. Shundan so'ng uning sonida {h:bahaybat} shish paydo bo'ldi.
examples: {r:I saw the team achieve a tremendous victory} - Men jamoaning ulkan g'alabasiga guvoh bo'ldim.
{r:She heard the crowd cheer with tremendous enthusiasm} - U olomonning katta ishtiyoq bilan qichqirishini eshitdi.
{r:He felt the impact of the tremendous explosion} - U katta portlash ta'sirini his qildi.
{r:They noticed the growth of the company with tremendous success} - Ular kompaniyaning katta muvaffaqiyat bilan o'sishini payqadilar.

text: {r:Shave}[ʃeɪv] – qirmoq, olmoq(soch va soqolni). Tasavvur qiling siz qamoqxonadasiz. Bu yerda har xil guruhlar, to'dalar bor. Sizni ham bir jinoyatchi to'da o'z safiga oldi. Sizning vazifangiz har kuni to'da {p:SHEF}ini soqolini {h:qirib olib qo'yish}.
examples: {r:I saw him shave his beard completely} - Men uning soqolini butunlay qirib tashlaganini ko'rdim.
{r:She heard her brother shaving in the bathroom} - U akasining hammomda soqol olayotganini eshitdi.
{r:He felt the razor shave his face smoothly} - U ustaraning yuzini silliq qirib olishini his qildi.
{r:They noticed the barber shaving the customer} - Ular sartaroshning mijozning soqolini olayotganini payqadilar.

text: {r:Instantly}[ˈɪnstəntli] – tezda. Instant(tez) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:I saw the car stop instantly} - Men mashinaning darhol to'xtashini ko'rdim.
{r:She heard the alarm ring instantly} - U signalning darhol chalinishini eshitdi.
{r:He felt the pain disappear instantly} - U og'riqning darhol yo'qolishini his qildi.
{r:They noticed the light turn on instantly} - Ular chiroqning darhol yonishini payqadilar.
{r:It was a pure fantasy to believe one good deed could fix all the problems instantly.} - Birgina yaxshi ish barcha muammolarni hal qila oladi deb ishonish sof fantastika edi.

text: {r:Mysterious}[mɪˈstɪəriəs] – sirli, jumboqli. Mystery(sir, jumboq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I saw the guy disappear mysteriously} - Men bir yigitning sirli tarzda g'oyib bo'lishini ko'rdim.
{r:They were at a disadvantage because they couldn’t figure out the mysterious plan in time} – Ular vaqtida sirli rejani tushunolmagani uchun noqulay vaziyatda qolishdi.
{r:He felt the atmosphere become mysterious} - U atmosferaning sirli bo'lib qolganini his qildi.
{r:They noticed the object move mysteriously} - Ular narsaning sirli harakatlanishini payqadilar.

text: {r:Sheer}[ʃɪər] – mutlaqo, juda; tik, nishab. Bu vaziyatda {p:SHOIR} Ahad Qayumni (yoki boshqa o'zingiz taniga shoir) tik joylashgan tepalikka ko'tarilib ketayotganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:The idea was sheer genius} - G‘oya mutlaq daholik edi.
{r:She felt sheer joy after hearing the cool news} - U yaxshi xabarni eshitgach, mutlaq quvonch his qildi.
{r:They climbed the sheer rock face with great difficulty} - Ular tik qoyadan katta qiyinchilik bilan ko‘tarilishdi.
{r:His argument was sheer nonsense} - Uning dalili mutlaq bema’nilik edi.

text: {r:Reliability}[rɪˌlaɪəˈbɪləti] – ishonchlilik. Reliable(ishonchli) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I saw the car prove its reliability} - Men mashinaning ishonchliligini isbotlashini ko'rdim.
{r:They kept on gathering data to test the reliability of the new system} – Ular yangi tizimning ishonchliligini sinash uchun ma’lumot to‘plashni davom ettirishdi.
{r:They noticed the improvement in the reliability of the service} - Ular xizmatning ishonchliligining yaxshilanishini payqadilar.
{r:Her reliability and charm made everyone trust her at the swimming club} – Uning ishonchliligi va jozibasi suzish klubidagi hammaning ishonchini qozondi.

text: {r:Fascinating}[ˈfæsɪneɪtɪŋ] – maftunkor, qoyilmaqom. Mana bu ko'ylak {p:FASONNI ITI}(ya'ni zo'ri) ekan. Juda ham {h:maftunkor.} Rasmdagi qizning ismi ham Maftun o'zi.
examples: {r:They get along so well because they both find history fascinating} – Ular juda yaxshi chiqishadi, chunki ikkalasi ham tarixni juda qiziqarli deb biladi.
{r:The fascinating news about the rare male bird spread quickly among researchers} – Noyob erkak qush haqidagi qiziqarli xabar tadqiqotchilar orasida tez tarqaldi.
{r:He felt the experience become fascinating} - U tajribaning qoyilmaqom bo'lib borayotganini his qildi.
{r:They noticed the artwork look fascinating and cool} - Ular san'at asarining qoyilmaqom va ajoyib ko'rinishini payqadilar.

text: {r:Tolerate}[ˈtɒləreɪt] – chidamoq, bardosh bermoq. Universitet ma'muriyati {p:TAL}abalarga {p:REYD}lar qilardi yotoqxonada(obshejityada) 'uyatsiz narsalar ko'rmayaptimi, taqiqlangan diniy materiallardan foydalanmayaptimi' deb. Bu reydlarga {h:chidolmay} oxiri kvartiraga chiqib ketdim.
examples: {r:I saw him tolerate the pain} - Men uning og'riqqa chidashini ko'rdim.
{r:She noticed the teacher tolerate the noise} - U o'qituvchining shovqinga chidashini sezdi.
{r:He felt the pressure but tolerated it} - U bosimni his qildi, lekin chidadi.
{r:They noticed the team tolerate the difficult conditions} - Ular jamoaning qiyin sharoitlarga chidashini payqadilar.

text: {r:Cab}[kæb] – taksi. Kecha Yandeksdan {h:taksi} chaqirsam taksichi {p:KAB}ob yeb o'tiribdi mashinaning ichida. Ustidan kompaniyaga bir shikoyat qilay dedimu lekin uning vaziyatini tushundim.
examples: {r:I saw the cab arrive at the station} - Men taksining stansiyaga yetib kelganini ko'rdim.
{r:My father found an excellent hotel, and a cab took us there.} - Otam ajoyib mehmonxonani topdi va taksi bizni u yerga olib bordi.
{r:He felt the cab stop suddenly} - U taksini to'satdan to'xtashini his qildi.
{r:I took charge of my father's cab company} - Men dadamning taksi kompaniyasida boshqaruvni qo'limga oldim.

text: {r:Terrific}[təˈrɪfɪk] – dahshatli, zo'r, qoyilmaqom. Kecha juda {h:zo'r} kino ko'rdim. Bu kino {p:TERIG}a allergiya bervordi maza qilganimdan.
examples: {r:I saw the performance become terrific} - Men spektaklning dahshatli bo'lib borishini ko'rdim.
{r:It was hard for him to reject such a terrific opportunity to travel abroad} – U uchun xorijga sayohat qilishdek ajoyib imkoniyatni rad etish qiyin edi.
{r:He felt the excitement of the terrific event} - U qoyilmaqom voqeadan hayajonlanishni his qildi.
{r:They noticed the improvement in the terrific results} - Ular qoyilmaqom natijalarning yanada yaxshilanishini payqadilar.

text: {r:Whale}[weɪl] – kit. Mashhur futbolchi Garet Beyl Uels terma jamoasi safida maydonga tushganidan so'ng dengizga dam olishga boribdi va u yerda {p:BEYL} {h:kitning} hujumiga uchradi va xayriyatki omon qoldi.
examples: {r:I specifically saw a white whale} - Men aynan oq kitni ko'rdim.
{r:She heard the whale sing underwater} - U kitning suv ostida qo'shiq aytishini eshitdi.
{r:He felt the power of the whale's movement} - U kitning harakatlanish kuchini his qildi.
{r:We cannot exclude the little details about the whale.} - Biz kit haqidagi kichik tafsilotlarni chiqarib tashlay olmaymiz.

text: {r:Puzzle}[ˈpʌzl] – jumboq; boshqotirma. Kecha Toshkentga borsam Jahongir {p:POZIL}jonovning {h:boshqotirma} yechib o'tirganini ko'rib hayron bo'ldim. Men uni bilimsiz odam deb o'ylardim.
examples: {r:I do not like weird puzzles altogether} - Men g'alati jumboqlarni butunlay yomon ko'raman.
{r:She heard the child play with the puzzle} - U bolaning jumboq bilan o'ynashini eshitdi.
{r:He felt the satisfaction of completing the puzzle} - U jumboqni yechib bo'lganidan qoniqish his qildi.
{r:He did his best to solve the puzzle, but it only frustrated him.} - U jumboqni yechishga qattiq harakat qildi, lekin bu faqat uni xafa qildi.

text: {r:Mushroom}[ˈmʌʃrʊm] – qo'ziqorin. Mana bu {p:MASH}hur {p:RUM}ka chunki bundan Ronaldo, Ramos, Benzema, Kross ichishgan. Eng qizig'i bu rumka {h:qo'ziqorindan} qilingan.
examples: {r:I saw the mushrooms grow in the forest} - Men o'rmonda qo'ziqorinlar o'sishini ko'rdim.
{r:She heard the chef cook the mushrooms} - U oshpazning qo'ziqorin pishirishini eshitdi.
{r:At high speed, we passed a field partially filled with giant mushrooms} – Yuqori tezlikda biz ulkan qo‘ziqorinlar bilan qisman qoplagan maydondan o‘tdik.
{r:They noticed the smell of the mushrooms} - Ular qo'ziqorinlarning hidini payqadilar.

text: {r:Ring}[rɪŋ] – uzuk; jiringlamoq(telefon, signal).
examples: {r:She wore a gold ring on her finger.} – U barmog‘iga oltin uzuk taqdi.
{r:The phone began to ring loudly.} – Telefon baland ovozda jiringlay boshladi.
{r:They exchanged cool rings at the wedding.} – Ular to‘yda ajoyib uzuk almashishdi.
{r:The couple promised each other a lifelong marriage when they exchanged rings} – Juftlik uzuk almashganda bir-biriga butun umr davom etadigan nikoh va’da qildi.

text: {r:Luck}[lʌk] – omad, baxt. Qizlar laki juda ham muammoli narsa. Uni sasitib surtishadi, yaxshi chiqmay qolsa xafa bo’lishadi, uni o’chirish ham bir muammo. Xullas biz yigitlarning {p:LAK} surtmasligimiz ham bir {h:omad}imiz.
examples: {r:He had good luck in the game.} – U o‘yinda omadli bo‘ldi.
{r:My grandmother believes in luck.} – Buvim omadga ishonadi.
{r:With a bit of luck, we’ll win.} – Biroz omad bilan biz yutamiz.

{r:With a bit of luck, she found a suitable dress before the shopkeeper started to yell about closing time.} – Biroz omad bilan u mos keladigan ko‘ylak topdi, do‘konchi yopilish vaqti haqida baqira boshlashidan oldin.

text: {r:Silly}[ˈsɪli] – ahmoqona, kulgili, beo'xshov. Ahmoq va {h:bema’ni} odamlarni tuzatish uchun ular ustiga bir piyola {p:SELI}tra sochib yuborish foyda berar ekan(lekin amalda qilib ko’rmang).
examples: {r:He made a silly joke and everyone laughed.} – U ahmoqona hazil qildi va hamma kuldi.
{r:Don’t be silly, it’s just a game.} – Tentak bo‘lma, bu shunchaki o‘yin.
{r:The kids wore silly hats at the party.} – Bolalar bazmda beo'xshov shapkalar kiyishdi.
{r:She acted silly to make her friend glad.} – U do‘stini xursand qilish uchun tentaklik qildi.

text: {r:Earthquake}[ˈɜːrθkweɪk] – zilzila.
examples: {r:Feeling the ground shake, we ran outside during the earthquake} - Yer titrayotganini his qilib, biz zilzila paytida tashqariga yugurdik.
{r:The earthquake caused a massive disaster in the region.} - Zilzila mintaqada katta falokatga sabab bo'ldi.
{r:Seeing the damage caused by the earthquake, they decided to help} - Zilzila olib kelgan zararni ko'rib, ular yordam berishga qaror qilishdi.
{r:Having experienced an earthquake before, he knew what to do} - Oldin zilzilani boshidan kechirganligi sababli, u nima qilish kerakligini bilar edi.

text: {r:Entrepreneur}[ˌɒntrəprəˈnɜːr] – tadbirkor.
examples: {r:Starting his own business, the entrepreneur faced many challenges} - O'z biznesini boshlab, tadbirkor ko'plab qiyinchiliklarga duch keldi.
{r:Having worked hard, the entrepreneur achieved success} - Qattiq mehnat qilib, tadbirkor muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
{r:Feeling inspired, the entrepreneur launched a new product} - Ilhomlangan holda, tadbirkor yangi mahsulotni ishga tushirdi.
{r:Seeing the market demand, the entrepreneur expanded his business} - Bozordagi talabni ko'rib, tadbirkor biznesini kengaytirdi.
{r:The successful entrepreneur spoke about his humble beginnings in a distant village.} - Muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkor o'zining uzoq qishloqdagi kamtarona boshlanishi haqida gapirdi.

text: {r:Waist}[weɪst] – bel.
examples: {r:Wearing a belt around her waist, she looked stylish} - Beliga kamar bog'lab, u zamonaviy ko'rinardi.
{r:Feeling pain in his waist, he went to see a doctor} - Belida og'riq his qilib, u shifokorga borishga qaror qildi.
{r:Having measured her waist, she bought the perfect dress} - Belini o'lchab, u mukammal ko'ylak sotib oldi.
{r:My waist was unable to endure this pressure} - Mening belim bu bosimga chiday olmas edi.

text: {r:Hip}[hɪp] – son. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:XIP} xop musiqasiga raqsga tushyapsiz. Bu sho'x janrga mos bo'lay deya siz jinsi shimingizni {h:son} tarafini kesib ochib tashladingiz.
examples: {r:Feeling pain in her hip, she stopped running} - Sonida og'riq his qilib, u yugurishni to'xtatdi.
{r:Having injured his hip, he needed surgery} - Sonini jarohatlab olgani uchun unga operatsiya kerak bo'ldi.
{r:My hips are thick} - Mening sonlarim qalin.
{r:Wearing a hip brace, he felt more comfortable} - Son bandajini kiyib, u o'zini qulayroq his qildi.

text: {r:Sibling}[ˈsɪblɪŋ] – ingliz tilida tug'ishgan aka-uka, opa-singillar 'sibling' deyiladi.
examples: {r:Playing with her sibling, she felt happy} - Tug'ishgani bilan o'ynab, u baxtiyor bo'ldi.
{r:Having argued with his sibling, he apologized} - Tug'ishgani bilan bahslashib, u uzr so'radi.
{r:Seeing her sibling succeed, she felt proud} - Tug'ishganining muvaffaqiyatini ko'rib, u faxrlanishni his qildi.
{r:Feeling lonely, she called her sibling for support} - Yolg'izlikni his qilib, u qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun tug'ishganiga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

text: {r:Rival}[ˈraɪvəl] – raqib; raqiblik qilmoq. Tasavvur qiling {p:RAY}on va {p:VIL}oyat(yoki rayhon va vilka) bir-biriga {h:raqiblik} qilib boks tushmoqchi ekan.
examples: {r:Competing with his rival, he gave his best} - Raqibi bilan raqobatlashib, u o'zining eng yaxshisini berdi(jon-jahdi bilan harakat qildi degani).
{r:Having defeated his rival, he celebrated the victory} - Raqibini mag'lub etgach, u g'alabani nishonladi.
{r:Seeing his rival succeed, he felt motivated} - Raqibining muvaffaqiyatini ko'rib, u ilhomlandi.
{r:Feeling the pressure from his rival, he worked harder} - Raqibining bosimini his qilib, u yanada qattiqroq ishladi.

text: {r:Liquid}[ˈlɪkwɪd] – suyuqlik, suyuq. Mana bu sehrli likopcha lyuboy qattiq jismni eritib suyuq holatga keltirish xususiyatiga ega. Masalan {p:LIK}opchaga {p:VIT}aminlar solgandim eritib {h:suyuq} qilib berdi.
examples: {r:Spilling the liquid, she quickly cleaned it up} - Suyuqlikni to'kib yuborib, u tezda tozaladi.
{r:Having poured the liquid into the glass, he drank it} - Suyuqlikni stakanga quyib, uni ichdi.
{r:Seeing the liquid boil, she turned off the stove} - Suyuqlik qaynayotganini ko'rib, u pechni o'chirdi.
{r:Feeling the cold liquid on his skin, he shivered} - Terisidagi sovuq suyuqlikni his qilib, u titradi.
{r:The scientist prepared a strange liquid mixture for the experiment.} - Olim tajriba uchun g'alati suyuq aralashma tayyorladi.

text: {r:Cheat}[tʃiːt] – g'irromlik qilmoq, qalloblik qilmoq; xiyonat qilmoq. Mashhur kinoqahramon Jek {p:CHIT}tak universitet imtihonlarida shpagalka olib kirib {h:g'irromlik} bilan universitetga kirib ketibdi.
examples: {r:Cheating on the exam consistently, he felt guilty eventually} - Imtihonda doimo g'irromlik qilib, u o'zini nihoyat aybdor his qildi.
{r:Having been caught cheating, he faced consequences} - G'irromlik qilayotganida ushlanganligi uchun u oqibatlarga duch keldi.
{r:Seeing his friend cheat, she reported it to the teacher} - Do'stining g'irromlik qilayotganini ko'rib, u o'qituvchiga xabar berdi.

{r:Honest competitors had to endure injustice while others managed to cheat and gain an advantage.} - Boshqalar g'irromlik qilib ustunlikka erishayotgan bir paytda halol ishtirokchilar adolatsizlikka chidashiga to'g'ri kelardi.
{r:My husband cheated on me} - Mening erim menga xiyonat qildi.

text: {r:Heal}[hiːl] – tuzalmoq; tuzatmoq; bitib ketmoq(yara). Sizning ajoyib bir odatingiz bor. Agarda kasal bo'lib qolsangiz O'zbekiston bayrog'ini bitta {p:HIL}piratasiz va {h:tuzalib ketasiz}.
examples: {r:Healing from the injury, he took time off work} - Jarohatdan tuzalib, u ishdan tanaffus oldi.(time off - tanaffus)
{r:Having healed completely, he returned to sports} - To'liq tuzalib, u sportga qaytdi.
{r:Seeing the wound heal, she felt relieved} - Yaraning bitib ketayotganini ko'rib, u xotirjam bo'ldi.
{r:Feeling the pain slowly heal, he became more optimistic} - Og'riqning asta-sekin yo'qolayotganini his qilib, u yanada optimistik bo'ldi.
{r:It will take time to heal the internal wounds caused by the conflict.} - Tortishuv natijasida yuzaga kelgan ichki yaralarni davolash vaqt talab etadi.

text: {r:Fever}[ˈfiːvər] – isitma, harorat. Tasodifmi yoki yo'q bilmayman {p:FIVR}al oyida juda ko'p {h:isitmalayman}.
examples: {r:Suffering from a fever considerably, she stayed in bed} - Isitmadan anchagina aziyat chekib u kravatda yotardi.
{r:Having recovered from the fever, he went back to school} - Isitmadan tuzalib, u maktabga qaytdi.
{r:Seeing her child with a fever, she called the doctor} - Bolaning isitmasi borligini ko'rib, u shifokorga qo'ng'iroq qildi.
{r:Feeling the fever rise, he took medicine} - Isitma ko'tarilayotganini his qilib, u dori ichdi.

text: {r:Rabbit}[ˈræbɪt] – quyon.
examples: {r:Chasing the rabbit, the dog ran through the garden} - Quyonni quvib, it bog' orqali yugurdi.
{r:Having caught the rabbit, the hunter felt proud once again} - Quyonni tutib, ovchi yana bir marta faxrlanishni his qildi.
{r:Rabbits love to eat fresh carrots from the garden.} - Quyonlar bog'dan yangi sabzi yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:He felt silly for believing that a rabbit brings luck.} - Quyon omad keltiradi deb ishonganidan u o‘zini ahmoqdek his qildi.

text: {r:Upstairs}[ˌʌpˈsteəz] – yuqori qavat, yuqoriga, tepada.
examples: {r:Going upstairs instantly, she found her lost book} - Yuqoriga tezda chiqib, u yo'qotgan kitobini topdi.
{r:Having cleaned upstairs, he took a break once again} - Yuqori qavatni tozalab, u yana bir marta tanaffus oldi.
{r:Seeing the mess upstairs, she started cleaning} - Yuqori qavatdagi tartibsizlikni ko'rib, u tozalashni boshladi.
{r:Feeling tired, he went upstairs to rest} - Charchaganini his qilib, u dam olish uchun yuqoriga chiqdi.

text: {r:Downstairs}[ˌdaʊnˈsteəz] – pastki qavat, pastga, quyida.
examples: {r:Running downstairs, he tripped and fell} - Pastga yugurib, u chalinib yiqildi.
{r:Having finished his work downstairs, he went outside} - Pastki qavatdagi ishini tugatib, u tashqariga chiqdi.
{r:Seeing the guests downstairs, she greeted them warmly} - Pastdagi mehmonlarni ko'rib, u ularni issiq kutib oldi.
{r:Feeling the cool air downstairs, he decided to stay} - Pastdagi salqin havoni his qilib, u qolishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Backyard}[ˌbækˈjɑːrd] – hovli. Tasavvur qiling siz juda dangasiz va {h:hovlingizni} ham yig'ishtirmaysiz. Bu ishda sizga {p:BEK}zod {p:YORD}am beradi.
examples: {r:I can't tolerate seeing rabbits in my backyard} - Hovlimda quyonlarni ko'rishga chidolmayman.
{r:Having planted flowers in the backyard, she admired her work} - Hovliga gullar ekib, u o'z ishiga hayrat bilan qaradi.
{r:Seeing the mess in the backyard, he started cleaning} - Hovlidagi tartibsizlikni ko'rib, u tozalashni boshladi.
{r:Feeling the sun in the backyard, she decided to relax} - Hovlidagi quyoshni his qilib, u dam olishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Consent}[kənˈsent] – rozilik bermoq; rozilik, ko'nish. O'zbekistonlik repper Konsta Amerikalik repper 50 SENT bilan {p:KONSERT} berishga {h:rozilik berdi.} Tez orada O'zbekiston va Amerikalik rep qirollarining duetini ko'rishimiz mumkin.
examples: {r:Giving his consent, he signed the contract} - Rozilik berib, u shartnomani imzoladi.
{r:Having obtained consent, they proceeded with the project} - Rozilik olib, ular loyihani davom ettirdilar.
{r:Seeing the importance of consent, she explained it clearly} - Rozilikning muhimligini ko'rib, u buni aniq tushuntirdi.
{r:Feeling unsure, he asked for consent before acting} - Ishonchsizlikni his qilib, u harakat qilishdan oldin rozilik so'radi.

text: {r:Explosion}[ɪkˈsploʊʒən] – portlash. Explode(portlamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The sudden explosion of a gas canister spread garbage across the entire street.} - Gaz ballonining to'satdan portlashi butun ko'cha bo'ylab axlatni sochib yubordi.
{r:Having witnessed the explosion, he called the police instantly} - Portlash guvohi bo'lib, u politsiyaga tezda qo'ng'iroq qildi.
{r:Seeing the damage from the explosion, they felt shocked} - Portlash olib kelgan zararni ko'rib, ular hayratga tushishdi.
{r:The explosion in the village was an act of sheer cruelty against innocent people} – Qishloqdagi portlash begunoh odamlarga nisbatan sof shafqatsizlik edi.

text: {r:Fascinated}[ˈfæsɪneɪtɪd] – lol qolgan, hayratlangan.
examples: {r:Watching the performance, she was fascinated by the music} - Spektaklni tomosha qilib, u musiqaga lol qoldi.
{r:Having read the book, he was fascinated by the story} - Kitobni o'qib, u hikoyaga hayrat qoldi.
{r:Seeing the artwork, they were fascinated by the creativity} - San'at asarini ko'rib, ular ijodkorlikka hayrat qolishdi.
{r:Feeling the energy of the crowd, she was fascinated by the atmosphere} - Olomon energiyasini his qilib, u atmosferaga lol qoldi.

text: {r:Glorious}[ˈɡlɔːriəs] – shuhratli, sharafli. Glory(shon-sharaf) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Watching the sunset, she admired the glorious colors} - Quyosh botishini tomosha qilib, u shuhratli ranglarga hayrat qildi.
{r:Having won the competition, he felt glorious} - Musobaqada g'alaba qozonib, u sharafli his qildi.
{r:Seeing the glorious view, they took many photos} - Shuhratli manzarani ko'rib, ular ko'p rasm oldilar.
{r:Feeling the glorious weather, she decided to go for a walk} - Ajoyib ob-havoni his qilib, u sayr qilishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Sin}[sɪn] – gunoh. Hind kinolaridagi {p:SIN}durning musulmon tomonidan surtilishi {h:gunoh} hisoblanar ekan. Chunki Hindistonda ham sindur diniy ma'noga ega va faqatgina hindular surtishi mumkin.
examples: {r:Stealing is considered a sin in many cultures.} – O‘g‘rilik ko‘plab madaniyatlarda gunoh hisoblanadi.
{r:She said it would be a sin to resign before finishing the work.} - U ishni tugatmasdan iste’foga chiqish gunoh bo‘ladi, dedi.
{r:They believe lying is a serious sin.} – Ular yolg‘on gapirishni jiddiy gunoh deb hisoblashadi.
{r:He felt useless after he quit his job, thinking it was a sin to waste his talent} – U ishdan bo‘shaganidan keyin o‘zini keraksiz his qildi, iste’dodini isrof qilish gunoh deb o‘yladi.

text: {r:Fry}[fraɪ] – qovurmoq; qovurma. Tasavvur qiling siz qozonga yog' solib qizitdingiz va {p:FRA}nsiya bayrog'ini {h:qovurib} yubordingiz.
examples: {r:First, fry the onion. Next, add the potato} - Birinchi piyozni qovur. Keyin esa kartoshkani qo'sh.
{r:You have to fry the mixture well} - Aralashmani yaxshilab qovurishingiz kerak.
{r:He enjoyed the chicken fry at the restaurant} - U restoranda tovuq qovurmasidan mazza qildi.
{r:They prepared a vegetable fry for the party} - Ular ziyofat uchun sabzavot qovurmasini tayyorladilar.

text: {r:Inspect}[ɪnˈspɛkt] – tekshirmoq, tekshiruv o'tkazmoq. Kinolarda {p:INSPEKT}orlar nima ish qilishini eslaysizmi? Ular {h:tekshiruv o'tkazadi}, analiz qiladi va xulosa yozadi.
examples: {r:The safety inspector checked the building altogether.} - Xavfsizlik inspektori binoni to'liq tekshirdi.
{r:She works as a quality inspector at the factory} - U zavodda sifat nazoratchisi sifatida ishlaydi.
{r:He conducted a health inspection at the school} - U maktabda sog'liqni saqlash tekshiruvini o'tkazdi.
{r:They hired a building inspector to check the house} - Ular uyni tekshirish uchun bino inspektorini yollashdi.

text: {r:Castle}[ˈkæsəl] – qal'a, qasr. Fransiyada bo'lajak epidemiyalar uchun qal'alar qurilyapti. {p:KASAL}lar uchun qurilyotgan bu {h:qal'alar} shifoxona vazifasini ham bajaradi.
examples: {r:We have visited a sand castle on the beach recently} - Biz oxirgi paytlarda plyajdagi qum qasriga bir necha marta tashrif buyurdik.
{r:She read a book about a fairy tale castle} - U ertak qal'asi haqida kitob o'qidi.
{r:He built a toy castle for his children} - U bolalari uchun o'yinchoq qal'a qurdi.
{r:She carried a bucket of sand to build a sandcastle on the beach.} - U plyajda qumli qasr qurish uchun bir chelak qum olib bordi.

text: {r:Means}[miːnz] – vosita, yo'l, usul. Tasavvur qiling ertaklar olamida {p:MINUS} belgisi sizni qo'shni shaharga eltib qo'yuvchi transport {h:vositasi}.
examples: {r:The subway was a familiar means of transport} - Metro men uchun tanish transport vositasi edi.
{r:She used a unique means of communication to contact her rival} - U raqibi bilan bog'lanish uchun noyob aloqa vositasidan foydalandi.
{r:They discussed the means of production at the factory} - Ular zavodda ishlab chiqarish vositalarini muhokama qilishdi.
{r:He discovered a means of escape from the situation} - U vaziyatdan qochish yo'lini topdi.

text: {r:Origin}[ˈɒrɪdʒɪn] – kelib chiqish, asos. Amerikada mana bu {p:O’R}ada {p:JIN} yashaydi. Xalq uni yaxshi ko’radi chunki u choy damlab keluvchi jin, sehrgar jin emas. Qachonki choy so’rasangiz ‘mana choy’ deb choynagi bilan berib yuboradi. Agar jinni chaqirmoqchi bo’lsangiz o’rasini silasangiz bas. Choyga bo’lgan muhabbatidan menimcha bu jinning {h:kelib chiqishi} O’zbekistondan.
examples: {r:She studied the origin of language in her class} - U darsda tilning kelib chiqishini o'rgandi.
{r:He researched the origin of the universe} - U koinotning kelib chiqishini tadqiq qildi.
{r:They discussed the origin of the tradition} - Ular an'ananing kelib chiqishini muhokama qilishdi.
{r:He wrote a book about the origin of life} - U hayotning kelib chiqishi haqida kitob yozdi.
{r:The unique origin of the band appealed to every teenager in the crowd.} - Guruhning noyob kelib chiqishi olomondagi har bir o'smirga yoqdi.

text: {r:Trader}[ˈtreɪdər] – savdogar. Trade(savdo) so'zidan olingan.
examples: {r:She met a stock trader at the conference and criticized his occupation} - U konferensiyada birja savdogari bilan uchrashdi va uning kasbini qoraladi.
{r:He works as a currency trader at the bank} - U bankda valyuta savdogari sifatida ishlaydi.
{r:The young trader used his charm to propose a new business deal} – Yosh savdogar yangi biznes kelishuvini taklif qilish uchun o‘z jozibasidan foydalandi.
{r:He became a successful trader in the market instantly} - U tezda bozorda muvaffaqiyatli savdogar bo'ldi.

text: {r:Disabled}[dɪsˈeɪbld] – nogiron. Mana bu yigit {p:DISNEY}da {p:BOLT}a bilan hujum qilinganidan so’ng {h:nogiron} bo’lib qolgan ekan.
examples: {r:She works at a disabled care center} - U nogironlar uchun g'amxo'rlik markazida ishlaydi.
{r:The program’s primary goal is to reduce ignorance and support disabled students} – Dasturining asosiy maqsadi bexabarlikni kamaytirish va nogiron talabalarni qo‘llab-quvvatlashdir.
{r:They have donated to a disabled children's fund lately} - Ular oxirgi paytlar nogiron bolalar fondiga xayriya qilishdi.
{r:He wrote a book about the rights of disabled people} - U nogironlar huquqlari haqida kitob yozdi.

text: {r:Currency}[ˈkʌrənsi] – valyuta. Karlson haqidagi multfilmni ko’rgan bo’lsangiz kerak. Rossiya va O’zbekistonda mashhur multfilm. Ucha oladigan, bolalarni ko’nglini oladigan {p:KARLSON} asli {h:valyut}chik bo’lgan ekan.
examples: {r:She exchanged her foreign currency at the bank} - U bankda chet el valyutasini almashtirdi.
{r:He studied the currency exchange rate} - U valyuta ayirboshlash kursini o'rgandi.
{r:They discussed the currency market trends} - Ular valyuta bozori tendentsiyalarini muhokama qilishdi.
{r:He invested in digital currency, therefore he went bankrupt} - U raqamli valyutaga sarmoya kiritdi va shuning uchun bankrot bo'ldi.

text: {r:Sunflower}[ˈsʌnˌflaʊər] – kungaboqar.
examples: {r:An entrepreneur planted a sunflower in her field} - Tadbirkor dalasiga kungaboqar ekdi.
{r:He painted a sunflower field in his artwork} - U o'z san'at asarida kungaboqar dalasini chizdi.
{r:They harvested the sunflower seeds for oil lately} - Ular oxirgi paytlarda kungaboqar urug'ini yog' uchun yig'ib olishdi.
{r:He chopped the sunflower stalks into tiny pieces} - U kungaboqar poyasini mayda qilib chopdi.

text: {r:Waterfall}[ˈwɔːtərfɔːl] – sharshara. Water(suv) va fall(tushmoq) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:They visited a waterfall park during their trip} - Ular sayohat paytida sharshara bog'iga tashrif buyurishdi.
{r:She took a photo of the waterfall view} - U sharshara manzarasini suratga oldi.
{r:He wrote a poem about the waterfall sound} - U sharshara tovushi haqida she'r yozdi.
{r:They enjoyed the walk around the waterfall in the mountains} - Ular tog'larda sharshara atrofida sayr qilishdan zavqlandilar.

text: {r:Pancake}[ˈpænkeɪk] – quymoq. Pan(tova) va cake(keks, tort) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She made a pancake breakfast for her family} - U o'z oilasi uchun nonushtaga quymoq tayyorladi.
{r:He ordered a pancake at the restaurant} - U restoranda quymoq buyurtma qildi.
{r:They enjoyed the pancake festival in the park} - Ular bog'dagi quymoq festivalidan zavqlandilar.
{r:He learned to make pancake dough from his grandmother} - U buvisidan quymoq xamiri tayyorlashni o'rgandi.

text: {r:Lipstick}[ˈlɪpstɪk] – pomada. Lip(lab) va stick(tayoq) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She regretted leaving her lipstick in the hot car, as the heat destroyed it} – U lab bo‘yog‘ini issiq mashinada qoldirganidan afsuslandi, chunki issiqlik uni yo‘q qildi.
{r:He noticed her lipstick color at the party} - U ziyofatda uning lab bo'yog'i rangini payqadi.
{r:They discussed the lipstick brand at the store} - Ular do'konda lab bo'yog'i brendini muhokama qilishdi.
{r:She applied her lipstick before the meeting} - U uchrashuvdan oldin lab bo'yog'ini surtdi.

text: {r:Rainbow}[ˈreɪnboʊ] – kamalak. Rain(yomg'ir) va bow(kamon) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:They saw a rainbow after the rain} - Ular yomg'irdan keyin kamalakni ko'rdilar.
{r:She painted a rainbow sky in her artwork} - U o'z san'at asarida kamalakli osmonni chizdi.
{r:He wrote a story about a rainbow bridge} - U kamalak ko'prigi haqida hikoya yozdi.
{r:They admired the rainbow colors in the sky} - Ular osmondagi kamalak ranglaridan zavqlandilar.

text: {r:Seafood}[ˈsiːfuːd] – dengiz taomi. Navbatdagi so'z + so'z = yangi so'z. G'arb davlatlarida dengiz taomlari ko'p tanovul qilinadi.
examples: {r:My mother cooked excellent seafood with a little rice.} - Onam ozgina guruch bilan ajoyib dengiz mahsulotlari pishirdi.
{r:He enjoyed the seafood soup at the beach} - U plyajda dengiz mahsulotlari sho'rvasidan zavqlandi.
{r:He possesses 10 seafood restaurants.} - U 10 ta dengiz taomlari restoraniga egalik qiladi.
{r:He cooked a seafood dish for the party} - U ziyofat uchun dengiz mahsulotlari taomini tayyorladi.

text: {r:Worldwide}[ˌwɜːrldˈwaɪd] – dunyo bo'ylab, butun dunyo. World(dunyo) va wide(keng) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She works for a worldwide organization} - U butun dunyo ahamiyatidagi tashkilotda ishlaydi.
{r:He studied the worldwide impact of climate change} - U iqlim o'zgarishining butun dunyo bo'yicha ta'sirini o'rgandi.
{r:They discussed the worldwide economy at the conference} - Ular konferensiyada butun dunyo iqtisodiyotini muhokama qilishdi.
{r:He wrote a book about worldwide cultures} - U butun dunyo madaniyatlari haqida kitob yozdi.

text: {r:Consumer}[kənˈsjuː.mər] – iste’molchi. Bu so‘z mahsulot yoki xizmatdan foydalanadigan, uni sotib oladigan shaxsni bildiradi.
examples: {r:The consumer bought fresh vegetables from the market} – Iste’molchi bozordan yangi sabzavotlar sotib oldi.
{r:Companies must listen to consumer feedback} – Kompaniyalar iste’molchi fikr-mulohazalarini eshitishi kerak.
{r:Consumer rights are protected by law} – Iste’molchi huquqlari qonun bilan himoyalangan.
{r:She is a smart consumer who compares prices before buying} – U xarid qilishdan oldin narxlarni solishtiradigan aqlli iste’molchi.

text: {r:Profession}[prəˈfɛʃ.ən] – kasb, mutaxassislik.
examples: {r:Teaching is a respected profession} – O‘qituvchilik hurmatli kasb hisoblanadi.
{r:She chose medicine as her profession} – U o‘z kasbi sifatida tibbiyot sohasini tanlagan.
{r:He is proud of his engineering profession} – U muhandislik kasbidan faxrlanadi.
{r:Different professions require different skills} – Turli kasblar turli ko‘nikmalarni talab qiladi.

text:
{r:Kid}[kɪd] – hazillashmoq. 
Men uyimda kit boqaman. Juda quvnoq {p:kit}. Har kuni men bilan hangoma qilib rosa {h:hazillashadi}.
examples: {r:I’m just kidding, don’t take it seriously} – Hazillashyapman, jiddiy qabul qilma.
{r:He likes to kid around with his friends} – U do‘stlari bilan hazillashishni yaxshi ko‘radi.
{r:Are you kidding me? That’s amazing!} – Hazillashyapsanmi? Bu ajoyib-ku!
{r:Julia kidded him about his new haircut} – Julia uning yangi soch turmagi haqida hazil qildi.

text: {r:Bakery}[ˈbeɪkəri] – nonvoyxona. Bake(pishirmoq, non yopmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:A bakery of mine is located near the market} - Mening nonvoyxonam bozor yaqinida joylashgan.
{r:She has her own recipe for bread} - Uning non pishirish uchun o'z retsepti bor.
{r:He runs the bakery on his own} - U nonvoyxonani yolg'iz boshqaradi.
{r:They visited a baker's shop of theirs in the city} - Ular shahardagi o'z nonvoyxonalariga tashrif buyurishdi.

text: {r:Strawberry}[ˈstrɔːbəri] – qulupnay.
examples: {r:A strawberry field of hers is famous in the region} - Uning qulupnay dalasi mintaqada mashhur.
{r:We grow our own strawberries} - Biz o'z qulupnaylarimizni yetishtiramiz.
{r:He picked strawberries by himself} - U qulupnaylarni o'zi terdi.
{r:They enjoyed the strawberry jam of theirs at breakfast} - Ular nonushtada o'z qulupnay murabbolaridan zavqlandilar.

text: {r:Dough}[doʊ] – xamir. Tasavvur qiling qattiq {p:DO’V}ul bo’lib hamma yoqdan {h:xamir} bo’laklari uchib kelyapti.
examples: {r:A recipe of mine for dough is very simple} - Mening xamir retseptim juda oddiy.
{r:She prepared her own dough for the pie} - U pirog uchun o'z xamirini tayyorladi.
{r:He made a silly mistake and dropped the dough on the floor.} - U ahmoqona xato qilib, xamirni polga tushirib yubordi.
{r:They shared the dough of theirs with the neighbors} - Ular o'z xamirlarini qo'shnilar bilan ulashishdi.

text: {r:Surrounding}[səˈraʊndɪŋ] – atrof. Surround(o'rab turmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:A park of ours is located in the surrounding area} - Bizning bog'imiz atrof hududda joylashgan.
{r:They explored the surroundings of their own neighborhood} - Ular o'z mahallasining atrofini o'rganib chiqdi.
{r:There are many enemies of mine in my surroundings} - Atrofimda dushmanlarim ko'p.
{r:They admired the beauty of their surroundings} - Ular atrofdagi go'zallikni hayrat bilan tomosha qilishdi.

text: {r:Comprise}[kəmˈpraɪz] – iborat bo'lmoq, o'z ichiga olmoq.
examples: {r:A team of mine comprises five members} - Mening jamoam besh kishidan iborat.
{r:He formed his own group which comprises former prisoners to work on the project} - U loyiha ustida ishlash uchun sobiq mahbuslardan iborat o'z guruhini tuzdi.
{r:The project comprises several parts, and he handles one part entirely by himself} – Loyiha bir nechta qismdan iborat bo‘lib, u ulardan birini butunlay o‘zi bajaradi.
{r:The committee comprises five members, one of whom works entirely by herself} – Qo‘mita besh a’zodan iborat bo‘lib, ulardan biri butunlay yolg‘iz ishlaydi.

text: {r:Reminder}[rɪˈmaɪndər] – eslatma. Remind(eslatmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:A reminder of mine helped her remember the meeting} - Mening eslatmam unga yig'ilishni eslashga yordam berdi.
{r:She set her own reminders for the tasks} - U vazifalar uchun o'z eslatmalarini belgiladi.
{r:The reminder on my phone helped me finish the work by myself} – Telefonimdagi eslatma menga ishni o‘zim tugatishga yordam berdi.
{r:I set a reminder to complete the task by myself} – Vazifani o‘zim bajarishim uchun eslatma qo‘ydim.

text: {r:Custody}[ˈkʌstədi] – vasiylik; hibsga olish, hibs. Men bobomning 90 – yillardan qolgan {p:KASITA}larini yig'ib o'z {h:vasiyligimga} oldim.
examples: {r:A child of theirs is in the custody of their grandparents} - Ularning farzandi buvisining qo'lida.
{r:She fought for her own custody rights} - U o'z vasiylik huquqlari uchun kurashdi.
{r:A prominent entrepreneur is in police custody currently} - Mashhur tadbirkor hozirda politsiya hibsida.
{r:The teenagers were released from police custody and sent home on their own} – O‘smirlar politsiya qo‘lidan ozod qilinib, o‘zlari uyga yuborildi.

text: {r:Garlic}[ˈɡɑːrlɪk] – sarimsoq, chesnok. Azizlar nihoyat {p:KARLIK}ning davosi topildi. Shunchaki ikkita qulog'ingizga bir boshdan {h:chesnok} ilib yursangiz bas.
examples: {r:A recipe of mine uses a lot of garlic} - Mening retseptimda ko'p sarimsoq ishlatiladi.
{r:I grow my own garlic in the garden} - Men bog'da o'z sarimsoqlarimni yetishtiraman.
{r:They cooked the dish by themselves} - Ular taomni o'zlari pishirdi.
{r:They enjoyed the flavor of their garlic-infused sauce} - Ular o'z sarimsoqli souslarining ta'midan zavqlandilar.

text: {r:Vessel}[ˈvɛsəl] – kema. Tasavvur qiling chumolilar {p:VAZL}in ustida o'zlarining {h:kemalarini} qurib suzib yurishibdi.
examples: {r:The captain is going to propose cleaning the vessel by removing all the trash.} - Kapitan kemani barcha chiqindilardan tozalashni taklif qiladi.
{r:She designed her own vessel for the competition} - U musobaqa uchun o'z kemasini yasadi(loyihaladi).
{r:I built a big vessel on my own/by myself} - Men katta kemani yolg'iz qurdim.
{r:Apparently, the vessel was built by yourself without any outside help} – Aftidan, bu kemani siz hech qanday tashqi yordam olmasdan o‘zingiz qurgansiz.

text: {r:Scene}[siːn] – joy, sahna, kadr. Filmning bu {h:kadri} shisha {p:SIN}iqlar bilan to'lgan qismi. Chunki oyna sindirilgan edi.
examples: {r:A painting of mine depicts a beautiful scene} - Mening rasmim go'zal manzarani tasvirlaydi.
{r:I created my own scene for the play} - Men pyesa uchun o'z sahnamni yaratdim.
{r:I directed the movie entirely by myself} - U filmga to'liq o'zim rejissyorlik qildim.
{r:We arrived at the scene on our own, without waiting for the rest of the team} – Biz voqea joyiga jamoaning qolganini kutmasdan o‘zimiz keldik.

text: {r:Construction}[kənˈstrʌkʃən] – qurilish. Construct(qurmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:A project of hers involves building construction} - Uning loyihasi binolar qurishni o'z ichiga oladi.
{r:She manages her own construction site} - U o'z qurilish maydonchasini boshqaradi.
{r:The construction is taking an extremely long time to finish} - Qurilishni tugatish o'ta uzoq vaqt olyapti.
{r:We managed to finish the construction project and submit the report on our own} – Qurilish loyihasini tugatib, hisobotni o‘zimiz topshirdik.
{r:The team had to swear to keep the construction plans a secret until the official announcement.} - Jamoa rasmiy e'lon qilinmaguncha qurilish rejalarini sir saqlashga qasam ichishga majbur bo'ldi.

text: {r:Regulation}[ˌrɛɡjəˈleɪʃən] – qoida. Shu kunlarda mazza qilib Oshin serialini ko'ryapmiz. Lekin {p:REKL}ama {p:OSHIN} serialini buzib qo'yayapti. Televidenyada ham qonun {h:qoida} bo'lishi kerak. Portalga yozamiz shekilli.
examples: {r:I learned the gathering was against local regulation, so I left on my own} – Men yig‘ilish mahalliy qoidalarga zid ekanini bilib, o‘zim ketdim.
{r:He implemented his own regulations for the team} - U jamoa uchun o'z qoidalarini joriy qildi.
{r:Local regulations prohibit the burning of garbage because of air pollution concerns.} - Mahalliy qoidalar havo ifloslanishi sababli axlatni yoqishni taqiqlaydi.
{r:A strict regulation was put in place to prohibit people from getting to the data without permission.} - Ma'lumotlarga ruxsatsiz kirishni taqiqlash uchun qattiq qoida o'rnatildi.

text: {r:Locate}[loʊˈkeɪt] – joylashmoq. Bu so'zning asosan passiv shakli(be located) ishlatiladi. Bir tanqidchining fikricha parlamentda eng {p:LOQAYD} insonlar {h:joylashgan}.
examples: {r:A house of mine is located near the lake} - Mening uyim ko'l yaqinida joylashgan.
{r:She found her own apartment located downtown} - U shahar markazida joylashgan o'z kvartirasini topdi.
{r:You should explore the area on your own} - Sen hududni o'zing o'rganib chiqishing kerak.
{r:The campus is an ideal location for study and research.} - Kampus o'qish va tadqiqot uchun ideal joy.

text: {r:Confirm}[kənˈfɜːrm] – tasdiqlamoq. Toshkentning havosi nega ifloslanib ketyapti deb hayron bo'layotgan edik. Shahar hokimiyatining {h:tasdiqlashicha} shahardagi minglab {p:KANF}et {p:FIRM}alari ishlab chiqarish jarayonida havoga juda ko'plab zaharli gazlar chiqarayotgan ekan.
examples: {r:A meeting of mine was confirmed yesterday} - Mening yig'ilishim kecha tasdiqlandi.
{r:We need to confirm whether they will accept or reject the revised plan.} - Ular qayta ko'rib chiqilgan rejani qabul qiladimi yoki rad etadimi, buni tasdiqlashimiz kerak.
{r:She confirmed the information by herself} - U ma'lumotni o'zi tekshirdi.
{r:They discussed the confirmation of their plans} - Ular rejalarining tasdiqlanishini muhokama qilishdi.
{r:The new evidence may confirm and indicate the previous assumptions.} - Yangi dalillar avvalgi farazlarni tasdiqlashi va ko'rsatishi mumkin.

text: {r:Properly}[ˈprɒpərli] – to'g'ri, yaxshilab, normalniy. Sud jarayoni bo'lyapti, sud zali esa juda sovuq. {p:PRA}kuror {p:PLI}tka yoqib xonani isitishga harakat qilyapti. Nahotki sud zalini {h:normalniy} isitish tizimi bilan ta'minlay olishmasa bular.
examples: {r:A task of mine was completed properly and instantly} - Mening vazifam to'g'ri va tez bajarildi.
{r:She organized her own files properly} - U o'z fayllarini to'g'ri tartibga soladi.
{r:He fixed the issue properly by himself} - U muammoni o'zi to'g'ri hal qildi.
{r:If we do this properly by ourselves, we won’t need any help later} – Agar buni o‘zimiz to‘g‘ri qilsak, keyin hech qanday yordamga muhtoj bo‘lmaymiz.

text: {r:Informative}[ɪnˈfɔːrmətɪv] – axborotga boy, ma'lumot beruvchi, foydali.
examples: {r:A book of mine is very informative} - Mening kitobim juda ma'lumotlarga boy.
{r:They wrote their own informative article} - Ular o'zlarining ma'lumotli maqolasini yozdi.
{r:Apparently, the students completed the informative project entirely by themselves} – Aftidan, talabalar ma’lumotlarga boy loyihani to‘liq o‘zlari bajarishdi.
{r:I gathered all the informative data for the report by myself} – Hisobot uchun barcha foydali ma’lumotlarni o‘zim to‘pladim.
