text: {r:Counter}[ˈkaʊntər] – qarshilik ko'rsatmoq, qarshi turmoq. Biz {p:KONTR}da 2 kishi 100 ta botga {h:qarshilik ko'rsatyapmiz}.
examples: {r:A suggestion of mine was countered by the team} - Mening taklifim jamoaning qarshiligiga uchradi.
{r:She presented her own counter-argument} - U o'z qarshi fikrini bildirdi.
{r:You need to learn how to counter his arguments on your own} – Uning dalillariga o‘zingiz javob bera olishni o‘rganishingiz kerak.
{r:If you want to counter that problem on your own, you’ll need solid evidence} – Agar o‘sha muammoni o‘zingiz hal qilmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, mustahkam dalillar kerak bo‘ladi.

text: {r:Dealer}[ˈdiːlər] – savdogar, diler. Deal(savdo qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:A car of mine was purchased from a trusted dealer} - Mening mashinam ishonchli dilerdan sotib olindi.
{r:I negotiated my own deal with the dealer} - Men diler bilan o'z shartnomamni muzokara qildim.
{r:She went to meet the jewelry dealer on her own without any assistance} – U hech qanday yordamchisiz zargarlik buyumlari sotuvchisi bilan uchrashishga o‘zi bordi.
{r:She negotiated the price with the car dealer by herself} – U avtomobil sotuvchisi bilan narxni o‘zi kelishdi.

text: {r:Inappropriate}[ˌɪnəˈproʊpriət] – noo'rin, nomaqbul. Appropriate(o'rinli) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:Both of my husband's jokes were inappropriate.} - Mening turmush o'rtog'imning ikkala hazili ham noo'rin edi.
{r:Neither of his comments was appropriate for the meeting.} - Uning izohlarining hech biri yig'ilish uchun mos emas edi.
{r:Both my nephew and my niece agreed the behavior was inappropriate.} - Mening o'g'il bola jiyanim ham, qiz jiyanim ham bu xatti-harakat noo'rin ekanligiga qo'shilishdi.
{r:Neither laughing nor shouting is appropriate in the library.} - Kutubxonada na kulish, na baqirish o'rinli emas.
{r:The committee found either your first or second action to be inappropriate.} - Qo'mita sizning yo birinchi, yo ikkinchi harakatingizni noo'rin deb topdi.

text: {r:Confirmation}[ˌkɒnfərˈmeɪʃən] – tasdiq.
examples: {r:Both confirmations were received on time.} - Ikkala tasdiq ham vaqtida qabul qilindi.
{r:Neither of the confirmations was accurate.} - Ikkala tasdiq ham aniq emas edi.
{r:You can use either confirmation for the process.} - Jarayon uchun istalgan tasdiqdan foydalanishingiz mumkin.
{r:Both the email and the letter served as confirmation.} - Ham elektron pochta, ham xat tasdiq bo'lib xizmat qildi.
{r:Neither the email nor the phone call provided confirmation.} - Na elektron pochta, na telefon qo'ng'irog'i tasdiq bermadi.
{r:You should either get a written confirmation or a verbal one.} - Siz yo yozma, yo og'zaki tasdiq olishingiz kerak.

text: {r:Upper}[ˈʌpər] – yuqori. Siz uchish uchun qanot yasadingiz endi sizni {p:yuqor}iga ko'tarib osmonga uloqtiradigan {h:APPAR}at yasashingiz kerak.
examples: {r:Both of the upper floors were renovated last year.} - Ikkala yuqori qavat ham o'tgan yili ta'mirlandi.
{r:Neither of the rooms has an upper window.} - Ikkala xonaning ham yuqori oynasi yo'q.
{r:My neighbor is looking to rent either of the upper apartments.} - Mening qo'shnim yuqori qavatdagi ikkita kvartiradan birini ijaraga olishni xohlayapti.
{r:Both the upper and lower decks of the ship were full.} - Kemaning ham yuqori, ham pastki palubasi to'la edi.
{r:Neither the upper nor the lower part of the sign was readable.} - Belgining na yuqori, na pastki qismi o'qib bo'lmas edi.
{r:He told me the keys are either on the upper or lower shelf.} - U kalitlar yo yuqori, yo pastki javonda ekanligini aytdi.

text: {r:Tire}[taɪər] – shina. Bu vaziyatda {p:TOIR} ismli odamning {h:shinalar} sotayotganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:Both of the car's tires were new.} - Mashinaning ikkala shinasi ham yangi edi.
{r:Neither of the spare tires was in good condition.} - Zaxira shinalarning hech biri yaxshi holatda emas edi.
{r:My uncle can replace either tire if needed.} - Mening tog'am kerak bo'lsa, istalgan shinani almashtirishi mumkin.
{r:Both the front and back tires need air.} - Ham old, ham orqa shinalarga havo kerak.
{r:Neither the left nor the right tire had enough pressure.} - Na chap, na o'ng shinada yetarli bosim yo'q edi.
{r:I will either replace the tire or get it patched.} - Men yo shinani almashtiraman, yo yamayman.

text: {r:Disclose}[dɪsˈkloʊz] – ochmoq, oshkor qilmoq. Close(yopmoq) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:Both parties agreed to disclose the information.} - Ikkala tomon ham ma'lumotni oshkor qilishga rozi bo'ldi.
{r:Neither of the reports disclosed the full truth.} - Ikkala hisobot ham to'liq haqiqatni oshkor qilmadi.
{r:You can either disclose the details or keep them a secret.} - Tafsilotlarni oshkor qilishingiz yoki ularni sir tutishingiz mumkin.
{r:Both my neighbor and my spouse agreed not to disclose the news yet.} - Ham mening qo'shnim, ham mening turmush o'rtog'im yangilikni hali oshkor qilmaslikka kelishib olishdi.
{r:Neither the company nor the employees could disclose the sensitive data.} - Na kompaniya, na xodimlar maxfiy ma'lumotlarni oshkor qila oldi.

text: {r:Beast}[biːst] – yirtqich hayvon, maxluq. Tasavvur qiling mr{p:Beast} odamdan {h:maxluqqa} aylanib ketyapti.
examples: {r:Both beasts were dangerous.} - Ikkala hayvon ham xavfli edi.
{r:Neither of the beasts was tame.} - Ikkala hayvon ham xonaki emas edi.
{r:My aunt can't tell the difference between the two beasts.} - Mening xolam ikkala hayvon o'rtasidagi farqni ayta olmaydi.
{r:Both the lion and the tiger are considered beasts of the jungle.} - Ham sher, ham yo'lbars o'rmon maxluqlari hisoblanadi.
{r:Neither the wolf nor the bear is a small beast.} - Na bo'ri, na ayiq kichik hayvon emas.
{r:You can either fear the beast or try to understand it.} - Siz yo maxluqdan qo'rqishingiz, yo uni tushunishga harakat qilishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:Interfere}[ˌɪntərˈfɪər] – aralashmoq, suqilmoq, burnini tiqmoq. Tasavvur qiling {p:INTER}netga {p:FIR}davs ismli yigit {h:burnini tiqmoqchi} bo'lyapti.
examples: {r:Both managers interfered in the project.} - Ikkala menejer ham loyihaga aralashdi.
{r:Neither of the teams wanted to interfere with the process.} - Ikkala jamoa ham jarayonga aralashishni xohlamadi.
{r:My nephew can either interfere or let them handle it themselves.} - Mening jiyanim yo aralashishi, yo ularning o'zlari hal qilishlariga ruxsat berishi mumkin.
{r:Both my aunt and my uncle decided not to interfere.} - Ham mening xolam, ham mening tog'am aralashmaslikka qaror qilishdi.
{r:Neither the teacher nor the students wanted to interfere.} - Na o'qituvchi, na o'quvchilar aralashishni xohlamadi.
{r:My neighbor said I should either interfere or call the police.} - Mening qo'shnim yo aralashishim, yo politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerakligini aytdi.

text: {r:Compel}[kəmˈpɛl] – majburlamoq. Armiyada xizmat qilgan paytim {p:KAM}andir {p:PEL}ani(piyolani) ustiga o'tirishga {h:majburlardi}.
examples: {r:Both laws compel citizens to pay taxes.} - Ikkala qonun ham fuqarolarni soliq to'lashga majbur qiladi.
{r:Neither of the arguments compelled him to change his mind.} - Ikkala dalil ham uning fikrini o'zgartirishga majbur qilmadi.
{r:Both the company’s policy and the new deadline will compel us to work overtime.} - Ham kompaniyaning siyosati, ham yangi muddat bizni qo'shimcha ishlashga majbur qiladi.
{r:Neither the teacher nor the parents could compel the student to study.} - Na o'qituvchi, na ota-onalar o'quvchini o'qishga majbur qila olmadi.
{r:The regulations will either compel or persuade companies to change their policies.} - Qoidalar kompaniyalarni o'z siyosatlarini o'zgartirishga yo majbur qiladi, yo ko'ndiradi.

text: {r:Confront}[kənˈfrʌnt] – yuzma yuz kelmoq, ro'baro kelmoq, qarshi chiqmoq. Millatimiz faxri Bahodir Jalolov Boks {p:KONFER}ensiyasida {p:O'NT}a raqib bokschilariga {h:ro'baro keldi} va hammasiga bir qarash bilan duxini oldi.
examples: {r:Both leaders confronted the issue directly.} - Ikkala rahbar ham muammoga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarshi chiqdi.
{r:Neither of the parties wanted to confront the problem.} - Ikkala tomon ham muammoga ro'baro bo'lishni xohlamadi.
{r:My aunt felt it was best to either confront the challenge or avoid it.} - Mening xolam yo qiyinchilik bilan yuzlashish, yo undan qochishni eng yaxshi yechim deb hisobladi.
{r:Neither the police nor the security guards were prepared to confront the situation.} - Na politsiya, na qo'riqchilar vaziyat bilan yuzlashishga tayyor emas edi.
{r:We must either confront our fears or let them control us.} - Biz yo qo'rquvlarimiz bilan yuzlashishimiz, yo ularning bizni boshqarishiga yo'l qo'yishimiz kerak.

text: {r:Justify}[ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ] – oqlamoq. Qishloqqa borganimda amakivachcham {p:JAS}ur {p:TIFAL}ga tezak solib quritib tappi qilgandi. Keyin esa shu tifaldan choy qaynatishda foydalangan. Eslasam uning harakatlarini hech narsa bilan {h:oqlay olmayman}.
examples: {r:Both of my nephew's actions were hard to justify.} - Mening jiyanimning ikkala harakatini ham oqlash qiyin edi.
{r:Neither of the explanations justified the decision.} - Ikkala izoh ham qarorni oqlay olmadi.
{r:You can either justify your choice or change it.} - Tanlovingizni oqlashingiz yoki uni o'zgartirishingiz mumkin.
{r:Both my aunt and my uncle tried to justify their late arrival.} - Ham mening xolam, ham mening tog'am kech kelishlarini oqlashga harakat qilishdi.
{r:Neither his words nor his actions could justify the betrayal.} - Na uning so'zlari, na uning harakatlari xiyonatni oqlay olmadi.
{r:I will either justify my point or admit I was wrong.} - Men yo o'z nuqtai nazarimni oqlayman, yo xato qilganimni tan olaman.

text: {r:Lion}[ˈlaɪən] – sher. Tasavvur qiling siz uchib ketayotgan samolyot {p:LAYN}eriga {h:sher} rasmi tushirilgan.
examples: {r:Both lions were majestic.} - Ikkala sher ham ulug'vor edi.
{r:Neither of the lions was aggressive.} - Ikkala sher ham tajovuzkor emas edi.
{r:My niece can't decide if she likes either lion.} - Mening jiyanim ikkala sherning qaysi birini yoqtirishiga qaror qila olmayapti.
{r:Both the lion and the tiger are powerful predators.} - Ham sher, ham yo'lbars kuchli yirtqichlardir.
{r:Neither the lion nor the cub was in the open field.} - Na sher, na uning bolasi ochiq dalada emas edi.
{r:The animal trainer said it's either the male or the female lion that is causing problems.} - Hayvonlar bo'yicha murabbiy yo erkak, yo ayol sher muammo keltirib chiqarayotganini aytdi.

text: {r:Inaccurate}[ɪnˈækjərət] – noaniq, noto'g'ri. Accurate(aniq) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:Both of the reports were inaccurate.} - Ikkala hisobot ham noto'g'ri edi.
{r:Neither of the statements was accurate.} - Ikkala bayonot ham aniq emas edi.
{r:You can either correct the inaccurate data or make a note of it in the report.} - Siz yo noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarni tuzatishingiz, yo hisobotda uni qayd etishingiz mumkin.
{r:Both the old map and the new one were inaccurate.} - Ham eski xarita, ham yangisi noto'g'ri edi.
{r:Neither the witness's statement nor the police report was accurate.} - Na guvohning bayonoti, na politsiya hisoboti aniq edi.
{r:You can either correct the inaccurate data or ignore it completely.} - Noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarni yo tuzatishingiz, yo ularni butunlay e'tiborsiz qoldirishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:Eligible}[ˈɛlɪdʒəbəl] – talabga mos bo'lish, to'g'ri kelish. Dadam har kuni o'g'lim {p:ELCHI BO'L}, sen elchilik uchun to'liq {h:mos}san' deydi.
examples: {r:Both candidates were eligible for the position.} - Ikkala nomzod ham lavozimga mos edi.
{r:Neither of the applicants was eligible for the scholarship.} - Ikkala ariza ham stipendiyaga mos emas edi.
{r:My niece is either eligible for the scholarship or for the grant.} - Mening jiyanim yo stipendiyaga, yo grantga mos.
{r:Both my nephew and my son are eligible for the award.} - Ham mening jiyanim, ham o'g'lim mukofotga loyiq.
{r:Neither my neighbor nor my spouse was eligible for the discount.} - Na mening qo'shnim, na mening turmush o'rtog'im chegirmaga haqli edi.
{r:You are either eligible for a grant or for a loan.} - Siz yo grantga, yo kreditga haqlisiz.

text: {r:Pot}[pɒt] – tuvak, qozon. Men uyda kom{p:POT} tayyorlashga qaror qildim. Lekin qozonim bo’lmagani sababli nima qilishga o’ylandim va gul {h:tuvak}ka kompot qaynatishga qaror qildim. Gulni bo’shatdim, loyini yuvib tashladim va 2 litr kompot qaynatdim. Hozir maza qilib kompot ichyapmiz, ba’zan gulni hidi keladi kompotdan.
examples: {r:Both of the pots were filled with water.} - Ikkala tuvak ham suv bilan to'ldirilgan edi.
{r:Neither of the pots was suitable for cooking.} - Ikkala qozon ham pishirish uchun mos emas edi.
{r:My spouse can use either pot for the soup.} - Mening turmush o'rtog'im sho'rva uchun istalgan qozondan foydalanishi mumkin.
{r:Both the cooking pot and the flower pot were placed on the stove.} - Ham pishirish qozoni, ham gul tuvagi pechka ustiga qo'yildi.
{r:Neither the small pot nor the large pot was clean.} - Na kichik, na katta qozon toza edi.
{r:You can either boil water in this pot or in that one.} - Siz yo bu idishda, yo anavi idishda suv qaynatishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:Lid}[lɪd] – qopqoq. Bu vaziyatda mashhur blogger {p:LIT}tos boshiga {h:qopqoq} kiyib olganini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:Both lids were missing from the containers.} - Ikkala qopqoq ham idishlarda yo'q edi.
{r:Neither of the lids fit properly.} - Ikkala qopqoq ham to'g'ri mos kelmadi.
{r:My aunt can choose either lid for the jar.} - Mening xolam idish uchun istalgan qopqoqni tanlashi mumkin.
{r:Both the lid and the handle were broken.} - Ham qopqoq, ham tutqich singan edi.
{r:Neither the small lid nor the big lid fits this jar.} - Bu idishga na kichik, na katta qopqoq to'g'ri keladi.
{r:The lid is either in the drawer or on the shelf.} - Qopqoq yo tortmada, yo javonda.

text: {r:Distinction}[dɪˈstɪŋkʃən] – farq, yuqori baho. Distinct(farqli) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:There is a clear distinction in average height between male and female athletes} – Erkak va ayol sportchilar orasida o‘rtacha bo‘yda aniq farq bor.
{r:Staying alive in the desert depends on fuel and a clear distinction between needs and wants} – Cho‘lda tirik qolish yoqilg‘iga va ehtiyoj bilan istak o‘rtasidagi farqni aniq bilishga bog‘liq.
{r:The doctor explained the distinction between a knee injury and a simple bone fracture} – Shifokor tizza shikastlanishi bilan oddiy suyak sinishi o‘rtasidagi farqni tushuntirdi.

{r:We plan to expand the team and gather experts who understand the distinction between theory and practice} – Jamoani kengaytirib, nazariya va amaliyot o‘rtasidagi farqni tushunadigan mutaxassislarni yig‘moqchimiz.

text: {r:Cap}[kæp] – kepka. Aslida 'kepka' so’zi ham aynan mana shu so’zdan olingan. Tasavvur qiling siz erkak kishi bo’lsangiz ham pushti kepka kiyib olgansiz va atrofdagilar esa hayron.
examples: {r:Both caps were left on the table.} - Ikkala kepka ham stolda qoldirildi.
{r:Neither of the caps was the right size.} - Ikkala kepka ham to'g'ri o'lchamda emas edi.
{r:My husband can choose either cap for the trip.} - Mening turmush o'rtog'im sayohat uchun istalgan kepkani tanlashi mumkin.
{r:Both my nephew and my daughter wanted to wear the same cap.} - Ham mening jiyanim, ham mening qizim bir xil kepka kiyishni xohlashdi.
{r:Neither the red cap nor the blue cap fits him well.} - Na qizil, na ko'k kepka unga yaxshi mos kelmadi.
{r:You can either wear this cap or go without one.} - Siz yo bu kepkani kiyishingiz, yo kepkasiz yurishingiz mumkin.

text: {r:Poverty}[ˈpɒvərti] – kambag’allik. Pulim kamayib {h:kambag’allik} meni qiynaganda o’zimning povrlarimni haydab yuborib {p:POVR}likka {p:TI}pratikanni oldim. Kamgina oylikka ko’nikib ishlayveradi.
examples: {r:Both regions suffer from poverty.} - Ikkala mintaqa ham qashshoqlikdan aziyat chekadi.
{r:Neither of the solutions addressed poverty effectively.} - Ikkala yechim ham qashshoqlikni samarali hal qila olmadi.
{r:My uncle believes we should either fight poverty or accept the consequences.} - Mening tog'am yo qashshoqlik bilan kurashishimiz, yo uning oqibatlarini qabul qilishimiz kerak deb hisoblaydi.
{r:Both education and job creation are keys to reducing poverty.} - Ham ta'lim, ham ish o'rinlari yaratish qashshoqlikni kamaytirishning kalitidir.
{r:Neither the government nor private charities could solve the poverty issue alone.} - Na hukumat, na xususiy xayriya tashkilotlari qashshoqlik muammosini yolg'iz o'zi hal qila olmadi.
{r:This program is either a short-term fix or a long-term solution to poverty.} - Bu dastur yo qashshoqlikni qisqa muddatli tuzatish yoki uzoq muddatli yechim.

text: {r:Nasty}[ˈnæsti] – yoqimsiz, iflos, xunuk. {p:NASTY}a men tanigan eng irkit qiz. Uning har kuni ichib yuradigan {p:NAST}arinli damlamasi juda {h:yoqimsiz}.
examples: {r:Both of the comments were nasty.} - Ikkala izoh ham yoqimsiz edi.
{r:Neither of the jokes was funny; both were nasty.} - Ikkala hazil ham kulgili emas edi; ikkalasi ham yoqimsiz edi.
{r:Both the nasty smell and the dirty look came from the old box.} - Ham yoqimsiz hid, ham iflos ko'rinish eski qutidan keldi.
{r:Neither his rude words nor his nasty attitude was acceptable.} - Na uning qo'pol so'zlari, na yoqimsiz munosabati qabul qilinadigan emas edi.
{r:The weather today is either nasty and cold or windy and humid.} - Bugungi ob-havo yo yoqimsiz va sovuq, yo shamolli va nam.

text: {r:Whole}[hoʊl] – butun. Qo'shnimni katta {p:HOVL}isi bor edi. Bir kuni o'g'li {h:butun} hovlisini sotib yuboribdi.
examples: {r:All the students were present for the whole lecture} - Butun ma'ruza davomida barcha talabalar hozir edi.
{r:Every part of the whole plan was carefully executed} - Rejaning har bir qismi diqqat bilan amalga oshirildi.
{r:Each member contributed to the whole project} - Har bir a'zo loyihaning butunligiga hissa qo'shdi.
{r:The whole team celebrated the victory} - Butun jamoa g'alabani nishonladi.

text: {r:Interference}[ˌɪntərˈfɪərəns] – birovni ishlariga aralashuv, burnini tiqish. Interfere(aralashmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:All the interference during the meeting was unnecessary} - Yig'ilish paytidagi barcha aralashuvlar keraksiz edi.
{r:Every attempt at interference was stopped by the moderator} - Har bir aralashuvga urinish moderator tomonidan to'xtatildi.
{r:The whole discussion was ruined by sheer interference} - Mutlaq aralashuvlar butun muhokamani buzdi.
{r:Each instance of interference was noted in the report} - Hisobotda har bir aralashuv holati qayd etildi.

text: {r:Sensitive}[ˈsɛnsətɪv] – sezgir, nozik, ehtiyotkorlikni talab qiladigan. Bu so'z ko'plab kontekstlarda ishlatiladi: Tez ta'sirlanadigan, sezgir odam haqida: "She is very sensitive to criticism." — "U tanqidlarga nisbatan juda sezgir." Nozik mavzu yoki maxfiy ma'lumot haqida: "This is a sensitive topic." — "Bu nozik (ehtiyotkorlikni talab qiladigan) mavzu." Jismonan sezgir (masalan, teri): "My skin is sensitive to cold weather." — "Mening terim sovuq ob-havoga sezgir." Demak, "sensitive" so'zi odamning his-tuyg'usi, mavzuning nozikligi yoki jismoniy sezuvchanlik haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:All the sensitive information was kept confidential} - Barcha nozik ma'lumotlar maxfiy saqlandi.
{r:Every sensitive topic was handled with care} - Har bir nozik mavzu ehtiyotkorlik bilan hal qilindi.
{r:The whole situation required a sensitive approach} - Butun vaziyat sezgir yondashuvni talab qildi.
{r:Each sensitive issue was discussed privately} - Har bir ehtiyotkor masala maxfiy muhokama qilindi.

text:
{r:Order}[ˈɔːrdər] – ketma-ketlik, tartib. 
 "The numbers are in ascending order." — "Raqamlar o'sish tartibida joylashgan." 
 "Please put the books in alphabetical order." — "Iltimos, kitoblarni alifbo tartibida joylashtiring." 
 "The events happened in a different order than expected." — "Voqealar kutilgandek tartibda yuz bermadi." 
 "He explained the steps in the correct order." — "U qadamlarni to'g'ri tartibda tushuntirdi."
{r:Inevitable}[ɪnˈɛvɪtəbəl] – muqarrar. Inevitably(muqarrar) so'zining sifat shakli. Mnemonik namuna uchun 111 - darsdagi inevitably ga qarang!
examples: {r:All the changes were inevitable} - Barcha o'zgarishlar muqarrar edi.
{r:Every step led to the inevitable conclusion} - Har bir qadam muqarrar xulosaga olib keldi.
{r:The whole process was inevitable} - Butun jarayon muqarrar edi.
{r:Each decision made the outcome inevitable} - Har bir qaror natijani muqarrar qildi.

text: {r:Fur}[fɜːr] – yung, jun, mo'yna. Tasavvur qiling {p:FOR}saj filmidagi mashinalarni bezatishda hayvon {h:yunglari} ishlatilmoqda.
examples: {r:All the fur coats were sold out} - Barcha jun paltolar sotildi.
{r:Every piece of fur was carefully inspected} - Har bir mo'yna parchalari diqqat bilan tekshirildi.
{r:The whole collection featured luxurious fur} - Butun kolleksiya hashamatli mo'ynalardan iborat edi.
{r:Each fur item was unique} - Har bir mo'yna buyumi noyob edi.

text: {r:Straw}[strɔː] – poxol. Strobar chiqqanida O'zbekistonning ham endi shokolad sanoati shakllanyapti deb xursand bo'lgan edim. Lekin mahsulotning sifati yaxshi emas, ichidan har xil narsalar chiqyapti ekan. Men o'zim olganimdan {h:poxol} chiqdi {p:STRO}bardan.(Namuna uchun yozildi)
examples: {r:All the straw hats were handmade} - Barcha poxol shlyapalar qo'lda tikilgan edi.
{r:Every straw was apparently carefully selected} - Har bir poxol ko'rinishidan diqqat bilan tanlangan edi.
{r:The whole field was covered with straw} - Butun dalani poxol qoplangan edi.
{r:Each straw was used in the craft} - Har bir poxol hunarmandchilikda ishlatildi.

text: {r:Resolve}[rɪˈzɒlv] – hal qilmoq, yechmoq; qaror qabul qilmoq.
examples: {r:All the issues were resolved quickly} - Barcha muammolar tezda hal qilindi.
{r:Every conflict was resolved peacefully} - Har bir nizo tinch yo'l bilan hal qilindi.
{r:The whole team worked together to resolve the problem} - Butun jamoa muammoni hal qilish uchun birga ishladi.
{r:Each member contributed to the resolution} - Har bir a'zo yechimga hissa qo'shdi.

text: {r:Ordinary}[ˈɔːrdɪnəri] – oddiy, odatiy. Bizning mahallamizda ko'plab kishilarga “Mahalla faxriysi” ordeni berildi. Rosa jahlim chiqdi shuncha odamga berilib menga berilmaganiga. Oxiri shikoyat qildim “Men ham {p:ORDEN OLAY}, qachongacha {h:oddiy} odam bo'lib yuraveraman? Yoki shu ham tanish-bilishmi?” dedim.
examples: {r:All the tasks were ordinary} - Barcha vazifalar oddiy edi.
{r:Every day felt ordinary until the surprise} - Sarguzashtgacha har kun oddiy tuyuldi.
{r:The whole experience was far from ordinary} - Butun tajriba oddiy emas edi.
{r:Even with ordinary mental abilities, she had a broad understanding of world history} – Oddiy aqliy qobiliyatlarga ega bo‘lsa ham, u jahon tarixini keng tushunardi.

text: {r:Priest}[priːst] – ruhoniy. Yevropada ruhoniy bo'lib ishlash uchun butun umr uylanmaslik kerak. Shuning uchun ham hozir u yerda ruhoniylikni tanlovchi xristianlar juda kam. Davlat shu sababli {h:ruhoniy} bo'lmoqchi bo'lganlarga 100 000$ {p:PRIZ} beryapti.
examples: {r:All the priests attend the ceremony consistently} - Barcha ruhoniylar doimo marosimda qatnashishadi.
{r:The priest deems stock trading against religion} - Ruhoniy birja savdolarini dinga qarshi deb hisoblaydi.
{r:The priest gave wise advice about avoiding sin.} - Ruhoniy gunohlardan saqlanish haqida dono maslahat berdi.
{r:Each priest had a unique role} - Har bir ruhoniyning o'ziga xos roli bor edi.

text: {r:Habit}[ˈhæbɪt] – odat. Odatda itlar yomg'ir yog'ishini oldindan sezadi deyishadi. Ayniqsa sizning itingiz yomg'ir yog'ishi oldidan juda ko'p akillaydi shuning uchun uni '{p:XAB}archi {p:IT}' deb ataysiz va uning bu {h:odati}dan xursand bo'lgansiz.
examples: {r:All the bad habits were hard to break} - Barcha yomon odatlarni tark etish qiyin edi.
{r:Every habit was instantly analyzed} - Har bir odat tezda tahlil qilindi.
{r:The whole process of breaking habits was challenging} - Odatlarni tark etish jarayoni qiyin edi.
{r:Each habit was replaced with a positive one} - Har bir odat ijobiy odat bilan almashtirildi.

text: {r:Compelling}[kəmˈpɛlɪŋ] – jozibali, maftunkor, qiziqarli. Tasavvur qil do'stim sen ertaklar mamlakatida yashaysan qancha {p:KAM PULING} bo'lsa shuncha {h:jozibali} bo'lib ketasan. Bu davlatda esa hech kim boylikka intilmaydi.
examples: {r:All the arguments were compelling} - Barcha dalillar qiziqarli edi.
{r:Every story was compelling} - Har bir hikoya qiziqarli edi.
{r:The whole presentation was compelling} - Butun taqdimot qiziqarli edi.
{r:Each point made the case more compelling} - Har bir fikr ishni yanada qiziqarli qildi.

text: {r:Confrontation}[ˌkɒnfrənˈteɪʃən] – to'qnashuv. Confront(to'qnashmoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun o'tgan darsdagi confront ga qarang.
examples: {r:All the confrontations were avoided} - Barcha to'qnashuvlardan qochildi.
{r:Every confrontation was resolved peacefully} - Har bir to'qnashuv tinch yo'l bilan hal qilindi.
{r:The whole situation escalated into a confrontation} - Butun vaziyat to'qnashuvga aylanib ketdi.
{r:Each confrontation was documented} - Har bir to'qnashuv hujjatlashtirildi.
{r:The manager faced a confrontation and decided to resign.} - Menejer yuzaga kelgan to‘qnashuvdan keyin iste’foga chiqishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Accuracy}[ˈækjərəsi] – aniqlik, akkuratnost. Accuracy – bu so'z accurate so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli. Quyidagi misollar bilan tanishib chiqing.
examples: {r:All the measurements were checked for accuracy} - Barcha o'lchovlar aniqlik uchun tekshirildi.
{r:Every detail was noted with sheer accuracy} - Har bir tafsilot mutlaq aniqlik bilan qayd etildi.
{r:The whole report was praised for its accuracy} - Butun hisobot aniqligi uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi.
{r:Each calculation was done with accuracy} - Har bir hisoblash aniqlik bilan amalga oshirildi.

text: {r:Attach}[əˈtætʃ] – yopishtirmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz qanaqa oboy qilish haqida ko'p o'yladingiz va oxiri devorga {p:atach}ento {h:yopishtirishga} qaror qildingiz.
examples: {r:All the documents were attached to the email} - Barcha hujjatlar elektron pochtaga ilova qilindi.
{r:Every file was attached correctly} - Har bir fayl to'g'ri yopishtirildi.
{r:The whole package was attached securely} - Butun paket xavfsiz yopishtirildi.
{r:When we go back to the village, we will attach the sign to the main gate} – Qishloqqa qaytgach, belgi yozuvini bosh darvozaga yopishtiramiz.

text: {r:Severe}[sɪˈvɪər] – shafqatsiz, qattiq, og'ir. Mening turk do'stim {h:shafqatsiz} qizlarni {p:SEVIYOR}.
examples: {r:All the warnings were severe} - Barcha ogohlantirishlar qattiq edi.
{r:Every consequence was severe} - Har bir oqibat shafqatsiz edi.
{r:The whole situation became severe} - Butun vaziyat shafqatsiz bo'ldi.
{r:Each decision had severe outcome} - Har bir qaror qattiq oqibatlarga olib keldi.

text: {r:Enhance}[ɪnˈhɑːns] – yaxshilamoq, kuchaytirmoq, rivojlantirmoq. Nos chekish zarar-zarar deyishadi kattalar. Men Toshkentdagi Inha universitetida o'qiyman. {p:INHA}da {p:NOS} chekkadigan talabalarning hammasi kuchayib {h:rivojlanib} ketyapti lekin.
examples: {r:All the features of the phone were enhanced} - Telefonning barcha xususiyatlari yaxshilandi.
{r:He needs to enhance his research methods to obtain more accurate data from the facility.} - Aniqroq ma'lumotlarni olish uchun u tadqiqot usullarini takomillashtirishi kerak.
{r:The whole experience was enhanced} - Butun tajriba yaxshilandi.
{r:Each improvement enhanced the product} - Har bir yaxshilanish mahsulotni kuchaytirdi.

text: {r:Fierce}[fɪərs] – kuchli, qattiq, shiddatli. {p:FERUZ}ning oshiqlari juda ko'p. Unga erishish uchun qizlar {h:shiddatli} kurash olib boryapti.
examples: {r:All the competitors were fierce} - Barcha raqiblar shiddatli edi.
{r:Every match was fierce} - Har bir o'yin shiddatli edi.
{r:The whole tournament was fierce} - Butun turnir shiddatli edi.
{r:Each player showed fierce determination} - Har bir o'yinchi shiddatli qat'iyat ko'rsatdi.

text: {r:Vocal}[ˈvoʊkəl] – ochiq gapirmoq, fikrini yashirmay aytmoq, dadil va baland ovozda o'z fikrini bildirmoq. Lekin bu so'z fe'l emas balki sifatdir.
examples: {r:All the members were vocal about their opinions} - Barcha a'zolar o'z fikrlarini ochiq aytishdi.
{r:Every participant was vocal during the discussion} - Har bir ishtirokchi muhokama paytida fikrini dadil gapirdi.
{r:The whole group was vocal in their support} - Butun guruh dadillik bilan qo'llashini bildirdi.
{r:Each member was vocal about the changes} - Har bir a'zo o'zgarishlar haqida ochiq gapirdi.

text: {r:Eligibility}[ˌɛlɪdʒəˈbɪləti] – moslik, haqlilik, talablarga javob berish.
examples: {r:His eligibility for the scholarship was fully confirmed} - Uning stipendiya uchun yaroqliligi butunlay tasdiqlandi.
{r:The eligibility criteria are quite strict} - Yaroqlilik mezonlari juda qat'iy.
{r:She checked her eligibility for the program} - U dastur uchun yaroqliligini tekshirdi.
{r:Eligibility for the job requires experience} - Ish uchun moslik tajribani talab qiladi.

text: {r:Impose}[ɪmˈpoʊz] – joriy qilmoq, majburan qabul qildirmoq. Hozir O'zbekiston maktablarida {p:IMPO}rtniy {p:OZ}uqa berishyapti Fransiyadan keltirilgan. “Bizning bolamiz restoranda yoki uyda ovqatlanadi” deb nozlanayotgan ota-onalar ham bo'lyapti. Lekin ularga ham bu qoida {h:joriy qilinyapti}.
examples: {r:The government has imposed new taxes lately} - Hukumat oxirgi paytlarda yangi soliqlarni joriy qildi.
{r:They imposed strict rules on the students} - Ular talabalarga qat'iy qoidalarni joriy qilishdi.
{r:She didn’t want to impose on her friends} - U do'stlariga zarar yetkazishni xohlamadi.
{r:The company imposed a ban specifically on smoking} - Kompaniya aynan chekishni taqiqladi.

text: {r:Transformation}[ˌtrænsfərˈmeɪʃən] – butunlay o'zgarish, tubdan o'zgarish. Transform(butunlay o'zgarmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The transformation of the old building was impressive} - Eski binoning o'zgarishi ajoyib edi.
{r:She underwent a complete transformation} - U to'liq o'zgarishni boshidan o'tkazdi.
{r:The transformation process took several months} - O'zgarish jarayoni bir necha oyni oldi.
{r:Technology has led to a transformation in communication} - Texnologiya aloqa sohasida o'zgarishga olib keldi.

text: {r:Unfair}[ʌnˈfɛər] – adolatsiz. Fair(adolatli) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:The decision was considerably unfair to the employees} - Qaror xodimlar uchun anchagina adolatsiz edi.
{r:It's unfair to judge someone without knowing the facts} - Haqiqatlarni bilmasdan birovni ayblash adolatsizlik.
{r:She felt the competition was unfair} - U musobaqani adolatsiz deb his qildi.
{r:Unfair treatment can lead to dissatisfaction} - Adolatsiz munosabat norozilikka olib kelishi mumkin.

text: {r:Distract}[dɪˈstrækt] – chalg'itmoq, fikrini bo'lmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz maza qilib o'ynayotganingizda {p:DIS}kotekaga {p:TRAKT}or kirib kelib hammani o'yin kulgidan {h:chalg'itdi}.
examples: {r:The noise distracted him from his work} - Shovqin uni ishidan chalg'itdi.
{r:Don't let social media distract you} - Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar sizni chalg'itmasin.
{r:The bright lights distracted the driver} - Yorqin chiroqlar haydovchini chalg'itdi.
{r:The strong smell from the uncollected garbage began to distract the residents.} - Yig'ilmagan axlatdan kelgan kuchli hid aholini chalg'ita boshladi.

text: {r:Merit}[ˈmɛrɪt] – afzallik, ustunlik; taqdirlashga loyiq xizmat. Mana bu Amerikadagi shaharning {p:MERi IT.} Chunki odamlardan itlarning bir {h:ustun jihati} bor. Ularning sadoqati juda kuchli.
examples: {r:The idea has some merit} - G'oyada bir oz afzallik bor.
{r:He received a certificate of merit} - U yutuqlari uchun sertifikat oldi.
{r:The merit of the proposal was undeniable} - Taklifning yaxshi tomonlarini inkor etib bo'lmas edi.
{r:She was promoted based on merit} - U yutuqlari(xizmatlari) asosida ko'tarildi.

text: {r:Chunk}[tʃʌŋk] – bo'lak, parcha, ulush. Mana bu 80 yillik {p:chan}a boshqa xizmatga yaramay qolgan. Shuning uchun uni bo'laklarga ajratib metal {h:bo'lak}larini metallomga topshirib yuboramiz.
examples: {r:He ate a chunk of bread} - U bir bo'lak non yedi.
{r:The text was divided into weird chunks} - Matn g'alati qismlarga bo'lib tashlangandi.

{r:A chunk of concrete was missing from the sidewalk, leading to the assumption it had been damaged by a truck.} - Trotuardan bir bo‘lak beton yo‘q edi, bu esa uni yuk mashinasi shikastlagan degan taxminga olib keldi.
{r:The project was completed in small chunks} - Loyiha kichik qismlarga bo'linib yakunlandi.

text: {r:Jungle}[ˈdʒʌŋɡəl] – jungli, o'rmon. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:The whole jungle was dense and difficult to enter} - Butun o'rmon zich va kirish qiyin edi.
{r:They explored the jungle for days} - Ular kunlar davomida o'rmonni o'rganishdi.
{r:The jungle is home to many wild animals} - O'rmon ko'plab yovvoyi hayvonlar uyidir.
{r:The sound of the jungle at night is frightening} - Tun o'rmonining ovozi qo'rqinchli.

text: {r:Invade}[ɪnˈveɪd] – bosib olmoq, egallamoq. 'Charli va shokolad fabrikasi' filmini ko'rganmisiz. Shokoladdan qurilgan hind shahzodasi saroyi yomg'irda {p:IVIYDI} va Villi Vonka bu saroyni {h:egallab oladi}.
examples: {r:The army decided to invade the neighboring country} - Qo'shin qo'shni mamlakatga bostirib kirishga qaror qildi.
{r:Privacy is important; don't invade it} - Shaxsiy hayot muhim; uni buzmang.

{r:The general tried to obtain secret maps to predict where the enemy would invade} – General dushman qayerdan bostirib kirishini taxmin qilish uchun maxfiy xaritalarni qo‘lga kiritishga harakat qildi.

{r:The influential leader kept a small map in his pocket, ready in case enemies tried to invade} – Kuchli ta'sirga ega lider dushmanlar bostirib kirishga urinsa, foydalanish uchun cho‘ntagida kichik xaritani saqlardi.

text: {r:Hurricane}[ˈhʌrɪkən] – kuchli dovul, to'fon. Tasavvur qiling {p:HARI KEYN} Germaniyada futbol o'ynashni boshlagandan beri bu davlatda bir nechta {h:to'fonlar} yuz berdi.
examples: {r:The hurricane caused widespread damage} - To'fon keng ko'lamli zarar keltirdi.
{r:They evacuated before the hurricane hit} - Ular to'fon kelishidan oldin evakuatsiya qilindi.
{r:The hurricane's winds were extremely strong} - To'fon shamollari juda kuchli edi.
{r:The hurricane disrupted travel plans} - To'fon sayohat rejalarini buzdi.
{r:Somehow, they managed to avoid the worst consequences of the hurricane} – Qandaydir yo‘l bilan ular dovulning eng yomon oqibatlaridan qutulishdi.

text: {r:Dense}[dɛns] – zich, qalin. Istanbul qirg'oqlaridagi {p:DENGIZ}da kemalar shunchalik {h:zich} joylashganki har kuni 10 lab kemalar to'qnashuvi bo'ladi.
examples: {r:Actually the forest was too dense to walk through} - Aslida o'rmon yurish uchun juda zich edi.
{r:This destination has a dense population} - Bu manzil zich aholiga ega.
{r:The fog was so dense that visibility was low} - Tuman shunchalik zich ediki, ko'rish masofasi past edi.
{r:The book is dense with information} - Kitob ma'lumotlarga boy.

text: {r:Boot}[buːt] – etik. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:BUT}ilkani yonidan o'yib {h:etik} qilib kiyib yuribsiz.
examples: {r:He wore his boots before going outside} - U tashqariga chiqishdan oldin etiklarini kiyindi.
{r:She wore her boot quickly after waking up to the alarming news on the radio} – U radiodagi tashvishli xabarni eshitib uyg‘ongach, tezda etigini kiydi.
{r:She kicked the ball with her boot} - U to'pni etigi bilan tepdi.
{r:The familiar smell of leather from the boot shop was pleasant and relaxing} – Etik do‘konidan kelayotgan tanish charm hidi yoqimli va taskin beruvchi edi.

text: {r:Entertain}[ˌɛntərˈteɪn] – ko'ngilxushlik qilmoq, ko'ngil ko'tarmoq. Agar siz ko'ngilxushlik qilishni istasangiz to'yib yeng. Agar ko'p yeb qo'ygan bo'lsangiz {p:ENTER}ojerminadan {p:TAYINli} normalarda iching. Shunda sizning oshqozoningiz {h:ko'ngilxushlik} qiladi.
examples: {r:The magician entertained the children} - Sehrgar bolalarni o'ynatdi.
{r:She entertained her guests with music} - U mehmonlarini musiqali tomosha bilan xursand qildi.
{r:The movie entertained the audience} - Film tomoshabinlarni ko'nglini ko'tardi.
{r:He acknowledged that it’s not easy to entertain such a large crowd} – U bunday katta olomonni ko‘nglini olish oson emasligini tan oldi.

text: {r:Beans}[biːnz] – loviya. Mashhur kinoqahramon Mr {p:BIN} inson tanasi kattaligidagi {h:loviya} yetishtirdi.
examples: {r:She cooked a pot of beans for dinner} - U kechki ovqat uchun bir qozon loviya pishirdi.
{r:The beans were fresh and tasty} - Loviya yangi va mazali edi.
{r:He planted beans in his garden} - U bog'iga loviya ekdi.
{r:The farmers struggle primarily because the beans did not grow well this season} – Dehqonlar asosan loviyalar bu mavsum yaxshi o‘smagani uchun qiynalishmoqda.

text: {r:Deceive}[dɪˈsiːv] – aldamoq. Toshkent shahridagi {p:DOSAF}(avtomaktablar odatda shunday nomlanadi) bizni {h:aldadi.} Ikki oy bizni avtomobil haydashga emas balki traktor haydashga o'rgatayotgan ekan. Toshkent shahrida yashasam menga traktor haydashni o'rganish nima zarur?
examples: {r:It is easy for a dishonest person to deceive others.} - Vijdonsiz odamning boshqalarni aldashi oson.
{r:The advertisement deceived many customers} - Reklama ko'plab mijozlarni aldadi.
{r:Yulduz felt deceived by his lies} - Yulduz uning yolg'onlaridan aldanganini his qildi.
{r:It's wrong to deceive others} - Boshqalarni aldash noto'g'ri.
{r:He tried to deceive the public by refusing to condemn the bad things happening.} - U yomon narsalarni qoralashdan bosh tortib, jamoatchilikni aldashga harakat qildi.

text: {r:Site}[saɪt] – joy; sayt. Bolalar bugun zo’r o’tirish bo’lishi kerak, {h:joyni} kim topadi? Har doimgidek {p:Sayd} topadi.
examples: {r:They visited the construction site yesterday.} – Ular kecha qurilish joyiga tashrif buyurishdi.
{r:I found the article on a news site.} – Men maqolani yangiliklar saytida topdim.
{r:This site is perfect for building a school.} – Bu joy maktab qurish uchun juda mos.
{r:She created her own website.} – U o‘zining veb-saytini yaratdi.
{r:The old site lost its charm because of the trash everywhere} – Eski joy o‘z jozibasini hamma joyda yotgan chiqindilar sabab yo‘qotdi.

text: {r:Soul}[səʊl] – ruh, qalb. Bir paytlar Modern Talking guruhini ‘’You are my heart, you are my soul’’ qo’shig’i mashhur bo’lgan edi. Ma’nosi ‘’Sen mening yuragim, sen meni jonim’’. Men esa bolalarimni sut bilan taminab turgani uchun shu gapni {p:SOVL}iq sigirimga aytaman.
examples: {r:Music touches the soul.} – Musiqa qalbga ta’sir qiladi.
{r:He is a kind and gentle soul.} – U mehribon va muloyim ruhli inson.
{r:They believe the soul lives after death.} – Ular ruh o‘limdan keyin ham yashaydi deb ishonishadi.
{r:Actually, their relation grew stronger because they felt a deep soul connection} – Aslida, ularning munosabatlari mustahkamlandi, chunki ular chuqur ruhiy bog‘lanishni his qilishdi.

text: {r:Update}[ˈʌp.deɪt] – yangilamoq, obnovit qilmoq.
examples: {r:I need to update my phone software.} – Telefon dasturini yangilashim kerak.
{r:He updated the app with new features.} – U ilovaga yangi funksiyalar qo‘shib yangiladi.
{r:Please update your contact information.} – Iltimos, aloqa ma’lumotlaringizni yangilang.
{r:The website is updated every week.} – Veb-sayt har hafta yangilanadi.

text: {r:Severely}[sɪˈvɪərli] – jiddiy, qattiq. Severe(jiddiy) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:The storm severely damaged the houses} - Bo'ron uylarga jiddiy zarar yetkazdi.
{r:He was severely punished for his actions} - U o'z harakatlari uchun qattiq jazolandi.
{r:The patient is severely ill} - Bemor jiddiy kasal.
{r:The drought has severely affected the crops} - Qurg'oqchilik ekinlarga jiddiy ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

text: {r:Enhancement}[ɪnˈhɑːnsmənt] – yaxshilanish. Enhance(yaxshilamoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The tree’s shadow provided a natural enhancement to the beauty of the garden} – Daraxtning soyasi bog‘ go‘zalligiga tabiiy bir yaxshilanish qo‘shdi.
{r:They made enhancements to the product} - Ular mahsulotni yaxshiladilar.
{r:The enhancement of the image quality was noticeable} - Tasvir sifatining yaxshilanishi sezilarli edi.
{r:Regular exercise is an enhancement to your health} - Muntazam mashqlar sog'ligingizni yaxshilaydi.

text: {r:Eyebrow}[ˈaɪbraʊ] – qosh. Men shu go'zal yigit bo'lishimga nimadir yetishmaydi. Menimcha shu {h:qoshim} {p:AYBDOROV}.
examples: {r:She raised her eyebrow in surprise} - U hayrat bilan qoshini ko'tardi.
{r:He has thick eyebrows} - Uning qoshlari qalin.
{r:The artist drew the eyebrows perfectly} - Rassom qoshlarni mukammal chizdi.
{r:I froze in surprise when I saw litter stuck to his eyebrow} – Uning qoshiga yopishib qolgan axlatni ko‘rib, hayratdan qotib qoldim.

text: {r:Discount}[ˈdɪskaʊnt] – chegirma. Bugungi kunda disklar va dvdlarni hech kim ishlatmay qo'ygan. Shuning uchun eski {p:DISK}larni {p:KAN}Selyariyada katta {h:chegirmalarda} sotishyapti ekan. 1000 tasi 100 000 so'm.
examples: {r:The store offered a 20% discount on all items} - Do'kon barcha mahsulotlarga 20% chegirma taklif qildi.
{r:She got a discount on her purchase} - U xaridiga chegirma oldi.
{r:Discount coupons are available online} - Chegirma kuponlari onlayn mavjud.
{r:They discounted the price because of low sales rates} - Ular kam sotuv darajasi tufayli narxni pasaytirdilar.

text: {r:Dip}[dɪp] – botirmoq, qo'lini tiqib olmoq; pasayish, tushish. Boshlig'imning qo'lida 1 million dollar bo'lgan diplomatni ko'rdim. {p:DIP}lomatga bitta {h:qo'limni tiqib olgim keldi}.
examples: {r:She dipped her finger in the water} - U barmog'ini suvga botirdi.
{r:The road dips sharply here} - Yo'l bu yerda keskin pastga tushadi.
{r:Because of extreme heat I dipped my head in the water quickly} - Keskin issiq tufayli men boshimni suvga bir tiqib oldim.
{r:The temperature dipped below freezing} - Harorat noldan pastga tushdi.

text: {r:Feather}[ˈfɛðər] – pat. Tasavvur qiling {p:FIZRA}(jismoniy tarbiya fani ko'p joylarda shunday ataladi) fani ustozingiz darsga {h:patlar} bilan burkangan kiyimda keldi.
examples: {r:The bird has colorful feathers} - Qushning rang-barang patlari bor.
{r:She found a feather on the ground} - U yerga tushgan patni topdi.
{r:Feather pillows are very soft} - Patli yostiqlar juda yumshoq.

{r:The rescue center decided to adopt the injured bird with a broken breast and ruffled feathers} – Qutqaruv markazi ko‘kragi shikastlangan va patlari to‘zigan yarador qushni asrab olishga qaror qildi.

text: {r:Riot}[ˈraɪət] – qo'zg'olon, isyon; qo'zg'olon qilmoq. Mana bu {p:RAY}simizning {p:IT}i bor. Kim {h:qo'zg'olon} qilsa raysga qarshi iti borib tishlab oladi.
examples: {r:The riot caused chaos in the city} - G'alayon shaharda tartibsizlik keltirdi.
{r:Police were called to control the riot} - G'alayonni nazorat qilish uchun politsiya chaqirildi.
{r:The riots were triggered by a local entrepreneur} - G'alayonlar mahalliy tadbirkor tomonidan boshlandi.
{r:After the riot, the site was full of trash.} - Tartibsizlikdan keyin joy chiqindilar bilan to‘la edi.

text: {r:Creature}[ˈkriːtʃər] – jonzot. {p:KRI}shtiano {p:ECHKI}ni o'zining sevimli {h:jonzoti} deb atadi.
examples: {r:The forest is home to many creatures} - O'rmon ko'plab jonzotlar uyidir.
{r:She loves reading about weird creatures} - U g'alati jonzotlar haqida o'qishni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:The creature was unlike anything they had seen before} - Bu jonzot ular ilgari ko'rgan narsalardan farq qilar edi.
{r:The deep sea is full of strange creatures} - Chuqur dengiz g'alati jonzotlarga to'la.

text: {r:Peak}[piːk] – cho'qqi; cho'qqisiga yetmoq. Bu so'z rus va o'zbek tillarida ham cho'qqi so'zi sifatida ishlatiladi. Tasavvur qiling Pikachu(multfilm qahramoni) va {p:PIK}olaks(dori) Everest {h:cho'qqi}sini zabt etishyapti.
examples: {r:The mountain peak was covered in snow} - Tog' cho'qqisi qor bilan qoplangan edi.
{r:He reached the peak of his career} - U karyerasining cho'qqisiga yetdi.

{r:At the peak of his career, he managed to capture a major deal that helped repay his loan} – Kasbiy faoliyatining eng yuqori nuqtasida u qarzini to‘lashga yordam bergan yirik bitimni qo‘lga kiritdi.
{r:The athlete's performance peaked at the right time} - Sportchi ishtiroki to'g'ri vaqtda eng yuqori cho'qqisiga yetdi.

text: {r:Disorder}[dɪsˈɔːrdər] – tartibsizlik, pala-partishlik. Militsiya xodimlari {p:DIS}kotekaga {p:ORDER} bilan reyd uyushtirib {h:tartibsizlik} sodir etgan maktab o'quvchilari va bog'cha tarbiyalanuvchilarini qo'lga olishibdi.
examples: {r:The room was in complete disorder} - Xona to'liq tartibsizlikda edi.

{r:His rudeness caused disorder at the event; otherwise, the guests were enjoying themselves} – Uning qo‘polligi tadbirda tartibsizlikka sabab bo‘ldi, aks holda mehmonlar o‘zlarini yaxshi his qilishardi.
{r:The disorder in the classroom made teaching difficult} - Sinfdagi tartibsizlik o'qitishni qiyinlashtirdi.
{r:The tenant reported a thief who caused disorder in the apartment} – Ijarachi kvartirada tartibsizlik qilgan o‘g‘ri haqida xabar qildi.

text: {r:Holy}[ˈhoʊli] – muqaddas. Qo'shnimiz {p:HOLI}(Holida) ishlari yurishib ketishi uchun {h:muqaddas} qadamjolarga borib ziyorat qilib keladi.
examples: {r:The holy book is kept in the temple} - Muqaddas kitob ibodatxonada saqlanadi.
{r:They visited the holy city} - Ular muqaddas shaharga tashrif buyurishdi.
{r:Farmers rely on the holy blessing of sunshine for a good harvest} – Dehqonlar yaxshi hosil uchun quyosh nurining muqaddas ne’matiga tayanishadi.
{r:The holy water is believed to have healing powers} - Muqaddas suv davolovchi kuchga ega deb ishoniladi.

text: {r:Twins}[twɪnz] – egizaklar. O'zbekistonda Real Madrid o'yinchisi {p:VINIS}iusning {h:egizagi} topildi. Aytishlaricha Vinisiusning ota-onasi O'zbekistonga aylanib kelganida egizaklarning kichigi shu yerda yo'qolib qolgan ekan.
examples: {r:The twins look exactly alike} - Egizaklar bir-biriga juda o'xshaydi.
{r:She gave birth to twins} - U egizaklarni dunyoga keltirdi.
{r:The twins made a silly mistake, but it was not a sin.} - Egizaklar ahmoqona xato qilishdi, lekin bu gunoh emas edi.
{r:The twins aim to join the ship’s crew next summer} – Egizaklar kelasi yozda kemaning ekipajiga qo‘shilishni maqsad qilishdi.

text: {r:Command}[kəˈmænd] – buyurmoq; buyruq. Armiyaga borib kelganlar komanda nimaligini yaxshi biladi. O'zbek tilida ham xuddi ingliz tilidagidek 'komanda' so'zi 'buyruq' ma'nosini bildiradi. Armiyada bizning {p:KOMAND}ir bitta barmoqda atjimanie qilishni {h:buyurardi}.
examples: {r:The officer gave a command to the soldiers} - Ofitser askarlarga buyruq berdi.
{r:The general commanded the troops during the battle} - General jang paytida qo'shinlarga qo'mondonlik qildi.
{r:He spoke with authority and command} - U vakolat va buyruq bilan gapirdi.
{r:The general commanded his troops to conserve resources, largely because of the long campaign ahead} – General uzoq yurish oldida asosan resurslarni tejash uchun askarlariga buyruq berdi.

text: {r:Constantly}[ˈkɒnstəntli] – doimo. Constant(doimiy) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:Twins are constantly on the phone} - Egizaklar doim telefonda.
{r:The machine is constantly working} - Mashina doim ishlaydi.
{r:He constantly interrupts the conversation} - U suhbatni doim to'xtatadi.
{r:He was excluded from the game because he constantly cheated on purpose.} - U doim ataylab g'irromlik qilgani uchun o‘yindan chiqarib tashlandi.

text: {r:Crucial}[ˈkruːʃəl] – muhim, zarur. Butun dunyoda qurg'oqchilik xavfi mavjud. Shuning uchun ko'p suv talab qiluvchi guruch kabi mahsulotlar yoki kamayib ketadi yoki ularning kam suv iste'moli bilan yetishtirishning yo'llari qidiriladi. Shunday yo'llardan biri {p:KRUSH}kada {p:SHOL}i yetishtirish usuli. Bu usul suv tejashda va yetarli hosil olishda juda {h:muhim}.
examples: {r:This meeting is crucial for the project} - Ushbu yig'ilish loyiha uchun hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega.
{r:It's crucial to follow the instructions} - Ko'rsatmalarga amal qilish juda muhim.
{r:The evidence was crucial in solving the case} - Dalil ishni hal qilishda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynadi.
{r:His role in the team is crucial} - Uning jamoadagi roli hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega.
{r:It's crucial to identify the specific cause of the problem.} - Muammoning aniq sababini aniqlash juda muhim.

text: {r:Literally}[ˈlɪtərəli] – haqiqatdan, chindan.
examples: {r:He was literally shaking with fear} - U chindan qo'rquvdan titrayotgan edi.
{r:She literally ran all the way home} - U chindan uyiga qochib ketdi.
{r:The book literally changed my life} - Kitob chindan mening hayotimni o'zgartirdi.
{r:I was literally speechless} - Men haqiqatdan ham gapira olmadim.
{r:She is literally unable to pay the rent.} - U haqiqatdan ham ijara haqini to'lolmaydi.

text: {r:Devote}[dɪˈvoʊt] – bag'ishlamoq, sarflamoq. Tasavvur qiling siz butun umringizni {p:DIV}anda {p:O'T}irishga {h:bag'ishlamoqchisiz.} Hojatxonangiz ham shu divanda. Ovqatlanish joyingiz ham. Siz hech qayerga siljimoqchi emassiz.
examples: {r:She constantly devotes her time to charity work} - U doimo o'z vaqtini xayriya ishlariga bag'ishlaydi.
{r:He is devoted to his family} - U o'z oilasiga sadoqatli.
{r:They devoted their lives to science} - Ular o'z hayotlarini ilmga bag'ishladilar.
{r:He plans to devote his ultimate efforts to obtaining the highest scores.} - U eng yuqori ballarni qo'lga kiritish uchun barcha sa'y-harakatlarini bag'ishlashni rejalashtirmoqda.

text: {r:Hardly}[ˈhɑːd.li] – deyarli yo‘q, zo‘rg‘a. Bu so‘z biror narsa juda kam yoki deyarli sodir bo‘lmayotganini bildiradi.
examples: {r:I hardly slept last night.} – Kecha deyarli uxlamadim.
{r:Julia hardly knows him.} – Julia uni deyarli tanimaydi.
{r:They could hardly walk after the long hike.} – Ular uzoq sayrdan keyin zo‘rg‘a yurolishdi.
{r:He hardly ever eats sweets.} – U deyarli hech qachon shirinlik yemaydi.

text: {r:Participate}[pɑːˈtɪsɪpeɪt] – qatnashmoq. Bizning maktabimizda ajoyib qoida bor maktabga rangli ichimliklar bilan kirish mumkin emas. Qora rangdagi kola yoki sariq fanta kitob daftarga to’kilib o’nglanmas zarar yetishi mumkin. Demak {p:PART}amda {p:SPRAYT} tursagina darsda {h:qatnash}a olarkanman.
examples: {r:She loves to participate in school events.} – U maktab tadbirlarida qatnashishni yaxshi ko‘radi.
{r:They participated in the competition together.} – Ular musobaqada birga qatnashishdi.
{r:Everyone is encouraged to participate.} – Hamma ishtirok etishga undaladi.
{r:Sobir didn’t participate in the discussion.} – Sobir muhokamada qatnashmadi.

text: {r:Inheritance}[ɪnˈhɛrɪtəns] – meros. Inherit(meros qilib olmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She received such a large inheritance from her grandfather} - U bobosidan shunday katta meros oldi.
{r:The inheritance included so much property and money that it changed their lives} - Meros shunchalik ko'p mulk va pulni o'z ichiga olardiki, bu ularning hayotini o'zgartirdi.
{r:He donated his inheritance to charity because it was such a meaningful amount} - U o'z merosini xayriya ishlariga bag'ishladi, chunki bu shunday muhim miqdorda edi.
{r:The inheritance tax was so high that they had to sell some assets} - Meros solig'i shunchalik yuqori ediki, ular ba'zi aktivlarni sotishga majbur bo'lishdi.

text: {r:Risky}[ˈrɪski] – xavfli, riskli.
examples: {r:Investing in startups can be so risky} - Startaplarga sarmoya kiritish shunchalik xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:It's such a risky decision to drive without a seatbelt} - Kamar bog'lamasdan haydash shunday xavfli qaror.
{r:The plan was so risky that they decided not to implement it} - Reja shunchalik xavfli ediki, ular uni amalga oshirmaslikka qaror qilishdi.
{r:Insurance helps manage financial risk.} - Sug'urta moliyaviy xavfni boshqarishga yordam beradi.

text: {r:Defeat}[dɪˈfiːt] – mag'lubiyatga uchratmoq, yutmoq; mag'lubiyat. Men shashkani shunday yomon o'ynaymanki meni hatto {p:DILF}uzni {p:IT}i ham {h:yutib qo'ya oladi}.
examples: {r:The team suffered such a sheer defeat} - Jamoa shunday mutlaq mag'lubiyatga uchradi.
{r:He couldn't accept his defeat because it was so unexpected} - U mag'lubiyatini qabul qila olmadi, chunki bu shunchalik kutilmagan edi.
{r:The defeat was such a learning experience that they became stronger} - Mag'lubiyat shunday o'rganish tajribasi bo'ldi, ular kuchayishdi.
{r:They celebrated their opponent's defeat with such joy} - Ular raqibning mag'lubiyatini shunday quvonch bilan nishonladilar.

text: {r:Ally}[ˈælaɪ] – ittifoqchi. Mening oldingi chaynovchi tishlarim rosa qiyshiq. Shu sababli mening hayotdagi eng yaqin {h:ittifoqchim} bu {p:ELAY}nerlar, tishni yillar davomida ham to'g'rilay olmaydigan briketlar emas.
examples: {r:The two countries became such strong allies that they signed a permanent treaty} - Ikki mamlakat shunday kuchli ittifoqchilarga aylandiki, ular doimiy shartnoma imzolashdi.
{r:He found such an ally in his colleague that his work became much easier} - U hamkasbida shunday ittifoqchi topdiki, uning ishi ancha osonlashdi.
{r:The allies worked together to achieve peace in such a difficult time} - Ittifoqchilar shunday qiyin paytda tinchlikni qo'lga kiritish uchun birga ishladilar.
{r:She needed an ally to support her idea; the task was so big to do alone} - U o'z g'oyasini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun ittifoqchi kerak edi; vazifa yolg'iz qilish uchun shunchalik katta edi.
{r:The city council will impose a new rule with the help of a local ally.} - Shahar kengashi mahalliy ittifoqchi yordamida yangi qoida joriy qiladi.

text: {r:Bury}[ˈbɛri] – ko'mmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz kartoshka {p:PYURi} tayyorladingiz, tami sizga yoqmadi. Keyin esa uni ko'mib tashladingiz.
examples: {r:They decided to bury the treasure, knowing it was such a safe place} - Ular xazinani ko'mishga qaror qilishdi, chunki bu shunday xavfsiz joy edi.
{r:The dog buried the bone in the garden so quickly that I barely saw it} - It suyakni bog'da shunchalik tez ko'mdiki, men uni deyarli ko'rmadim.
{r:He was buried in his hometown, which was so important to him} - U o'z tug'ilgan shahrida dafn qilindi, bu u uchun shunchalik muhim edi.
{r:She buried her face in her hands, feeling such deep sadness} - U yuzini qo'llariga ko'mdi, shunday chuqur qayg'uni his qilib.

text: {r:Glance}[ɡlæns] – nigoh, nazar. Men kecha Gladiator 2 filmini tomosha qildim. Filmning o'rtalarida {p:GLA}diator {p:NOS} chekib yubordi, o'zbek nosi. Hayron bo'lib ensaqotar {h:nigoh} bilan qaradim.
examples: {r:Don’t be fooled by his smile; you can conclude the truth if you glance at his actions} – Uning tabassumiga aldanma; uning harakatlariga qarasang, haqiqatni xulosa qilasan.
{r:He would often glance at his watch, unable to tolerate the very long meeting.} - U ko'pincha soatiga qarab turar edi, juda uzun yig'ilishga chiday olmasdi.
{r:A glance was enough to understand the situation; it was so clear} - Vaziyatni tushunish uchun bir nazar yetarli edi; u shunchalik aniq edi.
{r:Don't glance at your phone; it will distract you from studying.} - Telefoningizga qaramang; bu sizni o'qishdan chalg'itadi.

text: {r:Marble}[ˈmɑːrbəl] – marmar. Tasavvur qiling sizning kuyovlik(kelinlik) payt olgan {p:MEBEL}ingiz {h:marmardan} qilingan.
examples: {r:The floor was made of such beautiful marble} - Pol shunday go'zal marmardan yasalgan edi.
{r:She collected marbles as a child, she had so many of them} - U bolaligida marmarlar yig'ardi, ulardan shunchalik ko'p edi.
{r:The statue was carved from marble, and it was so impressive} - Haykal marmardan o'yilgan edi va u shunchalik ta'sirli edi.
{r:This cave has many harmful marble pieces} - Bu g'orda juda ko'p zararli marmar bo'laklari bor.

text: {r:Peer}[pɪər] – tengdosh. Men erkak kishi bo'lsam ham bu yili 18 yoshlilar ya'ni {h:tengdoshlarim} o'rtasida {p:PIYR}og pishirish musobaqasida qatnashdim. Musobaqada mendan boshqa hamma qiz bola edi.
examples: {r:These twins are my peers} - Bu egizaklar mening tengdoshlarim.
{r:He worked hard to defeat his peer in the chess match} - U shaxmat o'yinida o'z tengdoshini mag'lub etish uchun qattiq ishladi.
{r:The peer group discussed the project with such enthusiasm} - Tengdoshlar guruhi loyihani shunday ishtiyoq bilan muhokama qildi.
{r:We saw a peer repeatedly running across the campus} - Biz bir tengdoshimizning yotoqxona bo‘ylab qayta-qayta yugurayotganini ko‘rdik.

text: {r:Personnel}[ˌpɜːrsəˈnɛl] – xodimlar, kadrlar. {p:PERSON}ani {p:NIL}ufar Usmonova reklama qilyapti “Mening barcha xodimlarim persona soch bo'yog'ini ishlatishar ekan. Men esa boshqa qimmat ammo sifati qoniqarsiz mahsulot ishlatardim. {h:Xodimlarning} maslahat bilan personani bir marta ishlatib ko'rishga qaror qildim va natijalar zo'r”.
examples: {r:The company hired new personnel; they were so eager to start} - Kompaniya yangi xodimlarni ishga oldi; ular ish boshlashga juda ishtiyoqmand bo'lib turibdi.
{r:The personnel department handles recruitment and has such a busy schedule} - Xodimlar bo'limi ishga qabul qilish bilan shug'ullanadi va shunday band jadvalga ega.
{r:All personnel must attend the meeting, it's so important} - Barcha xodimlar yig'ilishda qatnashishi shart, bu juda muhim.
{r:All personnel wanted to participate when John proposed the plan.} - Jon reja taklif qilganida barcha xodimlar qatnashishni xohlashdi.

text: {r:Imply}[ɪmˈplaɪ] – nazarda tutmoq, ko'zda tutmoq, bildirmoq. Kecha stomatologga borib hayron qoldim. Bir odam qimmat {p:IMP}lant qo'ydiryapti {p:LAY}chasiga. O'sha implant tish qo'ydirishga mening pulim yetmaydi. U kishi esa itiga qo'ydiryapti. Bu it bilan odamni qadri bir bo'lganini {h:bildiradi}mi endi?
examples: {r:His tone implied that he was not happy; it was so obvious} - Uning ohangi xursand emasligini anglatardi; bu shunchalik aniq edi.
{r:Are you implying that I made such a big mistake} - Siz shunday katta xato qilganimni nazarda tutyapsizmi?
{r:The report implies a need for change, which is so crucial for the company} - Hisobot o'zgarish zarurligini anglatadi, bu kompaniya uchun juda muhim.
{r:She didn't say it directly, but she implied it, and her meaning was so clear} - U to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytmadi, lekin anglatdi va uning ma'nosi juda aniq edi.

text: {r:Silver}[ˈsɪlvər] – kumush. Mashhur futbolchimiz Server Jeparovni haqiqiy kumush futbolchi deyishimiz mumkin. {p:Server} o'ynagan yillarda jamoamiz finalga chiqib yutqazib qo'yardi va {h:kumush} olardi.
examples: {r:She wore such a beautiful silver necklace} - U juda chiroyli kumush marjon taqdi.
{r:The medal was made of silver and was so shiny} - Medal kumushdan yasalgan edi va juda yaltiroq edi.
{r:Julia called him a coward for refusing such a valuable silver medal} – Julia shunday qimmatli kumush medalni rad etgani uchun uni qo‘rqoq deb atadi.
{r:The silver lining in the cloud gave them such hope} - Bulutdagi kumush chiziq ularga shunday umid berdi.

text: {r:Corn}[kɔːrn] – makkajo'xori. Qo'shnimga 1 tonna {h:makkajo'xori} bergandim. {p:KO'RN}amak ekan. Men haqimda g'iybat va bo'hton tarqatib yurgan ekan orqamdan keyin bilsam.
examples: {r:The farmer harvested the corn; it was such a good crop this year} - Fermer makkajo'xorini yig'ib oldi; bu yil shunday yaxshi hosil bo'ldi.
{r:They ate boiled corn at the market, it was so delicious} - Ular bozorda qovurilgan makkajo'xori yedilar, u juda mazali edi.
{r:Corn is a staple food in so many countries} - Makkajo'xori juda ko'p mamlakatlarda asosiy oziq-ovqat hisoblanadi.
{r:The field was full of ripe corn, such a pleasing sight} - Dalada pishgan makkajo'xori to'la edi, shunday yoqimli manzara.

text: {r:Inner}[ˈɪnər] – ichki. Sv{p:INNIR}ning barcha go'zalligini uning {h:ichki} qismiga boqib anglaysiz. Tashqi tarafida aytarlik hech narsa yo'q.
examples: {r:She consistently explored her inner feelings, which were so complex} - U o'zining ichki his-tuyg'ularini izchillik bilan o'rganadi, ular juda murakkab edi.
{r:The inner city was bustling with such activity} - Shaharning ichki qismi shunday faollik bilan to'la edi.
{r:He focused on his inner strength, which was so important in difficult times} - U o'zining ichki kuchiga e'tibor qaratdi, bu qiyin paytlarda juda muhim edi.
{r:The inner circle of the organization made the decisions, and they were such powerful people} - Tashkilotning ichki doirasi qaror qabul qildi va ular shunday kuchli odamlar edi.

text: {r:Outer}[ˈaʊtər] – tashqi. Inner(ichki) ning teskarisi.
examples: {r:The outer layer of the cake was chocolate, so rich and delicious} - Tortning tashqi qismi shokoladli edi, shunchalik boy va mazali.
{r:They explored the outer regions of the country, which were such wild landscapes} - Ular mamlakatning tashqi hududlarini o'rganishdi, ular shunday yovvoyi landshaftlar edi.
{r:The outer walls of the castle were so strong that they resisted many sieges} - Qal'aning tashqi devorlari shunchalik mustahkam ediki, ular ko'plab qamallarga qarshilik ko'rsatdi.
{r:The outer space mission was such a success, it amazed everyone} - Tashqi kosmos missiyasi shunday muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi, u hammani hayratda qoldirdi.

text: {r:Swing}[swɪŋ] – tebranmoq, tebratmoq, chayqalmoq; tebranish. Snikers shunchalik zo'r mahsulotki uni ko'rganingda og'zingda {p:SUVING} {h:chayqaladi}.
examples: {r:He swung his bag as he walked down the forest path} – U o‘rmon yo‘lagidan yurarkan, sumkasini tebratib ketdi
{r:The wind made the lantern swing gently over the narrow path} – Shamol tor yo‘lak ustidagi fonarni asta tebratdi.
{r:Such a brave deed made the crowd swing their flags in excitement} – Bunday jasur ish olomonni hayajonda bayroqlarini hilpiratishga majbur qildi.
{r:She felt a swing of emotions, it was such a strange day} - U his-tuyg'ularining o'zgarishini his qildi, bu shunday g'alati kun edi.

text: {r:Crop}[krɒp] – ekin. Bu yili dehqonchilikka katta pul sarfladim. Hosilni yig'ishtirib olishga kelganda pulim tugab qoldi. Endi {h:ekinni} {p:KR}edit {p:OB} bo'lsa ham yig'ishtirib olishim lozim.
examples: {r:The farmer planted a new crop, hoping for such an abundant harvest} - Fermer yangi ekin ekdi, shunday mo'l hosilga umid qilib.
{r:The crop was so damaged by the storm that there was little left} - Ekin bo'ron natijasida shunchalik shikastlandiki, ozgina qoldi.
{r:They harvested the wheat crop, which was such a difficult task this year} - Ular bug'doy ekinini yig'ib oldilar va bu bu yil shunaqa qiyin ish bo'ldi.
{r:The crop rotation improved the soil so much} - Ekin almashinuvi tuproqni juda yaxshiladi.

text: {r:Abundancy}[əˈbʌndənsi] – ko'plik, mo'llik, seroblik. Abundant(serob, ko'p) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The abundancy of resources made the project so successful} - Resurslarning ko'pligi loyihani juda muvaffaqiyatli qildi.
{r:They celebrated the abundancy of the harvest, it was such a joyful occasion} - Ular hosilning ko'pligini nishonladilar, bu shunday quvonchli voqea edi.
{r:The region is known for its abundancy of wildlife; there are so many species} - Mintaqa yovvoyi tabiatning ko'pligi bilan mashhur; u yerda g'oyatda ko'p turlar bor.
{r:The abundancy of opportunities encouraged them so much} - Imkoniyatlarning ko'pligi ularni juda rag'batlantirdi.

text: {r:Embrace}[ɪmˈbreɪs] – quchoqlamoq. Toshkentda ommaviy kovidga qarshi emlanish payti men mana bu mashhur raysni ko'rib qoldim. {p:EM}lanayotgan {p:RAYS}ni vaksina qabul qilayotgan joyida “Men sizning muxlisingizman” deb {h:quchoqlab} oldim.
examples: {r:She embraced her friend so warmly} - U do'stini shunchalik iliq quchoqladi.
{r:They embraced the new technology, as it was such an innovation} - Ular yangi texnologiyani qabul qilishdi, chunki bu shunday innovatsiya edi.
{r:The company embraced change so willingly} - Kompaniya o'zgarishni shunchalik xohish bilan qabul qildi.
{r:He embraced the opportunity to learn, which was so valuable} - U o'rganish imkoniyatidan foydalandi, bu shunchalik qimmatli edi.

text: {r:Pink}[pɪŋk] – pushti. Siz bu vaziyatda o'g'il bola bo'lsada {h:pushti} rang kiyim kiyib olgan {p:PINOK}kioni tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:She wore such a lovely pink dress to the party} - U bazmga shunday chiroyli pushti ko'ylak kiygan edi.
{r:The sky turned pink at sunset, looking so beautiful} - Quyosh botayotganda osmon pushti rangga kirdi, shunchalik chiroyli ko'rinib.
{r:He painted the room pink, making it such a cheerful space} - U xonani pushti rangga bo'yadi, uni shunday quvnoq joyga aylantirib.
{r:She made a speedy payment in cash for the pink dress} – U pushti ko‘ylak uchun naqd pulni tezda to‘ladi.

text: {r:Bind}[baɪnd] – bog'lamoq, bog'lab qo'ymoq. Biz maktabda maktab sharoitlari haqida bayon yozdik. Garchi hamma sharoitlarni maqtab paxta qo'ygan bo'lsada, men ayab o'tirmadim. {p:BAYOND}a maktabdagi barcha sharoitsizlarniki ochiq oydin tasvirladim. Bu bayonimni tuman hokimiyati vakillari o'qib direktorimizga hayfsan beribdi. Direktorimiz bu ishim uchun meni {h:bog'lab qo'yib} rosa savalaganlar. Bu voqea 1960 – yilda bo'lgan edi.
examples: {r:They used rope to bind the packages so tightly} - Ular paketlarni shunchalik mahkam bog'lash uchun arqondan foydalanishdi.
{r:The security guard managed to bind the suspect after the theft} – Qo‘riqchi o‘g‘irlikdan so‘ng gumondorni bog‘lashga muvaffaq bo‘ldi.
{r:They frequently bind the cow during milking to keep it calm} – Ular sog‘ish paytida sigirni tinch turishi uchun tez-tez bog‘lab qo‘yishadi.
{r:The glue binds the pieces together so well} - Yelim qismlarni bir-biriga shunchalik yaxshi bog'laydi.

text: {r:Fairly}[ˈfɛərli] – biroz, ozgina; adolatli. Rossiyadan qaytib kelib o'zimning qo'y fermamni ochdim va bu men uchun to'g'ri qaror bo'lib chiqdi. Men bu yerda {p:FER}ma{p:LI} tadbirkor sifatida Rossiyadagidan {h:biroz} ko'proq daromad qilyapman. Eng muhimi o'z uyimda bola-chaqam, ota-onam bag'ridaman.
examples: {r:The movie was fairly interesting, but it could have been better} - Film o'rtacha qiziqarli edi, lekin yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin edi.
{r:She speaks English fairly well} - U ingliz tilini o'rtacha yaxshi biladi.
{r:The room was fairly clean, but not spotless} - Xona o'rtacha toza edi, lekin mutlaqo emas.
{r:I was treated fairly in a workplace} - Ish joyida menga adolatli munosabatda bo'lishgan.

text: {r:Smoothly}[ˈsmuːðli] – silliq, muammosiz. Smooth (silliq) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:The meeting went quite smoothly at an old site} - Yig'ilish eski joyda hech bir muammosiz o'tdi.
{r:She handled the situation pretty smoothly} - U vaziyatni juda bemalol hal qildi.
{r:The events developed smoothly in chronological order, like chapters in a well-written book.} - Voqealar yaxshi yozilgan kitob boblaridek, vaqt tartibida silliq rivojlandi.
{r:The transition was fairly smooth} - O'tish jarayoni ancha muammosiz bo'ldi.

text: {r:Anxious}[ˈæŋkʃəs] – xavotirli, bezovta, asabiy. Omadim kelib Garvardga o'qishga kirdim. Universitetga borishdan oldin juda {h:asabiylashdim.} Men talabalar ichida {p:ENG KUCHSIZ}man deb o'ylardim. Lekin keyin bildimki, o'zbek yigiti eng bilimlilaridan ekan.
examples: {r:He was quite anxious before the exam} - U imtihondan oldin juda bezovta edi.
{r:She felt pretty anxious about the results} - U natijalar haqida ancha xavotirda edi.
{r:The child was rather anxious in the new environment} - Bola yangi muhitda biroz bezovta bo'ldi.
{r:I'm fairly anxious about the upcoming trip} - Men kelgusi safardan biroz xavotirdaman.

text: {r:Channel}[ˈtʃænəl] – kanal. Mana bu telekanalni haqiqatdan antiqa kanal deyish mumkin. Ertalabdan kechgacha bolalarning chanada uchishini ko'rsatishadi. Bu kanalni {p:CHANAL}i {h:kanal} deb atasa bo'ladi.
examples: {r:The water flowed quite smoothly through the whole channel} - Suv butun kanal bo'ylab juda silliq oqdi.
{r:She changed the TV channel pretty quickly} - U televizor kanalini anchagina tez almashtirdi.
{r:The news channel provided rather accurate information} - Yangiliklar kanali ancha aniq ma'lumot berdi.
{r:The channel was fairly narrow} - Kanal biroz torroq edi.

text: {r:Flavor}[ˈfleɪvər] – ta'm, mazza. Qo'yliq bozorida yigit-qizlar yangi ochilgan shashlikxonaning reklama {p:FLAYER}larini tarqatishar edi. Men bunday flayerni umrimda ko'rmaganman. Shu kichkinagina qog'ozdan shashlikning {h:ta'm}i kelardi. Qog'oz bo'lsa ham yeb qo'ydim.
examples: {r:The soup had quite a unique flavor} - Sho'rva juda noyob ta'mga ega edi.
{r:The dish had rather strong flavors} - Taom biroz kuchli ta'mlarga ega edi.
{r:The tea was fairly mild in flavor} - Choy o'rtacha yumshoq ta'mga ega edi.
{r:Their representative praised the outstanding flavor of the new dish.} - Ularning vakili yangi taomning ajoyib ta’mini maqtadi.

text: {r:Absent}[ˈæbsənt] – qatnashmaslik, yo'q bo'lmoq. Beeline'dan qiziq sms keldi: 'Hayotingiz muammolardan holi bo'lishini xohlaysizmi? Unda har kuni {p:EKI SENT} to'lang va muammolarni hal qilish bo'yicha motivatorlarimiz tavsiyalarini eshiting.' Ular muammolardan {h:qutulishingizga} yordam beradi.
examples: {r:He was constantly absent during the meetings} - U yig'ilishlarda doim yo'q edi.
{r:My cousins are absent in my wedding} - Xolavachchalarim to'yimga kelmadi.
{r:The teacher noticed that several students were absent} - O'qituvchi bir nechta o'quvchilar yo'q ekanini payqadi.
{r:His attention was fairly absent during the lecture} - Uning diqqat-e'tibori ma'ruzada emas edi.

text: {r:Rapid}[ˈræpɪd] – tez. Hozirgi kunda {p:REP}per {p:IT}lar odam repperlardan {h:tez}roq rep aytyapti.
examples: {r:The changes happened quite rapidly} - O'zgarishlar juda tez sodir bo'ldi.
{r:The river flowed pretty rapidly after the rain} - Daryo yomg'irdan keyin ancha tez oqdi.
{r:The company experienced rather rapid growth} - Kompaniya biroz tez o'sishni boshdan kechirdi.
{r:The pace of the game was fairly rapid} - O'yin tezligi o'rtacha tez edi.
{r:The rapid growth of technology often leaves a teenager feeling overwhelmed.} - Texnologiyaning tez o'sishi ko'pincha o'smirni hayratda qoldiradi.

text: {r:Diverse}[daɪˈvɜːrs] – turfa xil, har xil. Korona bu {p:DAY}di {p:VIRUS.} Butun dunyo davlatlarida daydilardek kezib yurib 1 milliard {h:turfa xil} inson organizmida yashab ko'rdi.
examples: {r:The group was quite diverse in terms of backgrounds} - Guruh kelib chiqishi bo'yicha juda xilma-xil edi.
{r:The menu offered pretty diverse options} - Menyu ancha xilma-xil variantlarni taklif qildi.
{r:The city has rather diverse cultures} - Shahar biroz xilma-xil madaniyatlarga ega.
{r:The team was fairly diverse in skills} - Jamoa qobiliyatlari bo'yicha o'rtacha xilma-xil edi.
{r:She learned that if you cheat, you won't grow in a diverse world.} - U bilib oldiki, agar aldov qilsangiz, xilma-xil dunyoda o'smaysiz.

text: {r:Pace}[peɪs] – temp, sur'at, tezlik. Xitoyning mana bu pushti skorstnoy {p:POYEZ}i bir xil {h:sur'at}da 500 km tezlikda yuradi.
examples: {r:He walked quite slowly to match her pace} - U uning tezligiga moslashish uchun juda sekin yurdi.
{r:The story continued pretty quickly at a good pace} - Hikoya yaxshi sur'atda ancha tez davom etdi.
{r:The runner maintained rather a fast pace} - Yuguruvchi biroz tez sur'atni saqlab qoldi.
{r:The work progressed at a fairly steady pace} - Ish o'rtacha barqaror sur'atda o'sdi.

text: {r:Essay}[ˈeseɪ] – insho. Maktabda biz bugun Quyosh orbitasidagi eng {p:IS}siq {p:SAY}yora haqida ya'ni quyosh haqida {h:insho} yozdik.
examples: {r:She wrote quite an impressive essay} - U juda ta'sirli insho yozdi.
{r:His essay was pretty well-structured} - Uning inshosi ancha yaxshi tuzilgan edi.
{r:The essay had rather complex ideas} - Inshoda biroz murakkab g'oyalar bor edi.
{r:The essay was fairly short but meaningful} - Insho o'rtacha qisqa edi, lekin mazmunli edi.

text: {r:Giant}[ˈdʒaɪənt] – gigant, ulkan. {p:JAY}ra {p:YENOT} bilan turmush qurgan ekan ularning farzandi bo'lib {h:ulkan} bir hayvon tug'ilibdi.
examples: {r:The tree was quite a giant in the forest} - Daraxt o'rmonda juda ulkan edi.
{r:The company is a pretty giant in the industry} - Kompaniya bu sohada ancha ulkan hisoblanadi.
{r:The mountain looked rather giant from a distance} - Tog' uzoqdan biroz ulkan ko'rinardi.
{r:He was literally opposing the giant businesses} - U haqiqatdan ulkan bizneslarga qarshilik qilayotgandi.

text: {r:Adventure}[ədˈvɛntʃər] – sarguzasht.
examples: {r:The trip was quite an adventure} - Safar butunlay sarguzashtli edi.
{r:She had pretty exciting adventures on her journey} - U sayohatida ancha qiziqarli sarguzashtlar boshdan kechirdi.
{r:The book described rather thrilling adventures} - Kitob biroz hayajonli sarguzashtlarni tasvirlaydi.
{r:He told an unbelievable story about his adventure.} - U o'z sarguzashtlari haqida aql bovar qilmas hikoya aytdi.

text: {r:Delivery}[dɪˈlɪvəri] – yetkazib berish. Deliver(yetkazib bermoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The package arrived quite quickly} - Posilka juda tez yetib keldi.
{r:The delivery service was pretty efficient} - Yetkazib berish xizmati ancha samarali edi.
{r:The speech had rather a powerful delivery} - Nutq ancha kuchli yetkazildi.
{r:The delivery was fairly on time} - Yetkazib berish o'rtacha vaqtida edi.

text: {r:Award}[əˈwɔːrd] – mukofot; mukofatlamoq, taqdirlamoq. Yaqinda bizning mahallada qiziq voqea bo'ldi. {p:AV}ariyada odamlarni qutqarib qolgan {p:O'RD}ak 'Jasorati uchun' {h:mukofoti} bilan taqdirlandi.
examples: {r:She received quite a prestigious award} - U juda nufuzli mukofot oldi.
{r:The movie won pretty impressive awards} - Film ancha ta'sirli mukofotlarni qo'lga kiritdi.
{r:With some luck, he will propose a project that wins an award.} - Biroz omad bilan, u mukofot yutadigan loyiha taklif qiladi.
{r:The award ceremony was fairly well-organized} - Mukofot marosimi o'rtacha yaxshi tashkil qilingan edi.

text:
{r:Arise}[əˈraɪz] – vujudga kelmoq, paydo bo'lmoq. 
O'tgan zamon shakllari - arose, arisen. 
Qo'shnimizning uyida urush janjal {h:paydo bo'ldi.} {p:ERi AYOZ} bobo bo'laman, bolalarga o'yinchoq tarqataman. Shuning uchun shimoliy qutbga ketishim kerak deyapti. Xotini esa erining bu qaroriga qarshi.
examples: {r:A problem quite suddenly arose} - Muammo juda to'satdan paydo bo'ldi.
{r:The opportunity pretty unexpectedly arose} - Imkoniyat ancha kutilmagan holda paydo bo'ldi.
{r:A conflict rather quickly arose between them} - Ularning o'rtasida biroz tez nizo paydo bo'ldi.
{r:The issue fairly often arises in meetings} - Masala yig'ilishlarda biroz tez-tez paydo bo'ladi.

text: {r:Valley}[ˈvæli] – vodiy. Tasavvur qiling siz Qashqadaryo yoki Samarqanddan {p:VALEY}bol topini bir uloqtirgan edingiz bitta zarbadayoq to'p {h:vodiy}gacha uchib bordi. Aslida Vodiy so'zi har tomonlama tog'lar bilan o'ralgan tekislikni anglatsada bizning o'zbek tilida bu so'z Farg'ona vodiysiga nisbatan ishlatiladi. O'zbekistonda Farg'onadan tashqari bir nechta vodiylar bor. Masalan Chirchiq vodiysi, Ohangaron vodiysi.
examples: {r:The valley was quite beautiful in the morning} - Vodiy ertalab juda chiroyli edi.
{r:The river flowed pretty peacefully through the valley} - Daryo vodiy orqali ancha tinch oqdi.
{r:The valley looked rather mysterious in the fog} - Vodiy tuman ostida biroz sirli ko'rinardi.
{r:The valley was fairly wide and open} - Vodiy o'rtacha keng va ochiq edi.

text: {r:Impressive}[ɪmˈprɛsɪv] – ta'sirli, taassurot qoldiradigan. Impress(taassurot qoldirmoq) so'zida yasalgan.
examples: {r:Her performance was quite impressive} - Uning ijrosi juda ta'sirli edi.
{r:The building had pretty impressive architecture} - Binoning arxitekturasi ancha ta'sirli edi.
{r:The results were rather impressive for a first attempt} - Natijalar birinchi urinish uchun biroz yaxshi edi.
{r:The presentation was fairly impressive} - Taqdimot o'rtacha ta'sirli edi.
{r:The architect presented an impressive design that promised to diminish energy consumption.} - Arxitektor energiya iste'molini kamaytirishni va'da qilgan ta'sirchan dizaynni taqdim etdi.

text: {r:Disappointing}[ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntɪŋ] – ko'ngilni xira qiladigan, xafa qiluvchi. Disappoint(xafa qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The movie was quite disappointing and silly} - Film juda xafa qildi va ahmoqona edi.
{r:The results were pretty disappointing} - Natijalar ancha ko'ngilni xira qilar edi.
{r:The meal was rather disappointing} - Ovqat biroz xafa qiladigan darajada edi.
{r:The experiment was fairly disappointing} - Tajriba unchalik yaxshi emas edi.

text: {r:Pie}[paɪ] – pirog. Tasavvur qiling sizning fantaziyaga boy turmush o'rtog'ingiz {p:PAY}poq shaklidagi {h:pirog} pishiribdi.
examples: {r:The pie was quite delicious} - Pirog juda mazali edi.
{r:She baked a pretty amazing pie} - U ancha ajoyib pirog pishirdi.
{r:The pie had rather a unique flavor} - Pirog biroz noyob ta'mga ega edi.
{r:The pie was fairly simple but tasty} - Pirog biroz oddiy edi, lekin mazali edi.

text: {r:Urgent}[ˈɜːrdʒənt] – shoshilinch, zudlik bilan qilinadigan. Ajdodlarimdek yashashga qaror qildim. Boshimga do'ppi va ustimga chopon kiydim. Endi menga {h:zudlik bilan} {p:XO'RJIN} topib bersangiz bas.
examples: {r:The matter was quite urgent} - Masala juda shoshilinch edi.
{r:She received a pretty urgent message} - U ancha shoshilinch xabar oldi.
{r:The situation was rather urgent} - Vaziyat biroz shoshilinch edi.
{r:The request was fairly urgent} - So'rov ozgina shoshilinch edi.

text: {r:Absence}[ˈæbsəns] – yo'qlik, qatnashmaslik. {p:Ab}bos quruvchilik kasbini tanlagan, lekin ishxona tarafidan bo'ladigan {p:snos}larda {h:qatnashmaydi.} Chunki u buzuvchi emas, kimdir norozi bo'lishi mumkin deydi. Agar snosni bilmasangiz bu uylarni majburiy buzilishi.
examples: {r:His absence made the team much weaker} - Uning yo'qligi jamoani ancha zaiflashtirdi.
{r:The absence of light made the room far darker} - Yorug'likning yo'qligi xonani ancha qorong'ilashtirdi.
{r:The project was a lot more difficult in his absence} - Loyiha uning yo'qligida ancha qiyinroq edi.
{r:The new design was slightly more appealing despite its absence of color} - Rang bo'lmaganiga qaramay, yangi dizayn biroz jozibaliroq edi.

text: {r:Entertainment}[ˌɛntərˈteɪnmənt] – o'yin-kulgi, zavq. Entertain(zavqlantirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun 133 - darsdagi entertain ga qarang.
examples: {r:Is this movie any more entertaining than the last one?} - Bu film avvalgisidan bir oz ko'ngilocharroqmi?
{r:There is no entertainment more enjoyable than a good book.} - Yaxshi kitobdan ko'ra zavqliroq lazzat yo'q.
{r:I don't think there's any easier way to find entertainment.} - Huzur topishning bundan osonroq yo'li bor deb o'ylamayman.
{r:The play was no more entertaining than we expected.} - Spektakl biz kutganimizdan ko'ra zavqliroq emas edi.

text: {r:Restore}[rɪˈstɔːr] – tiklamoq. Dadamning 90 – yillarda toshbaqa sho'rva pishirib sotadigan restorani bo'lar edi. Keyinchalik u yopilib ketdi. Lekin men shu yili dadamning toshbaqa sho'rva {p:RESTOR}anini {h:tikladim}.
examples: {r:The old painting is looking cleaner and cleaner after the restoration.} - Restavratsiyadan so'ng eski rasm tobora toza bo'lib bormoqda.
{r:As the workers restored the old statue, it became more and more beautiful.} - Ishchilar eski haykalni tiklagani sari, u tobora go'zallashib bordi.
{r:The team got better and better at restoring historical artifacts.} - Jamoa tarixiy artefaktlarni tiklashda tobora mohir bo'lib bordi.
{r:The garden is coming back to life, looking more and more vibrant every day.} - Bog' jonlana bormoqda, har kuni tobora yorqinroq ko'rinib.

text: {r:Incomplete}[ˌɪnkəmˈpliːt] – chala, to'liq emas. Complete(to'liq) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:The longer you wait, the more incomplete the work becomes.} - Qancha ko'p kutsangiz, ish shunchalik chala bo'lib qoladi.
{r:The more details we add, the less incomplete the report will be.} - Qancha ko'p tafsilot qo'shsak, hisobot shunchalik chalaroq bo'ladi.
{r:The less time he had, the more incomplete his projects were.} - Uning vaqti qancha kam bo'lsa, loyihalari shunchalik chala bo'lardi.
{r:The more information they gathered, the less incomplete the situation became.} - Ular qancha ko'p ma'lumot to'plashsa, vaziyat shunchalik chalaroq bo'lib boraverdi.
