text: {r:Assign}[əˈsaɪn] – tayinlamoq, belgilamoq. Tasavvur qiling ishxonangizda eng ma'suliyatli ishni ishxonadagi eng {p:ESi AYN}igan, eng dovdir xodimga {h:tayinlashdi} va sizning esa jahlingiz chiqdi.
examples: {r:The teacher assigned much more homework than usual.} - O'qituvchi odatdagidan ancha ko'proq uy vazifasi berdi.
{r:The manager assigned a slightly more difficult task this time.} - Menejer bu safar biroz qiyinroq vazifa tayinladi.
{r:They assigned a lot more work to the new team member.} - Ular yangi jamoa a'zosiga ancha ko'proq ish yuklashdi.
{r:The project was far more complex than the one we were assigned last year.} - Loyiha bizga o'tgan yili tayinlanganidan ancha murakkabroq edi.

text: {r:Vacation}[veɪˈkeɪʃən] – ta'til, kanikul. Qizamiqqa qarshi {p:VAK}sina olgan {p:AYSHAN}I tobi qochib qizamiq bilan og'rib qolibdi. Aysha esa uyda dam olib yotish o'rniga ishxonaga xabar bermasdan {h:ta'til}ga dam olishga ketib qolibdi. Chunki qizamiq inson tanasiga toshmalar toshiradi. U insonning tobi qochishiga sabab bo'lmaydi.
examples: {r:Is this vacation any better than the last one?} - Bu ta'til avvalgisidan bir oz yaxshiroqmi?
{r:The trip was no better than staying at home.} - Ta'til uyda qolishdan ko'ra yaxshiroq emas edi.
{r:I don't think there's any cheaper way to have a nice vacation.} - Yaxshi ta'til qilishning bundan arzonroq yo'li bor deb o'ylamayman.
{r:This year's vacation was no less exciting than we hoped.} - Bu yilgi ta'til biz umid qilganimizdek qiziqarli emas edi.

text: {r:Heaven}[ˈhɛvən] – Jannat. Kristofer Roben juda katta asalari uyasini topib olib Vinni Puxni chaqiribdi “{p:Hey VIN}ni mana sening uchun {h:Jannat}, xohlagancha asal ye” debdi.
examples: {r:The view from the mountain became more and more beautiful with each step.} - Tog'dan ko'rinish har bir qadamda tobora go'zallashib bordi.
{r:The garden is getting more and more vibrant as the flowers bloom.} - Gullar ochilgan sari, bog' tobora yorqinroq bo'lmoqda.
{r:With each new discovery, the scenery got better and better, almost like heaven.} - Har bir yangi kashfiyot bilan, manzara tobora yaxshilana bordi, deyarli jannatga o'xshab.
{r:This palace was getting more and more like heaven.} - Bu saroy tobora jannatdek bo'lib borardi.

text: {r:Sofa}[ˈsoʊfə] – divan. Mana bu {p:SOF A}nordan qilingan {h:divan}.
examples: {r:The bigger the sofa, the more space it occupies.} - Divan qancha katta bo'lsa, u shunchalik ko'p joy egallaydi.
{r:The more expensive the sofa, the better the quality.} - Divan qancha qimmat bo'lsa, sifati shunchalik yaxshi bo'ladi.
{r:The sooner you decide, the sooner we can deliver the sofa.} - Qancha tez qaror qilsangiz, divanni shunchalik tez yetkazib bera olamiz.
{r:The more reviews a sofa has, the more reliable it is.} - Divan qancha ko'p sharhga ega bo'lsa, u shunchalik ishonchli bo'ladi.

text: {r:Permanent}[ˈpɜːrmənənt] – doimiy. Men ko'chada bittasidan rasmga olib qo'yishni so'ragan edim '{p:BIR MINIT}' deb qochib ketdi, {h:doimiyga} ayrildim telefonimdan endi.
examples: {r:The permanent solution was much more effective than the temporary one.} - Doimiy yechim vaqtinchalik yechimdan ancha samaraliroq edi.
{r:The job offered permanent benefits.} - Ish doimiy imtiyozlar taklif qildi.
{r:The change was far more permanent than expected.} - O'zgarish kutilgandan ancha doimiyroq edi.
{r:The new policy seems slightly more permanent than the last one.} - Yangi siyosat avvalgisiga qaraganda biroz doimiyroq ko'rindi.

text: {r:Temporary}[ˈtɛmpərəri] – vaqtincha. Siz dunyodagi eng antiqa insonlardan birisiz. Sizning {p:TEMPERATURA}ngiz {h:vaqtinchalik} 80 C ham chiqib ketib yana bir pastda normal holatga tushib qoladi.
examples: {r:Is this temporary fix any better than doing nothing?} - Bu vaqtincha tuzatish hech narsa qilmaslikdan bir oz yaxshiroqmi?
{r:The temporary solution was no easier than the permanent one.} - Vaqtinchalik yechim doimiy yechimdan ko'ra osonroq emas edi.
{r:Did the temporary agreement lead to any fewer problems?} - Vaqtincha kelishuv muammolarni bir oz kamaytirdimi?
{r:The temporary job is no less stressful than the permanent one.} - Vaqtinchalik ish doimiy ishdan ancha oson emas.

text: {r:Stable}[ˈsteɪbəl] – barqaror, stabilniy. Bir xil so'zlar!
examples: {r:The situation is becoming more and more stable every day.} - Vaziyat har kuni tobora barqarorroq bo'lib bormoqda.
{r:The market conditions are getting firmer and firmer, becoming more stable.} - Bozor sharoitlari tobora mustahkamlanib, barqarorroq bo'lib bormoqda.
{r:As the negotiations progressed, the political climate became stabler and stabler.} - Muzokaralar davom etgan sari, siyosiy iqlim tobora barqaror bo'lib bordi.
{r:The patient's condition is getting better and better; it's becoming quite stable.} - Bemorning ahvoli tobora yaxshilanmoqda; ancha barqaror bo'lib boryapti.

text: {r:Talkative}[ˈtɔːkətɪv] – ko'pgap, vaysaqi. Talk(gapirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:She became more and more talkative after the meeting.} - U yig'ilishdan keyin tobora ko'proq gapiruvchi bo'lib bordi.
{r:He became louder and louder as the evening went on.} - Kecha davom etgan sari, u tobora balandroq ovozda gapira boshladi.
{r:The team members got to know each other and became more and more open.} - Jamoa a'zolari bir-birlarini tanigan sari tobora ochiqroq bo'lib borishdi.
{r:As the conversation went on, the guests became faster and faster in their responses.} - Suhbat davom etgan sari, mehmonlarning javoblari tobora tezlashdi.

text: {r:Even}[ˈiːvən] – hatto; tekis. Soyuz davrida juda ko'plab shaharlik o'zbeklar ruslashib ketishdi. Hozir esa bu trendning teskarisini ko'rish mumkin. O'zbek tilini barcha milliy ozchiliklar va {h:hatto} rus {p:IVAN} ham biladi.
examples: {r:The surface was much more even after the repair.} - Ta'mirdan so'ng yuzasi ancha tekisroq edi.
{r:The distribution of resources was far more even this year.} - Resurslarning taqsimlanishi bu yil ancha tengroq edi.
{r:The widow didn’t want to rely on anyone, even when she was ill} – Beva ayol hatto kasal bo‘lganda ham hech kimga tayangisi kelmadi.
{r:I wake up early to enjoy the pleasant morning air, even on weekends} – Men hatto dam olish kunlari ham yoqimli tong havosidan bahramand bo‘lish uchun erta uyg‘onaman.
{r:I even don't know you} - Men seni hatto tanimayman.

text: {r:Extraordinary}[ɪkˈstrɔːrdɪnəri] – g'aroyib.
examples: {r:He wanted to propose an extraordinary idea for the tiny village.} - U kichkina qishloq uchun g‘ayrioddiy g‘oya taklif qilmoqchi bo‘ldi.
{r:I have no extraordinary skills that are any more useful than yours.} - Siznikidan ko'ra foydaliroq bo'lgan g'aroyib qobiliyatlarim yo'q.
{r:There is no easier way to describe his extraordinary talent} – Uning g‘ayrioddiy iste’dodini tasvirlashning bundan oson yo‘li yo‘q.
{r:There is no extraordinary solution that is any easier to implement.} - Amalga oshirish uchun bundan osonroq g'aroyib yechim yo'q.

text: {r:Prior}[ˈpraɪər] – oldin(gi), ilgari(gi). {p:PRAY}nikning {p:R}angi {h:oldin} oq bo'lar edi. Hozir pushti, yashil, sariq, qizil.
examples: {r:His prior experience is getting better and better with each new job.} - Uning oldingi tajribasi har bir yangi ish bilan tobora yaxshilanib bormoqda.
{r:The documents are becoming more and more organized compared to their prior state.} - Hujjatlar o'zlarining oldingi holatiga nisbatan tobora tartibli bo'lib bormoqda.
{r:Her prior knowledge became more and more useful as the project progressed.} - Uning oldingi bilimlari loyiha davom etgan sari tobora foydali bo'lib bordi.
{r:As the investigation continued, the prior events became clearer and clearer.} - Tekshiruv davom etgan sari, oldingi voqealar tobora aniqroq bo'lib bordi.

text: {r:Fake}[feɪk] – soxta, feyk.
examples: {r:The product is becoming harder and harder to identify as fake.} - Mahsulotni soxta deb aniqlash tobora qiyinlashmoqda.
{r:The more sophisticated the technology, the harder it is to spot a fake.} - Texnologiya qancha murakkab bo'lsa, soxtasini aniqlash shunchalik qiyin bo'ladi.
{r:The longer the investigation, the more fake evidence was uncovered.} - Tekshiruv qancha uzoq davom etsa, shunchalik ko'p soxta dalillar aniqlandi.
{r:It became harder and harder to tell the difference between the real and the fake currency.} - Haqiqiy va soxta valyuta o'rtasidagi farqni bilish tobora qiyinlashdi.

text: {r:Rank}[ræŋk] – martaba, unvon. Tasavvur qiling siz tushingizda o'z podshohligingizda {p:RANG}larga {h:martaba} berayotgan ekansiz. Yashilga bosh vazirlik, qizilga moliya vazirligi, sariqqa oila va mahalla vazirligi.
examples: {r:He achieved a much higher rank than last year.} - U o'tgan yilga qaraganda ancha yuqori martabaga erishdi.
{r:The team's rank was a lot better than we expected.} - Jamoaning martabasi biz kutganimizdan ancha yaxshi edi.
{r:Doston's rank was slightly higher than his colleague's.} - Dostonning martabasi hamkasbinikidan biroz yuqori edi.
{r:Their final rank was far better than their starting rank.} - Ularning yakuniy o'rni boshlang'ich o'rnidan ancha yaxshi edi.

text: {r:Yield}[jiːld] – hosil; hosil bermoq. Tasavvur qiling dalangizda ekkan narsangiz o'rniga {p:YILT}illagan metal sochilib yotardi va siz bu {h:hosil}ni oltin deb o'ylab yig'ishtirib oldingiz. Lekin bu nikel metali bo'lib chiqdi.
examples: {r:Did the new fertilizer yield any more crop?} - Yangi o'g'it bir oz ko'proq hosil berdimi?
{r:The investment yielded no less profit than we hoped.} - Investitsiya biz umid qilganimizdan kamroq foyda keltirmadi.
{r:The farmer must select the best seeds to yield a good harvest.} – Dehqon yaxshi hosil olish uchun eng yaxshi urug‘larni tanlashi kerak.
{r:The annual rice yield was lower due to unexpected floods} – Kutilmagan suv toshqinlari tufayli yillik guruch hosili kamaydi.

text: {r:Testimony}[ˈtɛstɪmoʊni] – guvohlik; dalil, isbot. Mana 2040 yil avgust oyi davlat imtihonlariga kiryapmiz. Hozir testlar qog'ozdagi varyantni tanlash orqali emas balki meni {p:TESTIM MONI}torda(kompyuter ekrani shunday ataladi) yechiladi va bu hozirgi kunda hamma imtihonlar adolatli o'tayoganligidan {h:guvohlik} beradi.
examples: {r:Her testimony is becoming more and more believable.} - Uning guvohligi tobora ishonchli bo'lib bormoqda.
{r:As they presented more evidence, the testimony became clearer and clearer.} - Ular ko'proq dalil taqdim etgan sari, guvohlik tobora aniqroq bo'lib bordi.
{r:With each new witness, the case gets more and more complete.} - Har bir yangi guvoh bilan, ish tobora to'liq bo'lib bormoqda.
{r:The more details the testimony has, the more convincing it is.} - Guvohlik qancha ko'p tafsilotlarga ega bo'lsa, shunchalik ishonchli bo'ladi.

text: {r:Treaty}[ˈtriːti] – kelishuv, shartnoma. Mana bu Belarus davlatida ishlab chiqarilgan eng zamonaviy traktorlar. Butun dunyo davlatlari mana shu traktorni sotib olib dalalarda ishlatishadi va Belarus bilan shartnomalar tuzishadi. Chunki bu zo'r traktor, bu {p:TR}aktorlarning {p:ITI.} {h:Shartnoma} tuzib siz ham traktorlardan daromad qiling.
examples: {r:The sooner we sign the treaty, the sooner the conflict will end.} - Shartnomani qancha tez imzolab olsak, mojaro shunchalik tez tugaydi.
{r:The more points they agreed on, the more comprehensive the treaty became.} - Ular qancha ko'p nuqtada kelishishsa, shartnoma shunchalik keng qamrovli bo'lib bordi.
{r:The longer the negotiations, the more difficult it was to agree on the final treaty.} - Muzokaralar qancha uzoq bo'lsa, yakuniy shartnomaga kelishish shunchalik qiyin bo'ldi.
{r:The more partners we have, the more stable the treaty will be.} - Qancha ko'p hamkorimiz bo'lsa, shartnoma shunchalik barqaror bo'ladi.

text: {r:Assault}[əˈsɔːlt] – hujum, tajovuz; hujum qilmoq. Doktor Malaver har doimgidek Esmeraldaga {h:hujum qilyapti.} Uning tajovuzlaridan charchagan {p:ES}meralda {p:SOD}ani Malaverning ko'ziga sochib yuborib himoyalanmoqda. Bu namuna mashhur serial 'Esmeralda'dan olindi.
examples: {r:The assault was much more violent than reported.} - Hujum xabar qilinganidan ancha vahshiyroq edi.
{r:The assault caused a lot more damage than expected.} - Hujum kutilganidan ancha ko'proq zarar keltirdi.
{r:The assault was slightly more intense than the last one.} - Hujum avvalgisiga qaraganda biroz shiddatliroq edi.
{r:The attack was far more coordinated than the police believed.} - Hujum politsiya o'ylaganidan ancha uyushqoq edi.

text: Wealthy [ˈwɛlθi] – boy. Wealth(boylik) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Is Uzbekistan a wealthy country?} - O'zbekiston boy davlatmi?
{r:I am no longer wealthy.} - Men endi boy emasman.
{r:Even the wealthy people face challenges.} - Hatto boylar ham qiyinchiliklarga duch keladi.
{r:After winning the lottery, Dilshod is literally very wealthy.} - Lotereyada yutganidan keyin Dilshod haqiqatdan juda boy.

text: Simplicity [sɪmˈplɪsɪti] – oddiylik. Simple(oddiy) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:I don't enjoy the simplicity of life any more.} - Men endi hayotning oddiyligidan zavq olmayman.
{r:She can't appreciate the simplicity of nature any longer.} - U endi tabiatning oddiyligini qadrlay olmaydi.
{r:I no longer care about simplicity.} - Men boshqa oddiylik haqida qayg'urmayman.
{r:After moving to the city, the quiet simplicity of village life was no more.} - Shaharga ko'chib o'tgandan so'ng, qishloq hayotining sokin soddaligi endi yo'q edi.

text: Advocate [ˈædvəkeɪt] – tarafdor, qo'llab-quvvatlovchi inson; qo'llab-quvvatlamoq, xayrixoh bo'lmoq, himoya qilmoq. Mening {p:advokat} do'stim ayollar faqat pushti mashinalar boshqarishi {h:tarafdori}.
examples: {r:He doesn't advocate for change any more.} - U endi o'zgarishni qo'llab-quvvatlamaydi.
{r:Shahnoza can't advocate for her rights any longer.} - Shahnoza endi o'z huquqlarini himoya qila olmaydi.
{r:Even the strongest advocate needs support.} - Hatto eng kuchli tarafdorga ham yordam kerak.
{r:After the new law, the organization was no longer able to advocate for that specific movement.} - Yangi qonundan keyin, tashkilot o'sha ma'lum harakatni qo'llay olmadi.

text: Resort [rɪˈzɔːrt] – dam olish joyi; kurort. Tasavvur qiling {p:REZ}inkani {p:O'RT}asidan mehnatkash chumolilar uchun {h:dam olish joyi} tayyorlab beryapsiz.
examples: {r:They don't visit the resort any more.} - Ular endi kurortga tashrif buyurmaydi.
{r:She can't stay at the resort any longer.} - U endi kurortda qololmaydi.
{r:Even the most luxurious resort can't be like home.} - Hatto eng hashamatli kurort ham uydek yaxshi emas.
{r:After the fire, the beautiful mountain resort was no more.} - Yong'indan keyin, go'zal tog' kurorti endi yo'q edi.

text: Destruction [dɪˈstrʌkʃən] – vayrona, vayronagarchilik. Destroy(vayron qilmoq) so'zining ot so'z turkumiga xos shakli.
examples: {r:The destruction caused by the storm was even worse than expected.} - Bo'ron keltirgan vayronagarchilik kutilgandan ham yomonroq edi.
{r:They can't ignore the sheer destruction any longer.} - Ular endi mutlaq vayronagarchilikni e'tiborsiz qoldira olmaydi.
{r:The destruction of the forest doesn't affect them any more.} - O'rmonning vayron bo'lishi endi ularga ta'sir qilmaydi.
{r:With the new rebuilding efforts, the whole destruction was no longer visible.} - Yangi qayta qurish ishlari bilan, butun vayronagarchilik endi ko'rinmas edi.

text: Tissue [ˈtɪʃuː] – salfetka. Bir kuni og'aynimga 'Hech qachon etidan ajragan, tushgan tish ko'rmaganman' desam cho'ntagidan salfetkaga o'ralgan nimadir chiqardi va salfetkani ochib 'Tushgan {p:TISH SHU} {h:salfetkaga} o'rab ko'tarib yuribman' dedi.
examples: {r:She doesn't use paper tissue any more.} - U endi qog'oz salfetkalardan foydalanmaydi.
{r:He can't find the tissue any longer.} - U endi salfetkani topa olmayapti.
{r:Even a small tissue can be useful.} - Hatto kichik bir salfetka ham foydali bo'lishi mumkin.

{r:After switching to reusable cloths, disposable tissue was no longer needed in their home.} - Qayta ishlatiladigan matolarga o'tgandan so'ng, ularning uyida bir martalik salfetka endi kerak emas edi.

text: Last[læst] - davom etmoq, chidamoq. Biz bu so'zning 'oxirgi', 'o'tgan' ma'nolarii bilar edik. Qarangki bu so'z ba'zan fe'l sifatida ham keladi.
examples: {r:The meeting will not last any longer.} - Uchrashuv endi davom etmaydi.
{r:How long will the battery last?} - Batareya qancha vaqt davom etadi?
{r:He no longer lasts in difficult situations.} - U qiyin vaziyatlarga endi bardosh bermaydi.
{r:The storm lasted for hours.} - Bo‘ron soatlab davom etdi.

text: Proceed [prəˈsiːd] – davom etmoq. Professor domlamiz leksiya o'tishi kerak edi. 1 soatcha tik turib leksiya o'qigan domla tizza revmatizmi borligini va ortiq tik turib leksiya o'qiy olmasligini aytdi va biz domlani tushundik va {p:PRA}fessordan {p:SID}enyaga o'tirib leksiyani {h:davom ettirishini} so'radik.
examples: {r:They don't proceed with the plan any more.} - Ular endi reja bo'yicha davom etmaydi.
{r:She can't proceed with the project any longer.} - U endi loyihani davom ettira olmaydi.
{r:Even if they proceed, it might be too late.} - Hatto ular davom etsa ham, kech bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:The team decided to proceed forward with the original plan.} - Jamoa asl reja bo'yicha oldinga siljishga qaror qildi.

text: Dispute [dɪˈspjuːt] – tortishuv, bahs, janjal; tortishmoq, bahslashmoq. Mahallamiz narkomanlari uchun narkologik {p:DISP}anserga {p:PUT}yovka berildi 2 ta tekinga. 20 dan ortiq narkomandan birortasi borib davolanib kelay demaydi. Katta {h:tortishuvlardan} so'ng ikkitasini majburlab jo'natib yubordik.
examples: {r:They don't dispute the decision any more.} - Ular endi qaror bo'yicha bahslashmaydi.
{r:He can't dispute the facts any longer.} - U endi faktlar bo'yicha tortishmaydi.
{r:Even in a dispute, respect is important.} - Hatto janjalda ham hurmat muhim.
{r:The dispute seemed to originate from a simple misunderstanding.} - Nizolar oddiy tushunmovchilikdan kelib chiqqan ko'rinardi.
{r:The dispute between twins lasted for years.} - Egizaklar o'rtasidagi tortishuv yillab davom etdi.

text: Remarkable [rɪˈmɑːrkəbəl] – ajoyib, tasanno. Men 10 yil Italiyada ishlab keldim. Yaxshi pul topdim, mashhur joylarida bo'ldim. Masalan {p:RIM AR}kasiga {p:KABL} o'tkazdim. Bu o'sha mashhur Gladiator filmida ko'rsatilgan joy, 2000 yillik tarixga ega. Yana bir nomi Kolizey bo'lgan bu joy dunyoning eng {h:ajoyib} arxitektura namunalaridan biridir va uni ko'rgani har yili 20 million odam keladi.
examples: {r:The remarkable achievement doesn't impress him any more.} - Ajoyib yutuq endi uni hayratlantirmaydi.
{r:She can't ignore the remarkable talent any longer.} - U endi ajoyib iste'dodni e'tiborsiz qoldira olmaydi.
{r:Even the most remarkable people have flaws.} - Hatto eng ajoyib odamlar ham kamchilikka ega.
{r:Her remarkable endurance helped confirm that time truly can heal deep emotional wounds.} - Uning ajoyib chidamliligi chuqur hissiy jarohatlar vaqt davomida tuzalishi mumkinligini isbotladi.

text: Overcome [ˌoʊvərˈkʌm] – yengmoq, yengib o'tmoq. Bir kampir hokimiyatga muammosini yechish uchun borsa nuqul 'unga boring, bunga boring' deb sansalorlik qilaverishibdi. Muammosini yecholmay hadeb hokimiyatga qatnayverganidan hamma uni '{p:OVOR}a {p:KAM}pir' deb atashni boshlabdi. 'Ovora kampir' oxiri portal qilib bu muammolarni {h:yengib o'tibdi}.
examples: {r:He doesn't try to overcome his fears any more.} - U endi qo'rquvlarini yengishga urinmaydi.
{r:Gulzoda can't overcome the challenges any longer.} - Gulzoda endi qiyinchiliklarni yenga olmaydi.
{r:Even the strongest can overcome with support.} - Hatto eng kuchlilar ham yordam bilan yengib chiqishlari mumkin.
{r:The whole world will overcome these problems.} - Butun dunyo bu muammolarni yengib o'tadi.
{r:After years of struggle, the feeling of defeat was no longer a burden. I overcame it.} - Ko'p yillik kurashdan so'ng, mag'lubiyat hissi endi yuk emas edi. Men uni yengdim.

text: Encounter [ɪnˈkaʊntər] – duch kelmoq, to'qnashmoq, ro'baro bo'lmoq; to'qnashuv. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:IN}stitutda jonli {p:KONTR} o'ynashga qaror qildingiz. Tish tirnog'ingizgacha qurollanib rektor xonasiga hujum qilyapsiz. Rektor ham anoyi emas, tayyorgarlik ko'rib qo'ygan. U osonlik bilan hujumingizni bartaraf etdi. Jang vaqti tugab qolib {h:to'qnashuv} durrang bilan tugadi.
examples: {r:They don't encounter such problems any more.} - Ular endi bunday muammolarga duch kelmaydi.
{r:She can't encounter such kindness any longer.} - U endi bunday mehribonlikka duch kelmaydi.
{r:Even a small encounter can change your life.} - Hatto kichik bir to'qnashuv ham hayotingizni o'zgartirishi mumkin.

{r:After years of peaceful coexistence, they were no longer expecting to encounter any hostility.} - Ko'p yillik tinch-totuv yashashdan keyin, ular endi hech qanday adovatga duch kelishni kutishmasdi.

text: Sue [suː] – sudga bermoq. Men mana bu restoranni {h:sudga beraman.} {p:SUYU} makaron opke desam qo'yu makaron olib kelibdi.
examples: {r:He doesn't sue the company any more.} - U endi kompaniyani sudga bermoqchi emas.
{r:She can't sue for damages any longer.} - U endi zarar uchun sudga berolmaydi.
{r:Even if you sue, it might not help.} - Hatto sudga bersangiz ham, bu yordam bermasligi mumkin.
{r:Only a fool would try to sue without enough evidence} – Faqat ahmoqgina yetarli dalilsiz sudga murojaat qilishga urinadi.
{r:The coward decided not to sue, fearing the trouble it might bring} – Qo‘rqoq bu ishni sudga bermaslikka qaror qildi, chunki buning olib keladigan muammolaridan cho‘chidi.

text: Blind [blaɪnd] – ko'r, ko'zi ojiz. {p:BILAYND}a endi {h:ko'zi ojiz} abonentlar 5 yil muddat davomida barcha xizmatlarni tekinga foydalanishlari mumkin. Bilayn hayotning yorqin tarafida bo'ling.
examples: {r:He doesn't help the blind any more.} - U endi ko'zi ojizlarga yordam bermaydi.
{r:She can't ignore the needs of the blind any longer.} - U endi ko'zi ojizlarning ehtiyojlarini e'tiborsiz qoldira olmaydi.
{r:Even the blind can achieve great things.} - Hatto ko'zi ojizlar ham katta yutuqlarga erisha oladi.
{r:After the operation, he was no longer blind.} - Operatsiyadan keyin u endi ko'r emas edi.

text: Retain [rɪˈteɪn] – saqlamoq; saqlab qolmoq, ushlab turmoq. Siz bu vaziyatda qarigan chog'ida o'zining yoshlikdagi {p:BETAYIN} xislatlarini {h:saqlab} qolgan odamni tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin(ishonchim komil shunday odamlar atrofingizda bor).
examples: {r:They don't retain old traditions considerably.} - Ular eski an'analarni unchalik saqlamaydi.
{r:She can't retain her position any longer.} - U endi o'z lavozimini saqlay olmaydi.
{r:Even if you retain the information, it might not be useful.} - Hatto agar ma'lumotni saqlasangiz ham, bu foydali bo'lmasligi mumkin.
{r:After the new policy, the company was no longer able to retain its long-term employees.} - Yangi siyosatdan keyin kompaniya o'zining uzoq muddatli xodimlarini ushlab qola olmadi.

text: Unstable [ʌnˈsteɪbəl] – beqaror, noqulay. Stable so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:The situation is even more unstable now.} - Vaziyat endi yanada noqulay.
{r:They can't ignore the unstable economy any longer.} - Ular endi beqaror iqtisodiyotni e'tiborsiz qoldira olmaydi.
{r:The unstable weather doesn't affect them any more.} - Noqulay ob-havo endi ularga ta'sir qilmaydi.
{r:After the reforms, the previously unstable government was no longer facing immediate collapse.} - Islohotlardan so'ng, avvalgi beqaror hukumat endi bevosita qulash xavfi ostida emas edi.

text: Assignment [əˈsaɪnmənt] – topshiriq, vazifa. Assign(topshirmoq, vazifa yuklamoq) so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun o'tgan darsdagi assign ga qarang.
examples: {r:He doesn't complete his assignments any more.} - U endi o'z vazifalarini bajarmaydi.
{r:She can't handle the assignment any longer.} - U endi vazifani eplolmaydi.
{r:Even the simplest assignment can be challenging.} - Hatto eng oddiy vazifa ham qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:Once he graduated, doing homework assignments was no longer a daily routine.} - U o'qishni tugatgandan so'ng, uy vazifasini bajarish endi kundalik odat emas edi.

text: Incentive [ɪnˈsɛntɪv] – rag'batlantiruvchi omil, stimul, rag'bat. Sizning uyingizda yashovchi tarakanlar bu yerda ko'payib emin-erkin yashashi uchun sizning oshxona mahsulotlaringizni yeyishi shart emas. Tarakan ochlikka yaxshi chidaydi va alternative ozuqa manbalarini qidiradi. Ozuqa taqchilligida {p:INSON TIP}igi ham ular uchun yaxshigina ozuqaviy {h:rag'bat}.
examples: {r:They don't offer incentives any more.} - Ular endi rag'batlantiruvchi narsalarni taklif qilmaydi.
{r:She can't work without an incentive any longer.} - U endi rag'batlarsiz ishlay olmaydi.
{r:Even a small incentive can motivate people.} - Hatto kichik bir rag'bat ham odamlarni ruhlantirishi mumkin.

{r:After the bonus program ended, financial incentive was no longer a driving force for some employees.} - Bonus dasturi tugagandan so'ng, moliyaviy rag'bat ba'zi xodimlar uchun harakatlantiruvchi kuch emas edi.

text: Tongue [tʌŋ] – til(tana azosi); til(gaplashiladigan til). Men kuni bo'yi tanamning barcha a'zolarini mashq qildiraman. Bu mashqlarni {p:TONG}da {h:tilimni} mashq qildirish bilan boshlayman.
examples: {r:He doesn't speak his native tongue any more.} - U endi ona tilida gapirmaydi.
{r:She can't learn a new tongue any longer.} - U endi yangi til o'rgana olmaydi.
{r:Even a foreign tongue can be mastered with practice.} - Hatto chet tili ham mashq bilan o'zlashtirilishi mumkin.
{r:After living abroad for decades, his childhood tongue was no longer fluent.} - O'nlab yillar xorijda yashagandan so'ng, uning bolalikdagi tili endi ravon emas edi.

text: Shelter [ˈʃɛltər] – pana, pana joy; boshpana, turar joy. Tasavvur qiling dunyoda eng yomg'ir ko'p yog'adigan shahardasiz. Yomg'ir juda kuchli yog'ib hammayog'ingiz {p:SHILTA} bo'ldi, qurinib olishga esa {h:boshpana} topolmayapsiz.
examples: {r:They don't seek shelter any more.} - Ular endi boshpana izlamaydi.
{r:She can't find shelter any longer.} - U endi boshpana topa olmayapti.
{r:Even a small shelter can provide safety.} - Hatto kichik bir boshpana ham xavfsizlikni ta'minlashi mumkin.
{r:With the storm passing, the need for immediate shelter was no more.} - Bo'ron o'tib ketgach, zudlik bilan boshpana topish zaruriyati endi yo'q edi.

text: {r:Bunch} [bʌntʃ] – bir nechta; bog’lam, tutam. Tasavvur qiling siz o’zingiz yoqtirmagan {h:bir nechta} kishini {p:PANJ}ara ortiga qamab qo’ydingiz.
examples: {r:He gave me a bunch of grape.} - U menga bir tutam uzum berdi.
{r:Even though the bunch of flowers was expensive, she bought it.} - Bir nechta gullar garchi qimmat bo'lsa ham, u sotib oldi.
{r:Despite the bunch of problems, they succeeded.} - Bir uyum muammolarga qaramasdan, ular muvaffaqiyatga erishdilar.
{r:We saw a bunch of kids who seemed to get along easily} – Biz bir nechta bolalarni ko‘rdik, ular oson til topishayotganga o‘xshardi.

text: {r:Temporarily} [ˈtɛmpərərɪli] - vaqtincha. Temporary(vaqtincha) so'zining ravish shakli. Ya'ni ish-harakat fe'llari bilan birga kelganda qo'llaniladi.
examples: {r:Although the solution was temporary, it worked.} - Garchi yechim vaqtinchalik bo'lsa ham, u ishladi.
{r:Even though the office was temporarily closed, they continued working.} - Hatto ofis vaqtinchalik yopilgan bo'lsa ham, ular ishlashni davom ettirdilar.
{r:Despite living here temporarily, he got along with everyone well.} - Bu yerda vaqtinchalik yashashiga qaramasdan u hamma bilan chiqishib ketdi.
{r:In spite of the temporary closure, the business managed to thrive.} - Vaqtinchalik yopilishiga qaramasdan, biznes rivojlana oldi.

text: {r:Permanently} [ˈpɜːrmənəntli] - doimiy ravishda. Permanent(doimo) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:Although the damage was permanently done, they found a way to adapt.} - Garchi zarar doimiy bo'lsa ham, ular moslashish yo'lini topdilar.
{r:Even though the change was permanent, they accepted it.} - Hatto o'zgarish doimiy bo'lsa ham, ular uni qabul qilishdi.
{r:Despite the permanently closed road, they found an alternative route.} - Doimiy yopilgan yo'lga qaramasdan, ular muqobil yo'l topdilar.
{r:In spite of the cold weather, she permanently moved to the mountains} – Sovuq ob-havoga qaramay, u tog‘larga butunlay ko‘chib o‘tdi.

text: {r:Rice} [raɪs] – guruch. Bu vaziyatda siz mana bu {p:RAYS}ni yoki mahallangiz raysini {h:guruch} bilan qoplangan rasmini tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin.
examples: {r:We have an urgent need for rice.} - Bizning guruchga shoshilinch ehtiyojimiz bor.
{r:Even though the rice was expensive, she bought it.} - Hatto guruch qimmat bo'lsa ham, u uni sotib oldi.
{r:Despite the lack of rice, they managed to prepare the meal.} - Guruch yetishmasligiga qaramasdan, ular ovqat tayyorlashdi.
{r:In spite of the burnt rice, the dinner was still enjoyable.} - Kuygan guruchga qaramasdan, kechki ovqat baribir yoqimli edi.

text: {r:Bullet} [ˈbʊlɪt] – o’q. Siz osmonga qaraganingizda {h:o’q} shaklidagi {p:BULIT}larni ko’rdingiz. 20 minutdan so’ng yana qaradingiz bu safar esa o’q shaklidagi bulitlar sizga yaqinroq joylashganini ko’rib cho’chidingiz va uyga yugurib kirib ketdingiz.
examples: {r:Although the bullet missed him, he was scared.} - Garchi o'q unga tegmagan bo'lsa ham, u qo'rqdi.
{r:Even though the bullet was found, the mystery remained.} - Hatto o'q topilgan bo'lsa ham, sir saqlanib qoldi.
{r:Despite the bullet wound, he continued fighting.} - O'q yarasiga qaramasdan, u kurashishni davom ettirdi.
{r:In spite of the bullet's speed, it was deflected.} - O'qning tezligiga qaramasdan, u burildi.

text: {r:Reflect} [rɪˈflɛkt] – aks etmoq, qaytarmoq, aksi tushmoq. Men talabalarga 1 soat davomida leksiya o’qib berdim. Lekin qo'shimcha materiallarimiz ham bor. Bugun sizlarga tarqatiladigan {p:REF}eratlarda {p:LEKT}siya mazmuni yana bir bor {h:aks etadi}. Mazmuni nima haqida deysizmi? Ko’zguda nimaga jismlar aks etishi haqida.
examples: {r:She selected a crazy design that reflects her unique personality} – U o‘zining noyob shaxsiyatini aks ettiradigan telba dizaynni tanladi.
{r:Even though the water reflected the sunlight, it was still cold.} - Hatto suv quyosh nurini aks ettirgan bo'lsa ham, u hali ham sovuq edi.
{r:Her smile reflects beauty and helps relieve my stress} – Uning tabassumi go‘zallikni aks ettiradi va mening stressimni kamaytiradi.
{r:These numbers reflect the estimate we discussed in a polite manner} – Bu raqamlar biz muloyim tarzda muhokama qilgan taxminni aks ettiradi.

text: {r:Detect} [dɪˈtɛkt] – ochmoq, fosh etmoq, sezmoq. {p:DETEKT}iv Sherlok Xolms qaysi cho’ntagingizda telefon, qaysi birida pul borligini 100 metr masofadan {h:sezib} qo’yadi. Bilmadim balki u odamlarni kiyimsiz ko’ra olar.
examples: {r:Although they detected the problem early, they couldn't solve it.} - Garchi ular muammoni erta aniqlagan bo'lsa ham, uni hal qila olmadilar.
{r:Even though the device detected the signal, it was weak.} - Hatto qurilma signalni sezgan bo'lsa ham, u zaif edi.
{r:Despite the efforts to detect the issue, it remained unsolved.} - Muammoni aniqlash uchun urinishlarga qaramasdan, u hal qilinmadi.
{r:The doctor quickly detected anxious behavior in the patient.} - Shifokor tekshiruv paytida bemorda asabiy xulq-atvorni tezda aniqladi.

text: {r:Innocent} [ˈɪnəsənt] – begunoh, beayb. Oxirgi paytlar sintepon sovuq o’tkazmaydigan material sifatida nom qozonyapti. Sintepondan ko’rpalar, kurtkalar, gilamni tagiga qoplama va boshqa maqsadlarda foydalanilyapti. Lekin sintepon butunlay {h:begunoh}, beayb material emas. Juda ko’plab pit va sirkalarning {p:INI SINT}eponda bo’ladi. Ular bu issiq muhitga joylashib olib sinteponni o’zlarining ko’payuvchi bazalariga aylantirishadi.
examples: {r:Although he was innocent, he was convicted.} - Garchi u aybsiz bo'lsa ham, u hukm qilindi.
{r:Even though the child looked innocent, he caused trouble.} - Garchi bola aybsiz ko'rinishga ega bo'lsa ham, u muammo keltirdi.
{r:Despite being innocent, he was punished.} - Aybsiz bo'lishiga qaramasdan, u jazolandi.
{r:In spite of his innocent appearance, he was quite mischievous.} - Uning begunoh ko'rinishiga qaramasdan, u ancha sho'x edi.

text: {r:Boundary} [ˈbaʊndəri] – chegara. Tasavvur qiling siz Farg’ona qamoqxonasida ishlaysiz. Qamoqxona {p:BANDI}lari {p:RI}shtondagi Qirg’iziston {h:chegarasiga} qochib ketishdi. Siz esa iskovich itlar bilan ularni hididan topib oldingiz.
examples: {r:Although the boundary site was clear, they crossed it.} - Garchi chegara aniq bo'lsa ham, ular uni kesib o'tishdi.
{r:Even though the boundary was marked, they ignored it.} - Hatto chegara belgilangan bo'lsa ham, ular unga e'tiborsizlik qilishdi.
{r:Despite the boundary dispute, they remained friends not condemning each other.} - Chegara bahsiga qaramasdan, ular do'st bo'lib qolishdi bir-birini qoralamasdan.
{r:The peace talks aimed to restore the old boundary between the two countries.} - Tinchlik muzokaralari ikki mamlakat o'rtasidagi eski chegarani tiklashga qaratilgan edi.

text: {r:Remote} [rɪˈmoʊt] – pult; olis, uzoq. Tasavvur qiling siz Rossiyaning Kamchatkasida usta bo'lib ishlaysiz. Kamchatka Rossiyaning eng olis hududi. Lekin bu olis hududda oltin qazib olinadi va odamlar farovon yashaydi va {p:REMONT} uchun yaxshi haq to'lashadi {h:uzoqdan} kelgan ustalarga.
examples: {r:Although the village was remote, it was beautiful.} - Garchi qishloq olisdagi bo'lsa ham, u chiroyli edi.
{r:Even though the location was remote, they visited it.} - Hatto joylashuv olisdagi bo'lsa ham, ular uni ziyorat qilishdi.
{r:Despite the remote area, they found a way to communicate.} - Hudud olisligiga qaramasdan, ular aloqa qilish yo'lini topdilar.
{r:In spite of the remote working arrangement, the team remained highly productive.} - Masofaviy ish tartibiga qaramasdan, jamoa yuqori unumdorlikni saqlab qoldi.

text: {r:Raw} [rɔː] – xom. Mayda bezorilik bilan tuman ROVdsiga tushib qoldingiz va u yerdan qanday qilib chiqib ketish yo’llarini qidiryapsiz. Yangi yil yaqin bo’lgani uchun {p:ROV}d dagi komandirga 10 kg {h:xom} go’sht berishga qaror qildingiz.
examples: {r:Although the materials were raw, they created something amazing.} - Garchi materiallar xom bo'lsa ham, ular ajoyib narsa yaratdilar.
{r:Even though the food was raw, they ate it.} - Hatto ovqat xom bo'lsa ham, ular uni yedilar.

{r:Eating raw vegetables can conserve their nutrients and relieve digestion problems} – Xom sabzavotlarni iste’mol qilish ularning oziq moddalarini saqlab qolishi va hazm muammolarini yengillashtirishi mumkin.
{r:The stranger gave no reply when offered the raw fish} – Begona odamga xom baliq taklif qilinganda, u hech qanday javob bermadi.

text: {r:Withdraw} [wɪðˈdrɔː] – pul chiqarmoq (bankomatdan);tortmoq, sug’urmoq; chekinmoq. To’yi buzilgan yigit to’yga oldindan 2000 ta vizitkaga buyurtma berib qo’ygan ekan. Jahli chiqqan yigit bankomatdan 5 000 000 so’m {h:chiqarib olib} maydalaydigan apparat drobilka sotib olibdi. Yigitcha {p:VIZ}itkalarni {p:DRO}bilkada mayda-mayda qilib tashlabdi va hovuri bosilibdi.
examples: {r:Although he wanted to withdraw, he stayed.} - Garchi u chekinishni xohlagan bo'lsa ham, u qoldi.
{r:The company withdrew essential funds to eliminate unnecessary expenses} – Kompaniya ortiqcha xarajatlarni yo‘qotish uchun zarur mablag‘larni yechib oldi.
{r:Despite the pressure to withdraw, he continued.} - Chekinish uchun bosimga qaramasdan, u davom ettirdi.
{r:In spite of the ability to withdraw funds, he chose to keep his savings in the bank.} - Mablag'larni yechib olish imkoniyatiga qaramasdan, u o'z jamg'armalarini bankda saqlashni tanladi.

text: {r:Testify} [ˈtɛstɪfaɪ] – guvohlik bermoq. Qishloqda amakimning ayollari tappi tayyorlash uchun {p:TEZ}akni {p:TEFAL}ga solib quritganini ko’rib ko’nglim aynib ketgan. O’sha tefalni bitta yuvib tashlab choy ham damlagan. Men bu voqeaga {h:guvoh bo’lganimni buvimga aytib berganimda} esa kenoyimni rosa qattiq urushganlar.
examples: {r:Although he was asked to testify, he refused.} - Garchi undan guvohlik berish so'ralgan bo'lsa ham, u rad etdi.
{r:Even though she testified, her words were ignored.} - Hatto u guvohlik bergan bo'lsa ham, uning so'zlari e'tiborsiz qoldirildi.
{r:Despite the chance to testify, he remained silent.} - Guvohlik berish imkoniyatiga qaramasdan, u jim qoldi.
{r:In spite of her compelling testimony, the jury remained unconvinced.} - Uning ishonchli guvohligiga qaramasdan, hay'at ishonchsiz qoldi.

text: {r:Proud} [praʊd] – faxrlangan, mag’rur. Siz to’satdan biznes bilan shug’ullanishni istab qoldingiz va o’zingiz sevgan mahsulot ya’ni praynik ishlab chiqarishni boshladingiz. {p:PRA}yniklarni {p:UD}arini tayyorlayapsiz va ko’p sotyapsiz. Har kuni minglab dollar foyda qilganingizdan o’zingizdan {h:faxrlanib} ketdingiz.
examples: {r:Although he was proud, he remained humble.} - Garchi u faxrlangan bo'lsa ham, u kamtarin bo'lib qoldi.
{r:Even though she was proud of her work, she sought improvement.} - Garchi u o'z ishidan faxrlansa ham, yanada yaxshilanishni qidirdi(xohladi).
{r:Despite being proud, he accepted the criticism.} - Mag'rur bo'lishiga qaramasdan, u tanqidni qabul qildi.
{r:In spite of his achievements, he never became proud.} - Erishgan yutuqlariga qaramasdan, u hech qachon mag'rur bo'lmadi.

text: {r:Mutual} [ˈmjuːtʃuəl] – o’zaro, ikki tomonlama. Bir kuni {p:MUSH}ukxonim {p:SHL}yapa kiyib, etik kiygan mushuk bilan uchrashuvga chiqibdi. Etik kiygan mushuk {h:ikki tomonlama bir xillik}(o'zaro demoqchiman) bo’lsin deb u ham shlyapa kiyib olibdi. 'Etik kiygan mushuk' bu mashhur multfilm obrazi.
examples: {r:Although they had a mutual agreement, they constantly disagreed again.} - Garchi ular o'zaro kelishuvga erishgan bo'lsa ham, ular doimo kelisholmay qolishardi yana.
{r:Even though the feeling was mutual, they parted ways.} - Hatto hissiyot o'zaro bo'lsa ham, ularning yo'llari ayrildi.
{r:Despite the mutual respect, they argued.} - O'zaro hurmatga qaramasdan, ular bahslashdilar.
{r:In spite of their mutual understanding, misunderstandings still occurred.} - O'zaro tushunishlariga qaramasdan, tushunmovchiliklar hali ham yuzaga keldi.

text: {r:Sink} [sɪŋk] – rakovina; cho'kmoq. Bir kuni egizak opa-singillar urushib qolishibdi va opasi {p:SING}lisini betini {h:rakovina} bilan ishqalabdi.
examples: {r:Although the ship began to sink, they remained calm.} - Garchi kema cho'kishni boshlagan bo'lsa ham, ular tinch qolishdi.
{r:After purchasing the house, they replaced the old sink with one from a nearby branch} – Uy xarid qilgach, ular eski rakovinani yaqin filialdan olingan yangi rakovinaga almashtirishdi.
{r:The plumber came to fix the leaking sink.} - Santexnik oqayotgan rakovinani tuzatish uchun keldi.
{r:She cleaned the sink until it was shining} – U rakovinani yaltiraguncha tozaladi.

text: {r:Relevant} [ˈrɛləvənt] - "muhim", "mazkur mavzuga oid", "aloqador", "tegishli" degan ma'nolarni anglatadi. Ya'ni, gap ketayotgan mavzu yoki vaziyatga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri aloqador bo'lgan narsani bildiradi. Masalan: 1) "His comment is not relevant to the topic." — "Uning izohi mavzuga aloqador emas." 2) "Do you have any relevant experience for this job?" — "Sizda bu ish uchun tegishli tajriba bormi?" 3) "We need to find relevant information." — "Bizga tegishli (muhim, mavzuga oid) ma'lumotlarni topish kerak." Xulosa: "Relevant" — hozirgi gap yoki vaziyatga aloqador, muhim va kerakli narsani bildiradi.
examples: {r:Although the information was relevant, it was ignored.} - Garchi ma'lumot muhim bo'lsa ham, u e'tiborsiz qoldirildi.
{r:Even though the topic was relevant, they changed it.} - Hatto mavzu muhim bo'lsa ham, ular uni o'zgartirdilar.

text: {r:Illogical} [ɪˈlɒdʒɪkəl] - mantiqsiz, logikasiz. logical(mantiqli) so'zining teskarisi
examples: {r:I found the initial chapter confusing because of its unusual length} – Dastlabki bobni noodatiy uzunligi sababli chalkash deb topdim.
{r:Even though the argument was illogical, it was convincing.} - Hatto bahs mantiqsiz bo'lsa ham, u ishonarli edi.
{r:Despite the illogical explanation, they believed it.} - Mantiqsiz tushuntirishga qaramasdan, ular bunga ishonishdi.
{r:Illogical fears often arise at night.} - Mantiqsiz qo'rquvlar ko'pincha tunda paydo bo'ladi.

text: {r:Confusing} [kənˈfjuːzɪŋ] - chalkash, adashtiradigan. Confuse(chalkashtirmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Although the instructions were confusing, they followed them.} - Garchi ko'rsatmalar chalkash bo'lsa ham, ular ularga amal qilishdi.
{r:Even though the situation was confusing, they remained calm.} - Hatto vaziyat chalkash bo'lsa ham, ular tinch qolishdi.
{r:Despite the confusing details, they understood the plan.} - Chalkash tafsilotlarga qaramasdan, ular rejani tushunishdi.
{r:In spite of the confusing directions, they eventually found their way.} - Chalkash yo'nalishlarga qaramasdan, ular oxir-oqibat yo'lini topdilar.
{r:The confusing instructions made me rush, and I ended up paying the wrong fee} – Chalkash ko‘rsatmalar meni shoshilishga majbur qildi va oxir-oqibat noto‘g‘ri to‘lov qildim.

text: {r:Controversy} [ˈkɒntrəvɜːrsi] – bahs, munozara, tortishuv. Og’aynilar bilan yig’ilishib kontr o’ynashga qaror qildik. Lekin qaysi {p:KONTR VERSIY}asi o’ynashni kelisha olmadik va bu keskin {h:tortishuvga} aylanib ketdi. Kimdir dasda o’ynaymiz desa yana kimdir desertda o’ynaymiz deb aytdi.
examples: {r:Although the controversy was intense, they resolved it.} - Garchi bahs-munozara shiddatli bo'lsa ham, ular uni hal qilishdi.
{r:The students thought the new library fee was nonsense, causing a big controversy} – Talabalar yangi kutubxona to‘lovini bema’nilik deb o‘ylashdi va bu katta bahsga sabab bo‘ldi.
{r:Despite the controversy, the project was successful.} - Bahs-munozaraga qaramasdan, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.

{r:In spite of the ongoing controversy, public support for the initiative remained strong.} - Davom etayotgan bahs-munozaraga qaramasdan, jamoatchilikning tashabbusni qo'llab-quvvatlashi kuchli bo'lib qoldi.

text: {r:Joy} [dʒɔɪ] – xursandchilik, rohat. E’tiqodli inson sifatida men uchun eng rohatbaxsh joy bu {p:JOY}namoz. Uni ko’rishimning o’zi menga {h:xursandchilik} bag’ishlaydi.
examples: {r:I'll restore my old PUBG account in case we need some joy.} - Agar ozgina xursandchilik qilish kerak bo'lib qolsa men oldingi PABJI akkountimni tiklayman.
{r:She packed her favorite book just in case she needed a source of joy.} - Xursandchilik manbasi kerak bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun u sevimli kitobini oldi.
{r:In case of a dull moment, we can play music to bring some joy.} - Agar zerikarli lahza sodir bo'lsa, baxt taratish uchun musiqani yoqishimiz mumkin.
{r:I'll prepare some jokes in case we need to add some joy to the conversation.} - Suhbatga xursandchilik qo'shishimiz kerak bo'lib qolsa bir nechta hazillarni tayyorlab qo'yaman.

text: {r:Protest} [ˈproʊtɛst] – e’tiroz bildirmoq; e’tiroz, namoyish. Amerika-Iroq urushida oyog’idan ayrilgan askarlar ularga davlat hisobidan {p:PRATEZ} oyoq qo’yib berishlari uchun {h:namoyish o’tkazishdi}.
examples: {r:A violent protest began in a new destination too.} - Yangi joyda ham zo'ravon namoyish boshlandi.
{r:She took an umbrella just in case it rains during the protest.} - Norozilik namoyishi paytida yomg'ir yog'ib yuborishi mumkin deya u soyabonini olvoldi.
{r:In case of a protest, we should stay calm and peaceful.} - Agar norozilik namoyishi sodir bo'lsa, tinch va xotirjam qolishimiz kerak.
{r:I'll bring some water in case the protest lasts longer.} - Norozilik namoyishi uzoqroq davom etishi mumkin deya bir oz suv olib kelaman.

text: {r:Comprehensive} [ˌkɒmprɪˈhɛnsɪv] – keng qamrovli, har taraflama. Buvim Turkiyaga keng qamrovli sayohat paketini sotib oldi. Bu degani buvim Turkiya shaharlarini ham, qishloqlarini ham, osmonopar binolarini ham, tog’larini ham ko’rib keldi. {h:Keng qamrovli} paketni sotib olib oxiri {p:KAMP}ir {p:HANSIR}ab qolibdi.
examples: {r:They needed a comprehensive plan for their long vacation around the world.} - Ularga butun dunyo bo'ylab uzoq ta'tili uchun keng qamrovli (to'liq) reja kerak edi.
{r:The army's comprehensive plan helped them defeat the enemy easily.} - Armiyaning keng qamrovli rejasi ularga dushmanni osongina mag'lub etishga yordam berdi.
{r:The report was incomplete so it couldn't provide comprehensive results.} - Hisobot chala edi, shuning uchun u keng qamrovli natijalarni taqdim eta olmadi.
{r:I'll prepare a comprehensive plan in case things go wrong.} - Agar ishlar noto'g'ri ketib qolsa deb to'liq reja tayyorlab qo'yaman.

text: {r:Load} [loʊd] – yuklamoq; yuk. Tasavvur qiling siz mana bu rasmda yuk {h:yuklayapsiz} kamazga. Yukingiz loviya, {p:LOV}iyaniyam {p:UD}ari. Hajmi kitobdek, rangi pushti, ichi esa qora rangda bu loviyani. Bozorda kilosi 50 000 so’m.
examples: {r:I'll bring an extra bag in case the load is too heavy.} - Yuk juda og'ir bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun qo'shimcha sumka olib kelaman.
{r:She got two chairs just in case the load makes us tired.} - Yuk bizni charchatishi ehtimoli borligi uchun u ikkita stul oldi.
{r:In case of a heavy load, we can ask for help.} - Agar yuk og'ir bo'lib qolsa, yordam so'rashimiz mumkin.
{r:The host asked us to load our luggage onto the bus} – Mezbon bizdan yuklarimizni avtobusga ortishimizni so‘radi.

text: {r:Innocence} [ˈɪnəsəns] - aybsizlik, begunohlik. Innocent(aybsiz, begunoh) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The entire university confirms these twin's innocence.} - Butun universitet bu egizaklarning aybsizligini tasdiqlaydi.
{r:I was anxious because despite his innocence my husband was jailed.} - Men tashvishda edim chunki aybsizligiga qaramasdan erimni qamab qo'yishdi.
{r:In case of a misunderstanding, we should protect their innocence.} - Agar noto'g'ri tushunish sodir bo'lsa, ularning beg'unohligini himoya qilishimiz kerak.
{r:His wife cheated on him but anyway she claims innocence} - Uning xotini xiyonat qildi lekin baribir ham begunohlikka da'vo qilyapti.

text: {r:Deer} [dɪər] – bug’u. Siz bu vaziyatda o’zingiz taniydigan {p:DIYOR} ismli yigitni {h:bug’u} ustida tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:I'll bring my camera in case we see a deer.} - Kiyik ko'rishimiz ehtimoli borligi uchun kameramni olib kelaman.
{r:The reliable guide showed us where the deer gather and explained the park entry fee} – Ishonchli yo‘lboshlovchi bizga kiyiklar to‘planadigan joyni ko‘rsatdi va parkga kirish to‘lovini tushuntirdi.
{r:A bunch of deer frequently come to the river to drink water} – Bir to‘da kiyik tez-tez daryo bo‘yiga suv ichishga keladi.
{r:I'll bring some food in case we need to attract a deer.} - Kiyikni jalb qilishimiz kerak bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun bir oz ovqat olib kelaman.

text: {r:Split} [splɪt] – bo’lmoq, taqsimlamoq. Tasavvur qiling SPRAYT sotib olib qopqog’ini hech ham ocholmayapsiz. Shunda pichoqni oldingizda {p:SPRAYT}ni {h:o’rtasidan bo’ldingingiz}.
examples: {r:After their split, time helped restore their friendship.} - Ular ajralganidan keyin, vaqt ularning do'stligini tiklashga yordam berdi.
{r:She packed some glue just in case the material splits.} - Material yorilishi ehtimoli borligi uchun u yelim oldi.
{r:In case of a split, we can use the tools to fix it.} - Agar yorilish sodir bo'lsa, uni tuzatish uchun asboblardan foydalanishimiz mumkin.
{r:This couple split during their vacation abroad.} - Bu juftlik chet el ta'tili payti ajralib ketishdi.
{r:Aside from one disagreement, the team never split over decisions} – Bitta kelishmovchilikdan tashqari, jamoa hech qachon qarorlar bo‘yicha bo‘linmadi.

text: {r:Emission} [ɪˈmɪʃən] – chiqarish, tarqatish. Chaqaloq onasini {p:EMISH} orqali asabiylikni {h:chiqarib} yuborib miyasi xotirjam bo’lar ekan. Shuning uchun ham aslida “onasini emsin” degan bu so’kinish emas balki yaxshi niyat.
examples: {r:I'll bring a mask in case the emissions are too strong.} - Chiqqan gazlar juda kuchli bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun niqob olib kelaman.
{r:She took some air freshener just in case the emissions are unpleasant.} - Chiqqan gazlar yoqimsiz bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun u havo xushbo'ylantirgichini oldi.
{r:If emissions are at the high level, we should avoid the area.} - Agar chiqqan gazlar yuqori bo'lsa, bu hududdan qochishimiz kerak.
{r:I'll bring some plants in case the emissions need to be absorbed.} - Chiqqan gazlarni yutish kerak bo'lib qolsa bir nechta o'simlik olib kelaman.

text: {r:Steady} [ˈstɛdi] – barqaror, uzluksiz, to’xtovsiz. {p:S}ariq {p:TEDDI} ayiqchalari har yili bayramlarda qizlarga va yosh bolalarga sovg’a qilinadi. Ayiqchaning mashhurligi {h:uzluksiz} ortib boryapti va har yili undan 10 000 lab dona sotaman.
examples: {r:Our rivals are having steady increases in profit.} - Raqiblarimiz daromadida barqaror o'sish bo'lyapti.
{r:In case the colors match perfectly, you’ll have a steady design for the room} – Ranglar mukammal mos tushib qolsa, sizda xona uchun barqaror dizayn bo‘ladi.
{r:The athlete’s continuous training built muscle and kept his performance steady} – Sportchining doimiy mashg‘uloti mushaklarini mustahkamlab, natijasini barqaror saqladi.
{r:He made steady progress despite working with incomplete information.} - Chala ma'lumotlar bilan ishlashiga qaramasdan u barqaror o'sishga erishdi.
{r:It’s essential to keep a steady temperature when germinating multiple seeds} – Ko‘plab urug‘larni undirishda barqaror haroratni saqlash muhimdir.

text: {r:Oven} [ˈʌvən] - duxobka, pech. Tasavvur qiling siz hech qachon duxobka sotib olmaysiz. Har doim ovsiningiznikini ishlatasiz. Siz uchun {p:OVSIN} bu {h:duxobka}.
examples: {r:The bakery uses a reliable oven to bake multiple bread simultaneously.} – Nonvoyxona bir vaqtning o‘zida bir nechta non pishirish uchun ishonchli pechdan foydalanadi.
{r:I bought a Turkish oven during my vacation in Turkey.} - Turkiyadagi ta'tilim davomida turk duxobkasi sotib oldim.
{r:She paid the entrance fee to see the exhibition of ancient ovens} – U eski pechlar ko‘rgazmasini ko‘rish uchun kirish to‘lovini to‘ladi.
{r:The old bakery still retains its original oven, which still works perfectly.} - Eski nonvoyxona hali ham o'zining asl duxobkasini saqlab qolgan, u hali ham mukammal ishlaydi.

text:
{r:Sustain} [səˈsteɪn] - "saqlab qolmoq", "qo‘llab-quvvatlamoq", "uzoq muddat davom ettirmoq" degan ma’nolarni anglatadi. U turli kontekstlarda ishlatiladi: 
 1) "We need to find ways to sustain economic growth." — "Iqtisodiy o‘sishni saqlab qolish yo‘llarini topishimiz kerak." 
 2) "She was too weak to sustain the effort." — "U harakatni davom ettirish uchun juda zaif edi." 
 3) "The roof was not strong enough to sustain the weight of the snow." — "Tomm qorning og‘irligini ko‘tarish uchun yetarlicha mustahkam emas edi." 
 4) "A healthy diet helps sustain energy levels." — "Sog‘lom ovqatlanish energiya darajasini saqlab qolishga yordam beradi."

{r:Flee} [fliː] – qochmoq, qochib ketmoq. Eduard Snouden haqida eshitgan bo’lsangiz kerak. Amerikaning maxfiy hujjatlar namunalarini {p:FLI}shkaga yuklagan va bu FLIshka bilan {h:Rossiyaga qochib ketgan.} (bo’lgan voqea, bu izoh yaxshiroq esda qolishi uchun u haqida onlayn o’qib ko’rishingiz tavsiya etiladi)
examples: {r:I'll bring a map in case we need to flee quickly from the site.} - O'sha joydan tezda qochishimiz kerak bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun xarita olib kelaman.
{r:I took some cash just in case we need to flee unexpectedly.} - Kutilmagan holda qochishimiz kerak bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun bir oz naqd pul oldim.
{r:In case of danger, we should flee immediately.} - Agar xavf tug'ilsa, darhol qochishimiz kerak.
{r:I'll bring a flashlight in case we need to flee in the dark.} - Qorong'ilikda qochishimiz kerak bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun chiroq olib kelaman.

text: {r:Leather} [ˈlɛðər] – teri, charm. Tasavvur qiling siz {h:terini} kuydiradigan {p:LAZER} sotib oldingiz. Inson terisi va oshlangan teriga ham zarak keltiradiganini. Bu haqida militsiya xabar topib sizni 15 sutkaga qamab qo’ydi.
examples: {r:The passenger was a witness to the theft of a leather bag} – Yo‘lovchi charm sumkaning o‘g‘irlanishiga guvoh bo‘ldi.
{r:He bought a leather jacket just in case it gets cold.} - Havo sovuqlashi ehtimoli borligi uchun u charm kurtka sotib oldi.
{r:In case of rain, I'll protect my leather shoes.} - Mabodo yomg'ir yog'sa, charm poyabzalimni himoya qilaman.
{r:The young hero received a leather diary as a gift to record his journey} – Yosh qahramon sayohatini yozib borish uchun sovg‘a sifatida charm kundalik oldi.

text: {r:Custom} [ˈkʌstəm] – urf-odat, rasm-rusum. Butun dunyo yahudiylari barcha {h:rasm-rusumlarini} pushti {p:kastim} kiygan holatda o’tkazadilar.(Namuna uchun yozildi)
examples: {r:It was a strange custom, but the villagers believed it would protect the innocent from harm.} - Bu g'alati odat edi, ammo qishloq ahli bu begunohlarni zarardan himoya qilishiga ishonardi.

{r:When visiting another country, you must select clothes according to their customs as part of your duty} – Boshqa mamlakatga borganda, burchingiz sifatida kiyimni ularning urf-odatlariga mos tanlashingiz kerak.
{r:According to local customs, it is rude not to accept tips from guests} – Mahalliy urf-odatlarga ko‘ra, mehmonlardan choychaqa qabul qilmaslik qo‘pol hisoblanadi.
{r:The village customs included placing a coin in a hole for good luck.} - Qishloq urf-odatlariga ko‘ra, omad uchun chuqurga tanga qo‘yish kirardi.

text: {r:Efficiency} [ɪˈfɪʃənsi] – samaralilik, ishchanlik, mahsuldorlik. Ishxonada eng samarali xodim bo’lganim uchun Parijdagi Eyfel minorasini ko’rib kelish uchun bilet berilyapti. Har doim bu haqida orzu qilganman. {p:EYFE}lga {p:SHANS} faqat bir marta beriladi. Uni ham ishdagi {h:mahsuldorligim} uchun berishdi.
examples: {r:The new blender works with such efficiency that it extracts juice completely from the fruit} – Yangi blender shunday samarali ishlaydiki, mevadan sharbatni butunlay ajratib oladi.
{r:She brought some energy drinks just in case we need to boost our efficiency.} - Samaradorligimizni oshirishimiz kerak bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun energetiklar oldi.
{r:In case of a tight schedule, we should focus on efficiency.} - Agar jadval tig'iz bo'lsa, samaradorlikka e'tibor berishimiz kerak.
{r:I'll bring a timer in case we need to track our efficiency.} - Samaradorligimizni kuzatishimiz kerak bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun taymer olib kelaman.

text: {r:Pile} [paɪl] – uyum, to’da, to’p. Men itimning shunchalik yaxshi ko’ramanki har kuni kilolab suyak beraman. Itim ayniqsa {p:PAYL}arni yaxshi ko’radi. Shuning uchun {h:bir uyum} qilib olib kelib qo’yganman.
examples: {r:I'll bring a shovel in case we need to clear the pile of leaves.} - Barglar uyumini tozalashimiz kerak bo'lib qolsa deb belkurak olib kelaman.
{r:In the pile of stones, there was definitely a small diamond hidden} – Toshlar uyumida shubhasiz kichkina olmos yashiringan edi.
{r:In case of a large pile, we should work together.} - Agar to'plam katta bo'lsa, birgalikda ishlashimiz kerak.
{r:Keep the incomplete paperwork in a separate pile in case the auditor visits.} - Chala hujjatlarni alohida uyumga ajratib qoʻying, agar tekshiruvchi keladigan boʻlsa.

text: {r:Vulnerable} [ˈvʌlnərəbəl] – nozik, zaif. Rossiyada ishlayotgan o’zbeklar yaxshi bilishadi dunyodagi eng {h:zaif} {p:VAL}yuta {p:RUBL}.
examples: {r:I'll bring some blankets in case the vulnerable people get cold.} - Zaif odamlar sovuqotishi mumkiniligi uchun bir nechta adyol olib kelaman.
{r:The fish were vulnerable, merely trapped in a shallow part of the lake} – Baliqlar zaif ahvolda edi, shunchaki ko‘lning sayoz joyida tuzoqqa tushib qolishgan edi.
{r:The bedroom door was fragile, leaving them vulnerable despite plenty of locks} – Yotoqxona eshigi mo‘rt edi, ko‘p qulf bo‘lishiga qaramay ularni zaif holatda qoldirardi.
{r:I'll bring some extra food in case the vulnerable people need it.} - Zaif odamlarga kerak bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun qo'shimcha ovqat olib kelaman.

text: {r:Migrate} [ˈmaɪɡreɪt] - migratsiya qilmoq, ko'chmoq.
examples: {r:I'll bring a map in case we need to migrate to a new location.} - Yangi joyga ko'chishimiz kerak bo'lishi ehtimoli borligi uchun xarita olib kelaman.
{r:He packed some warm clothes just in case we migrate to a colder area.} - Sovuqroq hududga ko'chishimiz ehtimoli borligi uchun u issiq kiyimlar oldi.
{r:In case of a natural disaster, we might need to migrate.} - Agar tabiiy ofat sodir bo'lsa, ko'chishimiz kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

{r:The villagers decided to migrate after a warning about floods, though some declined to leave} – Qishloq aholisi toshqinlar haqidagi ogohlantirishdan so‘ng ko‘chib ketishga qaror qildi, biroq ba’zilari ketishni rad etdi.

text: {r:Corruption} [kəˈrʌpʃən] - korrupsiya
examples: {r:The journalist exposed the corruption with proper evidence, causing guilt among the officials} – Jurnalist korrupsiyani to‘g‘ri dalillar bilan fosh qildi va bu amaldorlar orasida ayb hissini uyg‘otdi.
{r:He gathered some evidence just in case we encounter corruption.} - Korrupsiyaga duch kelishimiz ehtimoli borligi uchun u dalillar yig'di.
{r:He managed to acquire his position through corruption, but he still called it an achievement} – U lavozimini korrupsiya orqali qo‘lga kiritdi, lekin baribir buni yutuq deb atadi.
{r:They laughed at his joke about corruption, but the mayor did not approve} – Ular uning korrupsiya haqidagi haziliga kulishdi, lekin mayor buni ma’qullamadi.

text: {r:Fate} [feɪt] - taqdir.
examples: {r:You can't change your fate unless you take action.} - Agar harakat qilmasangiz, taqdiringizni o'zgartira olmaysiz.
{r:As long as you believe in your fate, you can achieve anything.} - Agar taqdiringizga ishonsangiz, hamma narsaga erisha olasiz.
{r:Unless you accept your fate, you'll always feel restless.} - Agar taqdiringizni qabul qilmasangiz, doim bezovta bo'lasiz.
{r:Your fate is in your hands as long as you make the right choices.} - Agar to'g'ri tanlovlar qilsangiz, taqdiringiz sizning qo'lingizda.

text: {r:Ongoing} [ˈɒnˌɡoʊɪŋ] – davom etayotgan, davomiy. Xullas men qishloqda 100 ta mol boqaman. Mollarimdan ancha muncha go’ng chiqadi. Sizlarga aytmoqchi bo’lganim {p:ONG GO’NG} mendan. Go’ngni ob tappi tayyorlasangiz 10 soat {h:davomiy} yonib beradi pechkangizda.
examples: {r:We wish you ongoing success.} - Biz senga davomiy muvaffaqiyat tilaymiz.
{r:As long as the ongoing research yields results, we'll keep funding it.} - Agar davom etayotgan tadqiqot natijalar berib tursa, uni moliyalashtirishni davom ettiramiz.
{r:Unless the ongoing negotiations fail, we'll reach an agreement.} - Agar davom etayotgan muzokaralar muvaffaqiyatsiz tugamasa, kelishuvga erishamiz.
{r:The ongoing discussion is productive as long as everyone participates.} - Agar hamma ishtirok etsa, davom etayotgan munozara samarali bo'ladi.

text: {r:Chapter} [ˈtʃæptər] – kitobning bobi. Mana bu kitob quvig’ini nazorat qilaolmaydigan inson haqida. Kitobning 1 – {h:bob}ida u daraxt tagiga {p:CHOPTIR}adi, 2 bobida maktab devoriga choptiradi, 3 – bobida ariq bo’yida choptiradi.
examples: {r:You can't skip this chapter unless you already understand the material.} - Materialni yaxshi tushunmaguningizcha, bu bobni o'tkazib yuborolmaysiz.
{r:As long as you read each chapter carefully, you'll do well on the exam.} - Agar har bir bobni diqqat bilan o'qisangiz, imtihonda yaxshi natija ko'rsatasiz.
{r:Unless you finish this chapter, you won't understand the next one.} - Agar bu bobni tugatmasangiz, keyingisini tushunolmaysiz.
{r:The chapter is interesting as long as you pay attention.} - Agar e'tibor bersangiz, bu bob qiziqarli bo'ladi.
{r:The first chapter is often an introduction to the main characters.} - Birinchi bob ko'pincha asosiy qahramonlarning tanishtiruvidir.

text: {r:Consume} [kənˈsuːm] – iste’mol qilmoq, yemoq, ichmoq. Tasavvur qiling g’ayrioddiy qobiliyatingiz bor. Baliq {p:KANS}erva {p:YUM}aloq bo’lsa tunikasini ochmasdan ham butunligicha {h:yeb} yuborasiz, to’rtburchak bo’lsa ochib yeysiz.
examples: {r:You shouldn't consume too much sugar unless you want health problems.} - Agar sog'lig'ingizga zarar yetkazishni xohlamasangiz, juda ko'p shakar iste'mol qilmang.
{r:The goal was to eliminate waste, sweep the streets, and consume fewer resources} – Maqsad chiqindilarni yo‘qotish, ko‘chalarni supurish va kamroq resurs iste’mol qilish edi.
{r:Unless you consume enough water, you'll feel tired.} - Agar yetarli miqdorda suv ichmasangiz, charchagan his qilasiz.
{r:The machine will work efficiently as long as it consumes enough power.} - Agar yetarlicha energiya iste'mol qilsa, mashina samarali ishlaydi.

text: {r:Trace} [treɪs] – alomat, belgi, nishona, iz; izini olmoq. Trener sizga karate o’rgatayotganda har bitta gapidan keyin “{p:TRE}ner {p:YES}” deb turish kerak. Aytmasangiz bu uni eshitmayotganingiz {h:belgisi} bo’ladi va sizni qattiq kaltaklashi mumkin.
examples: {r:You can't trace the source of the problem unless you investigate thoroughly.} - Agar puxta tekshirmasangiz, muammoning manbasini aniqlay olmaysiz.
{r:With plenty of patience and tips from experts, he finally found a trace of water underground} – Ko‘plab sabr va mutaxassislarning maslahatlari yordamida u nihoyat yer ostida suv izini topdi.
{r:Unless you trace the error, the system won't work properly.} - Agar xatoni aniqlamasangiz, tizim to'g'ri ishlamaydi.
{r:The food had a trace of something disgusting, but it was merely a smell} – Ovqatda jirkanch narsaning izi bor edi, lekin bu shunchaki hid edi.

text: {r:Infant} [ˈɪnfənt] – go’dak, chaqaloq. {p:IN}gichka {p:FANT}a chiqibdi {h:go’daklar} uchun maxsus. Lekin rangi sariq emas balki pushti bo’lar ekan.
examples: {r:You shouldn't leave the infant alone unless you're sure it's safe.} - Agar xavfsizligiga ishonchingiz komil bo'lmasa, chaqaloqni yolg'iz qoldirmang.
{r:As long as the infant is fed and rested, it will be happy.} - Agar chaqaloq ovqatlangan va dam olgan bo'lsa, u xursand bo'ladi.

{r:The lack of rain will diminish the crop yield, affecting even the youngest infants in the village.} - Yomg'irning yo'qligi hosilni kamaytiradi, bu hatto qishloqdagi eng kichik chaqaloqlarga ham ta'sir qiladi.
{r:The infant will sleep peacefully as long as the room is quiet.} - Agar xona jim bo'lsa, chaqaloq tinch uxlashi mumkin.

text: {r:Uniform} [ˈjuːnɪfɔːrm] – umumiy forma, maxsus kiyim (maktab va ishxonalarga kiyiladigan majburiy forma). Kishi boshiga eng ko’p sigir to’g’ri keluvchi Mongoliyada maktabda {p:YUNG}li {p:FORM}a kiyilar ekan sigir terisidan qilingan.
examples: {r:You can't enter the event unless you wear the proper uniform.} - Agar to'g'ri formani kiymagan bo'lsangiz, tadbirga kira olmaysiz.
{r:As long as you wear the uniform, you'll look professional.} - Agar formani kiygan bo'lsangiz, professional ko'rinasiz.
{r:Unless you follow the uniform policy, you'll face consequences.} - Agar forma qoidalariga rioya qilmasangiz, oqibatlariga duch kelasiz.
{r:He couldn’t imagine having to chase someone while wearing such a heavy uniform} – U bunday og‘ir formani kiyib kimnidir quvishini tasavvur ham qila olmasdi.

text: {r:Derive} [dɪˈraɪv] – chiqarib olmoq, ajratib olmoq, kelib chiqmoq. Direktorimiz fondga deb pul yig'ib lekin o'ziga Iphone 15 sotib olibdi. {p:DIR}ektor {p:AYF}onni pulini {h:chiqarib oldi} bir oylik fonddan.
examples: {r:You can't literally derive benefits unless you put in the effort.} - Agar harakat qilmasangiz haqiqatdan foyda ko'ra olmaysiz.
{r:As long as you derive lessons from your mistakes, you'll improve.} - Agar xatolaringizdan saboq olsangiz, yaxshilanasiz.
{r:Unless you derive meaning from your work, you'll feel incomplete.} - Agar ishingizdan ma'no topa olmasangiz, o'zingizni to'liq his qilmaysiz.
{r:It was a sheer joy to watch the dancers derive happiness from their movements.} - Raqqosalarning harakatlaridan quvonch olishlarini tomosha qilish sof zavq edi.

text: {r:Heel} [hiːl] – tovon. Siz tanigan {p:HIL}ola dunyodagi eng uzun {h:tovonli} oyoq kiyim kiyib yuradi. Chunchalik uzunki har ikki metrda qoqilib tushaveradi.
examples: {r:You can't walk comfortably unless your heel is healed.} - Agar to'pig'ingiz tuzalmagan bo'lsa, qulay yura olmaysiz.
{r:As long as you rest your heel, it will recover faster.} - Agar to'pig'ingizni dam oldirsangiz, tezroq tuzaladi.
{r:Unless you take care of your heel, the pain will persist.} - Agar to'pig'ingizga g'amxo'rlik qilmasangiz, og'riq davom etadi.
{r:The pain was so strong, he could barely tolerate it, holding his heel tight.} - Og'riq shu qadar yomon ediki, u unga deyarli chiday olmadi, tovonini qattiq ushladi.

text: {r:Resemble} [rɪˈzɛmbəl] – o’xshamoq. Siz tanigan {p:RIZ}von(Risolat, Rizo) {p:ZAMBIL}ga {h:o’xshaydi} turishi.
examples: {r:You can't resemble your idol unless you work hard.} - Agar qattiq ishlamasangiz, kumiringizga o'xshay olmaysiz.
{r:As long as you resemble your parents, people will notice the similarity.} - Agar ota-onangizga o'xshasangiz, odamlar o'xshashlikni payqashadi.
{r:The bright lights of the city can distract me because they resemble distant stars.} - Shahardagi yorqin chiroqlar meni chalg'itishi mumkin, chunki ular uzoqdagi yulduzlarga o'xshaydi.
{r:He will forever resemble his father in the way he walks, though he tends to drag his feet more} – U yurishida doim otasiga o‘xshaydi, lekin oyoqlarini ko‘proq sudrab yuradi.

{r:You must get a permit before you wrap food to sell at the fair, so pray it gets approved quickly} – Yarmarkada sotish uchun ovqatni o‘rashdan oldin ruxsatnoma olishingiz kerak, shuning uchun tez tasdiqlanishi uchun duo qiling. (o'tgan mavzudagi so'zlarni mustahkamlash uchun qo'shildi)

text: {r:Privacy} [ˈpraɪvəsi] – yolg’izlik, yolg’iz yashash; har kimning ijtimoiy hududi yoki shaxsiy hayoti. Mana bu {p:PRAY}nikning {p:VESI} qancha deb o’ylaysiz? 30 gram deysizmi? Yo’q bu 20 gram chiqadi. Men ana shuncha yil bir o’zim {h:yolg’iz} yashaganman. Nimaga xotiningiz ketib qolganmi deysizmi? Yo’q men xotinimdan qochib ketganman.
examples: {r:You can't enjoy privacy unless you set boundaries.} - Agar chegaralarni belgilamasangiz, shaxsiy hayotdan zavqlana olmaysiz.
{r:As long as you respect others' privacy, they'll respect yours.} - Agar boshqalarning shaxsiy hududini hurmat qilsangiz, ular ham siznikini hurmat qiladi.
{r:I lived in privacy for such a long time.} - Men shunday uzoq vaqt yolg'iz yashadim.
{r:The room will feel comfortable as long as it offers privacy.} - Agar xona shaxsiy chegarani ta'minlasa, qulay bo'ladi.

text: {r:Fabric} [ˈfæbrɪk] – material, mato; tuzilish. Mana bu {p:FABRIK}ani ko’ryapsizmi? Bu fabrika nafaqat {h:mato} ishlab chiqaradi balki o’zi ham shoyi matodan qurilgan g’isht yoki betondan emas.
examples: {r:You can't sew the fabric unless you have the right tools.} - Agar to'g'ri asboblar bo'lmasa, matoni tikolmaysiz.
{r:As long as the fabric is high-quality, the dress will look great.} - Agar mato yuqori sifatli bo'lsa, ko'ylak ajoyib ko'rinadi.
{r:Unless you choose the right fabric, the project won't succeed.} - Agar to'g'ri matoni tanlamasangiz, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'lmaydi.

{r:I purchased a beautiful fabric, and to preserve its colors from fading, I keep it away from sunlight} – Men chiroyli mato sotib oldim va ranglari o'chib ketmasligi uchun uni quyosh nurlaridan uzoq saqlayman.

text: {r:Contest} [ˈkɒntɛst] – konkurs, musobaqa; bahslashmoq, musobaqalashmoq. Men boshqa o’g’il bolalardan ko’ra sekinroq yuguraman. Bir kuni hech bo’lmasa qizlardan tezroq bo’lsam kerak deya sinfdosh qiz bilan {p:KANT}eynergacha {p:EST}afeta yugurdik {h:musobaqa} davomida. Men qoidalarni buzib qizdan avval start oldim lekin shundayam yutqazib qo’ydim.
examples: {r:You can't win the contest unless you practice.} - Agar mashq qilmasangiz, tanlovda g'alaba qozona olmaysiz.
{r:A big argument might arise during the final part of the contest.} - Tanlovning yakuniy qismida katta bahs kelib chiqishi mumkin.
{r:Unless you follow the rules of the contest, you'll be disqualified.} - Agar tanlov qoidalariga rioya qilmasangiz, diskvalifikatsiya qilinishingiz mumkin.
{r:The contest will be fair as long as everyone follows the guidelines.} - Agar hamma yo'riqnomalarga rioya qilsa, tanlov adolatli bo'ladi.
{r:The rules of the contest clearly prohibit any form of cheating.} - Tanlov qoidalari har qanday g'irromlikni aniq taqiqlaydi.

text: {r:Rifle} [ˈraɪfəl] – Avtomat, miltiq. Qo’shiqchi Rayhon juda qiziqarli inson. Antiqa texnologiyalarga qiziqadi. Masalan {p:RAY}honning {p:FL}eshkasi bor. Lekin u fleshkaning bitta tugmasini bossangiz u {h:miltiq}qa aylanadi. Menimcha Yigitali shundan qo’rqib ketib qolgan.
examples: {r:You can't use the rifle unless you have proper training.} - Agar to'g'ri trening olmagan bo'lsangiz, miltiqdan foydalana olmaysiz.
{r:As long as you handle the rifle carefully, it will be safe.} - Agar miltiqni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ushlasangiz, xavfsiz bo'ladi.
{r:Unless you clean the rifle regularly, it won't function properly.} - Agar miltiqni muntazam tozalamasangiz, u to'g'ri ishlamaydi.
{r:There was an urgent need for someone to use a rifle to protect the town.} - Shaharni himoya qilish uchun miltiqdan foydalanishga zudlik bilan ehtiyoj bor edi.

text: {r:Trick} [trɪk] – makr, xiyla, aldov; makr qilmoq; usul. Agar baliq bozorga {p:TIRIK} baliq olaman deb borsangiz baliqchilarning ajoyib {h:xiylasini} ko’rasiz. Akvariumga juda ham aktiv robot baliqni solib qo’yishadi sizga esa shalpillagan baliqni sotishadi.
examples: {r:You can't master this trick unless you practice.} - Agar mashq qilmasangiz bu hiylani o'zlashtira olmaysiz.
{r:The trick will work as long as you follow the steps carefully.} - Agar qadamlarni diqqat bilan bajarsangiz, hiyla ishlaydi.

{r:Don’t blame me if your clothes shrink; it was the trick you wanted to try, so it’s your fault} – Kiyimlaringiz kichrayib qolsa, meni ayblamang; bu siz sinab ko‘rishni istagan hiyla edi, shuning uchun bu sizning aybingiz.
{r:I suppose the best way to memorize the formula is to turn it into a simple trick.} - Menimcha, formulani yodlashning eng yaxshi usuli uni oddiy usulga aylantirishdir.

text: {r:Tent} [tɛnt] – chodir. Uyim yo’q bo’lib ko’chada {p:TENT}irab yurgan paytlarim qayerda yashaganman bilasizmi? {h:Chodirda} albatta. Xohlagan joyimga qurib olib uxlayverardim.
examples: {r:This tent is extremely heavy to transport to a mountain.} - Bu chodir tog'ga tashib olib borish uchun o'ta og'ir.
{r:As long as the tent is secure, you'll stay dry in the rain.} - Agar chodir mustahkam bo'lsa, yomg'ir payti quruq bo'lasiz.
{r:The tent will be comfortable as long as it's spacious.} - Agar chodir keng bo'lsa, qulay bo'ladi.

{r:She backed her friend’s plan to rent a tent for the market, believing it would boost earnings} – U daromadni oshirishiga ishongan holda do‘stining bozor uchun chodir ijaraga olish rejasini qo‘llab-quvvatladi.

text: {r:Sophisticated} [səˈfɪstɪkeɪtɪd] – ilg’or, takomillashgan, rivojlangan; nozik, nafis. Mana bu Toshkent Vodiy yo’nalishidagi {p:SOF ISTEKAD}a. Uning ilg’orligi shundaki mashinalar bu yo’lda toyib ketmaydi, chalg’imaydi. Istekadaning o’zi esa juda {h:mustahkam}.
examples: {r:You can't create a sophisticated design unless you have experience.} - Agar tajribangiz bo'lmasa, murakkab dizayn yarata olmaysiz.
{r:As long as the technology is sophisticated, it will be efficient.} - Agar texnologiya murakkab bo'lsa, samarali bo'ladi.
{r:Unless you understand the sophisticated system, you'll struggle.} - Agar murakkab tizimni tushunmasangiz, qiynalasiz.
{r:The solution will work as long as it's sophisticated enough.} - Agar yechim yetarlicha murakkab bo'lsa, ishlaydi.

text: {r:Efficient} [ɪˈfɪʃənt] - samarali, unumdor. Efficiency(samaralilik) so'zining sifat shakli. Menemonik namuna uchun 140 - darsga qarang.
examples: {r:You can't be efficient unless you plan ahead.} - Agar oldindan rejalashtirmasangiz, samarali bo'la olmaysiz.
{r:As long as the process is efficient, it will save time.} - Agar jarayon samarali bo'lsa, vaqtni tejaydi.
{r:Unless you use efficient tools, the task will take longer.} - Agar samarali asboblardan foydalanmasangiz, vazifa uzoqroq vaqt oladi.
{r:The system will be reliable as long as it's efficient.} - Agar tizim samarali bo'lsa, ishonchli bo'ladi.

text: {r:Dependence} [dɪˈpɛndəns] - bog'liqlik, qaramlik. Depend(bog'liq bo'lmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:You can't reduce your dependence on technology unless you limit usage.} - Agar foydalanishni cheklamasangiz, texnologiyaga qaramligingizni kamaytira olmaysiz.
{r:As long as you acknowledge your dependence, you can manage it.} - Agar qaramligingizni tan olsangiz, uni boshqara olasiz.
{r:Unless you solve your sheer dependence, it will grow.} - Agar mutlaq qaramligingizni hal qilmasangiz, u kuchayadi.
{r:The team will succeed as long as it reduces its dependence on external help.} - Agar jamoa tashqi yordamga qaramligini kamaytirsa, muvaffaqiyatga erishadi.

text: {r:Contract} [ˈkɒntrækt] - shartnoma, kontrakt.
examples: {r:You can't sign the contract unless you read it carefully.} - Agar shartnomani diqqat bilan o'qimasangiz, imzolay olmaysiz.
{r:As long as the contract is fair, both parties will benefit.} - Agar shartnoma adolatli bo'lsa, ikkala tomon ham foyda ko'radi.
{r:Unless you fulfill the terms of the contract, you'll face penalties.} - Agar shartnoma shartlarini bajarmasangiz, jarimalarga duch kelasiz.
{r:The agreement will be valid as long as the contract is signed.} - Agar shartnoma imzolangan bo'lsa, kelishuv amal qiladi.

text: {r:Desperate} [ˈdɛspərɪt] – noiloj, ilojsiz, umidsiz. Mening tog’am alkash, har kuni 2 litr ichadi. {h:Noiloj} uni narkologik dispanserga jo’natgandik {p:DISP}anserdayam {p:PAROT} qilibdi. 2 kunda orqa oynisidan sakrab qochib ketibdi.
examples: {r:As he was desperate, he took the risk.} - U juda nochor bo'lgani uchun xavfni qabul qildi.
{r:Since she was desperate, she asked for help.} - U yordam so'radi chunki noiloj edi.
{r:As he became desperate, he started looking for any solution.} - U noiloj bo'lganidan, har qanday yechimni qidirishni boshladi.
{r:Since the situation was desperate, they had to act quickly.} - Chunki vaziyat juda umidsiz edi, ular tez harakat qilishlari kerak edi.

text: {r:Promptly} [ˈprɒmptli] – tezda, kechikmasdan, vaqtida. Qizimning sochida pitlar paydo bo’libdi. Qarasam {h:tezda} boshqa bolalarimning ham sochiga o’tib ketyapti. Keyin tezda {p:PRAM}oy {p:PITLI} bozorga bordim va pitlarga qarshi dorilarni olib qizimning sochidan yo’q qilib yubordik.
examples: {r:As the meeting started, our twin workers arrived promptly.} - Yig'ilish boshlanganda, bizning egizak ishchilarimiz tezda kelishdi.
{r:Since he was late, he had to act promptly.} - U tez harakat qilishi kerak edi, chunki kech qoldi.
{r:As I asked for the report, he delivered it promptly.} - Men hisobotni so'raganimda, u uni tezda yetkazib berdi.
{r:The students promptly agreed to participate in the tiny project.} - Talabalar kichkina loyihada qatnashishga darhol rozi bo‘lishdi.

text: {r:Overlook} [ˌoʊvərˈlʊk] – e’tiborsizlik qilmoq, ahamiyat bermaslik; yuqoridan qaramoq. Bilasizmi oy tovog’im kel tovog’im degan udumga {h:ahamiyat bermasligimiz} va amal qilmasligimiz kerak. Qo’shningiz nimadir bersa siz ham nimadir olib chiqasiz va to’xtamaydi bu jarayon. Ikki o’rta {p:OVVOR} {p:LIK}opcha faqat.
examples: {r:As he was busy, he overlooked the details.} - U band bo'lgani uchun tafsilotlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirdi.
{r:Since she was tired, she overlooked the mistake.} - Chunki u charchagan edi va xatoni e'tiborsiz qoldirdi.
{r:As the manager was reviewing the report, he overlooked a small error.} - Menejer hisobotni ko'rib chiqayotganda, u kichik xatoni e'tiborsiz qoldirdi.
{r:Since the project was large, they overlooked some issues.} - Ular ba'zi muammolarni e'tiborsiz qoldirdilar chunki loyiha katta edi.

text: {r:Float} [floʊt] – suv ustida suzmoq, suvda turmoq. Siz bu vaziyatda afsonaviy bokschi {p:FLOYD} Meyvezer boks jangidan so’ng basseynda {h:suzib} yurganini tasavvur qiling.
examples: {r:As the boat floated, they enjoyed the view.} - Qayiq suzayotganda, ular manzaradan zavqlandilar.
{r:Since the water was calm, the boat floated smoothly.} - Chunki suv tinch edi va qayiq silliq suzdi.
{r:The teacher announced a contest after noticing a paper boat floating in the school fountain} – O‘qituvchi maktab favvorasida suzib yurgan qog‘oz kemani ko‘rgach, tanlovni e’lon qildi.
{r:While floating on the lake, she confessed her mistake, and he responded with a gentle hug} – U ko‘lda suzib yurganida xatosini tan oldi, u esa unga muloyim quchoq bilan javob berdi.

text: {r:Undergo} [ˌʌndərˈɡoʊ] – boshidan o’tkazmoq, boshidan kechirmoq. Men afg’on urushida xizmat qilganman. Urush qanday yomon narsaligini bilaman. Hozir Denovda T{p:ANDIR GO’}sht yeb o’tiribman maza qilib. Lekin bu Tandir go’shtgacha nimalarni {h:boshimdan o’tkazganimni} tasavvur ham qilolmaysiz.
examples: {r:As he underwent surgery, his family waited anxiously.} - U operatsiya qilayotganda, uning oilasi tashvish bilan kutdi.
{r:Since the patient was weak, he had to undergo treatment.} - Bemor davolanishi kerak edi chunki u zaif edi.
{r:As the company underwent changes, employees felt uncertain.} - Kompaniya o'zgarishlarni boshdan kechirayotganda, xodimlar noaniqlikni his qilishdi.
{r:If you cheat on the test, you will undergo a serious punishment.} - Agar testda g'irromlik qilsangiz, jiddiy jazoga duchor bo'lasiz.

text: {r:Sequence} [ˈsiːkwəns] – izchillik, ketma-ketlik, birin-ketin. Sichqonlar odamlardan ham madaniyatli bo’lar ekan. Men {p:SI}chqonlarga {p:KVAS} sotaman. Ular hammasi {h:birin-ketin} navbatga turishadi madaniyat bilan. Bir-birini turtish, birovni navbatini olib qo’yishga urinishlar yo’q.
examples: {r:As the sequence of events unfolded, they realized the truth.} - Voqealar ketma-ketligi ochilganda, ular haqiqatni anglashdi.
{r:Since the sequence was unclear, they had to investigate.} - Chunki ketma-ketlik noaniq edi va ular tekshirishlari kerak edi.
{r:As the speaker presented, he followed a logical sequence.} - Ma'ruzachi taqdimot qilayotganda, u mantiqiy ketma-ketlikka amal qildi.
{r:He made the sequence of tricks until he earned applause from the crowd} – U xalqdan qarsak olish uchun fokuslar ketma-ketligini qildi.

text: {r:Blade} [bleɪd] – tig’. Mana bu dunyodagi eng chiroyli zontiklardan biri. Haqiqiy go’zallik timsoli. Lekin {p:BLYAD} {h:tig’i} bor ekan uchida.(Bu kabi soyabonlar josuslar tomonidan qotilliklar uchun keng ishlatilgan o'tgan asrning 70 - yillarida.)
examples: {r:As he sharpened the blade, he felt a sense of pride.} - U pichoqni charxlayotib, faxr his qildi.
{r:The crowd clapped loudly as the knight raised his sword, its blade shining in the sun} – Ritsar qilichini ko‘tarib, tig‘i quyoshda yaltiraganida olomon qarsak chaldi.
{r:As the chef used the blade, he cut the vegetables precisely.} - Oshpaz tig'dan foydalanayotganda, sabzavotlarni aniq kesdi.
{r:The blade of your razor is too sharp.} - Britvangiz tig'i juda o'tkir ekan.

text: {r:Legacy} [ˈlɛɡəsi] – meros. Bobom Starbucks kompaniyasining egasi bo'lgan. U nevaralariga katta pullar meros qoldirdi. Menga esa {h:meros} sifatida faqat Starbucks {p:LEGOSI}ni qoldiribdi.
examples: {r:As he was thinking of his family's legacy, he felt inspired.} - U oilasining merosi haqida o'ylar ekan, ilhomlandi.
{r:Since the legacy was important, they documented it carefully.} - Meros muhim bo'lgani sababli, ular uni sinchiklab hujjatlashtirishdi.
{r:As the leader built a strong team, he ensured a lasting legacy.} - Rahbar kuchli jamoa qurish orqali mustahkam meros qoldirdi.
{r:Since the legacy was fading, they worked to revive it.} - Meros unutilib borayotganligi sababli, ular uni jonlantirish uchun harakat qilishdi.

text: {r:Legitimate} [lɪˈdʒɪtɪmɪt] – qonuniy, qonunga muvofiq. Rossiyada klinika ochish uchun ko'plab talablar bor. Masalan, tibbiyot bo'yicha diplom bo'lishi, kamida 5 yillik ish tajribasi va hokazo. Lekin qo'shiqchi Timati yuqoridagi talablarning birontasi bo'lmasa ham, “{p:LECH}enie {p:TIMAT}i” nomli klinikani {h:qonuniy} ocha oldi. Pul, tanish-bilish nimalarni hal qilib yubormaydiya?
