examples: {r:As the claim was legitimate, they accepted it.} - Da'vo asosli bo'lgani uchun ular uni qabul qilishdi.
{r:Since the document was legitimate, it was used as evidence.} - Hujjat qonuniy bo'lgani sababli, u dalil sifatida ishlatildi.
{r:Since the business was legitimate, it thrived.} - Biznes qonuniy bo'lgani bois, u rivojlandi.
{r:It is legitimate to forgive someone who made a mistake but did not intend to betray you} – Sizni xiyonat qilish niyatisiz xato qilgan odamni kechirish qonuniy va o‘rinli hisoblanadi.

text: {r:Cope} [koʊp] – uddasidan chiqmoq, eplamoq, dosh bermoq. Tasavvur qiling, butun dunyoni ko'piklar bosib ketdi. Insoniyat bu muammoga {h:dosh berolmagan} bir paytda {p:KO'P}paklar bu ko'piklarni yalab-yalab tugatib tashlashibdi.
examples: {r:As he tried to cope with the loss, he sought support.} - U yo'qotishga dosh berishga harakat qilar ekan, yordam so'radi.
{r:Since the situation was difficult, they had to cope with it.} - Vaziyat qiyin bo'lgani sababli, ular dosh berishlari kerak edi.
{r:As she learned new skills, she became better at coping with challenges.} - U yangi ko'nikmalarni o'rganar ekan, qiyinchiliklarga dosh berishda yaxshiroq bo'ldi.
{r:Since the pressure was high, they struggled to cope.} - Bosim yuqori bo'lgani sababli, ular bardosh berishga qiynalishdi.

text: {r:Flame} [fleɪm] – alanga, olov. Mana bu sehrli {p:FLAMA}ster. Agar u bilan qog'ozga yozsangiz, qog'ozdan {h:alanga} chiqib, yonib ketadi.
examples: {r:As the flame grew, they felt the heat.} - Alanga kuchaygani sayin, ular issiqlikni his qilishdi.
{r:Since the flame was small, it didn't spread.} - Alanga kichik bo'lgani uchun, u tarqalmadi.
{r:The flame was confirmed to expand quickly throughout the village.} - Olov qishloq bo'ylab tez tarqalgani tasdiqlandi.
{r:The flame from the fire looked excellent in the dark night.} - Yong‘indan chiqqan alangalar qorong‘u kechada ajoyib ko‘rindi.

text: {r:Wound} [wuːnd] – yara, jarohat; jarohatlanmoq. Mana bu joyga uy qurish uchun poydevor qo'yilgan. Lekin poydevorda kimyoviy zaharli moddalar bor shekilli, {p:FUND}amentga chiqsak, oyoq-qo'llarimizni {h:yara} bosib ketadi.
examples: {r:As he treated the wound, he felt a sense of relief.} - U yarani davolayotib, yengillik his qildi.
{r:Since the wound was deep, it required stitches.} - Yara chuqur bo'lgani sababli, uni tikish kerak bo'ldi.
{r:As the wound slowly healed, the pain reduced.} - Yara sekin-asta bitayotgan bir paytda, og'riq pasaydi.
{r:Since the wound was healing, they were hopeful.} - Yara tuzalayotgani uchun ular umidvor edilar.

text: {r:Comfort} [ˈkʌmfərt] - qulaylik, xotirjamlik, komfort; yupatmoq.
examples: {r:As she offered comfort, Anvar felt better.} - U taskin berishi bilan, Anvar o'zini yaxshi his qila boshladi.
{r:Since the situation was stressful, they sought comfort.} - Vaziyat stressli bo'lgani sababli, ular taskin izladilar.
{r:As the child cried, his mother offered words of comfort.} - Bola yig'laganida, onasi uni yupatuvchi so'zlar bilan ovutdi.
{r:Since the comfort was genuine, it helped them relax.} - Taskin chinakam bo'lgani uchun, u ularni tinchlantirdi.
{r:She missed the comfort of her own bed and felt homesick.} - U o'z to'shagining qulayligini sog'inib, uyini qo'msadi.

text: {r:Depict} [dɪˈpɪkt] – chizmoq, chizib tasvirlamoq; tasvirlamoq, so'z bilan tasvirlamoq. Qimorbozlikni qalamda {h:tasvirlash} so'ralganida, mashhur rassomlar {p:TUPIK}ni tasvirlagan ekanlar. Tupik bu 'boshi berk ko'cha' o'zbekchada.
examples: {r:As he depicted the scene, everyone listened intently.} - U sahnani tasvirlar ekan, hamma diqqat bilan tingladi.
{r:Since the painting depicted a historical event, it was valuable.} - Rasm tarixiy voqeani tasvirlagani uchun, u qimmatli edi.
{r:As the artist depicted the landscape, he used bright colors.} - Rassom manzarani tasvirlayotib, yorqin ranglardan foydalangan.
{r:He was glad to see the film depict heroes who deserve recognition} – U filmda e’tirofga loyiq qahramonlar tasvirlangani uchun xursand bo‘ldi.

text: {r:Operate} [ˈɒpəreɪt] – yurgizmoq, ishlatmoq, boshqarmoq, faoliyat yuritmoq. Mening xotinim {p:OPERA AYT}adigan teatrni {h:boshqaradi.} O'zi ham opera aytadi. Uning gapirishi ham opera bo'lib yotibdi. 'Dadaasi qachon kelyapsiz' deydi telefonda.
examples: {r:Since the machine was complex, it was hard to operate.} - Mashina murakkab bo'lgani sababli, uni ishlatish qiyin edi.
{r:As the new system began to operate, efficiency improved.} - Yangi tizim ishga tushishi bilan samaradorlik oshdi.
{r:Since the company operated efficiently, it was successful.} - Kompaniya samarali faoliyat yuritgani bois, u muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
{r:New regulations could complicate the operation and lead to delays.} - Yangi qoidalar operatsiyani murakkablashtirishi va kechikishlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

text: {r:Consumption} [kənˈsʌmpʃən] - iste'mol. Consume (iste'mol qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:As the consumption increased, entrepreneurs had to produce more.} - Iste'mol ko'payganligi sababli, tadbirkorlar ko'proq mahsulot ishlab chiqarishlari kerak bo'ldi.
{r:Since the consumption was high, they had to manage resources.} - Iste'mol yuqori bo'lgani sababli, ular resurslarni samarali boshqarishga majbur edilar.
{r:As the economy grew, consumption of luxury goods also increased.} - Iqtisodiyot o'sgan sayin, hashamatli mahsulotlar iste'moli ham ortdi.
{r:Since the consumption was sustainable, it benefited the environment.} - Iste'mol barqaror bo'lgani bois, u atrof-muhitga foyda keltirdi.

text: {r:Density} [ˈdɛnsɪti] - zichlik. Dense (zich) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:As the density of the population increased, resources became scarce.} - Aholi zichligi oshib borishi bilan, resurslar kamayib ketdi.
{r:Since the density was high, they had to plan carefully.} - Zichlik yuqori bo'lgani uchun, ular sinchiklab rejalashtirishlari kerak edi.
{r:As the gas cooled, its density increased significantly.} - Gaz sovigan sari, uning zichligi sezilarli darajada oshdi.
{r:Since the density was low, they had more space.} - Zichlik past bo'lgani uchun, ular ko'proq joyga ega bo'lishdi.

text: {r:Cross}[krɔːs] – kesib o‘tmoq. Real Madrid futbolchisi Toni {p:Kross} 2 soniyadayoq maydonning narigiqi qismini {h:kesib o’tdi} va gol urdi.
examples: {r:He crossed the street carefully.} - U ko‘chani ehtiyotkorlik bilan kesib o‘tdi.
{r:His involvement helped us to cross the river safely.} - Uning ishtiroki bizga daryoni xavfsiz kesib o‘tishga yordam berdi.
{r:Don’t cross the river alone.} - Daryoni yolg‘iz kesib o‘tma.
{r:Her approach to cross new challenges inspires everyone.} - Uning yangi qiyinchiliklarni yengishdagi yondashuvi hammani ilhomlantiradi.

text: {r:Seize} [siːz] – ushlamoq, tutmoq, egallamoq, tortib olmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:SEZ}ar haykalining qo’lidan {h:ushlagan} edingiz siz ham haykalga aylanib qoldingiz. Shuning uchun siz Sezar haykalini qo’lidan ushlamang.
examples: {r:He seized the bag as a police officer.} - U sumkani politsiya xodimi sifatida tortib oldi.
{r:The company seized the market as the new leader.} - Kompaniya yangi yetakchi sifatida bozorni egalladi.
{r:He seized control as a leader would.} - U yetakchi qilganidek nazoratni qo'lga oldi.

{r:The government seized several houses, but allowed the families to rent them back at a lower price} – Hukumat bir nechta uyni musodara qildi, ammo oilalarga ularni arzonroq narxda qayta ijaraga olishga ruxsat berdi.

text: {r:Distinguish} [dɪˈstɪŋɡwɪʃ] – farqiga bormoq, farqlay olmoq. Men dunyodagi eng sezgir odamman. Juda ko’p narsani farqiga boraman. Soxta dollarni haqiqiy dollardan 100 metr uzoqlikda ham ajrata olaman. Oddiy angishvonani {p:DIST}illangan {p:ANGISH}vonadan 2 sekundda {h:farqlab beraman}.
examples: {r:He cannot distinguish simple things as I expected.} - U oddiy narsalarni ham farqiga bormaydi men kutganimdek.
{r:He can distinguish different types of birds as he studied them for years.} - U qushlarning har xil turlarini farqlay oladi, ularni yillar davomida o'rgangani uchun.
{r:He distinguishes rare gems as he was taught by his master.} - U nodir toshlarni ustozidan o'rganganidek farqlaydi.
{r:As usual, he could distinguish fake dollar from a genuine one.} - Odatdagidek u soxta dollarni haqiqiysidan ajrata oldi.
{r:It's hard to distinguish his current work from what he previously created.} - Uning hozirgi ishini ilgari yaratganlaridan ajratish qiyin.

text: {r:Medium} [ˈmiːdiəm] – o’rtacha, o’rta. Talabalar darsga kirish o’rniga nima qilishni o’ylab o’tirishgan ekan. Bittasi aytibdi “Tanga tashay desam tanga yo’q ekan. Lekin meni tuman chempionatida yutgan medalim bor. Xullas {p:MED}alni {p:YUM}alatamiz agar o’ngga yiqilsa katta restoranga boramiz, chapga yiqilsa kichkinasiga, agar yiqilmasdan tik turib qolsa {h:O’RTACHASIGA} boramiz.
examples: {r:She works in a medium-sized company, and like many others, she deserves a fair salary.} – U o‘rta hajmdagi kompaniyada ishlaydi va ko‘plar kabi, u ham adolatli maoshga loyiq.
{r:A medium budget, like ours, often faces constraints in big projects.} – Biznikiga o‘xshagan o‘rtacha byudjet katta loyihalarda ko‘pincha cheklovlarga duch keladi.
{r:She chose a medium coffee, like the one she had elsewhere last week.} - U o‘rtacha hajmli qahva tanladi, o‘tgan hafta boshqa joyda ichganiga o‘xshab.
{r:It felt like a medium-sized problem, not too big or too small.} - Bu juda katta ham, juda kichik ham bo'lmagan, o'rtacha darajadagi muammodek tuyuldi.

text: {r:Portray} [pɔːrˈtreɪ] – tasvirlamoq, tariflamoq; kimningdir rolini o’ynamoq(filmlarda). Kelin: Oyijon o’g’lingiz ichadi, qimor o’ynaydi, qizlar bilan gaplashadi, chekadi, odamlarni aldaydi, omadlilarni ko’rolmaydi. Qaynona: {p:BOR TURE} sen bu gaplaring bilan o’zingni dadangni {h:tasvirlayapsan.} Mening o’g’lim rahmdil, halol, oilaparvar, bag’rikeng yigit.
examples: {r:He was hired to portray the king in the play.} - U spektaklda qirol rolini o'ynash uchun ishga olindi.
{r:The film portrays the war as a senseless tragedy.} - Film urushni ma'nosiz fojia sifatida tasvirlaydi.
{r:She portrayed herself as a victim to gain sympathy.} - U hamdardlik qozonish uchun o'zini qurbon sifatida tasvirladi.
{r:The painting portrays the beauty of the village.} - Rasm qishloq go'zalligini tasvirlaydi.

text: {r:Moderate} [ˈmɒdərɪt] – o’rtacha, o’rta. Tasavvur qiling agar hozir Real {p:MADRID}da Vinisius, Mbappe, Bellingem o’ynamasa u {h:o’rtacha} jamoaga aylanib qoladi. Ayniqsa {p:MODRICH}ga o'xshaganlar bilan.
examples: {r:The climate was moderate, just as the forecast had predicted.} - Iqlim, ob-havo bashorati aytganidek, mo'tadil edi.
{r:She tried to obtain a moderate amount of money for her studies.} - U o‘qishi uchun o‘rtacha miqdorda pul olishga harakat qildi.
{r:The training was moderate, as the coach had planned.} - Mashg'ulot murabbiy rejalashtirganidek, o'rtacha edi.
{r:The intensity of the exercise was moderate, just as he had hoped.} - Mashqning intensivligi u umid qilganidek, o'rtacha edi.

text: {r:Subsequently} [ˈsʌbsɪkwəntli] – keyinchalik, so’ngra. O’g’lim hamma narsani ortga suraveradigan yigit bo’lgan. Sabzilarni archilab qo’y desam “Dada {p:SAB}zi {p:SEKUNDLI} ishu {h:keyinroq} qilaman” deydi.
examples: {r:He worked like a machine to remove the obstacles and subsequently won the race.} – U to‘siqlarni olib tashlash uchun mashinaday ishladi va keyinchalik musobaqada g‘olib bo‘ldi.
{r:The notice, like the others, was removed and subsequently replaced with a new one.} – E’lon, boshqalari kabi, olib tashlandi va keyinchalik yangisi bilan almashtirildi.
{r:Subsequently, I worked as a seller like my father.} - Keyinchalik dadamdek sotuvchi bo'lib ishladim.
{r:Subsequently, I acted like predators.} - Keyinchalik men yirtqichlardek harakat qildim.

text: {r:Awful} [ˈɔːfəl] – rasvo, yoqimsiz. Men onlayn o’qishda o’qiyman. Lekin o’qishimizning onlayndan birdaniga {p:OFL}ayn formatga o’tishi eng {h:yoqimsiz} qaror bo’ldi.
examples: {r:The movie was described as awful.} - Film rasvo deb tasvirlandi.
{r:He was an awful singer, but he's much better now.} - U rasvo qo'shiqchi edi, lekin hozir ancha yaxshi.
{r:As prisoners were given afwul food.} - Mahbuslar sifatida bizga yoqimsiz ovqat berishgan.
{r:He described the situation as awful, filled with despair.} - U vaziyatni umidsizlikka to'la rasvo deb ta'rifladi.

text: {r:Pet} [pɛt] – uy hayvoni. Bizning mahallada {h:uy hayvonlari} mushuk va itlarni ustiga {p:PIT}arda (bombichka, paqildoq) otib ularni qo’rqitib yurgan o’qituvchi {p:PED}agog qo’lga olindi. U bu ishlarni ko’pini o’quvchilari bilan qilgan ekan.
examples: {r:As I entered the palace, my pet ran ahead to explore.} – Men saroyga kirganimda, uy hayvonim oldinga yugurib, hamma joyni ko‘zdan kechirdi.
{r:As I expected, my pet greeted me at the door.} – Xuddi kutganimdek, uy hayvonim meni eshikda kutib oldi.
{r:He loves his pet cat as I love mine.} - U o'z uy mushukini men o'zimnikini sevganimdek sevadi.
{r:The dog pet learned the tricks as its trainer had shown.} - It odatlarni murabbiyi ko'rsatganidek o'rgandi.

text: {r:Miracle} [ˈmɪrəkəl] – mo’jiza. Qiziqchi Mirzabek Xolmedov Toshkentda qarishga qarshi “{p:MIR}za {p:KL}inika” nomli klinika ochib {h:mo’jizali} tarzda insonlarni ajinlarini ketkazib berayotgan ekan. Ajinlarsiz mo’jiza.
examples: {r:His recovery was like a miracle.} - Uning tuzalishi mo'jizaga o'xshardi.
{r:The team's comeback was like a miracle.} - Jamoaning g'alabaga qaytishi mo'jizaga o'xshardi.
{r:Getting a ticket felt like a miracle.} - Chipta olish mo'jizaga o'xshab tuyuldi.
{r:The unexpected rain felt like a miracle in the drought.} - Kutilmagan yomg'ir qurg'oqchilikda mo'jizaga o'xshardi.

text: {r:Consensus} [kənˈsɛnsəs] – kelishuv, umumiy fikr, rozilik. Bir kuni Hasanboy, Isroil, Mo’ydinxo’ja va Lazizbek To’lqin Qilichev boshchiligida Olimpiadaga ketyapti ekan. Yo’llarida katta bir konteyner to’siq turgan ekan. Keyin jamoa a’zolarida {h:umumiy kelishuv} paydo bo’libdi va Bahodir Jalolovga telefon qilib “Baha biz {p:KAN}teynerni {p:SENSIZ} olib tashlay olmaymiz. Kel bizga qo’shil ham bizga yordam berasan, ham Olimpiadaga borib kelasan’ deyishibdi.
examples: {r:He presented the document as a consensus of the entire team.} - U hujjatni butun jamoaning roziligi sifatida taqdim etdi.
{r:The vote served as a consensus for the entire team.} - Ovoz berish butun jamoa uchun kelishuv sifatida xizmat qildi.
{r:The final decision was seen as a consensus.} - Yakuniy qaror umumiy rozilik sifatida ko'rildi.
{r:The agreement was described as a consensus.} - Kelishuv konsensus sifatida tasvirlangan.

text: {r:Gaze} [ɡeɪz] – tikilib qaramoq, tikilib qarash. {p:GAZ}etaga bir soat davomida {h:tikilib qarab} turish ko’zingizni pushti rangga kirgizib, tomiringizni kattalashib ketishiga sababchi bo’ladi.
examples: {r:As always, he gazed at her with admiration} – Har doimgidek, u unga qoyil qolib tikildi.
{r:He gazed at the moon as a romantic person would.} - U romantik insondek oyga tikildi.
{r:She gazed at her phone, as usual waiting for a message} – U telefoniga tikildi, odatdagidek xabar kutib.
{r:She gazed at the horizon as her grandfather had taught her.} - U ufqqa bobosi o'rgatganidek tikildi.

text: {r:Irresponsible} [ˌɪrɪˈspɒnsəbəl] - ma'suliyatsiz. Responsible(ma'suliyatli) so'zining teskarisi
examples: {r:His actions were like an irresponsible teenager's.} - Uning harakatlari mas'uliyatsiz o'smirnikiga o'xshardi.
{r:She behaved like an irresponsible driver, and afterward she was exhausted from the stress} – U mas’uliyatsiz haydovchidek harakat qildi va keyin stressdan charchadi.
{r:His spending was like an irresponsible person's.} - Uning xarajatlari mas'uliyatsiz odamnikiga o'xshardi.
{r:He made a decision like an irresponsible person, without considering the consequences.} - U oqibatlarini o'ylamasdan, ma'suliyatsiz odam kabi qaror qabul qildi.

text: {r:Unhappy} [ʌnˈhæpi] - baxtsiz. Happy(baxtli) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:He was an unhappy person as a child.} - U bola sifatida baxtsiz odam edi.
{r:He was viewed as an unhappy person by his coworkers.} - U hamkasblari tomonidan baxtsiz odam sifatida ko'rilgan.
{r:He was described as an unhappy leader.} - U baxtsiz lider sifatida tasvirlangan.
{r:She saw her life as an unhappy one after the divorce.} - U ajrashgandan so'ng o'z hayotini baxtsiz hayot deb bildi.

text:
{r:Clue} [kluː] – kalit, uch, iz, biror narsani topishda yordam beradigan qo’shimcha ma’lumot yoki iz. Ko'proq 'smb have no clue' strukturasi ishlatiladi va kimdir nimanidir bilmasligini nazarda tutadi. 
  Qishda {p:KLU}bnika(qulupnay) kilosi 250 000 so’m bo’lib ketar ekan. O'sha mevani yetishtirib men ham boy bo'lib ketishim kerak lekin menda uni qishda qanday yetishtirish {h:bo’yicha hech qanday ma’lumot yo’q}.
examples: {r:He followed the clues as the detective showed him.} - U detektiv unga ko'rsatganidek izlarga ergashdi.
{r:Since it was hidden under the table, she found the clue easily.} - Stol ostida yashiringanligi sababli, u izni osongina topdi.
{r:They described the evidence as a crucial clue, leading to the truth.} - Ular dalilni haqiqatga olib boruvchi hal qiluvchi iz deb ta'rifladilar.
{r:I have no clue where she went.} – U qayerga ketganini bilmayman.
{r:You have no clue what’s waiting for you outside.} – Tashqarida seni nima kutayotganini bilmayapsan.

text: {r:Slice} [slaɪs] – parcha, qism, bo’lak; kesib bo’laklamoq, parcha qilib kesmoq. {p:S}ariq {p:LAYS} chipsini reklama qiluvchi Messi bu chipslarni mayda-mayda {h:bo’lak}larga bo’lib yeyishni yaxshi ko’rar ekan.
examples: {r:The pizza tasted like a slice of heaven.} - Pizza jannatdan bir bo'lak kabi tuyuldi.
{r:He slices the onions like a professional chef.} - U piyozlarni professional oshpazdek to'g'raydi.
{r:The new job was like a small slice of a larger opportunity.} - Yangi ish kattaroq imkoniyatning kichik bir bo'lagiga o'xshardi.
{r:He wanted a slice of pie, like the one his mother used to make.} - U onasi pishiradigan pirogdek bir bo'lak pirog istadi.

text: {r:Coal} [koʊl] – ko’mir. Tasavvur qiling qishlog’ingiz tepaliklarida o’sadigan {p:KOVUL}ni siz qishda {h:ko’mir} qilib yoqyapsiz isinish uchun.
examples: {r:The old factory used coal as its main source of energy.} - Eski zavod ko'mirni o'zining asosiy energiya manbai sifatida ishlatardi.
{r:He worked as a coal miner for years.} - U yillar davomida ko'mirchi sifatida ishladi.
{r:The dark charcoal was used as a means for painting.} - Qora ko'mir rasm chizish uchun vosita sifatida ishlatildi.
{r:I earn a lot of money as a coal seller.} - Men ko'mir sotuvchisi sifatida ko'p pul topaman.

text: {r:Sacred} [ˈseɪkrɪd] – muqaddas. Tasavvur qiling siz juda vatanparvarsiz. Saylovlarda har doim qatnashib yurasiz. Saylov siz uchun muqaddas, {p:SAY}lovdagi {p:KIRD}iyam {h:muqaddas} deb bilasiz.
examples: {r:The land was protected as their sacred beliefs required.} - Yer ularning muqaddas e'tiqodlari talab qilganidek himoya qilindi.
{r:It may occur during the sacred festival after the official announcement.} – Bu rasmiy e’lon qilingach, muqaddas festival davomida sodir bo‘lishi mumkin.
{r:The holy book was treated as a sacred text.} - Muqaddas kitobga muqaddas matn sifatida munosabatda bo'lindi.
{r:In the sacred tale, the hero suffers betrayal from his closest friend.} – Muqaddas rivoyatda qahramon eng yaqin do‘stining xiyonatini boshidan kechiradi.

text: {r:Retirement} [rɪˈtaɪərmənt] - nafaqaga chiqish, nafaqa davri.
examples: {r:His retirement felt like a dream come true.} - Uning nafaqasi ro'yobga chiqqan orzu kabi edi.
{r:Life after work can be like a second youth.} - Ishdan keyingi hayot ikkinchi yoshlik kabi bo'lishi mumkin.
{r:The long vacation felt like a small retirement.} - Uzoq ta'til kichik bir nafaqaga o'xshardi.
{r:His new life was like an early retirement.} - Uning yangi hayoti erta nafaqaga o'xshardi.

text: {r:Lap} [læp] – tizza. Tasavvur qiling siz {h:tizzangizga} {p:LEP}yoshka qo’yib bozorda sotyapsiz.
examples: {r:As the cat rested on my lap, I read a book about how tigers hunt in the wild} – Mushuk tizzamda yotganida, men yo‘lbarslarning tabiatda qanday ov qilishlari haqida kitob o‘qidim.
{r:She smiled, as I expected, when the baby fell asleep on her lap} – Kutilganidek, chaqaloq uning tizzasida uxlab qolganda u jilmaydi.
{r:The blanket served as a lap protector.} - Adyol tizzani himoya qiluvchi sifatida xizmat qildi.
{r:As we learned, children often enjoy sitting on a parent’s lap during story time} – Biz o‘rganganimizdek, bolalar ertak vaqtida ota-onasining tizzasida o‘tirishni yoqtiradilar.

text: {r:Virtue} [ˈvɜːrtʃuː] – ezgulik, fazilat. Tabiat mo’jizalari ko’p. Masalan yaqinda {p:VIR}usli {p:CHU}moli kashf qilindi. Lekin uning yaxshi {h:fazilatlar}i ham bor ekan. Nomi xunuk eshitilishi mumkin lekin chumoli o’z virusi bilan chaqib olsa ozg’in bolalar ishib baquvvatlashib ketar ekan.
examples: {r:He spoke as if patience were the greatest virtue a person could have} – U sabr inson ega bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan eng katta fazilatdek gapirdi.
{r:He spoke as though virtue was the key to happiness.} - U fazilat baxtning kaliti bo‘lgandek gapirdi.
{r:He looked around nervously, as if he were an offender hiding from the police} – U atrofga asabiy qaradi, go‘yo politsiyadan yashirinayotgan jinoyatchidek.
{r:The ancient philosophers sought to distinguish each virtue with precise definitions and examples.} - Qadimgi faylasuflar har bir fazilatni aniq ta'riflar va misollar bilan ajratishga intildilar.

text: {r:Couch} [kaʊtʃ] – divan. Bobomning o’tgan yilgi KAVUSHini izlab omborxonaga kirsam sichqonlar u {p:KAVUSH}ni {h:divan} qilib dam olib o’tirgan ekan.
examples: {r:The couch looked as if it had been through a war.} - Divan urushni boshidan kechirgandek ko‘rindi.
{r:My customer sat on the couch as though it were her throne.} - Mening mijozim divanda go'yoki o‘z taxtida o‘tirgandek o‘tirdi.
{r:He lay on the couch like he owned the entire house.} - U go'yoki butun uyni egasidek divanda yotardi.

{r:After weeks of recovery, taking even a few steps from his couch to the kitchen felt like a small miracle.} - Bir necha haftalik tiklanishdan so'ng, divanidan oshxonagacha bir necha qadam yurish ham kichik mo'jiza bo'lib tuyuldi.

text: {r:Blast} [blæst] – portlatmoq, portlamoq. Men {p:PLAST}ilinni yomon ko’raman. Agar plastilin o’ynayotgan yosh bolalarni ko’rsam plastilinni ko’chaga olib chiqib {h:portlatib} yuboraman ichiga paqildoq solib.
examples: {r:The conflict sounded as if it were a massive blast.} - Janjal go'yoki katta portlashdek eshitildi.
{r:The fireworks exploded like the sky was tearing apart.} - Salyutlar go'yoki osmon yorilib ketgandek portladi.
{r:They acted as if the blast had shaken the entire city.} - Ular go'yoki portlash butun shaharni qimirlatgandek harakat qildilar.

{r:The blast damaged the building considerably, leading to a disagreement about who was responsible} – Portlash bino­ga sezilarli zarar yetkazdi va kim aybdor ekanligi borasida kelishmovchilik yuzaga keldi.

text: {r:Prevail} [prɪˈveɪl] – ustunlik qilmoq, g’alaba qilmoq; bor bo’lmoq. Aylanish yosh bolalar orasida kvadroberlikdan so’ng ikkinchi katta yomon odatga aylandi. Aylanishga qarshi dorilar va vaksinalar paydo bo’ldi. Lekin baribir {p:PRIV}ivka {p:AYL}anishga qarshi eng yaxshi vosita bo’lib turibdi va boshqa dorilardan {h:ustinlik qilmoqda}.
examples: {r:She fought as if justice would prevail.} - U go'yoki adolat g‘alaba qiladigandek kurashdi.
{r:He spoke as though hope would always prevail.} - U go'yoki umid har doim g‘alaba qiladigandek gapirdi.
{r:The team worked like they believed they could prevail.} - Jamoa go'yoki ular g‘alaba qilishlariga ishongandek ishladi.
{r:They described the victory as if it were a sign that good would prevail.} - Ular g‘alabani go'yoki yaxshilik g‘alaba qilish belgisi bo‘lgandek ta’rifladilar.

text: {r:Rubber} [ˈrʌbər] – rezina; o’chirg’ich. Bilasizmi {p:REPPER}lar aslida {h:rezina} mikrofon bilan qo’shiq aytadi. Chunki qo’shiq aytish paytida ular o’ynaydi va har xil qo’l harakati bajaradilar va rezina mikrofon qo’ldan sirpanib ketmaydi.
examples: {r:The ball jumped as if it were made of rubber.} - To‘p go'yoki rezinadan qilingandek sakradi.
{r:She wore the shoes as though they were rubber.} - U poyabzalni go'yoki rezina bo‘lgandek kiydi.
{r:They treated the rubber as if it were a precious resource.} - Ular rezinaga go'yoki qimmatbaho resurs bo‘lgandek ehtiyot bilan qarashdi.

{r:The doctor gave a subtle hint that the pill should not be chewed, even though it felt like rubber.} – Shifokor tabletka rezinaga o‘xshab tuyulsa ham, uni chaynash kerak emasligini nozik tarzda eslatdi.

text: {r:Retreat} [rɪˈtriːt] – chekinmoq; chekinish.
examples: {r:She raised her hands as if he were retreating from the argument.} – U bahsdan chekinayotgandek qo‘llarini ko‘tardi.
{r:The pig made a quick retreat into the barn after spilling a bag of flour} – Cho‘chqa bir qop unni to‘kib yuborgach, tezda omborga chekinib ketdi.
{r:The English government is retreating from its promises.} - Ingliz hukumati o'z va'dalaridan chekinyapti.
{r:They acted as if the retreat was their only option.} - Ular go'yoki chekinish ularning yagona imkoniyati bo‘lgandek harakat qildilar.

text: {r:Overwhelming} [ˌoʊvərˈwɛlming] – haddan tashqari, yengib bo'lmas, juda katta. Bu so'zning o'zbek tilida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarjimasi yo'q. Lekin quyidagi misollar orqali uning qanday kontekstda ishlatilishini bilib olasiz.
examples: {r:The overwhelming noise in the city made it hard to concentrate.} - Shahardagi kuchli shovqin diqqatni jamlashni qiyinlashtirdi.
{r:He spoke as though the task was overwhelming.} - U go‘yoki vazifa juda og‘ir va qiynab yuboradigandek gapirdi.
{r:The amount of trash after the festival was overwhelming.} - Festivaldan keyingi chiqindilar miqdori juda katta edi.
{r:Too much pressure can overwhelm a student, making them want to cheat.} - Juda katta bosim talabani qiynab yuborishi va hatto aldashga undashi mumkin.

text: {r:Spark} [spɑːrk] – uchqun, cho’g’. {p:Spark} mashinasi olovga chidamliligi bilan ajralib turadi. Masalan bir uyum {h:cho’g’} ustidan haydab o’tsangiz ham hech narsa qilmaydi.
examples: {r:The idea came as if it were a spark of inspiration.} - G‘oya go'yoki ilhom uchquni bo‘lgandek keldi.
{r:She spoke as though the spark had ignited her passion.} - U go'yoki uchqun uning qiziqishini yoqqandek gapirdi.
{r:The government’s beef ban managed to spark protests across the country} – Hukumatning mol go‘shtini taqiqlashi butun mamlakat bo‘ylab noroziliklarni qo‘zg‘adi.
{r:They acted as if the spark was the beginning of something great.} - Ular go'yoki uchqun katta narsaning boshlanishi bo‘lgandek harakat qildilar.

text: {r:Fatigue} [fəˈtiːg] – charchoq, toliqish. {p:FOTIH} ismli do’stingizni kimda kim ko’rsa va salomlashsa tanasiga birdan {h:charchoq} kirib hech qaysi ishni qilishga holi qolmaydi.
examples: {r:He looked as if he were overcome with fatigue.} - U go'yoki charchoqdan ezilgandek ko‘rindi.
{r:She spoke as though fatigue was her constant companion.} - U go'yoki charchoq uning doimiy hamrohi bo‘lgandek gapirdi.
{r:He walked like he was suffering from extreme fatigue.} - U go'yoki qattiq charchoqdan qiynalayotgandek yurdi.
{r:They described the journey as if it were filled with fatigue.} - Ular safarni go'yoki charchoq bilan to‘lgandek ta’rifladilar.

text: {r:Speculate} [ˈspɛkjʊleɪt] – taxmin qilmoq, faraz qilmoq. Men {h:taxmin qilyapmanki} agar siz, ha ha siz teatr aktyori bo’lganingizda {p:SPEK}taklda {p:LEYT}enant rolini o’ynagan bo’lardingiz.
examples: {r:He speculated as if he knew the answer.} - U go'yoki javobni bilgandek taxmin qildi.
{r:She spoke as though speculation was her job.} - U go'yoki taxmin qilish uning ishi bo‘lgandek gapirdi.
{r:He spoke like he was speculating on the stock market.} - U go'yoki fond bozorida taxmin qilayotgandek gapirdi.
{r:People began to speculate about the punishment after the suspect’s sudden confession} – Gumondorning kutilmagan iqroridan so‘ng odamlar jazoga doir taxminlar qila boshlashdi.

text: {r:Illegitimate} [ˌɪləˈdʒɪtəmət] - noqonuniy, qonunga xilof. Legitimate(qonuniy) so'zining teskarisi.
examples: {r:The claim sounded as if it was illegitimate.} - Da’vo go'yoki noqonuniy bo‘lgandek eshitildi.
{r:He spoke as though the decision was illegitimate.} - U go'yoki qaror noqonuniy bo‘lgandek gapirdi.

{r:The manager denied the employee's vacation request, calling it illegitimate due to false medical documents.} - Rahbar xodimning ta'til so'rovini rad etdi, chunki yolg'on tibbiy hujjatlar tufayli uni noqonuniy deb topdi.
{r:The decision looked like it came from an illegitimate source.} - Qaror go'yoki noqonuniy manbadan kelgandek ko'rinardi.

text: {r:Preach} [priːtʃ] – nasihat qilmoq, vaz o’qimoq, xutba o’qimoq(diniy mazmundagi leksiya); da’vat qilmoq, undamoq. Tadbirkor O’zbekistonda {p:PLITCH}niy shokolad ishlab chiqarishga {h:da’vat qilmoqda.} Chunki barcha shokolad mahsulotlari chet eldan import qilinadi. Biz ham kakao donalarini Afrikadan olib kelib o’zimizda Snikrsdek shokolad ishlab chiqara olamiz.
examples: {r:He preachs to others constantly.} - U doimo boshqalarga nasihat qiladi.
{r:She spoke as though preaching was her calling.} - U go'yoki da'vat qilish uning burchi bo‘lgandek gapirdi.
{r:It would be ridiculous to preach about being humble while acting proud.} - Mag'rurlik bilan harakat qilib kamtarlik haqida nasihat qilish bema'ni bo'ladi.
{r:The old man spoke like he was preaching a sermon.} - Keksa odam go'yoki xutba o'qiyotgandek gapirdi.

text: {r:Arrow} [ˈæroʊ] – kamon o’qi; strelka belgisi. Mening erim har kuni ichib keladi va mastligida ko’ziga har xil narsa ko’rinadi. Bugun ertalab {p:ER}im {p:ROV}dga ustimdan arz qilib boribdi “Xotinim menga {r:kamon o'qi} o’qtaldi” deb.
examples: {r:The arrow flew as if it were guided by fate.} - O‘q go'yoki taqdir tomonidan boshqarilgandek uchdi.
{r:He spoke as though the arrow was a symbol of hope.} - U go'yoki o‘q umid ramzi bo‘lgandek gapirdi.
{r:He saw the arrow pointing to the exit but hesitated to leave} – U chiqishga ishora qilayotgan strelkani ko‘rdi, ammo chiqishga ikkilanib qoldi.
{r:They described the path as if it were straight as an arrow.} - Ular yo‘lni go'yoki o‘q kabi to‘g‘ri bo‘lgandek ta’rifladilar.

text: {r:Consecutive} [kənˈsɛkjʊtɪv] – ketma-ket, izchil, podryad. Afg’onistonda urushda xizmat qilganimda tog’Ii joyda qamalda qolib ketganmiz. Ozuqamiz tugaganidan so’ng {h:ketma-ket} 5 kun ochligimizdan {p:KASSAK YUTIB} yashaganmiz va omon qolganmiz.
examples: {r:The wins came as if they were consecutive.} - G‘alabalar go'yoki ketma-ket bo‘lgandek keldi.
{r:He spoke as though consecutive victories were expected.} - U go'yoki ketma-ket g‘alabalar kutilayotgandek gapirdi.
{r:He won five consecutive matches like it was his fate.} - U beshta o'yinni ketma-ket yutdi go'yoki yutish uning taqdiridek.
{r:They acted as if consecutive success was guaranteed.} - Ular go'yoki ketma-ket muvaffaqiyat kafolatlangandek harakat qildilar.

text: {r:Spy} [spaɪ] – josus; josuslik qilmoq. O’tgan asrning o’rtalarida Amerikada josuslik qilgan Sovet {h:josuslari} bir-birini ko’rganda tanib olishlari uchun {p:S}ariq {p:PAY}poq kiyib yurishgan ekan. Sariq paypoq ular uchun maxfiy kod bo’lgan.
examples: {r:He acted as if he were a spy and therefore jailed soon.} - U go'yoki josusdek harakat qildi va shuning uchun qamaldi.
{r:The court sentenced the spy after confirming the allegations against him} – Sud unga qarshi qo‘yilgan ayblovlar tasdiqlangach, josusni jazoga hukm qildi.
{r:The spy tried to escape by swimming across the river but nearly drowned near the temple} – Josus daryodan suzib qochmoqchi bo‘ldi, ammo ibodatxona yaqinida cho‘kib ketishiga oz qoldi.
{r:They described the man as if he was a master spy.} - Ular go'yoki erkakni usta josus bo‘lgandek ta’rifladilar.

text: {r:Regulate} [ˈrɛgjʊleɪt] – nazorat qilmoq, tartibga solmoq. Samarqanddagi Registon maydoni xususiy tadbirkorlarga topshirilganidan so’ng juda ko’p tartibsizliklar bo’lib ketdi va kirish narxi ham ko’tarilib aholi noroziligiga sabab bo’ldi. Shuning uchun hukumat tarafidan qaror chiqarildiki endi {p:REG}iston {p:LEYT}enant harbiylar tomonidan {h:nazorat qilinadi}.
examples: {r:The teacher managed the class as if every minute were regulated.} - O‘qituvchi darsni go‘yoki har bir daqiqasi tartibga solingandek olib bordi.
{r:He arranged his desk as though someone had regulated it for a photo shoot.} - U stolini go‘yoki kimdir suratga olish uchun tartibga solib bergandek joylashtirdi.
{r:Festival visitors moved like the crowd was being regulated by invisible lines.} - Festival mehmonlari go‘yoki ko‘rinmas chiziqlar tomonidan tartibga solingandek harakat qildilar.
{r:She planned the wedding as if every detail had been regulated by law.} - U to‘yni go‘yoki har bir tafsiloti qonun bilan tartibga solingandek rejalashtirdi.

text: {r:Adolescent} [ˌædəˈlɛsnt] – o’smir. Keyingi misolimiz Adolf Gitler haqida bo’ladi. Tarixchilarning yozishicha {p:ADOL}fning boshiga {p:ZONT}ik tushib boshi lat yemaguncha Adolf detskiy bo’lgan ekan. Shu voqeadan so’ng uning miyasi yaxshi ishlay boshlagan ekan va bir kunning ichida Gitler {h:o’spirin}dan yigitga aylangan.
examples: {r:He behaves as if he were still an adolescent.} - U go'yoki hali ham o‘smirdek harakat qiladi.
{r:She spoke as though adolescence was the best time of life.} - U go'yoki o‘smirlik hayotning eng yaxshi davri bo‘lgandek gapirdi.
{r:They met an adolescent girl on the hill who gave excellent advice.} - Ular tepalikda ajoyib maslahat bergan o‘smir qiz bilan uchrashdilar.
{r:They described the boy as if he was a troubled adolescent.} - Ular bolani go'yoki muammoli o‘smirdek ta’rifladilar.

text: {r:March} [mɑːrtʃ] – marsh qilmoq, norozilik chiqishlarini uyushtirmoq; marsh, yurish. Siz tanigan {p:MARJ}ona har doim nimadandir norozi, har doim davlatdan, hokimiyatdan nimadir so’raydi. Bermasa Plakatlar ko’tarib olib {h:norozilik chiqishlarini uyushtiradi} va jurnalistlarni chaqiradi.

text: {r:Snake} [sneɪk] – ilon. Tasavvur qiling endi {p:SNIK}ers shokoladlariga yangi logo qilinyapti. Bu safargi logoda {h:ilon} tasvirlangan. Endi har safar maza qilib Snikers yeganingizda ilonni rasmini ko’rib ishtahangiz bug’iladi.

text: {r:Correlate} [ˈkɔrəleɪt] – bog’liq bo’lmoq, o’zaro bog’liq bo’lmoq. Al Pachino ijrosidagi mana bu filmni ko’rgan bo’lsangiz kerak. {p:KO’R LEYT}enant yoshi qarib borishi bilan pensiyasi ortib boradi. Ya’ni uning yoshi va pensiya miqdori {h:orasida o’zaro bog’liqlik} bor.

text: {r:Flash} [flæʃ] – yarqiramoq, chaqnamoq; yarqirash, chaqnash. Chaqmoq {h:chaqayotgan} paytda oq {p:PLASH} kiymang hech qachon. Chaqmoq chaqnashi sizning ustingizga urilishi mumkin.
