{r:In the realm of sports, hard work and sweat lead to victory} – Sport sohasida mehnat va ter to‘kish g‘alabaga olib keladi.
{r:The realm of science offers endless opportunities and praise for great discoveries} – Fan sohasi buyuk kashfiyotlar uchun cheksiz imkoniyatlar va maqtovlar taklif etadi.

text: {r:Chin} [tʃɪn] – iyak. Tasavvur qiling siz {h:iyagingiz}ga {p:CHIN}or rasmini(tatusini) chizdirib oldingiz.
examples: {r:The fall was the reason for his chin hurting.} - Yiqilish uning iyak og'rig'iga sabab edi.
{r:A strong chin is a sign of toughness in fighters.} - Kuchli iyak kurashchilarda matonatning belgisidir.

{r:It took a shameless amount of courage for her to lift her chin and face the crowd after the scandal.} - Janjaldan keyin iyagini ko'tarib olomon oldiga chiqish uchun unga uyatsizlarga xos jasorat kerak bo'ldi.
{r:He pointed a rifle at my chin.} - U miltig'ini mening iyagimga qadadi.

text: {r:Steep} [stiːp] – tik, tikka ko’tarilgan; keskin, shiddatli(o’sish, rivojlanishga oid). Tasavvur qiling Apple kompaniyasi asoschisi {p:STIF} Jobs {h:tik} balandlikka ko’tarilyapti.
examples: {r:The castle was built on a steep hill.} - Qal'a tik tepalikka qurilgan edi.
{r:The amazing view at the top is a great reward for climbing a steep hill.} - Tepalikdagi ajoyib manzara tik tepalikka chiqishning katta mukofotidir.
{r:The steep road caused harm to the car's engine.} - Tik yo'l mashinaning dvigateliga zarar yetkazdi.
{r:Hiking trips often face hard challenges with steep paths.} - Piyoda sayohatlarda ko'pincha tik yo'llar bilan qiyin muammolarga duch kelamiz.

text: {r:Decade} [ˈdɛkeɪd] – o’n yillik, dekada. Bugun {h:o’n yillardan} buyon ishlab kelayotgan {p:dik}tor {p:ketdi} ishdan. U tanqidlari uchun ishdan bo’shatildi. Bu futbol jurnalisti bilan bo’lgan voqea, uning ismini ochiqlay olmayman.
examples: {r:The successful project was the reason for celebrating the past decade.} - Muvaffaqiyatli loyiha o'tgan o'n yilni nishonlash uchun sabab edi.
{r:Air traffic has increased 45% in the last decade.} - Havo qatnovi oxirgi o'n yillikda 45% ga o'sdi.
{r:The economy saw major losses over the decade.} - Iqtisodiyot o'n yillar davomida katta yo'qotishlar ko'rdi.
{r:It took a decade to find the words that could convey her profound gratitude} – Uning chuqur minnatdorligini yetkazadigan so‘zlarni topish uchun o‘n yil ketdi.

text: {r:Barn} [bɑːrn] – omborxona. Tasavvur qiling qo’shningiz(yoki dugonangiz) {p:BARN}o {h:omborxonada} ishlaydi.
examples: {r:A barn's huge size is a great plus for storing crops.} - Omborning katta hajmi ekinlarni saqlash uchun katta afzallikdir.
{r:The storm caused bad harm to the old barn.} - Bo'ron eski omborga yomon zarar yetkazdi.

{r:The detective knew the suspect, although found near the barn, was completely innocent of the theft.} - Detektiv gumonlanuvchi omborxona yaqinida topilganiga qaramay, u o‘g‘irlikda butunlay aybsiz ekanini bilar edi.
{r:The old barn was full of dust particles, which could be harmful to breathe} – Eski ombor chang zarralariga to‘la edi va bu yerda nafas olish zararli bo‘lishi mumkin.
{r:The wind scattered the leaves near the barn while a drunken farmer laughed} – Mast dehqon kulayotgan paytda shamol ombor yonidagi barglarni sochib yubordi.

text:
{r:Grasp} [græsp] – ushlamoq, tutmoq; tushunmoq, anglamoq. 
Bir kuni mazali tayyorlangan hasip oyoq chiqarib qochib ketibdi. Lekin qish oylarida ko’chada sovuqotganidan issiqroq joy qidira boshlabdi. Bo’g’irsoqni ayyorlik bilan tutib olgan tulki “sovuqda ko’chada nima qilyapsan kel buyoqqa {p:KIR HASIP}” degan ekan, hasip yugurub tulkiniga kiribdi va uni tulki {h:tutib olib} bo’g’irsoq bilan yeb qo’yibdi.
examples: {r:His hard work was the reason for his good grasp of the topic.} - Uning mashaqqatli mehnati mavzuni yaxshi tushunishining sababi edi.
{r:His public image was damaged by his poor grasp of the situation.} - Uning omma oldidagi imidji vaziyatni yomon tushunishi tufayli zarar ko'rdi.
{r:I know this is hard for you to grasp.} - Bilaman bu sen tushunishing uchun qiyin.
{r:While running, he lost possession of the ball and couldn’t grasp it again} – Yugurayotib u to‘pni nazoratdan chiqardi va uni qayta ushlay olmadi.
{r:She grasped my hand in silence} – U sukunatda qo‘limni ushlab oldi.

text: {r:Speculation} [ˌspɛkjʊˈleɪʃən] - taxmin, faraz. Speculate(taxmin qilmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Not much info was the reason for all the market speculation.} - Kam ma'lumot barcha bozor taxminlari uchun sabab edi.
{r:He tightened his belt while listening to speculation about a distant war} – Uzoqdagi urush haqidagi taxminlarni eshitarkan, kamarini mahkam bog‘ladi.
{r:The mean teacher ignored the speculation despite the students’ effort} – Qattiqqo‘l o‘qituvchi o‘quvchilarning harakatiga qaramay, taxminlarga e’tibor bermadi.
{r:His strange conduct led to speculation about what he might dare to do next} – Uning g‘alati xatti-harakati, keyin nima qilishga jur’at etishi mumkinligi haqida taxminlarga sabab bo‘ldi.

text: {r:Rivalry} [ˈraɪvəlri] - raqobat. Rival(raqib) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:Wanting the title was the reason for their sheer rivalry.} - Unvonni istash ularning mutlaq raqobatining sababi edi.
{r:New ideas often come from the benefit of healthy rivalry.} - Yangi g'oyalar ko'pincha sog'lom raqobatning foydasidan kelib chiqadi.
{r:Their friendship got hurt by their strong rivalry.} - Ularning do'stligi kuchli raqobat tufayli zarar ko'rdi.
{r:There's a clear tie between rivalry and new products.} - Raqobat bilan yangi mahsulotlar o'rtasida aniq bog'liqlik bor.

text: {r:Behalf} [bɪˈhæf] – o’rin, nom, vakili sifatida. Xullas ‘chechenlar {h:nomidan} keldim bu yerga’ desangiz Moskvada {p:BEXAVF} yurasiz.
examples: {r:Helping the community was the reason for the donation on their behalf.} - Jamiyatga yordam berish ularning nomidan qilingan xayr-ehsonning sababi edi.
{r:The charity acted on behalf of the poor when donations began to decline} – Xayriya tashkiloti xayr-ehsonlar kamayganda kambag‘allar nomidan ish yuritdi.
{r:I spoke on behalf of my friend to complain about the broken dustbin} – Sinib qolgan axlat qutisi haqida shikoyat qilish uchun do‘stim nomidan gapirdim.
{r:I apologize on behalf of my son.} - O'g'lim nomidan kechirim so'rayman.

text: {r:Sustainable} [səˈsteɪnəbəl] – barqaror, davomli, kuchli.
examples: {r:Long-term good is a huge benefit of going sustainable.} - Uzoq muddatli foyda barqaror yo'ldan borishning katta afzalligidir.
{r:Running a sustainable farm requires both endurance and careful planning} – Barqaror fermer xo‘jaligini yuritish ham chidamlilik, ham ehtiyotkor rejalashtirishni talab qiladi.
{r:They need to cooperate to find a sustainable solution.} - Ular barqaror yechim topish uchun hamkorlik qilishlari kerak.
{r:With cautious planning and dedication, she built a sustainable business} – Ehtiyotkor rejalashtirish va o'zini bag'ishlash bilan u barqaror biznes qurdi.

text: {r:Rage} [reɪdʒ] – qahr, g’azab; g’azablanmoq. Tasavvur qiling siz mahallada yurgan paytingiz {p:RENJ} Rover mashinasi katta tezlikda sizni turtib ketishiga oz qoldi va siz qattiq {h:g’azablandingiz}.
examples: {r:It was foolish of him to act in rage.} - G‘azab bilan harakat qilish uning ahmoqligi edi.
{r:He was furious about the decision.} - U qarordan juda g‘azablandi.
{r:She was filled with rage after the argument.} - Bahsdan keyin u g‘azabga to‘ldi.
{r:His eyes burned with fury and rage.} - Uning ko'zlari g'azab va qahr bilan yonib turardi.

text: {r:Tender} [ˈtɛndər] – muloyim, yoqimli. Tasavvur qiling ko’p qavatli uy qurish bo’yicha {p:tender} o’tkazilyapti. Eng birinchi talab tender tashkilotchilariga loyihasining kuchliligi emas balki jamoaning {h:muloyim} va yoqimli ekanligi. Chunki ertaga proyektni tugatatish kechib ketsa xaridorlar bilan muloyim gaplashishni bilish kerak quruvchi kompaniya.
examples: {r:It was kind of her to be so tender.} - Uning shunchalik mehrli bo‘lishi juda yaxshi edi.
{r:He was always tender to his children.} - U har doim farzandlariga muloyim edi.
{r:She was emotional about the tender moment.} - U mehrli lahzalardan hissiyotga berildi.
{r:He was careful about the tender plant.} - U muloyim o‘simlikka nihoyatda ehtiyotkor edi.

text: {r:Dawn} [dɔːn] – tong. Tasavvur qiling siz har kuni {h:tong}da {p:DOVON}ga tushib chiqasiz.
examples: {r:I usually wake up at dawn.} - Men odatda tongda uyg'onaman.
{r:She goes running at dawn.} - U tongda yugurishga chiqadi.
{r:She was excited about the dawn hike.} - U tonggi sayr qilishdan xursand edi.
{r:He was glad about the dawn’s beauty.} - U tong go‘zalligidan mamnun edi.

text: {r:Ranch} [ræntʃ] – ferma, rancho. 'Rancho' so’zi ferma ma’nosida o’zbek tilida ham ishlatiladi. Tasavvur qiling sizning {p:RENCH} roveringizda sichqonlar {h:ferma} qurib u yerda qurt-qumursqa ko’paytiryapti ekan.
examples: {r:It was generous of them to invite us to their ranch.} - Ular bizni o‘z fermalariga taklif qilgani juda saxiylik edi.
{r:They were hospitable to the guests at the ranch.} - Ular fermada mehmonlarga mehmondo‘stlik qilishdi.
{r:He dropped his fork while eating frozen vegetables at the ranch.} – U fermada muzlatilgan sabzavotlarni yeyayotib, sanchqisini tushirib yubordi.
{r:The dogs bark loudly on the ranch, and you can definitely hear them from far away.} – Itlar fermada baland ovozda hurishadi va ularni uzoqdan ham aniq eshitish mumkin.

text: {r:Quest} [kwɛst] – qidirish, izlash. Agar yozda havo jazirama issiq bo’lsa hamma {p:kvas} {h:qidirib} qoladi. Shuning uchun yozda kvas biznesi bilan shug’ullaning.
examples: {r:Nothing will stop them in their quest for truth.} - Ularning haqiqat izlashlarini hech nima to'xtata olmaydi.
{r:The journey was difficult to the adventurers on the quest.} - Izlanishdagi sarguzashtchilar uchun sayohat qiyin edi.
{r:He was determined with his quest for justice.} - U adolat izlashda qat’iy edi.
{r:The government had to suspend the treasure quest after the rebel group took control of the area} – Hukumat isyonchilar hududni egallagach, xazina qidiruvini to‘xtatishga majbur bo‘ldi.

text: {r:Stiff} [stɪf] – qattiq, dag’al, egilmaydigan, bukilmaydigan. Apple kompaniyasi asoschisi {p:STIF} Jobs sochini qatiqda yuvardi va shuning uchun ham sochlari {h:dag’al} edi.
examples: {r:It was rude of him to give a stiff response.} - Uning qo‘pol javob bergani beodoblik edi.
{r:This brush was stiff.} - Bu chotka dag'al va bukilmaydigan edi.
{r:He was nervous about the stiff competition.} - U qattiq raqobatdan asabiylashdi.
{r:She was uncomfortable with the stiff chair.} - U dag'al stulda noqulay his qildi.

text: {r:Output} [ˈaʊtpʊt] – ishlab chiqarish hajmi; ijod mahsuli. {p:OUT FUT}boldagi {h:mahsuldorlikni} ko’rsatib beruvchi ko’rsatkichlardan biridir. Odatda outlarda ustunlik qilgan komandaning yutib chiqish ehtimoli ham kattaroqdir.
examples: {r:It was impressive of her to increase the output.} - U mahsulotni oshirgani hayratlanarli edi.
{r:To raise their output, the factory had to impose longer work hours.} - Ishlab chiqarishni oshirish uchun zavod uzoqroq ish soatlarini joriy etishga majbur bo'ldi.
{r:He was concerned about the low output. Subsequently, he took measures.} - U past mahsulot hajmidan xavotirda edi. Keyinchalik u choralar ko'rdi
{r:She was pleased with the output of the project.} - U loyiha natijalaridan mamnun edi.
{r:The factory's daily output was incomplete due to a machine breakdown.} - Zavodning kunlik ishlab chiqarishi mashina buzilishi tufayli chala edi.

text: {r:Stack} [stæk] – uyum, to’p, g’aram; to’plamoq, uymoq. Tasavvur qiling siz {p:STAK}anchik morojnilarni bir joyga {h:uyib tashladingiz}.
examples: {r:Subsequently, I gave away a stack of books to my cousin.} - Keyinchalik men bir uyum kitobni amakivachchamga berib yubordim.
{r:The books were heavy to carry in a stack.} - Kitoblarni uyumda ko‘tarish og‘ir edi.
{r:She put the doll on top of a stack of books} – U qo‘g‘irchoqni kitoblar uyumining ustiga qo‘ydi.
{r:He was busy with the stack of papers.} - U qog‘ozlar uyumi bilan band edi.

text: {r:Dot} [dɒt] – nuqta; nuqta qo’ymoq. 10 yil dota o’ynab hech qanday baraka topmadim shuning uchun bugun {h:DOT}aga {p:nuqta} qo’ymoqchiman.
examples: {r:It was clever of her to connect the dots.} - U nuqtalarni bog‘lagani aqlli ish edi.
{r:He marked the exact spot with a red dot to be precise} – U aniq bo‘lishi uchun qizil nuqta bilan o‘sha joyni belgiladi.
{r:He was curious about the dots on the map.} - U xaritadagi nuqtalar haqida qiziquvchan edi.
{r:She was meticulous with the dots in her design.} - U dizayndagi nuqtalarga nihoyatda sinchkov edi.

text: {r:Distraction} [dɪˈstrækʃən] - chalg'ish, diqqatni bo'lish. Distract(chalg'itmoq) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It was careless of him to cause a distraction.} - Uning diqqatni bo'lishi uning ehtiyotsizligidan edi.
{r:He decided to cancel all distractions and focus on his work.} - U barcha chalg‘ituvchi narsalarni bekor qilib, ishiga e’tibor qaratishga qaror qildi.
{r:She was frustrated about the constant distractions.} - U doimiy chalg'itishlardan asabiylashdi.
{r:He was annoyed with the distractions during work.} - U ish paytidagi chalg'ishlardan asabiylashdi.

text: {r:Fiercely} [ˈfɪərsli] - shiddatli. Fierce(kuchli, shiddatli) so'zining ravish shakli.
examples: {r:It was brave of her to compete so fiercely.} - Uning shiddatli raqobatlashgani jasoratli edi.
{r:The wind was harsh to the trees, blowing fiercely.} - Shamol qattiq esib daraxtlarni ayamasdi.
{r:He was passionate about fiercely defending his beliefs.} - U o‘z e’tiqodlarini shiddatli himoya qilishdan zavqlanardi.
{r:His madness grew fiercely, then seemed to vanish in a moment.} – Uning telbaligi(jahli) keskin kuchaydi, keyin esa bir lahzada g‘oyib bo‘lgandek bo‘ldi.

text: {r:React} [riˈækt] - reaksiya qilmoq.
examples: {r:It was natural of him to react quickly.} - Uning tez reaksiya qilgani tabiiy edi.
{r:He was nervous about how people would react.} - U odamlar qanday reaksiya qilishidan asabiylashdi.
{r:Julia was pleased with how he reacted to the news.} - Julia uning yangilikka qanday reaksiya qilganidan mamnun edi.
{r:The teacher reacted with joy when the teenager decided to enroll} – O‘qituvchi o‘smir ro‘yxatdan o‘tishga qaror qilganida xursand bo‘ldi.

text: {r:Specify} [ˈspɛsɪfaɪ] - aniqlashtirmoq, ochiqlamoq. Barselona futbol jamoasining homiysi o'zgardi. Kim ekanligini {h:ochiqlashimni} so'raysizmi? Yaxshi ochiqlayman. Bu musiqa strim qiladigan dastur {p:SPOTIFAY} ekan.
examples: {r:It was helpful of her to specify the details.} - U tafsilotlarni aniq qilgani foydali edi.
{r:The teacher specified the rules with great caution} – O‘qituvchi qoidalarni katta ehtiyotkorlik bilan ochiqladi.
{r:You need to specify the whole vacation days.} - Siz butun ta'til kunlaringizni aniqlashtirishingiz kerak.
{r:She was meticulous with specifying the requirements.} - U talablarni aniq qilishda nihoyatda e’tiborli edi.

text: {r:Convenience} [kənˈviːniəns] - qulaylik. Convenient(qulay) so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:It was thoughtful of him to consider our convenience.} - U qulayligimizni hisobga olgani uning mulohazaliligidan edi.
{r:The location was perfect to provide convenience for everyone.} - Manzil hammaga qulaylik ta’minlash uchun mukammal edi.
{r:She was excited about the convenience of the new system.} - U yangi tizimning qulayligidan xursand edi.
{r:He was satisfied with the convenience of the online service.} - U onlayn xizmatning qulayligidan qoniqqan edi.

text: {r:Delight} [dɪˈlaɪt] – zavq, xursandchilik; zavqlantirmoq. Men zooparkka borib delfinlarni ko’rib kelaman. Har safar {p:DEL}finni {p:AYT}ganini oborib {h:zavq}lantiraman.
examples: {r:The gift was a surprise to her, bringing great delight.} - Sovg‘a unga katta mamnunlik keltirgan kutilmagan hodisa edi.
{r:She was delighted with the outcome of the event.} - U tadbir natijasidan mamnun edi.

{r:The teacher’s kind words brought great delight, but they did not diminish the necessity of hard work.} - O‘qituvchining iliq so‘zlari katta quvonch keltirdi, ammo bu mehnat qilish zaruratini kamaytirmadi.
{r:The entrepreneur precisely calculated the risks, much to the delight of his team} – Tadbirkor xavflarni aniq hisoblab chiqdi, bu uning jamoasiga juda yoqdi.

text: {r:Timber} [ˈtɪmbər] – qurilish taxtasi, yog’och. Mashhur qo’shiqchi va aktyor Jastin {p:TIMBER}leyk qo’shiq aytishni tashlab o’rmonda daraxt kesib {h:yog’och} tayyorlayapti ekan. Agar Timberleykni qo’shiqlari orqali tanimasangiz vaqt haqidagi kinosi orqali aniq taniysiz.
examples: {r:It was careless of them to waste the timber.} - Ular yog‘ochni isrof qilgani ehtiyotsizlik edi.
{r:The timber was essential to the construction project.} - Yog‘och qurilish loyihasi uchun zarur edi.
{r:He was concerned about the shortage of timber.} - U yog‘och tanqisligidan xavotirda edi.
{r:She was impressed with the quality of the timber.} - U yog‘och sifatidan hayratda edi.

text: {r:Verbal} [ˈvɜːbəl] – og’zaki. Tasavvur qiling kitobdan {p:VERGUL} chiqib kelib “Sen hech qachon {p:vergul} qo’yilgan joyda pauza bilan o’qimaysan. Hozir senga {h:og’zaki} ogohlantirish beryapman. Imlo qoidalariga amal qil bola. Yo’qsa keyingi safar seni maktab direktori oldiga olib kiraman” debdi.
examples: {r:He realized that his verbal insults were a sin.} - U og‘zaki haqoratlari gunoh ekanligini tushundi.
{r:The instructions were understandable to everyone in verbal form.} - Ko‘rsatmalar og‘zaki shaklda hammaga tushunarli edi.
{r:He was nervous about the verbal agreement.} - U og‘zaki kelishuvdan asabiylashdi.
{r:She was satisfied with the verbal confirmation.} - U og‘zaki tasdiqdan qoniqqan edi.

text: {r:Spine} [spaɪn] – tikan; umurtqa. Agar hovlingizdagi tikanlardan qutula olmayotgan bo’lsangiz {p:SP}irtning {p:AYN}iganini seping. {h:Tikan}lardan xalos bo’lasiz shunda.
examples: {r:It was brave of her to endure the spine injury.} - U umurtqa pog‘onasidagi jarohatga chidagani jasoratli edi.
{r:She was careful with her spine during the exercise.} - U mashq paytida umurtqa pog‘onasiga ehtiyotkor edi.
{r:The spine this tribe grows always scares me.} - Bu qabila o'stiradigan tikanlar har doim meni cho'chitadi.
{r:We have no permission to cut these spines.} - Bu tikanlarni kesishga ruxsatimiz yo'q.

text: {r:Dock} [dɒk] – bandargoh. Sizning uyingizdagi {p:DOK}ani chigirtkalar uchib-qo’nuvchi {h:bandargoh} qilib olibdi.
examples: {r:It was generous of them to build the dock.} - Ular bandargoh qurgani saxiylik edi.
{r:The boat was tied to the dock securely.} - Qayiq bandargohga mustahkam bog‘langan edi.
{r:He was excited about the new dock.} - U yangi bandargohdan xursand edi.
{r:The ship arrived at the dock after a long journey to its final destination} – Kema uzoq sayohatdan so‘ng o‘zining yakuniy manziliga yetib kelib, bandargohga to‘xtadi.

text: {r:Summary} [ˈsʌməri] – xulosa, qisqacha mazmun. Yapon {p:samuray}lari haqida {h:xulosam} shuki ular asl janglarda o’zini ko’rsata olmagan, ularning obrazlari va qahramonliklari bo’rttirilgan, hech narsani qoyillatmagan chala jangchilar toifasi.
examples: {r:It was helpful of her to provide a summary.} - U xulosa taqdim etgani foydali edi.
{r:The summary was clear to everyone in the meeting.} - Xulosa yig‘ilishda hamma uchun tushunarli edi.
{r:He was confused about the summary of the report.} - U hisobot xulosasi bo'yicha chalkashdi.
{r:She was pleased with the summary of the project.} - U loyiha xulosasidan mamnun edi.

text: {r:Trim} [trɪm] – qirqmoq, kesmoq(soch, soqolni). Britvada soqolimni tartibli qilib {h:olmoqchi} edim lekin {p:TILIM}ni qirqib oldim.
examples: {r:He went to the barber to trim his moustache before the wedding.} – U to‘y oldidan mo‘ylovini qirtishlash uchun sartaroshga bordi.
{r:He had to agree to a shorter trim for his beard.} - U soqolini qisqaroq oldirishga rozi bo'lishi kerak edi.
{r:The expert looked at the plant, deciding where to trim next.} - Mutaxassis o'simlikka qaradi, qayerdan keyin qirqishni hal qildi.
{r:He trims his beard neatly every Sunday.} – U soqolini har yakshanba chiroyli qilib qirtishlaydi.

text: {r:Butterfly} [ˈbʌtərflaɪ] – kapalak. Do’stingiz {p:BOTIR FL}amastr bilan faqat kapalak rasmini chizib o’tiradi. {h:Kapalaklar}ga qiziqadigan bolada u.
examples: {r:The child ran to the garden to chase a colorful butterfly.} - Bola rangli kapalakni quvish uchun bog'ga yugurdi.
{r:We gazed at the beautiful butterfly resting on the flower.} - Biz gul ustidagi chiroyli kapalakka tikilib qoldik.
{r:Scientists often refer to butterflies when studying insect migration.} - Olimlar hasharotlar migratsiyasini o'rganayotganda ko'pincha kapalaklarga murojaat qiladilar.
{r:At the site, many children wanted to participate in catching a butterfly.} - O‘sha joyda ko‘plab bolalar kapalak tutishda qatnashishni xohlashdi.

text: {r:Summarize} [ˈsʌməraɪz] - xulosa qilmoq, qisqacha bayon qilmoq. E'tibor bering bu so'z xatolardan xulosa qilish ma'nosida emas balki uzunroq hikoya, kino, hisobotlarni qisqacha xulosalash ma'nosida ishlatiladi.
examples: {r:The student tried to explain to the teacher what he had summarized.} - Talaba o'qituvchiga nima xulosa qilganini tushuntirishga harakat qildi.
{r:Please listen to the full story before you attempt to summarize it.} - Xulosa qilishga urinishdan oldin to'liq hikoyani tinglang.
{r:The manager looked at the detailed report and asked him to summarize it.} - Menejer batafsil hisobotga qaradi va uni xulosa qilishni so'radi.
{r:Can you summarize how to retain new information better?} - Yangi ma'lumotlarni qanday qilib yaxshiroq eslab qolish (saqlab qolish) mumkinligini qisqacha tushuntira olasizmi?

text: {r:Delighted} [dɪˈlaɪtɪd] - mamnun, xursand. Delight so'zidan yasalgan. Mnemonik namuna uchun o'tgan darsga qarang.
examples: {r:Everyone smiled at the delighted child opening her presents.} - Hamma sovg'alarini ochayotgan xursand bolaga kulib boqdi.
{r:He laughed at the funny joke, looking truly delighted.} - U kulgili hazilga kuldi, chinakamiga xursand ko'rinardi.
{r:The good news came to them, and they were utterly delighted.} - Yaxshi yangilik ularga keldi va ular nihoyatda mamnun edilar.
{r:The crowd cheered at the delighted winner receiving the award.} - Olomon mukofotni olayotgan xursand g'olibni olqishladi.

text: {r:Limb} [lɪm] – qo’l-oyoqlar. Tasavvur qiling mana bu {p:lim}onga bitta chapak chalsangiz {h:qo’l-oyoq} chiqarib yurib ketadi.
examples: {r:His limbs are hurting mildly.} - Uning qo'l-oyog'i yengil og'riyapti.
{r:The doctor looked at the swollen limb to assess the injury.} - Shifokor shikastlanishni baholash uchun shishgan qo‘l-oyoqqa qaradi.
{r:She swears her children are the most precious parts of her life, like her own limbs.} – U farzandlari hayotining eng qimmatli bo‘laklari, xuddi o‘z qo'l-oyog'i kabi, deb qasam ichdi.
{r:She read a credible story about a soldier who walked again with an artificial limb.} – U sun’iy a’zo bilan yana yura olgan askar haqida ishonarli hikoya o‘qidi.

text: {r:Tune} [tjuːn] – kuy, navo, musiqa. {h:Musiqa} chiqaradigan {p:TYUN}ing faqat bizda O’zbekistonda.
examples: {r:Please listen to this beautiful tune I composed.} - Iltimos, men bastalagan ushbu go'zal kuyni tinglang.

{r:With a clever tune, he hoped to split the attention of the bored audience and bring them back into the show.} - U o'zining zukko kuyi bilan zerikkan tomoshabinlarning e'tiborini bo'lishni va ularni shouga qaytarishni umid qildi.
{r:She loves to sing to her favorite tunes in the shower.} - U dushda o'zining sevimli kuylariga qo'shiq aytishni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:The audience clapped at the catchy tune the band played.} - Tomoshabinlar guruh kuylagan esda qolarli kuyni olqishladilar.

text: {r:Bride} [braɪd] - kelin.
examples: {r:All eyes were fixed at the beautiful bride as she walked down the hall.} - Hamma ko'zlar go'zal kelinga qaratilgan edi u koridor bo'ylab yurganida.
{r:An angel statue stood near the lawn where the bride and groom took photos} – Kelin va kuyov suratga tushgan maysazor yonida farishta haykali turardi.
{r:Guests applauded the outstanding beauty of the bride.} – Mehmonlar kelinning betakror go‘zalligiga qarsak chalishdi.
{r:The loyal bride was ready to make any sacrifice for her husband.} – Sodiq kelin eri uchun har qanday qurbonlikka tayyor edi.

text: {r:Groom} [ɡruːm] - kuyov. Tasavvur qiling sizlarning kuyovingiz telefonda rosa sekin gapiradi. {p:GROM}kaga qo'ymasangiz eshitmaysiz {h:kuyovni}.
examples: {r:The groom plans to propose a new dance, but the space is too tight.} - Kuyov yangi raqs taklif qilmoqchi, lekin joy juda tor.
{r:Guests looked at the happy groom as he greeted them.} - Mehmonlar ularni kutib olgan baxtli kuyovga qaradilar.
{r:Her groom was a shameless guy.} - Uning kuyovi uyatsiz yigit edi.
{r:The groom tackled the concrete task of arranging the wedding chairs.} – Kuyov to‘y stullarini joylashtirishdek aniq vazifani bajardi.

text: {r:Warehouse} [ˈwerhaʊs] - ombor.
examples: {r:The warehouse was full of various stuff waiting for delivery.} - Ombor turli xil yetkazib berilishni kutayotgan narsalar bilan to'la edi.
{r:Security cameras focused at the main entrance of the warehouse all night.} - Xavfsizlik kameralari butun tun omborning asosiy kirish joyiga qaratilgan edi.
{r:He had to shout to his colleague across the noisy warehouse.} - U shovqinli ombor bo'ylab hamkasbiga baqirishi kerak edi.
{r:It was difficult to distinguish his small shop from the massive warehouse next door without a clear sign.} - Aniq belgi bo'lmasa, uning kichik do'konini yonidagi ulkan ombordan farqlash qiyin edi.

text: {r:Nationwide} [ˈneɪʃənˈwaɪd] - mamlakat bo'ylab. Nation(millat) va wide(keng) so'zlarining birlashuvidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The new policy will apply to all citizens nationwide.} - Yangi siyosat butun mamlakat bo'ylab barcha fuqarolarga qo'llaniladi.
{r:The advertising campaign aimed at reaching consumers nationwide.} - Reklama kampaniyasi butun mamlakat bo'ylab iste'molchilarga yetib borishni maqsad qildi.
{r:The news spread to every household nationwide within hours.} - Yangilik bir necha soat ichida butun mamlakat bo'ylab har bir xonadonga tarqaldi.
{r:Researchers looked at the results of the survey conducted nationwide.} - Tadqiqotchilar butun mamlakat bo'ylab o'tkazilgan so'rov natijalariga qaradilar.

text: {r:Allowance} [əˈlaʊəns] - "Allowance" so‘zi o‘zbek tilida "nafaqa", "to‘lov", "ruxsat berilgan miqdor" degan ma’nolarni anglatadi.
examples: {r:Initially, she agreed to a smaller weekly allowance but later she demanded more.} - U dastlab haftalik nafaqaning kichikroq miqdoriga rozi bo'ldi lekin keyinroq ko'proq talab qildi.
{r:Parents often give their children an allowance for doing the housework.} - Ota-onalar ko'pincha farzandlariga uy ishlari uchun to'lov beradilar.
{r:My monthly allowance seems to diminish quickly, no matter how careful I am.} - Mening oylik nafaqam qanchalik ehtiyotkor bo'lmayin, tezda kamayib ketayotgandek tuyulayapti.
{r:He laughed at the idea of living on such a tiny allowance.} - U shunday kichik nafaqaga yashash g'oyasiga kuldi.

text: {r:Implementation} [ˌɪmplɪmənˈteɪʃən] - amalda tadbiq qilish, joriy etish. Implement so'zidan yasalgan.
examples: {r:The team is ready to move to the final implementation phase.} - Jamoa yakuniy amalga oshirish bosqichiga o'tishga tayyor.
{r:They aimed at achieving quick implementation of the new policy.} - Ular yangi siyosatni tez joriy etishni maqsad qilishdi.
{r:The report clearly referred to the smooth implementation of the new system.} - Hisobot yangi tizimning silliq amalga oshirilishiga aniq ishora qildi.
{r:Everyone contributed to the successful implementation of the project.} - Hamma loyihaning muvaffaqiyatli amalga oshirilishiga hissa qo'shdi.

text: {r:Grandson} [ˈɡrændsʌn] - o'g'il nevara.
examples: {r:Grandpa loves to talk with his clever grandson about history.} - Bobo o'zining aqlli nabirasi bilan tarix haqida gaplashishni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:Grandma always smiled at her energetic grandson playing in the yard.} - Buvisi hovlida o'ynayotgan g'ayratli nabirasiga har doim kulib boqardi.
{r:They waved to their grandson as he left for summer camp.} - Ular yozgi lagerga ketayotgan nabirasiga qo'l siltashdi.
{r:He laughed at his grandson's funny drawings.} - U nabirasining kulgili chizmalariga kuldi.
{r:The grandfather had to swear to his grandson that he would teach him how to fish.} - Bobo nabirasiga baliq ovlashni o'rgatishga qasam ichishga majbur bo'ldi.

text: {r:Granddaughter} [ˈɡrændɔːtər] - qiz nevara.
examples: {r:She loves to read to her granddaughter before bedtime every night.} - U har kecha uyqudan oldin nevarasiga kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'radi.
{r:He proudly looked at his granddaughter's winning science project.} - U faxr bilan nevarasining g'olib ilmiy loyihasiga qaradi.
{r:They sent a special gift to their granddaughter for her graduation.} - Ular nevarasiga bitiruv marosimi uchun maxsus sovg'a yuborishdi.
{r:His granddaughter loves hearing stories about the old folks from their village.} - Uning nabirasi qishloqlaridagi keksa odamlar haqidagi hikoyalarni eshitishni yaxshi ko'radi.

text: {r:Harass} [həˈræs] - tahqirlamoq. {p:XO'ROS} 30 ta xotinlari-tovuqlarning talabi, egovlashi, ba'zan birgalashib mazax qilishlaridan o'zini {h:tahqirlangandek} sezarkan.
examples: {r:The company leadership had to apologize to the employee for the harassment.} - Kompaniya rahbariyati hurmatsizlik(tahqir) uchun xodimdan uzr so'rashga majbur bo'ldi.
{r:The leadership confirmed that she was consistently harassed.} - Rahbariyat u doimo ish joyida tahqirlanib kelinganini tasdiqladi.
{r:Always report to HR immediately if you feel anyone is trying to harass you.} - Agar kimdir sizni tahqirlashga urinayotganini his qilsangiz, darhol kadrlar bo'limiga xabar bering.
{r:Buddy, if you face harassment in workplace, tell me immediately.} - Do'stim, agar ish joyida hurmatsizlikka duch kelsang, darhol menga ayt.

text: {r:Sock}[sɑːk] – paypoq. Tasavvur qiling {p:SAK}kizoyoqni sakkizta {h:paypog’i} bor ekan.
examples: {r:I bought a new pair of socks.} - Men yangi juft paypoq sotib oldim.
{r:He used to wear thick socks in winter.} - U qishda qalin paypoq kiyardi.
{r:Her socks are colorful and funny.} - Uning paypoqlari rang-barang va kulgili.
{r:Don’t forget to pack your socks.} - Paypoqlaringni joylashni unutma.

text: {r:Look forward to} - intizorlik bilan kutmoq.
examples: {r:I look forward to our vacation next month.} - Men kelasi oydagi ta'tilni intiqlik bilan kutyapman.
{r:She's looking forward to seeing her family.} - U oilasini ko'rishni sabrsizlik bilan kutmoqda.
{r:We looked forward to the concert all year. Subsequently, it was cancelled.} - Biz butun yil davomida konsertni intiqlik bilan kutdik. Keyinchalik u bekor qilindi.
{r:They're looking forward to the weekend.} - Ular dam olish kunlarini intizorlik bilan kutyapti.

text: {r:Get by} - bir amallamoq, eplamoq.
examples: {r:We can get by with one car for now.} - Hozircha biz bitta mashina bilan ham bir amallaymiz.
{r:He gets by on a small salary.} - U kichik maosh bilan o'zini eplaydi.
{r:My Spanish is basic, but I get by in Mexico.} - Mening ispan tilim boshlang'ich darajada, lekin Meksikada o'zimni eplab yuraman.
{r:They got by with very little during the war.} - Ular urush paytida juda ozgina ovqat bilan ham bir amallashgan.
{r:They are tolerating the poverty, getting by with minimum wage.} - Ular minimal oylik bilan ham bir amallashyapti va kambag'allikka chidashyapti.

text: {r:Check in} - ro'yxatdan o'tmoq(mehmonxona, aeroport).
examples: {r:We'll check in at the hotel at 3 PM.} - Biz soat 3 da mehmonxonaga ro'yxatdan o'tamiz.
{r:You must check in two hours before the flight.} - Parvozdan ikki soat oldin ro'yxatdan o'tishingiz kerak.
{r:She checked in online to save time.} - U vaqtni tejash uchun onlayn ro'yxatdan o'tdi.
{r:Let's check in first, then explore the city.} - Avval ro'yxatdan o'tamiz, keyin shahar aylanamiz.

text: {r:Check out} - chiqib ketishdagi ro'yxatdan o'tish. Check in ning teskarisi.
examples: {r:Check out is at 11 AM tomorrow.} - Mehmonxonadan chiqish ertaga soat 11 da.
{r:We checked out early to catch the train.} - Biz poyezdga ulgurish uchun erta chiqib ketdik.
{r:Don't forget to check out before noon.} - Peshindan oldin chiqishni unutmang.
{r:He checked out at the airport and took a taxi to the hotel.} - U aeroportdan chiqib ketdi va mehmonxonaga taksi to'xtatdi.

text: {r:Fill out} - to'ldirmoq(so'rovnoma, ariza, forma).
examples: {r:Please fill out this application form.} - Iltimos, ushbu formani to'ldiring.
{r:She filled out the survey quickly.} - U so'rovnomani tezda to'ldirdi.
{r:You need to fill out these papers at the doctor's.} - Shifokor qabulida ushbu qog'ozlarni to'ldirishingiz kerak.
{r:He filled out the job application carefully.} - U ish uchun arizani sinchkovlik bilan to'ldirdi.

text: {r:Put on} - kiymoq.
examples: {r:Put on your jacket—it's cold outside!} - Kurtkangni kiy, tashqarida sovuq!
{r:She put on her silly glasses to read.} - U o'qish uchun ahmoqona ko'zoynagini taqdi.
{r:I put on a hat to protect myself from the sun.} - Quyoshdan himoyalanish uchun men shlyapa kiyib oldim.
{r:He put on his uniform for work.} - U ishga formasini kiyib oldi.

text: {r:Take off} - yechmoq.
examples: {r:Take off your shoes before entering.} - Kirishdan oldin poyabzalingizni yeching.
{r:She took off her wet socks.} - U ho'l paypoqlarini yechib oldi.
{r:It's hot, I'll take off this sweater.} - Issiq ekan, bu sviterni yechaman.
{r:He took off his tie after the meeting.} - U yig'ilishdan keyin galstukni yechdi.

text: {r:Plug in} - tokka tiqmoq, quvvatlamoq.
examples: {r:Plug in your laptop to charge it.} - Noutbukni quvvatlash uchun ulang.
{r:I plugged in the fan because it was hot.} - Issiq bo'lgani uchun men ventilyatorni tokka tiqdim.
{r:Make sure you plug in the Christmas lights.} - Rojdestvo chiroqlarini ulanganligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
{r:She plugged in her phone overnight.} - U telefonini tun bo'yi rozetkada quvvatladi.

text: {r:Run out of} - tugab qolmoq.
examples: {r:We ran out of milk this morning.} - Bugun ertalab sutimiz tugab qoldi.
{r:The car ran out of fuel on the highway.} - Avtomobil trassada yoqilg'isiz qoldi.
{r:Don't let your phone run out of battery.} - Telefoningiz quvvatsiz qolishiga yo'l qo'ymang.
{r:They ran out of time to finish the project.} - Ularning loyihani tugatishga vaqti yetmay qoldi.
{r:We don't run out of miracles.} - Bizda mo'jizalar hali tugab qolgani yo'q

text: {r:Sort out} - hal qilmoq, tartibga keltirmoq.
examples: {r:Let's sort out this mess together.} - Keling, bu tartibsizlikni birga hal qilamiz.
{r:She sorted out the paperwork for the trip.} - U sayohat uchun hujjatlarni tartibga keltirdi.
{r:He sorted out the problem quickly.} - U muammoni tezda hal qildi.
{r:Can you sort out the problem on my behalf since I'm not there?} - Men u yerda bo'lmaganim uchun muammoni mening nomimdan hal qila olasizmi?

text: {r:Turn out} - bo'lib chiqmoq, bo'lib yakunlanmoq.
examples: {r:The party turned out to be fun!} - Bazm qiziqarli bo'lib chiqdi!
{r:It turned out later that she knew my brother.} - Keyinchalik aniq bo'ldiki u mening akamni taniydi.
{r:It turns out the essence of life is in kindness.} - Men uchun hayot mohiyati mehribonlikda bo'lib chiqdi.
{r:How did your test turn out?} - Testingiz qanday yakunlandi?

text: {r:Carry on} - davom ettirmoq.
examples: {r:Carry on with your work while I'm gone.} - Men ketganimda ishni davom ettiring.
{r:Despite the noise, she carried on reading.} - Shovqinga qaramay, u o'qishni davom ettirdi.
{r:We'll carry this tradition on for years.} - Biz ushbu an'anani yillar davom ettiramiz.
{r:"Carry on," said the teacher.} - "Davom eting," dedi o'qituvchi.

text: {r:Rip off} - pulini shilmoq, juda qimmatga sotmoq.
examples: {r:This store ripped me off!} - Bu do'kon mendan ortiqcha pul olgan!
{r:They ripped us off with expensive tickets.} - Ular bizni qimmatbaho chiptalar bilan pulimizni shilishdi.
{r:Don't get ripped off by street vendors.} - Ko'cha sotuvchilar tomonidan aldanmang.
{r:10 dollars for coffee? What a rip-off!} - Qahva uchun 10 dollar? Bu qanday aldov!

text: {r:Turn up} - balandlamoq, ovozni ko'tarmoq.
examples: {r:Turn up the music, I love this song!} - Musiqani baland qiling, men bu qo'shiqni yaxshi ko'raman!
{r:Can you turn up the TV volume?} - Televizor ovozini baland qila olasizmi?
{r:She turned up her headphones too loud.} - U eshitish vositasining ovozini juda baland qildi.
{r:I turned up the radio to hear better.} - Men radio ovozini yaxshiroq eshitish uchun baland qildim.

text: {r:Turn down} - pasaytirmoq.
examples: {r:Turn down the volume, please.} - Ovozni pastroq qiling, iltimos.
{r:He turned down the TV during dinner.} - U kechki ovqat payti televizorni pastroq qildi.
{r:Can you turn your phone down?} - Telefoningizni pastroq qila olasizmi?
{r:Turn the music down after 10 PM.} - Soat 10 dan keyin musiqani pastroq qiling.
{r:Please turn down the volume; this ridiculous noise is giving me a headache.} - Iltimos, ovozni pasaytiring; bu bema'ni shovqin menga bosh og'rig'i bermoqda.

text: {r:Switch on} - yoqmoq.
examples: {r:Switch on the lights when you enter.} - Kirganda chiroqlarni yoqing.
{r:She switched on the computer.} - U kompyuterni yoqdi.
{r:I'll switch on the heater, as it's cold now.} - Men isitgichni yoqaman, hozir sovuqligi uchun.
{r:He switched on the blender to make juice.} - U sharbat tayyorlash uchun blenderni yoqdi.

text: {r:Switch off} - o'chirmoq.
examples: {r:Switch off the TV before bed.} - Yotishdan oldin televizorni o'chiring.
{r:Don't forget to switch off the oven.} - Duxobkani o'chirishni unutmang.
{r:She switched off her phone during the flight.} - U parvoz paytida telefonini o'chirdi.
{r:We switched off all the lights to save energy.} - Energiya tejash uchun biz barcha chiroqlarni o'chirdik.

text: {r:Pick up} - olib ketmoq, olib kelmoq.
examples: {r:I'll pick you up at 7 PM.} - Men sizni soat 7 da olib ketaman.
{r:She picks up her son from school daily.} - U o'g'lini har kuni maktabdan olib ketadi.
{r:Can you pick up some groceries?} - Siz oziq-ovqat olib kelib bera olasizmi?
{r:We picked up our friends at the station.} - Biz do'stlarimizni bekatdan olib ketdik.

text: {r:Make up} - ...dan iborat bo'lmoq.
examples: {r:This book is made up of short stories.} - Ushbu kitob qisqa hikoyalardan iborat.
{r:The team is made up of experts.} - Jamoa ekspertlardan iborat.
{r:Water is made up of hydrogen and oxygen.} - Suv vodorod va kisloroddan iborat.
{r:The class is made up of 20 students.} - Sinf 20 talabadan iborat.

text: {r:Turn down} - rad etmoq.
examples: {r:She turned down the job offer.} - U ish taklifini rad etdi.
{r:He turned down the invitation to the party.} - U bazmga taklifni rad etdi.
{r:The publisher turned down my book proposal.} - Nashriyot mening kitob taklifimni rad etdi.
{r:Don't turn down free help when you need it.} - Sizga kerak bo'lganda bepul yordamni rad etmang.

text: {r:Show off} - nimadir bilan maqtanmoq.
examples: {r:He showed off his new car to local folk.} - U o'zining yangi mashinasi bilan mahalliy xalqqa maqtandi.
{r:Kids often show off their toys.} - Bolalar ko'pincha o'yinchoqlari bilan maqtanishadi.
{r:Stop showing off - we know you're smart!} - Maqtanishni to'xtating - biz sizni aqlli ekanligingizni bilamiz!
{r:She showed off her cooking skills at dinner.} - U kechki ovqatda oshpazlik ko'nikmalarini namoyish etdi.

text: {r:Slow down} - sekinlashmoq.
examples: {r:Slow down! You're driving too fast.} - Sekinlashtiring! Siz juda tez haydayapsiz.
{r:The doctor told him to slow down at work.} - Shifokor unga ishda sekinlashishni tavsiya qildi.
{r:The train slowed down as it approached the station.} - Poyezd stansiyaga yaqinlashganda sekinlashdi.
{r:Can you slow down? I can't understand your English.} - Sekin gapirishingiz mumkinmi? Men sizning ingliz tilingizni tushunmayapman.

{r:Please slow down when driving near the school, teenagers might suddenly cross the road.} - Maktab yaqinida haydash payti iltimos, tezlikni pasaytiring, chunki o'smir to'satdan yo'lni kesib o'tishi mumkin.

text: {r:Pick up} - o'rganmoq.
examples: {r:Children pick up languages quickly.} - Bolalar tillarni tez o'rganishadi.
{r:I picked up some Spanish while traveling.} - Men sayohat qilayotib biroz ispan tilini o'rgandim.
{r:She picked up bad habits from her friends.} - U do'stlaridan yomon odatlarni o'rgandi.
{r:He picked up the guitar basics in a month.} - U bir oyda gitara asoslarini o'zlashtirdi.

text: {r:Show up} - kelmoq, paydo bo'lmoq.
examples: {r:Only 10 people showed up for the meeting.} - Faqat 10 kishi yig'ilishga keldi.
{r:She showed up late to her own wedding!} - U o'z to'yiga kechikib keldi!
{r:The sun finally showed up after days of rain.} - Quyosh nihoyat bir necha kunlik yomg'irdan keyin paydo bo'ldi.
{r:Don't promise to help if you won't show up.} - Agar kelmasangiz, yordam berishga va'da bermang.

text: {r:Shut up} - jim bo'lmoq, og'izni yummoq.
examples: {r:Shut up! I'm trying to concentrate.} - Jim bo'ling! Men diqqatni jamlashga harakat qilyapman.
{r:He wouldn't shut up about his new job.} - U yangi ishi haqida gapirishni to'xtatmagan bo'lardi.
{r:I told them to shut up during the movie.} - Men ularga kino davomida jim bo'lishni aytdim.
{r:Sometimes you just need to shut up and listen.} - Ba'zida shunchaki jim bo'lib tinglash kerak.

text: {r:Shut down} - yopmoq, yopilmoq.
examples: {r:The factory shut down last year.} - Zavod o'tgan yili yopildi.
{r:My computer keeps shutting down unexpectedly.} - Kompyuterim kutilmaganda o'chib qolyapti.
{r:They shut down the website for maintenance.} - Ular saytni texnik xizmat uchun yopdilar.
{r:The government shut down illegal businesses.} - Hukumat noqonuniy bizneslarni yopdi.

text: {r:Write down} - yozib olmoq.
examples: {r:Write down the phone number before you forget.} - Telefon raqamini unutmasdan yozing.
{r:I wrote down all the important dates.} - Men barcha muhim sanalarni yozib oldim.
{r:Students should write down the homework.} - Talabalar uy vazifasini yozib olishlari kerak.
{r:She wrote down the recipe for me.} - U retseptni men uchun yozib oldi.

text: {r:Grow up} - o'smoq, katta bo'lmoq.
examples: {r:I grew up in a small town.} - Men kichik shaharda o'sdim.
{r:When you grow up, you'll realise.} - Siz katta bo'lganingizda tushunasiz.
{r:He wants to be a doctor when he grows up.} - U katta bo'lganda shifokor bo'lishni xohlaydi.
{r:We grew up watching the same TV shows.} - Biz bir xil televizion ko'rsatuvlarni tomosha qilib o'sdik.

text: {r:Bring up} - o'stirmoq, katta qilmoq.
examples: {r:Parents work hard to bring up their children well, but they later realise it was not easy.} – Ota-onalar farzandlarini yaxshi tarbiyalash uchun ko‘p mehnat qilishadi, lekin keyin bu oson bo‘lmaganini anglashadi.
{r:She was brought up in a small town and later realised how much it shaped her life.} – U kichik shaharchada tarbiyalangan va keyin bu uning hayotini qanchalik shakllantirganini angladi.
{r:She was brought up in a remote village.} - U olis qishloqda o'sgan.
{r:The merchant worked hard to bring up his daughter, who later became a wise queen} – Savdogar qizini tarbiyalash uchun ko‘p mehnat qildi, u keyinchalik dono malika bo‘ldi.

text: {r:Make up} - to'qimoq, o'ylab topmoq.
examples: {r:A shameless student made up an excuse for being late.} - Uyatsiz talaba kechikkaniga bahona o'ylab topdi.
{r:Don't make up stories to impress people.} - Odamlarni hayratda qoldirish uchun hikoyalar o'ylab topmang.
{r:The children made up a game with their toys.} - Bolalar o'yinchoqlari bilan o'yin o'ylab topishdi.
{r:She made up the whole testimony.} - U butun guvohlikni o'ylab topdi.

text: {r:Mess up} - buzib qo'ymoq, tartibsiz qilmoq.
examples: {r:I messed up the recipe by adding salt instead of sugar.} - Men shakar o'rniga tuz qo'shib retseptni buzdim.
{r:Don't mess up this opportunity!} - Ushbu imkoniyatni buzib qo'ymang!
{r:He messed up his speech by forgetting the words.} - U so'zlarni unutib nutqini buzdi.
{r:One wrong move could mess up the whole plan.} - Bir noto'g'ri harakat butun rejani buzib qo'yishi mumkin.
{r:Don't mess up your reputation by being quick to condemn others without knowing.} - Boshqalarni bilmasdan tezda qoralab, obro'yingizni yo'qotib qo'ymang.

text: {r:Save up} - pul yig'moq.
examples: {r:We're saving up for a new car.} - Biz yangi mashina uchun pul yig'yapmiz.
{r:It took years to save up for college.} - Kollej uchun pul yig'ish yillar talab qildi.
{r:She saves up all her tips for vacation.} - U barcha choychaqalarni ta'til uchun yig'adi.
{r:Kids should learn to save up for books.} - Bolalar kitob uchun pul yig'ishni o'rganishlari kerak.

text: {r:Look up} - qidirib topmoq(kitob, jadval yoki internetdan).
examples: {r:Look up the word in the dictionary.} - Lug'atdan so'zni qidirib toping.
{r:I'll look up the train schedule online.} - Men poezd jadvalini onlayn qidiraman.
{r:He looked up her address in the directory.} - U ma'lumotnoma orqali uning manzilini qidirib topdi.
{r:Look up the recipe on your phone.} - Telefoningizdan retseptni qidirib toping.

text: {r:Pay back} - qarzni qaytarmoq, qaytarib to'lamoq.
examples: {r:When will you pay back the loan?} - Siz qarzni qachon qaytarasiz?
{r:I paid back my friend last week.} - Men do'stimga o'tgan hafta pulni qaytarib berdim.
{r:It took years to pay back the mortgage.} - Ipotekani to'lash yillarni talab qildi.
{r:Always pay back what you borrow.} - Qarzga olgan narsangizni har doim qaytarib bering.

text: {r:Throw away} - tashlab yubormoq.
examples: {r:Don't throw away those old photos!} - O'sha eski fotosuratlarni tashlab yubormang!
{r:Julia threw away all his letters.} - Julia uning barcha xatlarini tashlab yubordi.
{r:We throw away too much food.} - Biz juda ko'p ovqatni tashlaymiz.
{r:Throw the broken chair away.} - Singan stulni tashlab yuboring.
